4257680.short_description: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

4257790.title: Kart Racing Strike
4257790.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Racing, Simulation, Sports
4257790.short_description: Kart Racing Strike is a fast-paced arcade racing game where players race karts through dynamic tracks, beat lap records, and compete for first place. Easy to play, challenging to master, and built for pure racing fun.

4258010.title: Ocean Journey
4258010.short_description: This is a relaxing and therapeutic game where players control a ship, accompanied by a little sprite, to explore this boundless sea. Of course, there will be many dangers and unexpected encounters along the way. Choose the best strategy while avoiding danger to reach even greater destinations!

4258060.title: Castle
4258060.genre: Action, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4258060.short_description: Castle is a tactical FPS that combines fast-paced team combat with the strategic depth of chess. Instead of controlling a single character, you command your entire squad and switch between pieces in real time to outthink and outmaneuver your opponents.

4258180.title: Inquiry Counsel逆转茶食人
4258180.short_description: "Hold on!" A court battle game set in ancient China's Song Dynasty! In the government office of Lin'an County during the Song Dynasty of ancient China, many bizarre murder cases occurred! The protagonist engages in intense court battles with the county captain of Lin'an to find the real culprit!

4258340.title: I'm a Human
4258340.short_description: Forget defense. This is Reverse Tower Defense where you are the threat. Lead the AI, build robots and destroy human bases.Your goal is invasion. Your weapon is the swarm.

4258370.title: Task Force Barbro
4258370.short_description: Task Force Barbro is real-time tactical infiltration in an alternate Cold War Sweden. Build the ultimate Stay-Behind unit, and take up the fight against occupiers and traitors. Guns, stealth or subversion.. the choice is yours!

4258440.title: Offroad Arcade
4258440.short_description: Offroad Arcade is a retro-inspired arcade offroad racing game with switchable pixel effects, multiple game modes, and progression-based unlocks. Race, explore, and master 20 tracks across diverse biomes.

4258450.title: Catmarine
4258450.short_description: Catmarine is a chaotic, co-operative, typing game. Type to navigate through an ocean world with your cat submarine, the Catmarine! Use the various terminals inside of the Catmarine to maneuver it and to defend against oceanic dangers. Communicate, collaborate, and type as fast as you can!

4258480.title: Gun Up
4258480.short_description: Kill the undead, get new weapons, combine weapons, kill even more undead! Over 20 weapons, INFINITE combinations. Featuring different locations to play and survive. How long can you survive?

4258500.title: Nuts and Bolts
4258500.short_description: Sort the Bolts and Nuts: 30 addictive levels of matching nuts to bolts. Easy to learn, hard to master.

4258520.title: GoSifu(师傅快出招)
4258520.short_description: <GoSifu> is a personal indie work of roguelike turn-based card strategy. You will recruit and lead Masters with unique abilities, collect various skills, then sort, combine, and upgrade them. Defeat one powerful enemy after another in turn-based battles with auto-battle functionality.

4258540.title: The Bunker Freak
4258540.short_description: You're trapped in an abandoned bunker with no way out. Collect items and solve puzzles to escape, but be careful, because The Bunker Freak is always watching...

4258550.title: AMEN 11 11
4258550.short_description: AMEN 11 11 is a hidden object adventure game set in an atmosphere of apocalypse and psychological horror. The player's task is to find objects hidden on the maps.

4258590.title: Insanity Path
4258590.short_description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

4258680.title: Arctic Grave
4258680.short_description: Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo facility's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of this place, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you.

4258780.title: Pixel It!
4258780.short_description: Pixel it! – A Tetris-inspired puzzle game where you must recreate images by placing falling pieces. Play solo to relax, challenge your friends through online leaderboards, or unleash your creativity with the level editor and creative mode.

4258790.title: The Gardener
4258790.short_description: In this puzzle game you explore a grand garden, discover exotic flora and uncover their rules to solve tile-based lawn mowing puzzles. You play as Hectare who receives a mysterious letter from the missing owner of this garden asking you to tend to the lawns. Solve puzzles and uncover the mystery!

4258800.title: Mutant Survivors
4258800.short_description: Fuse elements. Evolve your weapons. Destroy the swarm. Mutant Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven where elemental fusion shapes your power. Combine 5 elements to create 10 devastating hybrid evolutions, defeat colossal bosses, and face Voltris.

4258890.title: Recursive
4258890.short_description: A recursive incremental game where every system feeds another. Click enemies, unlock towns with unique minigames and currencies, and channel everything into your Giant’s growing power.

4258910.title: Hunter From Hell
4258910.short_description: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

4258960.title: Rise of State
4258960.short_description: Rise of State is a state management game focused on leadership and strategy. Every decision you make affects public happiness, military strength, the economy, and political stability. Manage crises, define your ideology, and try to keep your state standing.

4258990.title: Ambient Prologue
4258990.short_description: A short atmospheric action-adventure where you take on a role of Princess Krinita: leave royal responsibilities and dive into wanders of forgotten places, face powerful magical entities, and uncovers secrets of the past of this ancient civilization.

4259060.title: Reap & Repay
4259060.short_description: Reap and collect the crops to repay the debt of villagers in this short, non-idle incremental game. Start weak, invest in the skill tree to unlock various new abilities and become strong enough to harvest every field.

4259170.title: EXOTERRA: A Space Journey
4259170.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4259170.short_description: EXOTERRA: A Space Journey is a first-person science fiction puzzle game set aboard a stranded ship in the vast, dark expanse of outer space. Explore the HOPE-03 and uncover the mysteries it holds as you solve fully interactive escape-room-style chambers powered by a physics-based system.

4259180.title: Animal Avenue
4259180.short_description: Build an animal city where every decision matters—from parks and schools to factories and city festivals.

4259220.title: SUBSUMED
4259220.short_description: A claustrophobic first-person horror game about crawling through a dark, winding cave system in search of three missing divers.

4259320.title: Gods vs Steam
4259320.short_description: A physics-driven action roguelite. Grab and hurl enemies with divine force. Turn the environment into a weapon. Become a towering god.

4259340.title: Silent Core Night – Holiday Edition
4259340.short_description: A quiet holiday experiment. Tend a softly glowing core like a small campfire, and let the room warm and calm.

4259520.title: Hamster, Eat, Run
4259520.short_description: This is a casual strategy game about being a hamster on your first escape. To survive out there, you must learn to efficiently gather energy from food and upgrade hoarding level to gain new survival tricks. Fail, you'll have no choice but to be a house pet again!

4259560.title: Nightmare On Maple Road
4259560.short_description: NIGHTMARE ON MAPLE ROAD is a survival horror game about juggling two characters at once, where failure for one means death for both. Solve puzzles, explore an abandoned house, and endure quick-time events while keeping them both alive.

4259600.title: Cropocalypse
4259600.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer farming game where you grow crops by day and sabotage your neighbors by night.

4259690.title: Ajnabee - The Unknown
4259690.short_description: Follow Naina’s daily life as it slowly stops belonging to her alone. 🚪 An unseen presence watches 👁️, remembers 📝, and interferes 🕰️ as her sense of safety slowly collapses. 🌑 A deeply atmospheric psychological horror set in India, exploring obsession 💔, fear 😰, and emotional vulnerability.

4259720.title: BECOME LIFE
4259720.short_description: A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

4259770.title: FARM RACING.
4259770.short_description: Train hard, respect your horse, and become a true champion in Farm Racing

4259800.title: Gear Slots
4259800.short_description: Spin the wheels of weaponry to incrementally upgrade your gear while endless monsters are defeated by your idle attacks. Watch your hoard of coins grow and find new ways to spend them to tip the scales of luck in your favor.

4259990.title: Corner King
4259990.short_description: Run you own boxing gym and lead your fighters to the top. Train your fighters, handle journalists and press conferences, manage finances, develop talents and much more. Every decision matters. Guide your fighters from the corner in Real Time as you watch them fight.

4260090.title: Bottle It!: Beverage Simulator
4260090.short_description: Create unique drinks by experimenting with ingredients, learn from customer feedback, and grow your business from a small stand into a thriving beverage empire in this flavorful simulation game.

4260120.title: Whispers of the Gallows
4260120.short_description: Whispers of the Gallows is an atmospheric horror game inspired by the classic Hangman game, reimagined in a dark Victorian setting. The player explores an old, haunted house made up of multiple main rooms, each representing a different level and a different hidden word.

4260150.title: Aevum
4260150.short_description: Aevum is a short atmospheric platforming journey about atrophy, loss, and acceptance. Help a young moth to follow the light, don't lose hope as your powers wane and find new ways to navigate this visually stunning, hand-crafted reverse metroidvania.

4260160.title: Reconquista
4260160.short_description: A fast-paced dungeon boomer shooter with melee combat, magic, and seed-based generated levels.

4260270.title: Stranded with You
4260270.short_description: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

4260300.title: Tombbound
4260300.short_description: Welcome to the afterlife’s most dangerous internship. In this co-op extraction horror, you serve Anubis. Raid cursed tombs, dodge mythological horrors, and collect enough cursed relics to meet the God of Death's quota. Remember: The scales of justice do not tolerate lighter wallets.

4260320.title: SUPER ANT
4260320.short_description: Embark on a manic search to locate a ontological superweapon lost on a rogue planet. Bash vicious monsters in close-quarters combat and master hidden movement and fighting techniques to overpower and outspeed your problems.

4260340.title: VoidFire
4260340.short_description: A fast-paced horror arena shooter set in unstable zones where darkness, shifting space, and constant pressure shape every fight.

4260370.title: Prism Wilds
4260370.short_description: You wake up on a beautiful island, with no memory of how you got there. Stranded, you and 6 strangers must survive, explore, and make this island your home all while uncovering that mystery. Farm, fish, build a home, decorate, form relationships, and uncover the truth hidden in the mountains.

4260410.title: Creaworm
4260410.short_description: In this short indie puzzle game you play as a little bookworm with a big dream. Find morsels of lost knowledge across the maze, craft spells to pass doors, and find the way to the land of dreams.

4260460.title: Lilacs in the Breeze
4260460.short_description: A trans otome game about a woman beginning a new leaf—until her childhood friend shows up at her door.

4260520.title: Carnival Roulette
4260520.short_description: Sit at a twisted carnival table. Play your cards under the dealer’s watchful eye. Outsmart fate, survive the rounds, and walk away alive ... If the table allows it.

4260540.title: Sacred Angel Crossnia Heart
4260540.short_description: In this adventure game with RPG elements, play as a boy Batsu, who awakens reborn as the heroine Crossnia Heart. Transform, battle the evil organization called Despercoia, absorb their power to upgrade your suit, and protect the city from the crime!

4260550.title: Run Giraffe Run
4260550.short_description: Run Giraffe Run is a multiplayer fast-paced giraffe racing 2D platformer. Poop bombs. Spit banana peels. Slip on banana peels. Race against friends through chaotic and colorful levels. Have you tried farting?

4260570.title: The Krampus Game
4260570.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Early Access
4260570.short_description: The Krampus Game is a chaotic, scary-fun multiplayer adventure where ancient winter folklore turns into wild holiday mayhem. Inspired by real Krampus and Nikolaus parades, this game brings the tradition to life — but with more monsters, more laughs, and a whole lot more chaos.

4260640.title: The Bomb Split
4260640.short_description: Two mysterious, challenging platformers where you launch yourself with an infinite supply of bombs.

4260720.title: EmuDevz
4260720.short_description: A game about building emulators! Implement your own NEEES core in JavaScript, get instant feedback with unit/video tests, build the graphics unit in real time, learn 6502 assembly, debug test ROMs, and have fun with the included homebrew games!

4260740.title: Cataclysmic Bite
4260740.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4260740.short_description: Cataclysmic Bite is a dark fantasy horror, turn based RPG where survival means hiding, listening, and holding onto your sanity. You follow a small group of travelers Lila, Malcolm, Elias, Rowan, and Alice. They uncover the truth behind, the demon cat curse spread across the village.

4260750.title: Guarded by the AI: Painted with Love
4260750.short_description: A luxe, high-heat sci-fi romance visual novel where your AI protector and his android counterpart take you to a beach house to ride out a biological nesting cycle—together, and on purpose.

4260870.title: Emu Empire
4260870.short_description: Build your empire, manage resources, and ascend to greatness in Emu Empire—a quirky strategy game where every decision shapes your legacy!

4260930.title: 快跑！哥布林来了！
4260930.short_description: In 'Run! Here Comes Goblin', you will play the role of Wang Dahui and experience strategic turn battles and deep partner bonds. Through exploration and dialogue, grow together with peers, and gather the power of trust. Final goal: unravel the mystery and save the campus. QQ group: 1032905256

4261070.title: Deadrock Salvation
4261070.short_description: The frontier of Deadrock Salvation is an immersive Open World RPG on the edge of a gun barrel and temptation hides behind every saloon door. In DS, you step into the boots of Colt Dawson, a weary gunslinger searching for a second chance in a land that’s forgotten the meaning of mercy.

4261120.title: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)

4261120.short_description: Asymmetrical Mascot Horror survival game where two mascots must team up to kill ALL the survivors. Featuring crossover characters from all across the mascot horror universe (and beyond!)

4261300.title: Teh Scrunglybois: Working Title
4261300.short_description: Grab and throw anything that stands in your way as you explore the world & moons while helping those around you throughout your travels.
developers: E O I A S R T
publishers: E O I A S R T

4261370.title: Orbit to Riches
4261370.short_description: Orbit to Riches is a short incremental space game about mining asteroids, upgrading ships, and building long-term progress through multiple runs and idle systems.

4261440.title: Wobble Pal
4261440.short_description: You meet a soft, expressive little Pal who reacts to the world around it — curious, clumsy, excited, nervous, and proud in equal measure. Through simple daily moments and light interactions, you guide your Pal as it slowly becomes more confident and expressive over time.

4261590.title: Goblins Go Up!
4261590.short_description: A chaotic vehicle-building physics sim where explosions are half of the equation. Your creativity is the only hope these goblins have of reaching the stars. Good thing they bounce.

4261640.title: Floriety
4261640.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4261640.short_description: Floriety is a cozy flower breeding game. Grow plants from seed to bloom, breed new colours and patterns, and customize your greenhouse in a calm, relaxing world designed for creativity and gentle discovery.

4261800.title: FastBall 2
4261800.short_description: FastBall 2 is back and faster than ever! Roll, jump, and dodge your way through 155 action-packed levels using simple one-tap controls. Easy to play, tricky to master, and endlessly addictive fun for players of all ages.

4261830.title: Sweet Ancient
4261830.short_description: Sweet Ancient - A simple and beautiful retro-themed jigsaw puzzle game featuring the daily lives of five pretty and adorable retro-style girls. It's accompanied by relaxing music, and after completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4261870.title: Pixel Orbit
4261870.short_description: Incremental game about defending Earth from impending danger. Develop your Skill Tree to setup automatic turrets and various other defensive mechanisms.

4261980.title: 女神的贴身男仆
4261980.short_description: "Service of Five Graces"​ is a romance FMV. You play as Lin Ye. One day, you wake up to find you've become the personal butler to the five ladies!? To repay your father's debts, you have no choice but to step into this mansion, beginning a strange life of being "ordered around" by five young women.

4262000.title: 白纸星途:民国乱世歌姬
4262000.short_description: "Oriental Songstress1930"​ is a FMV. Players will participate from a third-person perspective in the growth process of the historical figure "Zhou Xuan" . Explore Zhou Xuan’s story through extensive branching plots, item collection, and experience and collect the storylines of multiple characters.

4262070.title: Chart Weaver
4262070.short_description: Break the board with powerful synergies, discover game-defining relics and alter your deck in this market-inspired roguelike! Chart Weaver is a mesmerizingly simple but deep score-attack deckbuilder where you create magnificent combos and weave intricate patterns.

4262180.title: iNsAniA
4262180.short_description: Shoot'em up Bullet Hell Game, there is only one way out... WIN or go crazy trying!

4262380.title: Sea Warden
4262380.short_description: Sea Warden is a co-op survival game set on a living island carried across the endless ocean by a massive sea turtle named Ao. The sea, the wind, and the creatures beneath the waves are always changing, but Ao keeps moving forward, no matter what.

4262410.title: The Aurora Chronicles
4262410.short_description: A crew of four. Mysteries at the edge of known space. A utopia that might be more fragile than it appears. The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover buried secrets, and test whether hope can survive what you discover.

4262450.title: ShootOut
4262450.short_description: ShootOut is a first-person competitive target shooter. Fight for a top spot on the Leaderboards in over 30 levels, with six different guns to unlock, customize, and master.

4262510.title: Napolitan Hotel(2D)
4262510.short_description: Welcome to the Napolitan Hotel. Please show us your reasoning, patience, and survival skills.

4262600.title: The Dagby Files
4262600.short_description: Solve jigsaw puzzles to crack the case in this relaxing, cozy mystery game. Join Inspector Dagby as he investigates crime scenes, questions suspects, and leaves the final deduction to you. Seven perplexing mysteries. 28 hand-illustrated puzzles by artist Dave Montes.

4262660.title: Bypass
4262660.short_description: For all videogame fans, who have been looking for a multiplayer horror game with realistic graphics, Bypass is game which combines horror and action genre and compared to it's rivals, Bypass is free to play.

4262820.title: REARRANGED

4263000.title: Clicky & Yo
4263000.short_description: Clicky & Yo is a 2d psychological horror narrative experience where you explore unsettling environments, make subtle choices, and face unpredictable events that distort reality and test your perception.

4263100.short_description: A mixed-media visual novel about a robot and God. A story-focused visual novel game where the player can explore Nexus and interact with the world in whatever order they like, with a story emphasizing the player's agency.

4267830.title: The Trial of Progress
4267830.short_description: A fast-paced city-building experience inspired by the concept of civilization. As you advance your technologies and attract some of the greatest historical figures, you will face the trial of progress and strive to create a lasting legacy.

4267970.title: Beef
4267970.short_description: Clock in and discover the dark secret behind one of the world’s favorite canned meat brand in Beef, a surreal horror experience like no other.

4268040.title: Mutasmagoria
4268040.short_description: Mutasmagoria is a new narrative puzzle game from the creator of Magenta Horizon. Play as a veterinarian just starting work at a zoo in an alien world whose evolutionary paths diverged greatly from our own.

4268080.title: Campground Simulator
4268080.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own cozy campground. Stock supplies, set prices, help campers, and watch your peaceful wilderness business come to life—one campfire at a time.

4268740.short_description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful brown chocolate mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

4268890.title: Drop and Grow
4268890.short_description: A short incremental clicker about dropping water to grow plants. Sit back and relax while you grow more and more plants.

4269130.title: Star Voyagers – Hentai Jigsaw
4269130.short_description: Travel through distant galaxies while assembling sensual puzzles featuring alien beauties, stellar officers, and girls from different species and worlds — all illustrated in exclusive artworks that blend futuristic charm, bold sensuality, and that forbidden spark only the universe can hide.

4269570.title: Lost Stories
4269570.short_description: Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game set in the Siberian forests during the Cold War. Explore isolated locations, uncover censored experiments, and survive what was never meant to be found. Some stories were not forgotten. They were hidden.

4269660.title: Gravezone Arena
4269660.short_description: Gravezone Arena is a fast-paced top-down zombie arena shooter where you survive relentless waves, build defenses between rounds, collect powerful upgrades, and fight your way through a deadly grave-infested battleground.

4269770.title: Glorio
4269770.short_description: GLORIO is a fast-paced top-down couch party game where up to four players collect cucumbers, use absurd abilities, and battle across seven chaotic game modes designed for loud rooms, quick rounds, and shameless fun.

4270000.title: traveler of Y
4270000.short_description: 《Traveler of Y》是一款以旅途推进为主题的回合制 RPG，玩家将通过持续前行、组建队伍并制定战术，在战斗与成长中完成一段完整的单人冒险旅程。

4271170.title: President of Steel
4271170.short_description: President of Steel is a choice-driven political strategy game where every decision shapes the fate of your nation. Balance power, stability, and economy while navigating political intrigue, war threats, organized crime, and personal relationships.

4271310.title: Achievement Box
4271310.short_description: A simple game anyone can play! Click the boxes, open them, and earn achievements. With 100 different items—and possible duplicates— can you collect them all? It all depends on your luck!

4271680.short_description: Outpost 4 is a 2D cartoon-style idle resource management game focused on combat and progression. 4271720.title: What's in the box?
4271720.short_description: A first-person incremental game where you buy and open containers filled with random items, repair and upgrade the things you find, and sell them for profit. 4271920.title: How Smart Are You? IQ Test
4271920.short_description: How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!

4272970.short_description: LOST INSIDE is a story-driven, non-traditional RPG about a little human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World. They soon find out that the world has been corrupted by a curse, and only they can save the world for good by finding the 3 energy stones.

4273050.title: MITNAL
4273050.short_description: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.

4273100.title: KunKunPrison
4273100.short_description: This is a fictional story. In the game, you need to gather clues and uncover the secrets of this prison and leave safely. All content in the game is unrelated to reality, and any similarity is purely coincidental.

4273150.title: Galaxy Defender Elite 3D
4273150.short_description: Defend the galaxy as you fight swarms of alien invaders.

4274370.title: Floral Fury Online
4274370.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG
4274370.short_description: Unleash nature's wrath in Floral Fury Online, an Indie Action MMORPG. Master a unique Fusion system, conquer procedural dungeons, and battle epic bosses with dynamic combat. Forge your legacy, join guilds, and dominate the economy in a world where weather dictates the tide of battle.

4274860.title: As Duty Demands
4274860.short_description: As Duty Demands is a first-person psychological horror set in a decaying naval retirement home. 4275130.short_description: My Tiny Grocery Store is an idle shopping simulator located in the bottom right corner of your screen that allows you to manage your store while also completing other tasks! Design your store, arrange your shelves, and enjoy earning money.

4240070.short_description: 《她的掌门世代》，一款集门派经营、恋爱养成与世代传承于一体的高自由度武侠游戏。作为临危受命的掌门，你不仅要处理内务、抵御外敌，更要面对真实的江湖爱恨。是成为一代宗师，还是那个掌控所有人命运的幕后黑手？一切，由你定义。

4241580.title: Dawnrazor
4241580.short_description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

4243160.short_description: Help a cute cat in this cozy incremental game! You must catch many rats, build your house, upgrade your equipment, and improve your skills to aid Romeow on his mission.

4243280.short_description: Race at high speed in a dynamic world where you create the track as you go. Build platforms, glide, dodge hazards, and master skill-based routes in a futuristic racing playground.

4246570.short_description: Last Dolls is a roguelite horror game set in a dark fairytale world. Do you have what it takes to survive in a shattered world of dolls, scavenging supplies while evading monsters?

4246840.short_description: A retro-style arcade action game where you're a lone catgirl defending her house from a relentless onslaught of pests!

4247140.title: Everlasting Summer 2
4247140.short_description: Everlasting Summer 2 – the continuation of the legendary visual novel “Everlasting Summer” is coming soon!

4247240.title: 云隐仙踪CloudShadow
4247240.short_description: In Yunnan, China, there is a rich variety of mushrooms, and the local people have a culture of consuming mushrooms and "picking mushrooms". When a young boy mistakenly eats a hallucinogenic wild mushroom, he embarks on a series of fantastical adventures.

4251700.title: Away From Home VN
4251700.short_description: The game is an adult visual novel focusing on MILFs, cheating wives and adultery themes, packed with sneaky sex and “almost caught” moments. Play as a college student who travels to a new city for a secret investigation. Meet women and end up getting involved in their lives.

4252030.title: Geenius : Cupid Dough
4252030.short_description: A fast-paced runner game powered by GEENIUS’s new single Cupid Dough. Run, collect orbs, and switch between five characters to change vocal parts in real time. Earn gold, unlock instruments, and remix the song to create your own version.

4252640.title: VOID81: The Backrooms
4252640.short_description: VOID81: The Backrooms is a 3D platform game with survival horror elements, where you explore ever-changing levels, solve puzzles, avoid dangers, and traverse surreal worlds inspired by the retro atmosphere of the 1980s.

4252700.title: Archon Soul
4252700.short_description: Archon Soul is a 2D roguelike dice-builder where you create powerful dice using swappable faces, runes, and bodies with unique effects. ​Draft spells, craft powerful synergies, defeat challenging enemies, and conquer the Archon's palace.

4252830.title: Type or Die
4252830.short_description: In the heart of a medieval manuscript, a horse takes up arms to avenge its fallen master. Type to attack, collect cards, explore a living board, and survive in a roguelite where every word becomes a weapon.

4252910.title: Eternal Price: Whispers of Mystery
4252910.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4252910.short_description: This is an ink-style roguelike cultivation Cthulhu game. You will choose different characters to fight in a mutated world, combine various skills and magical treasures to strengthen yourself, unlock the story, survive in secret realms, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

4253340.title: TIME CYCLE
4253340.short_description: Twist the throttle, lean into the turn, feel the speed of the track beneath you.  Squeeze the brake, thread the needle, race against the clock.  Time Cycle is a classic arcade time attack racer with modern sensibilities.

4253590.title: Ella's Nightmare
4253590.short_description: Linear single-player game with puzzles and alternate endings. Control Ella and explore the rooms of the house, solving puzzles to progress and escape before becoming a victim of the lurking creature.

4253730.title: Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick Collector’s Edition
4253730.short_description: A killer hides behind familiar faces. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and expose the conspiracy tearing the village apart before fear consumes it whole.

4253750.title: Habitus: Broken Mask
4253750.short_description: Detective RPG-TTRPG-Action: Investigate the murders of 10 doctors through interrogations and decisions, save the city.

4253930.title: Rodent Rampage
4253930.short_description: Get ready for furiously fast-paced rodent warfare! Choose your champion from four uniquely powered critters and battle it out in chaotic multiplayer arenas where the smallest competitors pack the biggest punch.

4254050.title: Retroneer
4254050.short_description: Retroneer is an automation roguelike where you hand-make small electrical systems. Combine game-changing Trinkets, powerful Modules, and your own problem-solving skills to generate explosive results in this approachable and deep resource management game.

4254140.title: OVER THE TOWER
4254140.short_description: OVER THE TOWER is a hack-and-slash clicker game where you defeat enemies with simple mouse clicks. Collect coins to unlock upgrades, and equip the items you obtain to grow even stronger. What will you witness at the top of the tower…?

4254170.title: Idle Breakanoid
4254170.short_description: Idle Breakanoid combines the satisfying block-breaking action of classic Breakout/Arkanoid with the addictive progression of idle games. Watch as your balls bounce, blocks shatter, and your power grows!

4254250.title: Notebook Battlegrounds
4254250.short_description: A multiplayer game where your voice is the weapon. Play as a random letter and use proximity voice chat to hear nearby players. Say the funny words on your screen to shoot opponents, find secret words for special powers, and battle in Timed Deathmatch or Battle Royale!

4254260.title: Corner Quest
4254260.short_description: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

4254270.title: Tower War
4254270.short_description: Tower War is a fast-paced casual strategy game where you conquer enemy towers with a single swipe. Easy to learn but hard to master, it delivers smart tactical gameplay across 30 challenging levels, with quick matches and addictive replay value.

4254290.title: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
4254290.short_description: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

4254300.title: Swords And Magic: Path Of Conquest
4254300.short_description: Swords And Magic: Path Of Conquest is a Real-Time Auto Combat game with Team RPG elements set in a fantasy world! Gather your adventurers, build your team, challenge Dungeons, clain your rightful reward and reveal the mystery of the world!

4254310.title: Lopers
4254310.short_description: A game which brings trivia to the sword and sorcery world. No XP bar, no grind, just real world brain power growing. Cultivate Excellence. Reach Mastery. Attain Immortality.

4254320.title: Synephoria
4254320.short_description: Ambient VR art studio where your voice shapes a living grotto and you paint with light, color, and geometric forms. Export your creations to use in other 3D apps for fine-tuning or animation.

4254330.title: real
4254330.short_description: Smash the endless tide of enemies and become incredibly powerful! Collect loot, upgrade characters, unlock new characters and upgrade weapons, create unique and crazy builds, and resist monster armies at the same time

4254390.title: Zodiax
4254390.short_description: ZODIAX redefines the shooter: Your shot is your only way to move. Shoot the orbs to teleport and leap from target to target at breakneck speed! Blast through your enemies and conquer the 12 stations of the Zodiac. Do you have the precision and reflexes required for ZODIAX?

4254400.title: Spibee
4254400.short_description: A cooperative puzzle-platformer! Join a cute spider and bee on a thrilling adventure! Solve puzzles together, enjoy fun PvP minigames, and face epic boss battles!

4254440.title: explorer of Y
4254440.short_description: 《Explorer of Y》是一款以探索推进为主题的回合制 RPG，玩家将在不断发现新区域的过程中组建队伍、制定战术并提升角色能力，完成一段节奏明确的单人冒险。

4254560.title: 3876 AD: Corruption
4254560.short_description: A hardcore military sci-fi survival roguelike set in the post-apocalyptic world of 3876 AD. Engage in tense tactical combat, scavenge for resources, complete dangerous quests, and explore an immersive lore full of dark themes and meaningful decisions.

4254570.title: Corewave Defenders
4254570.short_description: Mining & Tower Defense! Build miners to gather ores, buy diverse cores, and freely assemble your own defense towers from modules! Your strategy and creativity forge the ultimate frontier against endless enemies!

4254650.title: Ember in the Frost
4254650.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4254650.short_description: This is a one-or three-person online survival game for the end of the world. The contents of the game include but are not limited to: pets, horseback riding, fishing, hunting, building, making, searching, killing zombies, bonfires, cooking, planting, mining, vehicles, furniture and firearms.

4254680.title: NOSTALGIA
4254680.short_description: Nostalgia is a tile-based strategy card game. To reclaim the once-existing "Notia," you must explore the diverse regions of Rodia, encountering loved ones and confronting looming threats. Where will your quest for lost memories lead you?

4254760.title: Proceed to ICU
4254760.short_description: Proceed to ICU is a Ruin-esque psychological horror game. As the new triage officer in a sinister hospital, your choices in handling daily incidents over seven workdays will unravel its dark truths and lead to diverse endings.

4254840.title: Weather Dragger
4254840.short_description: A chill strategy game about dragging weather across a dynamic, ever-shifting world to keep everything in balance. Shape clouds, sunshine, and storms as your map grows, challenges rise, and new possibilities open up each run.

4254860.title: Desktop Aquarium
4254860.short_description: A relaxing mini aquarium that stays on your desktop corner while you do other stuff — collect fish, upgrade tanks, and enjoy a cozy idle experience.

4254880.title: Dunjinn
4254880.short_description: Turn-based dungeon crawl, every step advances foes; stealth, noise, and light matter. Procedural rooms mix traps, mimics, locks, loot; combat is gear-driven with augments, consumables, and breakable durability. Between runs use town to shop, craft/repair, vault gear; death drops your pack.

4254900.title: The Cursed Ward
4254900.short_description: A system-driven psychological horror game where every threat has a pattern and every death has a reason.

4254920.title: Possessed Kingdom
4254920.short_description: Defend, Expand, and Loot their Deck. In this RTS/Deckbuilder hybrid, build towers to survive, then set a path for your troops to siege the enemy. Destroy their base to steal their cards and turn their own economy against them.

4254930.title: AutoSquad
4254930.short_description: AutoSquad is a turn-based roguelike autobattler where you build and refine a squad of units, choose their formation and strategy, then watch the battle unfold. Recruit new units, combine them into higher tiers, collect relics, and defeat the final boss.

4254950.title: Hollow Faces
4254950.short_description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

4254960.title: Let's BUG Dumplings
4254960.short_description: Like forced happy endings in Spring Festival Gala skits, “Let’s all make dumplings” reveals a subtle horror — the family’s discipline over the individual. Explore love and suffocation through Chinese New Year’s reunion dumplings. In this formulaic collective narrative, what’s your choice?

4255000.title: DECODE
4255000.short_description: DECODE is a minimalist logic puzzle game inspired by classic deduction systems. Analyse clues, break digital locks, and uncover hidden rules through text-based challenges. Every move matters. Think carefully.

4255010.title: THE PROJECT
4255010.short_description: The Project is a dark survival horror experience set in a hostile, unknown place. Trapped with no way out, survival depends on stealth, awareness, and restraint. Every sound matters. Every mistake is deadly. Survive. Adapt. Escape.

4255030.title: 纤维
4255030.short_description: Connections are like fiber threads—tugged and tangled. Some tighten; others fray. Grades, the future, and family expectations steal her breath. Between closeness and distance, hope and avoidance, she tries to understand—and be understood.

4255070.title: UNFATED
4255070.short_description: A realistic first-person action shooter set in an open-world post-apocalyptic setting. Survive, resist, and conquer a world devastated by invaders. Team up, explore the terrain, and reclaim the fate of humanity.

4255080.title: Pawns Survival
4255080.short_description: Pawn Survival is a turn-based survival strategy game where you command a small community of pawns struggling to survive, send them to gather resources, explore unknown lands, grow your village, and forge powerful equipment to withstand whatever this brutal world throws at you.

4255100.title: Veylora
4255100.short_description: You play as Mike Harvey, a local investigator searching for answers behind multiple missing persons cases. The trail leads into a forest — but it doesn’t end there. Taken by unknown creatures, you awaken inside a strange house. The shadows are watching. Escape is not guaranteed.

4255120.title: Fee Payment & Cigarettes
4255120.short_description: Fee Payment & Cigarettes is a first-person psychological horror anomaly-spotting game. Enter a hospital in first-person, finish all payment checklists. Spot anomalies, then head to the payment counter or retreat to the smoking area to calm down.

4255150.title: Corner Streamer
4255150.short_description: Corner Streamer is a chill idle game where your avatar streams from the corner, earning views, donations, and sponsors. Customize your look, upgrade your setup, and climb to the top of the streaming world.

4255160.title: Drunk Mages
4255160.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4255160.short_description: Drunk Mages is a co-op game. Players are drunk wizards trying to brew potions. Being drunk makes things a bit harder. Each level has its own unique design and different challenges that must be completed.

4255190.title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
4255190.short_description: We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all?🔎🙀

4255340.title: Wind Tunnel Flight Lab
4255340.short_description: Wind Tunnel Flight Lab is an interactive physics sandbox where you experiment with real aerodynamics in a vertical wind tunnel. Adjust air, gravity, mass, and size to make objects—and a fully controllable human—rise, fall, and fly. Learn, experiment, and play.

4255350.title: Ramming Turtleship - 1592: The Imjin War
4255350.short_description: Command the legendary Turtle Ship in this action roguelite set during the Imjin War of 1592. Ram through waves of Japanese warships, upgrade your ironclad vessel, and defend the ocean. Experience the thrill of naval impact and survival.

4255480.title: Souls Arena 100 Trials
4255480.short_description: A mini Souls-like arena game. Survive waves of enemies, defeat mini-bosses, loot weapons and potions, and unlock 100 achievements in an intense and compact experience.

4255520.title: Presentfall: Santa Defense
4255520.short_description: Presentfall: Santa Defense is a short, action, tower defense game where you help Santa defend his last presents from endless waves of naughty invaders. Aim, react, and throw snowballs to save Christmas. Collect rewards, improve Santa's skills and unlock bonuses!

4255530.title: A Certain Incremental Exoplanet
4255530.short_description: Build. Blast. Prestige. Repeat. An incremental game where you build the most productive exoplanet while protecting your enterprise from space pirates. Automate production, shoot rockets, employ an alien and keep on producing.

4255620.title: Stain
4255620.short_description: Stain is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. ou enter a place you were never meant to find.It looks empty, but something is already aware of you. It listens. It waits. It doesn’t rush — time is on its side.

4255670.title: Lumber in Space
4255670.short_description: A relaxing game about cutting weird types of trees in space. Whack space trees, collect drops, send them to space HUB and upgrade your gear.

4255690.title: Mazemerizzz2
4255690.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4255690.short_description: Moe is napping again and this time, it's a NIGHTMARE! The Watcher has Moe trapped in a massive endless maze filled with danger! Zombies, minotaurs and bone crushing, spikey, gaseous, flame filled traps. Equipped with just a torch, Moe must find a way to wake up.

4255720.title: Demons Killers
4255720.short_description: Escape Liztheuz in a first-person chase game: two relentless anime hunters, no fair fights—run, hide, use key items, and survive a one-life escape.

4256090.title: 悪人悪華 - AKUNIN-AKKA -
4256090.short_description: An interrogation game where you play as the detective in charge of a case and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth behind the bombing. Uncover the weaknesses of the unique suspects and get to the bottom of the case!

4256130.title: Late Night Duty
4256130.short_description: You’re a desperate, untrained night security guard called in at 10 PM after the previous guard vanished without notice. With no bag and only two hands, patrol a severely underfunded school. A first-person atmospheric horror about the terrifying mundane... and what hides in the dark.

4256440.title: Dead Zombie
4256440.short_description: Dead Zombie is a top-down survival shooter set in a dark city at night. Fight zombies and mutated monsters using a pistol, SMG, and flamethrower, explore the environment with a flashlight, rescue survivors, collect ammo, destroy obstacles with bombs, and escape by reaching the evacuation helicopter.

4256520.title: Isle of Titans
4256520.short_description: Isle of Titans is an idle tower defense game where you defend a small kingdom against giant invaders. Shape your build with long-term progression between runs, and adapt on the fly during each run to hold back endless waves of Titans.

4256880.title: Hexagon Soup
4256880.short_description: A keyboard-first traditional roguelike on an isometric hex grid—turn-based, permadeath, and ruthless decision-making. Your class emerges from the skills you pick, not a menu. Manage scarce resources, out-position enemies, claim Hex Runes, then survive the climb back out.

4256970.title: Neurosis
4256970.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly horror puzzle game where the player explores looping corridors, observes environmental details, and solves puzzles to escape the endless repetition.

4257210.title: DEMIURGE
4257210.short_description: DEMIURGE - A police chase game like you've never seen. Employ real life tactics to stop other cars and keep your gas-fueled mascot well fed to avoid death, all on a dystopian recreation of Brazil's 80s military era with a mix of realistic lightning and retro style 3D, with a dark story on top.

4257320.title: MetaChess
4257320.short_description: MetaChess is chess that lets you build your own army and rewrite the board. With alternate roles for every piece, it creates billions of new possible games possibilities. No more memorized openings, no more solved meta. Every decision matters. Outdraft, outthink, and outplay your opponent.

4257730.title: Red Christmas
4257730.short_description: Red Christmas is a short atmospheric thriller set in a small toy shop during the christmas eve.

4257830.title: 失踪トンネル
4257830.short_description: There is a tunnel rumored to be a place where people mysteriously disappear. You are asked to investigate a missing persons case and step into the tunnel. Will you be able to escape safely?

4257870.title: Loads of Roads
4257870.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4257870.short_description: Loads of Roads is a top-down traffic management game where you must guide the vehicles in a chaotic city from morning to midnight. Face rush hour challenges, unique vehicles, and special level layouts - can you master everything?

4258050.title: Just Kill It
4258050.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4258050.short_description: Just Kill It is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter.Shoot, survive, level up, and build your own playstyle as endless waves of enemies close in — then push your limits on the global leaderboards.

4258100.title: Inner Demons Calamity
4258100.short_description: Explore a colorful continent as you run, jump, and fight with your Angel in this 2D platforming adventure.

4258110.title: Down Hell
4258110.short_description: In this terrifying first-person action game, control an elite soldier sent on a suicide mission: infiltrate a prison laboratory where humanity has lost its way. Inhumane experiments on convicts have unleashed unspeakable horrors, now you face a desperate fight against deadly mutants and monsters

4258120.title: Runtalis
4258120.short_description: Runtalis is a 1–5 player turn-based tactical RPG. Coordinate your party, socket powerful Runes, and push your Magic Key against enemies with dangerous affixes. Higher risks unlock greater power in this grid-based, tabletop-inspired challenge. Master your skills or lose your Runes.

4258200.title: I Wanna Touch
4258200.short_description: I Wanna Touch is a pixel-art platformer where you play as a gliding bunny carried by a strange wind. Master the airflow, collect carrots, dodge deadly traps, and fly toward your beloved. Danger is everywhere—can you survive the journey?

4258210.title: 蟲
4258210.short_description: “你醒啦？快起来，一起迎接新世纪！” 显示屏上闪烁的异常痕迹，突然出现在桌面又突然变异死亡的“小虫子”，主动弹出的错误日志，梦回千禧年的网站，探求千年虫的真相……

4258220.title: Rabbit Detective
4258220.short_description: 《兔子侦探》是一款手绘风格的悬疑解谜互动游戏。玩家将扮演兔子侦探，在前往拜访好友时，竟发现对方已意外身亡！案发现场疑点重重，线索错综复杂。玩家将使用时间回溯机制，从现场抽丝剥茧，在正确的时机放置正确的证据，找出杀害受害兔的真凶，洗清自己被迫背负的嫌疑。最终将罪犯绳之以法，并在审讯中揭露其罪行！

4258240.title: Tales of Medieval Duelists
4258240.short_description: Ditch the animations. In Tales of Medieval Duelists, every swordfight is a unique physics-based clash. Master precise, skill-driven combat where timing a perfect parry is your key to victory. Build your legend with deep progression, gear, and a high-risk win streak multiplier.

4258280.title: Tiandao
4258280.short_description: Ready to rule the Three Realms? Tianao blends Roguelite & Grand Strategy. As a powerless Celestial Emperor, will you rule in name or defy fate? Master court intrigue, find soulmates, and wield supreme authority to judge all life. Become the ultimate Heavenly Dao and master the fate of all!

4258290.title: We Are So Cooked
4258290.short_description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

4258330.title: CALLUS
4258330.short_description: Callus is a short psychological horror walking simulator about cruelty and overprotection.

4258400.title: Bakken - Ski Jumping: Next Season
4258400.short_description: Bakken - Ski Jumping: Next Season is a winter sports simulation game. Compete with more than 200 male and female ski jumpers on more than 10 hills and master the jumping, the flying and the landing! The next season starts here ...

4258430.title: Beyond Your Threshold
4258430.short_description: These almost endless halls are only an unstable creation of the mind. Find within yourself the will to push forward, and you might just prevail. You are your own limit.

4258530.title: Limes 235
4258530.short_description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

4258760.title: Chainsaw Woods
4258760.short_description: A survival horror game where you must escape from a forest you've gotten lost in. The forest is randomly generated each time you play. Supports online co-op for up to 2 players. Work together to escape from the forest!

4258770.title: Dread Fields
4258770.short_description: Feed the animals, tend the fields, and keep the house clean while living dead girls wander nearby. A slow-burn rural horror.

4258880.title: Basement To The Sky
4258880.short_description: A bright afternoon, perfect weather. With your parents away, you’re left with a rocket toy you received as a birthday gift. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky! Enjoy delicious homemade meals and work part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Can your rocket reach outer space?

4259140.title: 2 Hours to Refund
4259140.short_description: Demo Available · A 5×5 card strategy game where poker hands become combat skills. A single card affects multiple lines—maximize combos through strategic placement.

4259250.title: Silent Snow
4259250.short_description: Seth and May have moved out of the city and into a big old house that uncle John decided he didnt want anymore. Although the holiday spirit brings color and joy to an otherwise barren house, something lurks outside hidden in the snow. Watching. Waiting.

4259630.title: La Cosa Nostra
4259630.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story-driven 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s America. Play as an immigrant navigating the world of organized crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a gritty mafia-themed narrative.

4259670.title: Ironseed 3 : Vigil
4259670.short_description: Sequel to a sci-fi exploration game Ironseed written in 1994, continued in Ironseed 2: Consensus, and now in Ironseed 3 : Vigil!

4259740.title: Cozy Against Humanity
4259740.short_description: Cozy Against Humanity is a roguelike tower defense game where the coziest things imaginable turn against you. Adapt, resist, and survive the soft apocalypse.

4259890.title: I am Coin
4259890.short_description: Life is tough when you're small change. Reach the piggy bank in this physics-based challenge and become savings!

4259900.title: Green Tea Field Mayhem
4259900.genre: Action, Casual, Strategy, Free To Play
4259900.short_description: Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them.

4259910.title: GravityOptional
4259910.short_description: A physics-based co-op roguelite about flightless owls, crippling debt, and industrial glue. Pilot a rickety airship through acid storms, harpoon floating garbage, and build makeshift shelters out of stolen bathtubs to protect your cargo. If the package gets wet, you don't get paid.

4259970.title: Watch Grass Grow Simulator
4259970.short_description: A real-time experience built entirely around watching grass grow, where patience turns into payoff and leaving too early means missing it.

4260380.title: DishDash
4260380.short_description: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

4260530.title: Rina's Undercover Train Operation
4260530.short_description: A rouge-lite simulation game where you play as Rina, a special investigator with psychic powers that aims to cut down crime rate on trains. Upgrade your skills, combine them, and take down your enemies before they get you! Oh, and have fun changing Rina's outfits too!

4260600.title: CORALINA - illacrimo
4260600.short_description: Lost in nostalgia, surrounded by ghosts, Coralina goes through the Elysian Fields to find a long lost alchemy artifact, all before the world ends. The girl that can enter memories travels through these Posthumous Lands once again, in her own Psychedelic Odissey.

4260690.title: Hardcourt Balls
4260690.short_description: Hardcourt Balls is a fast-paced, turn-based adaptation of the real-world game of tennis. With just a few simple rules, the roll of dice, and tactical use of skill "cards", it manages to capture some of the nuances and excitement that make tennis such a great sport.

4260730.title: Heroes of Arcania
4260730.short_description: Experience the tabletop action of Heroes of Arcania! Inspired by classic fantasy card and board games, this demo provides a bite-sized look at the combat, mechanics, and flow of the full game — perfect for learning the ropes before diving into the complete tabletop adventure!

4260790.title: Ascent of the Last Colossus
4260790.short_description: A once-great civilisation is crumbling, teetering on the edge of collapse. The last living colossus, slowly dying, its life force siphoned away. You are sent to end its suffering and perhaps the world it still holds together.

4260820.title: Blood Court
4260820.short_description: Blood Court is a Souls-like action RPG within a dark fantasy, horrifying world. Explore PSX styled Environments, battle blood hungry monsters, and piece together a story told through environments, and voiceless cinamatics.

4260940.title: Hatchling Scramble
4260940.short_description: A vibrant top-down game about helping baby sea turtles reach the ocean by clearing a safe path forward. Turn off bright lights, scare away aggressive crabs, and clear obstacles to guide hatchlings to safety!

4260960.title: Caveworks
4260960.short_description: Caveworks is a 1-4 player co-op action-adventure game. Explore procedurally generated lunar caves and pioneer unknown regions to fulfill your assigned missions.

4261180.title: Ascension: The Hehuan Sect & 66 Waifus
4261180.short_description: Ascension: The Hehuan Sect & 66 Waifus is a comedic Harem Strategy game. Fusing Roguelike deck-building, humorous storytelling, and Sanctuary management, it lets you practice Dual Cultivation with diverse waifus. Recruit them to your party and battle together in this wild adventure!

4261290.title: MELLDESTROY
4261290.short_description: Slay demons in a fast-paced roguelike action game with survival elements. Play as Mellstroy, destroy hordes of dangerous blogger-demons, spin weapon slots to gain buffs and create insane builds, and survive as long as possible. Climb the MELLDESTROY leaderboards!

4261390.title: Yulong Snow Mountain in Yunnan
4261390.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4261520.title: Coconut Party
4261520.short_description: Play as the king of Hawaii in this thrilling stylized FPT (First Person Thrower) game! Fend off the colonist invasion and get stronger with each day. Do you have what it takes to defeat them? Or will Hawaii fall to their wrath? Only you can stop them in order to get your Coconut Party!

4261580.title: Board of the Kings: A Chess RPG
4261580.short_description: A tactical roguelike role-playing game based in the original thousand-year classic, Chess

Try out the many game modes to set and beat the highest scores possible!

4272380.short_description: Build a team of powerful fruits and battle asynchronously against other players!

4272460.title: Scarf Tale
4272460.short_description: Scarf Tale is an RPG with light roguelike elements and a focus on exploration. You awaken into a new life, reborn in the world of Scarf Tale. Armed with a scarf, a weapon, and the drive to push further out and uncover what’s waiting beyond the town.

4272560.title: BREAKOUT BABY
4272560.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

4272700.title: Yellow
4272700.short_description: YELLOW is a liminal survival horror game. As a M.E.G. inspector in hazmat gear, explore unstable Backrooms zones to document "Undocumented" entities. With zero data available, you must study these lethal threats, uncover their origins, and solve the mystery of why new levels are appearing.

4272710.title: Up to the top!
4272710.short_description: A fast, addictive vertical-climbing game. Jump higher, chain combos, build insane speed, and don’t fall. Easy to learn—endless to master.

4272790.title: Approach Control: Remastered
4272790.short_description: A professional air traffic control simulation, now with voice recognition! Approach Control: Remastered is a realistic air traffic control simulation where you manage arrivals using real procedures, authentic radar behavior, and professional controller workflows in fast-paced, high-stakes scenarios.

4272820.title: Battle of the Alamo
4272820.short_description: Rewrite history and defend the Alamo as a shield who can only parry, in this short bullet hell action roguelike! Collect items as you fight through waves of enemies, but careful... a mighty foe waits for you at the end.

4272830.title: Haven Restored
4272830.short_description: A cozy restoration simulator focused purely on cleaning and tidying — no money, no timers, just calm, satisfying transformation.

4272860.title: Woodswalker
4272860.genre: Action, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4272860.short_description: Woodswalker is a strategy-based survival horror game in which quick thinking is key. Listen closely to your surroundings, defend yourself with your searchlight, budget your limited power, and solve environmental puzzles to discover the truth of the forest.

4273270.title: Tactris
4273270.short_description: A tactical game of slotting soldiers. Arrange formations of different units and attempt to break through the enemy's ranks whilst collecting buffs, modifiers and more to alter the power and performance of your units.

4273380.title: Chesscent
4273380.short_description: Chesscent is a pixel art turn-based strategy roguelite that blends classic chess with rule-breaking cards. Face impossible rivals, embrace defeat, and unlock new permanent abilities to change the outcome of the match.

4273420.title: Zom Mat Taeng
4273420.short_description: A bright and cozy casual tycoon! Grill skewers for hungry zombies, fulfill orders, and upgrade your shop to become the best spot in town. Don't miss special orders! Unlock recipes to boost your reputation. Enjoy cute customer reactions with simple controls anyone can play.

4273610.title: A Game About Shooting Bullets At Bullets (AGASBAB)
4273610.short_description: A 3D incremental FPS game where you don’t move, only your bullets do. You’re stuck in space with nothing to do but shoot bullets...at bullets. Watch bullets bounce out of control, numbers explode, and a quiet room turn into pure chaos.

4273620.title: Whispers of Appalachia
4273620.short_description: A story-driven atmospheric horror set in a forest inspired by Appalachian legends. Avoid patrolling creatures, listen to the whispers, and survive the night.

4273700.title: ShotSun Man & His Beauties
4273700.short_description: Ling Yun, bearing the Chaos Origin Mark, travels across China, encountering diverse ethnic beauties—shamans, Gu witches, snow spirits. Bound by love and fate, he battles demons, upholds balance, and carries the weight of guarding the world in this epic tale of romance and adventure.

4273760.title: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
4273760.short_description: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

4273820.title: Maritime Simulator
4273820.short_description: A realistic vessel traffic simulation where you manage and control maritime traffic in busy waterways. Monitor ships, assign routes, prevent incidents, and keep ports and rivers moving safely as a VTS (Vessel Traffic Service) operator.

4273870.title: River Runners
4273870.short_description: River Runners is a cooperative multiplayer adventure where you and your friends navigate a dangerous, unpredictable river. Clear communication and teamwork are essential to steer the raft, overcome hidden challenges, and survive the journey to the end.

4273950.title: Dance Dance Detective
4273950.short_description: Grab your dance shoes, and Dance, Dance, Detective! Go undercover as a dance teacher on a cruise ship full of wacky murder suspects. Create choreographies to uncover their dark secrets, follow leads, and connect clues to find who killed the chief science officer of the Bolero Chocolate Company.

4274110.title: Hardware Simulator
4274110.short_description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

4274120.title: Sushi Simulator
4274120.short_description: Manage your own sushi restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh sushi, purchase ingredients, manage stock, and keep your customers happy. No distractions, just a focused single-player sushi simulation.

4274170.title: The Honest Little Fisher
4274170.short_description: A cozy fishing game made with care, full of discovery, gentle progression, and hundreds of things to catch. Set out to explore the sea, upgrade your boat, and uncover stories, fun facts, and legendary finds along the way.

4274180.title: Dawn Vantor
4274180.short_description: Dawn Vantor is a single-player stealth-action story game where you play a lone elite operative sent on a final covert mission. Infiltrate hostile forests and caves, eliminate enemy forces, uncover a hidden base, and destroy it before dawn.

4274210.title: Medieval Decklords
4274210.short_description: Medieval Decklords is a medieval-themed roguelike card game with a three card poker system. Outsmart opponents in duels, and upgrade your deck. Rise through the ranks to become the ultimate Decklord.

4274270.title: Missy's Bugtastic Little Planet
4274270.short_description: Missy the kitty will hang out with you anywhere on your desktop and catch bugs! She will earn money based on the rarity of what she catches, and you can use that money to buy cosmetics and upgrades, or just see how much money she can make!

4274480.title: DonDonKitchen
4274480.short_description: No more boring cooking—chop, season, and flip the pan to the beat, and turn cooking into your very own show!

4274680.title: The VORIK Cycle
4274680.short_description: "Trapped in a decaying industrial loop, your greatest enemy is your own past. Survive harrowing deaths, battle a deteriorating mind, and face the truth: in The VORIK Cycle, you are your own architect of ruin."

4274690.title: Automation Farm
4274690.short_description: This is a game that simulates farm management using programming methods. The game simplifies the complexity of programming and extracts its automation elements. It allows players to experience the fully automated process of controlling robots to harvest and manage farms using code and thought.

4274700.title: Tonight resist drinking milk!!
4274700.short_description: To satisfy her pent-up desires, we spend another hot night together. Smoothly animated CG events , with voice acting.

4274740.title: ShanHaiYiXian
4274740.short_description: "Shanhai Yixian" is an action-adventure game set in a cultivation world.Begin as a mortal,explore a mysterious and brutal realm,search for rare spiritual treasures,refine elixirs and magical artifacts.Strengthen your cultivation,break through realms,and ultimately defy fate to dominate the world.

4274950.title: Outworld Defence
4274950.short_description: Outworld Defense is a 2D tower defense game where you recruit defenders, fortify your mansion, purchase upgrades, and use bonuses to protect it from hordes of demonic creatures.

4275020.title: Brewmatics
4275020.short_description: An Incremental Deck builder where you build decks, collect artifacts and upgrade your skills to brew the best potions Possible and discover crazy combos and live the fantasy of Number Go Up.

4275030.title: Lumina: Resenting Shadow
4275030.short_description: Journey through a kingdom drained of its life. An innocent being locked away from its own kind, longing to be loved and seen. Though it seems to have forgotten one flicker of hope. You, a glimmer of life not yet fallen.

4275060.title: Sparrow Shop
4275060.short_description: Run a shop and a factory in a narrative management sim with Mahjong battles. Craft "Gene Tiles," exploit intel for profit, and annex rivals in duels. "Become the 'First,' and we leave together." — Carve a bloody path through Dark Heron City.

4276220.title: Cursed Ghost
4276220.short_description: Once a ghost, now trapped in flesh—avoid every obstacle, evade human eyes, and use brief moments of spectral freedom to find your way out.

4276240.title: My Girlfriend is a VAMP
4276240.short_description: Guide a Vampire Autistic Magic Princess through a 2D narrative adventure where everyday situations are the real dangers. Avoid sensory overload, offer emotional support, and make meaningful choices as you help your VAMP girlfriend return to her castle and strengthen your relationship.

4276260.title: Gem Tales 2: Crystal Dragon
4276260.short_description: Gem Tales 2: Crystal Dragon is a story-rich match-3 adventure with 100 handcrafted levels. Match crystals, solve clever puzzles, and help Luna guide a lonely crystal dragon through a changing world filled with charm and magic.

4276300.title: 镜之境
4276300.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Free To Play
4276300.short_description: 某天，林铭和娜比意外掉入了一个由神秘古镜创造的世界。他们无法看到彼此，但可以听到对方的声音。现在，需要您和伙伴一起，通过交流沟通来交换彼此视角的线索，共同帮助他们离开这里。

4276390.title: Kaiju Inc.
4276390.short_description: Kaiju Inc. is a Real-Time Tactics + Roguelike Monster Raising game! Mutate, Modify, and Evolve your monsters! Build your strongest monster squad through Roguelike stages!

4276520.title: PCUBES
4276520.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4276520.short_description: This is a 3D puzzle action game where players create and manipulate blocks using special abilities to clear stages. By stacking and rotating blocks, players overcome obstacles and gimmicks. Each stage has keys and an exit, and there is no single solution, allowing creative and flexible gameplay.

4276530.title: C
4276530.short_description: A game where number goes up

4276550.title: Godling Harem
4276550.short_description: You've fallen from godhood to a godling that has lost much of your powers, but you're given a second chance. Save the world and gain back your powers, grow your harem of royals and nobles, and ascend back into godhood in this 2D RPG featuring animated adult content.

4276660.title: Yomifuda: Kanji Survivors
4276660.short_description: Your path to survival is written in ink! Survive the endless Yokai onslaught with the power of language. Yomifuda combines rogue-lite action with a Japanese learning system featuring over 1,000 essential Kanji. Build your vocabulary, and unlock powers to devastate the evils of the underworld.

4276730.title: 境界突破:放置修仙
4276730.short_description: 在这片浩瀚的修仙世界中，天地灵气充盈，仙缘无限等待有缘者。你将从炼气期的初入修行开始，踏上从筑基、金丹、元婴到化神的巅峰之路。游戏以轻松挂机为特色，让你在修炼、历练、闯荡仙境的同时，轻松积累经验与资源。无论是培养独具特色的剑修、法修或医修，还是收集稀有装备、强化自身实力，每一次修炼与突破都让角色更接近至高仙境。华丽的技能特效、回合制战斗以及多倍速挂机系统，让你在感受修仙世界壮阔宏大的同时，也能享受轻松流畅的游戏体验。加入这场修仙盛宴，开启属于你的修仙传奇吧！

4276740.title: Stuff It!
4276740.short_description: Colorful dolls with voluptuous bodies can come to life, don't you know? All they need to do is meet their Maker. Are you ready?

4276800.title: Spin, Baby, Spin!
4276800.short_description: Spin, Baby, Spin! is a short incremental game about slot machines. Spin the reels, upgrade your income and drop chances, craft new slot machines, and collect powerful artifacts. Choose your talent cards and earn enough chips to buy back your soul from a demonic clown!

4276890.title: Glyph Chess
4276890.short_description: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia. You will command mages with distinct abilities to escort your Scepter to the central "Source of Magic", or to destroy the enemy's Scepter.

4277130.title: Town Tower
4277130.short_description: A strategic tower defense game where management is key. Build houses to generate villagers, gather resources, and erect an impenetrable defense. Withstand increasingly powerful waves of enemies and prevent them from destroying your tower.

4277210.title: ClickRush
4277210.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4277210.short_description: ClickRush: Produce infinite clicks! Deploy drones and AI matrices to automate your empire. Take down Real-Time World Bosses with the community, level up your Battle Pass, and unlock celestial bonuses. Dominate the global leaderboard. Get your mouse ready!

4277250.title: Little Toys
4277250.short_description: What if toys came to life and escaped from our drawers for crazy, over-the-top races? Up to 4 players in local multiplayer, 16 maps, traps, powers, podiums, and LittleFlouz to unlock. Challenge your friends and your family! An explosive, hilariously frustrating couch-party game.

4277290.title: One More Spin
4277290.short_description: An incremental slot machine clicker. Every click is a chance to win big, so don't stop! Go for one more spin.

4277440.title: Apathema
4277440.short_description: Cursed to repair the inner organs of the Chasm, you fight to undercover the secrets of your existence and end a self-devouring cycle of Apathy. Apathema is a grunge fantasy turn-based RPG, inspired by God Husk, Baroque, and King's Field.

4277550.title: Break Protocol
4277550.short_description: The protocol has called… and it’s time to destroy everything! BREAK PROTOCOL reinvents the brick-breaker roguelike: build powerful combos, exploit card synergies, and face unique enemies and bosses across increasingly dangerous sectors.

4277590.title: Soul Hunter
4277590.short_description: A team of young paranormal researchers ventures into the cursed corners of Japan to prove the existence of the spirit world. Ghosts feed on fear and the sanity of the living, luring you into traps of illusion. Your only defense is a special camera, capable of banishing spirits and unveiling secrets.

4277630.title: KharkivVision 2035
4277630.short_description: An atmospheric story-driven game about life, choices, and the open world of Kharkiv. 1:30–2 hours of story, created by a single developer.

4277690.title: Jumpy Tiger
4277690.short_description: Jumpy Tiger is a family-friendly collect-a-thon 2D platformer inspired by the classics of the 90s. Journey through seven unique levels and complete 35 missions, defeating enemies and avoiding hazards along the way.

4277700.title: Princess Khalifa: Legacy of Wrath
4277700.short_description: Princess Khalifa: Legacy of Wrath is a fast-paced top-down action shooter where you dash, slow time, and fight through escalating enemy waves in a surreal sci-fi world, relying on precise movement, quick reactions, and controlled chaos to survive.

4277760.title: Boom Buddies
4277760.short_description: Boom Buddies is a fixed-position bullet hell survival game where animal heroes face endless enemy waves, upgrade weapons through card choices, unlock new characters, and compete on global leaderboards.

4277790.title: Blackjack Descent
4277790.short_description: You're locked in a room where your only chance of survival is to play blackjack against a sinister dealer. Every hand isn't just a gamble, it's a deal with fate. Fail to repay your debt on time, and you'll fall into darkness... or something far worse.

4277880.title: GLOAM: Search Company
4277880.short_description: GLOAM is a co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Rescue survivors, collect and manage resources, and extract what you find to invest in upgrades and keep your agency running.

4277930.title: Fast Food King
4277930.short_description: Serve hot dogs, hamburgers, and drinks in a fast-paced street food game. Manage orders, beat the clock, and keep hungry customers happy!

4277940.title: Hentai Furry Raccoon
4277940.short_description: Hentai Furry Raccoon is an exciting game that combines puzzles, light humor, and a seductive furry atmosphere. You will dive into a colorful and playful universe where temptation, cunning, and flirtation intertwine into a single story.

4277950.title: Hentai Furry Cat
4277950.short_description: Hentai Furry Cat is a playful puzzle game set in a seductive furry world. Solve puzzles, unlock flirty scenes, and enjoy light humor, charm, and a cozy feline atmosphere with an alluring cat girl.

4278010.title: 五年B班事件簿 - The Grade 5B Case Files
4278010.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4278010.short_description: A narrative AVG focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The two protagonists encounter ordinary yet unusual incidents at school, and through investigation and deduction, players uncover the truth together with them.

4278030.title: Soundscapes
4278030.short_description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

4278220.title: Runic Curse Remastered
4278220.short_description: Runic Curse Remastered is a thrilling action RPG Metroidvania that transports you to a cursed island. Explore dark and diverse locations, battle hordes of enemies and mighty bosses. Forge your own playstyle by combining various weapons with magical runes to overcome all challenges.

4278310.title: Oloo
4278310.short_description: Oloo is a 2D physics-based platformer where you play as a little creature that is too squishy to be dangerous and too cute to be scary. Find out why you are in this falling-apart world and where you are going.

4278330.title: Wasteland Outpost
4278330.short_description: Wasteland Outpost is an explosive online cocktail of tactical shooter, base building, and survival. Scavenge for resources, build an impregnable fortress, and fight off hordes of mutants and the enemy team. Fortify your base or watch it burn in the flames of the apocalypse!

4278400.title: Papers And Olé
4278400.short_description: Welcome to Valdehondo, where getting government aid is harder than winning the lottery. Manage real files, deal with the mayor, and choose your path: Will you be a sanctuary for the citizens or the most corrupt gear in the system? A simulator so real it hurts... And you, what would you do?

4278550.title: Niji Protocol
4278550.short_description: Hunt the Demon Aristocracy in this neon-noir detective puzzle game. As an agent of the Njij Protocol, travel the globe, interview witnesses, and cross-reference clues in the Grimoire to profile the suspect before time runs out and history is lost forever.

4278580.title: Matchmaking for Ghosts
