4513600.title: Infinite Empire
4513600.short_description: Become the Lord Captain of an ancient space fortress in a galaxy where railguns sit next to necromantic hull plating, steam-powered tesla cannons, and biological spore launchers. Build your ship, crush alien fleets in slow, weighty broadside combat, and carve out an empire one sector at a time.

4513750.title: The Void
4513750.short_description: The Void is a wave based survival horror fps inspired by the movie "The Mist" and spiritual theology. Your objective is to survive by utilizing the scarce resources and fighting through the hordes of creatures. Survive the Void, and find Absolution

4514030.title: WonderKing EU
4514030.genre: Action, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4514030.short_description: The return of classic 2D side-scrolling action! WonderKing is a free-to-play MMORPG packed with flashy combat and deep progression. Advance through diverse classes, master unique combos, and party up with friends for epic boss raids. Start your adventure today!

4514050.title: Tokyo Wave Rush
4514050.short_description: An aquatic racer where precision physics meets vibrant, stylized Japan in a sun-drenched tribute to the golden age of 90s arcade and console racing classics.

4514150.title: Pipreal
4514150.short_description: Wake up in the mysterious city of Liftograd! Explore a massive, atmospheric 80s building where every floor holds a secret. Master the physics of an authentic vintage elevator, leave your mark on the walls with spray cans, and manipulate the world around you.

4514330.title: Hiddensaurs
4514330.short_description: Hiddensaurs is a hidden object game with dinosaurs. This is a prequel to 100 Hiddensaurs. You'll learn how the Crazy Professor grew up and that Hiddensaurs were always around him.

4514640.title: BassBlock
4514640.short_description: BassBlock is a casual 2D platform rhythm jumping game inspired by Rhythm Heaven and Geometry Dash, aiming to bring fun through simple and joyful interactions!

4515540.title: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project
4515540.short_description: If love is an error you can’t fix… will you delete me—or choose to keep me? Step into the role of a censor and dive into a story of order, freedom, and love.

4515670.title: 100 Guys 1 Stick
4515670.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Early Access
4515670.short_description: 100 players drop into a cave, race through a maze, and fight over one powerful Stick. Grab it to become the strongest and the most hunted. A chaotic top-down battle royale with pixel-art mayhem, stone-throwing combat, and matches that always end in ridiculous chaos.

4516860.title: RuneClick
4516860.short_description: A medieval desktop companion RPG that runs as an always-on-top overlay. Your real keyboard and mouse input drives your character's progress. Chop, mine, fish, smith, cook, and craft while you work. Every click counts.

4517050.title: Bubble Hero: The Five Elements
4517050.short_description: Restore harmony among the elements in Bubble Hero, a cozy wave survival game. Play as a bubble hero, defeat hordes of enemies to convert them into loyal allies with your special powers, and build your own home while rescuing the five kingdoms.

4517120.title: Cat Block - Sliding Puzzle
4517120.short_description: Meet adorable cats in Cat Block - Sliding Puzzle. Move cat blocks and guide the yarn ball to its goal through 300 stages, with switchable cat skins, themed wallpapers, and relaxing music.

4517210.title: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）
4517210.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4517210.short_description: A unique fusion of Roguelike, Deckbuilding, and Tower Defense! Play as the Reborn Demon King, deploy Chibi-style units, and use strategic Talent Cards to conquer the continent. Featuring the innovative "Story Card" system for uninterrupted combat.

4517250.title: Squared Circle Tycoon
4517250.short_description: Step into the role of a wrestling promoter! Sign talent, book matches, manage intense rivalries, and fight for TV ratings in the ultimate GM simulator.

4517350.title: 传奇盛世
4517350.genre: Casual, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4517350.short_description: In Legendary Prosperity, you won’t face fierce competition—just immerse yourself in slow-paced, cozy management. From crafting steaming hot meals to greeting soft, adorable cat customers, every step is filled with warmth and a sense of achievement.

4517370.title: EULA
4517370.short_description: An image created by AI — is it yours? An AI art tool is placed before a nameless illustrator. To accept, or to refuse. A visual novel that tells the same story in different forms. Your choices shape the ending - there is no right answer.

4517480.title: My Football Growth Story
4517480.genre: Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4517480.short_description: Click cards to train your team and improve players. Buy skills that help you and your teammates grow stronger. After unlocking auto-training, players train automatically while you focus on strategy: choosing development paths and unlocking skills.

4517560.title: Thinky Wants To Guess
4517560.short_description: Draw simple sketches and see if the AI can guess what they are. Thinky Wants To Guess is a relaxing drawing game where your creativity is challenged by an AI trying to understand your doodles.

4517630.title: Hero and Monster
4517630.short_description: A fantasy-themed strategy auto-chess tower defense game. Choose your leader from 16 unique heroes, recruit armies from five factions, research synergies, deploy your troops and cast spells through 30 waves of monsters, defeat the Abyss Boss, and conquer three maps.

4517640.title: Hentai Succubus
4517640.short_description: Hentai Succubus - It's gotten hot in here. You won't be able to resist!!! A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4517650.title: Hentai Milf & Futanari
4517650.short_description: Hentai Milf & Futanari - Adults and interesting, you can find a bonus, be careful! A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4517670.title: SPACE HUG-DUNG
4517670.short_description: "Infiltrate mysterious planetary facilities to snatch the core 'Hug-Dung' and escape. Battle giant robots and alien creatures in 4-player co-op, secure the core, and return to the extraction pod in this sci-fi action experience."

4517680.title: Wasteland Train: Conductor
4517680.short_description: Wasteland Train is a 2D train management strategy game set on a post-apocalyptic rail network. Command an expanding mobile base, trade between isolated cities, recover crystal cores, develop technology, and survive raids, broken tracks, acid rain, and toxic fog.

4517700.title: Lenos
4517700.short_description: Loot, shoot, and survive the depths with friends. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, gear up with powerful weapons and perks, and fight your way to extraction in this top-down co-op dungeon crawler.

4517730.title: My House on the 9th Floor
4517730.short_description: A single-location psychological horror game where the elevator is your safe zone and the hallway is a gamble. Restore Line 9, collect missing service parts, and survive Benjamin’s game.

4517780.title: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
4517780.short_description: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional adventure where choices shape the fate of four characters. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

4517790.title: Sheep Game: Something In The Flock
4517790.short_description: A first-person horror game where you manage a lonely sheep ranch, count your flock, and hunt down impostor sheep hiding among the real ones before they grow strong enough to take over. not all of them belong in the field.

4518000.title: Panoptic II
4518000.short_description: Hunt up to 4 of your friends as the godlike Overseer in this tense online, asymmetric VR game. Unleash your new abilities to stamp out the rebellion. Or, as the tiny but crafty Challengers, cooperate, cause mayhem and pull off daring heists as you undermine the power of your oppressive opponent!

4518030.title: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
4518030.short_description: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

4518040.title: Goblins Stole My Panties 👙
4518040.short_description: A humorous adult fantasy adventure where you play as a cursed goblin exploring a medieval world. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, meet unique characters, and unlock plenty of spicy illustrated scenes while collecting unusual trophies. 😏

4518070.title: Strix and Scholar
4518070.short_description: Follow the story of Blanca Silverurn—a strix entangled in a murder mystery. Explore the Grimstrand campus and learn about its unique magic. Delve into the secrets of students and faculty members. Affect their relationships, including a spicy romance between Blanca and her enigmatic mentor.

4518110.title: Small Life: Shanghai
4518110.short_description: Small Life: Shanghai is a relaxing hidden-object game set in the streets of Shanghai. Explore hand-drawn scenes, connect subtle clues, and uncover the little stories in everyday life.

4518210.title: Counter Attack On Zombies
4518210.short_description: Fight through zombie-filled battle zones, survive relentless waves, and upgrade your combat power in this fast-paced action survival shooter.

4518230.title: TD Master
4518230.short_description: Build, upgrade, and defend in this tactical tower defense experience. Place traps, manage resources, and survive increasingly intense waves of enemies in a system-driven, replayable strategy game.

4518240.title: Commie Bobrs
4518240.short_description: Commie Bobrs is a chaotic co-op physics-based building simulator. Assemble iconic Eastern Europe buildings block by block using cranes, forklifts, pure muscle power and your friend's questionable guidance. Just try not to die while doing it...

4518320.title: Quarantine Market Simulator: Prologue
4518320.short_description: Run a market inside a quarantine zone. Check temperatures, manage customers and inventory, and defend the walls during zombie raids. A first-person market management simulator set in a post-apocalyptic world.

4518350.title: Laika's Space Defence
4518350.short_description: November 3rd, 1975, Laika was launched into space… never meant to return. But what if that isn't the whole story? What if she was secretly sent to protect Earth from evil space aliens? Blast your way through endless waves of enemies as the best girl to ever go to space!

4518420.title: Little Fires
4518420.short_description: Care for three little fires to survive while restoring an abandoned medieval home during a relentless blizzard.

4518610.title: FUTAHAMMER 69000
4518610.short_description: In the grim darkness of the far future, it's time to chill. A relaxing, low-stress sci-fi arcade breaker with a killer soundtrack. Smash heretical blocks, vibe to the music, and unlock explicit, uncensored videos of gorgeous sci-fi women packing their own "heavy artillery."

4518950.title: Quod Erat Demonstrandum
4518950.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain propositional calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

4519070.title: MOVILLIA
4519070.short_description: Plunge into the living alien cave system of MOVILLIA. Use LiDAR to map the dark and a grappling hook for total freedom of movement. Scan flora and fauna, mine ores, and explore breathtaking biomes. But beware: your LiDAR might detect a shadow that isn’t your lost partner. Adapt to survive.

4519100.title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
4519100.short_description: The days of dragon-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King sends you to reclaim the ancient halls! Grow crops & magic crystals, mine ores & precious stones, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich and expand a home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

4519110.title: Fortain
4519110.short_description: Build your castle, grow your economy, and raise a mighty army in this medieval strategy game. Manage resources, train Mamluk warriors, raid enemy camps, and defend against barbarian attacks. Can you amass enough glory to conquer the Horde Fortress?

4519190.title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn
4519190.short_description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Autumn is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Autumn-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

4519210.title: Tentacle Master
4519210.short_description: Adult-Only Narrative Clicker. Trapped in a writhing tentacles, you've seized control of the mass. Upgrade your tentacles, harvest neurons, and attempt escapes. Unlock erotic gallery scenes, and master your new form. Can you return to your body?

4519230.title: Penguin Pirates
4519230.short_description: Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!

4519240.title: Ignore the Blackbird
4519240.short_description: Ignore the Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolor puzzle game. Explore the greenhouse, solve puzzles woven into its surroundings, and uncover what happened to Sonya’s family.

4519250.title: Dungeon Roller
4519250.short_description: Master the Dice, the Deck, and the Roll. Dungeon Roller is a fast-paced roguelike deckbuilder where card strategy meets the grit of the dice. In the depths, success isn’t luck, it’s your ability to forge chance into your greatest ally. Build your engine, manipulate the odds and conquer the darkness.

4520500.title: Puzzle
4520500.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4520530.title: Bouncy Kingdoms
4520530.short_description: Bouncy Kingdoms is a ToyBox Fantasy Adventure Game! Explore an Open-World and Meet Fun Characters!

4520630.title: 鴷de（的）自学笔记之C语言（Le de Self-study note of C Game Language）
4520630.short_description: Leisure puzzle solving third person shooting game. Fly props 0 and 1 over polygons to display images.

4520780.title: 诸天斗法
4520780.short_description: A free-to-play strategic card game set in the world of Journey to the West. Choose your faction, build your deck, and battle for supremacy in real-time PvP.

4520950.title: Ancient World
4520950.short_description: You and your sister set out for the treasures of an ancient tomb, but she mysteriously vanished. Now it's a fight for survival in the desert: scorching heat, freezing cold, thirst, and hunger. Hunt down desert creatures, seek out oases, avoid traps and goblins.

4521010.title: holoBase
4521010.short_description: Enjoy real baseball action with hololive talents!! Create your own team with talents, fans, and mascots, and dive into intense, exciting games!

4521240.title: Butterfly Girl
4521240.short_description: A puzzle-adventure game blended with visual novel storytelling. A mysterious girl and butterflies appear each time you solve a puzzle inside the room. Who are they? What do they want? Unravel each puzzle one by one — and the truth draws ever closer.

4521310.title: Nepotism for Germany
4521310.short_description: Satirical political strategy: From local party to Orban's palace. Corruption has never been this much fun.

4521330.title: Ballmancy
4521330.short_description: Ballmancy is a pachinko-style roguelike where you launch balls to fight off waves of enemies. Choose from a variety of balls and items to create unique builds and see how far you can bounce.

4521510.title: Pokorama
4521510.short_description: Pokorama is a relaxing design game where you decorate cozy rooms with colors, patterns, and textures you love. There are no timers and no pressure - just kick back and enjoy the process of creating a homey space.

4521950.title: WorkWithDog
4521950.short_description: WorkWithDog is a productivity app where you track your work time with your cute companion, Mocha. Use the to-do list and memo features to organize your tasks, add your favorite work apps to the list, and see how much you've accomplished today — together with Mocha.

4522180.title: Tegelfall
4522180.short_description: Tegelfall is a cozy, stress‑free brick‑building puzzle game. Place each piece carefully so the upcoming ones can fit all the way to the end. And don’t worry about gaps, every building has a few holes, right?

4522510.title: Kill the Lich Idle
4522510.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4522510.short_description: Kill the Lich is a minimalist incremental game about time compression and resource flow. Route your primary resource—Momentum—downstream to unlock over 300 actions. Design granular automation, visualize exposed formulas, and trigger deep prestige layers to ultimately defeat the Lich!

4522690.title: Totem
4522690.short_description: TOTEM is a contemplative and spiritual experience in which you successively embody three totem animals: a bird, a wolf, and an elephant. Each animal represents a stage of an inner journey, guiding the player through the memories and emotions that shape a lifetime.

4522710.title: Swarmbound
4522710.short_description: Pick a class. Equip spell weapons. Survive the swarm. Chain lightning, spiral hammers, rain blizzards, and unleash poison novas against escalating waves of enemies. Loot, level, and spec your way to wave 30 — or go endless

4523240.title: The Last Connection
4523240.short_description: You are a Switchboard Operator, and you're about to be replaced by a machine. Use your last week of work to connect townsfolk, overcome problems, and explore the history of a cast of engaging characters. Your choices matter, so use each day to leave lasting bonds.

4524890.title: California Underground
4524890.short_description: Roll into a sun-bleached coastal town buzzing with ’90s indie energy, turn chaotic DIY gigs into legendary nights as you shape the local music scene and make it yours.

4525020.title: The Fourteen Day Letters
4525020.short_description: "The Fourteen Day Letters" is a ADV game centered around “chatting.” In a world that has already gone mad, you and “Yuna” hold onto the last fragments of sanity through a chatroom, spending fourteen days as everything slowly falls apart. And in the end, the outcome will change based on your choices.

4525350.title: TurboCraps
4525350.short_description: Craps game simulator with scripting and simulation support

4525390.title: Stacko
4525390.short_description: In Stacko, your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

4525680.title: Fonsermónique’s Culinary Diary
4525680.short_description: Fonsermónique's Culinary Diary is a short, linear narrative game where cooking becomes a bridge to the soul. As you prepare recipes, you receive feedback that accompanies Fonsermónique on her personal journey while exploring the temple for ingredients and the dragon, uncovering their unusual bond.

4525910.title: Square Escape
4525910.short_description: This little square keeps getting stuck in puzzling rooms, and it’s your job to help him find the way out. Push crates, interact with the environment, and think outside the box to escape

4526190.title: Hold It In
4526190.short_description: You are just trying to use the bathroom, but the world won't let you. Hold It In is a tower defense game where you battle waves of people and wild animals who are hell bent on ruining your relaxing bathroom break. Defend your toilet using drone-delivered defenses and a deep upgrade tree.

4526300.title: BAENANA
4526300.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4526300.short_description: BAENANA is a fast‑paced top‑down 2D roguelike arena shooter set in a vibrant cyber world. Choose unique fruit heroes with special power‑up skills and wield up to six weapons to fight hordes of hostile vegetables. Customize, upgrade, and survive chaotic cartoon‑styled battles.

4526340.title: Escape:The Nought
4526340.short_description: Trapped in diverse themed rooms connected through a massive central hub, you must use your interactive skills and deductive reasoning to uncover hidden truths. A variety of puzzles await you. Piece together the clues and escape this bizarre space!

4526380.title: My neighbor stinks
4526380.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4526380.short_description: A 3D first-person horror-comedy where players explore spooky environments, solve quirky challenges, and encounter bizarre, funny, and frightening moments.

4526640.title: Light the Fire
4526640.short_description: Light the Fire is a survival tower defense where you decide when waves begin and how difficult they become. Gather resources, craft gear, build defenses, and feed the fire… at your own risk.

4526710.title: N U C L I D E A N
4526710.short_description: NUCLIDEAN puts you into the shoes of a janitor at a planetary outpost invaded by an alien cult. In this retro boomer-shooter with a Non-Euclidean twist, you will encounter portals, crazy geometry and bloody monstrous enemies. All that on a distant planet where the rules of the Earth do not apply.

4526720.title: Pawn Within: Two Fates
4526720.short_description: A tabletop SRPG blending match-3, Skill Construction & tactics. Collect parts to craft skill discs, spin for random abilities, then merge or keep them. Equip gear, maneuver on grids, cast spells, and lead unique heroes to defeat challenging bosses in this strategic adventure.

4526770.title: Declutterer
4526770.short_description: Declutterer is a tidying and storage game. Accept commissions from different clients, clean up clutter, organize items, and restore order according to their requests.

4526890.title: Silver Requiem
4526890.short_description: Dance on the Edge of Death. A single counter turns the battlefield into your stage. High-Mobility Counter × Build-Oriented 3D Soulslike Action :Leave even your regrets behind.:

4526920.title: Space Commanders: Solar System
4526920.short_description: A lone space commander explores real planetary surfaces, builds small outposts, rescues stranded astronauts, and fights to survive in the cold silence of the Solar System.

4527040.title: One Step One Mistake
4527040.short_description: One mistake = death. This is not a normal Minesweeper. Think fast. Move carefully. Avoid deadly mines and survive relentless drone attacks. Every step could be your last.

4527150.title: Banana Belt Miner
4527150.short_description: a fast-paced twin-stick space shooter where humanity discovers that bananas are the most powerful energy source in the universe, Upgrade your ship, defeat massive enemy warships, and survive endless waves of enemies as you carve your path through the deep space of the banana belt..

4527180.title: Rift Diver
4527180.short_description: Rift Diver is a punishing 2D hack and slash with souls-like elements. As the "Unforgiven", descend into the chaotic Below to slay the Reaper! Master the dash, upgrade your unique class, and crush relentless swarms across a 4-level campaign or the Endless Dungeon.

4527290.title: Litter Treasures
4527290.short_description: A cozy cat-care game about discovering little treasures. Adopt curious cats, scoop their litter to uncover strange loot, and use your finds to decorate their home.

4527340.title: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
4527340.short_description: Help Chi Chi clean grime and master her magical cleaning prowess. Make her parents proud in this cozy witchy cleaning sim. Clean with a spell-powered wand, explore charming locations, find potions, and bring sparkle back to every corner of the enchanted world.

4527460.title: Void Odyssey
4527460.short_description: Chart the cosmos, master orbital flight, and battle your way through a genre-bending galaxy where ancient magic meets rocket engineering. A tactical RPG unlike anything in the universe.

4527480.title: MAD
4527480.short_description: MAD is a hardcore top-down action shooter set in a violent, 90s-inspired dystopia, featuring light RPG progression and inventory management. The story unfolds in a corrupt city of the future, where the elite stage and broadcast a deadly show — and you are the next contestant.

4527550.title: Flounder
4527550.short_description: From cozy to crazy. A fishy roguelite. Discover a colorful roster of fish, menacing bosses and dynamic items, all with their own tricks to master. Catch rare fish to fill your virtual fish tank and complete your collection. Survive the boss incursions and surface victorious! The depth is deceiving.

4527670.title: Vestige
4527670.short_description: Vestige is a third‑person narrative adventure where you explore a mysterious island to piece together the fragments of a forgotten past. Discover buried memories and confront the emotions that shaped Paul’s life.

4527800.title: Punt! Rollin Raccoons
4527800.short_description: The Raccoons are out and up to no good! Punt your very own Raccoon and cause havoc in this Pinball inspired arcade game. Destroy whatever is in your path, complete missions, and customize your rotund friend.

4527840.title: Of Grace & Gambit
4527840.short_description: Cards, courtship, and consequence. Build your deck and your reputation to make your mark in the social season. In this Regency inspired world, every victory and defeat leaves an impression. The eyes of the ton are watching carefully. The eyes of your prospects are watching even closer.

4527860.title: Slay Them All
4527860.short_description: A fast-paced dungeon clicker with satisfying combat feedback. Click to slash monsters, collect gold coins, and spend it on an upgrade tree that makes every run feel more powerful than the last.

4527890.title: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book I
4527890.short_description: Fight through the 1st and 2nd Crusades and the conflicts between them in Crusades: Book I, a tactical medieval wargame of sieges, field battles, and frontier warfare. Command Crusader armies or Islamic alliances across 74 scenarios and two branching campaigns.

4527900.title: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book II
4527900.short_description: Continue the struggle for the Holy Land in Crusades: Book II, a tactical medieval wargame covering the Third and Fourth Crusades between 1149 and 1204. Command the Crusader Alliance or the Anti-Crusader Alliance across 102 historically accurate scenarios and four branching campaigns.

4527910.title: Star Scrap
4527910.short_description: Star Scrap is a twin stick space roguelite where Star, a broke bounty hunter, blasts through 100 waves of aliens with 8 weapons, 33 upgrades, and a sarcastic salvage drone named Scrap.

4527930.title: Idle Deepcore
4527930.short_description: Idle Deepcore is an incremental mining game where you dig ever deeper, smelt ore into ingots, upgrade your pickaxe and machines, and expand across multiple mines running in parallel to build a vast underground industry.

4527970.title: The Anomaly Inspector
4527970.short_description: You're an Anomaly Inspector working the night shift at a remote facility. Walk through each area, report what's wrong at the terminal—or report that everything is clear. But as the night progresses, the anomalies become harder to ignore. Can you survive until morning?

4527990.title: Rogue Battler
4527990.short_description: A retro minimalist auto-battler roguelike where you choose your path, build your stats, and survive as long as possible.

4528060.title: Dominoir
4528060.short_description: Dominoir is a strategic domino roguelike where every tile can trigger explosive combos. Build powerful upgrades, manipulate the board, and chain massive scores in a stylish noir casino. Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

4528160.title: عامل المزرعة
4528160.genre: Action, Adventure, Racing, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4528160.short_description: تبدأ رحلتك كعامل بسيط تم استئجاره لمزرعة نائية، لتكتشف سريعاً الوجه المظلم لمالكها . بين رعاية الأغنام والدجاج وتنظيف المزرعة، ستجد نفسك سجيناً في نظام استغلال لا يرحم. استكشف أسرار السجن المخفي وحاول النجاة والهروب من قبضة الظلم قبل فوات الأوان

4528170.title: Sting & Swing
4528170.short_description: Explore a strange overgrown world as a bee with a golf ball. Master the skills of bee-golf to uncover the mysteries hidden in its furthest reaches and hiding in front of you. Discover uses for abilities you didn't know you had. There are always more secrets for those who seek them beneath the green.

4528230.title: Boom Boom No Guess Minesweeper
4528230.short_description: Classic MineSweeper meets intense dungeon combat! Explore mysterious magic towers, encounter bizarre monsters, and collect powerful items. Featuring unique mine-sweeping battle mechanics, every step of deduction is crucial!

4528240.title: 暗黑战神
4528240.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4528240.short_description: Dark Battle God is a tower-defense shooter blending post-apocalyptic wasteland with Q-version cartoon style. You play as a warrior defending your base, competing for the title of "Battle God" of survival and victory in the post-apocalyptic wasteland.

4528410.title: Logos Orbit
4528410.short_description: Logos Orbit is an emergent cosmic tuning simulation where you rewrite the "Logos" of an ever-expanding universe to control the collision and equilibrium of stars. Place gravity-altering Sigils to tune the orbits of star systems on the brink of collapse.

4528430.title: Gloamroot
4528430.short_description: Gloamroot is a first-person adventure set in a small, surreal village. Tasked to finish chores for your sick father, you uncover unsettling details hiding beneath the town’s calm surface. Something else is watching.

4528440.title: ALAYA: Tale of the Gloomy Dream
4528440.short_description: Alaya connects the multiverse but also sediments a corrupting Void, eroding the Great Qian Dynasty with eldritch horrors. Lead Taoist, Buddhist, Mohist, and Confucian heroes through grid-based 1st-person dungeons. Master tactical turn-based combat. A pure, immersive indie DRPG. No IAP. No ads.

4535780.title: Love is Undead
4535780.short_description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

4535850.title: LACUNA -ZEROA-
4535850.short_description: LACUNA -ZEROA- is a Fantasy Military Open World Survival Craft FPS. Wield elemental powers, enchant weapons from assault rifles to scythes, and fight to survive in a world where dark fantasy, sci-fi, and military aesthetics collide.

4535860.title: The Way Home | 집으로 가는 길
4535860.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the remote countryside of South Korea in the 1990s. Over the course of just three days, you will encounter a series of mysterious events and come face-to-face with an unseen, encroaching threat

4535920.title: Little Casualties
4535920.short_description: Tiny named units. Endless carnage. An epic journey spanning generations. Guide your little casualties to the exit... or don't. Sorry Gerald.

4535930.title: Pax Astra
4535930.short_description: Pax Astra is a political sim rpg set in a space opera setting. Follow any ideology, govern any way you want. Lead a broken nation as its first president. Build a communist utopia, become a fascist dictator, explore unknown dimensions, or enslave a god. Manage elections, economics, crises and more.

4535980.title: Talisman Codes
4535980.short_description: A cyberpunk × fantasy card battle RPG. Build your deck through diverse quests and grow an unstoppable party. Uncover the secrets of the Talisman Code — a mysterious device that summons spirits — in this deep deckbuilding experience.

4536070.title: Succulent Break
4536070.short_description: Come and grow a variety of succulents! Succulent Break is a relaxing simulation game where you can nurture plants in the corner of your desktop. Match pots and soil, water them at the perfect moment, and watch your succulents burst into vibrant colors.

4536100.title: Beer Gunner
4536100.short_description: A fast-paced run-and-gun shooter in the spirit of the classics — shoot, jump, and shred monsters to energetic music.

4536120.title: Beat Boxy
4536120.short_description: Play as Boxy, a stressed-out shipping crate running, skateboarding & rollerblading to make his delivery. Jump & slide through dozens of brutally fun, rhythm-fueled levels. Master 3 speeds, collect gems, unlock new outfits, and survive the chaos in this vibrant low-poly auto-runner with epic music!

4536130.title: Security Guard: Supernatural
4536130.short_description: Patrol a building as a night shift security guard and deal with intruders and supernatural entities using hired guards, surveillance systems, and specialized equipment before everything spirals out of control.

4536220.title: 汉末纷争三国
4536220.short_description: This is a 3D war game featuring a mix of over a dozen factions. You can choose any faction and, in first person, freely control any warrior with varying attributes and skills. Rely on your strategy to unify the whole world.

4536320.title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
4536320.short_description: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm is a strategy-driven, turn-based game that blends hexagonal grid exploration, Roguelite progression, squad building, and auto-battling—all set against the backdrop of classic Chinese mythology and folklore! No real-time manual input is required;

4536380.title: Corelith
4536380.short_description: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

4536460.title: Visual Novel: Call of Toilet
4536460.short_description: In this game, you don't survive; you live for your own pleasure. Drag your friend into this crazy road movie, where every mutant is trying not to devour you, but to draw you into their everyday drama. Will you reach the coveted golden toilet or become a local legend?

4536570.title: ドロチェの箱庭
4536570.short_description: Jackalope Doroche loves alcohol. Let's make flower liqueur and transform our winter garden into a spring wonderland.

4536660.title: Trap Roller
4536660.short_description: Control ball in this 3d ball platformer game. Try to collect all keys to unlock finish before time ends and also collect stars in every level to get achivements. Be a master ball controller

4536690.title: Holm Sweet Holm
4536690.short_description: A life simulator about working, driving, and getting by. Do odd jobs in a small town setting with fika and a cash-only lifestyle. At night, things change. The animals turn. Best to be asleep. Probably.

4536740.title: Echoes
4536740.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

4536810.title: 2TAP
4536810.short_description: 2TAP is a fast-paced competitive multiplayer shooter where two hits are enough to eliminate an opponent; drop into a Battle Royale, loot gear, and outplay other players using precision, reflexes, and strategy in intense real-time combat.

4536820.title: Betrayal at Paragon
4536820.short_description: BaP is an action RPG set in a vast immersive world with day night and weather cycles. Take on a variety of side quests, discover 300+ items with magical and physical attributes, master 30+ unique skills. Defeat monsters, give flowers to girls, and uncover all the secrets of the island.

4536850.title: Don't Push TOO Hard
4536850.short_description: A relaxing yet challenging Sokoban-style puzzle game. Push crates, plan ahead, and avoid dead ends. Discover clever mechanics like emotion-driven crates and solve increasingly complex puzzles across unique environments.

4536870.title: Idle Spin&Win Tower Defense
4536870.short_description: Idle Spin&Win combines strategic tower defense, satisfying idle progression, and thrilling luck-based mechanics. Build an impenetrable fortress, unlock devastating abilities, and spin the wheel of fortune to supercharge your defenses against endless enemy waves!

4536880.title: 仙途
4536880.short_description: A cultivation sim about a mortal’s path to ascension. Reach Divinity Transformation, defeat the guardian, and achieve your ending. Success requires resource management, synergy of gear and techniques, careful pacing, and avoiding age limits. Even cheap equipment can later shine with the right build.

4536970.title: Fish House Simulator
4536970.short_description: Catch it, cook it… or sell it under the table. 🎣 In Fish House, catch fish, cook, and serve customers! Upgrade your gear, catch valuable fish, and grow your restaurant. Not everything is legal—some fish are risky but profitable. Every fish ends up on a plate… some leave through the back door.

4536980.title: ClearIt M1
4536980.short_description: A cozy yet clever puzzle! Help the badger collect the red power stones before the monster. Clear the board with balls, complete 200 levels, and enjoy multiple modes, including playing against AI.

4537030.title: Rhythm Roll
4537030.short_description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes as the challenge grows. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

4537040.title: Sky Safari: FPV Drone
4537040.short_description: Take to the skies in this open-world FPV drone simulator. Track majestic animals, master realistic flight physics, and capture the perfect cinematic shot. Complete challenging missions and explore beautiful natural environments in the ultimate aerial photography safari.

4537080.title: Drift Tank
4537080.short_description: Take control of a powerful tank and prove that drifting isn’t just for cars. Slide through corners, build up speed, and cause pure chaos on the maps. Easy to pick up, hard to master perfect for a chill, no pressure experience.

4537100.title: diffiCULT
4537100.short_description: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.

4537170.title: Big Bumper Bash
4537170.short_description: Bigger Bumper Bash is a chaotic arcade score-chaser where you crash, drive, and try to beat your own records. No story, no drama just you, your car, and questionable decisions at high speed.

4537250.title: Batak
4537250.genre: Casual, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4537250.short_description: A classic Turkish trick-taking card game for 1-4 players. Play Klasik Batak or Eşli Batak (Partnership) against AI opponents or with friends online through Steam multiplayer. Bid, choose trump, and outplay your rivals.

4537260.title: Hentai Clicker: Yuki is streaming
4537260.short_description: 💻💜 Hentai Clicker: Yuki is streaming Collect hearts, unlock cute and daring nerd-girl outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Yuki, a playful geek streamer who knows exactly how to keep her audience hooked. 🎮🔥

4537280.title: Rulehouse
4537280.short_description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rule House is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

4537300.title: Among The Sierra Nevada
4537300.short_description: Explore a vast wilderness, track massive footprints, and collect cryptid evidence. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover clues left by a missing ranger, and survive encounters with an intelligent creature. The deeper you go, the more it feels like something is watching you.

4537870.title: Prehistoric Adventure
4537870.short_description: The World's greatest adventure is waiting for you. Just step through the entrance gates, and visit an age when the Earth was ruled by giant, exotic beasts. It's not just about prehistoric thrills, though, as modern attractions vie for your attention, including very tall and fast rollercoasters.

4537880.title: The Great Flock Off
4537880.short_description: Optimize your flock by converting chickens colors, upgrading your coop, selecting flock abilities and even merging chickens to make them fancier! Travel all the way across Cluckshire to different contests, win contests to earn gold and keep building your chicken empire!

4537930.title: Field Recordings
4537930.short_description: Field Recordings is an atmospheric sci-fi adventure set in the fragments of a collapsing reality. Guided by a lonely AI from the abandoned Project Ariadne, explore isolated pockets of the world and search for survivors. Use a Field Recorder to tune into echoes and uncover what remains.

4537940.title: Pick Three!!!
4537940.short_description: The game where you pick from three! Choose your weapon ball and fight others in unstable best-of-3 matches, upgrade your stats, and bounce around the arena until you finally claim victory. Get popular and have your fans assist you, and befriend the Ref to maximize your odds.

4537950.title: AM I HERE?
4537950.short_description: No character. No body. No mercy. Just footprints… and your inevitable failure.

4538030.title: Cybersquare Madness
4538030.short_description: Immerse in this cyberpunk fun strategic tower defence, with multitudes of strategic diversity, while encountering boss fight, and fighting for you glory to cubic perfection.

4538060.title: Subsurface
4538060.short_description: A co-op underwater horror game where you and your crew descend into the depths to recover resources, meet your quota, and survive what lurks below.

4538070.title: Find AI Parking Spot
4538070.short_description: Master the chaos in Cyber Chariot 3000, the ultimate Rage Game. With unforgiving driving mechanics, you’re late for work in a crowded city. Your only "ally" is an AI Helping Bot whose "assistance" is your biggest obstacle. Can you wrestle with the controls and park before you snap?

4538150.title: After Hue
4538150.short_description: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

4538170.title: Yet Another Reality Show
4538170.short_description: Explore a fantasy world with a reality television twist! In this turn-based CRPG, the choices are yours. Build your party alongside wacky companions, vanquish enemies in tactical combat, and even outlast fellow houseguests in the region's famous Bachelorette Tournament!

4538200.title: Heat
4538200.short_description: HEAT is a sandbox survival game, with tower defense elements, modular tools, and really cool building system. Focused on player interactions with the world.

4538260.title: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
4538260.short_description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

4538280.title: Pizza Turbo
4538280.short_description: High-speed arcade racing game where you deliver pizzas across a chaotic city full of deadly traps. Perform stunts, use power-ups, and survive before your pizza gets cold.

4538350.title: Astral Trial
4538350.short_description: This is an independent, episodic roguelike deck-building game. It features an innovative "symmetrical DBG" combat system: you can see through your enemy's hand and leave them with no cards to play. Defeat in battle doesn't mean the end; reshape your destiny and become a game-changer in this world.

4538420.title: D-Extinction
4538420.short_description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

4538450.title: Shattered Spheres
4538450.short_description: Shattered Spheres is a turn-based 2D space 4X strategy game inspired by the classics of the genre. Explore a living galaxy, build your empire, and crush your rivals through military conquest or diplomatic cunning — without the micromanagement bloat of modern 4X games.

4538480.title: Terra Ninfa
4538480.short_description: A laid-back puzzle/exploration game about reviving forgotten, dried-up landscapes and turning them into picturesque dioramas. Manipulate water, irrigate all the plants, bring a wild beauty to a neglected world while discovering the secrets of the Nymphs.

4538590.title: OBSERVE
4538590.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a Japanese train station after the last departure. The station knows your name. Something is watching. What is seen cannot be unseen. 終電後の日本の駅を舞台にした、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。駅は、あなたの名前を知っている。何かが、見ている。一度見たものは、二度と見なかったことにはできない。

4538600.title: Claire Darksage and the Penumbra Deaths Collector's Edition
4538600.short_description: Join Claire Darksage on a fantasy journey to Altheria. Solve signature Hidden Object scenes and master a revamped card battle system to hunt a killer hiding in plain sight. In a kingdom of magic, the deadliest threats wear the most familiar faces.

4538660.title: Signal Scavenger
4538660.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4538660.short_description: A tactical third-person extraction shooter where prisoners are sent into a fog-covered apocalypse to disable deadly signals. Complete randomized missions, survive against mutants, and extract before time runs out—or lose everything.

4538670.title: Love at First Frost
4538670.short_description: Love at First Frost is an adult romance visual novel set at a mountain lodge in the Colorado Rockies. Play as Asher, a photographer rebuilding his career, and choose between three women—Neve, Tamsin, or Margaux—each fighting her own battle with ambition, doubt, and legacy.

4538680.title: Midnight Queue
4538680.short_description: Vampires infiltrate the nightclub queue. You are the bouncer. Check documents, observe suspicious behavior, and use tools to decide who gets in and who stays outside, but the final decision is always yours.

4538820.title: Wasteland Light
4538820.short_description: Light of the Wasteland is a PvE survival game. Build your base in a wasteland, scavenge for supplies, gradually arm yourself, and fend off the creatures. When faced with insurmountable monster, you can awaken a mysterious power within your body, temporarily transforming to turn the tide of battle.

4538830.title: Track Star
4538830.short_description: Four years of high school track & field. One shot at a college scholarship. Choose your specialty, build your athlete, and beat the rival who's been faster than you since day one.

4538860.title: COZY MOVING DAY
4538860.short_description: COZY MOVING DAY is a relaxing moving game with no stress or time pressure. Pack furniture and objects, load up your truck, explore cozy locations, meet adorable animals, and enjoy calm music at your own pace.

4538870.title: Football Ambition
4538870.short_description: Want to control the World Cup? Want to create your own super league? Control the underground transfer market? Win the hearts of glamorous socialites? In this 2D football RPG, you can. Choose from 10 careers, manage 400+ clubs, and build your billionaire empire. It's all here.

4538910.title: Rogue Mate
4538910.short_description: A roguelite chess RPG where your pieces evolve beyond the board. Unlock branching skill trees, recruit and build your warband, then battle through ten handcrafted boss encounters, each with unique mechanics designed to dismantle your strategy.

4538930.title: We are one body
4538930.short_description: You are trapped on an endless road. Become one with your friend and reach the end of the road.

4539060.title: Grimshaw's Blotto
4539060.short_description: A gothic 1v1 card-and-dice strategy game of hidden plays, escalating drafts, and blood-cost powers. Face Grimshaw's Inner Circle in campaign or duel online at a cursed table.

4539120.title: Quantum Fight : Aero 2299
4539120.genre: Action, Indie, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4539120.short_description: Become the champion of the ultimate galactic show in this intense blend of Tower Defense and tactical assault. Manage resources in real-time, deploy your AI squads, and annihilate your rivals before billions of spectators in Quantum Fight: Aero 2299.

4539160.title: Son Of The Exorcist
4539160.short_description: You play as a son looking for his missing father, after he does not return from a job, you visit a mysterious mansion in his neighborhood to uncover what happened. Explore rooms, solve puzzles and face tense moments as you try to uncover the secrets inside relating to his disappearance.

4539220.title: Adapter Story
4539220.short_description: A third person platforming adventure game about making connections in a world inhabited by music equipment

4539230.title: Clicking Into Place: Clara
4539230.short_description: A cozy incremental game about falling in love. Meet Clara, earn her trust, and watch a lifetime unfold through hand-drawn scenes — from a spilled latte to the morning of your wedding.

4539240.title: 树人
4539240.short_description: As the bell rings, you face twelve students from vastly different backgrounds, each hiding their own secrets. Whether they are defensive prodigies, burdened high-achievers, or lost souls on the verge of dropping out, their converging paths of youth now meet in your classroom.

4539270.title: Seven Nights In The Dark
4539270.short_description: Mom says goodnight. The light goes off. And they come. Four demons haunt Ethan every night — patient, relentless, and learning. Hide under the bed. Shut the door. Turn on the heater. Survive until 6 AM. Seven nights. Can you make it to morning?

4539320.title: RoPos
4539320.short_description: In this poker auto battler, achieve poker hands (ranks) to earn predetermined rewards and grow stronger. Fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect and upgrade items, and craft your own build. Replay runs to challenge higher difficulties and more powerful enemies.

4539340.title: The Spaces We Share
4539340.short_description: Unpack a life together. In this co-op experience, you and a partner arrange belongings across changing homes, agree on what belongs where, or don’t.

4539410.title: Cubie
4539410.short_description: CUBIE is a minimalist puzzle platformer where you control gravity. Each side of the cube offers unique physics based on how you enter it. The world remains the same – only your perspective changes. Can you solve spatial puzzles in a labyrinth where "up" is just a relative term?

4539460.title: Fragments of Fear
4539460.short_description: A VHS found-footage horror anthology where everyday chores become your worst nightmares. Experience a growing collection of bite-sized analog horror episodes, from a late-night trip to the laundromat to a terrifying walk home. Can you survive the mundane?

4539550.title: Tabletop Survivors
4539550.short_description: Tabletop Survivors is a turn-based roguelike RPG driven by random event cards. You will survive and fight in a zombie apocalypse, making new companions and challenging dangerous enemies. Can you reach your destination?

4539590.title: Wax Rogue
4539590.short_description: Wax Rogue is a 2D roguelike where you must build the tallest tower. Play as a candle that must construct the tallest tower before it burns out. Use a variety of buildings, improve your stats, and customize your playstyle.

4539810.title: Almazuela Picross
4539810.short_description: You must complete almazuelas, quilts made from scraps of fabric arranged in geometric patterns. To obtain the scraps, you’ll need to solve a Picross by filling in and removing cells based on the clues. You can rotate and move these scraps until you’ve pieced together the patchwork like a puzzle.

4539860.title: Reignfall: Fallen Crown
4539860.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite card game where choices matter. Swipe cards, make moral decisions, build your skill tree — spin the Wheel of Kings and survive until the year 2000, or watch your kingdom fall.

4539870.title: Khaldun: Text Based Strategy
4539870.short_description: Khaldun is a medieval-themed ASCII graphics kingdom management game. Take part in realistic war simulations and decide every detail of your kingdom, from its economy to its demographics! Your decisions will shape the life of a nation. Rise or be lost to history...

4539900.title: Boobie Impact
4539900.short_description: An absurd daily life with a four-breasted girlfriend

4539930.title: Cooking Survivor
4539930.short_description: Battle hordes of hungry customers, create the meals they want, and serve them within the time limit to keep them happy. Will you survive the entire shift, or will you disappoint your customers?

4539950.title: Unanswered
4539950.short_description: You awaken in an impossible place with no memory of who you are, where you are, or how you got here. Trapped in a world that twists and bends to break your mind, your only escape is to step into the unknown and face the horrors of a past you are desperately trying to forget.

4540010.title: Business Defence
4540010.short_description: A forced perspective, business themed tower defence game where the player deploys corporate towers to hold back waves of protestors. Demolish special towers to adjust enemy stats and affect the score multiplier. Play through the story to find out if BBB learns anything along the way.

4540020.title: IRON-PLUNDER
4540020.short_description: THE PLUNDER AWAITS! Ambient Noise needs comic books, and the Mecha-Skull shrines of the Machine-Faith can be traded for comics! Assault their constantly shifting stronghold by way of action-packed arcade twin-stick shooting, Crush your foes and get the IRON-PLUNDER (That being comics).

4540090.title: DISTURBING FEARS - Workplace
4540090.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4540090.short_description: "DISTURBING FEARS" is an episodic horror series inspired by real events that immerses players in disturbing stories.

4540150.title: GridFall: Nine-Grid
4540150.short_description: "GridFall: Nine-Grid" is a survivor-like game where you build skills on a 3x3 grid. Complete lines to unlock active abilities—each cell has its own passive trait, forcing strategic choices between odds and stats. Survive the cyber wasteland!Free demo available now！

4540160.title: Claim Denied!
4540160.short_description: You're an insurance investigator. Review evidence, spot fraud, make decisions. Every case is a puzzle — approve, reject, or negotiate. Limited energy, a ticking clock, and your reputation on the line

4540180.title: Revenge Of Destiny
4540180.short_description: Revenge Of Destiny is a medieval-themed third-person action-adventure game that tells a story about a warrior seeking revenge. Fulfill your vow of vengeance through traditional sword and shield combat and by completing linear, story-driven quests.

4540260.title: Project Ants
4540260.short_description: Project Ants is a 3D Metroidvania combining the exploration depth of Hollow Knight with the technical hack-and-slash of Ninja Gaiden. Set in a fractured insect kingdom, a fallen Phragmotic Ant Warrior explores a brutal, layered world to uncover the secrets at its core.

4540360.title: Hel Survivor
4540360.short_description: Smite demons, collect holy power-ups, and turn Hel into a pixelated fireworks show in this chaotic Survivor game! Play as a ridiculously determined holy knight auto-blasting through hordes of the damned. Simple controls, massive screen-clearing combos, and enough divine fire to make demons cry.

4540510.title: 8-hour Workday
4540510.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4540510.short_description: 8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours. There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!

4540590.title: Tower's Gambit
4540590.short_description: A card-based roguelike where every flip could be your fortune — or your doom. Descend a pyramid of cards, dodge deadly matches, play face cards at the perfect moment, and risk your score against 10 brutal boss towers. No two runs are the same.

4540610.title: Labyrinth of Whiskers
4540610.short_description: In this game maps become larger and harder to get through, there are 3 ending portions of each map which only 1 will randomly have the final cheese to leave and unlock the next level, you will collect cheese throughout the maze to purchase more mazes to conquer.

4540660.title: Prehistoric Pit
4540660.short_description: Step into the scales of a dinosaur and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced action roguelike. Collect experience, choose from powerful upgrades, and evolve into the ultimate apex predator. How long can you withstand the chaos?

4540720.title: Lucky Again
4540720.short_description: Face down swarms of enemies using cards with diverse abilities. Evolve your own unique deck to overcome the trials ahead, and become a quick-witted hero who can conquer any crisis. You will be joined by loyal companions OR charismatic fairies who aren't afraid to use you for their own ends.

4540860.title: Chip Away
4540860.short_description: A roulette game with roguelite progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

4540880.title: Defence of Nythrial
4540880.short_description: Defence of Nythrial is a 2D, Top down, Tower Defence / Real Time Strategy Game.

4540900.title: Reclaim: Earth Protocol
4540900.short_description: A squad-based auto-battler where your strategy drives a living battlefield. Deploy units, trigger devastating combos, and reclaim Earth from an alien invasion.

4540990.title: Shaftkeeper
4540990.short_description: Your job is simple: collect trash bags and burn them in the furnace to generate energy and keep the massive Shaft spinning.

4541000.title: Hackers: The Revolution Begins
4541000.short_description: Welcome back to 2009. Experience a ground-up remake of the cult-classic hacking sim. Navigate a global map, crack high-stakes encryption, and manage your Heat. When the Feds trace your signal, survive the "Final Stand" or watch your save file vanish forever. Are you in, or just another log?

4541130.title: Div Zero
4541130.short_description: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.

4541170.title: Retro Pond
4541170.short_description: Design your dream pond, breed fish, combine traits and create entirely new species

4541190.title: Seas of Static
4541190.short_description: A methodical single-player strategy game. Command your fleet in an irradiated warzone, use deduction to uncover the locations of friends and foes, and bring your mighty arsenal to bear against all those who would defy the empire.

4541270.title: Cards Of Calling
4541270.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you command summoned creatures in battle. Build your deck, create powerful synergies, and fight alongside your pack in tactical turn-based combat.

4541310.title: Flirt Simulator
4541310.short_description: Forget pre-written options; let your words drive the game! In this first-person life and dating sim, say whatever you want to AI characters with real memories and get natural responses. Improve your stats, flirt with anyone, and experience a completely unique, living world.

4541320.title: Florence Mirror
4541320.short_description: Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in modern Florence, where a hidden mirror dimension unleashes monstrous reflections of human sins. As Leonardo Tornabuoni, fight through 30+ bosses, master arcane powers, and choose between a story-driven path or a brutal Souls-like challenge.

4541390.title: That's An Order Ensign
4541390.short_description: Complete a slew of mundane and dangerous tasks, Do it quick or you're dismissed! Try to stay alive, but do your job.  Because after all... That's an order, ensign!

4541400.title: Dustwalker
4541400.short_description: Pilot an armed rover in a sci-fi side-scrolling endless runner. Jump hazards, boost across rough terrain, battle UFOs, collect upgrades, and survive as long as you can.

4541420.title: Khaos Keys
4541420.short_description: Khaos Keys, a rhythm game utilizing the keyboard like an instrument! Players swiftly move their hands horizontally over the range of keys, striking notes to the rhythm of the music. It’s truly a hand-crafted experience with an original soundtrack! Can you keep up with this intense style of play?

4541440.title: Spider Lily
4541440.short_description: A Lost Soul rescues a Blind Fish on the shores of the afterlife, binding their fates. With only a drum to guide the way, escort this fragile companion through a vast facility that processes souls toward rebirth — an emotional journey through attachment, dependence, and letting go.

4541460.title: A Smithing Game
4541460.short_description: A Smithing Game is an online 2-4 player game where you smith weapons and fight other players with them.

4541520.title: Serenity In Surrender

4548150.short_description: Glass Monsters is a single-player first-person 3D survival shooter where you fight off waves of monsters on beautiful and varied procedural glass arenas, using different weapons, destructible environments, and constant repositioning to survive.

4548190.title: Ironfront Express
4548190.short_description: Command the Ironfront Express in this roguelite lane-defense. Build your train car by car with turrets, drones, and abilities, and fight through waves of corrupted mining machines toward the rogue AI core in the planet's depths.

4548240.title: Anonymized
4548240.short_description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

4548250.title: Past Due: Midnight
4548250.short_description: Venture through a twisted corporate office in this first-person psychological horror. An ordinary evening of overtime turns into a nightmare. You awaken at midnight, trapped in a place you no longer recognize. Follow the clues, unravel what happened. Can you survive the night and escape alive?

4548330.title: VI: REM
4548330.short_description: VI: REM is a psychological horror game with no hand-holding. Explore 5 dimensions to find clues while evading a stalker. Manage your flashlight, piece together notes, and solve the 6th door's mystery to wake up. With no save points, your memory is your only weapon to survive.

4548350.title: Barro 2026
4548350.short_description: Barro 2026 is a racing game where you choose from 20 cars, master 5 unique tracks, and compete against up to 10 rivals in intense high-speed races.

4548510.title: Shiki Tea House
4548510.short_description: Run a cozy tea house, grow tea plants, brew tea drinks and serve customers at your own pace in a relaxing life sim with farming, crafting, and shop management.

4548670.title: Within
4548670.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Explore a house that feels like it knows you. Uncover dark secrets buried within its walls. Something is watching. Something has been waiting a very long time.

4548710.title: Physician Simulator
4548710.short_description: A district physician simulator. See patients, review lab results, make diagnoses and write prescriptions. Real doctors say they recognize themselves. Every decision has consequences.

4548750.title: Entropy Protocol
4548750.short_description: A multiplayer space survival game where you are corrupted data in a dying universe. Build automated processing networks in the void. Steal bandwidth from The Cloud to stay alive. Fight off its immune system. Cooperate with other survivors or betray them. When the Exit Node opens, only one gets out.

4548810.title: Mega Mage
4548810.short_description: Combine devastating spells with lethal weapon mastery to liberate five distinct regions controlled by a tyrant Archmage. Gather new spells, weapons and armor to grow powerful enough to challenge the Archmage and decide the fate of the world.

4548840.title: Belonging to Eunoia
4548840.short_description: Belonging to Eunoia is a narrative walking simulator about loneliness and depression. Explore the world, find letters written by real people, solve puzzles, find lost treasure and guide Xialia as she is unsure of ending her own life. Your choice is her path.

4548940.title: KIRILMA: Helix Horizon
4548940.short_description: Explore a dystopian sci-fi world in KIRILMA: Helix Horizon, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a collapsed world.

4549030.title: E.S.O: Don't Forget
4549030.short_description: A terrifying test of memory. Escape the creatures and DON'T FORGET what door you've been assigned...

4549080.title: MarbleFlow
4549080.short_description: MarbleFlow is a physics-based puzzle game where you place various devices and rails to guide a marble to its goal. Arrange objects and use their interactions to solve each puzzle. Enjoy calm yet challenging puzzles with the gentle sounds of marbles and mechanisms.

4549270.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
4549270.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where every real-world keystroke converts into game progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

4549340.title: BRAINBUGS: The Game
4549340.short_description: Promotional tie-in game for BRAINBUGS, the new feature film from CUTitPRINTit. Play as Teddy, pick up and deliver food in innovative "DoorDash" style gameplay! Discover first-hand why our unlikely protagonist is so depressed.

4549380.title: Stuck in the Sewers
4549380.short_description: Stuck in the Sewers is a chill puzzle game about finding your way out in a maze of pipes.

4549520.title: Cronus Monument
4549520.short_description: Cronus Monument is a surrealist adventure game where players must purify the world... No matter the cost.

4549540.title: The Capitalist
4549540.short_description: The Capitalist is the ultimate hyper-realistic Private Equity simulator. Raise capital, execute Leveraged Buyouts (LBOs), restructure distressed businesses, and flip them for massive profits. Wall Street doesn’t forgive mistakes, but it pays handsomely for success.

4549610.title: Three Kingdoms : Alias
4549610.short_description: A world where officers hide their names and abilities. Can you spot Zhuge Liang? A hardcore turn-based strategy simulation for true Three Kingdoms devotees.

4549720.title: Hentai Age Land
4549720.short_description: Relaxing puzzle adventure where each level reveals beautiful girl portraits, with no time limits or pressure. Enjoy smooth gameplay, soothing visuals, and a calming experience perfect for unwinding anytime truly.

4549760.title: Shanhai Ranch
4549760.short_description: Shanhai Ranch is a desktop idle management game. Collect mythical beasts, assign the five elements, and let them dig treasure, produce resources, and build your ranch on your desktop. Expand storage, upgrade buildings, and grow your own automated beast-running loop.

4549870.title: Booox
4549870.short_description: "Booox" is a platform puzzle game where players control multiple characters simultaneously, coordinating their actions to solve challenges.

4550050.title: Sweet Massage 2
4550050.short_description: Sweet Massage 2 - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around a massage parlor, depicting the daily work lives of five pretty and cute massage parlor girls. It features relaxing music, and after completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4550080.title: Super Gerio Town
4550080.short_description: A new‑style indie action game that blends classic retro gameplay with the realism of human bodily needs. “Will you make it… or will you burst?”

4550120.title: Hyper Sphere
4550120.short_description: Hyper Sphere is a high-octane roguelite bullet hell where you shoot, parry and dodge through waves of evil cubes. Combine a wide variety of wacky items to create broken builds, parry projectiles back at your enemies, and defeat the final boss.

4550150.title: Get Rid Of Those Corners
4550150.short_description: Clear all sides of the shapes inhabiting this geometric incremental game to trigger unpredictable physical chain reactions, powered by over 130 upgrades available in your skill tree.

4550280.title: Dawn of Horror
4550280.short_description: Dawn of Horror is a high-intensity Action Horror FPS set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, step into the role of Kage—a survivor seeking vengeance against hordes of Cyber-Zombies and bio-mechanical monstrosities.

4550450.title: Hotel Renovator Simulator
4550450.short_description: In Hotel Renovator Simulator, you take on the role of a master renovator and manager. Your task is to restore an old hotel, transforming it from a pile of rubble into a five-star establishment. Progress from first room to managing a massive hotel complex with 24 unique rooms across multiple floors.

4550460.title: Iron grid
4550460.short_description: Unlock new towers based on enemy types encountered. Construct towers to hold the line and survive waves. Position defenses strategically to control enemy paths. Defend base and mining stations. Destroy enemy monoliths to gain control over battlefield. Build the colossal superweapon Iron Grid

4550500.title: Journey
4550500.short_description: Keita, a brave emperor penguin, lost its way during the migration and would start an extraordinary adventure on the ice alone.

4550590.title: Tiny Cats vs Toys
4550590.short_description: Timy Cats vs. Toys is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find the kittens, free the trapped cats, and eliminate the warlike toys.

4550740.title: Kidnapped Simulator
4550740.short_description: A psychological horror experience powered by a local AI model. You've been kidnapped by a serial killer who demands your deepest truths. Speak, type, or lie your way to freedom - but every word matters. No internet required. No data leaves your PC. 18+ only.

4550810.title: Typing Frankenstein
4550810.short_description: Type the classic novel "Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus" by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley. Type paragraphs quickly and flawlessly to unlock new chapters. Race against the ghost of your own cursor to beat your best time.

4550820.title: Extreme Racing Line
4550820.short_description: Extreme Line Racing is a top-down minimalist arcade racing game where you drive distinct cars across fully visible single-screen tracks, push tight lines through corners, and chase faster lap times, higher star ratings, and better global leaderboard ranks.

4550940.title: Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly
4550940.short_description: A Game Boy Color pinball action game. Flip, nudge, and fight your way through waves of enemy robots to rescue Self from a corrupted digital simulation.

4550980.title: Jokey and Jolly´s
4550980.short_description: Jokey and Jolly’s is a gripping indie horror game. Use the Jolly figures on your desk to ward off terrifying jumpscares. Explore a mysterious location, uncover the hidden truth, and prepare to take down Jokey, the mastermind behind the Jollys.

4552500.title: Dungeon Settlers: Prologue
4552500.genre: RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4552500.short_description: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your expedition to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

4552560.title: Dreamland Journey
4552560.short_description: "Dreamland Journey" is a 2D side-scrolling co-op adventure game. You and your companion will embark on an adventurous journey in a world full of fantasy, utilizing the different skills of the two characters to cooperate and fight through levels, exploring various regions within this world。

4552810.title: 命运观测:选择性缄默
4552810.short_description: Fate Observation: Selective Muteness is an interactive narrative game exploring the complex relationships (love?) between adult men.There are no black-and-white answers here.Make your choice, then walk the path.Uncover the truth that belongs to you across 15 divergent world lines.

4552960.title: AAA Island Hotline
4552960.short_description: AAA Island Hotline is a cozy desktop idle farming game. Create one-of-a-kind creatures through a magical crossbreeding system and build your own island world. Let it quietly keep you company on your screen.

4552970.title: Driftkill: Repurpose Protocol
4552970.genre: Action, Free To Play, Early Access
4552970.short_description: Driftkill is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where bullets bounce endlessly, turning every fight into a test of angles, timing, and quick reactions. Use the environment, predict your opponents, and land shots that were never meant to hit.

4553070.title: Almost Castaways
4553070.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious island after a sudden shipwreck, two girls must work together to survive. Balance deep narrative choices with sandbox survival mechanics as you build your camp, uncover ancient secrets, and navigate a story filled with humor, drama, and unexpected destiny.

4553140.title: Scratch Off!
4553140.short_description: Scratch Off is a roguelike built around the simple, irresistible act of scratching a lottery ticket. Each run you are handed a stack of cards and a dwindling pile of money. Buy tickets. Scratch them. Survive the rent. Repeat.

4553220.title: Hentai Clicker: Tammy is streaming
4553220.short_description: ⚾🔥 Hentai Clicker: Tammy is streaming Collect hearts, unlock sporty and daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Tammy, a playful baseball star who knows how to keep her fans cheering!

4553250.title: Nova Rush
4553250.short_description: A brutally fast jetpack survival game where one mistake kills you. Dodge impossible obstacles, outfly drones, and escape before everything explodes

4553270.title: Rummy Attack
4553270.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

4553340.title: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush
4553340.short_description: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush Is an upcoming Retro Survival Horror experience that takes inspiration from iconic staples of the genre with the charming narrative intrigue of a Sound Novel. Atmospheric exploration, Challenging Puzzles, and Horrifying Combat encounters await!

4553360.title: King Of Leberkas - Austria Restaurant Simulator
4553360.short_description: Run your own Leberkäse restaurant in Vienna! Prepare Leberkäse sandwiches, deal with grumpy customers, and grow your place into a thriving restaurant in the heart of the city.

4553490.title: Ape-tite
4553490.short_description: Cook through the chaos in an ape‑paced co‑op kitchen where space is tight and pressure is constant.

4553510.title: DEVIL GATE
4553510.short_description: DEVIL GATE — an Action/RPG Hack & Slash with a West‑Slavic fantasy atmosphere. Choose a character, create your build, and battle demons solo or alongside friends.

4553530.title: DarkRealms
4553530.short_description: Dark fantasy 2.5D boomer shooter focused on precision combat. Fight through surreal realms, lost civilizations, and dead gods. Recover the fractured Rift Stone, escape the soul prison, and stop the dark elf Razan.

4553620.title: Dark Rail
4553620.short_description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

4553740.title: Memory Studio
4553740.short_description: “Memory Studio” is a special photo shop that helps clients rediscover their memories through a unique camera that can bring the past back to life. Become Memo, the liquid cat, and Ria, the human girl, and work together to recover your clients’ cherished memories.

4553780.title: Crystal Ascend
4553780.short_description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

4553840.title: EraPuzzle: Grid & Glory
4553840.short_description: A casual tile-based puzzle game about resource management and strategic building. Harvest trees, construct villages and towers, defeat goblin camps, and chain your way across the map to reach the goldmine. Beautiful, relaxing, and satisfying to solve.

4553870.title: Nice Day For It
4553870.short_description: Tee off for a round of golf... but hurry! In this arcade-inspired golf game, it's a race against the clock to complete as many holes in the allotted time. Compete against friends and strangers in the global leaderboards!

4554050.title: A Game About Making Numbers Go Up
4554050.short_description: A Game About Making Numbers Go Up? It's Exactly That! Click, hover or idle through the different game modes as you make those numbers go up.

4554070.title: Overbloom
4554070.short_description: Overbloom is a real-time roguelite tower defense where you cultivate powerful plant builds, discover strange items from the past, and survive against a spreading corruption looking to consume all life on the planet!

4554080.title: Socrates Ragebait
4554080.short_description: Socrates and his crew are back and they won't stop yapping. Block the doors, survive the philosophical ragebait, and contain these ancient thinkers before they break your brain.

4554350.title: RISING FOOL
4554350.short_description: Game Overview Dive into "B2" as Officer Rokkaku to unlock the "ADA" prototype. Reach 100F to defeat the Guardian! Choose from 3 doors with random stats to build your power. With random gear and traps, every run is unique. Use logic and luck to climb!

4554510.title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
