4554510.short_description: 1990s China Driving Simulator: cargo deliveries, taxi fares, bus routes, police chases, and street races in this 5-in-1 driving anthology. Master the streets, earn your Shifu title.

4554530.title: Weekly Jobless Isle
4554530.short_description: In the wasteland ruled by AI, a weekly exile game unfolds.Will you choose to survive alone, lingering in the shadow of zombies and mutated creatures? Or rally your companions and build a haven of hope for old humanity on this desolate island with your own hands?

4554640.title: Self-Checkout: Scan, Weight, Steal
4554640.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4554640.short_description: You and your friends are at the self-checkout. Nobody is in charge. Everyone has a plan. The plans conflict. Scan what you want. Weigh what you must. Keep what you can. Blame each other when it goes wrong.

4554740.title: Ice Cream Simulator - Prologue
4554740.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4554740.short_description: Prepare ice cream, serve customers, set your prices, and manage your shop in this limited-access prologue of ice cream simulator—get a taste of the full game.

4554930.title: SideQuest
4554930.short_description: A desktop game designed to help you focus on real world tasks. Featuring a hat collection, different locations, romantic stories, and a built-in system clock.

4555090.title: Wandsmith
4555090.short_description: Wandsmith is a magical action roguelike with weapons that change every run. You cast spells that you build yourself, with wands that you are continually upgrading and customizing. Fight through castles of enemies in search of stronger foes and greater rewards.

4555180.title: Chyma and the Toll of Time
4555180.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4555180.short_description: Play as Chyma, a little bell trying to unravel the story of his people to save the planet. Solve 30+ puzzles by creating a temporary copy of yourself, which will follow your movements and actions. As you ascend the temple, learn more abilities that will help you in your quest to save the world!

4555260.title: Haiju
4555260.short_description: Gather the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells from across otherworldly landscapes drawn from Japanese mythology. Charge through enemies and glide over vast gaps in a high-speed action platformer charged with electric energy.

4555320.title: Xili Bay in Qinzhou
4555320.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4555460.title: What You Didn't See
4555460.short_description: Explore shifting places, uncover lost memories, and escape the creatures that look after you. A psychological horror game about guilt, loss, and the haunting silence of unspoken truths.

4555560.title: Outclassed
4555560.short_description: Outclassed is an arcade dungeon crawler roguelite where you combine unique class abilities to clear an expansive dungeon. Level up, collect items, and create powerful synergies to become truly outclassed!

4555670.title: GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer
4555670.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4555670.short_description: GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer is a grid-based puzzle platformer where you place missing tiles to build a safe path, collect every coin, and reach the goal. Use gravity flips, levers, portals, cloning, and dimension switching to solve clever platforming puzzles.

4555740.title: BOMBERCOOK!
4555740.short_description: A cooking-defence hybrid where players gather ingredients, prepare them at various stations, cook bombs in different appliances, and use them to defend their base. Every bomb is a recipe, every enemy is a customer, and survival depends on your kitchen skills.

4555750.title: Karless
4555750.genre: Indie, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4555750.short_description: A factory automation game where you build vehicle production lines to reconnect a shattered post-apocalyptic continent. Mine raw resources, research new technologies, and build vehicle supply chains — ship them out to reconnect the severed regions of Aris.

4555760.title: Container Hunter Simulator
4555760.short_description: Salvage lost containers from the depths, uncover their hidden value, and sell them at auction to build your maritime empire.

4555790.title: The Die of Flower
4555790.short_description: The Die of Flower is a text-based puzzle game based on dice rolling. It is primarily designed for two players, but one person can still experience it. Solving each condition counts as completing each segment of the story, and when there is nothing left to solve, that is when the story ends.

4555830.title: Zodiacra
4555830.short_description: Step into Zodiacra - an atmospheric puzzle game with calming stellar visuals. Connect the stars to reveal constellations across a serene night sky, uncovering zodiac signs, mythical creatures, divine beings, and the stories behind them.

4555850.title: Pool Glow
4555850.short_description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.

4555950.title: The Office Void
4555950.short_description: You’re stuck on the night shift. The code refuses to compile, the deadline is on fire, and your mind is no longer yours. To keep from passing out and blowing the entire shift, you have to drink coffee. Lots of it.

4555980.title: Space Stone Smashing Simulator
4555980.short_description: Control a mining drone in space. Scan asteroids, extract resources, and manage your equipment. Optimize your workflow and explore a relaxing sci-fi mining experience.

4556000.title: Tactilite
4556000.short_description: Tactics, transfers, and talent trees! Tactilite is a modern football manager with RPG elements. Lead your team from the 3rd division to the top, choose unique manager archetypes, level up your players, and master the tough Ascension mode. Do you have what it takes to become a legend?

4556020.title: Treasure Clicker
4556020.short_description: Tap the chest, buy upgrades, and grow a hoard that spirals into absurdity. Hire heroes, fund guild research, and spend Essence on a skill tree that persists between prestiges. When you need a change of pace, race the clock in speed challenges or descend into The Abyss

4556090.title: Zoo Party
4556090.short_description: Jump into fast, unpredictable minigames and battle your friends in a wild tournament of skill, luck, and pure madness. Choose your animal, outsmart the competition, and fight your way to the top in the ultimate party showdown!

4556180.title: RuneKeeper
4556180.short_description: RuneKeeper is an Open-World Sandbox JRPG with monster taming elements where you can choose to follow the story, or just simply live in the world with your friends in the world of Rin. It's up to you!

4556210.title: Castle Wars: Legacy
4556210.short_description: A fast-paced card strategy game with deck building, PvP, tournaments, and a campaign, inspired by the classic Castle Wars flash game

4556250.title: Sad Virus Cave
4556250.short_description: Walking simulation and platformer game. Control sad virus in cave enviroment and try find all beer bottles and avoid traps

4556280.title: Decks & Dashes
4556280.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

4556450.title: Stamped : Visa Officer
4556450.short_description: Work as a visa officer, inspect documents, and decide who gets visa. Balance your job, your family, and your morality as every decision shapes lives including your own.

4556470.title: Distance Travellers
4556470.short_description: Distance Travellers is a single player extraction space simulator, set in the distant future, fight, mine and loot your way around the galaxy. Upgrade your equipment and ship and do your best to survive the barren wastes of the new world.

4556520.title: Game of Runs
4556520.short_description: A fast-paced basketball roguelike deckbuilder where every run can decide the game. Build your playbook, control momentum, and outcoach your opponent in high-pressure matchups.

4556670.title: Centre 18
4556670.short_description: Lead a modern fire and rescue center inspired by real French firefighters. Build your station, train your crews, and dispatch the right vehicles for each emergency. Coordinate every mission in real time on an immersive operational map.

4556700.title: Everis : Tales of Players
4556700.short_description: Everis is a multiplayer procedural world where players build, explore, and shape the game itself. Create structures, design adventures, and let the community decide what becomes part of a shared, ever-evolving universe.

4556710.title: Digital Footprint: Cyber Investigation
4556710.short_description: Step into the role of a digital detective. Solve cases in a simulated OS by collecting evidence, linking clues, and making impactful decisions.

4556820.title: Mis 4 noches: Puerta 1
4556820.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a post-Soviet apartment. You are a student arriving in a new city for an exam. Cheap rent, strange neighbors, a locked room. A short 1-hour psychological horror experience.

4556900.title: Rescue Quest: Lexi's Mountain Adventure
4556900.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4556900.short_description: A 2D action platformer where you battle mountain wildlife, dodge dangerous obstacles, and rescue endangered animals across treacherous terrain. The mountain calls. Will you answer?

4557100.title: Lunaris
4557100.short_description: Lunaris is a fast-paced sci-fi top-down roguelite shooter: survive escalating enemy waves, stack powerful passive and active abilities, craft wild build synergies, and turn the arena into a neon storm of lasers and explosions. Every run feels fresh and intense.

4557150.title: The Determinator
4557150.short_description: A narrative desk simulation about bureaucracy and the people behind it. Ten days. Dozens of cases. Claimants file for benefits, you read the file, check the manual, and stamp the folder. Approve. Deny. Request more information. Your record will reflect your decisions

4557340.title: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
4557340.short_description: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

4557380.title: Batomon Showdown
4557380.short_description: Discover and battle with hundreds of Batomon! Assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

4557510.title: Medieval Invasion
4557510.short_description: Build towers, defend your main structure from waves of enemies in an intense strategy game. Prove your skills, join the legends!

4557900.title: Coin of Fate
4557900.short_description: Coin Slot System: Success lies in how you balance the odds between heads and tails. Strategic Resource Management: Maximize efficiency within the limits of your inventory and gold. Explosive Synergies: Unleash massive bonus effects by collecting and pairing specific sets of items.

4557940.title: Slime Reaper
4557940.short_description: Click to kill slimes and gain gold. Then hire adventurers to kill more slimes. Unlock new slime tiers, upgrade your clicks, adventurers and unlock abilities to kill even more slimes. And then prestige to unlock special upgrades!

4558050.title: Enfeathered
4558050.short_description: Flap, Dash, Jump, Glide, Dash, and more, through a vast world full of places to explore, people to talk to, and enemies to fight. Use all of your movement tools in order to both explore and fight, all in chunky 2d pixelart.

4558120.title: Dust Bunny
4558120.short_description: Dust Bunny is a relaxing cleaning game where you explore a mysterious abandoned mansion. Upgrade your tools, discover strange secrets, and unlock unique areas.

4558300.title: American Football Coach
4558300.short_description: An American football management simulation video game. The game allows players to take charge of any club, with responsibility for tactics and signings. You faces a full roster of teams throughout the season and can arrange friendlies against teams from outside the United States in the off-season.

4558570.title: The Membrane
4558570.short_description: Defend the jungle against The Membrane's vile spawns in this fantasy roguelite survivor. You've signed your life away, now you must fight your way from naked servant to fortified King. Earn wages, craft defenses, and improve your base. Will you survive long enough to slay every putrid boss?

4558640.title: 1982 Tenacious of the Air
4558640.short_description: 1982: Tenacious of the Air is a vertical scrolling shoot ’em up set during the South Atlantic conflict. Pilot five historic Argentine aircraft, choose your ordnance, take off from aircraft carriers or from land, and relive missions inspired by true events.

4558690.title: SkyChart: Airline Executive
4558690.short_description: Build a global airline empire across 90 years of aviation history. Buy or lease aircraft, open routes between 150 real-world cities, outmaneuver rival airlines, and navigate historical crises from the Golden Age of Flight to the modern era. Inspired by Aerobiz.

4558840.title: Minesweeper Ultra Turbo Deluxe
4558840.short_description: Minesweeper, but a roguelike. Solve classic minesweeper puzzles with the help of many unique items. Create explosive combos, fight bosses, unlock characters, and overcome Michael Sweeper's Minefield.

4558890.title: Faultline.Exe
4558890.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4558890.short_description: Initiate a neural handshake with a doomed deep-space facility. Hack through a corrupted AI, evade corporate kill-squads, and uncover a terrifying biological conspiracy. Every keystroke decides who lives and who dies in this immersive sci-fi terminal thriller featuring 12 distinct endings.

4558930.title: Eternal Blade
4558930.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4558930.short_description: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

4559110.title: 次元战姬ol
4559110.short_description: 次世代都市异能3D卡牌RPG大作——200+美少女自由组合，炫酷大招引爆全场，全明星日本声优演绎，助你酣战未来都市!

4559290.title: UNDERKING KINGDOM
4559290.short_description: UNDERKING KINGDOM is a belt-scrolling action RPG inspired by classic arcade nostalgia. But it’s more than just the thrill of victory. Set amid the horrors of war and senseless violence, it challenges players to reflect on the humanity and common sense we must strive to protect.

4559430.title: Memory Games
4559430.short_description: This game is a classic memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4559450.title: Super Darts Champs
4559450.short_description: Super Darts Champs is an arcade darts game where you get to play against some of the best darts players in the world!

4559620.title: Rotten Chamber
4559620.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

4559690.title: Uprising: Toys for Oppressors
4559690.short_description: As an awakened "toy" with no memory and a newfound purpose, manage an autonomous nightclub to recruit allies, dodge corporate suspicion, and orchestrate a city-wide revolution against the very people who built you.

4559880.title: Veil Phane - Path to Redemption
4559880.short_description: Veil Phane - Path to Redemption is a classic-inspired Open World brought to life with modern technology. As a condemned man with no memory, explore a dreamlike medieval realm, engage in tactical combat, and solve puzzles to reclaim your soul. Pure exploration meets Next-Gen.

4559960.title: Subsomnia
4559960.short_description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

4559970.title: 落樱
4559970.short_description: 落樱是一款将AI聊天与Galgame结合的聊天恋爱模拟游戏，拥有好感度、叛逆度等多系统。在游玩中你可以体验到落樱多种性格，并触发许多随机事件。

4560050.title: The King Must Fall
4560050.short_description: Draft your buildings, shape your kingdom, and trigger the wave. Draft building or skill cards, optimize your resource chains, and perfect your layout. When you're ready, trigger the wave and watch your kingdom's synergy clash with relentless enemies.

4560130.title: Still Warm
4560130.short_description: Deep-fry lángos in a Budapest alleyway and serve the regulars from the apartment building across the courtyard while they slowly realize someone is picking them off, one by one.

4560320.title: Metal Detect: Hidden Treasure
4560320.short_description: Grab your metal detector and hunt for buried treasure across a quiet countryside village. Drive your pickup between locations. Take jobs from neighbors and get permission to search their land. Sell what you uncover and upgrade your gear as you get closer to an ancient treasure buried beneath.

4560650.title: BACKROOMS
4560650.short_description: 'BACKROOMS' is an immersive first-person exploration horror game. Wander through the endless liminal spaces made with procedural generation, try to survive, and find an escape.

4560720.title: La Senda del Dragón RPG
4560720.short_description: A classic story-driven RPG where a group of heroes must face a world in crisis and the awakening of an ancient dragon.

4560800.title: Zonda
4560800.short_description: Some places keep secrets better than people. The Zonda Circuit has been silent for years. That silence has a name.

4560810.title: Silicon Souls
4560810.short_description: In a world dominated by all-powerful AIs, you’re a plain old human who just signed a crawler contract with the luxurious metaverse resort known as The Bathing Palace. Your job? Clean, pamper, and purify our beloved leaders so they can rest and continue their activities with peace of mind.

4560840.title: Lens of Lust
4560840.short_description: Who said you can't mix profit with pleasure? Become a lewd photographer in this corny mix of visual novel and business management. Do you have what it takes to enchant the lens...?

4561040.title: The Lustful Bride
4561040.short_description: The Lustful Bride is an explicit adult visual novel in a cartoon style. A typical wedding ceremony turns into a story of sudden passion and forbidden desire right at the altar. Instead of kissing her groom, the bride begins to caress the naked emcee while the groom stands nearby.

4561160.title: Demon's Door: The Checkpoint
4561160.short_description: A 2D "rage-platformer" designed to trick, troll, and frustrate you through seemingly simple checkpoints that constantly change. The game deliberately exploits your muscle memory and platforming instincts, turning "safe" paths into death traps. NOTE : "THIS GAME (Demon's Door) RAGES YOU".

4561260.title: Open Sourcerer
4561260.short_description: Open Sourcerer is a 2D platformer where players create and customize their spells in JavaScript.

4561460.title: Housewife Simulator
4561460.short_description: An adult visual novel about growing your housewife huge!

4561660.title: See-Through Jewels
4561660.short_description: Addictive Match 3 Puzzle with Smiley Girl's exquisite combination!

4561690.title: Ruinous
4561690.short_description: Craft devastating decks, gather loot to define your build, and defeat randomized dungeons and ruthless boss fights in a journey of risk, strategy, and ruin in this fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

4561840.title: Broken Masks
4561840.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4561840.short_description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve disturbing puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will test your sanity. Can you survive the horror that lies within?

4561890.title: Pastry Pile Up
4561890.short_description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

4561980.title: RobotzZz
4561980.short_description: A robot in silence. The beat drops - and the world floods with color. An infinite rhythm runner where every level is a world of its own.

4562060.title: Nah, I'd Shotgun
4562060.short_description: Dive into the deepest pits of hell, shotgun the hell out of big bad demons then blast them out of the existence, do not hesitate or crumble or you will get humbled, fast.

4562100.title: Doo 'N' Dash
4562100.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4562100.short_description: They closed the loo? Time to make a stinky poo! Play as Loo‑is in this Stealth N' Stench adventure. Hide, run, and use office receptacles to do your business. Relieve the pressure before it’s too late, or you might meet a truly stinky fate!

4562390.title: Order of the Ivy
4562390.short_description: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

4562770.title: Cosmo Piercers
4562770.short_description: A vertical scrolling shooter where you fire your main shot and strategically switch between limited ammo special weapons to take down enemies. Earn bonus points by clearing areas, and defeat as many enemies as possible before the game ends to achieve a high score.

4562850.title: I Fell for Her
4562850.short_description: Renting a small shop and opening a barber shop, Vito meets a woman who works alone next to his shop and he feels like he's falling in love with her, but... is she okay?

4562920.title: DrivApp
4562920.short_description: DrivApp is an urban transport simulator where you live as a professional driver. Play with a wheel, controller, or keyboard, choose manual or automatic transmission, face traffic, hear passenger stories, and earn money to grow your career.

4563000.title: Root Genesis
4563000.short_description: An idle/incremental game with a hacker twist. Type commands, deploy exploits like worms and ransomware, and take on contracts to pwn every node on the network. Upgrade your toolkit, expand your reach and expose the conspiracies the elite cult never wanted you to find.

4563300.title: CatDude & Karsh
4563300.short_description: A boss rush adventure with moderately challenging combat and cozy hub world activities, including fishing, hotel management, and market trading.

4563320.title: The Immortal Is Watching
4563320.short_description: Players will take on the role of a little flower fairy and tap on wish plaques to send blessings. Each character’s story will unfold differently based on your choices. Once all wishes have been fulfilled, she will also experience different endings depending on your decisions.

4563400.title: Sad Virus Darkland
4563400.short_description: Sad Virus is back now in dark themed land called darkland. Mission again collect beer bottles in this third person adventure walking game

4563440.title: Why Did You Press
4563440.short_description: Press the button. Get teleported. Find the item… or lose everything. Explore unpredictable, dark liminal spaces filled with danger, puzzles, and tension. Can you collect them all before it's too late?

4563450.title: The Sage's Seven
4563450.short_description: A 7-turn logic duel. Analyze and refute villains’ arguments using draft-based card strategy.

4563730.title: Master the Track
4563730.short_description: Leave the 9-to-5 behind and find your freedom on the rails. Deliver cargo, earn money, and grow your railway career in a relaxing 2D train simulation.

4563740.title: Outliers: Incrementum
4563740.short_description: Outliers: Incrementum is an incremental Action-RPG about hacking-and-slashing through hordes of monsters. Clear dungeons. Collect loot. Get stronger... and uncover the mysteries of THE tower.

4563770.title: Big Tech Time
4563770.short_description: Big Tech Time is a simulation game about creating your own modern tech company. Grow your company and hire skilled employees. Research promising technologies and develop top-tier software. Unlock upgrades to keep up with constant innovation. Start from the ground up and reach for the top!

4563780.title: Infinite Cat Theorem
4563780.short_description: You are a tiny cat cast into a dreamlike world of electric circuits. Manipulate power sources and switches to send current through wires and operate various contraptions. You must muster all your wisdom to solve the puzzles ahead.

4563810.title: The MachinEGG
4563810.short_description: Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing Idle / Clicker game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Grow your farm, automate your production... will you be able to retire? Buy chickens, feed them, take their eggs to the market, and automate it all!

4563960.title: Hentai Overtime
4563960.short_description: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Overtime, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

4564280.title: Labyrinth of Trials
4564280.short_description: Every level is a challenge where survival depends on your decisions.

4564400.title: THE HALLWAY
4564400.short_description: THE HALLWAY is a chilling text-based, command-line horror experience set in a dark, narrow corridor with comprehensive mechanics such as loops, stats, puzzles, meaningful choices, and Steam achievements.

4564440.title: Envision Research Facility
4564440.short_description: A routine maintenance job turns into something far more unsettling. Investigate a remote research facility, restore power, and uncover what went wrong. Is anyone still alive? Or are you already too late?

4564500.title: Kingdom's Calling: The Final Gospel
4564500.short_description: Survive the demonic tide in this 2.5D bullet heaven survivors-like. Command a Holy Vanguard of 14 heroes across 12 unique stages from Eden to Jehoshaphat. Stand in the gap against demonic hordes until the sky cracks and the King of Kings descends. Can your faith withstand the horde?

4564650.title: Flame of Y
4564650.short_description: 《Flame of Y》是一款以火焰为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在回合中精确规划行动，平衡战争与灵活性并逐步提升角色能力，在充满活力的战斗节奏中体验经典的回合制游戏乐趣。

4564680.title: Scale of Y
4564680.short_description: 《Scale of Y》是一款以平衡为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在回合中精密规划行动，巧妙调节攻防与策略并逐步增强角色能力，在充满变化的战斗节奏中体验经典的回合制游戏的深度。

4564720.title: DREAMFEAR
4564720.short_description: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

4564770.title: Public Fears - George's Farm
4564770.short_description: Felix Turner is forced out of the police force by mysterious forces. His friend George urges him to seek refuge at his remote farmhouse. In search of peace, Felix has no idea what awaits him…

4566900.title: The King in Search of the Hidden
4566900.short_description: A hidden object game where you are the king of a dilapidated kingdom. Progress through levels, finding all the hidden objects. Read the funny dialogues and simply enjoy the beautiful pixel art.

4566950.title: Mawgate
4566950.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4566950.short_description: Maria Moore is wrongfully imprisoned in the dreaded Mawgate Asylum. To survive she must do things she never thought herself capable of. Fight, hide, solve puzzles, and investigate the illusive dark forces behind the asylum. Maria must escape, or be consumed by the madness of Mawgate…

4566970.title: The Grounds Escape
4566970.short_description: The Grounds Escape is a co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players. Team up with your friends to solve intricate puzzles and escape this living hell. Remember: every item has a purpose, every sound has a meaning, and every choice comes with a price... paid in blood.

4567000.title: Dominó Gótico
4567000.short_description: A dark 2D domino game with strip mechanics. Defeat your opponent, remove their clothing, and break the cycle of death and resurrection.

4567280.title: Knightfall Requiem
4567280.short_description: Step into a fallen kingdom consumed by darkness. Master brutal hack & slash combat, wield forbidden magic, and carve through relentless enemies. In Knightfall Requiem, every strike matters. Will you rise as the last hope, or become part of the eternal requiem? Non-realistic blood size adjustable.

4567300.title: Candy Clicker
4567300.short_description: Candy Clicker is a cozy candy clicker about big numbers and sweet meta progression: Steam inventory, crafting at the anvil, roulette, gifts, and leaderboards—all in one game you can enjoy for five minutes or a whole evening.

4567510.title: Potato Simulator | One Last Try
4567510.short_description: A rage-inducing physics platformer where you control a potato through absurd obstacles. Fall, fail, scream… and try again.

4567530.title: Steamboat Willie Rescue Mission
4567530.short_description: Step back into 1928 in this retro 8-bit platformer! Play as Willie, pilot biplanes, dodge angry ducks, and brave 20 challenging levels to rescue Winnie from the clutches of Captain Pete. Jump, climb, and collect musical notes in a nostalgic, public-domain adventure!

4567690.title: LUMINOUS GATE
4567690.short_description: LUMINOUS GATE is a 3D action roguelite. Strengthen your character as you progress through dungeons and aim for the deepest part of the "Gate" where powerful bosses await. Create your own strategy with various builds—using swords, bows, bombs, wings, and more.

4568170.title: They Not Fae!
4568170.short_description: A short horror where you help a teenage girl rescue her cat, exploring a creepy building filled with creepy monsters.

4568190.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
4568190.short_description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

4568490.title: TurtleSkate
4568490.short_description: Skate as a turtle, complete objectives, avoid entities, and escape. 1-5 player co-op horror.

4568560.title: TriVictor
4568560.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where your battlefield scars as you fight. Push your lanes to the breaking point — or let them break you.

4568580.title: The Wandering Her
4568580.short_description: Stitch delicate threads and solve gentle puzzles while restoring pieces of forgotten embroidery. As old photos, worn fabrics, and unfinished patterns resurface, uncover a quiet story of memories, family, and a secret hidden within the threads of time.

4568640.title: House of Anomalies
4568640.short_description: Explore a shifting haunted house alone or with friends in online co-op. Watch every room carefully, uncover disturbing anomalies, and question what is real as the house grows stranger with every new discovery.

4568780.title: VertalStrike
4568780.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4568780.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer FPS built around momentum, readable firefights, and tight map control. Host rooms, fight online, or train with bots while you chase Battle Pass progress, quests, and loadout upgrades.

4568910.title: FragMiner
4568910.short_description: They mine with pickaxes... you mine with bombs 💣! FragMiner is an active incremental clicker. Trigger satisfying chain reactions, vacuum up loot, and navigate a deep skill tree. Prestige to blast your way into the deepest mines!

4568990.title: 决战-勋章
4568990.short_description: Crimson flames scorch the heavens, turning the earth to ash; weapons blot out the sun, leaving countless souls to wither. A black mist devours the forests and corrodes the moon's spirit; a wicked heart poisons the world, transforming it into a toxic abyss.

4569360.title: Kraken's Treasures
4569360.short_description: You are pirates who have come to a cursed island to find the Kraken’s treasures. Players must collect the Kraken’s treasures and escape the island. On this adventure, many dangers await you, including the island sinking, attacks by pirate skeletons, volcanic eruptions, injuries, and poisoning.

4569740.title: Combo Trigger
4569740.short_description: Fast paced arcade survival. Kill to earn time. Choose from a unique roster of characters and fight through relentless waves. Keep the combo up, master the map, and dominate the leaderboard.

4569790.title: Anathema Requiem
4569790.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

4537520.title: The Fool's Journey
4537520.short_description: A simple tarot-themed, ASCII style roguelike deckbuilder with a unique twist! Play cards upright or flipped for power at a cost. Build synergies across seven suits, collect 87 relics, and fight through three acts as one of five unlockable characters. Every run reshuffles the journey!

4537530.title: 龙王捕鱼
4537530.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4537530.short_description: 《龙王捕鱼》采用全新顶尖3D引擎打造，呈现超强国风美术表现力，原汁原味复刻街机经典玩法。游戏内设多个东方神话奇幻渔场，捕获各种山海经中的神秘强大BOSS。炫酷的仙境场景、超高清的画质，给您带来绝对震撼的国风视听盛宴。

4537540.title: 海神捕鱼
4537540.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4537540.short_description: 《海神捕鱼》采用全新次世代引擎倾力打造，拥有突破极限的美术表现力，完美复刻经典街机捕鱼玩法。游戏内设多个亚特兰蒂斯奇幻3D渔场，等您来捕获各种潜藏在深海的神秘BOSS。炫酷的深海场景、超高清的电影级画质，为您奉上一场绝对震撼的视听盛宴。

4537550.title: Thoughtless
4537550.short_description: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

4537570.title: PSYCORP
4537570.short_description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in America in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

4537590.title: All or Nothing
4537590.short_description: Minimalist logic, pattern matching card game. Simple, addictive, and mind bending!

4537600.title: Dice Gun Commando
4537600.short_description: Guns roll dice. Dice trigger mods. Mods cause MAYHEM! Save the world from invading cosmic horrors by building crazy synergies with dice-driven weaponry.

4537640.title: Black Powder Box
4537640.short_description: Black Powder Box is a sandbox FPS focusing on PvE and EvE combat, a level editor, and both realistic and sci-fi environments. Create and play your own levels—or the ones built in-game. Join NPC factions in combat, solve traps and puzzles, and destroy everything in your way!

4537700.title: Notebook Workshop
4537700.short_description: Manage your own cute notebook shop. Create unique designs in your workshop. Carefully package orders and make your customers happy with distinctive designs. Grow your small shop and become one of the most beloved notebook stores.

4537710.title: Aqua Street
4537710.short_description: Aqua street is an open world game where you can race with friends. The game has a traffic system, it is very interesting to race and have traffic on the streets and not just traffic, there is also the police chasing you. The game has many interesting details.

4537730.title: Tomo Cafe
4537730.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a story-rich focus game. Focus with characters, bond with them through stories, and grow together.

4537740.title: Scrap Planet
4537740.short_description: Clean, rebuild, and transform a trash-covered planet into a cozy world of your own. Collect resources, construct structures, and shape your environment in this relaxing sandbox experience.

4537750.title: CTRLR.CLUB
4537750.short_description: CTRLR.CLUB is a precision controller training platform that sharpens reaction time, timing consistency, and input accuracy. Engage with a responsive neural environment, track performance in real-time, and elevate your competitive skills. Not a traditional game.

4537770.title: Nonogueram
4537770.short_description: Nonogueram is a nonogram roguelike! Make your way through floors and collect items as you complete more and more nonograms! Defeat the boss at the end each floor to make your way to the next.

4537780.title: Climber Toys: Together
4537780.short_description: Climb, jump, and try not to fall in this chaotic 8-player co-op parkour adventure set in a toy-filled room. Dodge obstacles, use your abilities, and stay on track — because one mistake can send you all the way back down. Try not to lose everything… or each other.

4537800.title: Snuggle Nightmare
4537800.short_description: Snuggle Nightmare is a horror, stealth, and puzzle game where you must escape animatronics while uncovering the secrets of a theme park closed under mysterious circumstances. Face an advanced AI that adapts to you, explore the facility… and survive.

4537820.title: Overcome Your Fears - Lighthouse
4537820.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

4537830.title: DEATH CULT
4537830.short_description: Uncover a cult in the forest with your friends. Take photos and collect evidence. Don't get CONVERTED.

4537850.title: Jack The Reaper : Vagrants in the Mist
4537850.short_description: A 2D noir action game of 'Reaper' seeking revenge for his partner 'Robellia'. Fight through mafia threats with a modified gun, record in a journal, and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth in the mist and punish the true culprit who murdered 'Robellia'.

4537890.title: Serpentine Harbor
4537890.short_description: Enjoy your stay on a Mediterranean island, creating art and living alongside gorgons, cyclops and minotaurs as your neighbors. You can grow your own food, explore the island or fight in the Minotaur’s bunker.

4537970.title: Region at War: The Shogun's Tale of War
4537970.short_description: Conquer the fractured lands of Hinomoto. Blend deep turn-based empire management with thrilling real-time tactical battles in this 2D strategy game. Build your cities, research vital technologies, and lead your samurai armies to become the undisputed Shogun of the Sengoku era!

4538040.title: HERO BOY
4538040.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4538040.short_description: HERO BOY is a cinematic, narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game about becoming the hero you once needed, featuring: an EMOTIONAL and TIMELESS ORIGINAL STORY, TWO AWESOME PLAYABLE PROTAGONISTS, fresh yet iconic HAND-PAINTED ART, and a DASHING DEBUT SCORE!

4538210.title: Snailium
4538210.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4538210.short_description: Play as a snail in Snailium, a calm exploration game with a sci-fi twist. Traverse atmospheric environments, collect unique items, and discover new areas in search for the rare, undiscovered element - Snalium.

4539000.title: SoulSwap
4539000.short_description: Defeat enemies and take over their bodies to fight on. A dark fantasy 2D action roguelite where you transform into a new being with every monster you slay.

4539070.title: AI School Simulator
4539070.short_description: Enter a prestigious academy filled with AI-powered students. Excellence and ambition will be essential if you want to survive this school.

4539310.title: Guild of Three
4539310.short_description: Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you command a party of three characters — each with their own deck. Combine different classes, pass Relay Cards between allies, and position your party across the front and back lines to create your own combat strategy.

4539480.title: Roommate Lover: Love in Progress
4539480.short_description: With a mature and sophisticated female CEO, a stunningly beautiful news anchor, a college sweetheart, and the girl next door all entering her life, what will be the final outcome of this battle for love?

4539630.title: Sorry, My King
4539630.short_description: A 1-bit pixel roguelite where every step costs time and every coin feeds the system. Explore procedural maps, fight card battles, and gather 5000 gold in 7 days to pay your debt to the king. Or discover why the debt exists at all.

4539970.title: The Show Goes On
4539970.short_description: The Show Goes On is a psychological horror game with puzzles and exploration. Trapped in a strange place, you must solve challenges to escape. Deep in debt, you joined an illegal show for easy money — now it feels like a trap. A voice guides you, but it may not help.

4540040.title: Soul General
4540040.short_description: The game is an ancient-style musou roguelike action game. Players will lead a powerful allied squad to charge into enemy lines and resist invasion. As players progress, more mysterious events and ultimate challenges will be unveiled.

4540340.title: Pixelora Tech Store
4540340.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own tech store! Sell products, interact with customers, follow market trends, and make the right decisions to create your empire. Every choice shapes your future in Pixelora.

4540750.title: Maze Rift
4540750.short_description: A co-op roguelite where you explore a deadly maze, fight dangerous enemies, and grow stronger with every run.

4540810.title: Throne of Shards
4540810.short_description: A dark TCG where you explore a massive dungeon, collect cards, and fight brutal battles. Each floor introduces its own unique rules, twisting the experience in this classic card adventure.

4540870.title: Pact of the Black Tide
4540870.short_description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

4540970.title: Unhappening
4540970.short_description: Unhappening is a narrative post-apocalyptic psychological horror 2.5D side-scrolling adventure, with a unique painterly visual style.

4541050.title: Project Ark
4541050.short_description: In Project Ark, the land has become uninhabitable after the apocalypse. The sea has become the only habitable place. Transform your ship into a floating city. Build, produce, and collect resources, research technologies, take care of your health, and rescue survivors!

4541300.title: Your Friend, Sam
4541300.short_description: Your Friend, Sam is an adventure/puzzle game where you play as the old friend to a boy who went missing two decades ago. Collect clues, solve puzzles, and defend the forest from corruption to build the story and figure out what happened to Sam in this mystical, discovery based world.

4541350.title: Fraga
4541350.short_description: A pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy, and escape before the forest claims you.

4541930.title: Charm Studies
4541930.short_description: Cassia is an airheaded young witch who's currently failing charms class... at this rate she won't be able to graduate! Study hard by completing nonogram puzzles, and maybe learn something about friendship along the way.

4542050.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
4542050.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

4542110.title: Full Stacked
4542110.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer FPS where you draft powerful cards each round to warp your weapons, abilities, and movement. Choose your build, outplay your opponents, and break the game wide open.

4542140.title: Duper
4542140.short_description: Duper is a 5-player real-time PvP social strategy game where players build their economy, trade resources, form alliances, and attack rivals. Every match blends negotiation, deception, and tactical decision-making as players compete to come out on top.

4542240.title: Dream at Dead of Century
4542240.short_description: July 1999— Soushi Takagi is asked by his childhood friend Kanae Sakura to collect and investigate occult stories. As he looks into rumors of ghosts, a mysterious illness, and a new religious organization, he encounters a strange girl he once saw in his dreams…

4542250.title: GRID CRYPT
4542250.short_description: GRID CRYPT is a grid-based puzzle game where you observe and exploit enemy behavior. Monsters in the dungeon move according to strict priorities and routes. Use their habits against them and clear your path. Just who is the King lurking in the depths of this dungeon...?

4542520.title: Motelia
4542520.short_description: A psychological horror game set in an old roadside motel. Clean rooms, fix broken things, and welcome weird customers. Try to go your normal routine while struggling with your mental health

4542590.title: Fish Slayer
4542590.short_description: 《Fish Slayer》 is a light roguelike game featuring multiple gameplay modes and meta-progression. Players take on the role of an animal that hunts fish, strengthening themselves by choosing attributes and items to become more efficient at hunting.

4542630.title: Roller Coaster Looper
4542630.short_description: A roguelite idle-like roller coaster sim where you draft track segments, recruit riders, and combo card upgrades between rounds, then watch the thrill scores spiral gloriously out of control. Physics optional.

4542700.title: UnDo
4542700.short_description: UnDo is a box-pushing puzzle game where you place boxes on target tiles using mechanics tied to Undo. To clear a stage, you must consider not only walls and boxes, but also the order of actions and how the mechanics interact.

4542730.title: Jump Broke
4542730.short_description: Play as a legless Mimic whose only way to move is by blasting gold coins at the ground, using physical recoil to jump. The rule is simple: 1 jump costs 1 gold coin. Precisely control the force and angle of every leap. Finish in heavy debt, or reach the summit decently with your treasure intact.

4542820.title: Sad Virus Asia
4542820.short_description: Sad virus back again in this third person platformer simulation game where mission to find beer bottles in Asia place

4542840.title: COOKBOT
4542840.short_description: You've been placed as a standard, industrial kitchen model COOKBOT on the transit cargo ship Zima. Follow recipes and complete orders from crew members. Execute orders correctly if you want the crew to come to you. Pay no mind to what they say, you're not human. The cake is there for company morale.

4542860.title: Isekai x Isekai
4542860.short_description: "Isekai × Isekai" is a casual 2D idle desktop game. Explore forests, journey into space, earn coins, collect new companions (including hidden characters), and build your own world.

4542880.title: Ironblood
4542880.genre: Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4542880.short_description: You are the Emperor. Your arena dominates the empire - for now. Recruit gladiators, build brutal fight cards, and stage Blood Nights to keep the crowd hungry. Rival houses are rising, champions die, and the empire demands blood. A living dark fantasy dynasty sim where no two empires are the same.

4542890.title: Crane's Dream
4542890.short_description: Crane's Dream is a story-driven blend of isometric action and point-and-click adventure. Help a Russo-Japanese War soldier rebuild his sanity by day and survive hardcore battles against mythological monsters in his nightmares by night, all against the backdrop of a collapsing empire.

4542980.title: The Last Gap
4542980.short_description: Master the tightest parking spaces and unlock stylish upgrades in this physics-based parking simulator!

4542990.title: Insurance Agent Simulator
4542990.short_description: A first-person life simulation game where you work as an insurance agent, complete office tasks, manage your daily routine, and unwind with interactive activities after hours.

4543030.title: Exploiters
4543030.short_description: Build and expand your village, recruit collectors, explore biomes, gather resources, upgrade gear, and defeat enemies in this pixel strategy survival game.

4543080.title: CHOMP CHOMP Carnage
4543080.short_description: Eat everything. Grow big. The ocean's never looked this cozy and deadly at the same time. A fish-eat-fish arcade chomper where every creature is crafted from wool. Devour your way up the food chain in CHOMP CHOMP Carnage.

4543090.title: Simply Higher or Lower
4543090.short_description: A casual game about guessing the next card. Can you do it 10 times in a row?

4543360.title: The Office: Dirty Affairs
4543360.short_description: Power. Desire. Secrets. The Office : Dirty Affairs is an adult game with multiple choice routes and endings. Navigate office politics, forbidden relationships and dangerous choices in this branching visual novel.

4543470.title: ProBelt
4543470.short_description: ProBelt is a game in which you calculate results by using mathematical operators.

4543490.title: Infinite Museum
4543490.short_description: A psychological game where you spot anomalies in a looping museum and choose the correct exit to reach G Floor.

4543500.title: MicroMacro: Downtown Detective
4543500.short_description: MicroMacro: Downtown Detective merges hidden-object and detective game into a new genre with a surprising narrative depth. Step into a cartoon city, jam-packed with details, goofy characters – and loads of crimes. Search for clues, follow suspects and make clever deductions to crack all cases.

4543520.title: hEvEN oN sNOrF
4543520.short_description: "hEvEN oN sNOrF" is a dysfunctional bug-full multiplayer cacophony. Deliver "sNOrF", collect "HEPI" and unlock "hEVEN" in a PvP world and reconsider your life choices.

4543590.title: Leave a Message
4543590.short_description: Test your wits in this funny party game where players record their voices to answer prompts that set them up with increasingly humorous and silly scenarios. Players vote for the funniest answer. Endless fun for up to 6 players and even more with audience voting!

4543620.title: Milky Way: Chumak Trail
4543620.short_description: Lead a Chumak caravan across the vast Ukrainian steppe, guided by the Milky Way. Trade salt, survive the journey, and follow an ancient road through history and legend.

4543670.title: Stack Match
4543670.short_description: Stack Match is a Roguelike deck-building game centered around card stacking mechanics.

4543680.title: Yet Another Shift
4543680.short_description: A checkpoint job at a private facility. Verify the documents. Approve or deny. One growing suspicion: what happens to the people you let through?

4543710.title: Shilutey Shopping Avenue
4543710.short_description: It’s a tower defense game disguised as a management/city building game.

4543800.title: Anthea's Justice
4543800.short_description: The year is 2248. You play as Anthea, a pilot for the Spacing Guild. She's battling a pirate fleet. During the game, you'll need to destroy four leader ships.

4543920.title: A Playground Afternoon
4543920.short_description: Relive the feeling of childhood wonder and play in this 3D platforming party game.

4543940.title: SlimeSurvivor
4543940.short_description: Slime Survivor is a roguelite where every decision is yours. Chase big rewards in dangerous zones, take it easy in safer areas, or hit the shop when your pockets are full. New builds, new strategies, and unexpected chaos await you every run.

4543970.title: Fallen Scout
4543970.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4543970.short_description: Fallen Scout is a cozy yet mysterious 2D adventure about a tiny scout who took one wrong step and came tumbling down a cliff. Now stranded in a forest laid in shadow, he now must find his way through the darkness armed with nothing but courage, determination, and a surprisingly powerful flashlight..

4543990.title: Soviet Shop Simulator
4543990.short_description: Manage your own grocery store. In this simulator, you have the opportunity to run your own business in challenging times of the past. Order products, decorate the interior, serve impatient customers, fight off thieves, build your reputation, and survive unpredictable events.

4544020.title: Straddle
4544020.short_description: The Tic Tac Toe roguelike. Straddle is a deckbuilder where you match shapes by placing special poker chips on the board. Plan your moves, trigger exciting combos, and adapt to the ever changing rules and boards.

4544280.title: Project GOVNOVOSIS
4544280.short_description: A fast-paced Bullet Hell roguelike where your "hero" is a heavily armored sewage truck. Drift through thousands of enemies, combine dozens of absurd weapons and passive skills. Upgrade your heavy machinery and survive the shift!

4544620.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
4544620.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

4544650.title: Astro Hop
4544650.short_description: Try to complete 30 challenging levels in this 2D platformer! Dodge moving saws, watch out for rising lava, and reach the exit gate by mastering your timing. With its simple design and fluid gameplay, will you be able to finish every level in this adventure that tests your reflexes?

4545110.title: Tell the Ocean
4545110.short_description: Type your thoughts. Bottle them. Release them into the ocean or burn them in a fire. Learn to let go. Meditate for five minutes. Climb a tower. Write your to-do list. A quiet game about clearing your mind before you begin or getting you unstuck when you have writer's block.

4545120.title: Drowned Caves
4545120.short_description: Atmospheric, short, and simple adventure puzzle game that gives the player freedom in finding the solution to the obstacles they encounter along the way in the drowned caves.

4545200.title: Broken Crown
4545200.short_description: Broken Crown is a classic real-time strategy experience focused on large-scale battles, base building, resource management, and tactical army control. Lead your forces across campaign missions, skirmish matches, and Endless Mode while commanding hundreds of units in dynamic, strategic warfare.

4545390.title: Hypnogenesis
4545390.short_description: Hypnogenesis is an experimental video feedback bullet hell game in which arcade gameplay is integrated with the controls of a video synthesizer.

4545670.title: Peace Incarnate
4545670.short_description: Stop the enigmatic crisis of the disappearing city. Fight or troubleshoot your way across warring factions.

4545700.title: Enjoy Your Stay
4545700.short_description: "Welcome to the Hudson Hotel, where our guests are our top priority." — This is not the hotel you remember. This is not the hallway you know. Something here is trying to lead you astray. Observe your surroundings, spot irregularities, and choose the right path. That is, if you really want to leave.

4545750.title: Milliseconds Matter: Precision Platformer
4545750.short_description: Complete levels in seconds... Then spend hours shaving off milliseconds. Use frame-perfect jumps and dashes to find shortcuts and discover faster routes. Race the ghost of your fastest run and fight for the fastest time.

4545770.title: Pick Them up!
4545770.short_description: A 3D cleanup game where you pick up trash, manage waste efficiently, and restore polluted areas zone by zone.

4545780.title: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood
4545780.short_description: Most will fail. Will you escape the Fogbound Deadwood? You have 60 minutes to survive. Find keys, open gates, gather resources, and navigate deadly terrain. You are being hunted—and every mistake brings you closer to death.

4545850.title: Age of Gods
4545850.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4545850.short_description: A competitive turn-based strategy game where positioning, unit synergy, and map control decide everything. Capture structures, build your army, and outplay your opponents in tactical battles with up to 8 players.

4545870.title: Empeti - Quest for the Pinnacle
4545870.short_description: Empeti is a fun, story-driven interactive game in emotional learning where empathy replaces aggression. Through choice-based dialogues within a medieval fantasy setting, explore how the power of empathetic connection can build trust and determine the fate of a kingdom on the brink.

4546100.title: Kircles
4546100.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

4546280.title: Demon Draw
4546280.short_description: A game that blends rogue-lite elements with slot machine mechanics. Arrange your hand, unlock synergies, and collect artifacts to craft your build. Rain bullets upon demons and experience the ultimate thrill where strategy meets luck!
developers: Beijing XinJing Culture Communication Co., Ltd
publishers: Beijing XinJing Culture Communication Co., Ltd

4546290.title: MineZone
4546290.short_description: A 3D horror survival game inspired by the classic Minesweeper. Explore a graveyard, investigate tombs, and avoid hidden mines using visual clues. But beware — zombies are watching. If they spot you, it's game over.

4546370.title: Starport Merchants
4546370.short_description: A space trading tycoon where you buy and sell commodities, speculate on stocks, manage factories, mine asteroids, build a trading fleet and much more. Go from rags to riches as you outsmart the competition and build your interplanetary business empire.

4546470.title: Remain At Your Desk
4546470.short_description: A cyberpunk incremental clicker where every click earns credits, every hack raises suspicion, and every promotion pulls you closer to Floor 13. Work by day. Hack by night. Remain at your desk.

4546630.title: Frogmancer
4546630.short_description: A survivors-like shooter where you play as a frog wizard defending your home from swarms of flying enemies. Aim, shoot, level up, and shape your build through a variety of overpowered magical attack patterns!

4546690.title: Snail Pit League
4546690.short_description: SNAIL PIT LEAGUE is a snail race simulation game where you can bet on races, buy and train snails, invest on the snail stock market, sell snails to shady collectors, and do whatever it takes to make enough money to retire forever!

4546720.title: The Crimson Strike
4546720.short_description: Survive the colosseum in The Crimson Strike. Face waves of enemies in intense third-person combat. Master your skills and become the ultimate warrior in this epic Roman action arena. Glory awaits you in the ring!

4546760.title: SOE 64
4546760.short_description: A retro-inspired WWII FPS built in the spirit of 90s console classics. Operate behind enemy lines, from Alpine railways to undercover dinner parties; shoot, explode and dismantle the German war effort one mission at a time. Work alongside the resistance and unlikely allies as you liberate Europe.

4546840.title: Community Button
4546840.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4546840.short_description: A global multiplayer idle clicker where every player contributes to a single evolving number in real time. Gain EXP, level up, unlock milestones, and watch the world change through a live heatmap. Compete, contribute, and shape the outcome—together. How high can it go? Will you press it… or watch?

4547180.title: REST STOP
4547180.short_description: The long hours of the night feel longer when you're a rest stop attendant at the site of a famous murder. Help travelers, complete your tasks, and try to shake the feeling that you're being watched. You’re probably just overthinking it.

4547330.title: Hotel Beresford
4547330.short_description: 1929. The Beresford Mansion once again becomes the stage for a tragic story. Follow its new owner, Samuel Chapman, on his descent into madness in this dark visual novel.

4547370.title: SEVER
4547370.short_description: Down to your last $50, but flesh has value. Trade pieces for cash and gamble with your very life. Will you make it out rich… or become part of the collection?

4547610.title: Abyss Cards
4547610.short_description: Abyss Cards is a strategic roguelike deck-builder with real-time auto-battle combat. Recruit powerful units, cast devastating spells, and collect ancient relics as you descend deeper into a cursed dungeon — where every choice is permanent and death means starting over.

4547760.title: Evil thought
4547760.short_description: Awakened by a brainwave separator in an artificial resurrection experiment, you fall into a mental maze blending reality and dreams. Corroded by the inner "Earth Mother", you follow your grandmother’s clues through distorted campuses, decayed buildings, secret labs and strange memory plains.

4547840.title: Link Lab
4547840.short_description: Connections are all you need to succeed. Link objects together to share and mix traits to create the tools you need to solve each level. Be careful which resource you spend where though, as each one is single use and you might need that piece later!

4548140.title: Where There's a Mask
4548140.short_description: You are a lost mask of the God of Mischief, torn from your rightful place. To return, you must cling to others — quite literally.

4548160.title: Don't Chicken Out
4548160.short_description: An extremely difficult game about two chickens balancing an egg. Will you finish the game, or chicken out? Suffer and triumph alone or with a friend in online Co-Op!

4548450.title: 论道聊斋
4548450.short_description: 以《聊斋》为灵感的中国志怪剧情游戏。以章节形式体验一个个独立的聊斋故事，在文字对话、事件触发与剧情推进中，走入充满人心、执念与因果的东方怪谈世界。

4548470.title: Ground Floor
4548470.short_description: Len Chandler is trapped in an elevator, navigating strange floors filled with the fragmented conversations and unresolved problems of his colleagues, friends, and family. Can he piece together the storylines, mend relationships, and finally reach the Ground Floor?

4548480.title: 25 Days in the DARK
4548480.short_description: The game puts you in the role of a lost child who must survive 25 days in a dangerous, pixelated world full of hostile creatures. Every day is a fight for survival—you must find food by hunting, fishing, or gathering berries. However, even the simplest tasks can be risky.

4548550.title: Outage Navigation
4548550.short_description: The power is out! No worries. With the help of you and your flashlight, we'll get that power back up and running before you can say "this is dangerous!" Oh yeah, watch out for the objects left around the floor.

4548600.title: Turbo Horizon
4548600.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Early Access
4548600.short_description: Drive through a vibrant world of color and chaos, smashing obstacles and chasing distance in a relaxing, physics-driven experience. Customize your environment and master the art of controlled destruction.

4548920.title: Puzzle Pulse!
4548920.short_description: Master the pulse line and chain crystals together, switching from color to color! Conquer 12 addictive game modes in a uniquely strategic experience. 12 remarkably addictive gamemodes from blazing fast to slow and strategic. Tons of customization options. This is NOT your ordinary match-3 game.

4548960.title: this SHORT indie game made me MISS MY FRIENDS | Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream
4548960.short_description: Tidy up after a sleepover birthday party by finding a home for each decoration and belonging in this story-rich, fully narrated, block-fitting puzzle game. Play alongside a commentating vtuber as you delve into their experience with loneliness evoked by this cleaning indie game.

4549090.title: Escape From Z
4549090.short_description: Make your way through a crumbling, zombie-infested building. Each floor is different. Every decision matters. If you can escape...

4549180.title: Taddius and the Forbidden Bog
4549180.genre: Casual, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4549180.short_description: In "Taddius and the Forbidden Bog", manage an inn for lost travellers, restore a ravaged bog, and find purpose in the most unexpected of places.

4549220.title: TigerGame
4549220.short_description: Merge animal blocks to create a tiger. Achieve high scores to enter the rankings. Unlock various skins through achievement rewards.

4549240.title: Rogue Merchant
4549240.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4549240.short_description: Play as the merchant instead of the hero in this Shopkeeper Roguelite RPG! Run your shop, read your customers, and talk your way to riches in this cozy, quirky merchant roguelite! Haggle with fantasy characters of all different sorts from Gnomes to Ogres using charm, wit, or a well-placed insult!

4549300.title: My Dearest Direst Disaster
4549300.short_description: 「透明人間」のクロと、「透明人間しか見えない・聞こえない」豹馬。平穏を望む２人に、世界は恐るべき牙を剥ける。何度でも。ただ、豹馬の望みが絶たれるまで。

4549590.title: Night Duty Log: A Shōwa School Record
4549590.short_description: A short psychological horror set in a Japanese school during the Shōwa era. At night in the school, you begin to realize that you are not alone. As you investigate classrooms and hallways, you notice strange occurrences. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple endings.

4549620.title: Fire Escape
4549620.short_description: A fire is spreading through the office — and you only have seconds to memorise the escape route. Fire Escape is a fast-paced memory puzzle game where visibility disappears and only your memory can guide you. With 50 challenging levels and limited lives, can you make it out before it's too late?

4550070.title: Two Left Hands
4550070.short_description: A co-op physics game where each player controls one clumsy left hand. Communicate, coordinate, and catastrophize your way through odd jobs in a small town. The job doesn't have to be perfect, it just has to be done.

4550090.title: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static
4550090.short_description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Just keep doing your job. And remember - The Spider is watching.

4550270.title: Bingo Bingle
4550270.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

4550520.title: 七罪之淵
4550520.short_description: Harold, a young man full of ideals, will struggle in a world full of malice. Through countless choices and sacrifices, he will gradually uncover the buried truth and face various different endings.

4550550.title: Vampire Pumpkin Plot
4550550.short_description: You are a Vampire traitor left for dead. Now you will take down the evil vampire pumpkin plot and escape into the void in this retro inspired boomer shooter.

4550990.title: A Vessel of Frustration
4550990.short_description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

4551030.title: The Cluster
4551030.short_description: Experience the story of Richard, a poor hunter, and his wife, Lilith. They are fighting to escape their circumstances with high hopes that their hard work is finally about to pay off, allowing them to leave this place behind forever.

4551050.title: Void Daggers
4551050.short_description: One touch kills you. Your timer is your score. Neon wireframe horrors swarm from infinite darkness. Shatter them, harvest their essence, forge your daggers through 5 tiers of devastation. Bunny hop the void. Dagger jump to survive. Prove your skill on Steam leaderboards. For fans of Devil Daggers.

4551150.title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
4551150.short_description: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make decisions by stamping decrees.

4551370.title: Knockout Carnival
4551370.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4551370.short_description: Knockout Carnival is a chaotic online multiplayer party game where players compete in crazy physics-based challenges, push, fall, and sabotage each other to survive and win. Fast, fun, and unpredictable matches with friends!

4551380.title: Robo Siege TD
4551380.short_description: A classic sci-fi tower defense game filled with waves of robots in full 3D. Get rewarded with automatic mini upgrades for well placed towers. As you make progress, unlock even more upgrades for your towers by building factories. Can you unlock the legendary golden tower?

4551420.title: SHOTRUN
4551420.short_description: One shot. One kill. SHOTRUN throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

4551440.title: Linkisa
4551440.short_description: Linkisa is a 2D Metroidvania set in the rainy region of Orana, inspired by Malagasy folklore, where you explore mysterious lands, master fluid combat, face legendary bosses, and uncover hidden secrets in a exploration-based adventure.

4551520.title: Your Daddy
4551520.short_description: Need a father figure who actually stays? Your Daddy is a 3D desktop companion who’s always by your side, ready to support you, cheer you up, and never leave for bread.

4551530.title: SIM Election USA
4551530.short_description: Run a presidential campaign in this turn-based strategy game where you manage funding, media, and political influence to win the election.

4551560.title: Medic Simulator: Combat Zone
4551560.short_description: Rescue wounded soldiers under enemy fire, control severe bleeding, apply tourniquets, perform emergency procedures, and transport patients to safety. Use real combat triage principles, react to unpredictable threats, and engage enemies when necessary. Only the fastest and bravest save lives.

4551590.title: Chat, Is This Real?
4551590.short_description: Chat is this Real? is a first-person psychological horror game. Play as a streamer in an abandoned hospital during a livestream. Uncover the hospital's dark past, follow the clues in the chat, and survive a nightmare that should have remained buried.

4551640.title: Pod's Itty Bitty Adventure
4551640.short_description: "Pod's Itty Bitty Adventure" is a short retro-themed open-world Metroidvania platformer that prioritizes movement and exploration.

4551680.title: Bounced: Not Tonight
4551680.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4551680.short_description: You're the bouncer. The door is yours. Check IDs, spot fakes, enforce the rules, and ragdoll anyone who argues. Play solo or co-op in this comedic, physics-fuelled nightclub sim.

4551710.title: Fat Justice
4551710.short_description: You are the newly appointed Judge in the Stone Age trying to keep a chaotic island from falling apart. Listen to bizarre testimonies while balancing absurd laws and deadly politics. Pass judgment, shape the island's fate, and uncover the truth behind your father's mysterious disappearance.

4551740.title: CalvinChess
4551740.short_description: It's chess, but the rules keep changing! Add new rules, adapt to events, and watch as the board and its pieces change with each move made. No two games are played the same!

4551780.title: Treasure Blast Quest
4551780.short_description: Easy to learn and fun to master, Treasure Blast Quest is perfect for players who enjoy casual treasure hunting, score chasing, and satisfying arcade-style gameplay.

4551820.title: Yuki Jump
4551820.genre: Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4551820.short_description: Climb the Forbidden Jungle Tower in this fast-paced 2D platformer! Jump higher, defeat creepy spiders, snakes, scorpions, and bats, collect XP to level up your hero, unlock double jumps, and conquer the heights. Short, free adventure – reach the top and claim victory!

4551890.title: Peak Rhythm
4551890.short_description: Climb to the beat in Peak Rhythm, a VR rhythm-climbing experience where every move powers your ascent. Sync with a high-energy electronic soundtrack, master precision movement, and rise through a neon cyberpunk city to top the global leaderboards.

4552100.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
4552100.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

4552140.title: Malice in Wonderland
4552140.short_description: Tear through Wonderland and break free of The Hatter's control in this fast-paced action roguelike. Augment your abilities to destroy your foes and escape before you're out of time!

4552160.title: Help Me Get Up
4552160.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy
4552160.short_description: The ground belongs to the undead—your only escape is up. Scavenge ruined skyscrapers for supplies, fight off desperate survivors, and manage your hunger in a high-stakes vertical wasteland. Every step is a gamble; every fall is a tragedy. Stay alive. Stay climbing.

4552190.title: 《30天》
4552190.short_description: 12月初雪夜，你被公司优化。路过电线杆时，发现一个箱子，里面有哭声。 走掉吗——30天后，心形陨石会毁灭世界。 带着吗——箱子里是一个弃婴。而她，一天长一岁。 跨年倒数，只剩30天。过完生日，你才30。 看到婴儿，脑中一闪而过的背影，是你父亲，还是母亲？ 30天内，你会变成谁，并教会她，何为人间的爱？ 以及，30天后....？

4552230.title: Make it! Gyoza
4552230.short_description: Wrap, cook, and serve crispy gyoza in this hectic cooking action game! Handle a rush of orders and aim for a booming business! Fast-paced gameplay rewards speed and precision. Play solo for high scores or compete with up to 4 players!

4552250.title: Cage of Y
4552250.short_description: 《Cage of Y》是一款以战略解放为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在回合中精密规划行动，巧妙平衡攻防并逐步增强角色能力，在结构严谨的战斗流程中享受经典的回合制游戏魅力。

4552280.title: YiShi Contagion: Versus
4552280.short_description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, go through the level building your character by collecting power-ups and weapons 💥, and win the match by defeating first the final boss and retrieving its viral conduit ☢️!

4552340.title: Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening
4552340.short_description: 《Lightning-Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening》 Choose different characters, combine various skills, and quickly complete challenging minesweeper levels. Features classic minesweeper, standard roguelike gameplay, and challenge mode. With 4 characters and over 100 skills.

4552350.title: Sandun Highway In Qinzhou
4552350.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

4552360.title: Galactic Conflict
4552360.short_description: A real-time sci-fi 4X strategy game where you explore procedurally generated star systems, expand your empire, manage resources, build fleets, and wage war against multiple AI factions in a dynamic and evolving galaxy.

4552380.title: My Part-Time Job With a Flirty Mistress
4552380.short_description: A struggling college student transforms into a butler for a wealthy heiress. You move into this luxurious mansion, serving the cold Miss while paying off your family's debts and dealing with her scheming uncle. Can you overcome the challenges alongside the Miss?

4552450.title: Off Garbage
4552450.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4552450.short_description: A sleep-deprived scientist must use a broken cleaning robot to contain a biological outbreak he accidentally caused before his wife returns and discovers the chaos.

4552460.title: BOB'S BOMB
4552460.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Sports, Free To Play
4552460.short_description: Chaotic bomb soccer with wobbly, floppy “Bobs”! Shove the bomb into the goal! But if you get caught in the blast… the point goes to your opponent!

4552600.title: Tiltyard
4552600.short_description: Joust, clash swords, and send your opponents flying in Tiltyard — a chaotic online PvP party game featuring wobbly knights, over-the-top physics, and medieval mayhem. Tilt or get tilted.

4553020.title: Pingo
4553020.short_description: Pingo is a desktop companion experience that combines virtual pet charm, light nurturing, and AI interaction. Spend your days with a tiny penguin that chats, reacts, remembers, and turns your everyday desktop routine into a more personal companion experience.

4553080.title: JAMA POKER
4553080.short_description: JAMA POKER is a strategic deck-building card game. During each match, you can discover and arrange JAMA cards, and elevate your gameplay by mastering the unique interplay of the five elements—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth—where each element generates or counters another.

4553290.title: Road From Horno
4553290.short_description: Play as an elite enforcer for a corrupt regime in a collapsing America. Hunt the persecuted, survive the wasteland, and experience a radical transformation in this story-driven tactical FPS where redemption is your greatest weapon.

4553330.title: Hemlotrion: Broken Mirror
4553330.short_description: Hemlotrion - a magic school full of secrets and mysteries. Immerse yourself in a world of magic, friendship, and rivalry, learn new spells, battle magical creatures, explore hidden corners of the school, and uncover the dark secret hidden within its walls.

4553440.title: 团战不能输
4553440.short_description: 创新融合卡牌策略与 MOBA 团战对抗，带来全新策略对战体验。玩家自由组合5 名英雄组成出战阵容，打造属于自己的战术体系。手牌会随机变化，相同的阵容也能打出完全不同的节奏与套路。没有复杂走位与手速要求，你只需专注出牌、技能释放，用智慧与运营打出决胜团战。

4553500.title: Abyss Drifter
4553500.short_description: You are a lone courier in a distant star system. Transport cargo between isolated outposts, survive hostile worlds, and navigate a quiet, atmospheric sci-fi frontier.

4553890.title: Service Area Simulator: Prologue
