4553890.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4553890.short_description: Start your journey from a small roadside stop and grow it into a massive rest area. Stock shelves, sell fuel, run a restaurant and motel, and keep everything clean and efficient. With the right management, turn a tiny business into a bustling service hub everyone wants to visit!

4553910.title: Codex Solis: Purrgatorium
4553910.short_description: A surreal 3D space shooter where every battle feeds a second war. Fight archons, collect cat cards, conquer planetary grid cells, and rewrite verses inside living planetary books in an asynchronous online meta-game.

4554030.title: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
4554030.short_description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Everyone is accepted here – whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious to learn more. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

4554330.title: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
4554330.short_description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

4554340.title: Project YH
4554340.short_description: A story-driven rhythm game where you follow the beat on a rotating clock to restore fractured time and emotion.

4554410.title: VOID WARD
4554410.short_description: A minimalist roguelite tower defense with neon aesthetics. Defend your planet against infinite waves of geometric enemies. Buy 70 upgrades, activate abilities, chain combos and grow stronger between runs with permanent upgrades. Every attempt makes you stronger.

4554430.title: Cuby Desk Farm
4554430.short_description: Turn your workflow into a farm with Cuby Desk Farm! Earn coins with every click, collect and hatch cute pets through blind boxes, and recharge your batteries with fun mini-games right on your desktop.

4554710.title: Portal of Nightmares
4554710.short_description: Developed by a solo developer, this atmospheric horror mystery tasks you with investigating a school where everyone vanished without a trace. Navigate untouched corridors and find notes to uncover the backstory. No difficult puzzles...just the truth waiting in the dark.

4555130.title: Fireworks Designer
4555130.short_description: Design your own fireworks! With a super easy-to-use editor, you can effortlessly create stunning, realistic fireworks. GPU-accelerated rendering handles millions of particles without lag, AND you can launch fireworks together with friends!

4555360.title: Specter
4555360.short_description: Sealed within a labyrinth of shadow, you are suddenly given a chance to escape! Delve into the maze and find your way out for a chance at freedom! Specter is a short puzzle platformer that explores moving platforms and flying discs.

4555470.title: Platformus
4555470.short_description: Platformus is a pure platformer game. Game has a fast paced gameplay with 3d platformer mechanics. You will focus only run, jump and complete platforms. This game will give you thrill of the platform game.

4555540.title: EGGCONSOLE HYDLIDE PC-8801
4555540.short_description: Operate the hero Jim and defeat the demon Varalys, the strongest in mythology! A classic action RPG representing the 1980s.

4555720.title: 黑帆王座·Galactic Loadout
4555720.short_description: One more run won’t hurt… right? In Black Sail Throne: Galactic Loadout, chase insane synergies, uncover unpredictable upgrades, and push your warship beyond limits. Every choice snowballs into chaos—until you break the galaxy.

4555840.title: Swamp Game
4555840.short_description: Swamp Game is the definitive swamp life simulation experience. Waking up with a hole in your head and nothing but the clothes on your body, do you have what it takes to get by, make a living and conquer the Swamp life?

4555880.title: ウンコらしょ！
4555880.short_description: This is a click-and-play idle game for children. It's easy to understand with Japanese (and some English) text, and playable with just a mouse. When you're busy, let your child play this game while you get things done.

4556110.title: Kinetype
4556110.short_description: KINETYPE is a minimalist, terminal, ASCII, roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Navigate procedural terminal grids by typing commands to move and survive. Extract to bank Bytes for permanent upgrades, or lose your streak to the system. The terminal is yours to command.

4556220.title: SANDSTRIKE
4556220.short_description: Tactical top-down multiplayer shooter where PvP battles, co-op Zombie Horde, and open-world RolePlay mode collide. Build your combat robot, install implants, and fight other players across a post-human desert wasteland.

4556580.title: The Brewline - Prologue
4556580.short_description: Step into the world of bootleg booze in this story-driven, single-player sim! Grow your crops, brew your drinks, bond with eccentric customers, and bottle it all under your own brand. Uncover the truth behind your brother’s arrest, complete quirky missions, and build your underground empire.

4556620.title: Somnara
4556620.short_description: Somnara is a relaxing dreamcore walking simulator. Step through portals and discover surreal environments filled with atmosphere and calm. There are no quests, no objectives, and no pressure — just peaceful spaces to explore where you can stay for as long as you wish.

4556750.title: Slots & Sword & Magic
4556750.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4556750.short_description: Slots & Sword & Magic is a turn-based roguelike slot machine game where every spin can break your build and trigger insane combo chains.

4556780.title: MetaHustle One
4556780.short_description: MetaHustle One is a fast-paced, frantic FPS with horror elements. Fight through hordes of wicked horned foxes and other corrupted familiars of the «Great Meta-Druid» to escape a glitchy simulation before it turns into a surreal nightmare.

4556800.title: His Last Film
4556800.short_description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

4556990.title: PetrolHeads
4556990.short_description: Build your dream garage from scratch! Customize everything from lifts to engines with deep tuning options. Design unique wide-body beasts, dominate drift duels or track days, and showcase your style in global meets. Your garage, your rules, your racing legacy starts now!

4557070.title: Ghostgirl Trainer
4557070.short_description: Ghostgirl Trainer is a linear dating sim where you move into a haunted house for its low rent and learn to live with the ghost. During the process, you build a relationship with her and train her to behave properly and not cause a ghostly outburst that may harm you mentally.

4557200.title: Drawing out Demons
4557200.short_description: A devilish drawing challenge! Free possessed souls by finding and correctly drawing the right sigils in this medieval puzzle game.

4557240.title: WOOD | We Observe Odd Disturbances
4557240.short_description: Co-op horror game about running a night shift in a strange building where reality keeps breaking down. Players monitor cameras, report anomalies, fix breakdowns, shoot intruders on sight.

4557350.title: Archmage Idle
4557350.genre: Casual, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4557350.short_description: An idle/incremental RPG where you're an Archmage of a wizard guild. Your skills bolster the frontlines and the supply lines. Every skill multiplies the others, and it all keeps running while you're away.

4557490.title: DarkStone Restoration
4557490.short_description: Darkstone Restoration brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, controls, readability, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

4557560.title: Necromancer Delivery Service
4557560.short_description: A 3D physics-driven action racing game where players control a struggling necromancer at Borz Bash, the city's fastest-growing delivery service. Complete deliveries in set times to collect money and souls while exploring the city and causing chaos with devious magic spells.

4558000.title: Defend Our Land
4558000.short_description: A fast-paced lane defense strategy game where you build your economy, place units, and defend your kingdom against relentless enemy waves across various bioms

4558200.title: Big Breasted Milky Futa Mommies 2
4558200.short_description: Relax, lay back, and pick a puzzle. Solve over 50 beautiful, sexual puzzles at your pleasure. Have thousands of hours of sexual fun with these EXTREMELY NSFW Futanari Mommy Puzzles.

4558450.title: Our Last Stand
4558450.short_description: Our Last Stand is a tower defence game that allows you to command a powerful mech and defend against relentless waves of enemies. Play on different worlds to gather resources, unlock advanced technology, and level your commander to gain powerful new abilities. Build defend, survive.

4558500.title: Squarsenal
4558500.short_description: Squarsenal is a short strategy game with a unique battle system. Defeat enemies and buy upgrades to expand and improving your arsenal of weapons.

4558620.title: The Apostle's Ascent
4558620.short_description: Guide an Apostle on their path to godhood. As a divine being, you shape fate through sacrifices, boons, and divine choices — but never control your champion directly. Build a legacy across generations as your Apostle ascends toward ultimate Apotheosis.

4558660.title: Momentum Fracture
4558660.short_description: Survive as long as you can in this fast-paced brick breaker. Each round unlocks unique upgrades that bend the rules of the game — every powerful buff comes with a risky trade-off.

4558920.title: Yua Games collection
4558920.short_description: a collection of adult games by Yua Nizu(me), containing a wide range of game-play and themes across every game. you have dungeon crawling, factory building, point and click, Vpet, and more.

4559050.title: Idle Xanxia
4559050.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4559050.short_description: Idle Xanxia is a cultivation themed idle RPG where you grow stronger through combat, Aspects, Dao paths, and Rebirth.

4559160.title: Endless War: Defense
4559160.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

4559220.title: Last Alive
4559220.short_description: You receive a message from an unknown sender. Following their instructions, you must navigate a world overrun by zombies and survive the night. Explore, fight, and solve puzzles to carve your path forward. But remember not every message is meant to keep you alive.

4559230.title: Beer Pong Party
4559230.short_description: Prove yourself at a hot beer pong party. If you show yourself well in the game, you will be rewarded with hot girls.

4559240.title: Grid Grief
4559240.short_description: A roguelite plinko-style pinbuilder about escaping the space between heaven & hell. Forge powerful synergies, trigger chaotic screen filling effects and rack up huge scores to secure your resurrection.

4559300.title: Yuumi-Chan: Rent is Due!
4559300.short_description: In this city, not even the power of friendship can stave off the threat of rising housing costs. So, put on your glittery big girl gloves, and get ready to punch, bash, thwack, and twinkle through enemies to rack up a small fortune of rent funds in Yuumi-Chan: Rent is Due!

4559320.title: Five Nights at Carson's
4559320.short_description: Survive the night in this point-and-click horror experience featuring bizarre, real-life inspired characters. Expect tense gameplay, unexpected scares, and a mix of horror and humor that keeps you on edge.

4559510.title: 目を閉じてプレイするゲーム「星の記す真実」
4559510.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4559510.short_description: When you start the game, the narrator will instruct you to “close your eyes.” At that moment, whether you actually close them or keep them open will change the course of the story. Listen carefully to the voice as you proceed, and find your way to the truth.

4559530.title: Marginalia
4559530.short_description: Marginalia is an atmospheric narrative anthology. Seven stories, one for each deadly sin. Enter the library. Choose your tale. Your choices will not save you. But they will define you.

4559610.title: You Will Fall
4559610.short_description: A parkour climbing game where gravity is your enemy, fire is your only friend, and the ground keeps winning. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just you and your poor life choices.

4559630.title: Between Us: Reckoning
4559630.short_description: Play as a journalist investigating mysterious events. Collect clues, uncover secrets, and shape the story through your choices in this narrative-driven mystery.

4559800.title: Hell is Empty, Demons are playing Apokerlypse
4559800.short_description: A card-strategy roguelike inspired by classic poker games. Play as Satan, an unremarkable underworld clerk, progress through a 3-chapter Story Mode, challenge mighty bosses, and use Demonic Chips to rewrite the rules on your rise to become the King of Hell.

4559930.title: Oboro no Ichi
4559930.short_description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

4560070.title: QuizMasters
4560070.short_description: Participate in this thrilling quiz experience alone or with friends. Be the fastest to solve a puzzle, be the most creative player inventing subtitles for a short video or gain points with your general knowledge on multiple choice questions. Play with friends even if they didn't buy the game.

4560170.title: Orblins
4560170.short_description: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

4560180.title: Alyanom
4560180.short_description: EXPLORE 6 entropic gateways ranging from a liminal swimming pool to an empty art museum with up to 4 friends. MEMORIZE before they change each loop, then CATALOG if any ANOMALIES occur. Spaces shift from horrific entities to comedic encounters, we have no idea what's in there, that's your job.

4560260.title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
4560260.short_description: Spot anomalies in a looping complex of empty poolrooms. Choose the correct exit and find the way out.

4560290.title: Sweet Dance
4560290.genre: Action, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4560290.short_description: A next-gen 3D dress-up rhythm dance game. Mix and match a vast collection of fashionable outfits, master the hottest dance moves, and unlock trending TikTok hits. Meet new friends and embark on a sweet romantic journey!
developers: 上海游牛信息科技有限公司
publishers: 辰炎翎网络科技（上海）有限公司

4560520.title: Saoirse
4560520.short_description: Eight people are trapped in an abandoned neurotech facility. The only hope for escape is by surviving deathgames based on scans of each other's minds.

4560660.title: Eslabong
4560660.short_description: Fight in real-time arena battles while running your own club in a unique blend of action combat and management. Recruit mercenaries, shape your team, and compete in leagues and cups to rise to the top.

4560710.title: Spacebolt
4560710.genre: Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4560710.short_description: What am I? Where am I? Who am I? In this narrative-driven puzzle adventure, you control a spark of electricity lost in an abandoned lab. Move across walls and ceilings, travel through circuits, and activate dormant machines, every discovery bringing you closer to uncovering the truth.

4560790.title: GenoCube
4560790.short_description: GenoCube is a real-time action roguelite where you scan creatures, steal DNA, and mutate mid-run. Draft species-based powers, adapt on the fly, and choose when to extract or risk everything as the ecosystem hunts you back.

4560910.title: Paper Carnival
4560910.short_description: Paper Carnival is a surreal 2D puzzle platformer. Play as a hammer-wielding clown rabbit exploring interconnected puzzle rooms. Smack props with your giant hammer and use the recoil to jump higher! Escape this bizarre carnival machine, only to discover the ending is actually...

4561110.title: Budget Renovation Simulator
4561110.short_description: Turn "Trash" into "Cash"! 💰 Buy wrecked houses, hunt for the cheapest materials, and fix them up for a massive profit. Spend the least to make the most in this renovation challenge! Can you finish the job without going broke?

4561190.title: Moon Mice: The Game
4561190.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4561190.short_description: Moon Mice: The Game, is a solo-developed action game that blends souls-like with hack-and-slash combat, parkour-style traversal, and companion-based gameplay within a sci-fi world where humanity survives in floating cities powered by mysterious lunar creatures.

4561310.title: Melancholic Night
4561310.short_description: A visual novel about returning home. That is, trying to get home. After all, your home is no longer there. You could say that it is actually about drinking in a bar and talking to strange people.

4561370.title: Relic Reaver
4561370.short_description: Relics, poker, and impossible choices at the end of the world: equip your reliquary, loot cursed zones, accept dangerous rituals, and play the best hand you can. You'll fall. You'll learn. You'll come back better.

4561720.title: AltarCall
4561720.short_description: Altar Call is an adult romance visual novel set in small-town Georgia. As newly appointed pastor Gideon Hale, navigate three forbidden relationships with women from your congregation. Three routes, nine explicit adult scenes, and a Southern Gothic story that refuses to moralize.

4562090.title: Slime Girl: Sticky Love
4562090.short_description: Fall into the depths with Nimea, a curious slime girl. An adult monster girl visual novel with spicy animated scenes, fluid intimacy, and a romance shaped by your choices.

4562170.title: Oar We There Yet?
4562170.short_description: Raft down a river while you try to wrangle your stupid friends.

4562430.title: Blackdoor
4562430.short_description: You're a hacker with a terminal and four terrible scripts. Rewrite them. Hack servers by writing actual code in a custom scripting language - probe ports, crack passwords, steal data, and get out before the trace completes. Better code = better hacker.

4562650.title: Island of the Lost
4562650.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island, gather resources, craft tools, and build a ship to escape—or explore freely in a larger open-world survival mode.

4562700.title: 小鹿游北京 Lulu in Beijing
4562700.short_description: Learn about local customs and culture by answering questions with NPCs. Each city includes 20 different scenes with a total of 1,000 questions. The game is light and fun, suitable for all ages. Players can earn an achievement by answering more than half of the questions correctly in each round.

4562930.title: 侦探R和预言者J
4562930.short_description: 《侦探R和预言者J》是一部通过交流追查案件的悬疑冒险游戏。 ※本游戏中包括暗示使用药物的描写，部分暴力描写和残酷描写。 电视剧一般的世界，在这部悬疑冒险游戏中，您可以尽享欧美电影或欧美电视剧的世界观氛围。 不擅推理也没有关系，您可通过对话，刺探证人与犯人，揭露真相！ 本游戏使用Live2D与演出效果，为您带来沉浸感。 因选择改变的人际关系交往 哪怕选择相同的选项，角色的反应也会随着您的能力值，或者您过去选择的选项而发生改变。

4562980.title: Soul of Dreamer
4562980.short_description: A young girl trapped in a strange world guided only by their heart and soul. jump around and explore many places to find a way out.

4563230.title: WolfProof
4563230.short_description: FPS meets base building survival. Construct walls, floors, and traps to fortify your base, then fight off waves of monsters. Build. Fight. Survive.

4563250.title: BauHouse
4563250.short_description: BauHouse is a rhythm-driven bullet hell where energetic music creates and drives every obstacle. You control a block. Move to dodge obstacles and dash to pass through them. Simple. Can you?

4563360.title: BünzliFight: Swiss City Simulator
4563360.short_description: Cooperative real time city building simulator with Swiss flair. Build a town together manage resources and budgets solve quirky everyday problems and experience a world that keeps running even when you are offline.

4563370.title: The Great Maze
4563370.short_description: The Great Maze is a strategy exploration game centered on "choice." Lead your team through layers of doors, each with unique risks. Decide who opens which door and when to use items. No combat—only risk assessment, resource management, and sacrifice. Every step depends on the door you choose.

4563480.title: 粒子战争 Particle Wars
4563480.short_description: GPU particle war sim. Console tunes physics to aggregate particles into solids, then split. 16 types, force matrix, 4 factions, mutations, 3 modes (Tutorial, War, Pure). Goal: make particles split like cells.

4563570.title: Battle 3D - Strategy game
4563570.short_description: Control the military units from above or handle whichever one you want.

4563870.title: Miseria
4563870.short_description: Miseria is a dark fantasy–themed idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

4563940.title: Guard Dog on Duty
4563940.short_description: In a corporate convenience store, a hero must awaken... Donning a mask and cape of char, Weiner-Man is here to save fellow wieners from the clutches of Wostco! Spin, twist, and launch yourself off the maze of shelves, all while the employee on duty stares on—he isn't paid enough for this...

4563950.title: Chase & Crash
4563950.short_description: Welcome to Chase & Crash, a fast-paced arcade driving game focused on high-speed pursuits, risk-taking, and survival.

4564150.title: Titan Hunters
4564150.short_description: Grab your friends, load the cannons, and defend your castle from giant monsters in this chaotic 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Blast massive Titans apart piece by piece, upgrade your weapons, and try not to blow up your own base!

4564230.title: Shard Cycle
4564230.short_description: Prospect plasma-storing crystals on an alien planet. Upgrade your drill, unlock devastating abilities, and prestige to grow stronger. A sci-fi incremental game with deep progression, multiple ability paths, and a strategic prestige loop.

4564390.title: Heroes of Ropascia
4564390.short_description: Create your own party of heroes to face the dark forces in this 2D-RPG with a round-based combat system. Collect gear, level up your characters and discover what this vast world has to offer.

4564550.title: Headward Erosion 溯源侵蚀
4564550.short_description: Headward Erosion is a story-driven RPG set in a fictional world. Players will experience the story through the perspectives of nine different characters, gradually uncovering the truth behind a girl's death.

4564630.title: Minkle's Masks of Mayhem
4564630.short_description: A cosy 2.5D micro management game, situated in a magical fantasy universe. Play as Minkle, and help him arrive safely at his destination by keeping his troublesome masks at bay.

4564660.title: Engine of Y
4564660.short_description: 《Engine of Y》是一款以科技创新为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在回合中精密规划行动，巧妙平衡攻防并逐步增强角色能力，在结构严谨的战斗流程中享受经典的回合制游戏的机械魅力。

4564670.title: Husk of Y
4564670.short_description: 《Husk of Y》是一款以荒芜探索为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在回合中精心规划行动，平衡攻防策略并不断增强角色能力，在神秘而引人深思的战斗环境中体验经典的回合制游戏魅力。

4564750.title: StarStruck
4564750.short_description: Check this High-Octane Roguelite-Survivor TPS! Blast, burn, and mutilate your way through five rounds of escalating carnage. Hunt secrets, upgrade your arsenal, and break the curse of a mad villain to save a universe at war as Tigo, the galaxy’s last uncursed tiger and his gang of unlikely friends.

4564790.title: Towerslam
4564790.short_description: Slam your towers down and conquer endless maps of enemies in this roguelike tower defense game. Level up, earn loot, unlock powerful upgrades and create unstoppable towers!

4566530.title: Town of Hopkinton
4566530.short_description: One day, a murder is committed in the town with the lowest crime rate in the world. Your job as an FIB agent is to solve this murder as quickly as possible and send the right person to prison.

4566560.title: Mahjong Kawuxing
4566560.short_description: A casual chess game. In the fast-paced three-player mahjong, click the left mouse button to play the mahjong tiles in your hand, win more money, and become a gambling god.

4566580.title: Billionaire in the Greedy America
4566580.short_description: America, 1850. Fortunes are made and destroyed in a single day. Will you be the predator — or the prey? Trade stocks, crush rivals, seize companies, and claw your way to the top in the most ruthless financial arena of the century.

4566660.title: Regret Archive
4566660.short_description: Regret Archive is a dark fantasy turn-based tactics game where abandoned possibilities take form. Read enemy intent, control forecast tiles, and shape your build through relics and combat choices.

4566780.title: ALFA: Antiterror
4566780.short_description: As the commander of elite soldiers from the Russian special forces unit ALFA, you take charge in the fight against terrorism. Each of your men has his own skills and strengths, and every terrain and mission presents its own challenges and dangers.

4566830.title: Bugorama
4566830.short_description: Explore colorful natural scenes, spot hidden insects and tiny animals, and build your collection in a cozy hidden-object game shaped by weather and procedural variation.

4566850.title: Sepak U - Sports Fighting Game
4566850.short_description: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

4566880.title: Endless Roll
4566880.short_description: Your dice are your health in this endless survival roguelite. Pick a lane, manage wounds and corruption, draft omens, climb the leaderboard, and push for one more floor.

4566890.title: Trickster's Trial
4566890.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where every run is different. Fight, adapt, and grow stronger in a chaotic world shaped by a mischievous god.

4566980.title: Sticker DECO
4566980.short_description: The sticker books you loved as a kid are back! Collect 1,000+ stickers and freely decorate your own scrapbook. Meet 50+ cute animal friends to trade with, or spin the free in-game Gacha. Read their tastes for fun trades. Once your kawaii masterpiece is done, snap a pic and share it with the world!

4567020.title: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
4567020.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.

4567120.title: Eclipse Blade
4567120.short_description: Eclipse Blade is a retro ninja action-platformer inspired by classic ninja games from the 1990s. Featuring challenging old-school gameplay and beautifully hand-crafted pixel art, it delivers the pure thrill of classic action in a fresh new way.

4567240.title: OESM - Sacred Story
4567240.short_description: Ottoman Empire: Spectacular Millennium prequel. Richard, your mission is to find the original Bible manuscript in the Ottoman Empire lands in the absence of Alp Er Tunga and bring it to the Archbishop.

4567390.title: Hop Slash
4567390.short_description: Hop Slash is a Casual 3D Platformer game with a focus on Action, Exploration and Item Collection, which draws strong inspiration from 64-bit Golden Age Platformer games such as Spyro, Zelda and Mario 64.

4567670.title: Chick'n Slide
4567670.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

4567790.title: Project Crypto: Trading Simulator
4567790.short_description: Achieve true financial freedom starting from zero. Save up your seed money through part-time jobs, dive into the crypto market, and use various apps including high risk futures and real estate trading to climb the wealth ladder in this realistic trading simulation.

4567970.title: Wellspring
4567970.short_description: Master your timing and precision in this relentless wave survival game. Hone your skills and discover your style as you beat back the assault. Unlock powerful upgrades that compliment and enhance your abilities. Can you make it to round 40?

4567990.title: Infernal Crusader: Metal of the Damned
4567990.short_description: A 2D Hack and slash game where you fight your way through hell as a fallen knight to the sound of heavy metal. A 2d hack and slash platformer to rip the roof off. Armed with your sword and shield which can be thrown at enemies you must destroy everything that stands in your way.

4568030.title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
4568030.short_description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

4568130.title: LaVonne's Lemons Idle
4568130.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4568130.short_description: Grow an ultimate empire in LaVonne's Lemons Idle! Click your way from a single citrus to deep cosmic automation. Unearth ancient Artifacts, build out the Endless Research Lab, "feed" (click) your screen pet monkey, and prestige into the stars in this deeply strategic resource management clicker!

4568300.title: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons
4568300.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4568300.short_description: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons is an action game where you survive waves of zombies and demons in explosive environments. Fight, collect weapons, and master each level.

4568450.title: Torin's Greed
4568450.short_description: Torin's greed is a FPS is a FPS Dungeon Mining game. Use your pickaxe to mine through the dungeon to find gold and shoot monster enemies to go further down the dungeon for gold.

4568470.title: Sunlit Journey: The Town
4568470.short_description: Sunlit Journey: The Town Small Town is a short, heartwarming visual novel. As the opening chapter of an ongoing series, it centers on gentle everyday life and tells a tender encounter set in a quiet small town.

4568730.title: Lost Soul of the Missing Island
4568730.short_description: The legendary pirate king Captain Jack was slain by black magic, leaving his soul trapped in his ship’s helm. Lost in purgatory, he can only find peace if you help him discover the lost island and finally set his spirit free.

4568800.title: Techmino-Downstacking
4568800.short_description: Classic block stacking game where you place tetrominoes and clear them by filling rows. But how efficiently can you "downstack"?

4568830.title: ASTRAL COURT DX
4568830.short_description: Astral Court DX is an arcade bullet hell platformer! You're on death-row in a prison in Heaven, HOWEVER the Astral Court grants you with a chance at bale as long as you complete their death-defying trials! How will you weigh against justice?

4568940.title: Defrost
4568940.short_description: Defrost - a 3D third-person metroidvania. Jump, climb, explore, collect coins, and upgrade your abilities. Fight, help strange characters survive, and use the world in creative ways. Discover why the fridge is defrosting before it's too late.

4568960.title: 某一年四季
4568960.short_description: This is a short visual novel that blends atmospheric audio with radio drama.After this snowy night, through the seasons to come, she will sit by his bedside, telling him of her hopes and the stories that belong to them.

4568980.title: Fu-Fu-Chan -way up!-
4568980.short_description: Blow into the microphone and breathe life into your climb. As simple as a breath. As deep as the sky.

4569080.title: MEMESTEINE FILES
4569080.short_description: Secret meme archive. Dusty case files, strange faces, leaked documents, and the old internet that still feels more alive than a lot of people.

4569110.title: Invasion 2
4569110.short_description: Invasion sequel. Our story continues where it left off. You are trying to find your father, who went on a mission to Mars years ago and was never heard from again.

4569230.title: Tower And Dragon
4569230.short_description: Retro back to the year 1977! With the release of the Commodore PET, personal computers became accessible to masses for the first time. It only had 8K. Tower And Dragon's goal is to create a fully immersive RPG 2D gaming experience on that computer (or emulator) for the very first time.

4569260.title: Nytherra
4569260.short_description: A cozy 2D adventure where you explore, gather resources, turn them into profit, craft, and battle enemies to save a fading world before time runs out.

4569350.title: COURIER GUILD
4569350.short_description: Kai dreams of becoming the greatest courier in the world. Joining the elite Courier Guild, he sets off on a dangerous journey to delivering packages, exploring islands, battling monsters, and uncovering the secrets of the roads that connect people's fates.

4569530.title: Emergency Roadside Assistance
4569530.short_description: One day, all the electricity in the world goes out and all the vehicles break down. Only your vehicle is working. You can save your city by repairing all the vehicles in the time given to you.

4569900.title: Creepytape Rewind - Not From Here
4569900.short_description: A change of environment, isolation in a remote area, and a chain of seemingly random events can leave the mind vulnerable. But what will your imagination create when you're met with hostility from the locals?

4569950.title: Silent Fare
4569950.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

4570050.title: Monster TD
4570050.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4570050.short_description: This is a classic tower defense game featuring a level mode and an endless mode. Strategically combine your towers to defeat the enemies.

4570060.title: Myth's and monster's
4570060.short_description: A classic style JRPG featuring party based turn-based combat open world exploration and a mature dark fantasy story.

4570100.title: Rutted
4570100.short_description: A physics-based off-road riding game about balance, momentum, and not flipping over like an idiot.

4570130.title: GridLock
4570130.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

4570250.title: Cover My Buns
4570250.short_description: Run a chaotic burger stand where every order is physically built by hand. Cook, stack, and serve under pressure—then challenge your friends to beat your shift.

4570310.title: Femboy Simulator
4570310.short_description: Atmospheric visual novel set around a mysterious coffee shop. Observe, interact, and uncover subtle changes as you piece together a quiet, unsettling story through environment, dialogue, and mood-driven moments

4570360.title: The Red Disciples
4570360.short_description: Build your own cult in a living open world. Recruit followers, infiltrate institutions, expand your influence and use strategy or violence to rise from the streets and take control of the system.

4570470.title: Hyper Profit Pets
4570470.short_description: Hatch. Train. Sell. Repeat. Become the ultimate pet mogul in this idle incremental! Collect over 100 types of pet with dozens of special effects!

4570540.title: Lucifuge
4570540.short_description: In this reverse-horror stealth RPG, you are a vampire fledgling fighting a holy human crusade. Shift instantly between Bat and Human forms to evade blinding light, ambush Watcher-Priests, and free captured monsters. Master the shadows to save the Evil from the hands of the Holy.

4570670.title: Wherever You Get Your Podcasts
4570670.short_description: Spooky Sacramento is a podcast that investigates the unexplained in the greater Sacramento Area. While touring the infamous Dyer Lane, the show’s hosts and their live audience disappeared. Become a podcast editor, repair audio files, and find them before the hard drive dies!

4570710.title: LinkMaster
4570710.short_description: A minimalist grid puzzle where you connect matching points to fill the board without crossing lines. Earn up to four stars based on speed as levels scale from 4×4 to 14×14. Easy to learn, challenging to link master.

4570940.title: Monster Flipper
4570940.short_description: Monster Flipper is a short incremental game where you buy and level monsters, smash them with a giant hammer for gold, and unlock swords and artifacts to automate your progress.

4570960.title: GigaTroubleS
4570960.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4570960.short_description: Piece together the complete story in this Unique Adventure game with Giantess Girls, which combine First-Person exploration and decryption, Text Adventure, Rouge-like, Real-Time combat, and many interesting gameplay! There’s plenty of interesting content waiting to be explored!

4571000.title: Secho
4571000.short_description: Secho is a dark action roguelike. You are blind. To see, you must make sound. Pay for attacks with your own health, identify true targets by the color of the heart. Follow the guidance of the White Cauldron—your only mentor in this void.

4571010.title: Dungeon Stew
4571010.short_description: Gather your companions, feed them suspicious stew, and conquer the dungeon! Dungeon Stew is a time-loop roguelite RPG centered on card-based combat. Return to the past and use the knowledge and resources you gain to break the loop!

4571050.title: Agartha Survivors
4571050.short_description: Agartha Survivors is a bullet-heaven roguelite set in the mythical underground world of Agartha. Fight off relentless waves of cybernetic soldiers from the surface of the earth while leveling up a growing arsenal of zesty weapons and passive abilities. How long can you survive?

4571160.title: Rainbow Tower Defence
4571160.short_description: Building towers is only the beginning. In this innovative tower defense, you must draw powerful 'Lines' between your towers to halt the enemy advance! Strategically deploy towers of the right colors and combine functional lines to create an impenetrable defense against the approaching monster hordes

4571210.title: Darkman: Bounty Hunter
4571210.short_description: You are a bounty hunter living in an alternate parallel universe in a timeline close to the present day. Your mission is to kill the demons that plague the townspeople and make the area more livable.

4571230.title: The Lost Samurai
4571230.short_description: Your husband, King Wukong, was kidnapped by the Witch Queen of the North into a different parallel universe. Your mission is to rescue your husband from where he is held captive as quickly as possible.

4571260.title: King of Wukong
4571260.short_description: In your absence, the enemy king has taken over the entire country. He awaits you for the final duel. To return everything to its former state, you need to travel back in time.

4571330.title: Magical Girl OS 98
4571330.short_description: Visual novel × management sim × dating sim. As a magical girl manager, you will be taking charge of your very first magical girl—Lin Gen. Even though she smokes, drinks, runs loan-sharking schemes, and is addicted to transforming, she is a good girl—a good magical girl, right?

4571450.title: The Ghost's Guide to the Afterlife
4571450.short_description: "The Ghost's Guide to the Afterlife" is a sci-fi visual novel with a multi-threaded ensemble narrative. You are already dead— and yet, your journey has only just begun. Become a ghost. Step into a strange and dazzling world beyond life, and witness a tale where love and death entwine.

4571590.title: Sweet Running
4571590.short_description: Sweet Running - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and cute running girls in their daily lives after exercise. It's accompanied by relaxing music, and after completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4572110.title: ESCAPE THE NEST
4572110.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4572110.short_description: Survive deadly creatures across tense, level-based challenges. Use unique mechanics, manage limited resources, and don’t get caught.

4572160.title: Water Margin: Defiance
4572160.short_description: Water Margin: Defiance is an action RPG set in the 14th-century Chinese classic Water Margin (Outlaws of the Marsh). Choose your path between good and evil; fight in fast-paced combat; strike unseen from the shadows. Step into a world where legend and reality intertwine.

4572190.title: Mine Farm
4572190.short_description: Mine Farm is a progressive mining RPG centered on the pure joy of looting. Mine various minerals, challenge colossal entities, and find your way out of the unknown. Be warned: the journey home won't be easy.

4572510.title: 领导来了Boss is coming
4572510.short_description: A casual indie game set in a modern workplace. You're a rookie in the office. But you have a self-serving manager. You'll be tasked to handle tricky situations. So how to handle that? And how many ways to drive your manager crazy? The game aims to provide a relaxing, enjoyful and some LOL moments.

4572600.title: Sunset Angels
4572600.short_description: A former volleyball star becomes the coach of a troubled girls’ team in the coastal town of Sunborn Bay. Train players, build relationships, explore the town, and prepare for the big tournament while uncovering secrets and pursuing romance

4572610.title: Agon : Legends of the Arena
4572610.short_description: Enter Agon, a PvP autobattler set in Greek mythology. Empower your champion with divine favors, equip powerful gear, and shape your strategy before combat. Watch battles unfold and refine your builds to rise as a Legend of the Arena!

4572620.title: Canvas Attack!
4572620.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

4572760.title: The 9th Corpse
4572760.short_description: Montserrat is a vampire detective with absolutely zero vampire powers. She has a grumbling 1,000-year-old demon dog, Arko. Explore a bizarre, hand-drawn mansion, solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and stop a sinister cult from claiming their 9th corpse in this quirky, mystery-filled adventure!

4572850.title: Orbital Express
4572850.short_description: Build and manage your own space company. Design missions, launch satellites, and expand your influence across Earth’s orbit.

4572880.title: Radiation Caterpillar
4572880.short_description: Are you willing to take risks to grow? Can you collect all the radiation without getting trapped in your own body? Test your skills in this unique space puzzle!

4573020.title: The Creator
4573020.short_description: The Creator is a meditative, relaxing journey through the wonders of the virtual world where you create the world from a large selection of items while enjoying the music and atmosphere you created.

4573060.title: Lab 2040
4573060.short_description: Lab 2040 is a Sci-fi, first person shooter game where the player combats different robots and drones using various weapons. Weapons include pistols, automatic guns, grenade, time bombs and more. There are 10 main levels which you will have to progress through to get to the final boss, Bamidele.

4573210.title: Klifur
4573210.short_description: Casual 2D bouldering. Make your way through 60 hand-made campaign routes or use the level editor to make your own routes and share them with friends!

4573330.title: Mine it!
4573330.short_description: Mine It — dive into a world of forgotten stellar technology. Search for rare resources in the darkness, trade and upgrade your gear, guided only by a beam of light in the endless void.

4573450.title: See-Through Bubbles
4573450.short_description: A perfect blend of easy, addictive bubble-shooting puzzles and a beautiful girl game!

4573470.title: Supermaneuver
4573470.short_description: Retro flightcade action; dogfight in the past's future with next generation aircraft over a war-torn country as a privateer combat pilot. Choose a path, fight a war, and immerse yourself in the world of 20XX.

4573540.title: Shipolis
4573540.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game where you explore unknown archipelagos with a ship and hopes of glory! Sail the seas, develop your cities, grow your population, set up production lines and collect tons of resources. How many great wonders will you build?

4573590.title: The Horror Occultist
4573590.short_description: The Horror Occultist is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a cursed forest and the ruins of an abandoned monastery where an ancient force was awakened. Uncover the truth, avoid the cult, and survive what watches from the dark.

4573600.title: Jaded Jade Jayden
4573600.short_description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

4573970.title: Syntaris
4573970.short_description: Syntaris is a logistics and automation strategy game with RTS elements, focused on system design over micromanagement. Build industrial networks, organize local economies, set logistics rules, unlock advanced technologies, and capture enemy infrastructure to integrate it into your own base.

4574120.title: Civilization Idle
4574120.short_description: A strategy-driven idle game where you develop your civilization, research technologies, and make critical decisions to expand your empire across the ages.

4574210.title: Santa Smoke: Prologue
4574210.short_description: Santa is at wit's end. Life is very long. This world is not what it once was. The Christmas spirit is lost. Too many polar smokestacks producing toys that get thrown out on boxing day. His belly overhangs, Mrs. Claus feels far away, Rudolph's nose doesn't glow so bright.

4574240.title: Havenrail
4574240.short_description: “The Last Train of Humanity” is a survival strategy game. Manage your train, oversee resources, and make tough decisions that determine the fate of your passengers. Will they survive the perilous journey?

4574250.title: The Secret Dungeon
4574250.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4574250.short_description: Embark on a 2-player adventure through vast, enchanted realms. Wield weapons, uncover powerful upgrades, and face dark magic as you explore a fallen kingdom. Easy to jump in, with depth for those who venture deeper into the dungeon's mysteries.

4574290.title: ATROX
4574290.short_description: ATROX is a pixel art adventure where you will face your deepest nightmares while traversing a desolate and unknown world, filled with metal, monolithic structures and a lot of red color.

4574300.title: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins
4574300.short_description: The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

4574320.title: Ah. Ah. Ah.
4574320.short_description: A voice-input action game that can be cleared in about 10 minutes.

4574330.title: Borrowed Faces
4574330.short_description: Help stranded humans escape an otherworldly realm as you pick them up on your bus route. Investigate and interrogate each new arrival to ensure they don't devour you or your passengers as you head to your safehouse.

4574370.title: Sword & Banner
4574370.short_description: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

4574410.title: Glossolalia
4574410.short_description: A terrifying voice-driven psychological horror game where your voice controls everything. Speak to move, solve puzzles, and answer disturbing questions. Something is listening… and the more you speak, the closer it gets.

4574510.title: PROJECT REPRIEVE
4574510.short_description: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

4574660.title: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends
4574660.short_description: 90 minutes remain until the world ends. Will you face the end with regret or go out with a bang?”

4574760.title: Overdrive Reloaded
4574760.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4574760.short_description: Overdrive Reloaded is a single player first-person shooter created by Dynamite Games. Drop into a stunning reimagining of the series, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, open world Battle Royale, and an all-new progression system known as Evolution.

4574820.title: Rejected Draft
4574820.short_description: You are a flawed doodle that was thrown in the trash. Battle rival sketches, absorb their powers, and seek your ultimate revenge. Watch numbers soar in this second-screen idle battler. Massive skill tree and randomized prestige mechanic means every journey is distinct.

4574850.title: Escape the Exomoon
4574850.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a story-rich first person cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony. Will you escape with your humanity intact?

4575080.title: Lost Exit
4575080.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

4575140.title: Project Uncover
4575140.short_description: Uncover hidden art in this neon synthwave Qix-style arcade! Dodge bullet hell to capture 80% of the area. Upgrade roguelike skills like Dash and Shield to defeat evolving boss phases. Experience infinite fun with Custom Mode—turn your own images into playable stages!

4575150.title: 이세계 바텐더
4575150.short_description: A cohabitation story that begins with two men who crossed over from another world.

4575180.title: My Sister-in-Law is Secretly a Succubus
4575180.short_description: A visual novel of aching desire. Balance the fragile teasing bond with your bubbly wife Ava while surrendering to your succubus sister-in-law’s dangerous pull. Make choices that slowly corrupt your marriage into forbidden hotwife bliss — or shatter it forever. NTR/NTS slow-burn corruption awaits.

4575200.title: tombolo
4575200.short_description: Welcome to tombolo! This is a game where you use the sliding effects of vertical and horizontal pieces to make your opponent drop the circle piece off the board! It's a perfect information game like Go, Shogi, Chess, and Othello.

4575270.title: Breaking Drugs
4575270.short_description: Build your own underground empire in Breaking Drug, a gritty simulation game where you produce, manage resources, expand your network, and take risks to dominate a dynamic and dangerous world.

4575330.title: Hiryu no Ken Collection
4575330.short_description: Retro action collection featuring the first four Hiryu no Ken titles plus two international versions. Experience mixed martial arts battles, side-scrolling action, and the distinctive Shingan battle system. Japanese titles are Japanese-only; international versions are English-only.

4575390.title: Bow-wow Battle
4575390.short_description: Be a dog. Bark. And win. "Bow-wow Battle" is a 1v1 game where you bark into your mic for real! Steam Online Multiplayer supported! Push the tug-of-war gauge with voice volume and rapid-fire barks! Adorable dogs, Dog Road story mode, and Crab Survival. With friends, family, or your crush — bark out!

4575440.title: Omen of the Godless
4575440.short_description: A first-person roguelike deckbuilder where you build elemental decks, battle through branching node maps, unlock permanent cards, and strategically choose your path as each victory increases the difficulty of remaining challenges.

4575470.title: Mountains & Molehills
4575470.short_description: Dig up attacks to build your deck and fight your way to the source of a mysterious rumbling underground! A colorful cast of animal friends and lots of powerful relics make every run of this turn-based rogue-like mole adventure a unique experience!

4575490.title: Full Thrust at Work
4575490.short_description: A story-driven romance visual novel set in the workplace. Guide the protagonist through office life, build relationships with two heroines, and make choices that shape the story. Your decisions lead to multiple endings, from love and career success to unexpected outcomes.

4575540.title: Shape Survivors
4575540.short_description: The arena is shrinking. Annihilate endless swarms of angry geometry to climb the global leaderboards in this relentless bullet heaven. Collect Poly shards, upgrade your weapons, and unlock permanent meta-progression to survive the crush in Shape Survivors.

4575650.title: Cosy Puzzle Cabin
4575650.short_description: A cosy collection of 17 handcrafted puzzle types to unwind with. Logic, word, and pattern challenges — at your own pace, one puzzle at a time.

4575680.title: Prison Glow

4565100.title: Crow's Curated Closet - Shop Simulator

4565280.title: Waves of Chaos
4565280.short_description: In Waves of Chaos, your goal is simple: survive. Face increasingly difficult waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and push back the invasion before it overwhelms you.

4565390.title: Grief
4565390.short_description: Grief is a psychological horror game with a dark, scary atmosphere. The game takes place in a Soviet-style apartment somewhere in Estonia in 1998.

4565400.title: Samurai Fighters Together
4565400.short_description: A stylized samurai combat game featuring wave-based PvE survival and skill-driven PvP duels. Master precise combat, survive relentless enemy waves, and prove your skill against other players in a world inspired by feudal Japan.

4565530.title: Divinuet

4565730.title: Taverntasia

4565830.title: Prismachines

4565840.title: Bet On It

4567160.title: September 3rd
