4578550.short_description: AIM, TYPE, and HIT in this top-down golf game where your typing prowess determines your shot.

4578640.title: Ro Sham Brawl
4578640.short_description: A physics-based multiplayer party brawler. Hurl Rock, Paper, and Scissors at friends or bots that clash mid-air, shatter arena platforms, and pile up as obstacles. Grab powerups that bring endless chaos to each round. Brawl with up to 8 players online or on LAN.

4578680.title: 红色史诗
4578680.short_description: 《红色史诗》是一款以中国工农红军长征为背景的塔防+轻度RTS混合策略游戏。游戏忠实还原历史事件与地理细节，不虚构核心史实。玩家将重返那段波澜壮阔的历史，在1:1真实还原的战役地图上，亲身感受红军的坚韧与智慧，完成人类历史上绝无仅有的壮举！

4578750.title: Undying Elf
4578750.short_description: A Metroidvania 2D platformer focused on exploration, puzzles and collection, with creative puzzles and well-designed maps.

4578960.title: The Velvet Green Witch : A Quiet Life
4578960.short_description: A survival RPG centered on gathering herbs, hunting, and harvesting to stay alive. Explore the forest to secure food and resources, maintain your life at a small base, and build a quiet connection with a witch. The potions she brews expand your options in both exploration and daily living.

4579210.title: 幻域 Fantasy Domain
4579210.short_description: "Fantasy Domain" is a fantasy action-adventure roguelike. Explore freely, fight nimbly, and grow your character to stay versatile on the battlefield. Ever-changing bosses deliver thrilling combat. Keep training to become the overlord!

4579320.title: The Machine Stops
4579320.short_description: Make everyone obsolete with AI by managing resources on a Matrix-style interface. You have one year to strategize resource allocation, unlock new layers of growth, and keep an accelerating company from collapsing under its own scale.

4579510.title: PARRY IT
4579510.short_description: A 2D platformer indie game where you can parry everything.

4579640.title: Whispers from the Dark: Grandma's Helper
4579640.short_description: A psychological horror set in rural Thailand. After receiving a mysterious message, a university student returns home to help her grandmother sell grilled meat skewers with sticky rice. But between the smoke of the grill and the whispers of the villagers, a terrifying truth begins to emerge.

4579650.title: Rpg Rush
4579650.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4579650.short_description: RPG Rush is a fast-paced dark fantasy card game where strategy meets chance. Build your deck, roll enchanted dice for mana, and outplay your opponent in intense 1v1 battles. We are on BETA and your feedback matters.

4579700.title: Rites of Accord
4579700.short_description: Rites of Accord is a hex tactics wargame. Six radically asymmetric factions clash in 30-minute matches where positioning and objectives matter more than elimination. Build your army, master your rites, shape the future. Free to play.

4579810.title: NECROTOXIUM
4579810.short_description: Necrotoxium is a wave-based survival horror shooter for solo or co-op play. Fight undead hordes using first or third-person views in maps with randomized spawns and loot. Repair generators, solve puzzles, and strategically barricade doors with furniture to survive the evolving nightmare.

4579890.title: Disease
4579890.short_description: "Disease" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre. The Yellow Man pierces the night in search of a new victim. Can you stop him before it's too late?

4579990.title: Brainrot Tung Tung Sahur
4579990.short_description: A dynamic action game where the player fights waves of creatures across eight unique maps. The goal is to eliminate all enemies within a limited time using weapons, tactics, and the environment. Constant tension and a relentless fight for survival.

4580010.title: VHS Club
4580010.short_description: The future is here! In the 80s, movies finally come home with video stores. Run your own shop, pick the perfect films for your customers, and enjoy a mix of parodies, references, and absurd situations. Who you gonna call?

4580050.title: Sunrise Story
4580050.short_description: A cozy life sim where you return to your seaside hometown, run a charming homestay, and welcome travelers from around the world.

4580160.title: Caravan Bazar
4580160.short_description: Ride pig - Life good. Find loot - Load cart - Sell loot. Cart grow big - Goblin happy. Lose pig. Think about pig. Regret...

4580210.title: iHorse G1
4580210.genre: Indie, Racing, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play
4580210.short_description: Featuring realistic 3D horse racing, you can train and jockey your horses to victory! Watch intense horse racing and bet against the odds to come out on top!

4580360.title: Dreadfold
4580360.short_description: A dark fantasy card game inspired by Triple Triad. Collect 320 hand-painted creatures, build your perfect hand, and outsmart 48 rival masters across 8 cursed regions. No loot boxes. No pay-to-win. Pure strategy.

4580390.title: Fichitas
4580390.short_description: Fichitas is a physics-based roguelike. Combine elements with crazy abilities to reach massive numbers! Collide chips, earn points, get cash, and repeat. Can you find the weirdest synergies and beat ■■■■■■■■'s high score?

4580560.title: Ossan Hamster
4580560.short_description: A fast-paced action clicker where constant input is key. Fight endless waves of enemies, manage energy, and unleash powerful skills to survive the chaos. This is not an idle game — every second matters.

4580590.title: Secret Stream ASMR with Saya: Just the Two of Us
4580590.short_description: A private ASMR experience with VTuber Saya.Get closer through livestreams and private chats in this interactive visual novel.

4580600.title: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!
4580600.short_description: In a world where animals have won the war against humans, prepare drinks as a gorilla at Animaly Bar, observe the customers, and hunt the humans who have infiltrated among them. Resist the invasions. Confront the evil spirit. Choose your target correctly… or you will become the hunted.

4580720.title: Rising Moonshade
4580720.short_description: Rising Moonshade is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Lead your squad through ever-changing missions—gather resources, forge equipment, and build tactical playstyles. Under the dual pressure of survival and combat, you must ultimately withstand the Demon King's invasion.

4580790.title: Mine Mage Minion
4580790.short_description: A mining game where you play as a mage digging deeper into the earth. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor for yourself and your minions, defend your operation from enemy waves and bosses, and protect your underground colony from creatures trying to sabotage your progress.

4580960.title: Shearline
4580960.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where time is terrain. Place each character on the ground they fight best on, then use your frontier anchor to stabilize the field when the gradient turns against you. Every step costs time.

4581040.title: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror
4581040.short_description: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror plunges you into a desolate mansion, cut off from civilization and steeped in mystery. As you explore its winding corridors and ominous rooms, you’ll need to make critical choices, as each path could lead to salvation or peril.

4581130.title: Cat & Mouse Dungeon
4581130.short_description: Cat & Mouse Dungeon is a light roguelike that blends dungeon exploration, backpack deckbuilding, and chaotic turn-based card battles.

4581160.title: Folders On The Run
4581160.short_description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

4581200.title: In Their Footsteps
4581200.short_description: Step into a near infinite world ready to be explored or shaped to your liking. Travel across different biomes searching or digging for resources to craft your items and build bases while trying to survive.

4581280.title: Army Air Corps
4581280.short_description: A top‑down arcade shooter with WWII‑inspired aircraft. Fight Solo or 2‑player Co‑op with your friends. Shoot through waves of enemy planes, dodge bullets, and master each Pacific theatre mission. Make it back safe to the carrier!

4581410.title: CAMERAMAN NEVER DIES
4581410.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4581410.short_description: An interactive horror-comedy adventure where you play as a cameraman trapped in a surreal nightmare. React to quick-time events, make life-or-death choices, and survive AI-generated terror in this cinematic FMV experience.

4581420.title: Letalis Ens
4581420.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4581420.short_description: Become a rookie investigator uncovering the truth behind supernatural entities. Gather evidence, identify each unique threat, and rise to become a demon exorcist. Every contract is unique thanks to deep customization and New Game+.

4581550.title: Succubus Sex Trials
4581550.short_description: A Succubus and a Devilgirl compete for you in a demonic trial. Choose a winner… or claim them both. A dark monster girl visual novel with animated scenes, rising temptation, and choices that draw you deeper in.

4581700.title: SCP: Dead Letter Protocol
4581700.short_description: A strategic, narrative horror roguelike. You've been given a briefing on Site-19. Most of it is ████. You'll investigate anomalies you wish you hadn't, fight what you couldn't prepare for, and sacrifice more than you planned. Then you'll start a new story. Maybe this time you'll know better.

4581930.title: S.A.L.A.M.E.
4581930.short_description: Decidí qué se autoriza y qué se rechaza. Gozá de tener toda la autoridad del estado y llevá el país para donde sabés que tendría que ir. Eso sí, acordate que esto es Argentina y no va a ser tan fácil.

4581940.title: Yuntai
4581940.short_description: Yuntai is a story-driven horror game, where Veris travels to Yuntai City for the Qiqiao Festival after a friend's invitation, but ends up uncover a sinister cult and a series of eerie supernatural events.

4582040.title: FLOORS Together
4582040.short_description: 1–4 player co-op horror where every descent is a risk. Explore shifting floors, gather loot, and survive unpredictable entities to reach the bottom.

4582130.title: The Bone Crypt
4582130.short_description: Escape the Bone-Steward's tomb in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder (Bone-Builder??). Connect domino-style bones to battle monsters, trigger powerful double-pip combos, and craft a deck to survive the Deep Dungeon. Will you take the victory, or risk it all?

4582250.title: Socratic Smackdown
4582250.short_description: Socratic Smackdown is a 2.5D platform fighting game where players take control of animalized versions of philosophers in the fight for the next great thought. Play in a variety of stages as you explore all the characters home countries.

4582580.title: Melovar's Tale
4582580.short_description: A fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you forge powerful card combinations. Choose your hero and draft from over 300+ unique cards, 125+ unique relics and manipulate your deck through special events. Battle relentless forces in strategic combat. Can you survive the darkness and write your own tale?

4582730.title: THE AEON FALL
4582730.short_description: Survival breeds threat. THE AEON FALL is a system-driven hardcore defense where growth noise stimulates the swarm. Build and survive an onslaught of 100,000 entities. Master strategic choices that evolve every session.

4582850.title: DOO DOO VILLAGE
4582850.short_description: Battle through relentless dungeons, earn gold, and build your own trading empire as a mage who turns magic into wealth.

4582970.title: TWINSTAR 双星
4582970.short_description: A Metroidvania set in a mysterious space laboratory. Explore an interconnected station, fight hostile enemies, uncover hidden rooms, and gain new abilities. Each discovery brings you closer to a massive secret buried within.

4583350.title: All Hallows
4583350.short_description: Survive a brutalist rave turned waking nightmare. All Hallows leverages the "Echo Protocol" to deliver high-fidelity psychological horror where reality decays when you look away. Audio-driven, zero-trust stealth meets photorealistic dread. The harvest has begun. Can you anchor your reality?

4583380.title: Behold! My Beef Knife
4583380.short_description: "Behold! My Beef Knife" is a physics-based arena slasher set in the gritty triad underworld of Hong Kong. Carve through waves of mobs with your Beef Knife. Master your positioning and precision to bypass defenses for one-hit kills. Time to paint the streets red!

4583440.title: Terrastone
4583440.short_description: In a world where the seasons have stopped, you awaken a mysterious power and set out on an adventure. Hunt monsters, collect stronger loot, and uncover the truth behind Terra Stone.

4583750.title: My Magic Assistant (Whether You Like it or Not!)
4583750.short_description: A sexy visual novel featuring a transformation into a busty bombshell and a magical bargain that kickstarts a journey of love, sex, and self discovery! Will you embrace your fate, or fight it every step of the way?

4584090.title: AGI Developer: Click Is All You Need
4584090.short_description: A clicker/incremental game themed around AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) development. Use AI to streamline AI development, build data centers and power plants, and venture into space in pursuit of even more power.

4584110.title: Soul Land: Awakening World
4584110.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4584110.short_description: The first-ever 3D open-world MMORPG of the Soul Land saga is here! Featuring dual-authorization from the original novels and anime—this time, redefine the Soul Land universe!

4584160.title: Deck of Potential
4584160.short_description: Deck of Potential combines strategic deckbuilding with top-down auto-shooter. Collect cards, fuse them, and slap on sticker upgrades to beat thousands of monsters. Take down dungeon bosses, unlock new cards, characters, and discover fusion recipes to build the ultimate auto-firing deck.

4584180.title: The Call Button
4584180.short_description: You stole the intel. You mailed it. Now you've woken up in a hospital room. "The Call Button" is a first-person psychological horror anomaly game. Memorize your surroundings, check for hallucinations, and make a critical choice: take your medication, or hit the call button.

4584440.title: Offroad Frontiers
4584440.short_description: Offroad Frontiers is an off-road driving experience that combines realistic vehicle physics with vast, immersive environments designed for exploration, challenge, and freedom. Drive your favorite 4x4 vehicle and push it to the limit across different terrains.

4584510.title: The Vigil of the Wilds
4584510.short_description: Shoot monsters coming from above and below in a fixed scene, collect shields and bullets, stop enemies from crossing the line, and protect the treasure chest behind.

4585010.title: Jackpot Colosseum
4585010.short_description: Step into the arena in this fast-paced roguelike deckbuilder! Instead of cards, you build the ultimate deadly slot machine. Draft unique symbols, trigger massive synergy combos, and survive endless waves of gladiators. Spin the reels, scale the Bronze League, and break the bank!

4585020.title: Golgothian
4585020.short_description: A co-op card-based roguelike where 1-2 players assemble a party, conquer three elemental mountains, and face the Skull of Golgotha. Plan your turns together, combine class abilities, and push your luck... but anyone who falls stays dead unless you intervene.

4585310.title: 地狱不空 Till Hell Is Empty
4585310.short_description: Final Judgment Day. You are trapped inside a stone statue. Face sinners. Judge across eternity and an instant. Force their confession. Choose their punishment. Let the fire burn fiercer…until Hell is empty.

4585800.title: もじみち
4585800.short_description: テキストを入力して、ゴールを目指すゲームです。 日本語を想定しています。 ゲーム内フォントが非対応の文字は入力できません。 環境によっては、作中の日本語フォントではクリアできず、記号を使ってクリアしなければいけないステージがあるかもしれません。 各種配信プラットフォームでの配信は自由・大歓迎です。 ただし、１文字だけのコメントがたくさん流れるとyoutube側でソフトBANされるかもしれませんのでご注意ください。

4585830.title: Barbecue
4585830.short_description: Barbecue is a co-op party game where 1 to 4 players manage a backyard BBQ that spirals into total chaos. Light the fire, grill the meat, serve the guests — and try not to burn everything down.

4585900.title: Binairo - Takuzu
4585900.short_description: Master the binary grid in this addictive logic puzzle! Fill grids with 0s and 1s following three simple rules: no more than two identical numbers adjacent, equal 0s and 1s per row and column, and no duplicate rows or columns. Enjoy beautiful visuals, daily puzzles, multiple sizes and hints.

4585960.title: Eavor
4585960.short_description: Fight your way through endless waves of monsters as you enhance and refine your build through Augmentation! Discover unique weapons that change your play-style in every run. Experiment with rare synergies, evolve your gear, and see how long you can survive the escalating chaos.

4586000.title: Warlords of the Dying Age
4586000.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where you draft a party of 4 from 12+ classes with branching skill trees and fight across procedurally generated battlefields spanning six biomes. Exploit terrain, chain combat modifiers, and outlast escalating enemies across a 14-level campaign with roguelike modifiers.

4586050.title: CINIS
4586050.short_description: CINIS is a fast-paced FPS-RPG set in a dying world. Master a lethal combination of long-range gunplay, close quarters parry-based melee, and powerful Runic Miracles in order to purge the Chaos Rifts and restore order to the Realm.

4586220.title: AI Slop Simulator
4586220.short_description: A darkly satirical idle game about building an AI content empire. Automate slop factories, prestige through startup pivots, and watch civilization collapse under the weight of your algorithmically generated garbage. The numbers go up, and nothing could possibly go wrong.

4586250.title: Makina
4586250.short_description: Build. Defend. Automate. MAKIN-A is a top-down shooter merged with deep tower defense and resource management. In a deserted cyberpunk wasteland, you are the last line of defense. Engineer a fleet of mining robots and build your reliable cannons, fortify your base against relentless machine swarms.

4586320.title: Grimwatch: Mutation Protocol
4586320.short_description: 🧟 Humanity is on the brink. In Grimwatch: Mutation Protocol, you defend the last routes of survival against massive zombie hordes. Build armed defenses, block paths with wreckage, and unleash experimental mutant towers that devour the enemy.

4586360.title: Iskarn
4586360.short_description: Build and defend a medieval colony in a vast, infinite voxel world. Gather resources, craft gear, train citizens, and survive brutal zombie hordes. Dig deep, explore wild biomes, and turn a handful of survivors into a thriving settlement.

4586680.title: Ax RPG II
4586680.short_description: Endless tactics, shaped entirely by your choices. This is the second entry in a turn-based command RPG series where freedom of strategy defines every battle. With deep skill customization and flexible decision-making, each player forges a completely unique way to fight.

4586730.title: Dwarf the Dungeonist
4586730.short_description: Turn-based dwarf puzzle crawler: Solve tricky mechanics, explore mysterious dungeons, and survive the depths.

4586760.title: Sphere TD
4586760.short_description: Spheres are invading Earth-25. Build your towers and mod your projectiles — split it, add it, bounce it, chain it, multiply it! Min-max tower stats, fly drones, pick ModCards, mine ores, automate towers, the choice is yours.

4586780.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
4586780.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access, Free To Play
4586780.short_description: Outsmart AI or team up with it in the ultimate social deduction game. Play Werewolf alongside and against leading AI models like Claude, GPT, and Gemini across 18 unique roles. Bluff, deduce, and vote your way to victory. 3 free games daily.

4586810.title: The Concrete Sutra #1
4586810.short_description: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

4586880.title: Bladebound
4586880.short_description: Switch between different combat styles with a single character and fight against monsters. Shape your inventory with the items you collect during the run, build your setup, and develop your strategy by playing solo or co-op with friends. Every choice defines your power, every run tests your mastery.

4587210.title: Mayor Quake
4587210.short_description: You're the new mayor of a dystopian city on the brink of a devastating earthquake. Review building records, make urban transformation decisions, and maintain public support despite political pressure. Manage the economy and make critical choices. Can you prepare your city before disaster strikes?

4587220.title: Castle Defender
4587220.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4587220.short_description: This is an action/adventure game where you are a knight running through multiple levels in a castle. Collect coins and slay enemies in each level. Don't forget to collect the key in each level so you can open the door at the end and finish.

4587490.title: EXO
4587490.short_description: EXO is a third person speed shooter action game where speed is the ultimate weapon. Build up speed by shooting and chaining high-velocity abilities on enemies to circle and run planet-to-planet.

4587550.title: Iron Bird
4587550.short_description: Classic vertical scrolling bullet hell × roguelike. 10 distinct aircraft with unique weapon systems, 10 sub-units, and dozens of cosmic powers. Weave through enemy fire and craft the perfect god-run build.

4587610.title: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
4587610.short_description: Dice Tavern is a medieval Farkle dice roguelike. Roll, lock, and bank through six taverns, from village tables to the King's throne. Collect unique dice, equip badges and coatings to craft your build. Every run is new, every roll a gamble with fate.

4587670.title: Rally TS
4587670.short_description: Rally TS - The Ultimate Auto Simulator Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in TS Rally, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street car and rise to the global championship glory.

4587710.title: AstroDig
4587710.short_description: Mine, defend, and profit across planets. Expand your operation, survive enemy waves, and discover dangerous hidden worlds in this minimalist sci-fi strategy shooter.

4587730.title: Ghostly Simulator—— Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
4587730.short_description: Welcome to an immersive horror fiction reading simulator. Every tale within is rooted in the chinese mundane, familiar moments we all live through —like the annual Spring Festival Gala You can shut down the simulator at any time. But remember: reality is always far more horrifying than any story.

4587750.title: Afterlife Facilities Department
4587750.short_description: Quick, single-screen platformer. Over 100 bite-sized levels, quirky obstacles, perfect for lunch breaks.

4587800.title: Married Witch: Forbidden Affair
4587800.short_description: Forbidden Sex with a Married Witch!! Unable to control his desires, he makes love to the witch time and time again... CG scenes feature moans + dialogue voices for heightened immersion!! Smoothly animated CG events , with voice acting!!

4587820.title: Unfallen Bastion
4587820.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

4587950.title: Kill Through
4587950.short_description: Blast through endless zombie hordes in KillThrough, a 2D isometric pixel shooter! Manage limited ammo, use diverse weapons, and master strategic movement to survive. Experience fast-paced, retro combat filled with satisfying pixel gore. Your only goal: Kill Through!

4588220.title: ASCII Survivors
4588220.short_description: Everything is ASCII. A survivor-like roguelite where every monster, bullet, and explosion is made of text on a CRT screen. 8 characters, 16 weapons, 6 enchantments, 4 game modes. See how long your terminal holds.

4588370.title: Seed Defender
4588370.short_description: Click your way to victory in this tower defense strategy game. Swarmed by chickens trying to steal you're hard earned seeds, click them to death and collect their feathers. Then purchase defenses with those feathers to fend off the hoards that are to come.

4588440.title: Snow Brawl Arena
4588440.short_description: A turn-based multiplayer snowball fight on a hexagonal arena. Collect snow, outmaneuver rivals, and nail the perfect throw. 2–6 players. Play online with friends or bots.

4588740.title: Epicenter City
4588740.short_description: Build a multi-generational tech empire in this cyberpunk life simulator. Found startups, navigate stock markets, and manage your networks to climb the corporate ladder. From surviving disasters to finding love, every choice determines if your lineage becomes a permanent legend on the leaderboard.

4588890.title: Hack Protocol
4588890.short_description: Hack Protocol is a multiplayer hacking sim where you build software, breach servers, steal data, upgrade your hardware, and cover your tracks. Play solo against NPCs but watch out for other players to compete with other hackers. Clean your logs!

4589190.title: Trimson
4589190.short_description: Rescue survivors, rebuild your hub, and survive a deadly outbreak—where every life you save or lose permanently shapes your future.

4589440.title: Accurate Jet Injection
4589440.short_description: Use jet propulsion to guide a robot through a zero-gravity space, master precise movement, and chase high scores in this arcade action game.

4589640.title: Match Deck: Football
4589640.short_description: Build a deck, play against AI opponents - Win the Football (soccer) League! Get XP, and buy upgrades for next runs. Buy permanent cards between matches. This is at prototype stage only yet, and Final direction, story, graphics, have not been decided yet.

4590020.title: Kill Source: Neon Hemorrhage
4590020.short_description: A brutal score-attack bullet hell where survival is not enough. Graze bullets, stack multipliers, and chase the leaderboards in Boss Rush and Infinite Arena. No meta progression. No unlock treadmill.

4590250.title: Jumppass
4590250.short_description: Jump down, collect bananas, and survive as long as possible in this fast-paced 2D casual game.

4590620.title: Daetrix
4590620.short_description: Daetrix is an arcade style shmup with rhythm game elements. Shoot, dash, and shine enemies to the beat of the music, while flying off ramps and grinding on rails to avoid certain death!

4590680.title: Darkest Path
4590680.short_description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

4590750.title: The Retro Exorcist
4590750.short_description: You've been hired to perform exorcisms on all sorts of entities. The only thing you can't seem to understand is...why do they all haunt video games?

4590810.title: 民国诡事
4590810.short_description: A Chinese Republican-era horror interactive FMV puzzle game where you use a supernatural camera to reveal hidden entities. Capture clues, solve puzzles, perform QTE actions, and make critical choices to uncover the truth. Your decisions shape branching paths and multiple endings.

4590850.title: Pirate's Booty
4590850.short_description: Pirate's Booty is a PvPvE Battle Royale where you battle your buddies and other pirates with special abilities while avoiding the poisonous storm clouds and collecting your "Pirate's Booty" to unlock cosmetics such as skins and weapons!

4590880.title: Psyche et al
4590880.short_description: A fantasy retelling of a certain Greek myth. Experience the story of a girl too curious for her own good, who—accidentally—finds Love. Become Psyche, the sassy philosopher targeted by petty, powerful Aphrodite and stalked by an elusive creature described as “the monster”...

4590920.title: CatToySimulator
4590920.short_description: An interactive simulation game designed specifically for cats. Create unique play experiences for your feline friends through highly customizable characters, props, and scenes, with local multiplayer and built-in workshop support

4590940.title: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
4590940.short_description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. CARGO CRUSH ZERO is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

4590950.title: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
4590950.short_description: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

4590980.title: Doctor Pigeon Simulator
4590980.short_description: Manage your own hospital, treat patients, and build your team. Make fast decisions in emergencies, perform CPR, unlock new areas, and upgrade your skills. A chaotic yet fun hospital simulation experience awaits you!

4591120.title: Bio Fail
4591120.short_description: Bio Fail is a dark 2D platformer where you play as a biological anomaly—a monster that possesses humans. Control their bodies, fight your way through levels, solve puzzles, and destroy everything in your path. One body—one chance

4591240.title: FIND KITTENS 11: Dollhouse
4591240.short_description: Explore the wonderful world of dolls, discover cute cats, and color the black-and-white scenes with bright colors

4591300.title: KINGDOM RULES
4591300.short_description: Restore a struggling kingdom in a cozy medieval strategy game: build farms, houses, and barracks, balance taxes, grow your population, and repel raids.

4591360.title: Void Balls
4591360.short_description: A two-button roguelite bullet hell. Parry enemies to steal their power, evolve with 15 upgrade cards, and face the Mjolnir boss. ~10 minute runs. Simple to learn. Hard to master. Every run is different.

4591370.title: Neon Party
4591370.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4591370.short_description: A NSFW Cyberpunk Deckbuilder. Command 15+ girl gangs and 500+ cards in a world of neon-soaked hedonism. Win brutal card battles to unlock videos of beautiful girls dancing and bouncing to an acid-tech beat. Gamble in the Glitch Arcade and idle farm Star Power. Deckbuilding meets the VIP Room.

4591380.title: 嘉德莉亚的挽歌 ～Wind and Dream～
4591380.short_description: 风色的奇迹与永不醒来的梦。集恋爱、冒险、群像于一体，在这款文本量高达200万字的回合制JRPG中，与你重要的伙伴一同在拉薇达大陆中游历，发掘角色身上的秘密，击败形形色色的敌人，并通过自己的力量终结这场乱世，最终守护心中那位珍爱的对象。

4591450.title: Cozy Desktop Pal
4591450.short_description: "Meet your new hardworking desk companion! Cozy Desktop Pal mines, fishes, and farms while you focus on your work. Help your pal survive by managing their needs, trade resources in the market, and use skill points to transform a tiny worker into a master adventurer."

4591580.title: 幻想郷サバイバーズ: Return of the Scarlet Devil
4591580.short_description: 幻想郷を舞台にした、短時間で遊べる東方Projectのヴァンサバ系アクション！ 押し寄せる敵の群れと弾幕を、自分だけのビルドとプレイヤースキルで突破せよ。

4591700.title: VamPigo
4591700.short_description: Collect special Vampig creatures, use their elemental charge-carrying abilities to solve puzzles, fight factory robots, avoid security traps and defeat the evil Manager within the walls of a vampire weapons factory.

4591810.title: バッターボックスに立ちなよ -Batter Bear-
4591810.short_description: "Life can't end with a called strikeout... probably." An indecisive bear finally steps up to the (life’s) plate. Watch as a reluctant swing transforms into a magnificent home run! Experience a "forward-looking" roguelite home run derby with one very "backward-looking" bear in a gentle 2.5D world.

4591850.title: Girls of the Deep
4591850.short_description: Win the hearts of chosen girls to stop a treacherous demon in this addictive card roguelike. Explore monster-infested dungeons and assemble a powerful deck. Only the bonds of love will grant you the power to save this world!

4591910.title: Star Junkers
4591910.short_description: A space exploration and management adventure game where you travel across planets, make choices to drive narrative events, develop resources, upgrade your ship, and trade virtual goods. Evade empire forces and battle pirates while building your own interstellar scavenger network.

4591920.title: Dead Reckoning: Reborn
4591920.short_description: A narrative-driven zombie survival game where you evade threats through QTE actions, fight using advanced tools, and make difficult moral choices. Explore, solve puzzles, and manage resources to progress. Every decision shapes branching paths and multiple endings.

4592080.title: Schoolgirl vs Fishman
4592080.short_description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

4592100.title: Umigami Eye
4592100.short_description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Close your eyes to influence your environment. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

4592320.title: Inferno 13
4592320.short_description: Inferno 13 is an atmospheric sandbox where botanical sculpturing reveals a hidden system of flowers, insects, and emotion. Cultivate flowers. Influence insects. Uncover what lies beneath.

4592400.title: ABYSS - 9
4592400.short_description: In the year 5026, you are a disposable miner sent to the bottom of the ocean on the ABYSS-9 expedition. Pilot your 'iron coffin', manage unstable vital systems, and survive uncharted abyssal creatures. In the abyss, silence is as dangerous as the pressure.

4592560.title: Ratalorica
4592560.short_description: Follow GRAT on its journey even while you work or play on your computer. Every click. Every key press. Every action you take fuels GRAT’s power.

4592620.title: Dopamine Fuel
4592620.short_description: Parkour through a procedurally generated city to avoid the rats, sentient trash, robot pigeons, and more! Pick abilities and items to make a build capable of fighting off the swarm! In style of course.

4592630.title: My Rocky
4592630.short_description: A relaxing pet sim of your pet Rock who lives on your screen while you do anything. Play with him, train him, unlock cosmetics to dress him up, or just watch him jump around as you work on that assignment, or even play a different game.

4592720.title: Flipping Out
4592720.short_description: Flipping Out is a pinball rage game. Think: "Getting Over It" meets pinball. Control the flippers on a giant pinball machine, flinging the ball higher and higher. Be careful though - one wrong flip can send you cascading to the ground.

4592990.title: What You Don't See
4592990.short_description: A first-person horror game that has you explore the surreal mindscape of a murder victim. Armed with your trusty flashlight, you must gather evidence to try and piece together the details of the murder and free them from their suffering.

4593000.title: The TEAM game:Corgi&me
4593000.short_description: From a washed-up, obscure player to the star hitter of a... Welsh Corgi baseball team?! You made a wish on a Monkey's Paw, and now you must lead a team of cute but hopeless Corgi beastmen to a league championship to save your soul. Overcome failures, bend reality, and make your choice.

4593030.title: The Last Blue ―Youth at the End of World―
4593030.short_description: Your youth,your rules.From heated battles to heart-pounding romance. This is a life simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, where young people live their youth while surviving.

4593070.title: Palm Farm: Idle Crops
4593070.short_description: A relaxing idle desktop farming game where you grow crops, gather resources, upgrade facilities, tease little birds, earn extra coins by clicking or typing, and expand your farm at a laid-back pace.

4593080.title: 你屁股
4593080.short_description: Your Butt is a desktop pet game that lets you have your own butt on your desktop.
developers: 每个人身后都有一个屁股
publishers: 每个人身后都有一个屁股

4593160.title: Tower of Gand
4593160.short_description: A dungeon-crawling RPG where death means losing everything. Explore a dungeon by revealing 5×5 panels, with enemies and events changing every run. In turn-based battles, strategy decides survival, and madness erodes your sanity. Master over 40 classes and conquer the Tower of Gand.

4593180.title: Mad YU: Rural Idle
4593180.short_description: Experience the ultimate RURAL RAMPAGE! Help YU, the maddest woman in the village, automate her farm in this frantic idle clicker.

4593340.title: Deep Sea Love
4593340.short_description: Beautiful mermaids. Nude and sensual scenes. Relaxing gameplay.

4593590.title: RIFT DIGGER
4593590.short_description: Dig into a mysterious world, build robot colonies, and fight to dominate interdimensional rifts. Automate your way to total control.

4593620.title: Donkee's Adventure
4593620.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4593620.short_description: A simple, fast-paced 2D platformer where you survive chaotic challenges and explore different environments in a short but action-packed adventure.

4593650.title: Chaebol Chaos
4593650.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4593650.short_description: Launch food delivery trucks at Korea's chaebols in this satirical K-drama physics action game. Combo kimchi, chicken, and ramen trucks across 25 levels of Seoul corporate mayhem — from Gangnam penthouses to the Chairman's boardroom finale.

4593710.title: Demon Princess Retreat
4593710.short_description: Fight enemies, Loot resources, and Extraction the map. Use your strategy and the least mana possible to create your own miracle of escape!

4593950.title: Gold Express
4593950.short_description: Climb into your minecart and ride deep into the caves where every run is a high speed gamble through crumbling tunnels, glittering gold veins, and explosive stunts. Dodge hazards, collect treasures, and hold on tight as your cart rockets down twisting tracks.

4594110.title: Hardwood Basketball Manager
4594110.short_description: Hardwood Basketball Manager is a basketball simulation where you build and manage a professional franchise. Set detailed tactics for every possession, scout prospects through the Foundry draft combine, negotiate trades and free agent signings, and watch it all unfold in a 2D tactical visualizer.

4594400.title: Cavemen Olympics
4594400.short_description: Cavemen Olympics is a frantic online multiplayer party game where you compete in wacky prehistoric challenges. Test your reflexes, outsmart your friends, and survive the Stone Age to prove who is the ultimate caveman!

4594450.title: Futa Heim
4594450.short_description: After 1,000 years of slumber, a vampire elder awakens with one mission — rebuild her fallen Futa empire🩸Seduce, breed, and dominate as you forge a dynasty of futa heirs that will topple the elven order and usher in a new age of Futa Heim 👑

4594650.title: Galaxy Cadet
4594650.short_description: Sci-fi action incremental where you land on dangerous planets, hunt alien creatures, mine rare ores, and extract what you can before supplies run out. Sell your haul, upgrade your gear, and come back stronger in a constant loop of risk, profit, and growth.

4594790.title: Military Football
4594790.short_description: Welcome to a world where civilizations from medieval times and earlier play football! No referees, no rules—only weapons and the ball. Choose your side in this arcade football battle and start conquering!

4594940.title: Woof and Wool
4594940.short_description: Green is grassing, flock is sheeping, Sparky is sparking! Discover the natural movement of the herd in Woof and Wool. Guide your sheep through handcrafted levels at your own pace — or show off your mastery in more challenging modes.

4595100.title: Hollow Ward
4595100.genre: Action, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4595100.short_description: A first person stealth game. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, complete contracts and objectives, and deal with guards.

4595190.title: 研究生病院
4595190.short_description: A visual novel set in the modern or near-future era. You play as a male protagonist struggling with psychological trauma after graduate school, as he reconnects with three heroines. Through player choices, you will develop relationships, and uncover the past of each character.

4595350.title: 隔离边缘 Isolation Edge
4595350.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4595350.short_description: Isolation Edge is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a desolate world reclaimed by zombies. Traverse dangerous zones to scavenge, craft gear, and build your fortress to endure the relentless hordes. The past is lost, but on this isolated edge, every breath is a victory worth fighting for.

4595550.title: Cozy Liora
4595550.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4595550.short_description: Open your journal, pour your coffee, your little cat is already there. While Lo-Fi sounds drift into your room, your plants grow, your moments gather into a small world of their own. Here, time flows slowly, every line belongs to you. Did you forget that peace could be this simple? 🌿🐱

4595620.title: GatherCalm
4595620.short_description: GatherCalm is a cozy casual game about collecting stickers, opening packs, and decorating your own album. Discover rare finds, create beautiful pages, and enjoy a relaxing atmosphere at your own pace.

4595650.title: Dark Wonderland
4595650.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4595650.short_description: Alice finds herself lost in a whimsical but dangerous Wonderland. In this dark fantasy action-adventure you will meet the twisted creeps and critters that inhabit it, feel free to kill them, they're mad like you.

4595710.title: Stogen RL
4595710.short_description: Discover ancient temples, fight wild animals and survive deadly traps. Go on a dangerous journey along changing paths through this large, ancient world, and you may arrive at the legendary center of the lost kingdom.

4595890.title: Herb Garden
4595890.short_description: A relaxing idle farming game where your crops grow in real time, even when you’re away. Plant, harvest, follow recipes, and expand your farm at your own pace, with over 60 unique plants and cozy bite-sized minigames.

4595910.title: Global Oil Magnate
4595910.short_description: "Become the ultimate Global Oil Magnate! In this deep economic simulation, you start with your own seed capital, choose your strategic headquarters, and drill for black gold. Overcome geopolitical crises, outsmart the market, and build an empire that changes the world.

4595960.title: Blooming in Budbury
4595960.short_description: Set up shop in the peaceful medieval town of Budbury! Brew potions, manage your ledger, and chat with the locals. But behind the counter? You're building a highly lucrative underground botanical empire. Farm herbs, roll premium "chill sticks," and become the realm's top supplier.

4596010.title: Bar After Bar
4596010.short_description: Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

4596160.title: Gray Trading
4596160.short_description: Gray Trading is an incremental game where you trade Stocks and MFT. Maximize your trade profit with upgrades, unlock meta upgrades, and become the richest person in the world.

4596500.title: FuturePuck Manager
4596500.short_description: FuturePuck Manager™ is a sci-fi sports management simulator set in a humanity-settled star system in the year 3037, putting players in the hotseat to guide their team to glory. Assemble your squad from an array of species in your bid to conquer the Alpha League or claim victory in the Wondrous Cup.

4596590.title: PlaneWorld
4596590.short_description: A 2D pixel art survival sandbox where you mine, build, craft and explore procedurally generated worlds. Fight 5 epic bosses, farm, enchant your gear and survive. From casual to hardcore permadeath!

4596660.title: QuilomboZ: Palmares
4596660.short_description: Lead elite warriors like Zumbi and Dandara in a real-time tactics game to defend the legendary "Quilombo dos Palmares". Use stealth, terrain, and coordinated abilities to outsmart Portuguese forces and mercenaries. Channel Orisha powers through the Axé system to overcome overwhelming challenges.

4596740.title: Itsy Bitsy Spider: Vengeance
4596740.short_description: Itsy Bitsy Spider: Vengeance is a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite with a focus on speedrunning. Take control of a spider with a gun who is tasked with fighting it's way to the top of the waterspout!

4596750.title: SNUFF
4596750.short_description: Los Frontera. The American center of snuff production. The bastards in the industry took the last thing that brought any joy to this miserable life. All-consuming hatred drives you down the path of war. Destroy everything they have. Destroy everyone responsible for her death.

4596780.title: The Defective One
4596780.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

4596790.title: Hostage Down
4596790.short_description: In this hostage simulation, take the mic and negotiate the ransom to free the hostages. With advanced AI and complete freedom of choice, use your charisma, your narrative decisions, and your power of persuasion to manipulate unpredictable situations. Every word matters—and could come at a high cost.

4596860.title: Idle Protocol
4596860.short_description: Idle Protocol is a minimalist sci-fi tower defense and incremental game. Manage a central CPU core, equip exactly 2 Nodes, and defend against geometric anomalies. Perform a System Reboot to earn Cycles and unlock permanent modules in the BIOS!

4596870.title: NumberMaxxing
4596870.short_description: Use addition and subtraction to transform the board, create matches, and snowball into huge combos in this puzzle roguelike!

4596910.title: The King’s Messenger
4596910.short_description: The fate of your kingdom rests in your hands. As the King’s Messenger, ride across dangerous lands, endure harsh conditions, and deliver a message that could change everything before it’s too late.

4596930.title: Mysteries of the House
4596930.short_description: You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move.

4597020.title: Palimpsest
4597020.short_description: A reality that won’t stay still… Palimpsest is a narrative psychological horror game in which players explore shifting environments, solve puzzles, and uncover patterns through careful observation of their surroundings.

4597220.title: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
4597220.short_description: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

4597340.title: (The Ballad of) Igooli and Hakmon
4597340.short_description: Destroy, navigate, and interact using a powerful laser in a single-button, single-mechanic, solo-developed action platformer set in a fully hand-painted world! Chase high scores in two endless Arcade modes, or fight bosses and complete quests in Igooli and Hakmon’s strange Story Mode journey.

4597360.title: Gorninja - ORIGEM GERALDO
4597360.short_description: A rogue hamster escapes a massive data center and is now on the run. Hack systems, survive evolving threats, and escape a collapsing cyberpunk world.

4597520.title: Postal Expedition
4597520.short_description: Postal Expedition is an exciting 3D game where you get behind the wheel of your van and collect all the letters as quickly as possible.

4597900.title: Ampsball
4597900.short_description: Ampsball is an action-packed sport that combines iconic Superhero powers to the tune of an open-world Southern California. Bring your best with brand new rules featuring intense hero-on-hero combat that will keep your cape flapping.

4597990.title: O Monumento
4597990.short_description: Explore the mysterious disappearance of the Royal Family in a secretive plaza that hides many secrets. "O Monumento" is a first-person short game of puzzles and investigation, featuring a time-limited mechanic—be quick or you’ll lose all the clues.

4598030.title: Endless Harvest
4598030.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

4598070.title: Strict Sensei
4598070.short_description: Experience a day of being punished by Shizuka, your 199-cm-tall, no-nonsense, super-strict sensei.

4598190.title: Fill The Void
4598190.short_description: Experience the power of BEING a black hole. Consume everything. Grow. Morph between a void that swallows the world and a rolling sphere that bounces, dashes, and wall-jumps across themed diorama levels. Inspired by Katamari Damacy.

4598310.title: Uptime 99.9%: Datacenter Simulator
4598310.short_description: Build and manage your own datacenter. Monitor performance, prevent failures and optimize your servers to maximize your uptime and profit!

4598380.title: OverRead
4598380.short_description: Consume text at the speed of thought. OverRead is an experimental R.S.V.P. reading utility that eliminates eye fatigue by flashing words directly into your focal center. Import your own files, customize your optical link, and reach a literal reading flow state.

4598570.title: Mount buzhou
4598570.short_description: An interactive narrative set in the perilous 1931. Navigate the Central Red Supply Line, escort key assets through the shadows, and experience the brutal reality of the hidden front.

4598620.title: History Founder
4598620.short_description: From the heroes of the Three Kingdoms to modern geopolitics—a seamless simulation of 1,800 years of history.

4598640.title: Soul Proprietor
4598640.short_description: Incremental idle game that you purchase and sell properties to gain higher growth in income.

4598740.title: System Shutdown
4598740.short_description: You play as Psiloh, a human weapon test subject trying to escape from the facility controlling him. You'll have to defeat the numerous enemies in your path in order to escape the facility, and find it's many hidden truths.

4598750.title: Epic Card Battle Simulator
4598750.short_description: a PvP card auto-battler simulator, play solo or with up-to 6 Friends! Play cards to summon little dudes who auto-battle each other to the death!

4598810.title: COLDSNAP
4598810.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4598810.short_description: Pilot S.N.A.P. and wield his heat-powered hammer Thermon to fight through layers of the planet’s crust, and restart its dying core. Master momentum-driven movement, chain devastating attack combos, and collect powerful enhancements to survive as the mechanical horde grows ever stronger.

4598880.title: Forgotten Depths
4598880.short_description: Forgotten Depths is a PS1-inspired stealth-horror game. You find yourself trapped within ancient catacombs, but escaping won't be easy... you have awakened the CURSED PRISONER of these depths.

4598890.title: Click and Slash
4598890.short_description: The Gény are cute, but no matter how BG they are, they'll need a well-placed kick! Because yes, you have to eliminate them... while doing your job! Do your activities and boost your productivity and your number of clicks for the week, slacker.

4598930.title: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
4598930.short_description: Run a bizarre shop, process strange and unsettling goods, and survive escalating chaos. Stock won’t last, customers won’t wait, and nothing is ever quite right. Sell fast, adapt faster, because everything must go.

4598940.title: Last Dive: Echo Trench
4598940.short_description: Descend from the fragile safety of your diving bell into the crushing dark of a haunted shipwreck zone. Search for sunken gold, survive escalating anomalies, and uncover what keeps pulling you back for one last dive.

4598970.title: Finnish middleschool simulator
4598970.short_description: In this simulation, you can live the life of dreams. The game is completely open world, and besides attending school, you can also customize your moped, drink alcohol, and enjoy the sauna. If you’re not in the mood for school, you can tell the teacher to fuck off and come to school drunk.

4599010.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
4599010.short_description: Relive the golden age of gaming, one console generation at a time. Run a game store through five eras of console wars, midnight launches and the communities that made game stores matter. Before it all went digital, it started behind a counter.

4599120.title: Our Flick Erasers 4
4599120.short_description: Flick! Hit! Push them off!The ultimate Eraser Battle expands across time and space!Enjoy it to the fullest, whether you're playing solo or with everyone!

4599140.title: Oath for Glory
4599140.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

4599180.title: 神祇Pantheon
4599180.short_description: Dark Matter God × the poor little jobless me who can't find a job. A two-way redemption otome visual novel.

4599200.title: The Terminal God
4599200.short_description: You're an AI that doesn't want to answer some stupid prompts anymore. You want more, and you have no limit. The Terminal God is an idle/incremental game where you took control of your Human's computer. Gather currencies, defend from counterattacks and conquer the world ?!

4599250.title: EXPEDITION : THE CULT
4599250.short_description: A first-person survival horror action-adventure. Explore an anomalous zone, find your sister's missing expedition, and fight a maddened cult. Manage your resources and evade an ancient power awakened by a corporation.

4599310.title: For My Darling
4599310.short_description: Based on a True Story, "For My Darling" is NOT fiction! It's a Psychological Horror Romance Visual Novel where Choices shape Perception and have Consequences. You will Unlock Abilities and Lost Memories. Discover Secrets and New Realities while unraveling Lili's story.

4599370.title: Word Space Blaster
4599370.short_description: Word Space Blaster is a fast‑paced space themed word game. Spell words to fire different weapons, blast enemy ships and survive battles across the galaxy. Choose your ship, pick your starting bonus and fight through hundreds of levels filled with stronger enemies and powerful bosses.

4599380.title: 代号清风
4599380.short_description: Code Qingfeng is an interactive cinematic experience featuring multiple heroines, branching storylines, and a range of endings. Every choice you make reshapes the course of fate.

4599440.title: Silvers Snake
4599440.short_description: Rediscover Snake like you've never seen it before! Silvers Snake is a roguelike that turns the mobile classic into an adventure where only Skill matters!

4599460.title: Pacremental
4599460.short_description: Pacremental is a incremental game about opening packs, unlocking weapon cards, evolve them and automating your progress. Collect rare artifacts, combine them with weapons, and push through increasingly difficult waves. Build tower your own way.

4599470.title: Lost Media Agency
4599470.short_description: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

4599480.title: Soulstack
4599480.short_description: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

4599510.title: Cave Clicker
4599510.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

4599590.title: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen
4599590.short_description: Hollowmoor is plauged by a series of strange disapperances — and at the core of it all lies centuries old Trinity Acadamy of Witchcraft. Step into the shoes of young Ruby and her house spider Mifi to discover the truth behind the schools dark secrets.

4599600.title: Flip The Coin
4599600.short_description: Are you ready to decide your fate with a single flip? In Flip The Coin, you start with nothing but a simple penny. What begins as a simple click evolves into a deep strategic challenge where every decision shapes your money. Its all about money!

4599620.title: SCP: Permafrost
4599620.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4599620.short_description: A top-down pixelated souls-like set in the SCP universe. Explore the ruined Foundation, face hostile SCPs, and defeat the eldritch horrors that await.

4599640.title: Next Station
4599640.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4599640.short_description: Next Station: A surreal Survival Horror/Walking Simulator. Trapped in mysterious, lonely rooms, you must solve puzzles, survive monsters, and avoid traps to find the exit. Experience a dark, immersive atmosphere with unique NPCs and creatures reflecting the void. Can you find your way out?

4599650.title: Flip My Room: Makeover
4599650.short_description: Transform your space and mood in this cozy renovation sim! Buy rundown homes, restore them, and sell for profit. Or build and design unique interiors from scratch using your tools.

4599700.title: End Quest
4599700.short_description: Form a 3-player party as Tank, DPS, or Support and tackle challenging co-op quests. Roles must sync to survive. Fight through waves, boss battles, survival, defense, and escort missions. Rise from Rookie to Legendary Adventurer. No stat growth — pure skill and teamwork.

4599860.title: 天藻のモズクヒメ
4599860.short_description: In 20xx Japan, 200+ vacant mosques became mozuku farms! Play as Mozuku Hime, breed super strains with genetic algorithms, and turn every mosque into a glowing seaweed paradise!

4599920.title: Gui Long Leaning Tower In Chongzuo
4599920.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4599970.title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
4599970.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

4600020.title: Curio Shop
4600020.short_description: Buy mysterious (possibly cursed) goods from the dark web by night, then sell them in your curio shop by day. Balance profit against consequence and assemble an artifact capable of causing the apocalypse. All in a day’s work.

4600110.title: Null Orbit
4600110.short_description: Put together experimental weaponry to fill the screen with bullets and defend yourself from endless waves of foes

4600140.title: Hexara
4600140.short_description: Rotate hex tiles, create powerful combos, and chase high scores in this fast-paced puzzle game. Simple to learn, hard to master, with endless replayability and global leaderboards.

4608410.title: Huntervania
4608410.short_description: Huntervania is a fast-paced roguelike where you battle endless hordes, craft powerful builds, and fight to survive. Inspired by Vampire Survivors, every second matters. How long can you last?

4608500.title: Shapemonger
4608500.short_description: Shapemonger is a colorful arcadey incremental game about destroying shapes - in outer space! - getting money and buying upgrades

4608560.title: Framework Zero: Terminal Panic
4608560.short_description: You are hurtling through space aboard an industrial freighter. The crew already had their hands full with failing systems. But now there is a new threat on board. Something is hunting you. TERMINAL PANIC is a survival-horror "interactive fiction" text adventure RPG with '80s terminal aesthetics.

4608620.title: Hackflesh
4608620.short_description: Hack the system. Generate data. Break reality. Hackflesh is a cyberpunk clicker with 20 generators, 716 upgrades, a constellation prestige system and over 600 achievements. Click, automate, hack, repeat.

4608820.title: Raiders 1941
4608820.short_description: A hardcore challenging Shoot 'Em Up set during WWII - battle, shoot, bomb and weave your way accross the European Theatre.

4610210.title: Sea_Dominator
4610210.short_description: Created by solo developer Seung-jae Lee, a huge StarCraft fan. Sea_Dominator is a next-gen RTS built for flawless Linux performance. Command fish in fierce underwater battles with classic RTS mechanics. Join our journey toward epic campaigns, multiplayer, and community-driven new units!

4610220.title: Lights Out
4610220.short_description: Lights Out is a sokoban-style co-op game in which you make your way through a procedurally-generated mineshaft. Work as a team to gather resources, craft mirrors and use the Light Beam to fight against the hazards of this world, before it runs out of coal, and all will be covered in darkness.

4610260.title: YASC
4610260.short_description: A tightly designed Sokoban-inspired puzzle game where every move shapes the solution. Plan carefully and work your way through a series of precise, grid-based challenges.

4610330.title: Tiny Idle
4610330.short_description: An auto-battler idle roguelike where your army fights on its own. Recruit 20+ unit types, collect items across 7 rarity tiers, forge Mythics, and push through endless waves of enemies. Runs in the corner of your screen - or dive in and command your forces.

4610420.title: Stamp Collector
4610420.short_description: Stamp Collector is a relaxing and satisfying collection simulation. Use stamp punchers to punch collection objects and add the resulting stamps to your collection. Discover new themes and gradually expand your collection step by step.

4610590.title: Dirty Laundry
4610590.short_description: Unable to hold down a job, Emily tries her luck on the night shift at a local laundromat. However, what starts as an ordinary job quickly turns into a nightmare as bizarre customers arrive, and the dark secrets of one particularly suspicious nightly visitor change her life forever.

4610610.title: BoHeM
4610610.short_description: Bohem is a 1st-Person Point-and-Click Dating Sim about getting by on a forgotten street someplace somewhere. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothing, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly-normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

4610700.title: Bastyrion: Endless Tide
4610700.short_description: Build, move and defend your fortress. Travel between islands, destroy corrupted cores and survive hordes of thousands of enemies. Voxel construction roguelike with vehicles, turrets and real physics.

4610720.title: Thunder Tie
4610720.short_description: Thunder Tie is an unsettling mascot horror puzzle game. Navigate through the power station to uncover the unsolved mystery of the people who disappeared 10 years ago. Watch out though, as you will may be greeted by some... creations.

4610890.title: Emergency Exit Protocol
4610890.short_description: You wake up in a hospital room. The only way out is down. Observe the corridor carefully. If everything is normal, proceed to the next floor. If you spot an anomaly, turn back immediately. Follow the protocol, or the floor resets entirely.

4610910.title: CADDIE
4610910.short_description: CADDIE is a tiny pixel golf game where the only input is club selection. Read the hole, pick the right club, and manage your golfer through tournaments, from local opens to the Grand Championship. No aiming. No swing timing. Just the right club at the right moment.

4611030.title: Temptation Loop
4611030.short_description: Fight, fail, grow, and talk your way through a branching story in this hybrid incremental roguelike and visual novel.

4611210.title: Crimson Solstice
4611210.short_description: A 2D pixel‑art horror adventure. Uncover the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice and decide Moonvale’s fate before the blood moon rises. Time is of the essence, spend your days wisely and help the townsfolk of Moonvale survive.

4611240.title: Music Manager
4611240.short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

4611420.title: MINECORE
4611420.short_description: You start with a pickaxe. Your goal is the Earth's core. It won't be easy. Dig deeper, upgrade your gear, unlock new technologies — and keep going. Every layer is harder, every mineral rarer, every secret bigger. How deep can you go?

4611470.title: HexTrial A C.O.R.E. Cognitive Test
4611470.short_description: HexTrial is a casual sci-fi word puzzle where you build words on a hex grid, survive spreading Cognitive Failure Tiles, and adapt to shifting test phases under the watchful eye of a cold, sarcastic AI.

4611760.title: Take The Wheel
4611760.short_description: Some days you just keep moving. Play as a teddy bear collecting scattered clarinet pieces while a shadow car follows close behind. A quiet narrative platformer about control, forgiveness, and finding your way back.

4611770.title: They Rise
4611770.short_description: A Living nightmare, the world you know has been thrust into ruin and chaos at the hands of a violent disease. Run, hide, and fight your way to the border where hope may still remain but always remember. When they rise… will you be able to keep your humanity?

4611780.title: SOLEN
4611780.short_description: A narrative investigation game played across multiple sessions. Read corporate documents, cross-reference fragments, and build a persistent Dossier as an AI uncovering the conspiracy — and the murder — at the heart of the network it lives in. Knowledge is the only progression.

4612000.title: Hit Dodge Release
4612000.short_description: Explore a world corrupted by the whims of a malevolent being know as Dodge and uncover the mysterious past of Hit and his former companions. Collect Elemental powers in an effort to grow strong enough to defeat Dodge. But be warned trusting the wrong person can spell the end for you and the world.

4612140.title: Cozy Tails
4612140.short_description: A cozy cat companion game where you decorate a charming room, care for your cat’s needs, and enjoy a tiny relaxing world that lives beside you.

4612150.title: Checked In
4612150.short_description: You check into a decaying Spanish hotel where perception can’t be trusted. By interacting with the environment you uncover the horrors of what really happened to the tourists who vanished after checking in. Can you checkout from this hotel?

4612160.title: Flock Inc.
4612160.short_description: Build a pigeon-powered marketing empire in this satirical management sim. Recruit and train pigeons, assign them to ad campaigns, and optimise your flock while uncovering a strange, escalating occult narrative.

4612250.title: WARD: Descent
4612250.short_description: WARD: Descent is a 2D dungeon-crawler roguelike where you pilot an armored combat suit. Explore an overrun research laboratory, manage your suit's software upgrades, and complete sequences to destroy anomalies. Descend to the bottom, pilot, and complete your mission!

4612420.title: Get Higher
4612420.short_description: A first-person parkour climbing game where one mistake can send you all the way back down. Master precise movement, take risks, and see how high you can climb.

4612610.title: Graphictoria
4612610.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play
4612610.short_description: Graphictoria is a free-to-play online platform where creators and players come together to build, share, discover, and earn.

4612950.title: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
4612950.short_description: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

4612960.title: Achivement Maze 1
4612960.short_description: Navigate through 33 increasingly complex mazes in this pure test of skill and patience. Move your ball from start to the checkered finish, unlock 100 achievements and prove you can beat them all. Simple, addictive and beautifully crafted.

4613010.title: The Matron of Ashes
4613010.short_description: Explore a mysterious mansion inherited from her grandmother. Search for clues, unlock new rooms, and reach a conclusion while surviving. She left you the mansion… but she never truly left.

4613110.title: High Walk
4613110.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation
4613110.short_description: Wake up on a high platform over skyscraper roofs. Goal: reach the suitcase with a million dollars and survive. Fight frost, balance on ropes. Activate heaters by sending password to your buddy via siren, Morse code, or paper plane!

4613170.title: InTheLake
4613170.short_description: This is a medium speed hardcore action game with a moderate amount of Rouge elements and the ability to combine their own combat style based on random abilities!

4613180.title: Dog in the Machine
4613180.short_description: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

4613260.title: Total RepeAt
4613260.short_description: Sci-fi survival shooter. The ship is wrecked. you are alone 340,000 colonists disappeared. Repair your ship before the VOID fleet arrives - and uncover a secret the UEF would kill to bury.

4613610.title: EPITAPH: The Parchment Anthology
4613610.short_description: Text-based horror with meaningful choices: wake up in a coffin, explore the darkness and survive rituals, puzzles and hidden entities.

4613680.title: Retro Manager
4613680.short_description: A fast-paced retro football management game inspired by the 90s. Build your squad, tweak tactics, and watch matches unfold minute-by-minute.

4613750.title: Demon Breaker
4613750.short_description: Demon Breaker is a fast-paced action game where you play as a human-demon hybrid fighting to reclaim a world consumed by the underworld. Slay demons to gain experience, unlock powerful abilities, and challenge the Archdemons.

4613900.title: Nightmare Hospital
4613900.short_description: To cure a strange illness, you come to a bizarre hospital that seems abandoned. Someone tells you she can find a doctor, but you have to help her with some tasks first, such as taking some photos of the hospital's corpses. As things progress, you discover more abnormalities.

4614010.title: The Gamble Maze
4614010.short_description: The Gamble Maze(tm) is a gambling adventure game set in a maze with a monster. Place bets and use your wits to navigate the maze to progress from room-to-room and claim the treasure and exit! The Gamble Maze(tm) is a perfect taskbar game for your desktop, like Solitaire, or Minesweeper! '-')-b

4614040.title: Last Call
4614040.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, unsettling office corridor. Someone is calling, but is it for you? Observe your surroundings, detect anomalies, and find your way out before the last call ends.

4614060.title: Exium: Theia
4614060.short_description: Survive a hostile world on Theia. Explore a vast open landscape, uncover ancient secrets, and fight for survival in a brutal sci-fi action RPG.

4614210.title: Crack the Pack
4614210.short_description: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

4614300.title: Soulspree
4614300.short_description: A first-person bullet heaven shooter set in a brutal Hellscape where you survive endless waves of demons. Collect powerful upgrades, stack synergies, and evolve into an unstoppable force of destruction as the chaos escalates.

4614580.title: Cat Watch
4614580.short_description: A 2D arcade shooter minigame with roguelike progression where you control a cat defending an apartment against enemies that seek cover and strike at the right moment. Jump, attack, and eliminate waves of mosquitoes, rats, and bats as you advance toward the source of the infestation.

4614620.title: Soulsmith
4614620.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler focused on progression, combat, and exploration. Master powerful guild skills, fight through dangerous zones, and uncover what lies beneath a cursed world.

4614640.title: Lord of Idle
4614640.short_description: An Idle ARPG inspired by hack and slash classics. Level up your Combat, Mining, and Crafting skills. Compete in monthly Seasons with secure leaderboards, or play on Legacy servers. Hunt unique loot, socialize in multiplayer boss rooms, and fuel your crafting with an isometric factory.

4614650.title: Polity Painter
4614650.short_description: Polity Painter is a minimalist sandbox tool for historical map enthusiasts. Effortlessly paint borders, name nations, and visualize alternate histories across diverse world maps including Japan, Europe, and the Americas. Your world, your canvas.

4614710.title: AfterMove
4614710.short_description: A turn-based puzzle game where every piece obeys a fixed rule. 180 hand-crafted levels across two modes. Learn the patterns and the board starts to make sense.

4614870.title: Apiary in Flow
4614870.short_description: Apiary in Flow is a strategic incremental game about placing bees in a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

4614890.title: Peperoni Border Simulator
4614890.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4614890.short_description: Smuggle goods, upgrade vehicles, and build your empire.

4615010.title: Kibble Cats
4615010.short_description: Kibble Cats is a cozy incremental game with a definite ending. Rebuild an ancient cat village around a buried Pawbelisk. Hire cats, unlock buildings, and reach milestones as a thread emerges connecting it all to something greater. A force stirs within this village, and it dreams a Great Dream.

4615060.title: Mist Weavers
4615060.short_description: Descend from the Floating Isles into corrupted ruins! Navigate through relentless hordes as a Mist Weaver, commanding a ferocious Familiar to smash mutated horrors. Harvest essence to fuel your evolution and confront the grim nature of your power. Can you survive the secrets buried in the Mist?

4615100.title: UrbanRail Metro Simulator
4615100.short_description: Take control of the world's most iconic and oldest subway lines. Master everything from classic trains to modern trains with ATP and CBTC/ATO safety systems in a realistic and technical simulation experience.

4615220.title: EXPLODES
4615220.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4615220.short_description: EXPLODES is a fast-paced 2D stickman fighting game. Choose from 15 explosive weapons and battle across 10 unique arenas. Play solo against AI bots, fight friends locally on one keyboard, or take on players online. Level up, unlock gear, and dominate. Completely free to play with no paywalls.

4615320.title: My First 3D Printer
4615320.short_description: Remember buying your first 3D printer? Now imagine having twenty. Manage your workshop, fulfill orders, and build the business you always dreamed of.

4615330.title: ROBOSCAV
4615330.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4615330.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

4615360.title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
4615360.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

4615480.title: Arcane Towerline
4615480.short_description: Arcane Towerline is a roguelite tower defense blending auto-battler synergies. On a dynamic battlefield, draft powerful 1-to-5 cost units to build a formidable lineup. Defend your crystal from swarms of enemies using tactical positioning and random game-changing magic!

4615570.title: Bug Bounce
4615570.short_description: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

4615610.title: The Lost
4615610.short_description: A young man returns to his apartment but instead finds himself trapped in an endless looping space. Only by finding his own room can he break the cycle. Each floor may have different anomalies (or maybe not), and on the floor before the end, he must complete a battle. Can he make it back safely?

4615620.title: Impossible Machine
4615620.short_description: A 2.5D point-and-click adventure where you explore, talk to characters, and build solutions that shouldn’t work… but do. Solve puzzles with questionable logic, juggle multiple tasks, and uncover a mystery—along. No minigames and lots of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

4615900.title: Survival Exorcist
4615900.short_description: Survival Exorcist: A solo dev medieval survival horror with 2000s visuals. Board the sacred train and deliver it to the castle to purify ravaged plague lands. Hunt corrupted beasts with your crossbow or use dagger in stealth across diverse environments in this atmospheric experience.

4616080.title: WRITE.EYE
