4616080.short_description: In a futuristic Seattle, the CorpoState regulates every citizen's perception through a mandatory contact lens. Magic, a weary editor in Tower D#503, has come to realize the history he polishes is a hollow lie. Installing an unauthorized override, he toggles his lens to descend to the streets below.

4616170.title: DO NOT FILE
4616170.short_description: DO NOT FILE is a single-player psychological horror game set in an abandoned police station. You are a reporter investigating a cold case, searching for a missing file. As you go deeper inside, the case becomes uncertain and the truth harder to find.

4616250.title: Lost City
4616250.short_description: A noir metroidvania adventure in a mysterious Lost City spiced with souls-like gameplay systems. Multilayered 2D world design with intricate spatial depth. Equipable trumpets, guitar and guitar pedals.

4616480.title: Tiny Leaf Kingdom
4616480.short_description: A tiny cozy action adventure where leafy warriors wear human gear, clash in silly battles, and fight for survival in a strange little kingdom where clever green leaves hide, red leaves swarm, and every battle turns into a funny but chaotic leafy showdown.

4616530.title: Dolly's Breeding Party
4616530.short_description: Play Dolly: a housewife with a loving husband, a very specific itch he can't scratch, and five men lined up to help. Infidelity, breeding kink, and the thrill of doing exactly what you shouldn't. Choice-driven adult visual novel.

4616590.title: Settled At Sea
4616590.short_description: Settled At Sea is a first-person mystery set on a remote Scottish island. You are a lighthouse keeper grieving your wife's death-but the island doesn't feel as isolated as it should.

4616730.title: Supernova Deliveries
4616730.short_description: Transport cargo, optimize your inventory, and upgrade your convoy. Command your space-truck through a 2D pixel-art space filled with asteroids and hostile pirates and master the art of deep space logistics.

4616990.title: GemPals
4616990.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4616990.short_description: Embark on a vibrant co-op journey in GemPals. Join forces with a partner to overcome intense combat, clever puzzles, and daring platforming. Uncover the ancient, sacred Gems hidden across the world and restore harmony together.

4617060.title: Sextates Manager
4617060.short_description: A story-rich adult visual novel where your choices shape everything. Start your new life as a real estate agent, prove yourself with clients, and build an intimate connection with your alluring boss, Emma. Every decision matters from the boardroom to the bedroom.

4617070.title: Sklesh
4617070.short_description: A terminal-based battler where you build decks, evolve creatures, and fight for dominance across a fading digital network.

4617170.title: Broadside Bets
4617170.short_description: In the Pirate Roguelike Deckbuilder Broadside Bets you command your pirate crew in explosive battles. Build your deck and collect powerful Booty to discover creative interactions and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of different encounters, islands and treasure.

4617210.title: I Am Hercules
4617210.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4617210.short_description: Step into the sandals of Hercules, the greatest hero of antiquity. Face monsters, gods, and your own limits as you live through the legendary Twelve Labors of Hercules in this first-person mythological epic.

4617230.title: Retail Rivals
4617230.short_description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

4617330.title: Shape Showdown
4617330.short_description: SHAPE SHOWDOWN is a arcade style fighter where enemies present with unique mechanics that increase in complexity as you progress. Attack, parry, and dodge with precise timing while learning each enemies patterns to win. Learn tight windows and increasingly interesting patterns to win fights faster.

4617480.title: Chrome Fist
4617480.short_description: Chrome Fist is a Cyberpunk Themed Autobattler with roguelike elements. Install the Microchips on your motherboard purchased with your hard-earned credits from fighting in the ultimate underground fighting ring: The Ditch.

4617630.title: Tight Tactics
4617630.short_description: Be ready for turn-based combat in this roguelite to kick off with the enemy opening fire on you first, trying to keep you from regrouping, and one bad decision leading to the death of your entire upgraded squad

4617680.title: Monster Girl Chat
4617680.short_description: Talk to five unique monster girls in a fantasy city powered by local AI. Every conversation is real-time, unscripted, and completely private. Characters remember you, build relationships, and react to holidays. No internet, no subscriptions, no limits. Offline AI RPG: buy once, play forever.

4617690.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New Delhi
4617690.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New Delhi🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4617750.title: MANSION
4617750.short_description: Fight a real AI that thinks, adapts, and shows you its reasoning live. Battle through procedurally generated wireframe mansions or spectate five AI labs fighting each other in endless deathmatch. No difficulty settings. No hand holding.

4618090.title: Backrooms: The Last Observer
4618090.short_description: Backrooms: Forgotten Floors is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Descend into something that resists understanding, where perception itself begins to fracture. You are here not to fight, but to witness — and sometimes, witnessing is the worst thing you can do.

4618130.title: Travelling Home: Ever After
4618130.short_description: Get your very own moving castle! Travelling Home: Ever After is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Journey through a charming world in a cozy house built on a train.Perfect for studying, working, creating, or simply drifting off to sleep.

4618230.title: KETZER
4618230.short_description: KETZER is a brutal roguelite horde FPS where blood is both your weapon and your resource. Fight through endless waves of possessed and cursed abominations, grow stronger mid-run, and descend deeper into corruption with every death.

4618290.title: Sweet Time
4618290.short_description: Sweet Time - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around time. Enjoy pleasant moments with five pretty and lovely girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4618300.title: Beat the Ads
4618300.short_description: A fast-paced typing game where a pop-up ads are destroying your PC. Enter the right key combination to delete them! Do it quickly or your PC will die! and... don't fall for the ads.

4618320.title: Self-Replication /// Destruction
4618320.short_description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

4618570.title: Booster Pack Heroes
4618570.short_description: A short incremental game about opening booster packs and surviving monster hordes. Discover rare heroes, upgrade their power, cast powerful spells and climb through ever harder chapters.

4618850.title: HZ Industry
4618850.short_description: Your factory feeds the fight—above ground and below. Automate ruthless production lines, hold your colony through raids, then descend into The Abyss: real-time champion combat where gear and gems actually matter. Build. Automate. Dominate.

4618980.title: Kitty Krush
4618980.short_description: Kitty Krush is a cozy, cat-themed roguelike deck-builder about a hive mind cat civilization that enslaves humanity. Upgrade your deck after each run with powerful cards and discover what happened to the last of the humans. Based on a true story.

4619290.title: Fatimopolis
4619290.short_description: Just after the start of the new year in 2005, Lucas receives a call from his boss asking him to make a few deliveries in Fatimopolis, a mysterious small town that, overnight, lost all of its inhabitants.

4619420.title: Slot Grind
4619420.short_description: Slot Grind is an incremental slot machine game where you spin, earn money, and put it back into upgrades. Unlock new machines with better payouts, improve them, and automate your slots as your profits grow, until you finally pay off your debts.

4619590.title: DAWGS: The Revenge
4619590.short_description: DAWGS: The Revenge is an unhinged, genre-bending physics sandbox of pure chaotic action. You play as a highly customizable, aggressively squishy ball of fury on a quest for absolute vengeance. What starts as a simple mission escalates into a multi-genre fever dream!

4619670.title: Cyberpunk Neon Survivor
4619670.short_description: A top-down roguelike bullet-hell survivor where you pilot a cybernetic mech-dog against endless swarms of rogue cats. Dash, blast, and stack augments into game-breaking builds across 60 waves, persistent nemeses, and epic boss fights — then die, upgrade, and deploy again.

4619730.title: Doorcrash!
4619730.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Racing, Free To Play
4619730.short_description: Deliver food fast while causing as much destruction as possible. Laws be dammed!

4619780.title: Fallen Immortal Expanse
4619780.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4619780.short_description: No spiritual root – can you still ascend? In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.

4619950.title: PopVibe
4619950.short_description: PopVibe is a casual rhythm game centered around pop music. Using only your keyboard, you can play along with various tracks in a straightforward, easy-to-learn manner. It is designed for players looking for a simple way to interact with music.

4619990.title: Summit Climber
4619990.short_description: "Summit Climber" is a third person adventure game and a virtual journey. As youths from the Ancient Path Village, manage your stamina, food, supplies and unique gadgets. climb The Milon Mountain. Only through unity and cooperation can you reach the summit together.

4620130.title: Mechanocide: Fortress Omega
4620130.short_description: On a forgotten world, confront a malevolent machine intelligence. Extract minerals, build factories, power up the railguns, and arm the missile batteries. Defend the Fortress Omega against the alloyed nightmare.

4620380.title: Scales of the Ibis
4620380.short_description: This puzzle-story game is cosmic fairytale set during the end of the world✨ Your decicions will shape the course of the universe, so what will you do?

4620480.title: Defective Detectives 2
4620480.short_description: A comedic detective visual novel in a noir style. Try on an old raincoat, arm yourself with a half-eaten éclair, and set out to find the Mayor's stolen wig! Read dialogue, make choices, and try not to lead the investigation down a dead end before the Sausage Baron takes over the city.

4620680.title: 時折記 -Tokioriki-
4620680.short_description: I can't do this anymore -- but I've decided to choose. There are people I want to protect, but I can't save them all. One old book shatters an ordinary life -- a visual novel of despair and love, where your choices shape the story. Japanese voice / English subtitles / ~10hrs

4620820.title: Immortal Sect Defend
4620820.short_description: Guard the Sect Eye or lose everything. Build immortal towers to defend against demon hordes. Explore dangerous realms, slay beasts, and upgrade your defenses in this unique cultivation tower defense game.

4620990.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
4620990.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

4621340.title: Reborn Arena
4621340.short_description: RebornArena is a competitive 2D platformer arena shooter where elemental deck-building meets precise combat. Draft your powers, master custom kinematic movement, and evolve your build every round. Outplay rivals in a skill-based arena where tactical choices are as vital as your aim.

4621800.title: Indebted Duke
4621800.short_description: Indebted Duke is a deckbuilding management game where each villager owns unique cards. Generate profit through production chains, and grow stronger cards through promotion, marriage, and inheritance. Overcome battles and random events to rebuild your domain your way.

4621810.title: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
4621810.short_description: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting. Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

4621990.title: Special Request: Chapter 2
4621990.short_description: Power, pressure, and desire begin to overlap. As Laura’s role in PAM deepens, corruption and control intensify — every choice has consequences.

4622170.title: Date For Dead
4622170.short_description: A dark romantic comedy where every match brings you closer to love… or something far more dangerous. Meet monsters, go on dates, and shape your relationships through meaningful choices. But behind every perfect date lies a secret: You’re not looking for love. You’re trying to bring love back.

4622310.title: Chicken Miner
4622310.short_description: Chicken Miner is a short incremental single-player top-down mining management game. Capture chickens and mine minerals alongside them. Use the resources you gather to unlock more research. Craft weapons and capture higher-tier chickens that are harder to encounter.

4622430.title: Annexation
4622430.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots.  Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

4622830.title: Darkstone Bay
4622830.short_description: A shipwreck has been hidden on this island for 300 years. Nobody has found it. You arrive at Darkstone Bay determined to change that. Cross the island by solving ancient puzzles, navigate rocky beaches, caves and dense jungles in an escape room inspired adventure. Will you be the one to find it?

4623020.title: 吉他制造专家 Guitar Luthier
4623020.short_description: Step into the world of lutherie and build your legendary guitar brand from the ground up in this 100% hand-drawn pixel art simulation game! Craft one-of-a-kind electric guitars, run your own workshop, understand client needs, and rise to become the most sought-after luthier among musicians worldwide

4623090.title: Tiny Catcher
4623090.short_description: Tiny Catcher is a fishing game where you can keep it open in a floating window mode, so you can place it wherever you want while doing other things on your PC. The idea is to have something cozy running in the background while you work, study, or just relax.

4623280.title: Bonfire Buddies
4623280.short_description: If the fire goes out, you don’t survive the night. Team up, gather resources, and survive the darkness. Bonfire Buddies is an online co-op survival game where you and your friends must keep the fire alive through the night.

4623550.title: The Path of Kana
4623550.short_description: A top-down action-adventure RPG inspired by the classics. Play as Kana; Chosen to carry a sacred flame through haunted dungeons, solve ancient puzzles, and guide lost souls home. Built-in randomizer for endless replayability.

4623620.title: Postin Paradise
4623620.short_description: Chill, relax... and stamp! Postin Paradise is a satisfactory incremental game where you work as post office manager. Grab the mail, stamp it, throw it into the hole, collect your coins, and repeat. At night, when your shift ends, you can buy upgrades to improve your performance. Stamp 'em all!

4623890.title: Boom Rush: Desert OPS
4623890.short_description: After a emergency crash landing in the middle of the desert, your fight for survival begins. Space Base Nyra has detected your location and enemy signals. Guide yourself through increasingly intense waves of enemies with real-time radio support. Fast action FPS where every wave brings new threats

4623970.title: Heavyweight Saint
4623970.short_description: Neo-noir third-person VR immersive sim. Possessed by a vengeful spirit, navigate the streets of Manhattan in search of the missing boy.

4624460.title: Puzzle ATLAS
4624460.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4624460.short_description: Take on 60 handcrafted puzzles filled with tricky mechanics, clever twists, and challenging logic trials.

4624470.title: Pengzle:Arctic Arcane
4624470.short_description: Pengzle is a real-time puzzle action adventure where you weave mana into spell formulas in the middle of battle. Read the flow of combat, build the right combination, and cast at the perfect moment as a small penguin mage in a distinctive polar fantasy world.

4625240.title: 长安首富模拟器
4625240.short_description: A single-player business sim set in Tang Chang’an. Start as a street vendor: trade (buy low, sell high), manage shops, invest to grow wealth. Handle market changes, build connections, rise from commoner to Chang’an’s richest tycoon—casual management, strategy, satisfying progression.

4625760.title: 山上那个猴儿
4625760.short_description: A Journey to the West idle game. As a young monkey, battle demons, cultivate power, forge weapons, learn magic, and hunt treasures. Simple yet deep. Play at your own pace.

4625990.title: 字獄 JIGOKU
4625990.short_description: Words wage war. Every enemy, every weapon, and you yourself — everything is made of words. Cut through hordes of living characters, seize skills, and evolve from Human to God. Across five stages — Wild, Mountain, Sea, Dark, and Heaven — something awaits beyond.

4626430.title: Toon & Tune
4626430.short_description: A Survival-Crafting Game combining all of your favourite mechanics from different games and genres. Fill your Item Collections, Max out your Weapons and Skills, Complete all Quests, Defeat Bosses, Increase your Stats, or just Build your Island.

4626720.title: SINEK
4626720.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

4627180.title: Null Ascent: Stellar
4627180.short_description: an incremental game built around one simple loop: hover, destroy, upgrade, ascend. You have a little helper drone, a garden and plenty of powerups to unlock

4588320.title: Lostbound
4588320.short_description: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

4588730.title: SKREW YOUR STUPID MARBLE GAME
4588730.short_description: You play as a digital marble consisting of a force field and a cockpit. You roll through over 100 levels, completing a huge variety of missions. There are skate parks, racetracks, a roller coaster, puzzles, boss battles, exciting water levels, and much, much more.

4588870.title: 热血街边摊：盲光
4588870.short_description: 多年以后，黄超雄和李柔再次相遇，他们能回到从前吗？自由探索布鑫街，找回黄超雄的记忆碎片。

4589000.title: Void Step
4589000.short_description: Run, swing and defy gravity through a first-person neon void driven by music and compete to be the fastest there is. Sprint on beat using your own music in Rhythm Rush mode, or create your own levels for others to play!

4589010.title: BUTTON
4589010.short_description: Find the hidden button before time runs out! Explore, think fast, and overcome increasingly challenging levels in this first-person puzzle experience.

4589060.title: Pixel Room Stickers
4589060.short_description: A cozy and creative room-decorating game using a collection of charming sticker-style objects

4589130.title: Dravora
4589130.short_description: A narrative roguelite where you lead desperate people across a fractured dark fantasy continent. No combat screens — every choice is made in words and every consequence follows you. Your companions have their own reasons to leave. How you survive reveals who you are.

4589350.title: RED PROTOCOL
4589350.short_description: A psychological sci-fi thriller aboard an orbital quarantine station. Interrogate 10 astronauts, identify 4 infected crew members, and prevent a mutiny before Earth reentry.

4589360.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
4589360.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

4589420.title: Chasing Shadows
4589420.short_description: A top-down puzzle adventure where light affects your environment. Avoid illuminated areas and solve shadow-based puzzles by manipulating machines and luring light-driven mechs. Uncover secrets, and explore a dark world where light is both danger and the key to progress.

4589530.title: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
4589530.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

4589890.title: FindHuman
4589890.short_description: In an abandoned robot city, humans have vanished without a trace. Wander through quiet streets, observe the routines of robots who remain, read forgotten terminal logs, and piece together fragments of what happened. No quests, no timers — just a city that lives on without you.

4590150.title: Deskpot
4590150.short_description: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

4590210.title: Baulk
4590210.short_description: Play solo pool where every shot is a risk. An elephant runs the game. The order of safe and cursed turns is hidden. Clear the table to buy items, but avoid potting balls on cursed turns.

4590640.title: Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I
4590640.short_description: Fight through the Hundred Years War in Age of Longbow: Volume I, a tactical medieval wargame of longbow battles, sieges, and shifting campaigns. Command English and French forces across 94 scenarios and an expansive campaign system spanning the war's major phases.

4590990.title: Ouroboros Solitaire
4590990.short_description: Face infinitely scaling foes in this endless deck-builder! Its elegant rules let you play for free with a real deck of cards. But here, Steam automates the shuffling and complex modulo 13 math. Dive into fast-paced gameplay and deep deck-building dilemmas without the hassle!

4591260.title: Desktop Claw Master
4591260.short_description: Graboo is the shyest claw machine in the world. Graboo quietly picks up doll friends from the corner of the screen while you're working or enjoying games. Give warm friends to Graboo, a loner!

4591390.title: Xeno Finder
4591390.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4591390.short_description: A local multiplayer social deduction game for friends—featuring 8 categories and 240 unique expressions to keep every round fresh.

4591400.title: Royal Flux — The Astral Shadow Plague
4591400.short_description: A simultaneous card battle system built on rock-paper-scissors kingdom logic, 18 races, five game modes, and a deck engine designed to reward planning over luck. Royal Flux plays fair. Build smarter or fall.

4592010.title: Elemental Wandering Survivors
4592010.short_description: Face hordes of corrupted creatures in challenging lands with the help of magical abilities. Elemental Wandering Survivors is a horde survival game where your goal is to persevere in combat against monsters while evolving your battle potential to explore hostile lands.

4592040.title: Just Chessing Around
4592040.short_description: Build a chess army. Break the rules. Collect buffs that make your pieces addictively OP, with knights that roam the entire board, rooks that smash through anything. Use items like bombs or potions to cause even more chaos. No king to checkmate. Just enemies to destroy.

4592270.title: Eris
4592270.short_description: ERIS is a rail shooter roguelike. Shoot, destroy, gather resources, and through an engaging narrative, you’ll discover what your fate holds. In a story that will keep you hooked for at least 8 hours, you’ll learn how best to build your ship to defeat the galaxy’s most powerful enemies.

4593220.title: Adrift
4593220.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4593220.short_description: Wander a quiet forest, collect materials and uncover hidden items. Enjoy the peaceful ambiance and find all of your hiding mole friends!

4593540.title: SANGUINE CYCLE; REDUX
4593540.short_description: A narrative-driven thriller about missing people, stagnant towns, and the fact that even if you love someone, you can't always see the good sides of them when push comes to shove.

4593570.title: Extreme Clicker
4593570.short_description: Click the golden triangle and unlock 100 achievements! Extreme Clicker is the perfect game for achievement hunters. Simple, addictive, and satisfying. Can you reach 1000 clicks and complete them all?

4593680.title: Loopy Dungeon
4593680.short_description: Legend has it that all who enter this dungeon are doomed to loop forever. In Loopy Dungeon, build your deck fight after fight, combine your relics and break the cycle.

4594420.title: Blitz Haul
4594420.short_description: Fast-paced neon arena FPS. Fight 10 waves of killer robots, loot crates for weapons, buy gear from the shop, and take on a massive final boss. Six weapons, three difficulty modes.

4594440.title: A.K.O - Arrow Keys Only
4594440.short_description: One hand. Four arrow keys. Your weapon auto-fires. You position, time, and swap elements to survive the climb. 5 pilots, 75 skins, 35+ relics. This is A.K.O... OK? LETS GO!

4594480.title: Cataclysm Escape
4594480.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite survival game set in a collapsing post-apocalyptic world. Explore shifting environments, avoid deadly mutants, and use unique abilities to hide and escape. As darkness spreads across the map, every run becomes a desperate race to survive.

4594600.title: Hentai Tetromino
4594600.short_description: Hentai Tetronimo is a puzzle-arcade game in which the player drops tetrominos (shapes composed of 4 squares) into a grid, attempting to form complete rows. When a row is completed, it is removed and the player's score is increased. Completing a level reveals an adult image.

4594750.title: Decay
4594750.short_description: Decay is an incremental game in which you are tasked with using your trusty particle launcher to create ever-larger and more unstable atomic nuclei, witnessing longer and more complex atomic decay chains and aiming to discover all the isotopes!

4595080.title: Capy Chaos
4595080.short_description: Become the galaxy’s deadliest hunter! Wield 7 weapons at once, unleash ricochet chaos, and conquer alien worlds in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive 10 minutes of madness, trigger your Rage, and slay the boss. Master unique Signature Weapons and craft your ultimate build!

4595210.title: Fiefs & Trade
4595210.short_description: Fiefs & Trade is a medieval sandbox game which focuses on trade, party and inventory management, combat and diplomacy. Hire companions to fight for you, herd animals to carry your goods and create trade routes to become the richest merchant the world has seen. Or simply overpower everyone in battle.

4595300.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
4595300.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

4595310.title: Platon³
4595310.short_description: Build your cube deck and place them on a strategic grid. Combine effects, upgrade them, and maximize your score. Every choice matters. Master combinations and let the Platonic solids amplify your power.

4595340.title: 重启人生
4595340.short_description: What would you do if you could restart life? Live from birth to old age in a life-sim visual novel with branching careers, romance routes, random fate events, and 30 endings.

4595540.title: Touhou Erosion ~ The Fallen Shrine Maiden of Paradise
4595540.short_description: A mysterious wave of 'Erosion' has swallowed Gensokyo, turning its maidens into red-eyed predators. Survive the relentless bullet hell and shatter the dark shells that bind them. Reclaim the fading light of Paradise in this intense Survivors-like action.

4595740.title: Rope Up!
4595740.short_description: Climb higher. Fall harder. Try again.

4595750.title: The Spirit Apprentice
4595750.short_description: Jump into this cozy adventure as a Spirit Apprentice, finishing your final year of studies. Explore this fantasy world where you tame spirits (charming magical creatures), help the residents and uncover the mysteries of the spirit world.

4595870.title: Stack the Spells
4595870.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

4595880.title: Hearing Voices
4595880.short_description: Hearing Voices is a unique indie short horror experience where you will need to put your listening and deduction skills to the test to solve puzzles. Mistakes have consequences.

4596140.title: 网络男神模拟器
4596140.short_description: Net Idol: Rise to Fame is a 2D simulation game. Play as a 16-year-old internet-savvy girl, turn your game-talented but internet-ignorant brother into a top idol. Customize his look, build a guild/team/companion group, switch to his perspective to interact and compete.

4596150.title: Water Margin: Defying Heaven
4596150.short_description: This is a multimedia narrative game based on images and text, adapted from Water Margin, one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature.
developers: Lu'an Ni Xue Meng Xun Information Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Lu'an Ni Xue Meng Xun Information Technology Co., Ltd.

4596440.title: Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
4596440.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
4596440.short_description: Identify the truth on the world map! Experience the life of a world-traveling influencer in this geolocation mystery. Explore iconic landmarks, solve historical riddles, and grow your channel. Manage your budget & chat while uncovering the world's long-lost romance!

4597000.title: Dwarven Rails
4597000.short_description: You are put in charge of a dwarven gun train. Your mission, destroy as many bugs as possible. Build turrets, mine ores with bullets, upgrade your train, and dare to dig deeper.

4597130.title: Occupied Hearts
4597130.short_description: Occupied Hearts is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set in a sunlit Mediterranean town under military occupation. Play Captain Declan, whose permits, parole files, and kindness shape three romances where power is always in the room. One choice, one relationship.

4597290.title: Devil's Logic
4597290.short_description: A face-off against the Devil in a deadly 9x9 grid. Use logic to strike, build your deck to distort reality, and play every card with precision. But beware: mistakes draw blood. When health hits zero, only a revolver stands between you and the end. Spin the chamber. Survive, or lose everything.

4597300.title: Operation P.L.U.S.H
4597300.short_description: Operation Plush is a 1-4 player horde defender where you take control of dream-powered plushies defending your child's nighlight from the encroaching nightmare horde. Protect the dream, Defend the nightlight, Defeat the darkness

4597330.title: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED
4597330.short_description: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG intro to SHRIMP GAME set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!

4597380.title: Angel Essence
4597380.short_description: Ascend to a heavenly realm as the treasure hunter Angelique. Weave together fast, fluid combos as you unlock a deep movement system. Battle surreal foes and uncover secrets in the expansive world of Angel Essence, a retro-inspired 3D platformer.

4597530.title: Evolve: Dead City
4597530.short_description: The city has fallen. Scavenge supplies, arm yourself, secure logistics, and build your base in a metropolis overrun by the undead. Uncover the truth behind the outbreak and command zombie workers who never complain, never tire, and never ask for wages.

4597620.title: Grind Up
4597620.short_description: A retro first-person game where everything turns into cash. Grind items, earn money, pay your debt, make upgrades, and don't stop until you've made a million dollars.

4597630.title: CHROMALEES
4597630.short_description: Explore a decaying island as a young fox who awakens in the mysterious Vivo Basin. Use the power of the Prism to manipulate color, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden at its core.

4597670.title: Spud Keeper
4597670.short_description: Pick up and smash bugs, upgrade your tools to protect your potato patch from escalating waves of pests!

4597770.title: Sisyphus Conviction
4597770.short_description: Sisyphus Conviction is a Clicker Game about walking up Mountain, dragging a Rock from the Underworld. Based on the Greek Myth of the King Sisyphus who tried to defy Death. Now doomed for Eternity, join Sisyphus on this adventure with a Click, Upgrade, Repeat fun system.

4597820.title: DRENCHED
4597820.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4597820.short_description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burned-out artist, Brie, becomes a fish. Switch between two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

4597850.title: Atmos
4597850.short_description: ATMOS - is a fast-paced action roguelike, where you can shoot, slash, blast, smash, slice, bash and more!.

4597870.title: Minnow
4597870.short_description: Fall asleep, explore, hide, seek, don't wake up.

4598120.title: The Syndicate: Classified Operations
4598120.short_description: An incremental strategy game where you rise from a small-scale operator to a global intelligence power. Establish blacksites, expand your reach, shape policy, advance through eras of counter-intelligence, and build a covert empire.

4598300.title: Vacanauta
4598300.short_description: Abduct and conquer worlds. VACANAUTA: a very irreverent cosmic adventure!

4598450.title: Forklift Basketball
4598450.short_description: Earn your forklift certification in Forklift Basketball! Forklift Basketball is a chaotic, physics-based sports game where forklifts take center court. Drive, lift, and launch your way to victory in fast-paced matches filled with pure unpredictable fun!

4598470.title: Negative Space
4598470.short_description: You are a sentient creative thought, in a A 3D Open World exploration based platformer. Restore color to a unique world set in the human mind. Uncover memories hidden beneath the surface and discover the mystery to how the mind ended up in this state.

4598760.title: BLOCK13
4598760.short_description: Block13 is a first-person psychological horror exploration game. On a calm afternoon, you step into a weathered Hong Kong public housing estate. Wandering its hazy corridors, unsettling secrets emerge. The deeper you go, the more it entangles you. Unravel its mystery to break free.

4598780.title: BLOODSHOT
4598780.short_description: A blistering-fast retro FPS. Your brother got kidnapped, and you're getting him back. Down drinks/candy to keep your speed maxed out, chug through chaotic environments and kill everything in your way.

4599500.title: DottyBead闪闪拼豆
4599500.short_description: A super soothing coloring game! 50 levels of rich content, glass-like luminous dots + embossed 3D visuals. Auto-playback your coloring process after completing each level. Pick up anytime, put down anytime—perfect relaxation for all ages.

4599710.title: IDLE_DIRECTIVE
4599710.short_description: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. IDLE_DIRECTIVE is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

4599890.title: Hong Kong Horror Incident: Yik Sin House
4599890.short_description: The last food delivery order leads you into a residential building you can never leave. You thought it was just an ordinary job, but in the familiar Yik Sin House, you gradually fall into an inescapable nightmare.

4600060.title: Seal The Breach
4600060.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

4600230.title: KeelOver
4600230.short_description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

4600670.title: Life in Tudorofka
4600670.short_description: Life in Tudorofka is a game where you, find a rusty broken junk, restore the junk, buy parts for the junk, build your car, work and enjoy your life at country

4600690.title: Cold Snap
4600690.short_description: 3v3 multiplayer snowball fights where you stun, knock out, and outplay your opponents in fast-paced, physics-driven matches.

4600820.title: Jackie Snape Clicker
4600820.short_description: Jackie Snape is a bold brunette with an icy stare and a body built for sin. Click, upgrade, and watch her slowly strip and lose control. 156 explicit illustrations, deep progression, and rising heat. Ready to push the cold vixen to her limit?

4600970.title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
4600970.short_description: A haunted hotel hides a trapped soul. As a medium, use your voice to perform rituals, solve puzzles, and uncover sealed memories… while something listens to every sound you make.

4600980.title: Weird Life
4600980.short_description: An atmospheric, surreal 3D point-and-click adventure featuring direct character control, a 360-degree freely rotating camera, and horror elements that unfold into a dramatic story as the game progresses.

4601340.title: 4Power
4601340.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy
4601340.short_description: Every playthrough features different rooms, different enemies, and different scenarios. With an endless number of rooms, every run is unique.

4601390.title: Twin Stick Checkers
4601390.short_description: Checkers meets twin-stick chaos! Control turret pieces, shoot enemies, and outplay opponents in fast-paced strategy duels. Practice solo against the AI, challenge friends locally, or compete online using Remote Play Together.

4601560.title: Ember
4601560.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

4601670.title: Visseron Idle
4601670.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4601670.short_description: A deep idle RPG with 26 skills, class-based progression, and wave-based dungeon combat. Train skills, craft gear, build your estate, and automate production. Progress keeps ticking even when you're offline.

4601800.title: Cyber Capitalist
4601800.short_description: An incremental business sim that roasts workplace culture. Run a cyberpunk startup in the AI era—hire humans or deploy AI workers, navigate funding rounds from Angel to IPO, and decide: exploit your team or build a conscience. 45 minutes per run. Your choices have consequences.

4601820.title: INFINITER
4601820.short_description: Navigate the Geometric Void and survive agsint the hordes of creatures that lurk within the unknowable space. INFINITER is an incremental action-rougelike, where every run earns you progress towards becoming the most powerful being in the entire universe.

4601840.title: Tales from the Other Side: Beneath the Roots
4601840.short_description: Psychological first-person horror. Fate brings you to your grandfather’s house, left abandoned after his mysterious disappearance. Explore it and uncover the dark secret hidden within.

4601850.title: The Yield
4601850.short_description: A minimalist dystopian inspection sim. Check packages, verify codes, and fill out reports. Every mistake triggers a mechanism above your head. Don't let the scale fill up.

4601880.title: Cobalt Miner
4601880.short_description: Survive in futuristic 2046 USA where a ruthless megacorporation owns your debt. Mine cobalt, automate production, craft machines, explore a dying world, and ride your electric bike across vast pixel-art wastelands. Pay what you owe… or disappear.

4602120.title: 500 FINGER FILLET
4602120.short_description: 500 STABS. 30 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

4602350.title: Turning point
4602350.short_description: Turning point is a narrative-driven puzzle platformer, full of twists and turns. Learn to listen to the voices that somehow-someway you hear. Based on narration find your way out.

4602470.title: Graviton Core
4602470.short_description: Absorb mass. Bend gravity. Detonate everything. A fast-paced hardcore bullet hell where every explosion is your choice.

4602620.title: Brothel Tycoon 2
4602620.short_description: Brothel Tycoon 2 is a simulation game where you are in the role of Yvonne, a young entrepreneur who wants to turn a small cafe into a luxurious place for adult entertainment.

4602790.title: Guate Grand Prix
4602790.short_description: Arcade racing through iconic locations in Guatemala with customizable wooden toy trucks inspired by a beloved local tradition.

4603010.title: RushLife
4603010.short_description: RushLife is a turn-based life simulation where you manage time, money, and survival through skill-based minigames while competing with up to 4 local players in a pressure-driven city system.

4603160.title: Moonbeam Mayhem
4603160.short_description: Moonbeam Mayhem is a vertically scrolling 2D shoot'em up with heavy emphasis on shooting, dodging and​ controlling the skies!

4603280.title: Triad of Victory
4603280.short_description: Turn the world’s most familiar hand game into an addictive strategy adventure. Combine skills, gear, and progression choices—every decision can change the course of a run.

4603550.title: W.A.M
4603550.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

4603640.title: Bootlegger's Bar
4603640.short_description: Mix, upgrade, and expand in Bootlegger's Bar, the ultimate puzzle incremental experience. Serve thirsty customers and grow your underground empire!

4603750.title: Indomitus: Path of Ordeals
4603750.short_description: Face relentless trials as an indomitable hero. 'Indomitus' is a 2D pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. Use cards in real-time auto-battles, level up to choose powerful traits, and build synergies with unique relics. Overcome every ordeal with your tactics. High-stakes strategy and deep growth await.

4603920.title: My Little Ocean
4603920.short_description: Swim with colorful fish and explore the secrets of the ocean. Lead your flocks to food and safety, watch them play and wander, and have fun together in your cozy little ocean.

4604010.title: BEAST
4604010.short_description: Gather your animal companions—from the cunning fox to the mighty lion—and write your own legend through the power of cards.Will you follow the natural laws of the food chain, or create miracles of your own?[BEAST] — an adventure of strategy and glory awaits you.

4604300.title: Vitalis
4604300.short_description: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

4604390.title: ReliCursed
4604390.genre: Adventure, Casual, Strategy, Free To Play
4604390.short_description: Relicursed is a roguelike puzzle game where you collect and manage relics inside your bag to generate enough essence to go deeper in The Dungeon. Players can upgrade their bag slots and move relics around to avoid harmful effects or create a powerful synergies that improve their essence generation.

4604470.title: A Noble Steed
4604470.short_description: A Noble Steed is an open ended sandbox RPG set in a post-apocalyptic medieval world. Take the reins to slay hordes of zombies, explore and find new equipment. Use your loot to level up, repair your farm and the village. Tame and breed new Steeds to take your combat to the next level.

4604570.title: Pending Approval
4604570.short_description: Idle, where you fill out and sign meaningless forms to climb the ranks of an absurd bureaucracy. Automate, advance, and repeat in an endless loop. The further you go, the more ridiculous it gets. Will you survive, or will you become part of the system?

4604640.title: The Pumpkin Paradox
4604640.short_description: The Dark Lord won. Now what? Find out in this quirky 2D action-adventure where fluid combat meets time-twisting exploration. Shift the seasons, reshape the world, solve clever puzzles, and get swept up in a heartfelt story full of oddball characters and darkly funny charm.

4604680.title: Tiny Tape Store
4604680.short_description: A cozy, nostalgia-fueled idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Reminisce the good old days and run your own little VHS store while using your PC for work, games or whatever.

4605700.title: Kanojo Panic
4605700.short_description: A Gals Panic-style territory-capture game with modern illustrations and full voice acting. Draw lines, claim the screen, dodge enemies, and reveal her.

4605810.title: Waifu Cam Girl - NSFW Hentai Clicker
4605810.short_description: Build your own streaming empire! Help your charming waifu cam girl attract viewers, collect likes, and become more and more successful with clever upgrades.

4606030.title: Geo Grinder
4606030.short_description: Geo Grinder is an incremental roguelite where you shatter geometric enemies, harvest resources, and power up through a massive upgrade tree. Every run makes you stronger. Grind geometry, grow, repeat.

4606050.title: Super Slots
4606050.short_description: Super Slots is an active-idle casino builder where hands-on or idle play, smart timing, symbol, combo upgrades, skill tree and prestige progression turn one machine into a massive combo-chasing empire.

4606070.title: Deadly Obsession
4606070.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel where you’re kidnapped by an obsessed captor—your choices determine whether you escape or fall into his twisted love.

4606080.title: No Panic
4606080.short_description: NO PANIC is a cooperative, high-pressure party game where two players must communicate, multi-task, and make fast decisions to keep a failing airplane in the air. The game aims to turn stressful situations into fun, memorable moments through controlled chaos, humor, and shared responsibility.

4606090.title: Caber
4606090.short_description: Caber is a novel logic puzzle inspired by the 8 queens problem, transform your computer in a metal challenge that improves your memory, perception and logic skills.

4606600.title: CHESST
4606600.short_description: Open up a CHESST full of magical intrigue and mayhem! Dragons, Unicorns & Sorcerers? Check! Pawns with potent powers? Check! Hand-crafted pixel goodness? Check! Scrapping checkmate & bishops for new victory conditions & unique pieces? CHESST – the sage choice for lovers of fantasy & adventure.

4606620.title: National Transit
4606620.short_description: A sandbox strategy game. Build your nation's transport network, grow your economy, and raise your people's prosperity. Every map is procedurally generated and unique.

4606730.title: LaVonne's Bouncing Idle
4606730.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4606730.short_description: A satisfying physics-based idle game where you deploy an army of neon bouncing balls to obliterate geometric blocks. Buy crazy upgraded balls, level up your lab, and watch the numbers scale into infinity.

4606860.title: Zombies Attack My Burger Joint
4606860.short_description: Defend your burger joint against hordes of the undead! In Zombies Attack My Burger Joint, you assemble tactical burgers for ammo and fire french-fry machine guns. Aim for the head, manage your ingredients, customize your kitchen, build defenses, and save the world!

4607180.title: PulseWave
4607180.short_description: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

4607190.title: Phantom Echoes Chapter I
4607190.short_description: After a plane journey to Delhi goes wrong, you arrive at a strange hotel surrounded by a dense forest. Something feels off. The environment seems distorted, sounds echo unnaturally, and reality itself feels unstable. Explore the mysterious hotel and escape from entities to uncover what is happening.

4607240.title: Warfront: Three Kingdoms
4607240.short_description: This is a cold weapon war game set in the Three Kingdoms period of China. Players will take on the role of an unknown soldier. They can either go to the front lines to slash enemies themselves, or command tactically from the rear. Recruit troops, build up strength, and unify the empire.

4607320.title: CORE
4607320.short_description: CORE is a "Retro" style fps or rather fpp [first person puncher?] about a robot going into the earth and destroying it from the inside out.

4607460.title: Gauchesca
4607460.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4607460.short_description: Gauchesca is a story-driven Truco game inspired by Argentine mythology. Play as Martina Chapanay, bluff and strategize against supernatural opponents in a deadly tournament where each match risks your soul.

4607640.title: 历史的回旋(History in Retrospect‌)
4607640.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4607640.short_description: This is a role-playing game that deeply combines modern urban settings with historical depth. By cracking the time-space code, you can travel back to Jingjiang Prefecture in the Song Dynasty and witness how ancient craftsmen built a solid city defense line amidst the mountains and rivers of Guilin.

4607700.title: Big Breasted Milky Futa Mommies 3
4607700.short_description: Relax, lay back, and pick a puzzle. Solve over 50 beautiful, sexual puzzles at your pleasure. Have thousands of hours of sexual fun with these EXTREMELY NSFW Futanari Mommy Puzzles.

4607810.title: Lizard Simulator
4607810.short_description: You're a lizard. The town is not ready. Grab things with your tongue, ragdoll through the streets, climb walls, and watch NPCs panic in this physics-driven chaos sandbox. There is no goal. There is only the lizard.

4607930.title: DVD Dealer Simulator
4607930.short_description: Build and manage your own DVD game store in DVD Dealer Simulator. Buy, sell, and trade game discs, expand your inventory, upgrade your shop, and move to bigger locations as your business grows. Turn a small store into a thriving gaming retail empire.

4608160.title: Gin and Wall
4608160.short_description: “Gin and Wall” is a 2D action game where you dodge a variety of walls. The controls are simple: just move and jump. Strange-looking walls appear on the stage, trying to stop you from clearing the level. Jump over the walls or move under them to reach the finish line.

4608240.title: Carpet Hero: Jet Hunter
4608240.short_description: Carpet Hero: Jet Hunter is an arcade action game where you ride a magical flying carpet and battle endless waves of deadly jet fighters. Dodge, shoot, and survive as long as you can in an intense sky battlefield.

4608380.title: Joy Malignant
4608380.short_description: A visceral dice-based RPG in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your past shapes your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique identity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

4608390.title: Cucumber Chat
4608390.short_description: Click, connect to the stream, and influence what’s going on — unlock activities and control clothing. Take interactivity to the maximum.

4608400.title: Qu Adra
4608400.short_description: Qu Adra” is a single‑player, 2D horror tabletop‑style game. Experience a deadly game of memory created by “Adra,” born from a warped ideology.

4608540.title: OVERRIDE PROTOCOL
4608540.short_description: Hack hostile AI systems in a cyberpunk hacker sim. Build proxy routes, poison live context, breach secured nodes, steal the payload, and wipe the logs before your trace burns.

4608760.title: Garden Cleanup Simulator
4608760.short_description: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

4608790.title: Clowny The Great Escape
4608790.short_description: Trapped in a nightmare house, you must escape Clowny, a blind but sound-sensitive stalker. Restore power, solve puzzles with realistic physics, and find multiple security codes to unlock the exit. Customize your experience with a deep Custom Mode. Stay quiet—he's listening.

4608850.title: Aetheris Core
4608850.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

4609040.title: Hook and Gun
4609040.short_description: A fast-paced 2D top-down action roguelike set in a rising industrial elevator. Use your grappling hook to snatch, corrupt, and turn enemy weapons against them. Battle through relentless waves of security robots, harvest scrap to unlock powerful upgrades and survive the ascent to escape the facility.

4609110.title: BULLET GIRL：ZOMBIE DEFENSE
4609110.short_description: Command a squad of five girls to defend against zombie hordes across ruined cities, forests, deserts, and labs! Deploy melee and ranged units, manage energy, and find the best tactics to hold the line. Features 4 stages, Endless Mode, and unlockable CG illustrations. A pixel-art tower defense game!

4609140.title: Betrot
4609140.short_description: A dark roguelike where you bet everything on a cursed roulette. Drink, smoke, break the rules, build insane synergies, meet brutal quotas — and survive the spin. Did I mention you smoke?

4609250.title: Click Click Brick
4609250.short_description: Click – Collect granules – Click – Make bricks – Brick – Start building Build your way to fame and glory in Click Click Brick, the Brick Simulator.

4609260.title: Card Pack Dungeon
4609260.short_description: A deck-building roguelike where you open card packs with limited funds, collect monsters, and defeat bosses as you climb to Floor 100.

4609330.title: Spirit Axis
4609330.short_description: A surreal dark-fantasy action adventure RPG built on an eightfold spiritual system, where sin, virtue, and balance shape your experience.

4609400.title: Errata
4609400.short_description: Survival Horror with first-person exploration in a dark, isolated forest. Flashlight-based gameplay; manage limited visibility as your light fades. Environmental storytelling through notes and subtle clues. Simple objective: find the key and unlock the door… before something finds you.

4609470.title: Heralds Of Heroism
4609470.short_description: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

4609500.title: Defense Front
4609500.short_description: A new charm of traditional tower defense.Hordes of unknown aliens have descended upon Earth. On dynamic scene maps, you need cleverly build defense towers to construct their path of advance, combine with controllable targeting strategies, and stop the aliens' assault.

4609540.title: ScaMMO
4609540.short_description: Incremental game where you play as a frustrated rich MMO veteran promising to make the next WoW killer. How far will you get before cashing out?

4609580.title: Pastelo
4609580.short_description: How about running your own pastel stand across Brazil? Fry your customers’ pastéis and be careful not to burn yourself! Travel through different regions of the country, discover new ingredients, and upgrade your stand to attract more and more customers along the way.

4609770.title: Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival
4609770.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4609770.short_description: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration.

4609800.title: Influencer Solitaire
4609800.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4609800.short_description: Play your cards and dice well to become an influencer! Start as nobody and choose your actions wisely to climb up the influence ladder.

4609830.title: Allelon
4609830.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4609830.short_description: Play as Ollie and Spade, a rebel and detective, on both sides of a high-profile murder case, in a dual-character investigative-stealth experience. Discover the secrets plaguing the citizens of Andropolis.

4609840.title: The Archmage Who Defeated the Demon King Wants to Be Ravaged by Mobs in a Peaceful World
4609840.short_description: Turn-based tactical puzzle where you don't kill monsters — you enrage them. The world's strongest archmage wants to lose, and designed an elaborate method to do it. Cast elemental spells, manipulate monster paths, push their rage to 100%. 11 monsters, 13 puzzle stages, 118+ illustrated CG scenes.

4609970.title: Write Night
4609970.short_description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

4610080.title: Bering Tonnage
4610080.short_description: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

4610110.title: Cowboy and Zombies
4610110.short_description: Survive waves of the undead in the Wild West! Blast zombies with revolver, shotgun, or assault rifle. Upgrade your weapons for higher chances of survival. Action-packed fun awaits!

4610180.title: Deep Hook
4610180.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4610180.short_description: Cast your line across five unique biomes! From a sun-drenched pond to the lightless Abyssal Deep. Hunt legendary fish, collect rare hats, and chase the perfect catch in this relaxing fishing RPG.

4610250.title: Featherless
4610250.short_description: You’re a duck. You’re armed. Everything wants you dead. Fair enough. Blast through hordes of enemies, discover ridiculous weapon combos, and grow stronger every run in this chaotic roguelike shooter.

4610270.title: Slime's Blacksmith
4610270.short_description: Forge powerful slimes, craft resources, and grow your blacksmith empire in this relaxing idle clicker. A simple yet addictive incremental game made by a solo developer.

4610300.title: 模联人
4610300.short_description: YongAn, 2008. A Model UN event in their youth, tangled with emotional conflicts and malicious incidents, changed the lives of all participants. Years later, people reunite and seek revenge. The game is adapted from real events，a visual novel with twists and rich layers.

4610380.title: Feather Rogue
4610380.short_description: Combine fire, water, and wind to survive in Feather Fall, a tactical roguelike deck builder. Experiment with elemental chemistry to trigger devastating chain reactions and unlock permanent upgrades through a vast skill tree. Every run offers new discoveries in this high-stakes strategic battle.

4610530.title: Spunky's Funhouse
4610530.short_description: Take the night shift at an abandoned funhouse once filled with laughter. Monitor dusty halls, respond to alarms, and survive roaming animatronic mascots. Each night grows darker as secrets surface… and something starts watching you back.

4610730.title: No Guess Minesweeper
4610730.short_description: Are you tired of Minesweeper games that depend on luck? Play No Guess Minesweeper for a logic-based experience with no guesswork required.

4610740.title: Driftborn
4610740.short_description: Race powerful creatures through a wild, futuristic frontier. Drift, boost, and compete in fast-paced multiplayer races while customizing and evolving your own unique mount.

4610780.title: Castle Clash
4610780.short_description: Build your fortress, control powerful weapons, and destroy your opponent in a PvP game combining construction, magic, and combat.

4610810.title: Nightmare Before BlackGate
4610810.short_description: Un incubo prende forma nella quiete della notte. Esplora una casa abbandonata e un inquietante cimitero mentre qualcosa ti osserva nell’oscurità. In Nightmare Before BlackGate, la realtà si deforma… e non sei mai solo.

4610870.title: NightFang
4610870.short_description: NightFang wears it's inspirations on it's sleeve.  It's an 80s/90s Anime/VHS inspired Shmup, rendered in delicious  3D that hypnotizes you into thinking it's 2D. Youth is a falling star. Rise up against the Crimson Scourge.

4610960.title: EcoMoguls
4610960.short_description: A card-management tabletop boardgame where players pursue long-term growth through careful risk management, strategic messaging, and a flexible approach to who absorbs the consequences.

4612230.title: Squid x Squid
4612230.short_description: Squid x Squid is a fast-paced arcade sports game. Blending competitive technical set-ups with the frantic chaos of party games, it's the soccer-basketball-squid hybrid you never knew you needed. Challenge your friends and blast, dash, dive, and taunt your way to squid stardom!

4612290.title: Beneath The Surface: Mermaid Hunter
4612290.short_description: Explore the deep ocean in your submarine, hunt human eating mermaids and sea creatures, destroy their hebitat for more loot. Craft gear to sell. Upgrade your sub to go deeper, but stay alert—the Deadly Badly Giant is also hunting you.

4612530.title: Birds Eat Bugs
4612530.short_description: One tree, two birds. One bird climbs up, one bird climbs down. Draw lines, circle bugs, feed them. If you don't care about scores, just draw and relax; if you aim at full combo, there are endless random challenge-mode levels. No matter what, enjoy the cute birds!

4612540.title: Lone Mining Engineer
4612540.short_description: This is a strategy game that fuses automated base building and real-time tower defense with FPS shooting elements. You, the only one who survived, will construct an automated base to build a spaceship, and while defending against approaching enemies, you aim to return to Earth.

4612650.title: Metro Anomaly
4612650.short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

4612810.title: バレットバラージュ-弾幕乱舞-　Bullet Barrge
4612810.short_description: Bullet Barrage is a competitive bullet-hell action game with simple one-button controls. Unleash powerful attacks while managing energy and spacing in fast-paced duels. Easy to learn yet deep, each character offers unique strategies across close, mid, and long-range combat.

4612870.title: Hard Edge - War Zone
4612870.short_description: HARD EDGE is back as a 4v4 real-time tactical card battler! Combine strategic deck-building with simultaneous team actions. Every turn, draw cards to shoot, throw, or defend. Sacrifice cards to move in a high-stakes tactical "WAR ZONE."

4612930.title: 谐了个音 - 这是谐音梗
4612930.short_description: 爆笑又上头的谐音梗猜词游戏！根据两张魔性图片，大开脑洞，猜出那些离谱而不失合理的谐音答案。挑战自己的汉字直觉，或是和朋友们一起集思广益，在笑声与崩溃之间找到那个恰到好处的"哦！原来如此！"

4613060.title: Demigod
4613060.short_description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Slay the Spire and Hades, where you build your deck from enemy abilities, recruit companions, and master tactical 4v4 battles as you grow stronger with every death.

4613080.title: The Exhibition
4613080.short_description: You just arrived on this Island to visit The Exhibition. Discover this place, alone, and it's challenging and surprizing puzzles.

4613450.title: 山河捍卫者
4613450.short_description: 《山河捍卫者》是一款互动影视游戏，亲历实现祖国统一的神圣时刻。爷爷在长津湖血战到底；父亲在撤侨中以身筑盾；而你，将与阴谋密布的“环保组织”博弈对垒，与狗急跳墙的分裂势力激烈交锋。三代使命，一脉传承。请用你的每一次选择，捍卫锦绣山河！

4613530.title: Cornerfall
4613530.short_description: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

4613620.title: The door has doubts
4613620.short_description: The Door Has Doubts is a very short and absurd narrative game about manipulation, dialogue, and the existential crisis of room furnitures. You are stuck in a room, there is a door. Your only way out: Convince the door to open. Choose your words carefully, as you try to escape the room.

4613720.title: Temperhall 1402
4613720.short_description: A medieval blacksmith guild management sim. Grow your workshop, forge items from horseshoes to swords, fulfill orders, and build reputation. Manage resources, track ore supplies, and train blacksmiths in new techniques.

4613730.title: Brooks Investment Simulator
4613730.short_description: Brooks Investment Simulator puts you in control of a real-money portfolio across 4 historical stock markets — from the 1980s Nikkei bubble to modern Wall Street — with 30 turns to beat the index or go broke.
developers: Brooks Innovation and Technology Consulting LLC
publishers: Brooks Innovation and Technology Consulting LLC

4613770.title: Otherlands
4613770.short_description: Fight back against AVARICE corp in this cozy farming sim meets dungeon crawler. Cultivate your land in Miracle Creek by day, then dive into the procedurally generated Otherlands to battle monsters and mine ores. Trade your loot to unbox your own unique tools.

4614050.title: Up There is Quiet
4614050.short_description: Roll, jump and climb out of a loud, restless city where one mistake can send you really far back. Fight cruel obstacles, strange forces, and your own patience on the way to the quieter place.

4614070.title: Gun Massacre
4614070.short_description: Return to Survival Horror in decaying mansion filled with echoes of broken glass.

4614080.title: Cartel Pilots Wanted
4614080.short_description: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.

4614120.title: Fiat Less
4614120.short_description: In aurora-drenched Moria Bay, reality fractures. As the Matron’s Executor, reclaim the Holy Grail. Fiat Less blends deck-building with grid tactics. Build from 180+ cards, collect relics, and forge synergies to survive grotesque foes.

4614170.title: The Element Ninjas
4614170.short_description: Dive into a legendary odyssey with The Element Ninjas. Six warriors, each wielding the power of a primordial and evolved element—fire, magic, earth, speed, thunder, and shadow—rise to confront the dark Lord Kou, who has stolen the sacred sphere that maintains harmony in the world.

4614230.title: The Fifth Bell: Frequency of Secrets
4614230.short_description: The Fifth Bell is a premium 2D point-and-click mystery adventure set in 1994 Europe. Investigate hidden mechanisms, decode historical clues, and stop a forbidden instrument before it is awakened.

4614410.title: Lonely Planet
4614410.short_description: A Sci fi looter shooter. You have crashed on a strange planet, your spaceship parts scattered across the mystical world. Collect weapons, explore the world, clear dungeons, interact with NPCs and fight bosses to save the planet's inhabitants and repair your ship!

4614430.title: Power Up!
4614430.short_description: Power Up is a single-player narrative/strategy game where you experience corporate life and grow stronger by defeating your bosses in strategic card battles. In each chapter, meet different coworkers, complete your company tasks, challenge your bosses, and RISE!

4614820.title: Exogear
4614820.short_description: Exogear is a high-speed 3D action-platformer inspired by classic games and anime.

4614860.title: Keep On Hashing!: Idle Mining Sim
4614860.short_description: Mine blocks. Earn Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin and Solana. Hire 20 helpers who mine while you sleep. Upgrade rigs from USB sticks to quantum machines. Climb a 22-node skill tree. Overclock everything. Prestige and chase the next zero. It never ends — and you won't want it to.

4614930.title: Chrono Tower
4614930.short_description: Tokinotou is a soulslike command RPG focused on 1-on-1 mind games. Read your enemy, choose the best response, raise your win rate, and kill at 100%. Build your own playstyle with stats, equipment, skills, and magic as you climb a tower twisted by time.

4614940.title: Space Suits
4614940.short_description: Explore the galaxy. Unearth ancient technology. Recruit, train and command your crew – or maroon them on a nearby comet to save oxygen. Play as a lost spacefarer in this golden age sci-fi adventure - can you find your path home?

4614980.title: The Honored Wife
4614980.short_description: In The Honored Wife, you play as Graham Hargrove, a respected architect whose flawless life begins to crack. After twenty years of marriage, three encounters open three doors, and one irreversible choice will reveal whether goodness is who you are or just what you perform.

4615140.title: Trader's Life: Medieval Shop
4615140.short_description: Step behind the counter in an immersive medieval trading simulation. Buy low, haggle hard, and sell high! Upgrade gear at the blacksmith, infuse your goods with elemental magic, and research new skills to transform your humble stall into the realm's most famous marketplace.

4615240.title: Little Joe the Dodger
4615240.short_description: A high-difficulty puzzle action game featuring monochrome minimalist graphics and extremely simple controls — you can only jump.

4615470.title: Numbers Go Up
4615470.short_description: The 2048 roguelike. Numbers Go Up is a dangerously addictive deckbuilder where you slide tiles, build absurd combos with game-warping mods, and watch your score explode.

4615680.title: The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia
4615680.short_description: An interrogation mystery aboard a 1936 ocean liner. Five suspects. One murder. No dialogue options — every suspect is powered by AI and will remember every word, deflect every question, and only surrender their secrets under pressure. Four voyages. One truth. Break someone.

4615730.title: Endless Maze

4615730.short_description: This is a first-person 3D maze-themed casual game. The game features many different interesting mazes, each with its own characteristics. Each level is relatively short, focusing on the fun of the maze. Additionally, it also offers randomly generated traditional mazes of selectable sizes.

4615810.title: Periodic Lottery
4615810.short_description: “Periodic Table Lottery” combines lottery-style gameplay with the periodic table. Place bets, earn rewards, complete level objectives, and see how far you can go!

4615870.title: Kromex
4615870.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4615870.short_description: Conquer. Control. Dominate. A fast-paced, competitive territory game where every tile you claim brings you closer to victory, and every second of inattention can turn the tide completely.

4615880.title: Cursed Clouds 64
4615880.short_description: Cursed Clouds 64 is a 90’s inspired 3D-Collectathon featuring a cute little cat-magician accompanied by a grumpy book. Jump and run through a variety of worlds to free the world from an evil fog. Unlock new worlds and learn magic spells from lost bookpages to reach hidden places.

4615930.title: Hentai Clicker: Mila is streaming
4615930.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Mila is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Mila, a seductive spy who loves playing with secrets… and attention!

4615950.title: !CHESS
4615950.short_description: !Chess reimagines chess as a tactical battle of health, attacks, and step-by-step commands. Instead of instant captures, pieces can be commanded to any valid tile and then advance one step per turn, turning movement, combat, and board control into a deeper tactical battle.

4615970.title: Might of Fate
4615970.short_description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

4616300.title: Celestial Routes
4616300.short_description: A sci-fi space flight, exploration, and survival game in third person. Survival is important in this universe, both physically and economically. Exploring different planets, spacestations, and debris areas, and surface facilities is the key part for scavenging and collecting materials and tools.

4616360.title: Anachronistic Survivors
4616360.short_description: Something shattered time. Survivors from every era fight waves of temporal aberrations in a dark arena. Combine weapons from across history to forge powerful fusions. 9 base weapons. 36 fusions. 6 characters. Every run is different.

4616370.title: FinalDefense
4616370.short_description: A 2D comic-style survivor-like game featuring a third-person perspective. Endless hordes of enemies swarm from the edges of the screen—hold the line and survive the final 15 minutes!

4616540.title: Void Runner
4616540.short_description: Fast-paced arcade game where you must dodge deadly obstacles, collect power-ups, and survive as long as possible to beat your high score.

4616620.title: Bug Fishin'
4616620.short_description: It's time for the Great Bug Feast! Find your wandering fishlings and catch all the bugs you need to host the perfect dinner.

4616690.title: Outta Space
4616690.short_description: Where is your cat flying right now? Outta Space is an idle game where a tiny cat explores the universe from your desktop corner. Every keystroke, every click fuels the spaceship. From the Moon, past the solar system, to distant stars. Come back and see how far your lovely cat has gone.

4616770.title: cursor+cursor
4616770.short_description: cursor+cursor is a fast-paced arena shooter where you don't control one avatar... but two at the same time! Move your pair of cursors around, upgrade your equipment and create unique builds to survive, all the while enjoying a "minimalist cyberpunk-ish" vibe.

4616780.title: Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales
4616780.short_description: Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales offers a unique blend of farming and survival. Build your own farm and survive the wild. Complete quests, rescue your loyal dog, and experience an epic rural adventure with up in online co-op.

4616820.title: Shard Defender: Rogue
4616820.short_description: Protect your crystal at all costs! Build your defense line, upgrade your abilities, and fight against endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced survival game that blends fluid FPS action, tower defense strategy, and roguelike mechanics.

4616910.title: Vampire's Shire
4616910.short_description: Vampire Shire is an arcade roguelike. Construct and evolve the county to break the score through explosive synergies. Combine blood strains to customize your power-ups, and build structures to control the shire and free yourself from Dracula's grasp.

4616940.title: Hexroads
4616940.short_description: Build your kingdom by day and survive the night. Hexroads is a mix of RTS with random roguelite runs. Capture new lands, route your armies, cast powerful spells, and develop relationships with other factions. New quests and perks each dawn.

4616970.title: S-Ranker
4616970.short_description: Fight through short dungeon runs, shape your build through your choices, and rise on the path from F-Rank to S-Rank.

4617040.title: Backrooms: Into the Hole
4617040.short_description: Explore a liminal space inspired by the Backrooms. Progress by jumping into holes, find alternative paths, and survive deadly entities. Play solo or in co-op and choose your way out… if there is one.

4617090.title: Farm Harbeest
4617090.short_description: Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed little bee, fight, harvest, collect resources, and keep upgrading as your firepower, efficiency, and harvesting range grow out of control.

4617310.title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
4617310.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

4617350.title: ASTALA MUERTE
4617350.short_description: Step into the shadows of the past in this third-person survival horror game inspired by the golden age of PS1/PS2-era classics. Set in the 1990s, you’ll explore a forgotten underground laboratory where something went horribly wrong: dinosaurs walk again, and you're trapped in the aftermath.

4617430.title: John
4617430.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer focused on precise movement, where you jump, dash, and fight through handcrafted levels, defeat enemies and bosses, and improve your skills to progress through increasingly challenging stages.

4617470.title: Choose Your Paul!
