4617470.short_description: Build bizarre Pauls. Break the run. Choose Your Paul is a strategic roguelite auto battler where you choose a unique Trainer, capture strange creatures called Pauls, craft powerful synergies through positioning and upgrades, and push through branching routes filled with battles, elites, shops, events, and bosses.

4617500.title: Revenant Survivors
4617500.short_description: Mow down relentless hordes in this action horde survival roguelite with impactful combat. Absorb souls, steal boss skills and bodies, and unleash devastating boss-powered builds as you become evil incarnate.

4617610.title: Storm Clan
4617610.short_description: Medieval Viking sea combat reverse bullet hell deckbuilder. Command a longship in roguelike runs: build devastating card decks, dodge swarms of enemies, unleash naval mayhem. Viking mythology meets intense top-down action. Permadeath. One run, one legend.

4617640.title: Keeb Quest: Typing Battles
4617640.short_description: Keeb Quest is a typing game where your keyboard is your weapon. Battle enemies, defeat bosses, and explore Choose Your Own Adventure stories - all while sharpening your typing skills. Multiple game modes, combos, and achievements keep every keypress counting.

4619100.title: GNAW
4619100.short_description: Gnaw is a FPS where you fight an ever growing horde of monsters with a "gun-game" like model for earning new weapons. More kills will earn you stronger weapons. As time progresses, the monsters will become harder to kill and more agile, so take them out as fast as you can before they outpace you!

4619160.title: Dungeons of Delveria
4619160.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where terrain is your tool—create hazards, block paths, and outsmart deadly encounters. Discover terrain powers which help you to turn the dungeon against your enemies.

4619190.title: The Last (Hotdog) Stand
4619190.short_description: Run your own hotdog stand in this fast-paced food management game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

4619230.title: Rescue the Hostages: Misaligned Fate
4619230.short_description: Race against the clock in this gripping FMV horror puzzle where every move could be your last. Solve a deadly sliding-tile challenge, uncover hidden clues, and disarm the bomb while a twisted mastermind watches your every mistake. Can you keep your nerve and save the hostages?

4619340.title: BUBBLE BOI
4619340.short_description: BUBBLE BOI is a puzzle platformer where the protagonist cannot move. Play as a bubble magician, use bubble mechanics to explore a surreal, pantomime-style fantasy world, retrieve your bow tie, and perform a magic show on stage.

4619430.title: No Fap Island 2
4619430.short_description: Flirt, seduce and fuck your way through gorgeous ladies on this bizarre reality TV show. The island's back. The girls are hotter. Can you survive another season without losing your mind — or your shorts?

4619500.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
4619500.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

4619700.title: Tonkatsu Diner Simulator
4619700.short_description: You are the owner of a small tonkatsu restaurant. Manage everything from purchasing ingredients and cooking to customer service and running the business, and grow your restaurant into a popular success.

4619810.title: Vatan
4619810.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

4619820.title: Dungeon Buddy
4619820.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4619820.short_description: A tiny pixel hero lives in the corner of your screen, automatically exploring dungeons. Check in to manage loot, combine relics, and risk equipment upgrades. Progress continues even when closed! A desktop idle RPG companion for busy people.

4619920.title: Washed Ashore
4619920.short_description: The island was never meant to be found. Whatever is being contained in the lighthouse knows you're here. Do what it takes to get off the island. Escape or Perish.

4619930.title: Reversi2048
4619930.short_description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough — if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

4620190.title: Ebon Crucible
4620190.genre: Action, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play, Early Access
4620190.short_description: The arena where excuses die. Five classes, 63 abilities, ranked 1v1 and 2v2 where skill is all you have. Battle pass, live spectating, full crossplay. Free to play.

4620280.title: Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life (Reimagined)
4620280.short_description: The album "Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life (Reimagined)" is a remake of the original album that was released many years ago back in 2002. Journey through the map and experience each song with it's own animated background and music.

4620320.title: Okinawa Soba Simulator
4620320.short_description: A 3D simulation game where you run an Okinawa soba shop by yourself, handling orders, cooking, serving, and payments efficiently.

4620420.title: Void Commander: Armada
4620420.short_description: Lead your fleet in a roguelite auto-battler where commanders define your strategy. Build your armada, adapt every run, and survive against an overwhelming alien swarm.

4620430.title: Meet Me In The Well
4620430.short_description: Meet Me in the Well is a frantic 4-player local arena shooter. Drop in with a revolver loaded with 6 bullets from a huge arsenal of effects, spin the chamber, and fire. Every shot pulls a random round. Some deal damage, some modify players or the arena, and some just make noise.

4620450.title: Valvontaa
4620450.short_description: Valvontaa is a sci-fi third-person action RPG set in the distant future. Interact with townsfolk and fight off hostile aliens to survive. Find unique armor and equipment to aid on your descent into the depths.

4620720.title: Tank POV
4620720.genre: Adventure, Free To Play, Early Access
4620720.short_description: You play as a little tank in a psychological horror game set in a bizarre world where tanks can devour each other, and are even treated as meat. Grilled, cooked, and served like ordinary food.

4620810.title: Clover Town Cozy Solitaire
4620810.short_description: Relax to soft music and play classic and new solitaire variants - perfectly adapted to beginners and advanced players.

4620970.title: 亡灵都WraithGather
4620970.short_description: Why did I wake up in a laboratory?It feels as though the world is being eroded by a mysterious force.How did things come to this?What choice should I make in such a world to survive or to perish?To give up, or to keep going?And as I set out to recover my memories,where exactly should I go from here.

4621010.title: Not Today: Homeless Survival
4621010.short_description: Survive 30 unforgiving days on the streets before a deadly blizzard hits. Hustle for change, dumpster dive, or risk it all by picking pockets and dodging cops. Balance your hunger, hygiene, and morale. The city doesn't care if you live or die, prove it wrong.

4621210.title: Stream Empire: Platform Simulator
4621210.short_description: Build and manage your own streaming empire. License content, hire talent, negotiate sponsors, set subscription prices, and outmaneuver rival platforms across five industry eras. Every decision shapes your path to dominance — or bankruptcy.

4621230.title: 问鼎仙台（Ascend to Immortal Throne）
4621230.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4621230.short_description: “Ascend to Immortal Throne" is an open-world cultivation game. You will experience an authentic cultivation world with true lineage: cultivate alongside your sect members. Fight your way through sect wars, or choose the path of a lone cultivator—free and unrestrained—pursuing the Great Dao.

4621370.title: Orderbound
4621370.short_description: After the catastrophe, order survives only beneath the Church's iron rule. As a wandering bishop, pass judgment by day and confront the nightmares born of human emotion by night. Every choice tips the balance between order and chaos, shaping the fate of the world.

4621400.title: Hang Out
4621400.short_description: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

4621410.title: ScreenSaver Idle
4621410.short_description: That bouncing screensaver you've been staring at? It's a game now. Watch EVE ricochet across the screen, hit that corner, and unleash a flood of resources — then build your idle empire one bounce at a time.

4621450.title: Lofi Cozy Room
4621450.short_description: The first 3D lofi room that lives on your desktop. Decorate, focus, and chill — with cozy lighting, lo-fi music, and built-in productivity tools. Your tiny world sits beside your work, never blocking it.

4621560.title: SnakeyBoss
4621560.short_description: Try your best to dodge and get a high score. Move with WASD! If you touch the boss's body, the snake bodies summoned by the boss, or the stone pillars summoned by the boss, your body will be severed or you will die. Eat apples to grow bigger! Push bombs at the boss to earn points!

4621590.title: Dereology Chime
4621590.short_description: A 2D romance adventure set in a Japanese high school. Explore the campus freely, build your relationship with the heroine through your actions and choices, and uncover the legend of the “Bell of Lovers,” said to ring only for couples bound by true love.

4621610.title: Pentabit Copy-X
4621610.short_description: Pentabit Copy-X is a 90s Amiga themed puzzle game with roguelike elements. Edit and enhance your pieces, copy your data and defeat the glitches and IRQs. Test your skill in the benchmark or endless mode.

4621700.title: Monster Masher
4621700.short_description: Drop monsters. Merge monsters. Pray the pit doesn't overflow. Monster Masher is a cozy-yet-chaotic puzzle game where matching creatures fuse into bigger beasts. Build combos, fight bosses, and pretend you're not addicted. You are though. Fr fr.

4621740.title: Lotto.exe
4621740.short_description: "99% of gamblers quit right before they hit it big. This game is for the other 1%." The ultimate test of human stubbornness. Lotto.exe isn't a "game" in the traditional sense. It is a simulation of a lottery draw designed to determine exactly how much your time is worth to you.

4621850.title: Beast Survivor 3D
4621850.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

4621900.title: Laptop Architect
4621900.short_description: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

4622010.title: Road Defense Racing
4622010.short_description: High-speed vehicular combat racing set in the world of Road Defense: Outsiders. Drive, shoot, destroy, and upgrade your car across 30 challenging tracks. Battle armed rivals and survive attacks from a hostile crowd while earning cash to upgrade your vehicle.

4622160.title: Arise Dark Lord
4622160.short_description: You are The Dark Lord! Raise an evil army, and crush the race of men. An action-strategy hybrid RTS, blending tower defence, base building and direct control of your Dark Lord avatar, currently in early development.

4622180.title: HyphoSphere
4622180.short_description: A fungal idle game where you grow a mycelial empire from a single filament. Click to harvest nutrients, build living organisms, trigger sporulation to prestige, and let your Twitch viewers join the network.

4622300.title: Undercurrent
4622300.short_description: Undercurrent is a hand-drawn sci-fi adventure set in 2250 where you play as a diplomat on a rescue mission. Use holo-tech to navigate an alien ocean planet, interact via branching dialogue to figure out what broke the crew you came to save. Can you get them out before you lose yourself?

4622350.title: Reflex This!
4622350.short_description: A fast-paced reflex game with multiple modes—hit the highlights, spot the odd one out, and master sequences. Chain combos, chase high scores, and survive the pressure.

4622890.title: Oneiron Expanse
4622890.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

4623010.title: PARRALYSIS
4623010.short_description: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

4623310.title: Charm And Clue 2 Collector's Edition
4623310.short_description: Charm & Clue 2 - detective puzzles, hidden clues, and secrets everywhere

4623340.title: Unleash
4623340.short_description: Unleash devastating spell combos on formidable enemies, discover super-powerful talismans in crates with random loot, and help Robyn fight her way through a mining starship in stasis caused by a mysterious event.

4623360.title: Max's Jungle Odyssey
4623360.short_description: Enjoy a 2D platforming adventure with 3D graphics starring Max, a brave cat. Experience over 30 levels and an exciting storyline in single-player or local multiplayer. What are you waiting for? The Kikis won't save themselves!

4623540.title: Clickomorph
4623540.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

4623600.title: The Wrong Ones
4623600.short_description: The Wrong Ones is a single-player social deduction game where you study characters dialogue, detect contradictions, and uncover Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight. Analyze each claim carefully and decide who can be trusted before making your final accusation.

4623640.title: I Died as a Virgin and My Sex Life Began Once I Became a Ghost!
4623640.short_description: A supernatural adult game where you’re a ghost trapped in a house of dangerously tempting women. Explore, seduce, and indulge in interactive sexual encounters.

4623860.title: Netfall
4623860.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Build devastating decks from 250+ hackware cards. Master 5 hacker identities. Breach corporate networks. Die, learn, repeat.

4624020.title: A Love Like Broken Glass
4624020.short_description: You're an exorcist. Lorenn's a half-ghost. It's up to you to find out what's wrong with his soul and exorcise him once and for all... Just try not to fall in love in the process, would you?

4624130.title: Scourge of Eldryngard
4624130.short_description: Tactical deckbuilder meets the hunt for ancient items. In a dark medieval setting where archaic technology reigns, your survival depends on engineering your deck and the tactical precision of your items. Explore Eldryngard, conquer epic equipment, and master the combat system.

4624140.title: Murder Castle
4624140.short_description: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

4624150.title: Rotten Angel
4624150.short_description: Rotten Angel is a psychological horror game blending dark fantasy and survival. Delve into a corrupted divine trap, evade nightmarish entities, and fight to maintain your sanity in an oppressive world where every shadow is a threat.

4624230.title: Whale Cleaner
4624230.short_description: Mr. Blue, a giant whale, has arrived at your deep-sea station, and he’s covered in grime! Experience a deeply satisfying cleaning ASMR: scrape off barnacles and peel away toxic jellyfish in a cozy bio-industrial setting. Just make sure your grumpy boss, Mr. Claw, doesn't catch you slacking!

4624320.title: Man-U-Facture
4624320.short_description: Man-U-Facture is a short, casual factory game about making furniture out of random materials. Using the powers of unpaid interns, make chairs out of wacky items from rusty metal to hyper-dense stars!

4624340.title: Invaders Evolutions
4624340.short_description: 100 levels. One final boss. No careless mistakes. Survive an escalating arms race in this retro-industrial reimagining of the 1978 classic. Out-tech a mutating swarm, manage your reserves, and master a loop where every failed defense makes the enemy stronger.

4624510.title: RoofTown
4624510.short_description: RoofTown is a game about surviving after being chased onto the rooftop by your cat. Build, farm, and expand your home. When night falls, venture below to scavenge, fight, and deal with the mean cats who kicked you out.

4624530.title: Immortal Cards
4624530.short_description: A Xianxia Roguelike deckbuilder. 3 cultivators, 214 cards, 42 relics, 12 formations. Master Five Elements combat across 3 acts. 9 endings, 21 difficulty levels. Every run is unique.

4624560.title: Chest Buster
4624560.short_description: An incremental battle game where destroying treasure chests instantly brings item effects into battle to fight enemies. A little luck may be required.

4624610.title: To-Doodle
4624610.short_description: A game that truly lets you slack off while working—what could fool your boss better than a game disguised as a to-do list? No more sneaking in a few rounds when they’re not looking. This game lets you procrastinate out in the open.

4624680.title: Lust: Secret House
4624680.short_description: A choice-driven adult visual novel with high-quality 3D graphics where you are trapped in a house with two attractive women due to a quarantine. Manage the rising tension, alter the story's course with critical decisions, and explore hidden desires in this isolated home.

4624870.title: Wife Life : Secret
4624870.short_description: Shape the story of a happy wife in a happy marriage, your choices matter!, so choose wisely!

4625170.title: Dice N Grids
4625170.short_description: Strategically place dice on a grid, roll for points, and create combos to reach or lower the target score.

4625300.title: STAFFUP
4625300.short_description: Two friends turn their new startup into a quadrillionaire corp by hunting candidates in this local co-op cozy incremental top-down shooters. Suck candidates, collect blueprints, register patents, and renovate the office into a massive corporate cashing machine while firing employees along the way.

4625340.title: 寝取らせ温泉旅行
4625340.short_description: これは成人向けの日本のビジュアルノベルです。 本作品には性的な表現が含まれており、成人向けです。

4625460.title: SkyVeil
4625460.short_description: A meditative puzzle game about a ruler who devoted his life to a dream of flight. Arrange and combine illustrated panels to awaken an ancient city hidden in the clouds — and uncover the secret it has kept for centuries.

4625730.title: BlockNBullets
4625730.short_description: A short incremental game where you destroy a series of blocks, earn coins, buy upgrades, improve your bullets, game time, blocks, increase coins. Unleash your power!

4625850.title: Unknown Horizons
4625850.short_description: Unknown Horizons is a retro styled top-down space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home.

4625860.title: Sneak Kicks: Underground Shop Simulator
4625860.short_description: Build your underground sneaker empire! Source raw materials, manufacture flawless replicas of the hottest shoes on the market, and sell them directly from your storefront. Grow your business, but keep a low profile—the cops are always watching!

4625970.title: The Hawk of Circuit
4625970.short_description: Survive this grueling race where your rivals drop out one by one!

4626000.title: Left Fore Dead: Zombie Battle Golf
4626000.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies keep showing up and your friends make everything worse.

4626030.title: 视讯判官：水军指挥官
4626030.short_description: Just released from prison, former top-tier celebrity Fanfan becomes your first major assignment. As the paid comment syndicate leader, you take on this mission and gradually grow into the underground PR master handling various social public opinion incidents!

4626170.title: LISIA
4626170.short_description: Drive your truck on deadly roads. Use the winch, build bridges, and spray-paint the body. Reach the summit alone or in co-op with friends. And remember the main rule: don't look down!

4626300.title: Valdrax Beyond the Rift
4626300.short_description: Build a kingdom from nothing, forge your armies, and breach the rifts between worlds. Face endless enemies, recruit legendary creatures, and prepare for the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord. Every map is different. Every death is permanent.

4626410.title: 开局养成满级修士
4626410.short_description: idle sandbox game Create and expand your faction. Deploy various units, manage gold resources, and expand your territory. Guide your units through progressive level breakthroughs. Freely combine a variety of weapons (such as swords, staffs, etc.) and magic to shape each unit’s unique combat style.

4626420.title: Real Life Simulator
4626420.short_description: Rise to the top of trade with your friends! Buy and sell second-hand goods, establish a car dealership, manage the real estate market, and own the biggest businesses in the city. Real Life Simulator combines all trading simulations in a 2D Co-op world.

4626470.title: Dustline
4626470.short_description: A brutal 8–10 minute roguelike where one wrong choice ends everything. Explore a dead world. Make decisions. Survive… or start over.

4626560.title: Vienkiemis
4626560.short_description: VIENKIEMIS is a hardcore multiplayer survival game set in the early 2000s rural Lithuania. In a world ravaged by a mutated virus, you must scavenge for resources, build your base, and survive against both the infected and other players.

4626570.title: Fixpert
4626570.short_description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

4626700.title: Office Shoe Slinger
4626700.short_description: "Live the Dream" of throwing shoes at your coworker's faces. Just imagine the text bubbles are Steve from accounting.

4626950.title: Grow/Tend/Reap
4626950.short_description: Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back. Your farm IS your deck. Grow crops. Tend fields. Reap what you sow.

4628630.title: Vertical Momentum Revival
4628630.short_description: Engage in fast paced vertical PVP combat. Jump straight into the action on the rooftops, or flank your enemy through the alleyways below. Choose from a variety of movement abilities to compliment your playstyle. Play any existing maps, or create your own!

4628690.title: No Register
4628690.short_description: Cross the threshold between existence and non-existence in search of a forbidden singularity. Decipher the logic of an abstract realm, solve puzzles, and survive the vigilance of the Guardians who protect this domain. Accept the destiny set before you or break the silence to forge your own.

4628700.title: Renegade Run
4628700.short_description: Renegade Run is a rogue-lite deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

4628760.title: Standard Human Pizza
4628760.short_description: Pizza simulator meets horror. Serve the monsters, survive the anomalies, and use secret ingredients to exterminate your clientele.

4628800.title: GeoFlag
4628800.short_description: A geography game for the curious. Match flags. Place countries. Race the daily challenge. Four game modes covering 154 countries, with two visual themes — vintage parchment or modern aerial — to set the mood.

4628820.title: Beam it up, Blorp!
4628820.short_description: A charming and cozy creature collector, where you play as Blorp the alien scout piloting a UFO, and, as the name suggests, you BEAM THINGS UP!

4628980.title: Briar And Brew : A Bowl of Time
4628980.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4628980.short_description: A cyberpunk narrative RPG blending ASMR shop sim and auto-battler cards. By day, pack tobacco and brew drinks, using Eastern philosophy to rewrite the fates of lost souls. By night, win hardcore card battles to earn funds. In an era of KPIs, stage a gentle rebellion.

4629100.title: MC Chopped's Melee Mayhem
4629100.short_description: 36 fighters. 16-round tournaments. Pure local chaos. MC Chopped’s Melee Mayhem is a massive 2D indie brawler built for competitive grit. Master an eclectic roster, track deep combat stats, and dominate the Champions Board. High-intensity combat meets deep stat tracking in the ultimate arena.

4629170.title: Epic Action Packs
4629170.short_description: Become a master of Deckscovery when you combine cards, build your Master Deck and defeat the Deck Master while avoiding elemental weaknesses!

4629400.title: Somewhere Café
4629400.short_description: A desktop ambient music player with 32 cities, 320 tracks — each with its own sound, from the noise of arrival to the silence of 3AM.

4629500.title: Starherald
4629500.genre: Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4629500.short_description: Explore thousands of planets, gather resources, craft warships, and battle space pirates. Form factions, conquer worlds, and build your galactic empire in this vast sci-fi sandbox. Captain — are you ready?

4629630.title: You Ain’t the Hero
4629630.short_description: Live your life instead of saving the world in this top-down action RPG.

4629650.title: Sketchy Sprouts
4629650.short_description: Fight the always "Growing" onslaught of evil plants in the cozy hand-drawn roguelike bullet hell Sketchy Sprouts. Play as a bunny planting seeds to add would you rather style modifiers making it easier or harder depending on what you choose.

4629790.title: catfish
4629790.short_description: Fish up adorable enchanted fish, travel with lovable pets, and set off on cozy roguelike adventures filled with gentle surprises. Meet quirky visitors, receive blessings from gods, shape your build, and grow stronger through each warm and whimsical new journey.

4629850.title: Project ACCIPITER
4629850.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

4629870.title: Astronine
4629870.short_description: Place cards into a 3×3 grid and unleash chain reactions driven by position and synergy. A roguelike deckbuilder where every placement matters—optimize your layout, build powerful combos, and create explosive, constellation-like scoring plays.

4629920.title: Backrooms: Echo
4629920.short_description: A co-op horror for 1–4 players inspired by the Backrooms. Procedurally generated levels, terrifying entities, and a realistic atmosphere powered by Unreal Engine 5. Every playthrough is a unique experience. Try to find the way out, but don’t trust everything you hear and see.

4629950.title: I am a Taxi Driver
4629950.genre: Action, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Early Access
4629950.short_description: Step into the chaotic life of the world’s most questionable taxi driver and dive into a city where every passenger is a new disaster waiting to happen. In I Am a Taxi Driver, nothing is normal, everything is unpredictable, and your job is simply to survive the ride…

4629980.title: Still Life Inside
4629980.short_description: Descend 7 floors of a decaying building in this psychological horror visual novel. Confront fears through unique mini-games, collect memory fragments, and question the voice in your head. Will you face the chilling truth or remain trapped in a self-made nightmare?

4630030.title: PieceMonsters
4630030.short_description: Monster Raising × Tower Defense × Puzzle. Build your team of unique monsters, power them up with puzzle-like equipment, and defeat waves of incoming enemies!

4630400.title: Directors cut: Train
4630400.short_description: A narrative 2D single-player game about working in an underground tobacco shop, funding a collapsing film project, taking on tasks, exploring a dangerous city, and watching reality gradually break apart.

4630420.title: Zetrya: Dungeon Dive
4630420.short_description: A group of adventurers work their way through a dungeon with the goal of clearing it. Finding new threats along the way.

4630550.title: Blood Clicker
4630550.short_description: Blood Clicker is a simple idle clicker game where you collect blood, buy upgrades, grow your income, and keep progressing even while offline.

4630570.title: RUNNING TRAIN | 走ル列車！
4630570.short_description: New realistic 3DCG Train Game is here! Step into the crew's cabin and immerse yourself as train operator. Navigate 40km+ across Japanese Rural Railway with breathtakingly detailed scenery through the seaside and heart of countryside.

4630580.title: Reel Clicker
4630580.short_description: A frantic clicker with a roguelike soul. Risk your progress in high-stakes runs, unlock illegal upgrades, and dominate the dopamine black market.

4630680.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
4630680.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

4630710.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom
4630710.short_description: A first-person psychological horror about a failed research expedition in the Backrooms. Explore distorted levels, follow the traces of your missing team, and uncover what happened.

4630940.title: Okeyto
4630940.short_description: Okeyto is a roguelike deck-building game inspired by the classic Turkish board game 101 Okey, combining traditional tile-laying mechanics with incredible synergies.

4630980.title: Space Tram
4630980.short_description: Control a UFO through different levels, avoid obstacles, and bring your passengers safely to their destination in this fast-paced 2D arcade game.

4631010.title: A Lucky Hunt With : Aella
4631010.short_description: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Aella, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Aella's enticing layers.

4631070.title: Vroomity Loops
4631070.short_description: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

4631110.title: Trashy Cashy
4631110.short_description: Trashy Cashy is an incremental game where you make money from trash. Open packages manually, unlock and upgrade your weapons and automation features for more efficient opening and selling. Get rich!

4631120.title: Dead Hand
4631120.short_description: A brutal post-apocalyptic deckbuilder. Scavenge, survive, and fight through the dead world — every card is a resource, every run a last stand. How long can you hold on ?

4631200.title: Bring The Rift
4631200.short_description: Bring the Rift is a competitive puzzle-matcher blending frantic strategy with a Visual Novel narrative. Master unique skills to warp reality, launch attacks at rivals, and uncover the portal mystery in an epic story mode or intense local multiplayer duels.

4631340.title: Beyond The Gate
4631340.short_description: Explore a brutal medieval world, gather what you can, and return before nightfall to not lose it all.

4631400.title: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
4631400.short_description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

4631430.title: Hidden Rabbit 2
4631430.short_description: Explore the captivating hand-drawn artwork in unique settings, and in a theme park filled with rabbits, attempt to locate all 100 adorable rabbits hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

4631440.title: Luminara: The Second Dawn
4631440.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4631440.short_description: Raise your daughter as a traveling merchant through 11 years of monthly choices. Every decision shapes her career, her love, and her destiny across 50+ endings. Her future is in your hands.

4631800.title: ONLYFAPPER FEMBOYS
4631800.short_description: Four broke roommates, one month to pay rent, and a single camera. Can you turn your household into the internet's next viral sensation? ONLYFAPPER FEMBOYS is a character-driven visual novel about survival, romance, and the spicy world of adult content creation.

4631830.title: Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey
4631830.short_description: An unorthodox 3D collectathon adventure! Throw shiny objects, survive a roster of bizarre monsters, and guide Trunkey through a hostile and utterly unpredictable world! Keep your eyes on the prize, and stay sharp...

4631840.title: Deckrown
4631840.short_description: Deckrown: Where Poker meets dungeon crawling. In this tactical roguelite, traverse a shifting labyrinth alongside a sentient deck. Assemble devastating hands, overcome lethal trials, and reclaim the kingdom!

4631860.title: The HOUSE
4631860.short_description: Inspired by Balatro and Vampire Survivors. In every casino game, the house always wins. In The HOUSE, you are the casino. A NY mob family runs the most crooked casino in Vegas — and you're their engineer. Rig the machines, break the odds, and launder a fortune one gloriously broken payout at a time.

4631970.title: The Day I Started Harvesting
4631970.short_description: An idle clicker game where a simple harvest grows into something far stranger. Expand your fields, hire workers, and survive pests, storms, and bizarre events as your peaceful routine slowly turns into chaos.

4632110.title: Picklemania: The Ultimate Showdown
4632110.short_description: Arcade-style pickleball game focused on fast, skill-based rallies. Move, aim, and time shots to control ball trajectory and outplay the opponents. Pick up a paddle and head straight in an intensive match!

4632210.title: Heroes, Warlords and Ruin
4632210.short_description: Create your hero, manage resources, raise armies and build an empire. This fantasy turn-based 4x strategy game features empire management, large-scale tactical battles, and RPG mechanics.

4632380.title: Tear Them All
4632380.short_description: Tear through waves of doodle enemies with your sharp pencil. A fast-paced, stylized arena shooter set in a chaotic notebook realm.

4632470.title: Crownseeker
4632470.short_description: Hunt relics by day and night across a fog-shrouded world. Manage hunger. Gear up. Outlast or defeat what's hunting you. Collect all the relics — and the Crown appears. If you survive long enough to claim it.

4632550.title: Necromancer's Army
4632550.short_description: A dark narrative idle game where your clicks fuel a ritual that begins to answer back. Raise minions, harvest souls, and push deeper into a pact that shouldn't exist. Five acts, three endings, and an Endless Mode.

4632630.title: Hansi auf Sylt
4632630.short_description: A fast-paced platforming adventure set on a sunny island – jump, aim, and react quickly to overcome challenging obstacles.

4632690.title: Papers or Death ⏱️
4632690.short_description: Screen travelers in a post-war world where lies are common. Check documents, spot inconsistencies, and decide who passes. Take bribes or stay honest—your choices shape the outcome. No action, just tension, tough calls, and hidden truths.

4632750.title: Coldblooded
4632750.short_description: After crash landing in the midst of a catastrophic orbital battle, take on the role of a reptilian alien in this non-linear 2D puzzle adventure game.

4632810.title: Road To Majesty
4632810.short_description: A journey of redemption through a dying world. Break through mazes filled with traps and the Horsemen of the Apocalypse, solve tactical puzzles, and evolve unique abilities. Forge your own Road to Majesty — or create a new trial for others.

4633010.title: HackSaw
4633010.short_description: HackSaw is a cooperative puzzle-survival game for 2-5 players where you solve deadly traps together—or shove a friend into one. Navigate group dynamics, and decide who lives and who doesn't.

4633090.title: Misa Online
4633090.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4633090.short_description: Survive in dark worlds opened by Portal Stones. Explore vast maps, battle unique creatures, strengthen your class, and shape your own destiny against the approaching war.

4633120.title: Voxotron
4633120.short_description: Go faster than your brain can process. Survive an ultra-speed race around a rotating cosmic cylinder where every decision is already too late.

4633230.title: Wild West Furry - Hentai Jigsaw
4633230.short_description: Explore the Wild West like never before! Solve challenging puzzles featuring stunning furry girls, unlock exclusive artworks, and enjoy a relaxing yet enticing experience.

4633270.title: Valor Framer
4633270.short_description: Build your team, master diverse Valor frames, and influence the continent through strategic battles and ever-changing adventures. Valor Framer is a turn-based monster-taming roguelike JRPG.

4633410.title: Light's Call
4633410.short_description: Dive into Light's Call, a fast-paced action-adventure game in which you play as Eilly, an elementalist who can control fire, ice and lightning. Change elements constantly to create elemental reactions and defeat hordes of enemies as you explore the depths of a corrupted mine!

4633610.title: Lost Emblem of Time
4633610.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4633610.short_description: A retro 8-bit JRPG with turn-based combat and a story-driven adventure. Explore a vast world filled with dangerous enemies, mini-games, hidden treasures, and diverse locations. Grow stronger, uncover secrets, and experience an emotional journey that expands as you progress.

4633660.title: Split Fate
4633660.short_description: Split Fate is a 2D co-op game for two players where you control fire and ice characters. Work together to solve puzzles, fight enemies, and progress through levels. Success depends on teamwork, timing, and coordination between both players.

4633680.title: Mercenary Brotherhood
4633680.short_description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

4633690.title: World of Aurea
4633690.short_description: Aurea is what happens when you cross Pokémon: Emerald with The Witcher 3. A story-rich, creature-collector RPG set in a pixel art world shaped by eight gods. Bond with Prodiga, explore the vast open-world, and uncover why the government has begun confiscating every bonded creature in the land.

4633710.title: Melody Teacher
4633710.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

4634040.title: Echoes of the Scourge
4634040.short_description: Every year, a festival is held to celebrate the founding of Springure, a small and quaint town. Odette, a girl grieving a dear friend, suddenly finds herself in an empty, distorted version of her hometown.

4634070.title: Memories of the Pinewood Islands
4634070.short_description: "Memories of the Pinewood Islands" is a cozy walking sim and treasure hunting game where you explore the hauntingly gorgeous Pinewood Islands in search of some missing artefacts belonging to the Good King Harold. Immerse yourself in this rich and ethereal world to solve the realm's greatest mystery,

4634140.title: Centurion's Gambit
4634140.short_description: Command a living chess army across ancient battlefields in this tactical roguelike. Level up your pieces, unlock abilities, gamble with NPCs, and conquer 5 campaigns solo or with 2-4 players in local co-op. Push your limits in endless mode, or clash in arena. Every piece matters. Every move counts.

4634190.title: Mimic Escape
4634190.short_description: In this fun Sokoban-style puzzle game, you play as a Mimic yearning for freedom! You must cleverly plan your moves to avoid deadly traps, patrolling guards, and greedy adventurers. Featuring 60+ meticulously designed levels, the game offers a perfect blend of strategy and mind-bending challenges.

4634490.title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
4634490.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in under 4 hours.

4634560.title: Carpet Cleaning Simulator
4634560.short_description: Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game. Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

4634570.title: Widget Idle
4634570.short_description: An idle game that lives on your desktop. Widgets that make widgets that make widgets.

4634590.title: Blue Fury
4634590.short_description: A helicopter combat game inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Destroy tanks, eliminate enemy forces, and rescue soldiers before an enemy missile launches. Manage fuel, ammunition, and altitude while engaging helicopters and avoiding AA launchers over procedurally generated terrain.

4634820.title: ForgottenLands:BrokenRealm
4634820.short_description: Break the cycle of a fallen realm. Forgotten Lands: Broken Realmfuses Diablo-style action​ with dungeon puzzles. Master shifting dungeons, outsmart ancient traps, and conquer mighty bosses. Each run reveals lost truths and grants power to reshape your fate. Loot. Solve. Conquer.

4634840.title: Justice Project
4634840.short_description: Manage your very own operational courthouse, show your architectural talent, with every detail in your control. Let your management prowess show, schedule cases and trials alongside the ever present pressures of profit and reputation.

4634910.title: Trees Inc
4634910.short_description: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

4634970.title: The Shaman: What's in Your House?
4634970.short_description: "Something is in your house." As a Shaman, you are the only one who can face the unknown. Investigate haunted homes, uncover secrets, and exorcise malevolent spirits. Your choices determine the client's fate. Experience a chilling K-horror story where every decision matters.

4634980.title: The Maddening Mercy
4634980.short_description: A Wild-West-themed visual-novel/bullet-hell game where you collect clues to shoot down suspects' arguments to solve a murder mystery.

4635010.title: Dead Saints Parade
4635010.short_description: A third-person stealth immersive sim set inside a Gothic-Victorian cathedral that should not still be standing. Observe patrols, hide in shadow, and piece together the truth behind the Maestro's sermons. Combat will kill you in two hits. Information keeps you alive.

4635040.title: Tet Story
4635040.short_description: Relive the 2010s Southern Vietnamese Tet with Tet Story! A 2D point-and-click puzzle journey where you decorate the house, prep Banh Tet, and solve heartwarming challenges. Dive into a nostalgic world of yellow blossoms and red envelopes to celebrate the Lunar New Year!

4635110.title: Achievement Maze 2
4635110.short_description: Navigate through 33 cybernetic labyrinths of increasing difficulty. Find the right path, avoid long dead ends and unlock 100 achievements. Can you conquer every maze and become the Grand Maze Master?

4635170.title: NO MORE COWS
4635170.short_description: Physics-based co-op platformer where you and your friend must abduct a cow and drag it all the way from a barn to a laboratory in space. Survive traps, zero gravity, and friendship-breaking chaos in online co-op for 2 players.

4635260.title: Iris and the Moonlight Bakery
4635260.short_description: Play as Iris, a burnt-out goddess who opens a midnight bakery in a sleepless city. Read customers’ emotions as color and craft cakes to comfort them, while hiding from the gods searching for her.

4635270.title: EXITRANCE
4635270.short_description: EXITRANCE is a single-player psychological horror game set in a constantly shifting loop. Explore a confined environment where each cycle subtly changes, altering objects, sounds, and events. Observe your surroundings, uncover anomalies, and solve environmental puzzles to break the loop and escape.

4635280.title: Necro Survivors
4635280.short_description: Fight through relentless waves of monsters, upgrade your heroine, and create powerful builds in a fast-paced action RPG set in a dark fantasy world filled with danger, deadly enemies, and ever-growing survival challenges.

4635530.title: TOOSIN : 투신
4635530.short_description: Face an AI that evolves by learning your combat patterns in real-time. TOOSIN is a roguelike action game where enemies analyze your habits to counter you. Strategically combine 100+ traits and weapon skills to push past your limits and dominate the battlefield.

4635550.title: SHAHED
4635550.short_description: Control military drones in fast-paced modern combat. Use suicide drones, cluster bomb attacks, and C-RAM defense mode to complete tactical missions. Plan your moves, strike with precision, and dominate the battlefield from above.

4635560.title: FEED IT
4635560.short_description: A online co-op horror game where you and up to 3 others are out camping in the woods, enjoying the night when you hear one of you walkies starts buzzing. A distorted emergency broadcast warns campers in the area: something is in the forest and you are not alone.

4635660.title: Echoes of the Mind
4635660.short_description: A narrative-driven journey through evolving dreamscapes and fragments of the mind. Each dream takes on a new genre, and every return to the hospital brings you a little closer to yourself. 🧠 Every dream changes gameplay rules 🎮 Platformer, horror, and narrative shifts 🌑 Psychological atmosphere

4635820.title: YO UP!
4635820.short_description: YO UP! is a chaotic co-op physics building game where one wrong move can collapse everything. Build unstable towers solo or with friends, climb floating islands, and reach for space... if your tower holds.

4635840.title: Play Things
4635840.short_description: A psychological horror game about testing dolls and determining if they are Good or Dangerous. Play in a strange location with dolls potentially filled with bloodlust. Uncover secrets about who you are, where you are, and just WHAT is happening.

4635950.title: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
4635950.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

4636010.title: Zereoton Hauntings 2
4636010.short_description: Zereoton Hauntings 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

4636130.title: Square!
4636130.short_description: Shatter endless enemy waves from the baseline, rake in gold and XP, level up and draft modules and ball upgrades to forge absurd builds, then hold the line as bosses widen the arena and the grid fights back!

4636260.title: Caravanserai Simulator
4636260.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

4636280.title: Ami's Pearl Dive
4636280.short_description: Ami's Pearl Dive is a quaint underwater adventure game developed for the Game Boy Color! Help Ami dive deeper to find her missing mermaid friend, collect pearls and meet interesting faces along the way!

4636380.title: TheLastHelicopter
4636380.short_description: An arcade survival FPS set in a low-poly city infested with giant spiders. Armed with a pistol, explore an abandoned city, survive the creatures, and collect the 6 fuel canisters needed to escape with the last functional helicopter.

4636390.title: Survive to Save
4636390.short_description: Surviving is not enough. You have to save the world. You might be its last hope. Immerse yourself in a text-based survival game set in a zombie apocalypse, where every decision shapes the story. Survive the outbreak, reach the lab, and become humanity’s last chance.

4636420.title: Once Upon a Time… After the End
4636420.short_description: Manage a fairy tale survivors' shelter, explore dangerous regions, and make decisions in a collapsed fantasy world.

4636430.title: Memory Farm
4636430.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

4636580.title: Patched Conic
4636580.short_description: Fly real astrodynamics from an Apollo-era DSKY. Plan Lambert transfers, mine asteroids, build a fleet, and survive a 38-body solar system where every trajectory is solved from Kepler's equation. No autopilot, no cheating.

4636640.title: increTower
4636640.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game. Upgrade your tower. Upgrade your enemies. Repeat until it gets out of control.

4636670.title: Fleet Manager: Logistics Simulator
4636670.short_description: Build a delivery empire from a single bicycle to an orbital fleet. Hire specialists, unlock cities, optimize routes, and conquer weather, events, and the cosmos — all while your fleet runs without you.

4636700.title: Fishing Fever
4636700.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder fishing game. Draft powerful tool cards, catch rare fish across different ocean zones, build your deck, and haul legendary creatures from the deep. One more round. Always one more round.

4636840.title: Astral Archive
4636840.short_description: Astral Archive is a short, incremental idle + space shooter hybrid where you collect space artifacts to grow a powerful archive!

4637020.title: Cubalance
4637020.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

4637330.title: Company Rising
4637330.short_description: In this business simulation game, you take on the role of an entrepreneur, starting with a small team of just a few people and gradually building your very own corporate empire, step by step.

4637340.title: NoxTurn
4637340.short_description: Help Noxia find the remedy that will allow her to cross the boundaries of the ever-present gloom. NoxTurn is an atmospheric puzzle game where bending shadows are your primary tool. Traverse forgotten graveyards, manipulate reality, and uncover secrets hidden within the dimensions of lost souls.

4637350.title: Hentai Sake
4637350.short_description: Relaxing 18+ puzzle game with a bar vibe: complete mini-games, unlock seductive illustrations, and enjoy the smooth atmosphere of sake and nightlife.

4637510.title: Arkhe
4637510.short_description: Action roguelike in a dark fantasy world. Solo or online co-op up to four. 52 biomes, 520 items, enemies that grow stronger every loop. Choose a portal. Survive the descent. Nothing below you is kind.

4637550.title: Retro Madness DX
4637550.short_description: A collection of brand-new retro-style games that feel like lost classics. Dive into fast, weird, and addictive experiences in Retro Madness DX.

4637560.title: BleepWare Incrementals
4637560.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports
4637560.short_description: Five complete incremental games, plus a crossover that ties them together. Command a growing war machine, dig ever deeper for resources, survive escalating defense battles, embrace chaotic absurdity, and fish through creeping darkness in one strange collection of number-goes-up adventures.

4637580.title: Sky Runway
4637580.short_description: Drive a car in space and use its skills to survive, manage and gather resources to reach the end of your route and destroy the machines that are searching for you, immersive third-person game.

4637840.title: Depthloot
4637840.short_description: Click tiles. Find loot. Get out alive!

4637960.title: Blessed To Die
4637960.short_description: Predict. Commit. Resolve. Lead squads into simultaneous tactical combat in this deck-building rogue-lite where hidden enemy behavior, permanent death, and run-defining blessings shape every decision.

4638040.title: Archie's Pumpkin Patch
4638040.short_description: Archie's pumpkin patch is a farming simulator by day, and a fight to survive at night. You play as Archie, a go-getting axolotl who, after years of running this pumpkin patch, is starting to run into issues. He hears noises he can't quite explain at night and must go investigate them or die trying.

4638110.title: Brushwork
4638110.short_description: Hand-painted Nurikabe with an authored learning path, fixed challenge books, explain-before-reveal hints, and recurring daily and weekly competition boards.

4638290.title: Card of Fate
4638290.short_description: Card of Fate is a roguelike deckbuilder where you wander the path to Heaven or Hell. Construct a powerful deck, find legendary relics, and defeat the guardians of the afterlife. Will you master the celestial arts of the Angel or the devastating fury of the Demon?

4638460.title: Solo Shift!
4638460.short_description: From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all! Take on waves of customers all by yourself!

4638570.title: Zombie Taxi
4638570.short_description: Fast-paced arcade-style Taxi game where you're in a race for time trying to drop off survivors in the apocalypse while keeping an eye on the fuel gauge.

4638580.title: Doll Hero Thirty-Six
4638580.short_description: As a city lord, revive a ruined city: manage residents, develop economy, train troops, and lead generals to conquer lands, explore dungeons, and build a prosperous, powerful city.

4638600.title: 忍者刺杀行动
4638600.short_description: The ninja partners received an assassination mission. There was a Behind-the-scenes boss boss controlling the funds transactions in the black market. He issued a reward notice to the ninja alliance. Capturing the head of the Behind-the-scenes boss boss would earn a huge reward.

4638840.title: Constellations
4638840.short_description: Constellations A cozy astronomy puzzle game. Connect the stars to reveal constellations in infinite procedural skies, authentic real-world skies or Guesser Mode. Fill your celestial journal in a warm observatory. Discover all 88 constellations!

4639230.title: A Game About AI
4639230.short_description: Build the machine that consumes the world. Expand your AI infrastructure, drain resources, and destabilize humanity as systems spiral into collapse, water runs dry, wars ignite, and nothing can stop what you've set in motion.

4639260.title: The Fortuneteller
4639260.short_description: Take up the mantle, read the fates, control them, use them. You are The Fortuneteller. You are to be the best of the best. Use the tools given to take what is rightfully yours, vengeance.

4639410.title: Signal Zero
4639410.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

4639580.title: MMO Botfarm Simulator
4639580.short_description: A game about running a botfarm on an oldschool MMO to gather and sell resources, level up your bots, and clear dungeons to find loot.

4639940.title: Arena Arcade Fest
4639940.short_description: Arena Arcade Fest is a fast-paced local multiplayer party game built for chaotic fun with friends and family. Grab your controllers and battle across 30 unique mini-games, from reflex challenges and brain teasers to arcade action and puzzle showdowns. For 1-4 local players, CPU players supported!

4640600.title: In Us
4640600.short_description: The devil wears a human face. Unmask and exorcise it—with friends. A 4-player co-op horror game where you hunt demons lurking in a village. Observe behavior, detect environmental shifts, and use items to expose the truth. But beware: should you misjudge, the consequences will be severe.

4641210.title: Get-Out-Hoomanz : Bash-door, skrak-floor, run-run fast! Wagh!
4641210.short_description: [2-4 players] A chaotic goblin game show where you raid deadly dungeons, sabotage other players, and grab as much loot as you can before escaping… alive.

4641240.title: Silverbrook: a Text-Based RPG
4641240.short_description: A retro text-based RPG. The town of Silverbrook is in trouble. Goblins to the east. Undead to the north. A necromancer doing something unspeakable in the old dungeon. And somewhere beyond the mountain pass, something ancient is waking up — something that was sealed away for a reason.

4641420.title: Keeper's Vigil
4641420.short_description: As the Harbinger, you are the only Keeper who can cast spells. Stop a necromantic plague, uncover an Elven conspiracy, and decide the fate of a dying world! A text-based fantasy novel, 193,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects."

4641660.title: Dob x Dob
4641660.short_description: Build your ball and test it against other balls! Dob x Dob is a roguelike where you buy and combine weapon parts to create unlikely combos and beautiful abominations to battle against equally weird balls!

4641740.title: Astro Raiders
4641740.short_description: A retro-inspired arcade action game where you shoot, split, and dodge bouncing orbs across vibrant alien worlds. Grab power-ups, unlock characters, and climb the leaderboards as you battle through hundreds of increasingly challenging levels.

4641750.title: Until Dusk!
4641750.short_description: A high-pressure round-based zombie shooter packed with intense objectives, powerful rewards, and addictive “one more round” survival action.

4641880.title: Silent Wreckage｜寂靜沉輪
4641880.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4641880.short_description: Dive into a sunken ocean liner lost in the deep sea. In this narrative-driven 3D survival horror puzzle game, explore a claustrophobic environment while managing limited air resources, solving puzzles, evading unknown horrors, and uncovering the truth behind a distortion of time and space.

4642140.title: VENERA 31
4642140.short_description: Operator, you have one hour. Remotely control the VENERA 31 rover on the surface of Venus. Tag rocks, dust, and anomalies for computer vision training before battery depletion. For undefined creatures, use tag "HARVESTER". Previous operators reported similar sightings. No further action required.

4642180.title: 8 Ball 4
4642180.short_description: 8 Ball is back with challenges and locations never before seen in the series!!! Come on in and find out why this ball is the most famous in the world.

4642310.title: Taktari
4642310.short_description: Taktari is a turn-based auto-battle game where both player and enemies queue up their actions prior to battle. Press play and let the actions play out in this African Inspired Fantasy deck building game.

4642320.title: Dig! Dig! Dino!
4642320.short_description: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

4642350.title: Pachinko Life
4642350.short_description: a pachinko roguelike where every run is a life. every country, class, and choice changes how the board plays.

4642370.title: NO LOVE:2009
4642370.short_description: NO LOVE: 2009 The story of two high school lovers during their summer break. The internet c@fés everyone was obsessed with back then, amusement parks, train stations, dark side streets and burning through your SMS credit before you even get to say how you feel. Not just 2009… this is NO LOVE: 2009

4642410.title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
4642410.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

4642480.title: Glitchy: Not So Sweet
4642480.short_description: This looks like a super cute spot-the-difference game, but it isn’t!

4642550.title: Ghost Town Seekers
4642550.short_description: Ghost Town Seekers is a 2-10 player multiplayer hide-and-seek game where villagers transform into objects and try to survive using special abilities, while a witch hunts them down.

4642740.title: BonkCity
4642740.short_description: Four modes. One block. Play the daily seed everyone on Earth plays, climb a server-verified leaderboard, go Endless for the bragging rights, or paste a Bonk Code to run any scenario seed-for-seed. A 90s hip-hop horde survivor that plays offline and plays with friends.

4642770.title: Rock Diver
4642770.short_description: Land, mine, fill your pack, and head back to your ship. Become a Rock Diver in this incremental adventure as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and greet the locals along the way.

4642990.title: Dawnhold
4642990.short_description: Dawnhold is a top-down action base-defense game where you gather resources, build up your defenses, and survive relentless enemy waves. Strike back by assaulting enemy strongholds and defeating powerful bosses in a fight to protect the Sunstone.

4643110.title: Garden Of Being
4643110.short_description: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

4643120.title: Dockmates
4643120.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. Cast your line, catch fish of every rarity and grade, and track your collection in the journal. Invite up to 3 friends to fish together on a shared dock. No clicking, no pressure — just chill vibes while you work or play.

4643490.title: Hentai Futanari
4643490.short_description: Hentai Futanari - I can't take my eyes off it!! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4643570.title: Drowning Dream
4643570.short_description: A dreamcore liminal-space exploration game where you wander through beautifully strange environments with cinematic lighting and artful level design. No enemies, no chases, no jump scares—just you getting lost in your own dream

4643580.title: CYBERSEX
4643580.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports
4643580.short_description: CYBERSEX - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4643590.title: HOT STRIPPERS
4643590.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports
4643590.short_description: HOT STRIPPERS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4643990.title: Place：Weapon Workshop
4643990.short_description: Place: Weapon Workshop is a casual 2D idle roguelite raising game. Unlock blueprints, forge weapons, gather resources, upgrade buildings, optimize stats and grow stronger to dominate the arena.

4644050.title: Viking Vending
4644050.short_description: Start with a Viking harbor at your command—buy low, sell high, and turn a tidy profit! Identify unknown treasures and strike it rich overnight! Rebuild the blacksmith's forge, enchant mighty artifacts, hire fierce raiders, and make every Viking your loyal customer!

4644110.title: Clara Wraiths 2
4644110.short_description: Clara Wraiths 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.

4644190.title: County Hospital Outbreak
4644190.short_description: Co-op or solo sci-fi horror. Purge a biological outbreak with flamethrowers & grenades. Explore infested zones, grab keycards & stuff, then trigger the protocol to burn the Mother Organism. Team up. Erase the threat

4644290.title: 春はあけぼの、我はバケモノ。 - Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster.
4644290.short_description: You only wanted to save them. But in this psychological horror visual novel, a teacher’s kindness may become the thing that breaks his students.

4644840.title: Cowpocalypse - The Night of the Lights
4644840.short_description: A story driven adventure with drunk reindeers and something in the forest ready to drag you away at any time. Help Bran uncover how he might be responsible for a possible apocalypse.

4644850.title: Last Floor
4644850.short_description: Every floor looks normal… until it isn’t. Go up if everything is fine, down if something is wrong. One mistake sends you back. Can you reach the final floor?

4645020.title: SpringTale
4645020.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG
4645020.short_description: SpringTale is a 2D action platformer RPG MMO where you explore the changing seasons in a massive endless world alongside your friends.

4645200.title: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids
4645200.short_description: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids is a medieval fantasy blend of tower defense and roguelike progression. Build defenses on a grid, manage resources, and survive ever-evolving enemies.

4645210.title: Voodoo Craft
4645210.short_description: Run a cozy witchcraft shop in the strange village of Graveberg, mixing ingredients, crafting curse dolls, and performing hexes that twist fates and entangle villagers’ relationships. where every curse tells its story.

4645350.title: SystemRebellion
4645350.short_description: In a world collapsing under runaway AI, the last human fighters struggle to survive among the ruins. Lead your squad across cities and wastelands, confronting ever‑evolving machines as you search for humanity’s final chance to resist.

4645490.title: Skrrt Racing
4645490.short_description: Race through stylized old school arcade levels, unlock JDM inspired cars and upgrade performance parts, visual evolution and customization. Beat bosses, evolve your build, and push into infinite mode in this fully offline 2D racing game.

4645530.title: Sweet Primitive
4645530.short_description: Sweet Primitive - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around primitive life. Enjoy pleasant moments with five pretty and adorable primitive girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4645570.title: Gekko Episode of Nova
4645570.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4645570.short_description: Gekko is the stage where swords, machines and ponytails appear in modern society. A school romantic comedy visual novel that depicts an exciting love pattern with five heroines. This is the fourth installment in the Gekko series, featuring the story of the robot girl “Kikouin Nova.”

4645670.title: one more bottle
4645670.short_description: In ONE MORE BOTTLE, every cap you twist off hides a tiny puzzle, a prize, or a wish. Collect caps, build your shelf, and chase the rare one stamped 再来一瓶 — One More Bottle. A cozy solo puzzle-meets-gacha about luck, patience, and the hope that the next one will be the lucky one.

4645730.title: Assassin Of Aliens
4645730.short_description: Play as space warrior in this 2d person sci-fi shooter game. Mission is to kill different enemies like spiders and troopers and end of level destroy big ufo ship and collect skulls

4646020.title: Crystal Breaker
4646020.short_description: Crystal Breaker is a short incremental space game about flying, mining, and upgrading. Destroy crystal formations with your ship, unlock rare new upgrades, convert your crystals into credits, and grow stronger through a massive skill tree full of upgrades.

4646290.title: Animal Clicking
4646290.short_description: Animal Clicking is a cute, cozy island builder that blends farming, automation, and resource management with the addictive gameplay loop of clicker games into a completely new sandbox experience.

4646480.title: Hentai Futanari MILF Teacher
4646480.short_description: Hentai Futanari MILF Teacher - There's a whole semester ahead of you, don't even think about failing your exams!! A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4646550.title: SUMMER WITH MY WIFE
4646550.short_description: SUMMER WITH MY WIFE - A visual novel with open-world elements where you spend a hot summer with your wife: explore, become a cuckold, and watch your relationship evolve.

4646760.title: War for Ylinthia
4646760.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

4646790.title: noCube
4646790.short_description: noCube is a short physics platformer with 22 synthwave themed levels. Jump in and complete compact levels built around physics based movement and puzzles with no story to slow things down while the focus stays on fun and easy-to-pick-up gameplay.

4646900.title: Life in Cities
4646900.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4646900.short_description: Life in Cities is not just another city builder it is a one of a kind experience where you build, manage, and truly live inside your own city. Wishlist now.

4647250.title: SUCCU’S STORY
4647250.short_description: Hentai visual novel where you help the streamer Succu become famous and improve her skills to survive. Manage fans, money, and training, unlock special endings, and discover romantic, spicy, and corruption routes. 18+ content.

4648890.title: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
4648890.short_description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a turn-based PvP puzzle game that fuses the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

4650000.title: CRIKEYMAS
4650000.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a (seriously kinda gross-looking) reindeer who somehow ended up as Santa's errand boy, smashing your way through brutally fun levels.

4650280.title: The Dream Hold
4650280.short_description: Hardcore turn-based RPG. Choose a soul fragment trapped in the dream world, travel between the shattered dreamscapes, search, explore, survive, build skills, fight, and find a way out.

4650350.title: BCKSPCE
4650350.short_description: When an unknown friend request comes in you begin to question your friendship with Stella, your digital sanctuary quickly unravels as the truth comes out. A narrative-driven psychological thriller told entirely through a retro desktop interface.

4650560.title: Dream&Robot
4650560.short_description: Dream and Robot is a 3D level-based game with simple operation and rich level content. Various mechanisms and traps await you to overcome. Those who love level-based games and dreamcore style must give it a try!

4650800.title: Mafia Boss Simulator
4650800.short_description: They shot you on your own driveway. Now dig your way back. MAFIA BOSS SIMULATOR is a cinematic crime saga from 1920s Sicily to 1950s New York — stealth, driving, shootouts, and a story of loyalty, betrayal, and the price of the crown. Welcome to the Family.

4651000.title: Checkers Kingdom
4651000.short_description: From your grandmother's kitchen table to the Phantom's throne. Learn the classical openings, master the canonical endgames, and face opponents who play like real humans across every official ruleset. A story campaign, one purchase, everything included.

4651130.title: Cleaning Simulator: Ultimate Mess
4651130.short_description: Clean, organize, and restore different environments in this level-based cleaning simulator. Every level introduces new mechanics, tools, and satisfying ways to turn mess into perfection.

4651840.title: 100 Hidden ASCII Cats
4651840.short_description: A cozy hidden-object puzzle set in massive worlds drawn entirely from ASCII text. Grab your magnifying glass and find 100 kittens hiding between the characters.

4652350.title: Grandma's Golden Boy: Sheep Shear Madness
4652350.short_description: Defend your title as Grandma’s Golden Boy! No one leaves without a bare bum. Shear the wildest sheep, host legendary tea parties for the grannies, craft epic gear, and build your very own Wool Empire!

4652460.title: SCP-294: The Coffee Machine
4652460.short_description: Enter the depths of a silent facility as a D-Class subject. Test the limits of SCP-294, a machine that can produce any liquid imaginable. But remember: in this low-poly PS1-style nightmare, every cup has a price. A short, narrative-driven psychological horror experience.

4653000.title: Visual novel: The One from the Dark
4653000.short_description: Visual novel set in a rural horror setting. Take on the role of a city real estate appraiser stranded in a remote village with no phone service, no cars, and no escape. Read dialogues, make choices, and try to maintain your sanity before the local Tree decides you're for dinner tonight.

4653120.title: Touhou Desktop Pet
4653120.short_description: Thiis is a desktop pet companion game. Maybe Touhou girls can let you feel less lonely.

4653150.title: MutaPit
4653150.short_description: Mutate alien creatures with stolen body parts, seal them in a bio-flask, and fight your way through the Millennium Space Colosseum. Every part changes your creature. Every choice is permanent. Every monster is yours alone.

4653190.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
4653190.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

4653220.title: Scenemates
4653220.short_description: A chaotic co-op platformer for 2–6 players, local and online. Team up, survive the Director, and star in your own movie. Couch co-op meets Hollywood madness.

4653390.title: Deep Space Miner
4653390.short_description: Deep Space Miner is a short incremental game. Explore planets, upgrade tools, and unlock drones that mine automatically. Use your riches on a massive skill tree to enhance your abilities and uncover the galaxy's rarest materials.

4653840.title: Trapped in the Backrooms
4653840.short_description: Trapped in the Backrooms is a psychological horror experience across unsettling, interconnected levels. Navigate shifting environments, uncover hidden truths, and survive entities that adapt to your movement. Each map brings new rules, new threats, and deeper descent into the unknown.

4654130.title: Abyssal Academy
4654130.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Survive a 10-floor dungeon to pass your wizardry exam. Draft spell cards, battle monsters, and trade remains for relics. Death isn't the end: wake up in the infirmary with an 'F', rebuild your deck, and dive back in.

4611200.title: SCP RP
4611200.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4611200.short_description: A multiplayer SCP roleplay experience where a living facility is powered by programmable-driven characters, dynamic events, and player choice.

4611230.title: Secrets Within Us
4611230.short_description: Follow Evan Rowe as he goes to check on a friend who has been missing. What begins as a simple visit quickly takes a turn, and the more he looks into it, the more it pulls him deeper into hidden secrets.

4611310.title: Scrapbot Outpost
4611310.short_description: Defend a salvaged power core with linked tower networks on handcrafted scrapyard maps.

4611340.title: StillAsleep
4611340.short_description: StillAsleep is a first-person psychological horror game where you are trapped inside your dreams that slowly begin to break, shifting and distorting as you try to find a way out.

4611380.title: Tacos or Death
4611380.short_description: Make deliveries. Buy tacos. Don't die. Health drains every second and your only lifeline is the taco stand. Dodge skull-van chasers, grab power-ups, and see how long you can last in this top-down pixel art arcade survival game.

4611400.title: Neon Planet
4611400.short_description: An open-world RPG on a neon lit alien planet. Farm, fish, craft, fight, and trade across five factions. Solo or in a 25-player online co-op world with a player-driven economy, 100-floor mine, combat spire, casino, and player housing.

4611750.title: Pinball Tide
4611750.short_description: Pinball Tide is a roguelike pinball game. Control the flippers to score points and strategically earn gold. Use points to enhance your gameplay, and spend gold to draw higher-rarity balls and merge them. Through merging, you can discover new flippers and balls.

4611870.title: Vocabulary Mastermind
