4611870.short_description: Master Vocabulary in 13 Languages Test your mental agility with Vocabulary Mastermind! Choose from 13 play languages and navigate a global interface available in over 80 languages. Prove who has the widest vocabulary.

4611880.title: XiaoLuo's English War
4611880.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

4611990.title: 日本事故物件監視協会3 -Japan Stigmatized Property-
4611990.short_description: Can you survive until dawn? Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly. Miss too many… and you will fail.
developers: 日本事故物件監視協会
publishers: 日本事故物件監視協会

4612470.title: Bottanics
4612470.short_description: An automation farming game where you teach a robot through demonstrations instead of writing code. Train its neural network, then watch it adapt to similar situations. Teach. Train. Deploy. Fix. Expand. Repeat.

4612480.title: Land of Ghosts
4612480.short_description: A literary horror adventure made in RPG Maker MV, where you explore a land of endless rain and continue a lonely journey through fleeting encounters with ghosts. Rain-soaked landscapes and quiet conversations shape a desolate, melancholic road ahead.

4612490.title: The Last Student : Showa-Era Radio Room
4612490.short_description: A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts. Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow. Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

4612590.title: Bullet Train
4612590.short_description: Welcome abord the Bullet Train: blast enemy towers, collect powerful upgrade orbs and improve your train! Navigate through escalating enemy territory to defeat the creatures that destroyed your town!

4612620.title: Pion's Theorem
4612620.short_description: Solve equations. Build decks. Break the system. A math-fueled deckbuilding puzzler where you combine number and operator cards to hit the target. Master four modes — Puzzle, Daily Challenge, Competitive, and Strategy — with π at your side. Casual to pick up. Dangerously deep to master.

4612840.title: Woodville Chronicles
4612840.short_description: Woodville Chronicles is a match-3 game! An idyllic little clearing in the middle of the forest is just waiting for you to build the village of your dreams. In innovative match-3 worlds full of unexpected possibilities, you’ll earn the money you need to watch your little community grow.

4612880.title: Dumb Dunks
4612880.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

4613340.title: Bannerlings
4613340.short_description: Bannerlings is a strategy roguelike auto battler where you recruit, fuse, and customize units with emblems to build powerful synergies and overcome escalating, randomized encounters.

4613370.title: Gempop
4613370.short_description: Channel your beam into drifting gems, charge them until they pop, and trigger cascading chain reactions across a dark void.

4613480.title: Let Go Of That Girl Let Me Handle It
4613480.short_description: 【Dynamic Jigsaw Puzzle】Bring the jigsaw puzzle to life with 99 exquisite pictures of girls. Each picture can serve as your desktop wallpaper. Slowly restore each picture in a relaxing and pleasant environment. After completion, you can earn various achievements and save the pictures to your computer

4613890.title: Lazy Kickers
4613890.short_description: Lazy kickers is a tiny soccer incremental where you grow balls from plants and shoot goals for coins. Start small and climb the leaderboards, unlocking more upgrades to score millions and plunge the playing field into total chaos.

4614290.title: WAGEE
4614290.short_description: Climb the corporate ladder in WAGEE! WAGEE is a roguelike deckbuilding game where you play cards and roll dice from your desk to reach increasingly difficult score quotas. Buy powerful items at the shop, merge cards to discover new ones, and upgrade your cards to create the strongest deck possible!

4614320.title: Dead Night Highway
4614320.short_description: Dead Night Highway is a compact colony simulator where a group of survivors on their journey west set up camps to replenish resources, but the horde only grows larger...

4614770.title: Terracota
4614770.short_description: Close your eyes… and find the way. Join Etena in a challenging precision platformer, where closing your eyes is the only way to see the whole path. Explore, transform the environment and destroy the heart of a curse that corrupts everything in its path.

4614800.title: Pellets
4614800.short_description: Pellets is a 2D shooter game about stopping a concentric ring-filled prophecy. You control two characters at once, where you try and manage the swarms of Pellets coming down. There are many pellet types, characters and abilities, and environment effects. Defend yourself or bring a second player.

4614880.title: Superkid X1
4614880.short_description: Superkid X1 is street football with superpowers! Inspired by Mario Strikers and the soul of Brazil, jump into insane 3D matches with powerful kids. Relive the nostalgia of street play with arcade action, multiplayer, and a unique cartoon style!

4614900.title: Loot Hoggers
4614900.short_description: A 1-4 player online co-op scavenging game where you play as goblins raiding dangerous dungeons, stashing loot on a shared pack-mule pig, and pushing your luck to escape before losing it all.

4615250.title: Stellar Golf
4615250.short_description: Stellar Golf is a fast, stylish arcade mini golf game set in space, blending smooth air-hockey-inspired shots with trick-shot physics, neon obstacles, black holes, portals, bumpers, color changing puck mechanics, and 108 handcrafted holes across 12 vibrant courses.

4615430.title: Chrono Mailbox
4615430.short_description: A dark psychological romance visual novel. Send letters through a bronze mailbox that rewrites the past — every miracle brands a scar into your chest. Five women you saved now rule the world, and each is obsessed with you. 5 routes, 37 Bad Ends, and a villain made from your own deleted words.

4615490.title: Magika Bounce
4615490.short_description: Magika Bounce is a single-player, top-down action brick-breaker combat game. Players control a Stellar Spirit–powered high school girl, ricocheting a North Star comet to counter enemies. The story challenges the Twelve Zodiac and reveals a final conspiracy.

4615640.title: DRYN: Don't Reveal Your Next
4615640.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4615640.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge dangerous, abandoned environments for valuable loot to meet the Company's strict profit quota. Survive unpredictable monsters, manage your gear, and work together to escape alive.

4615650.title: Delivery Derby
4615650.short_description: Work for an unconventional pizza chain that pits drivers against each other to deliver the same pizza. You will kick, run over, and commit other unforgivable acts to your fellow drivers to gain any advantage you can. Test your delivery skills (and your friendships) in this chaotic multiplayer game!

4615660.title: Woke Up In a Dark Nightmare
4615660.short_description: You closed your eyes on your own bed, but Woke Up In a Dark Nightmare. Explore an unfamiliar house filled with paranormal activities. Solve puzzles and uncover the dark truth behind your displacement before the shadows catch you up. Can you escape the nightmare, or will you become part of it?

4617260.title: Nano CODE:X
4617260.short_description: A small 2D game where you sneak through a lab simulation, collect parts, and rebuild your drone companion with multiple possible looks.

4617510.title: Souls Divided
4617510.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

4617700.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Istanbul
4617700.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Istanbul 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4617870.title: Soundwave
4617870.short_description: Five tones. You listen. Then recreate each one from memory using a frequency slider. Or identify chords by ear — root note and quality. Most people think they have a good ear. Soundwave will prove otherwise. How close can you get?

4618080.title: Prime//Directive
4618080.short_description: Place procedurally generated structures and watch a cyberpunk city evolve into a living, interconnected system.

4618160.title: Lobotomy
4618160.short_description: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylum’s dark history claims you next.

4618340.title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
4618340.short_description: Deploy units on a 3x3 grid in this clicker × auto-battle tactics game. Pick cards to forge the ultimate build, then rebirth for permanent power-ups. Watch damage scale beyond imagination in this incremental RPG — aim for the extreme 10^300.

4618380.title: 雪球对对碰 Snowball Bumping
4618380.short_description: This is a local multiplayer 1V1 game. Invite your friends to compete, hit the ball to each other, break through the opponent's defense to score.

4618430.title: Runeveil: Idle PvP
4618430.genre: Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4618430.short_description: Pixel art idle RPG where your hero fights, loots and climbs the PvP arena. Skill tree, crafting, legendary sets and world rankings await you. Build your legend in 5 minutes a day.

4618470.title: A Game About Shooting Targets
4618470.short_description: Your beloved country is at war and you want to help your country as a patriot. But your current weapon handling skills suck, so you have to get better by shooting a lot of targets in this Game About Shooting Targets!

4618590.title: The Silver Crow
4618590.short_description: You play Conrad - executioner, outcast, and the last man anyone would trust to solve a murder. A handcrafted adventure steeped in Renaissance atmosphere, occult shadows and moral ambiguity. A point & click mystery in a city where truth is buried, power decides guilt, and someone is always watching.

4618640.title: Misfit Warbands
4618640.short_description: In this Roguelike Auto-Battler, create a strategic Warband of Misfit units to journey on an adventure.  Each round, buy & field units from your custom Warband.  Synergize and upgrade, acquire items and world buffs, and complete challenges to unlock more unique units and synergies for your Warband!

4618660.title: cherry blossom fleet 1946
4618660.short_description: A 2D scrolling shooter set in the Pacific theater. Fly as an Allied fighter pilot and take on the 「Empire of the Rising Sun」 overwhelming forces. Wipe out enemy units and turn the tide of battle.

4618750.title: Roll & Slay : Dice Caster
4618750.short_description: A dark fantasy Yahtzee-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler where luck decides every battle.

4618760.title: Moorhaven: Cozy Canal Life
4618760.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

4618990.title: Glyph
4618990.short_description: A word-tile roguelike. Spell words to break score targets, then shop between rounds for glyphs, tile upgrades, and bonus cells that chain into game-breaking combos. Push through five boss fights, each with its own debuff — before your hands run out.

4619000.title: Shatterhold
4619000.short_description: Idle survivor meets shared world. Your Hold produces resources 24/7. Your expeditions push back a fracturing reality. 25 regions. 8,000 zones. One world. Every player matters. Success and failure is shared by your entire region.

4619020.title: Magical Magic World 2
4619020.short_description: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

4619040.title: Valken
4619040.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

4619060.title: SoundFest: Music Festival Manager
4619060.short_description: Build and manage your own music festival. Design the venue, book artists, control crowds, and grow a profitable event empire.

4619130.title: Chimaera Evolution
4619130.short_description: Chimaera Evolution is a pixel art monster-capture RPG blending turn-based strategy and survival. Explore a vast world, track down Shiny Chimaeras, master egg breeding, and craft your own gear to become the ultimate master of evolution.

4619240.title: Gambiarra Garage
4619240.short_description: Gambiarra Garage is a car mechanic game inspired by 2000s Brazilian car culture. You inherit your grandfather’s garage and start from scratch, dismantling, assembling, and repairing cars with realistic systems. Improvisation, creativity, and your decisions shape every result.

4619560.title: A Runner's Rage
4619560.short_description: Platform across a mysterious maze as you evade traps and enemies along the way. Collect artifacts that grant you incredible powers, but beware of the bosses that lurk in the setting.

4619600.title: Funny Rummy
4619600.short_description: This table feels familiar... the rest of it? A little funny. Funny Rummy is a rummy-based roguelike deckbuilder where the rules make sense, the combos don't, and the dream ends if you don't hit your score.

4619620.title: Abominable Asteroids
4619620.short_description: Lost in deep space and surrounded by deadly asteroids, your survival will depend on your shooting and piloting skills in this retro-inspired action game!

4620070.title: Magelike: Path to Redemption
4620070.short_description: Magelike: Path to Redemption is an action roguelike with adult themes, following a woman seeking redemption as she battles through a looping world shaped by her past and her desires.

4620100.title: Little Heart AI - 2055
4620100.short_description: Welcome to 2055. Play as a young person who has just been replaced by AI. Take in the AI units that have been phased out, venture into the shadows of Alpha City, and journey against the tide with your companions, through laughter and tears.

4620790.title: Cargo Lines
4620790.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

4620890.title: Bada Boom
4620890.short_description: BADA BOOM is an action adventure where players use the rhythm of 4 Drums to command a gang of silly, slightly alcoholic dudes who find themselves washed up on the shores of a strange land and lead them on their quest for survival aka beer ;)

4621050.title: SAI-1
4621050.short_description: SAI-1 is a puzzle game set in the futuristic world of the 2100s. You take on the role of a robot named SAI-1, tasked with overcoming a series of challenges at STM 2100—a prestigious tournament for robots from across the globe.

4621440.title: Homestay Queen
4621440.short_description: An intimate visual novel about Edwin, a young man living with his enigmatic host during a year abroad in Japan. What begins as cultural wonder slowly unravels into obsession, shame, and desires he can't control.

4621600.title: LEGION OF HONOR
4621600.short_description: A WWII action-adventure FPS with powerful gunplay. Fight through operations across occupied Europe, blending fast-paced combat with the spirit of classic war stories! Featuring Splitscreen and Online Multiplayer modes.

4621860.title: Invasion of the Lizard People
4621860.short_description: 1–4 player co-op survival where you fight through waves of enemies, rack up kills, and collect powerful pickups to stay alive as long as possible. Fast-paced, chaotic runs push your limits every time.

4621930.title: Sparkle灵光一闪
4621930.short_description: A puzzle-adventure card game that retraces the evolution of human civilization. Starting from the very first Sparkle, light up nodes along the tech tree—drag, combine, and inspire your way through humanity's journey,Decode the Golden Record.

4621970.title: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
4621970.short_description: Loop Dungeon - Incremental is an ultimate blend of dungeon crawling and auto-battler progression. Assemble your squad of heroes, venture into endless loops, collect massive loot. Break through limits with a deep prestige system and transform your ragtag band into a god-slaying legion.

4622110.title: 我的傲娇妹妹 MY TSUNDERE SISTER
4622110.short_description: 《我的高冷女友》续作来袭！与红发双马尾傲娇妹妹同住一屋，体验嘴硬心软的日常守护，解锁夏日限定的甜蜜与感动。

4622330.title: CD Market - Music Label Sim
4622330.short_description: CD Market is a music industry management sim where you build a record label on your own terms, from vinyl to digital. Stay small, or grow into something bigger. Discover artists, shape careers, and survive decades of changing formats, trends, rivals, and crises.

4623510.title: Animal x Truck
4623510.short_description: Drive your truck to survive massive monster hordes! Along the way, rescue your fur-rious allies to build your ultimate fire forces and blast every enemy off the road.

4623520.title: Bloodbath
4623520.short_description: As an operator, you must guide an android through an abandoned mansion in search of the object responsible for the paranormal activities in the location. As you explore, solve puzzles and investigate the dark past that runs in the blood of the Bailey family.

4623570.title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
4623570.short_description: Grind mobs and capture them as your minions to haul your loot. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays along the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary gears and build overpowered heroes while you chill or work.

4623650.title: Koumii
4623650.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4623650.short_description: Enter a magical duel where every turn is a new creation. Craft your own spells, predict your opponent's moves, and outplay them in a fast-paced battle to be the last player standing. A casual 2-player experience for friends and foes alike.

4623830.title: Na Cabeça do Bicho
4623830.short_description: In the Animal's Head is an adventure and narrative game focused on exploration, with interactive dialogues and minigames.

4623870.title: CYBER SCOUTS
4623870.short_description: Cyber Scouts is a multiplayer space sandbox with block-level ship destruction. Build modular ships block by block, write Lua scripts to automate your fleet, and engage in tactical combat against players and AI. Your engineering skills are the ultimate weapon for galactic survival!

4624000.title: Ascend6
4624000.short_description: Scoundrel meets Poker in this score-attacking roguelike card game! Multiple classes to choose from. Buy unique skills, equip game-altering items, and conquer the round!

4624060.title: Mortar and Malady
4624060.short_description: A medieval apothecary simulator where you brew, grind, and sell remedies to earn your place in a wary new town. Solve intricate recipe riddles, manage your resources, and grow your mastery of herbalism to heal the sick and maintain your reputation as the local healer.

4624100.title: Smoke Town
4624100.short_description: Experience the high-stakes hustle in a cutthroat multiplayer economic strategy game to clear your $1,000,000 debt. Grow your product, outbid rivals in real-time auctions, and manipulate the Syndicate to rule the district. Can you rise from Street Dealer to Kingpin, or will the heat catch up to you?

4624310.title: Seventh Mansion: The First Escape
4624310.short_description: Escape an eerie mansion where death resets everything. Solve puzzles, evade the Wicked Nuns, or use a camera to survive in this psychological horror experience.

4625080.title: Paw Pew Pew
4625080.short_description: A fast-paced 3D roguelike shooter set in a post-human world ruled by evolved animals. Fight robotic enemies in ever-changing arenas, collect upgrades, and adapt your build each run to survive and dominate the food chain.
developers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi
publishers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi

4625290.title: Incident Archives - Flight 882
4625290.short_description: Inspired by true events. A First Officer on a night flight is paired with a new Captain for the journey. What begins as a normal flight slowly turns unsettling as the situation slowly turns intense.

4625800.title: Black Plague: Survival
4625800.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation
4625800.short_description: You are an outcast who lost everything in the flames of the plague but gained the knowledge of "Devil's Mushrooms." In Black Plague: Survival, you must rise from a lone refugee to a fierce knight and leader of your own survivor clan.

4626050.title: Apawcalypse: Gang War
4626050.short_description: The world has fallen. Animals have risen, and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, and lead your animal gang through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

4626060.title: Cosmic Carl
4626060.short_description: The only things between Carl the Alien and the cold, uncaring vacuum of space are his rubbery forcefield, and a powerful rocket placed precariously on his back. Try not to kill Carl as you rocket, bounce, and orbit your way through fast paced, short levels with wacky physics.

4626130.title: Pile Goes Up
4626130.short_description: "Pile Goes Up" is a roguelike deck‑builder where you stack cards in order… but you are in hell, and the devil cheats. As rounds progress, your deck destabilizes, piles grow harsher, and devilish tricks escalate. Use the shop, discover synergies, and cheat your way to salvation.

4626140.title: Archivist: Protocol Zero
4626140.short_description: Survive the bureaucratic nightmare in this action roguelike. As a lone Archivarius, use a cinematic projector and loudspeakers to repel swarms of living documents and ink blots in a vast Soviet-style vault. Burn the secrets, survive the night, and don't let Protocol Zero escape.

4626280.title: This Party Sucks
4626280.short_description: You end up at a party you never wanted to attend. It’s loud, chaotic, and full of drunk guests. When the lights go out, chaos begins. The only way out is to perform a ritual and summon a light demon. And you’re the only sober one here.

4626350.title: Lampyris Moon
4626350.short_description: On a night when the moon seems different, an individual ventures into a silent but oppressive environment. Very quickly, a strange feeling takes hold… as if something is watching him, lurking in the shadows.

4626920.title: Cloud JourneyVR
4626920.short_description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

4627210.title: Strip Memory: Unlocked Desires
4627210.short_description: "Test your memory and claim your ultimate rewards! Challenge four gorgeous women to a classic game of memory match. Keep your focus, beat the timer, and unlock exclusive, fully-animated adult scenes. When the game ends, the real fun begins—how will you take your final prize?"

4627220.title: Untold Memories: Grandma's House
4627220.short_description: Rick is forced to spend a week at his grandmother’s house, where every night grows more disturbing. Explore a house filled with whispers, survive paranormal events, and uncover the secret hidden beneath it all while one warning echoes in your mind: never enter the basement..

4627270.title: Firewall Breaker
4627270.short_description: Firewall Breaker settles into the corner of your screen and gets to work. While you're in a meeting, watching a video, or on another tab — it hacks, attacks, and grows stronger. You just check the results.

4627290.title: Whenever; We Rise
4627290.short_description: Gravity is your greatest weapon as you launch enemies into the air and spike them back down in this tactical roguelite with a unique perspective.

4627300.title: Defender Zed-001
4627300.short_description: Defender Zed-001 is a fast-paced arcade space shooter where you battle endless waves of enemies, upgrade your ship between rounds, and push your skills to the limit.

4627320.title: Siglings
4627320.short_description: Siglings is a chaotic auto-battler where you collect sigils inspired by symbols and pictograms. They fight for you against increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Mix and match sigils to create powerful combinations, with effects that interact in fun and sometimes unexpected ways.

4627340.title: Normile
4627340.short_description: Normile is a first-person simulation game where you travel along the Kaluzhsko-Rizhskaya line in the Moscow metro as a rectangular player

4627420.title: Demonic Gauntlet
4627420.short_description: I am a solo developer that has worked in the games industry for decades. I had the idea of making this game. It is just a christian demonology treaty converted into a game. There is the famous Ars Goetia, part of the Lemegeton that catalogs 72 demons with their names, ranks, seals and powers.

4627510.title: Hentai Glacial
4627510.short_description: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Glacial, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

4627520.title: Smoke Easy: Hookah Lounge Simulator
4627520.short_description: Run your own hookah lounge! Seat guests, pack the bowl, keep the coals burning, put out fires (literally) and grow your business from a tiny spot to a place worth staying for.

4627540.title: Kinetic Conundrum
4627540.short_description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

4627590.title: Too Many Balls
4627590.short_description: There are too many balls. No one knows why. Your only option? Collect them. All of them. Yes, even that one in the corner.

4627700.title: Eyes in the Woods
4627700.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where players navigate dense forest-based maps while being hunted by Bigfoot. The game emphasizes environmental awareness, limited resources, and psychological pressure. You must gather all the evidence needed to conclude that Bigfoot does exist.

4627770.title: DOOMFRONT
4627770.short_description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

4627830.title: Moss & Destiny
4627830.short_description: Your forest has a story it needs to finish... and it is calling you to tell it. A 2D pixel art cozy adventure! • Grow herbs for tea and healing • Cure the strange ailments you find in your forest creatures • Solve the mystery of what is changing the forest around you.

4628090.title: I Woke Up In An RPG
4628090.short_description: After dying, you awaken inside a fantasy game world. Battle through a 3D action-RPG with soulslike-inspired combat. Slash, shoot, and cast spells to conquer powerful enemies before you’re lost in the game for good.

4628100.title: The Murder Of Yesterday
4628100.short_description: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

4628110.title: Sellin' Snake Oil
4628110.short_description: Buy low, sell high, and survive the frontier. Sellin' Snake Oil is a western trading roguelike where every run brings a new map, new prices, new challenges, and new decisions. The ranch won't buy itself.

4628250.title: How to Grow Your Sausage
4628250.short_description: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your computer. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!

4628310.title: Epic Idle Quest II
4628310.short_description: Turn-based idle RPG with elemental combat, 900+ monsters, crafting, PvP, and 1,000 achievements. Fight actively or let the server grind while you're away. No cheats — all progress is server-verified. Cross-platform with web and Android.

4628420.title: South of the March
4628420.short_description: South of the March is an RPG that combines visual novel exploration with turn-based combat in a hand-drawn dark fantasy world. Meet the locals and unravel a mystery, equip your party for the dangers ahead, and set out into the unforgiving wilderness.

4628430.title: INVARIANT
4628430.short_description: INVARIANT is a first-person psychological horror game. Step into the shattered mind of a mathematician. Rely on your destructive addiction to bend reality, explore ever-changing environments, and hide from the terrifying manifestations of your grief. Truth and lies are a sip apart.

4628440.title: gunman
4628440.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4628440.short_description: A roguelite buildcrafting swarm-eleminating game about a guy with a gun

4628500.title: Dungeon of Calibris: Demon Orb
4628500.short_description: Descend into a sprawling, perilous dungeon in this old‑school first‑person RPG. Build your party, uncover hidden rooms, battle deadly creatures, and meet a large cast of adventurers trying to survive the depths. Designed with the spirit of classic “dad‑era” dungeon crawlers.

4628590.title: Fishing Factory
4628590.short_description: A cozy sandbox where relaxing fishing meets light automation. Catch, raise, and process fish as you grow a seaside business, upgrade gear, and explore vibrant coasts. Solo or with friends, blending peaceful play with satisfying progression.

4628600.title: Autonomous Warfare Evolution
4628600.short_description: A real-time strategy simulation where you evolve and command swarm-intelligence autonomous weapons using genetic algorithms. Whether you simply watch or deeply intervene in the evolution, both are valid ways to play the game.

4628680.title: Outmost Ruminant
4628680.short_description: Outmost Ruminant is an action-adventure game set in a dark fantasy world. Follow the traveler, one of many on a journey for reasons unknown, she'll venture through an abandoned land filled with hostile foes and unravel the true reason for her journey.

4629330.title: Keystones: Foundations
4629330.short_description: Keystones is a cerebral 3D puzzle game focused on spatial reasoning. Manipulate voxel blocks through sliding, rotating, and tumbling to solve intricate grid-based challenges. Master the logic of movement and orientation to unlock the path forward in a minimalist, atmospheric world.

4630830.title: Undefined 339
4630830.short_description: Undefined 339 is a linear TPS action-adventure game focused on dystopian science fiction storytelling. Accompany 339 as it awakens, drawing its power from a real human heart, and searches for its destiny.

4631030.title: TarotBullFight
4631030.short_description: A bullfighting-style card game based on classic bull poker rules, featuring special abilities from select tarot cards or tarot-themed decks. Players can engage in turn-based battles against both robot opponents and other players to win matches.

4631050.title: You Can't Ring It
4631050.short_description: You Can’t Ring It is a playful physics-based tossing game where every throw matters. Aim carefully, adjust your angle and power, and land perfect rings on moving, tricky targets across a series of humorous handcrafted levels

4631100.title: Arcany
4631100.genre: Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4631100.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

4631350.title: Forest Raid
4631350.short_description: Fight together. Grow stronger. Defeat the Forest Bosses! Forest Raid is a idle clicker MMO where players gather resources, craft weapons, fight together against the powerful forest bosses and compete for top ranks.

4631410.title: Long Rescue
4631410.short_description: Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis. Will you rescue your dog?

4631470.title: Where It Happened
4631470.short_description: You wake up to find yourself standing before an old house. The painful memories buried deep within your heart suddenly return. You don’t remember it well, but you used to live here. This is where it happened.

4631490.title: SU-93 Survivor
4631490.short_description: A fast-paced survivor-like where you clear rooms, defeat bosses, and build powerful synergies between temporary weapons and permanent passive items.

4631520.title: Pump Away!
4631520.short_description: A railroad adventure that sits at the bottom of your screen! Click to make the car go brrr or let it idle - this cat and dog duo will pump away and liven up your desktop.

4631570.title: Drawn into Darkness
4631570.short_description: Drawn into Darkness will have you Descend the Depths in this Deckbuilding, Dungeoncrawler, Roguelite with over 200 Cards, 200 Enemies, and 100 Floors of pure RNG Goodness. What path will you take, hmm, Hero?

4631660.title: Crimsooon Sun
4631660.short_description: No choices but deduction. No game over. No multiple endings. A mystery "novel" adventure you can play with the same focus as reading a detective novel. Defy the sun with twenty-six bullets—even if the revolution of the heavenly spheres cannot be stopped.

4632280.title: Adult spirit
4632280.short_description: Explore a colorful suburban town as a wandering spirit. Enter houses, complete mini-games and household tasks, and find books, flash drives, photos, and videos to better understand the main character and the atmosphere of this strange place.

4632540.title: Fellwood
4632540.short_description: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

4632590.title: Data Abyss
4632590.short_description: A 3D third-person high-speed shooter. Fight through a crumbling data world to find your family and the truth. Core art + surrealist. WASD move, Shift dodge, Ctrl slide, Q grapple (points/enemies), LMB attack, F collect memories. Chain moves for 3D combat and high-speed offense-defense.

4632600.title: 《美少女旅馆：可爱即是正义，但正义需要处刑》
4632600.short_description: 一间神秘的旅馆，一群彼此怀疑的美少女，一场无法停止的猎杀游戏。在谎言与处刑之间，找出真正的狼人，每一个选择，都会改写她们的结局。

4632640.title: ROIDSTRIKE
4632640.short_description: Retro-synthwave-arcade-space-shooter with 10 galaxies, 100 level, 4 ships, and local co-op for up to 4 players. Pick a ship. Destroy everything. Don't die.

4632680.title: NTR Tales - Lustful Orders
4632680.short_description: Run a restaurant, build a relationship… and watch it slowly change. In NTR Tales: Lustful Orders, manage your daily life through mini-games, go on dates with Sasha, and trigger events that blur the line between love and temptation.

4632990.title: NODGE
4632990.short_description: Test your reflexes in this neon arcade dodge game. Rely on split-second reactions to survive 20 unique hazards closing in from all sides, all perfectly synced to 15 heavy instrumental tracks. Miss once and it's over.

4633190.title: Spiretela
4633190.short_description: Climb the tower, defeat powerful enemies, and uncover the cause of a cosmic instability in this intense roguelike adventure.

4633250.title: Star Breaker Index
4633250.short_description: Short incremental game where you mine asteroids, destroy enemy ships, travel through the galaxy and manage resources to improve your exo-suit, but be careful all those upgrades might bring some unwanted attention! what could be lurking in the infinite space?

4633340.title: Pizza Boy
4633340.short_description: A pizzeria simulator where you can take customers orders, make pizzas, and manage your shop.

4633390.title: DeadZone Outpost
4633390.short_description: Turn-based pixel survival shooter against waves of zombies. Limited resources, tactical shooting, diverse weapons, and deep incremental progression with a large skill tree.

4633540.title: Soft Money
4633540.short_description: Eight weeks from Election Day, political consultant Wells Ashford negotiates with three women at ideological extremes: a conservative TV host, a tenants' organizer, and a foreign agent. Each meeting becomes something else—romance as leverage, intimacy as access, ideology as costume.

4633700.title: Feast for Frogs
4633700.short_description: Leap into this cozy incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

4633760.title: Deskdragora
4633760.short_description: Deskdragora is a desktop companion game designed to live in the corner of your screen. Split your time between taking care of a little plant monster (or is it a monster plant?) while you work, study, or pretend to be productive.

4634000.title: Leviathan
4634000.short_description: Leviathan is a multiplayer ocean survival game where you play as a fish, hunt smaller creatures, and evolve unique abilities to dominate a living ecosystem of players and AI!

4634090.title: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band
4634090.short_description: The band is in town, and it’s time for some fun! Join Miss Rosen, a clockwork majorette escaped from her music box, as she travels the world solving mind-bending puzzles that’ll allow you to put things where they belong!

4634430.title: DelveCo
4634430.short_description: A roguelike management game where you operate DelveCo’s corporate software to recruit adventurers, send them into procedurally generated dungeons, direct their actions, equip gear and spells, and oversee turn-based combat while balancing risk and profit under strict quotas.

4634520.title: CatBun Idle
4634520.short_description: Tap and idle your way through 40 areas with adorable catgirl and bunny girl companions! Level up your crew, trigger powerful skills, and prestige for Stardust in this cute pixel art idle RPG with a full original soundtrack.

4634610.title: Malk
4634610.short_description: You are Malk. You survived where you were meant to die. And now you are paying for it. Fanatics are hunting you. Aristocrats are playing with your life. And power is your only chance not to become dirt beneath someone else’s boots. Allies betray you. Patrons use you. No one gets a second chance.

4634710.title: Blood and Bravery
4634710.short_description: Blood and Bravery is a fantasy horde-survivor with an emphasis on action-RPG elements. Discover magical gear to deck out your character from head to toe. Craft your perfect champion to take on massive swarms and difficult bosses. Ascend to new heights of power to conquer the challenges before you.

4634760.title: Eternal Flame
4634760.short_description: Eternal Blaze Eternal Blaze is an action looter‑survival extraction game. Players take on the role of a Flower Seeker, who journeys to the Otherworld to quell the calamities plaguing the mortal realm.

4634900.title: GViRacer
4634900.short_description: Race, drift, and prove your skill in a fast-paced arcade racer. Unlock cars, master 16 tracks, and defeat rival drivers across multiple difficulty levels – solo or in local split-screen.

4634940.title: Architect of War
4634940.short_description: A strategic tower defense with roguelike elements where every enemy demands an answer. Prepare your team, adapt your defense, and face waves designed to break your strategy.

4635030.title: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on borrowed dime
4635030.short_description: An Action-Rougelike Deckbuilder with a twist: Build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver‘s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are monitoring you. As it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin-flips, you were the one to take it's job offer.

4635600.title: Scoundrel: Deck Crawler
4635600.short_description: A roguelike pixel-art dungeon crawler inspired by the card game Scoundrel. Strategically manage your health and equipment while using Tarot cards to survive until the very last card.

4635720.title: Fractal Soul
4635720.short_description: An open-world action RPG where you expand your Infinite Skill Tree to live the ultimate power fantasy. Evolve through distinct races, reap balance-defying items, and endlessly scale your power to shape a soul entirely your own.

4635850.title: piano-BALL
4635850.short_description: A 2D physics-based puzzle game where pressing keys triggers sounds and interactions. Experiment with timing and mechanics to solve challenges and progress through creative levels.

4635890.title: Night Guard - The Last Shift
4635890.short_description: Check license plates, handle incidents, and keep working your shift while an unauthorized visitor keeps insisting on getting into the lot. What starts as a dull routine turns into an increasingly terrifying night

4636050.title: Internet Cafe Tycoon
4636050.short_description: Run your own internet cafe in late 1990s and early 2000s! Seat customers, brew drinks, hire a ghost apprentice, and level up your business. A nostalgic tycoon sim with pixel art, CRT vibes, and that unmistakable LAN party atmosphere.

4636080.title: Samurai Pets
4636080.short_description: Take on your friends & players from around the world in lightning-fast duels where timing is everything. Tap at the right moment… or lose instantly. Samurai Pets is a fast-paced arcade game where one button decides the outcome. Duel locally or online—extreme reflexes, mind games, & chaos guaranteed.

4636110.title: Subject: Escape
4636110.short_description: Escape a mysterious laboratory in a 2.5D puzzle platformer. Solve challenges, navigate experimental rooms, and find your way out.

4636120.title: Moss Palace Parade
4636120.short_description: 謎に満ちた施設「モスパレス」を探索し、貴女と世界に秘められた謎を解き明かそう

4636410.title: Flight Date
4636410.short_description: A puzzle simulation game where you plan trips with limited tickets, meet new people, and solve story-driven puzzles to reunite them.

4636440.title: Fractal Flyers
4636440.short_description: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across hand animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.

4636460.title: Ctrl+Alt+Defeat Zero Humanity
4636460.short_description: A 2D roguelike survivor where robots face absurd human leaders at the end of the world. Waves, builds, epic bosses, and an infinite mode for those who conquer Antarctica. Chaos never felt this good.

4636500.title: Growth Function
4636500.short_description: A sharp, first-person incremental game about materializing objects. Fire at falling data, solidify your path, and stack the physical remains of your labor to reach the unreachable. Shoot, make, climb and buy upgrades. Every system has its limits—yours are artificial. Break them.

4636540.title: Cards n Zombies
4636540.short_description: Choose your champions and descend into card-based dungeons of the undead. Search for upgrade cards and treasures, survive, and make difficult choices, all within an exotic card game atmosphere.

4638010.title: The Sin Of Fabien
4638010.short_description: A psychological horror about guilt, denial, and the truths you chose to ignore.

4638050.title: Fates of Command
4638050.short_description: Shields up, red alert! YOU are the captain. Experience the thrill of command in this captain's chair roguelike: engage in combat, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, explore, make scientific discoveries and perform a dash of diplomacy.

4638120.title: All Vans on Deck
4638120.short_description: All Vans on Deck is a logistics simulation game about a network that never stops demanding more. Connect cities across land and water, shape your routes, and keep the parcels flowing. The older a city gets, the faster it generates. How long can you hold it together?

4638130.title: Hustlin' Every Day
4638130.short_description: Dead broke in a dump, heavy mob debts, and a sick mother in the hospital. Hustle your way out. Flip wholesale goods online, day-trade crypto, build mining rigs, or dive deep into the dark web. A first-person hustle simulator where every dollar is your ticket out—or your death sentence.

4638280.title: Peter the Stash Hunter
4638280.short_description: Play as Peter, bid on abandoned storage units at auction, loot the treasures inside, and sell them in your own shop. Peter the Stash Hunter is a single-player adventure that blends auction thrills, looter-RPG discovery, and shop management simulation.

4638300.title: PlanetMars3D: Spirit Mission
4638300.short_description: Explore Mars in 3D through real Pancam photographs from NASA's Spirit rover. Glide between images with detail that sharpens as you approach, and skim thousands of rover photos at a glance — manual mode, slideshow, or automated flythrough. Photo credit: JPL / NASA / Cornell / ASU

4638590.title: Goaldeck
4638590.short_description: Football meets roguelike deck-building. Be the coach: draft legends, stack Manager Cards, and manage player egos with Reigns-style choices. Place your squad across 3 zones, open packs, upgrade cards, and conquer all 8 cups against escalating AI. Lose and start over — win and lift the trophy.

4638610.title: Tell Death We Live
4638610.short_description: The Gods are dead. The universe is dying. Survive and explore the anomaly in this story-rich, turn-based, RPG deck-builder, featuring real-time defensive mechanics and online co-operative play.

4638830.title: 妄梦海之战 War Of Delusive Dreams Sea
4638830.short_description: Place the ships, locate the enemy, confirm the number of enemies, and then fire. Explore the storyline and collect various ships and cannons. It's just such a simple game. We have no plans to release an English version for the time being.
developers: 山屋锻戈 Mtn Forge Arms
publishers: 山屋锻戈 Mtn Forge Arms

4638860.title: PROMulti-TableTournament
4638860.short_description: PROMulti-TableTournament is a Texas Hold’em multi-table tournament strategy simulator. read hands by position, stack depth, blinds, and opponent actions, then choose fold, call, raise, or all-in to practice MTT pacing. GTOrange judgment, stack control, and final table decisions.

4638930.title: Ember Legion
4638930.short_description: 《Ember Legion》 is a lightweight RTS. Rifts shattered the world—hope lingers in embers. Choose a hero, build a legion, attack by day, defend by night. Master day-night cycles and troop combos to reclaim your homeland.

4639050.title: Battle Queen
4639050.short_description: Charming heroines jump into the Battle Stone conflict, risking their destinies. Their hidden stories and fierce struggles begin now. Claim victory and reveal their true selves.

4639120.title: klik.
4639120.short_description: klik. is a minimalist puzzle game about turning off every light. Click a tile to toggle it and its neighbors. 50 hand-crafted levels. Tons of achievements. Simple to learn, satisfying to master.

4639130.title: Aether FIR ATC Simulator
4639130.short_description: Take control of the airspace in Aether FIR ATC Simulator, an interactive Air Traffic Control simulator. Guide aircraft safely through your sector by issuing altitude, speed, and heading commands. Prevent mid-air collisions, manage complex traffic flows, or master challenging campaigns.

4639140.title: Dough it Yourself
4639140.short_description: Create your own cozy farm and bakery, where you grow crops, care for animals, craft ingredients, and bake delicious goods entirely from your own production.

4639170.title: Tileburg
4639170.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

4639490.title: Custom Corner
4639490.short_description: Custom Corner is a cozy simulation and focus tool that runs quietly in a corner of your screen. Create your own isometric room with over 200 items and enjoy lo-fi music. Boost your productivity while working or relaxing with devices like a to-do list and focus timer.

4639510.title: JIRO
4639510.short_description: JIRO is a story driven action-adventure game featuring fast-paced combat, exploration, and challenging puzzles in a mysterious and evolving world.

4639650.title: Mostly Delivered
4639650.short_description: Ride through a chaotic city on two wheels as the world's worst courier. Pick up passengers, deliver packages, pull off speed boosts and try not to ragdoll everyone into traffic. Arcade meets physics comedy.

4639760.title: Radioactive Roses
4639760.short_description: Radioactive Roses is a deckbuilding, tactical RPG. Explore the wasteland, fight mutants, scavage for resources, and... met cute and horny ladies where most guys died, and you are one of the last surviving males!

4639770.title: 主公請躺好
4639770.short_description: 【主公請躺好】是掛機類卡牌遊戲，玩家可以組建自己的隊伍，遊戲無需操作自動完成挑戰。獲得更高級的裝備和寶物後提升隊伍的實力，挑戰更高難度的BOSS。

4639780.title: NOT ENOUGH SPACE
4639780.short_description: Shoot to move. Move to survive. A space action roguelike about momentum, chaotic battles, loot, builds, and bosses.

4639820.title: Farmastrophy With Friends
4639820.short_description: A chaotic farming race against the clock! Sow, water, harvest your crops and prepare meals — then deliver them to the tractor before the cows trample everything. Solo or with friends in online co-op!

4639950.title: Recoil Rabbit
4639950.short_description: A momentum based 2D pixel art platformer where shotgun recoil is your primary movement tool. Blast yourself through increasingly brutal levels across multiple worlds, each with unique enemies, obstacles, and weekly Steam leaderboards.

4639980.title: Red Light On
4639980.short_description: Red Light On is a single-player first-person shooter that follows a tactical police officer, seen through the lens of his body cam. As you investigate a challenging case, you’ll need to rely on both your combat tactics and investigative abilities to make progress.

4640000.title: Vibe Farmer
4640000.short_description: In Vibe Farmer, you shape and cultivate a peaceful farm, turning simple land into a cozy, living world. Plant crops, decorate your space, and watch as wind, weather, and time of day gently shift the atmosphere creating a relaxing rhythm where your farm grows.

4640030.title: Teeworlds : Archive
4640030.short_description: TeeworldsArchive is a free online multiplayer game with community support, including Deathmatch and Infection, available for all major PC operating systems. Battle or cooperate in the Tees' world with up to 64 players. You can also play in a map with music.

4640080.title: Walled City of Living Will
4640080.short_description: AI-generated fantasy RPG set in a living fortress city and its world. Take quests, visit facilities, meet NPCs, and explore dungeons through free text input and choices. Towns, dungeons, NPCs, items, text, and illustrations are generated in real time, creating a new adventure every playthrough.

4640140.title: Parry the Bullet
4640140.short_description: Kill fast. Die fast. Parry, slash and shoot your way through an army of gunslinger knights in this fast-paced top-down action. Master stylish kills and fuel your speed with blood. A short and intense challenge.

4640280.title: Lantern Lane
4640280.short_description: A roguelite management game blending deckbuilding and shop sim elements. Recruit workers, arrange buildings, craft powerful builds, and maximise profit each run.

4640320.title: 17 Steps
4640320.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4640320.short_description: 17 Steps is a fast-paced Japanese mahjong duel. You handpick 13 tiles from a pool of 34 as your starting hand, then race to tenpai and victory within just 17 discards. No chi, no pon — only tsumo and ron, stripped down to what mahjong is really about: hand efficiency and reading your opponent.

4640350.short_description: 1101-The Steel is Your Soul! Experience a hyper-realistic alien frontier where the scale of a flight simulator meets the bone-crunching intensity of a hardcore ARPG. Master the Dual-Combat System: take to the skies in advanced machinery then breach enemy strongholds to settle the score on the ground

4640540.title: 枫落奇遇记
4640540.short_description: 王都为何孤军对抗外星人？枫落为何爆发可怕的力量？

4641230.title: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol
4641230.short_description: Fast-paced roguelite where you switch combat styles mid-fight, destroy the world around you, and survive an ever-escalating challenge. Adapt, master your skills, and push your limits as each run becomes faster, deadlier, and more unforgiving.

4641520.title: Ultrapong
4641520.short_description: Extreme procedural bullet hell. Not ping-pong. It’s ULTRAPONG—where color defines behavior. Battle through a spectrum of 16,777,216 potential enemies where even the slightest chromatic shift alters their mass, size, and acceleration. No clones, just a continuous evolution of movement and challenge.

4641550.title: Kegs of Eternity
4641550.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

4641620.title: Space Fleet Logistics
4641620.short_description: Wars are won by logistics. Command the Federation's fleets across a star system, manage supply chains, secure planets, and outmaneuver a relentless AI enemy. Every battle is decided before it begins.

4641640.title: Only Humans On Board
4641640.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4641640.short_description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

4641700.title: Sill Cats
4641700.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4641700.short_description: Tiny cats have moved onto your desktop. They pad along the tops of your windows, swat at your cursor, curl up for a nap somewhere, then suddenly bolt across the screen at 2 a.m. Adore them for their cat-like antics. Two breeds are free to invite home.

4641910.title: Build To The Moon
4641910.short_description: A relaxing incremental tower builder—until hundreds of tiny workers turn it into complete chaos.

4641930.title: DeadWeight: A Lullaby
4641930.short_description: A baby falls. You jump after it. One moment changes everything in Deadweight: A Lullaby, a dark narrative experience about irreversible consequence.

4642010.title: Spectron
4642010.short_description: A fast-paced, retro-style space shooter with challenging levels. Race against the clock as you blast and dodge through waves of enemies and obstacles, pushing your reflexes to the limit.

4642030.title: Bee Killings Inn
4642030.short_description: A turn-based grid strategy action where you fight bees with household items inside a haunted inn. BeeKillingsInn blends tactical grid combat with quick time events and deck-driven enemy AI. Clear room after room of angry bees using shoes, fly swatters, and spray cans

4642060.title: InVein
4642060.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4642060.short_description: Traverse this never-ending hospital as you discover clues of where and who you are. As each day passes by, the world around you decays, and you can’t help but wonder what is real. Utilize your time and resources as you roam these collapsing halls, but be careful; you may not be alone after all...

4642090.title: Urban Feather
4642090.short_description: Urban Feather is a local co-op digital tabletop game for 1-4 players about avian migration. Navigate a procedurally generated city, manage environmental hazards, and learn real-world strategies to prevent bird-window collisions.

4642250.title: Prevent WW3
4642250.short_description: You have no direct power - only diplomacy and influence. A global strategy game where you lead an international organization: stop conflicts, resolve economic crises, and restore stability before the world descends into chaos.

4642260.title: Sovereign Hand : The Last Enclave
4642260.short_description: Build and defend your fantasy city in a strategic roguelike deckbuilding experience. Manage resources, upgrade your enclave, and choose your cards wisely to survive the encroaching darkness. Every decision shapes the fate of your sovereignty in Sovereign Hand: The Last Enclave.

4642380.title: Nothing Ever Happens Here
4642380.short_description: A British life sim set in a real town, with a real Grandad at its core. Can you turn your life around, save his pub, and make something of yourself?

4642400.title: PANEMA
4642400.short_description: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

4642440.title: Thrivelands
4642440.short_description: Thrivelands is a cozy and simple city builder where you create pretty villages by playing and discovering cards. Earn coins for great placements, fulfill quests and spend coins for new cards and upgrades. And most of all, dont run out of cards.

4642510.title: Cosmic Wilker
4642510.short_description: Cosmic Wilker is a boss rush bullet hell roguelite where you’ve literally become a spaceship and must now defeat a pantheon of gods to reset reality and save planet Earth.

4642610.title: Deephold
4642610.short_description: A tactical dwarven tower defense. Forge runes onto 7 tower types, unlock commander skills, and hold your gates through 12 campaign levels and an endless gauntlet. No ads, no micro-transactions, no always-online. Buy once, play forever.

4642630.title: MythicMonsterOutlaws
4642630.short_description: Skip the grind and dive into an MMO focused entirely on skill-based PvP and PvE combat. Unlock weapons and skills to expand your build variety, not your power. Competitive leaderboards, instanced raids, and fast-paced arenas—mythic combat starts the moment you create a character.

4642650.title: Souls Inferno
4642650.short_description: A minimalist soulslike with turn-based combat. Enter a cursed realm, defeat demonic knights, collect souls, and shape your build as you uncover a deeply interconnected world.

4642780.title: SAKIMORI
4642780.short_description: "Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary." Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

4642840.title: Spear of the Sky
4642840.short_description: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

4642870.title: オブジェクト・ハッピーエンディング
4642870.short_description: “You” are the only human to have arrived in a world inhabited by non-human beings with the characteristics of objects, commonly known as “Objects.” A visual novel game in which you grant the Objects—who can only end their lives through human hands—the endings they desire.

4643160.title: Mining Grounds
4643160.short_description: A clicker where every click matters. Build chains, break limits, and automate everything. Place characters to trigger powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and scale your clicks to extreme levels. No rush. Just satisfying progression and smart strategy.

4643290.title: Come Right Inn - Season 2
4643290.short_description: The Come Right Inn, a 5-star LA hotel, offers the elite anything they desire, as long as they’re willing to pay. Your sister worked there until her mysterious disappearance six months ago. Now, it's up to you to uncover the hidden truths behind the allure and find out what really happened.

4643380.title: Typical NPC
4643380.short_description: Run a grimy fantasy weapon shop while heroes save the world somewhere else. Sell rusty swords, survive arrogant customers, repair the damage, and fight for your retirement before the final battle arrives.

4643390.title: More Deaths, More Fun (Lie)
4643390.short_description: More Deaths, More Fun (Lie) is a brutal 2D platformer where every death makes the game harder. Face evolving levels, precise challenges, and climb the global leaderboard. Fail fast, adapt faster - or lose your sanity trying.

4643480.title: Shutterspeed
4643480.short_description: Use your awesome camera gadgets to drill through enemies and the environment, fly where no cameraman has flown before and most importantly, freeze the world like a photograph in this platforming adventure through cyberspace!

4643650.title: pixel arabi
4643650.short_description: A challenging 2D platformer full of traps, pranks, and surprises. Explore five unique islands, each with five handcrafted stages, and survive a world designed to test your skill and patience.

4643700.title: Bug Down
4643700.short_description: Take flight as a fierce wasp and tear through giant household rooms — dodging hazards, blasting bugs, and tackling shifting objectives across every room in the house.

4643740.title: Null Carrier
4643740.short_description: Operate a deep-space listening array in this minimalist signal-reconstruction puzzle game. Tune frequencies, isolate transmissions from noise, and classify patterns for Command. But as the shifts go by, you begin to realize: the signals aren't from where you thought, and Command is lying to you.

4643820.title: Second Monitor Football
4643820.short_description: A lightweight, physics-based football auto-simulation designed to be played or watched on a second monitor just press play and let the match unfold.

4643840.title: Hacker Cats
4643840.short_description: Hacker Cats is an idler game about hacking and cats. Hack servers, download data, sell it on the dark net and buy new upgrades for hacking.

4643870.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
4643870.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

4643890.title: Hantu & Hunted
4643890.short_description: Experience chaotic, large-scale hide-and-seek rooted in authentic Southeast Asian regional folklore. Can you survive the Hunt?

4643930.title: Serve Or Die
4643930.short_description: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.

4644100.title: The Blood Mage 2 by Daniel da Silva
4644100.short_description: The Blood Mage 2 is a turn-based Puzzle/Dungeon Crawler RPG hybrid. You play as a blood mage, so your health doubles as mana pool. Fight against different creatures and explore the environments to reach your goal!

4644200.title: Shadow Play: Nezha
4644200.short_description: Shadow Play: Nezha’s Legacy is a Roguelike action game blending Chinese myth with shadow puppetry. As a fallen god branded a fugitive, Nezha is trapped in a loop of death. Undergo Lotus Rebirths, build divine powers, and challenge the Three Realms to shatter the shackles of Samsara.

4644310.title: A Lighthouse on Rock Bottom
4644310.short_description: A narrative idle game about healing in your family's lighthouse. Clean, paint, eat healthy, and improve these habits while you reflect on the memories which brought you here. Make sure to give Dad a call too.

4644480.title: Dungeonery
4644480.short_description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

4645790.title: BURIED INSIDE ME
4645790.short_description: What if you couldn’t wake up from your worst nightmare? BURIED INSIDE ME is a first-person psychological horror experience where you find yourself trapped within your own dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive yourself.

4646010.title: Bot.by.Bot
4646010.short_description: Build and program customizable robots using simple logic systems to overcome clever grid-based challenges and help Robby reunite with his friends.

4646030.title: Toothy Trouble
4646030.short_description: A humorous action roguelike in which you play as a tooth battling endless hordes of sweets. Survive wave after wave, level up your character and face increasingly dangerous enemies. How long can you last?

4646080.title: The Cleaner's Contract
4646080.short_description: You are a mob cleaner drowning in $1,000,000 of underworld debt. Scrub procedural blood, dispose of bodies, manage your sanity, and exploit roguelite upgrades to survive this top-down 2D cleaning simulation.

4646090.title: Akonite Fall
4646090.short_description: Defeat hordes of enemies in Akonite Fall a Tower Defense in dark fantasy world! Protect castles, build and upgrade towers, combine physical and magical damage. Defend the kingdom from an unknown enemy summoned by the dark Obelisk!

4646170.title: Your Darling
4646170.short_description: Is staring at the computer too boring? Summon a girl to accompany you at work or while gaming!

4646260.title: GolFall: Make Your Way Up
4646260.short_description: Hit, fall, and try again. A hard and unforgiving golf action game where you land precisely on floating platforms to reach the top. Fall and you start over—but the higher you climb, the more retries you earn. Play solo or with friends and aim for the summit!

4646460.title: Sweet Land Survival
4646460.short_description: Sweet Land is an action-survival game with crafting: play a bear stranded on a candy island. Manage hunger, fish, gather food, and use jams to stay strong. Two allied bears help you collect resources and fight strange creatures. Quick wits and teamwork keep you alive.

4646530.title: Manifest Moonfall 月球坠落
4646530.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder adapted from "Records of the Giant Moon." Master the unique Emotion system with five distinct characters to break the death loop.

4646580.title: Tsuchinoko Fishing
4646580.short_description: "Tsuchinoko　Fishing" is a fishing romance adventure game. In this game, you'll fish in various locations, solve problems, and deepen your relationship with the heroine!

4646590.title: Loop Duck Battles
4646590.short_description: Loop Duck Battles is an engine-building battle game that combines Monopoly-style board gameplay with roguelike elements.

4646660.title: Dress Up
4646660.short_description: Climb to collect. Dress up to shine. Gather outfits as you make your way to the top.

4646720.title: Unlock Her Desire
4646720.short_description: Meet four girls, build attraction, and unlock a fully animated intimate scene. A short, replayable experience focused on chemistry, visuals, and desire.

4646910.title: Indian Street Food Simulator
4646910.short_description: Run your own simple and friendly Indian street food stall. Serve customers from your roadside stand, cook authentic dishes and absurd food combos, manage limited ingredients, and keep up with orders. A chaotic yet warm single-player experience focused on your stall.

4647160.title: Raze The Realm
4647160.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

4648300.title: PaletCard涂涂卡牌
4648300.short_description: Palet Card is a turn-based strategy card game that blends grid battlefield tactics, deck-driven decisions, and roguelite run progression. Through painting, synthesis, and sticker interactions, you fight to keep the board alive while pushing through escalating encounters.

4649950.title: Bladeweave
4649950.short_description: A fast-paced beat ’em up roguelite focused on long combos and relentless action. Fight through each run, craft powerful builds, and carve your way back to the lich who shattered time.

4650100.title: 幽囚の魔法使い
4650100.short_description: “The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice. Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

4650370.title: Cycle of the Unbroken
4650370.short_description: A new roguelike deckbuilder enters the battle. Master the 5 styles, fight rival schools, prepare your counterattacks, stack bonuses and become the Unbroken Iron Pillar.

4650450.title: Pulcinella's Infinity
4650450.short_description: Pulcinella's Infinity is a psychedelic roguelite deckbuilder that blends the centuries-old tradition of Neapolitan Scopa with a cyber aesthetic. In a future where folklore has been digitized into an infinite kernel, you'll play as Pulcinella, hacking reality one deck of cards at a time.

4650570.title: Wake the Beacon
4650570.short_description: A short incremental game about firing bouncing shots, crushing geometric swarms, and upgrading your beacon to send its signal farther and farther.

4650640.title: MeowRig
4650640.short_description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

4650680.title: Micro Corp
4650680.short_description: A desktop idler management simulator, where you are the CEO of a software company. Buy computers, place furniture, hire employees, buy upgrades, fire prompt engineers and much more. Or just focus on something else while your company revenue grows.

4650720.title: Deadhand Theater
4650720.short_description: Deadhand Theater is a dark, turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set on a stage where poker cards are your weapons and every hand you play carries unique combat properties. Collect and upgrade talismans, refine your deck, make desperate sacrifices with your own body to survive one fight longer!

4650780.title: Solo Defending
4650780.short_description: Hold the line alone. Fight waves, build elevated cover, and unlock permanent tech in this action tower defense. 30 waves. 3 bosses. One heroic last stand.

4650840.title: Up-Beat!!
4650840.short_description: Up-Beat!! is an action-packed boxing game heavily inspired by Punch-Out!! - fight through a colorful cast of characters and take your place in history as the WFBA's new world champion!

4650900.title: Grid of Change
4650900.short_description: Grid of Change is a turn-based strategy board game where every move can change the entire match. Easy to learn but hard to master, it delivers fast, tense, and highly tactical mind games against your opponents.

4650990.title: Random Coin
4650990.short_description: Buy, sell, and grow your capital in this simple, fast, and addictive trading simulation. Earn Prestige Coins and climb the Steam leaderboard.

4651030.title: PeeWee Purpdrank's FOENEM Clicker
4651030.short_description: The OFFICIAL PeeWee Purpdrank VIDEO GAME. Double Tap the FOENEM button in this wacky and hilarious idle-clicker.

4651040.title: Gear Notes -ogre slayer-
4651040.short_description: Japanese dark fantasy action RPG inspired by Momotaro. Experience fast-paced combat with combos, parries, and real-time character switching.

4651070.title: Red Clicker
4651070.short_description: Click the triangle. Watch the counter rise. Unlock 100 Steam achievements — from your very first click to one trillion. Simple, satisfying, and endlessly clickable. How far will you go?

4651120.title: Farming Incremental But With Guns
4651120.short_description: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

4651180.title: Virtual Karting
4651180.short_description: A ground-up karting simulator built on real racing experience. Authentic chassis flex, VR mimicked body weight shift, and tire dynamics that make a kart feel truly alive.

4651280.title: Bahgonia
4651280.short_description: Learn to confront your own fears in this surreal adventure. Push, attack, disable, destroy, outsmart, and send hordes of immortal enemies flying to escape this nightmare. Experience a journey of transformation and uncover the mysteries and deep secrets hidden in Bahgonia.

4651290.title: Parasomnia Verum 2
4651290.short_description: Parasomnia Verum 2 is a psychological horror game about Maddy's repeating nightmares crawling into reality.

4651300.title: Hotel Paraíso
4651300.short_description: What has happened at Hotel Paraíso? Explore this ancient haunted establishment in a game that blends RPG, puzzle, and turn-based strategy mechanics, and investigate the powerful tremor that has unleashed thousands of supernatural creatures, as the dreamlike and the magical intertwine.

4651320.title: Ashes of Holloway Bay
4651320.short_description: Immerse yourself in a chilling, interactive cold-case investigation. Review crime scene photos, decrypt restricted hard drives, compare evidence, and deliver your final report in Ashes of Holloway Bay, a dark, atmospheric detective experience where every detail matters.

4651500.title: Alchemania
4651500.short_description: Alchemania is a frantic co-op alchemy game for one to four players where you and your fellow apprentices must brew potions under time pressure. Follow recipes, prepare questionable concoctions and enchant unstable ingredients.

4651560.title: The Calcium Crusader 64
4651560.short_description: Meet the Calcium Crusader, a skeleton that has been brought to life in a world overrun by The Devil King! It is your task to save humanity and put a stop to an evil curse the Devil King has put upon the land. Delve into this retro-adventure and learn the mysteries of the past!

4651590.title: Agestan
4651590.short_description: Build your base in Agestan, form your army with cards, and crush your rivals. Conquer all lands solo or clash with a friend in PvP... Choose a blind spot, fire the catapult, and destroy their base. Remember: you can only see each other on the battlefield!

4651880.title: 6600：The Park
4651880.short_description: You are an investigator sent to an isolated prehistoric park sealed after a "containment breach." Facilities have collapsed. The former tourist zones are now hunting grounds. Your mission: uncover the truth behind the disaster, gather evidence, and reach the evacuation point before it's too late.

4652040.title: Night Record: Thin Walls
4652040.short_description: Vadim, a maintenance worker in a decaying post-Soviet apartment, leaves town to care for his sick mother, asking his wife to take over his duties. As she settles into the routine, the building begins to feel off quiet in all the wrong ways.

4652070.title: Forsaken Sight
4652070.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game, blending exploration, puzzles, stealth, and environmental storytelling. As Catherine, a young anthropologist lost in a surreal world, you must navigate through nightmares and dread to discover the truth behind both a forgotten evil and yourself.

4652230.title: Crankstone
4652230.short_description: The retro shooter with the fastest mini games in the Wild West! Step into the boots of the town marshall, get rid of nasty cowboys and dodge the corrupted sheriff. And when your shift is finally over, enjoy some downtime at the saloon!

4652300.title: Matching Misrolls
4652300.short_description: Gamble your way through misrolls, by matching dice and cards in this deckbuilder roguelike. Perform your best in this ancient game of luck to receive blessings from your adoring crowd. Place their bets carefully: cheating dice might not be enough to outlive the night.

4652340.title: Cloudrooms
4652340.short_description: You are trapped in a corridor suspended above the clouds. At the end lies a door. Explore the ever-changing environment each time you open it, find anomalies, use the alarm, and break the loop.

4652730.title: Lost Vessel
4652730.short_description: Idle sci-fi RPG where combat actually matters. Crash-landed on an alien world, you rebuild through five skills, melee/ranged/void-magic combat, and a server-wide world boss. Progress keeps going while you're AFK. Solo, co-op, or faction raids. No pay-to-win.

4652830.title: Synapse Idle
4652830.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

4653100.title: Train Set Code
4653100.short_description: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

4653180.title: Boreal
4653180.short_description: What if the winter season never ended? With an unique hunting mechanic, and a pixel aesthetic, unravel the tale of Boreal.

4653210.title: The Mask of Agnosia
4653210.short_description: The Mask of Agnosia is a surreal 3D narrative RPG. Navigate and map a shifting network of waterways to recover a boat keeper’s memories.
