Solve matching puzzles to reveal a fallen kingdom, confront specters of time, and collect sacred masks to rebuild an ancient tower before the light fades.

4653240.title: HALLS
4653240.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4653240.short_description: HALLS is a co-op survival horror game set in a liminal space for 1-6 players. You end up stranded inside of the backrooms. Explore to gather resources, protect your base and craft gear to hunt giant bosses. Will you be able to find a way out of this space in between worlds?

4653330.title: OurLife
4653330.short_description: OurLife is a text-forward life simulator game filled with immersive, choice-driven systems that impact more than just the character you're playing. Live any life, make any choice: OurLife.

4653360.title: Egress: Gravity & Escape
4653360.short_description: A box full of blocks and bubbles. One door. Rotate to empty it — in as few turns as possible.

4653490.title: IVON
4653490.short_description: Stranded in a cursed forest until dawn. Loot abandoned facilities, fight creatures, and survive other players. But death isn't the end — when you fall, you return as a spirit. Help your friends reach the dawn, or haunt those who betrayed you. Survive the night. If you can.

4653530.title: Red Rising
4653530.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

4653580.title: Ranger of Ancuria
4653580.short_description: Get out there, young ranger, and help those in need. Your journey starts in Ranger of Ancuria, a retro game that recreates the experience of the adventures of the 8-bit era. Explore a full of life open world, find why monsters are multiplying and unveil the mysteries from the dungeons of Ancuria.

4653610.title: Bar Simulator
4653610.short_description: You made a demonic deal to open your bar. With your friends, prepare cocktails, manage the chaos, and pay off your debt as you build your own bar empire.

4653670.title: Signal Bleed
4653670.short_description: How much damage can love do when there is no one watching? A first-person psychological horror game. One facility. One voice. Two realities.

4653860.title: Hollow Crown
4653860.short_description: Hollow Crown is a dark idle-incremental autobattler that casts you as an ascendant claimant to a ruined throne. Assemble a court of cursed champions, relics, and sigils; set their decks, assign passive roles, and watch the spire’s floors unspool as automated skirmishes resolve

4654060.title: Mellow's Garden
4654060.short_description: Build your dream garden as a cute cat in Mellow’s Garden, a cozy and stress-free farming game. Plant crops, harvest them, earn money, and customize your space however you like.

4654140.title: Tethyscope
4654140.short_description: Explore our planet's ocean to discover animals, plants, and shipwrecks. Take photographs to document your findings and sell them to fund upgrades to your submarine.

4654170.title: Tenured Hearts
4654170.short_description: Tenured Hearts is an adult romance visual novel set at an elite New England university. As tenured professor Harlan Voss, navigate three entangled romances—an advisee, a rival colleague, and a trustee's daughter—where every choice risks your career, reputation, and heart.

4654200.title: Promethean Thirst
4654200.short_description: Fight your way through hordes of vampiric thralls to earn the favor of the gods! Curate a unique arsenal of legendary relics and blessed weapons in each run of this roguelite where Greek mythology meets vampires!

4654240.title: Beyond The Blight
4654240.short_description: A first person, incremental dungeon-crawler that bestows upon you temporary invincibility to conquer the blighted lands. Prepare to embark on a perilous journey as you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

4654280.title: 我的钓鱼世界
4654280.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Sports, Early Access
4654280.short_description: 主打沉浸式真实垂钓体验，融合野钓探索、黑坑竞技、家园养成多元玩法；坐拥开阔临海钓场 + 垂钓别墅，随时随地随心挥竿垂钓，还能与全网钓友实时联机互动，一站式解锁原汁原味的沉浸式垂钓乐趣。

4654310.title: The Crane Rider's Tale
4654310.short_description: Fly passengers around a fantasy town inspired by Chinese folktales and unravel a mindbending, Zero Escape-like mystery.

4654620.title: 我的璀璨男友
4654620.short_description: 《我的璀璨男友》是一款悬疑恋爱互动乙女类游戏。你化身咖啡店老板，调查父兄失踪真相，与五位性格迥异的豪门男主邂逅，在步步惊心中解锁专属浪漫结局。

4654710.title: Hentai Age Desert
4654710.short_description: Experience a peaceful puzzle quest where each victory showcases a new beauty. With zero pressure and a focus on flow, it is the ultimate way to relax and lose yourself in soothing visuals.

4654740.title: The Unnamed
4654740.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play
4654740.short_description: The Unnamed is a third-person fantasy RPG with character action style combat. Play as Ao, a Spirit Wanderer hellbent on avenging his family, and discover the secrets of the spirit realm.

4654980.title: Bio-Breaker
4654980.short_description: Fight against over 25+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

4654990.title: Not a Trolley Problem!
4654990.short_description: A dark-humor idle clicker where you drag hapless pedestrians onto the trolley tracks. Every splat pays out. Spend coins on faster hands, bigger trolleys, and satirical upgrades. There's no trolley problem — just a trolley solution.

4655050.title: 야간근무 - Finding
4655050.genre: Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4655050.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you monitor CCTV cameras, detect anomalies, and report them to survive a night shift in a military base.

4655060.title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
4655060.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

4655100.title: A Mystic Journey With : Olea
4655100.short_description: Embark on a titillating journey through mystical realms with Olea, your alluring guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with seductive reveals.

4655140.title: C.R.F.T. // Chuansha Is Not in Shanghai and We Are Lost
4655140.short_description: Chuansha County of a parallel world, 2004. Everything was so old-fashioned. The story begins on the last day of the summer holiday. Perhaps even earlier...

4655250.title: Mainland Delivery Run
4655250.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4655250.short_description: This is a simulation management game about urban survival. You play as an unemployed young person. To make a living, you hop on an e-bike and start dashing through the city’s streets and alleys delivering takeout.

4655370.title: Wardens of Inysgar
4655370.short_description: As the old warden, you are forming a band of adventurers to save the realm from evil. Choose your party, level them up, and watch them fight. Navigate skill trees and explore the fantastical lands of Inysgar in this stylised 3D autobattler.

4655400.title: 'In You We Trust, Not Algorithms' ~Newbie Matsumoto's Manual Elevator Operation with Sticky Notes~
4655400.short_description: A hyper-stressful, strictly manual elevator simulation! You're the corporation's new "control system" (a human). Drag and drop sticky notes to transport employees. Amidst massive clock-out rushes and blaring complaints, can you survive this extreme one-man shift?!

4655410.title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 18 Collectors Edition
4655410.short_description: A family friendly Hidden Object Game set in the Great Outdoors

4655540.title: 摸金秘藏
4655540.short_description: A Chinese tomb-raiding action-puzzle game featuring teammate recruitment and tomb plundering.

4655570.title: SHUT UP, IT'S HERE!
4655570.short_description: Shut Up, It's Here is a co-op survival game where you're trapped in a pitch-black labyrinth. Your voice is your only light source but speaking lets IT hear you. Navigate the darkness with friends, stay quiet to survive, and escape before IT finds you.

4655590.title: Silly Agent
4655590.short_description: He’s highly trained but highly unstable! Guide a clumsy agent through wild rescue missions across the globe. Use physics to your advantage (or demise) in solo or split-screen co-op. Whether jumping trucks or saving kittens, every step is a hilarious challenge in Silly Agent!

4655610.title: Robo Rig
4655610.short_description: Robo Rig is a 3D, top down, Extraction Bullet Hell where you play as a fully customizable robot. You build your robot, enter battle and destroy enemies, gain coins and collect parts, then you must extract and build an even more powerful robot with the newly acquired parts!

4655720.title: Tomatito's Culinary Pizza Adventure
4655720.short_description: Help Tomatito make a delicious pizza! Dough, cheese, onion and... watch out for the slippery spots!

4655750.title: Trucker: Master Drivers
4655750.short_description: Experience the realistic truck driving experience in Turkey with your friends, and start your journey to becoming MASTER DRIVERS through realistic vehicle breakdowns and road experiences.

4655770.title: Rune Tavern
4655770.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

4655800.title: Slime Soup
4655800.short_description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange Decorations, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

4655810.title: Decide Your Fate
4655810.short_description: Trapped in a house with a blind killer, your voice is your worst enemy and silence is your only ally. Navigate through the shadows, find the clues, and escape before his keen ears find you. In Decide Your Fate, every sound you make could be your last. Will you survive the night?

4655850.title: Yunling Dreamland In Tian'e County
4655850.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

4655940.title: Eternal Eden™ Resurgence
4655940.short_description: A classic-style RPG brought back with a fresh 3D look. Explore, battle, and uncover new secrets in this expanded remake of a beloved 2008 adventure.

4656300.title: Hollow Rock
4656300.short_description: A horror game set in an abandoned mine full of dark secrets and deadly puzzles. Explore underground tunnels, uncover the story, and hide from an unknown monster that hunts you. Will you survive and find a way out?

4656430.title: Crusoe & Agarthas: Chronicles of Speranza
4656430.short_description: A witty musical visual novel based on an apocryphal manuscript found in Daniel Defoe’s lost sock. Survive the 'capitalist trágala', mock the júnjuma, explore Speranza Island, and discover the beautiful Agarthas in this hand-drawn odyssey.

4656460.title: Idle Aqua Driller
4656460.short_description: Dive into the depths of the ocean in this incremental game about underwater mining! Control drilling rigs, hire divers and submarines, and unlock new layers and resources. Upgrade your decks, speed up mining, and develop your skill tree to turn your station into a powerful underwater complex.

4656520.title: Palingenesia
4656520.short_description: Explore the ruins of a mysterious castle filled with deep magic, brutal monsters, and ancient secrets. Fight your way through the dark castle to find the king's son.

4656540.title: Granny's Rampage
4656540.short_description: Granny's had enough. Armed with a minigun and a bad attitude, she's cutting through five stages of demonic suburbia, hellfire, and the forces of darkness itself.

4656550.title: NEKO MAKER: Catgirl Raising Story
4656550.short_description: She came to you at six. Twelve years later, who she becomes depends on every choice you make. 15 endings, 61 events, and a letter only the two of you will ever read.

4656560.title: Not My Son
4656560.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

4656630.title: Wonderful Realms
4656630.short_description: Visit many wonderful realms of various types and defeat a huge variety of enemies with a selection of weapons.

4656650.title: Last Lawn Standing
4656650.short_description: Use flower pot towers and barricades to shape deadly mazes and killboxes for invading creatures of darkness. Control a lawn gnome, level up endlessly, upgrade gear, craft new builds, protect sacred altars, and survive infinite randomized nights.

4656690.title: Pink Clicker
4656690.short_description: Click the pink heart. Unlock 100 achievements. Simple, satisfying, and endlessly clickable. How far can your dedication take you? Every 100 clicks brings a new milestone. Are you a Pink Clicker Master?

4656700.title: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
4656700.short_description: Create delicious coffee drinks and cannoli in Papa's Mocharia Deluxe! Create stylish layered lattes in the coffeehouse for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Take a trip in the Food Truck to design and serve your own eye-catching creations!

4658320.title: Rebel's Ascent
4658320.short_description: Defeat waves of enemies using everything from sticks to exploding throwing axes 💥🪓🪽 Rebel's Ascent is an incremental auto-battler RPG where you acquire and improve weapons, gain new talents, and fight your way to freedom.

4658450.title: House Of Trauma
4658450.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

4658470.title: Goldfish Simulator
4658470.short_description: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

4658490.title: Insert Disc
4658490.short_description: A DVD screensaver inspired roguelike - Launch the logo and watch the sparks fly, late 1990s-2000s nostalgia included. Maybe this time, it will hit the corner!

4658520.title: Cards of Bellum
4658520.short_description: A medieval strategy card game where a lucky dice roll can turn certain defeat into glorious victory... Lead unique heroes such as Wizards, or named knights. Build your deck. Storm the capital. Claim the throne.

4658560.title: Against the Dark Moon
4658560.short_description: The poker roguelike, reimagined as 1980s heroic fantasy. Play poker hands as combat as you lead a party of five heroes to hold back the rising Dark Moon. Every card is painted, named, and carries its own story. No two runs play the same.

4658590.title: Gridholm
4658590.short_description: A tactical card battler where positioning wins games. Deploy cards on a 5x5 grid, move them like chess pieces, and control the throne. Use terrain and cast powerful spells. 200+ cards across four factions. Play Roguelike Deckbuilder, Draft, or Ranked Multiplayer. Think-to-win never pay-to-win.

4658900.title: Bunny:Protect Her
4658900.short_description: Bunny: Protect Her is a third-person shooter (TPS) blended with tower defense elements. Armed with only a handgun, you must fight off waves of monsters to protect your girlfriend. Somehow you can fly because of the strange energy in the forest. Survive the onslaught until the break of dawn.

4658910.title: PachiRogue
4658910.short_description: A physics-based economic roguelite where you curate a pachinko machine to scale revenue. Draft synergistic passives, evolve balls, and rig the market.

4658940.title: EMZOMBED 2
4658940.short_description: EMZOMBED 2 - Get Ready for this TopDown Survival RPG Action Adventure game!

4658980.title: Wuxia Life
4658980.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4658980.short_description: Wuxia Life is a solo wuxia RPG on Yingzhou Island. From Luzhou Village, step into jianghu — trace your bloodline, join a faction, walk your own path. ATB combat, 6-slot skills, four mental-state systems (Inner Demon, Calligraphy, Pressure, Storyteller), 4-member party with pets, multiple endings.

4659090.title: Afterlife West
4659090.short_description: The Veil falls at sundown — and the West stops belonging to the living. AFTERLIFE WEST is co-op frontier survival where you build a ranch by day, hunt Wanted Legends across cursed biomes, and defend your crew through nights that shouldn't be survivable. Saddle up. Sunrise is earned, not given.

4659110.title: AllWheelDrive
4659110.short_description: Drive a single vehicle together, literally. In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

4659250.title: A Game About Flipping Cards
4659250.short_description: It's all in the title. A Game About Flipping Cards is an incremental game where you flip cards to make money to buy more cards and upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money.

4659260.title: Water Truck Simulator
4659260.short_description: Drive a heavy water tanker fill your tank travel through city roads and off-road routes and deliver water safely across challenging missions in Water Truck Simulator. Test your driving skills as you control a mini water tanker truck through traffic.

4659280.title: Not Yet
4659280.short_description: You are the Judge. Twelve souls appear before you, each burdened by regret. Words left unsaid. Promises left unfulfilled. Listen to their stories, then decide — Heaven or Hell. But when the twelfth soul arrives, everything changes.

4659330.title: Century’s End Awakening
4659330.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4659330.short_description: You wake from cryogenic slumber in 2099. Tech has transformed all, and society's split among three powerful factions. You've got 24 turns to explore a freely accessible map with 2D/3D scenes. Craft items, forge relationships, gather faction intel, maybe even fall for characters from rival groups.

4659340.title: Nullvein: Incremental Mining Evolution
4659340.short_description: Mine. Evolve. Sacrifice. Nullvein is a fast-paced incremental mining game where every strike counts and every reset makes you stronger.

4659380.title: Last Hit
4659380.short_description: LASTHIT is an original indie game that blends tactical strategy, roguelike elements, and deck-building. As the commander, you defend against monster invasions by positioning your troops and increasing your combat power—striking with the last hit to eliminate enemies before they go berserk.
developers: Huan Sheng Technology Chengdu Co., Ltd.
publishers: Huan Sheng Technology Chengdu Co., Ltd.

4659460.title: SALMON
4659460.short_description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels as satisfying as it feels ridiculous that a salmon can do it. Jump off walls, race your salmon friends, learn the ways of the salmon. Also, did you know that salmon are magnetic?

4659600.title: MQ: Rise Above
4659600.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG
4659600.short_description: Reach the heavens or burn in the abyss! In this intense physics survival, build your path out of a crumbling world. Dodge lightning and hurricanes, defeat epic bosses, and level up your hero. With wings, pets, and multiplayer, customize your legend and conquer the ultimate ascent!

4659610.title: Blueprint: EV
4659610.short_description: Blueprint: EV is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through six fiscal years. Make five binding decisions at the start, then guide pricing, production, R&D, and finance across 24 quarters of real P&L and three rivals companies.

4659640.title: TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER
4659640.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4659640.short_description: Live the life of a truck driver in TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER. Travel across open roads, complete jobs, manage your needs, upgrade your truck, and build your path in a world driven by distance and time.

4659650.title: ACHIEVEMENT MAZE
4659650.short_description: A minimalist maze game built for those who love simple, focused gameplay. Each maze is different. Each step counts. Find the exit. • 100 levels with increasing difficulty • 100 Steam achievements — one per level • Simple controls, pure maze gameplay

4659660.title: Graveyard Cabin
4659660.short_description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

4659730.title: Blighthold
4659730.short_description: Reclaim the lost city and its Eldritch Tree. Suffer through moral decisions that will shape your society. Defend against abominations and uncover the terrible secret that lies below. Blighthold is a 2D city builder set in a Lovecraftian-Dieselpunk world.

4659930.title: 丹命
4659930.short_description: In this realm, all beings can attain immortality—but also can be exploited and forged into materials. You are about to step into this world. You have no backing, no resources. Yet by chance, you are chosen by an immortal from the upper realm to serve as a divine officer. How will your story unfold?

4659950.title: Sky Recoil
4659950.short_description: SkyRecoil is a fast-paced action game where you use a powerful hammer to defeat enemies and propel yourself across the battlefield with explosive recoil. Avoid enemy attacks, prevent falling into the ocean, and challenge yourself to defeat as many enemies as possible.

4660070.title: Destructor2D
4660070.short_description: 2D racing sim with soft-body physics, car deformations, highway driving, demolition derby, professional racing, crash racing, drifting, truck racing, open wheel racing, advanced AI with up to 50 cars on track, and more.

4660170.title: Witch Shop Simulator
4660170.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4660170.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

4660180.title: Minim
4660180.short_description: Minim is a modern puzzle adventure in the style of classic minimalist retro games. Problem solve, uncover secrets and plan your attack on enemies in this grid-based odyssey.

4660210.title: Poolrooms Museum
4660210.short_description: A surreal exploration game set in endless poolrooms. Wander through water-filled halls, discover strange structures, and find your way through shifting spaces.

4660240.title: Tempest of Nations
4660240.short_description: Tempest of Nations is a real-time, historical grand strategy game set during the Industrial Revolution. Lead your nation through one of the most transformative eras of history as you manage diplomacy, economics, and politics.

4660280.title: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles
4660280.short_description: An asymmetric noir experience where communication is everything. While one player gathers clues on-site, the other provides guidance from analog terminals. Work together without seeing each other's screens to solve a complex murder case in a retro-tech world.

4660290.title: 100 Hidden ASCII Cats: Colors
4660290.short_description: A cozy hidden-object puzzle set in massive worlds drawn entirely from full-color ASCII text. Grab your magnifying glass and find 100 kittens hiding between the characters.

4660300.title: Hentai Flesh
4660300.short_description: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Glacial, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

4660350.title: Agro Tycoon
4660350.short_description: In this management simulator with a charming isometric pixel art aesthetic, you are not just a farmer, but the CEO of your own operation. Start with a modest plot of land, invest your initial capital wisely, and transform a small plantation into a true agribusiness powerhouse.

4660370.title: Astromental Incremental
4660370.short_description: Mesmerizing incremental idle clicker game about space. When objects collide, you receive matter. Use this matter to unlock and upgrade objects in your star system. Use powerful Abilities. Dive into the Prestige system (Warp) with a wide Skill Tree, and discover new star systems with new bonuses.

4660470.title: Near Mint
4660470.short_description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

4660480.title: The Plus-One Kingdom
4660480.short_description: In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

4660500.title: 3D Sokoban Quest
4660500.short_description: Get ready for an incredible journey of mental challenges! Embark on this adventure to solve 20 Sokoban-style puzzles.

4660530.title: Mow Simulator Together
4660530.short_description: Compete with friends in Mow Simulator Together, a fast-paced co-op game for up to 4 players where you race to mow the most grass. Choose your mower, manage damage and repairs, and outplay your rivals in chaotic, dynamic matches 🌿

4660620.title: Giantess Striker
4660620.short_description: Take down giant beauties taller than skyscrapers with a single shot from your ship! This game is an exhilarating one-versus-many strip-shooting game where you use your shots to completely destroy the giant girls’ outfits.

4660730.title: 西游释厄传
4660730.short_description: This is a strategy RPG wargame based on the ancient Chinese mythological classic Journey to the West.

4660760.title: Skate Rush: 90s Retro Arcade
4660760.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Sports, Free To Play
4660760.short_description: A fast free-to-play retro arcade skating game where you dodge obstacles, keep your speed, and chase a better score in quick single-player runs inspired by classic 90s energy.

4660800.title: Blooming Canvas
4660800.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around 'painting.' The story begins with a commission to restore a damaged painting, and as the art exhibition draws near, the secrets hidden beneath the canvas will gradually be revealed.

4660870.title: DarkCage
4660870.short_description: DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

4660910.title: Final Deal
4660910.short_description: A dark roguelike card duel where every move costs you. Make the deal. Survive 15 circles. Or don’t.

4660960.title: Rescue Guys - Firefighters Simulator
4660960.short_description: A chaotic open-city rescue sim where you improvise your way through fires, disasters, and absurd emergencies. No training, no rules - just fast decisions, creative problem-solving, and a city that keeps getting worse.

4660990.title: Problematic
4660990.short_description: Problematic is a gothic party game where someone always goes too far. Be a fearless judge, or you will be judged, and your friends will reveal their true selves! Fill blanks, judge answers, score points, and secret rules govern the table. and use your power-ups wisely... You will need it.

4661140.title: Happy Country
4661140.short_description: Survive life in recession-era 1990s Finland in this first-person life simulation. Manage hunger, health, and money, complete tasks, face harsh weather, and uncover the truth behind the "happiest country in the world." Your choices shape your survival story.

4661340.title: SableSyn Protocol
4661340.short_description: Engage enemy fleets in this tactical space RPG where each team is locked to their side of the battlefield. Outthink, outmaneuver, and outclass your opponents to claim victory.

4661350.title: A MANSION on the HILL
4661350.short_description: ATMOSPHERIC UNDERGROUND ADVENTURE. You seek revenge against the oligarch who destroyed your family. Is killing ever justified?

4661510.title: KeepFighting
4661510.short_description: A cute SD pixel hero cuts through endless waves of enemies, then grows stronger between battles in an incremental auto-battle RPG built around satisfying progression.

4661520.title: MUSO
4661520.short_description: A ragtag, misfit group of five band together, defying fate and work to solve their world's many mysteries. Explore strange worlds! Meet colorful friends! Fight wacky foes! Near the end...you'll be met with the final question: Which side prevails? Hope, or despair...? Welcome to the World of MUSO.

4661550.title: I Am Emma
4661550.short_description: Nevada, 2011. As Emma Carter, doubt your own mind and face a domestic nightmare that breathes the same air as you. In this immersive psychological horror, every shadow hides a twisted secret. Question your sanity and uncover the chilling truth.

4661600.title: Project Haymaker
4661600.short_description: Build an unstoppable bulldozer in secret. Then prove it. A two-phase game about quiet nights in the workshop and one very loud morning. Inspired by a true story.

4661620.title: King's Deck
4661620.short_description: Build your deck, defend your kingdom, and fight alongside your army in a roguelike strategy game.

4661630.title: Collective Corp
4661630.short_description: In Collective Corp, your job is to collect as MANY artifacts as you can without dying! Obey MasterColecty or face the punishment... Or do the opposite and defeat him lol.

4661650.title: HobGob
4661650.short_description: HobGob is a dungeon crawler roguelike, where you have to clear dungeons, clear the dungeon bosses and get to the stage's megaboss in order to clear it and move to the next one.

4661790.title: 结界大阵：生灵庇护所 Warding Sanctum: Creature Refuge
4661790.short_description: A strategy game blending Xianxia (cultivation) elements with tower defense and settlement-building mechanics. Recruit and cultivate creatures, fuse them into formations, repel demon invasions from the outside world, and build your Creature Sanctuary.

4661840.title: Acrônimo Tupiniquim
4661840.short_description: The greatest detective in São Paolo is dead, and you are the prime suspect in his death. Investigate the detective's past cases, unravel the web of mysteries that binds the great city, and prove your innocence. Enigmatic letters, hidden secrets, and one certainty: Every story has two sides.

4661860.title: Starfish Simulator 👍
4661860.short_description: Game characters come in all shapes and sizes. They can be brave knights, brilliant scientists, or superheroes who save entire worlds. This game offers a more unusual experience. Here you can become a starfish.

4662030.title: Unearthly
4662030.short_description: Build powerful alien loadouts, hurl enemies into each other, and unleash chaotic abilities in fast-paced, procedurally generated areas!

4662080.title: Dark DieMansion
4662080.short_description: Escape a dark, randomly generated mansion where creatures stalk you in the shadows. Outsmart them by manipulating the environment, restoring the power, and scavenging supplies to survive.

4662090.title: Cyberpix '89
4662090.short_description: Run, shoot, power-up, and kill ’em all. Take down ruthless bosses and carve your way through the underworld.

4662130.title: Eve of Cultivation
4662130.short_description: Waking up alone on an deserted island, Keiko must discover the fate of her missing brother, find food to survive, and confront a warped force of nature who seeks to subsume her.

4662150.title: We Die Below
4662150.short_description: 1–4 player co-op dungeon crawler. Choose your class and gear! Fight through procedural dungeons, complete objectives, and outrun the horrors you awaken. Deep combat. High stakes. Permadeath if your party falls.

4662260.title: Ceraphic Requiem
4662260.short_description: Dive into a ruined world devastated by the gods. Ceraphic Requiem is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania with a demanding combat system. Master elemental magic combos, unravel the mysteries of the decay, and impose your will in the final moments of a moribund world.

4662270.title: Clickfall
4662270.short_description: Clickfall is a fast-paced idle game blended with Vampire Survivors–style action. Click to trigger powerful effects, build your run with upgrades, and survive waves of enemies as your power scales into chaos.

4662350.title: Chess 2
4662350.short_description: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

4662660.title: WOTT
4662660.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4662660.short_description: "Get ready for a stylized arena experience where strategy meets speed in a fierce four-player battle! Conquer territories, manage resources, and outsmart your opponents to become the sole master of the arena. WOTT offers a fresh thrill in every match with its dynamic gameplay."

4662680.title: Gaslit Bay
4662680.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4662680.short_description: Gaslit Bay is a co-op horror game following strict, ever-changing rules in order to survive a night shift at a remote gas station. While reality breaks down serve customers, manage the store and avoid what lurks in the dark at all costs. One mistake, one broken rule... It could cost you everything.

4662960.title: Project: C.E.L.L.
4662960.short_description: Project: C.E.L.L. is a retro-terminal sci-fi roguelike management sim where you engineer a living cell for a corporation chasing immortality. Run simulations, build organelles, manage resources, and stop cascading failures. How long can you keep the experiment alive?

4663010.title: Entiled
4663010.short_description: Entiled is an infinite spatial tile clearing puzzle game built for endless replayability. Clear tiles without collisions, build massive multipliers, compete on Steam Leaderboards, and create, share, and play community made puzzles through the Steam Workshop. Climb the Ranked Steam Leaderboards.

4663060.title: The Haunted Spot 2
4663060.short_description: The Haunted Spot is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a century-old abandoned haunted house to experience the paranormal.

4663150.title: MYRIORAMA
4663150.short_description: MYRIORAMA is a top-down action-adventure game in the style of classic 2D Zelda titles, but with a twist: players will solve puzzles and complete dungeons by rearranging the rooms of the dungeons themselves!

4663270.title: FAR EDGE: Adrift
4663270.short_description: Drift alone at the farthest edge of the ocean, where silence feels alive. You must survive, explore, and endure the unknown. But something beneath the surface is watching you.

4663320.title: Dance of Y
4663320.short_description: 《Dance of Y》是一款以律动与节奏为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在经典 RPG 战斗系统中操控角色进行攻击、防御与技能施放，通过规划每个回合的行动、持续强化角色能力，并在不断推进的战斗挑战中体验兼具策略深度与成长乐趣的单人冒险。

4663350.title: Beacon of Y
4663350.short_description: 《Beacon of Y》是一款以光明指引为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在经典 RPG 战斗系统中操控角色进行攻击、防御与技能施放，通过规划每个回合的行动、逐步强化角色能力，并在持续推进的挑战中体验兼具策略深度与成长乐趣的单人冒险旅程。

4663360.title: Petal of Y
4663360.short_description: 《Petal of Y》是一款以自然花语为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在经典 RPG 战斗系统中指挥角色进行攻击、防御与技能施放，通过合理规划每个回合的行动、持续强化角色能力，并在层层推进的战斗挑战中体验兼具策略性与成长感的单人冒险。

4663380.title: Hello Duck
4663380.short_description: A cozy idle desktop game where a little duck eats grass, lays eggs, earns coins, and lives a lazy life on a tiny floating island.

4663630.title: Hollow Descent
4663630.short_description: A narrative-driven RPG where you investigate an anomaly consuming the world. Explore, engage in turn-based combat, and make choices that shape the story, your allies, and the fate of everything.

4663800.title: One More Core
4663800.short_description: One More Core is a 3D incremental game about tearing planets apart with bombs from your flagship, gathering resources, upgrading your fleet, and pushing toward the core until nothing is left behind. Don’t forget to refuel for one more core!

4663840.title: S4NCTU4RY
4663840.short_description: S4NCTU4RY — a bar set in the heart of a cyberpunk city. Outside, the world is loud, exhausting, and never stops. Your job is to offer shelter from the chaos, and craft the one drink that makes people forget it all.

4663990.title: Art Collage
4663990.short_description: Place the pieces to restore stunning works of art, with a diverse collection of masterpieces waiting for you to admire in peace.

4664030.title: Seven Seas Jewels 2 Collector's Edition
4664030.short_description: Set sail to save Rowan from the siren Narissa’s curse. As Polly, journey across stormy seas, solve 250 Match-3 levels, uncover secrets, and face supernatural threats. Will love prove stronger than dark magic?

4664170.title: Coinqueror
4664170.short_description: Coinqueror is a turn-based strategy game where you conquer enemy lands by drawing around them, and battles are decided by a coin flip! Share your room code to play with friends, build defensive walls, forge alliances, and dominate the map.

4664230.title: Cat Music Chaos
4664230.short_description: Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

4664470.title: Bookstore Incremental
4664470.short_description: An active incremental game where you run your own Bookstore! Print and upgrade books, unlock new customers, new staff members and more.

4664720.title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Coral Peach
4664720.short_description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful coral peach mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

4664840.title: In the Van
4664840.short_description: A cozy post-apocalyptic survival game where your van is your home, your shelter, and your key to survival.

4664900.title: Sunder Siege
4664900.short_description: A short incremental physics game. Swing a wrecking ball to smash monsters before they reach your home! Upgrade your ball and your home for more smashy goodness!

4664920.title: Wiseman: No More Breakups
4664920.short_description: QTE boss rush action game with roguelite elements. Fight through unique bosses in fast-paced, timing-based combat while uncovering a comedic, anime-style story about love, relationships, and chaos, all to win back what matters most.

4665130.title: About Thieves
4665130.short_description: About Thieves is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler with real-time combat. The character progression system rewards exploration and secret hunting, and that’s where the main focus lies.

4665380.title: Wheat and Wrath
4665380.short_description: Wheat and Wrath is a fantasy city-builder about straw people transitioning from nomadic wheat gathering to a settled farming village with a patron god. To survive, players must sustain and grow the community, manage wrathful gods, trade for technology, and defend the village from raiders.

4665590.title: Apotheosis Engine
4665590.short_description: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. "Apotheosis engine" is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity.

4665740.title: Gold & Brown
4665740.short_description: Gold & Brown is a choice-based visual novel set in the medieval era, enhanced with card mechanics. Embark on a challenging journey as a knight, shape your fate through card choices, and pursue an impossible love across multiple endings.

4665970.title: Grids of Thermometers
4665970.short_description: Grids of Thermometers delivers the relaxed fun of a pen-and-paper logic game right to your fingertips. In each level, you fill a grid of thermometers with mercury. Numbers on the grid edges tell you how many cells must be filled in each row and column.

4666130.title: Echo of Me
4666130.short_description: Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. Explore a maze of memories, solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and uncover notes as you piece together a story in which every new answer changes the meaning of what came before.

4666250.title: Stone to Stove
4666250.short_description: Gather resources during the day and earn money by serving people; at night, buy towers and defend your base. Optimize your settlement, take risks to gain more profit, and surviving increasingly difficult attacks each day offers a rewarding experience.

4666280.title: Lightspeed
4666280.short_description: Pilot a lone starship on an endless quest to reach the ultimate speed limit. In this minimalist space incremental, harvest cosmic substances, manage complex thermal and shielding systems, and upgrade your engines to break the speed of light. Every refuel is a new chance to go faster.

4666310.title: Feed the King
4666310.short_description: Build a medieval kitchen empire for a hungry king in this incremental cooking game. Click and automate food stations, refine better ingredients, craft richer dishes, serve nightly feasts, and decide when to poison the king for a powerful prestige reset.

4666420.title: Starry Station
4666420.short_description: Adventure through a newly abandoned space station called "Starry Station", a station that once took children to space. Journey through this place to find a way to space while trying to find the reason for its closure with your new pal Cosmo Paw. Be careful some things in here do tend to bite.

4666530.title: Signs Of Devourer
4666530.short_description: Its another night shift in the store, except this time you are trapped with monster disguised as one of the items. Keep the floor clean, shelves full, serve the customers... and try to not get devoured until the dawn.

4666700.title: Corporate 0
4666700.short_description: You're trapped in your office after a typical working day. Carefully explore every corner to reach the freedom and break the loop.

4666780.title: Messiah Simulator
4666780.short_description: A Gnostic survival roguelite where you play as Jesus, get the miracles slightly wrong, and try not to be crucified. The perfect gift for your ultra-religious friend—or the one who thinks they're the Messiah. Jesus lasted 33 years. You'll be lucky to last five minutes.

4666840.title: Glowbot Tower Defense
4666840.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi tower defense game where you strategically place and upgrade Glowbots to stop waves of enemies across vibrant space maps.

4667230.title: Peristeria
4667230.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4667230.short_description: An atmospheric 3D metroidvania with heavy emphasis on platforming and exploration. Use projectiles, grappling, and dash to discover hidden ruins and secrets beneath the surface.

4667540.title: Longtan Canyon Rafting
4667540.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4667620.title: Chicken and Tank
4667620.short_description: 【鶏和戦車】は、戦車戦闘と戦車改造、資源収集、アイテム製作を中心としたサバイバルRPGゲームで、下馬戦闘も含まれています。

4667770.title: Foxwood Adventure
4667770.short_description: A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable. Explore, craft, and learn the basics of survival alone or with someone new to the genre.

4667920.title: Richer than the King
4667920.short_description: Create immense wealth, build a rebel army, and overthrow the crown in this medieval economic strategy game. Trade daily, invest wisely, bribe royal scouts to stay hidden, and rally fellow nobles to survive clashes against the King's forces.

4667970.title: Coldline: Disconnect
4667970.short_description: You will operate as an agent in enemy territory. Your cover: repairing items. While working, gather intelligence and relay it to us. Every action and decision will shape your fate. The question is… will you make the right ones?

4668040.title: Capybara Bingo
4668040.short_description: A cozy party bingo game for 1–8 players. Manage up to 6 cards, stamp your numbers, and race to call bingo — but get it wrong and you pay the price. Cozy mayhem with capybaras, abilities, and lots of cosmetics.

4668110.title: Time To Waste
4668110.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

4668130.title: Alpha Star
4668130.short_description: "Survive the crushing gravity and conquer the void! Alpha Star is a fast-paced 2D space shooter where you must navigate through evolving bullet hells and dynamic black holes. Upgrade your ship, survive 10 intense mission phases, and reach the heart of the Singularity."

4668250.title: Mini Sushi Factory
4668250.short_description: Automate your way to the sushi of your dreams in this sushi contraption building toy. Wait until you try YOUR OWN signature Dragon Meat Sashimi…

4668390.title: Your Own Cozy Motel
4668390.short_description: Build and run your own roadside motel in a hands-on simulator. Check in guests, clean and repair rooms, manage payments, upgrade facilities, and grow from a small stopover into a thriving, high-reputation business.

4668490.title: Sit or Die
4668490.short_description: The classic party game Musical Chairs turns deadly under a mad warden. Rust fills the air, a funeral tune echoes. One rule: when the music stops—sit, or die. Survive 30+ twisted modes, outlast all, and win… then the music starts again.

4668560.title: The Hollow Road: Prologue
4668560.short_description: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

4668570.title: Party of Lust
4668570.short_description: This is a kinetic visual novel — a fully linear story with no choices. Only pure, intense, and extremely explicit storytelling.

4668640.title: Rabbit Runabout
4668640.short_description: Play as a rabbit, run through a sandbox world, and collect scattered medals in this 3D action game.

4668870.title: Medieval Juice Crafter
4668870.short_description: Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business.

4668890.title: Mall Together
4668890.short_description: Run your mall. Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, hire teammates, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your mall.

4671790.title: 豚の背に明日への金貨を
4671790.short_description: Is it hope you carry, or a heavy burden? Tomorrow’s Coins, Pig’s Back is a roguelike action RPG. Brave randomly generated maps that grow larger and deadlier as you ascend. Exchange loot for coins, upgrade your stats, and enhance unique weapons. Your choices forge your path in the abyss.

4671810.title: Lightfold
4671810.short_description: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

4672170.title: Dronelord Hyperviber
4672170.short_description: A fast paced bullet heaven FPS played with just the mouse where your speed is your fire rate. As a member of the Hypervibers you will complete missions for the Hypervibers fighting against inhuman hordes in the Dronelord's Domain to ultimately take down the Dronelord.

4672540.title: Nova Impact
4672540.short_description: Nova Impact puts you in command of your ship as an elite Zenith pilot. Fight in the arena, earn credits, optimize your build in this fast-paced SSRPG (Space Shooter RPG). Survive the swarm, once at the top of the ranks, face rival pilots in unique 1-on-1 duels to claim your spot as the #1 champion !

4672690.title: 马场大亨Online国际版
4672690.genre: Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Free To Play
4672690.short_description: Become a horse owner, own your own horses, train and participate in various races, and cultivate horse kings to dominate the track! Buy luxury cars, own your own independent villa, decorate your own mansion, form your own horse racing club with like-minded people, and become the derby's tycoon!

4637280.title: Weapon Skills
4637280.short_description: Master precision-based combat where every move matters. Fight using melee weapons and throwable attacks while avoiding deadly enemies that punish every mistake. Improve your timing, positioning, and decision-making to survive increasingly challenging encounters.

4637430.title: Everything Mart
4637430.short_description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

4637470.title: Thunder Training Ground
4637470.short_description: You can freely define parameters such as aircraft performance and weapon performance to simulate all air combat scenarios. Additionally, the unique one-click scene reset function of this Training Ground enables you to complete up to 10 training sessions even within a brief one-minute timeframe.

4637710.title: Binary Proof
4637710.short_description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

4637810.title: Orbit's Grocery
4637810.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4637810.short_description: Manage the galaxy’s quirkiest store in Orbit’s Grocery! Balance retail tasks like window wiping and shelf stocking with chaotic mini-games. Encounter eccentric aliens that trigger FPS, racing, and horror events. Survive cosmic phenomena in this genre-bending workplace adventure.

4638020.title: Do You Even Brick?!
4638020.short_description: 'Do You Even Brick?! Old-school brick breaking meets virtual tennis. Our modern twist on two arcade classics. Featuring single player & couch co-op! You gotta ask yourself a question: 'DO I EVEN BRICK?'... Well, do, ya, punk?!

4638200.title: Good Gaijin, Bad Gaijin
4638200.short_description: You’ve just landed in Japan with nothing but a suitcase and a lot to learn. Part social simulator, part cinematic journey—it’s time to choose your own adventure.

4638220.title: Greywind's Legacy - A Text Based, Skill Progression, RPG
4638220.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4638220.short_description: This is a text based game that allows the player to step into the town of Alara as the grandson of the late Adventurer Greywind. 4638520.title: THE OMEGA REACH
4638520.short_description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) which makes you feel like a musical genius.

4639110.title: Demonium Illusion

4639190.title: Dream Adventurer
4639190.short_description: "Dream Adventurer" is a free adventure game where players battle, explore, and search for treasure chests within a dreamlike realm.

4639240.title: Gladiator's Revenge
4639240.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy

4639300.title: the art of Tortoise Walking
4639300.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4639300.short_description: A walking simulator with a deep sense of zen. Embody a tortoise on a desolate island, independently controlling each of its four limbs with a controller. In every clumsy step, rediscover the instinct of walking.

4639450.title: CandyPop
4639450.short_description: The Great Sweet Battle Begins! "CandyPop" is a confectionery war set in the Land of Sweets! A top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game! Are you ready?

4639830.title: vok1

4640160.title: SOKOL
4640160.short_description: Sokol is a turn-based roguelike where every shot counts. Stranded in the taiga, fight monsters, master ricochets, and find your way out.

4640200.title: Without Regret
4640200.short_description: Free those stuck in regret while uncovering the secrets of the world. Let the path you choose shape who you are and the world you envision.

4640230.title: Counter Targets Clicker
4640230.short_description: A short incremental shooting range game. Shoot targets, earn money, buy upgrades, discover and customize your weapon.

4640300.title: Perimeter, Paint & Process
4640300.short_description: A basketball management sim built for depth. Build your roster, set tactics, develop players, and watch every possession resolve through a detailed simulation engine. Career mode. Replayable. No helplessness loops.

4640510.title: Evil is near
4640510.short_description: Evil is Near is a game about a young bartender who gets a job at a mysterious bar, where he is visited by the ghost of a former employee. The ghost reveals the secrets of the establishment and warns him to be careful. You will have to mix cocktails, to survive and uncover the truth.

4640590.title: Fool's Pub
4640590.short_description: Bluff, bet, and survive. Play deadly card games where every lie can cost a life. Be the last one standing.

4640620.title: Flux Ascendant

4640620.short_description: A fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelite where you tame the four elements. Made by one developer, balanced by thousands of test runs.

4641440.title: SKY DRIFT
4641440.short_description: A Lite-Action 2.5D flying adventure where you control an unstable rocket through a giant alien world, using physics and magnetic powers to overcome obstacles while unpredictable wormholes pull you into the unknown.

4642050.title: Infogrind
4642050.short_description: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

4642080.title: Varren's Expanse
4642080.short_description: Varren's Expanse is a roguelite strategy game. Explore the wilderness using mice and badger legionnaires, rabbit scouts, and squirrel skirmishers. Every round builds your strength, every round brings new challenges.

4642790.title: Screen Skater
4642790.short_description: Your taskbar is a skatepark. The faster you type, the harder they shred. Earn tricks, unlock cosmetics, and pretend you're being productive.

4643060.short_description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

4643520.title: Scoundrel
4643520.short_description: A solo card roguelite where a single shuffled deck is the entire dungeon. Draw four, face three, survive the deck. Fast runs, brutal choices, just one more.

4644090.title: Just Eat Sushi!
4644090.short_description: A revolving sushi simulator for up to 4 players! Relax and watch the plates go by, eat until you're stuffed, or just hang out and chat with friends.

4644320.title: Chirpology
4644320.short_description: Collect and breed adorable birds in this pencil-drawn 2D casual idle game! Watch them take leisurely strolls and play on slides in your yard. Purchase furniture, unlock a rich bird encyclopedia, and build a cozy home for you and your feathered friends.

4644350.title: Astromino
4644350.short_description: A roguelite battle against cosmic evils - drop customized polyominoes, collect relics, and execute powerful combos to defeat your enemies!

4644400.title: Unstable Nuclear Reactor
4644400.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where merging atomic elements prevents a nuclear meltdown.

4644600.title: Bitroca

4644660.title: Deskpet Engine
4644660.short_description: A cute pet will freely roam on your desktop, accompanying you while you work, study, and play. Pet can work or play minigame to earn money which provide its own living needs!

4644670.title: Cow Project 1986

4644670.short_description: A game about an alien that has to abduct things to pay rent!

4644870.title: Green Mist over Portland

4644950.title: Layermask
4644950.short_description: Save yourself from being stuck behind layers of enemies, platforms, and hazards in this puzzle platformer all about getting to the end of a colorful journey!

4645130.title: Paragon Protocol: V X V

4645360.title: Titanic Escape Simulator™

4645410.title: Glitch Forest

4645430.title: うさぎとたまきはお休みちゅー！3
4645430.short_description: A novel game where a rabbit girl and various characters spend time together.

4645450.title: Exipath
4645450.short_description: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

4645470.title: WHERE IS MY CAT?
4645470.short_description: Your cat is missing. This is terrible! It was kidnapped and hidden by an unknown, evil Entity that terrorizes the tenants of your house because it is bored. Finding the cat is now your unsolvable problem. You will go crazy before the end. This is not a threat. It's a statistic.

4645590.title: Hutong Gambit
4645590.short_description: You time-traveled to the Y2K era to challenge the undefeated park chess hustlers! 4645630.title: Mansion of Relics
4645630.short_description: In this game: Play through the perspectives of four characters in turn, experiencing their individual storylines within the same timeframe—including flashbacks to their pasts, interconnected conflicts and psychological shifts, as well as the firsthand memories of another person.

4645680.title: 植物大战星球怪兽 Plants vs. Planet Monsters

4645780.title: Apartment 10

4646190.title: Just Dying
4646190.short_description: A 2D action roguelike where you play streamer parodies and die on purpose. Unlock characters, stack relics, snowball into a screen-clearing menace, then watch it all collapse in 30 seconds. Learn. Die again.

Huck into the arena with the help of cybernetically enhanced gorillas and cause chaos for glory and entertainment!

4647040.title: Geppetto's Nightmare
4647040.short_description: Geppetto's Nightmare is a first-person gothic horror. Navigate a nightmare built from a father's regret, using past inventions to overcome distinct challenges. Survive a jarring journey through deepening darkness where every tool is a key to enduring this surreal and haunting struggle.

4650180.title: SHADOW LINK～Two Of Me～

Plan your builds, position strategically, and defeat giant bosses to survive all 40 waves (approx. 20 mins)!

4650270.title: Happy Lane: The Threshold

4650530.title: SUP

4650730.title: Split Happens!
4650730.short_description: Sharing is caring. But can you cut any object perfectly in half? Sit back, relax, and slice hundreds of objects exactly in half.

4650750.title: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee ~ Episode 2 ~ Reharm
4650750.short_description: Play as Solea, a young Witch who travels on behalf of her friend Amadeus to the place they first met... Welcome to the lonely moors of Augur Pyne. A linear narrative Visual Novel + Adventure Game. Episode 2 of 5.

4655010.title: Digidice

publishers: タイニーワークス TINYWORKS

4657830.title: Witch You!
4657830.short_description: A first-person co-op game where, as witches, you must run your own apothecary. Witch You is a roguelike management game: customize your shop, upgrade it, and survive as many days as possible without getting shut down, all while traveling to a Dantesque Hell to restock your supplies.

4657900.title: Gem Rush Devil's Realm
4657900.short_description: Collect gems, avoid enemies, and survive as long as possible. Buy abilities, fight bosses, earn stars, and use powerful attacks to stay alive in this fast-paced arcade experience.

4658020.title: Neon Whispers
4658020.short_description: Neon Whispers contains nudity, explicit sexual content, fetish elements, and adult themes. All characters are 18+. It features deep emotional and physical relationships and hardcore scenes. Push the boundaries of desire and power dynamics with your choices.

4658040.title: The Sons of Earth
4658040.short_description: An asymmetric hex wargame about occupation and insurgency. Command the alien Verkhan Empire pacifying a human world — or the fractured Sons of Earth fighting to reclaim it.

4658160.title: Reach The Banana
4658160.short_description: A chaotic two-player climbing game where you control one monkey together, one arm each, and battle physics, panic, terrible coordination, mistimed grabs, desperate recoveries, and an endless chain of bad decisions on every climb.

4658280.title: The Doldrums
4658280.short_description: A third-person survival game where you wait on a deserted island for a ship that may never come. You must fend off the depression that creeps in despite the relief of surviving.

4658550.title: ALL GAS
4658550.short_description: ALL GAS is an endless, high-speed traffic-weaving experience where every run is different. Push your limits on a flowing, procedurally generated highway and prove yourself on the global leaderboards.

4658670.title: Re:Bloom 花精霊のぽかぽか温泉郷
4658670.short_description: A mysterious hot spring where fragile flower spirits gather. As the caretaker, you build baths and watch over them. By soaking, they regain vitality little by little. Collect Poka Energy to expand your springs and enjoy a relaxing idle clicker simulation.

4658720.title: Hamster Mapster
4658720.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer local party game where adorable hamsters build their own arena and battle for the Golden Nut.  Snap map pieces together, uncover surprises, and jump into fast-paced minigames full of laughter and chaos.

4658840.title: Praedatum
4658840.short_description: Praedatum is a fast-paced top-down Extraction Shooter set in the dystopian world of tomorrow. Our future has been stolen by evil robotic overlords. As a legendary Warrior from the distant past, your job is to steal it right back!

4658880.title: 夏のしっぽをおいかけて
4658880.short_description: This is a multi-ending game with branching storylines. Spend the last three days of the summer holidays with Tia, a young dragon girl. The choices you make could significantly affect your future relationship with her... Support her in her activities and enjoy a wonderful summer holiday together.

4659100.title: Pizza Portale!!
4659100.short_description: Pizza Portale!! is a first person horror game where you work as a portal delivery guy, delivering pizzas through portals. Your job is to keep delivering freshly baked pizzas via portals to destinations all across the country.

4659290.title: Let Me Free!
4659290.short_description: Are you just letting your chat scroll by? Chat from Chzzk, Twitch, YouTube, and SOOP comes alive as speech bubbles right on your screen. Enjoy your viewers' passionate support and donations on your own screen to the fullest! Good luck!

4659360.title: Home
4659360.short_description: Join your friends on an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world, gathering resources from various locations to strengthen yourself.

4659370.title: The Last Elf
4659370.short_description: A dark-fantasy action RPG where the last Elven blade rides to save the Kingdom of Men. Explore for hidden gold, buy weapons, and level up by slaying demonic monsters in stamina-based combat - then face a golem, dragon, and Demon Lord across 4 chapters.

4659400.title: Supernatural Archives：The Frontrooms
4659400.short_description: Inspired by liminal space concepts like the Backrooms and Poolcore, the game blends multiple unique art styles on the original foundation. More than a plain walking simulator, it features diverse gameplay, keeping players immersed in an adventure full of mysteries and surprises at every turn.

4660540.title: Bloody Cleanup TOGHETER
4660540.genre: Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4660540.short_description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered. 🩸

4660580.title: Storm Of Magic
4660580.short_description: Storm Of Magic is a fast-paced magical bullet heaven roguelite. Level up spells in unique ways, stack game-breaking builds, and blast through hordes of enemies across cursed biomes. Unlock heroes and new ways to cause magical mayhem each run.

4660590.title: Chreynard
4660590.short_description: Rewind time and control clones to solve intricate puzzles in this innovative 2D action-puzzler. Use your wits and skills to conquer all 30 stages of charming, nostalgic pixel art.

4660830.title: GeckoShop 2
4660830.short_description: Open boxes and collect geckos. Merge them in your lab to create new mutations, then sell or keep 'em. Decorate your new home, and build machines to automate every step.

4660840.title: Rusty Flagon
4660840.short_description: The last tavern before the cursed forest. Feed them. Shelter them. Watch them leave. Not all of them come back.

4660950.title: Typegrinder
4660950.short_description: A keyboard-first typing game built around discovery. Hunt new words across 3-to-12 letter brackets, forge speed-runs from your personal decks, and battle the world on daily online leaderboards. Pure typing, no fluff.

4661010.title: Corporate Entropy
4661010.short_description: Climb the ladder while burning it down. In this satirical management sim, you work for a corporation rolling out ARIA — an AI that's replacing your coworkers. Balance your performance cover against quiet sabotage, organize your resistance, and survive 8 quarters with your soul mostly intact.

4661190.title: INTERRED
4661190.short_description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

4661210.title: Landers
4661210.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Racing, Early Access
4661210.short_description: Pilot a nimble combat ship through hazardous terrain, complete high-speed objectives, destroy ground threats, collect hidden rewards, and master precision flying in a single-player action campaign built around skill, momentum, and replayability.

4661220.title: Match Cards: Football
4661220.short_description: Change the course of football history in a tactical sports card game. Lead national teams through authentic tournaments since 1916, play cards on the virtual pitch, and decide the fate of legendary matches in fast, few-minute clashes.

4661300.title: My True Desire
4661300.short_description: A lighthearted, story-driven adult romance visual novel about love, trust, and forbidden curiosity. Follow a young couple as they slowly explore consensual exposure, sharing, jealousy, and desire through playful romance, meaningful choices, and plenty of erotic scenes.

4661400.title: FRACTURE - Loot or die
4661400.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Early Access
4661400.short_description: RPG-PvPvE extraction game set in a dark fantasy setting. ✅ Choose from 6 classes ✅ A system for combining multiple game classes; ✅ Item and equipment crafting system; ✅ Character leveling system with a talent tree - 100 levels; ✅ Over a hundred skills with unique effects; ✅ Quests and achievements;

4661560.title: Bible Quiz: Trivia Game
4661560.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4661560.short_description: Race the clock across hundreds of Bible trivia questions! Test your knowledge of scripture, famous figures, miracles, parables, and more. Perfect for faith communities, trivia fans, and anyone curious about the world's most read book.

4661640.title: Road of Heart
4661640.short_description: Leave your quiet village, join the Adventurers’ Guild, and return to defend your home in a heartfelt retro fantasy JRPG with turn-based battles, class-based combat, scroll skills, and pixel-art exploration

4661670.title: Reclaim
4661670.short_description: Reclaim is a fantasy visual novel following a peculiar elf and a dying god trying to free the world and themselves. Choose wisely and help them study, create, and escape.

4661770.title: Anthros' Edge
4661770.short_description: Anthros' Edge is a philosophical puzzle game about perception, reality and contradiction. What is reality and when does it break? Switch between projections of what might be real and follow their logic - or break it?

4661890.title: Hexstride
4661890.short_description: Movement is combat. No attack button. Your positioning and movement patterns trigger abilities automatically. Choose your class, complete objectives, and descend deeper into procedurally generated dungeons. Every step is a tactical decision.

4661910.title: Nexus Legacy
4661910.genre: Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4661910.short_description: Rebuild civilization from a single planet in Nexus Legacy, a persistent sci-fi 4X MMO. Colonize worlds, manage resources, research technologies, command fleets, forge alliances, and fight for control of a living galaxy.

4661950.title: Gothic Blood
4661950.short_description: A top-down action adventure game. Play as a reaper exploring the world of Vernov, fight your way through enemies and find cool weapons to make it to the end.

4662140.title: Goodnight, B
4662140.short_description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry, tired little girl. Rotate and place sections of each level and explore various atmospheric environments. Meet interesting characters, push abnormally large alphabet blocks, and uncover the disturbing events happening in B's life.

4662170.title: Larva
4662170.short_description: LARVA is a tactical co-op horror FPS for up to 4 players. Explore procedurally generated environments, collect valuable loot, face deadly anomalies, and extract before it's too late. Coordinate, survive, and don't go alone.

4662340.title: Project ROSS
4662340.short_description: Project ROSS is a horror/puzzle game where you play as Jason who is struggling to overcome the absence of his father. Explore the abandoned testing facility where he was supposedly last located and uncover the mystery of what really happened all those years ago. Just try to keep your head on!

4662430.title: Blind Savior
4662430.short_description: In a game without graphics where sound is everything, you must reach a man amongst a spreading fire without being burned alive.

4662550.title: Everguest: The Veiled Inn
4662550.short_description: Everguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

4662560.title: For God and For Profit
4662560.short_description: For God and For Profit is a medieval-Renaissance investigation game. The player learns the essentials of accounting, then applies the principles to investigate scenario records and decide the state of the records. Calm and cozy, yet culminating in thrilling interrogation.

4662580.title: Duke vs The Gang
4662580.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4662580.short_description: A Wild West bullet hell where you mix drinks into attacks, blast enemies from afar, and whip them up close. Dodge chaotic patterns, discover new combinations, and outplay unique bosses in fast-paced, precision-driven duels.

4662900.title: Sic Bo Macau: The Ultimate Casino Dice Game
4662900.short_description: Casino-grade Sic Bo simulator with real payout tables — Standard, Macau, Atlantic City, Australia, and Super Sic Bo with multipliers up to 1000×. Infinite virtual chips, zero microtransactions. Built for players who want to learn strategy, test variance, or just roll the dice in peace.

4663040.title: Lazy Boxing
4663040.short_description: Welcome to the Boxing Test Room. I’ve never seen a robot as lazy as you. You must use your spineless, invertebrate-like upper body to clear this boxing test. Good luck.

4663080.title: Escape the Grind
4663080.short_description: Can you retire before 65?? A realistic financial life sim across 10 real economies. Real salaries, real housing markets, real investment products. Every month is a real decision. Three difficulty levels + Play Your Life mode. Six native languages. Play your way to freedom.

4663090.title: NUMBAKO-なんばこ-
4663090.short_description: Blackjack in a falling-block puzzle game!? Clear all your stocked lines at once, and flood your rival’s board with garbage blocks!

4663100.title: Lex Arbor: Learning an alien language
4663100.short_description: A language-learning puzzle game. Wake up face to face with an unknown creature, and learn to communicate in an alien language, from simple words to weird complex structures. Feel it, learn it, express it... and uncover the truth behind why you're here.

4663170.title: Tavern Deep Cauldron
4663170.short_description: Become the owners of a mythical tavern where you'll have to brew magic potions together for extraordinary creatures, consulting an ancient book of recipes. It’s a dynamic co-op game where every drink does more than just quench thirst—it holds its own special secret

4663220.title: Mob Marathon
4663220.short_description: A side-scrolling runner where Twitch viewers help or sabotage you with 25+ commands. Run, survive, and watch your character transform. Features 9 characters, Endurance Mode, and Nightmare Mode. Fun for streamers, viewers, and solo players alike.

4663300.title: Apocalypse: The Last RV
4663300.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4663300.short_description: Once #1 on both TapTap New Releases and Exclusive Charts, this post-apocalyptic comfort survival game is now on Steam. One-time purchase, no ads, focusing on survival simulation, RV stockpiling and roguelike reincarnation to deliver a relaxing wasteland experience with full preparation and no fear.

4663330.title: Jailer of Y
4663330.short_description: 《Jailer of Y》是一款以秩序与禁锢为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家将在经典 RPG 战斗系统中操控角色进行攻击、防御与技能施放，通过规划每个回合的行动、持续强化角色能力，并在层层升级的战斗挑战中体验兼具策略性与成长感的单人冒险。

4663420.title: Read Only
4663420.short_description: A psychological narrative game about memory, identity, and things that were never meant to be “fixed.” Explore your past, piece together what was lost, and decide what you’re ready to see.

4663600.title: Overhead
4663600.short_description: Write code to command your defenses. Overhead is a strategy game where your code is your weapon; script turret (or sensor) behavior in JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Go, or any WASM language. Every scenario is seeded and deterministic. Write a better script, get a better score.

4663660.title: Hidden Objects - Items Find
4663660.short_description: Explore atmospheric locations, search for and find hidden objects in an engaging puzzle game!
developers: A A G BROTHERS SOFTWARE DESIGN
publishers: A A G BROTHERS SOFTWARE DESIGN

4663870.title: Bake Masters
4663870.short_description: Welcome to Baking Master! This is a co-op roguelike management simulation game with a warm and comforting art style. Become an adorable animal chef and run a busy bakery with friends locally or online.

4663900.title: The Dealer's Voice
4663900.short_description: In a secret bar for aliens, every story you hear can change lives.

4663930.title: SYLVA
4663930.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Early Access
4663930.short_description: The battle for survival on a deserted island begins. Fight skeleton warriors, build your base, gather loot, and survive. An open-world survival + RPG experience: SYLVA.

4664530.title: Before the screen goes black
4664530.short_description: You only have one week to befriend the one who lives on the other side of the screen. He’s waiting for you, remembers all your visits, and even notices how long you’re gone. Play mini-games, listen to his thoughts, and simply watch how the world around you changes.

4664650.title: 灰度决策
4664650.short_description: After saving an old Taoist, a programmer discovers talisman crafting is just like coding. He starts a cyber talisman company, balancing profit and morality. Will you stay righteous or embrace the gray?

4664670.title: Liminality: Chapter 1
4664670.short_description: Liminality is a Singleplayer Liminal Horror Game That focuses on Liminal Environments, and has a bunch of lore that you have to uncover - Based on the web-series and movie created by Kane Parsons (The Backrooms) CAN YOU ESCAPE THE LIMINAL COMPLEX

4664790.title: Oh, For Bugs' Sake!
4664790.short_description: Jump on platforms, cross deadly cables and crawl your way out of a CRT TV with the help of a friend in this cartoonish asymmetric coop-only platformer!

4664860.title: Sail On
4664860.short_description: Explore the Shallow Sea. Build absurd cannonballs. Plunder a procedural voyage. Sink enemy fleets designed by other captains. Die loud, rebuild louder and Sail On!

4664970.title: Hyperwurm is back!
4664970.short_description: A cyber‑worm engine roaring through a deadly maze. Guide a growing creature through tight corridors and sometimes face bosses using mouse, controller, or keyboard ...or let an AI Agent take over control.

4665070.title: FACTOVIVAL
4665070.short_description: Build an illegal factory before the government raids you, earning money to unlock new machines and gun cards. Keep the operation running by managing resources. Satisfy the government’s demands, or settle your debts and conflicts in gunfights.

4665270.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
