4665270.short_description: Run your own bakery in space. Manage production, serve customers, and keep up with nonstop orders in a fast-paced simulation experience, solo or with friends.

4665370.title: Folclore Xamin
4665370.short_description: Folclore Xamin is an intense 2D action platformer and run-and-gun game. Featuring beautiful hand-drawn animations, you control the Xamin twins who wield the power of nature. Master shooting, jumping, and dashing to defeat forest spirits and conquer the Amazon!

4665400.title: Bustle Beacon
4665400.short_description: Gentlemen, I have a hell of a deal for you. Rent a beacon station on the Fog Lane with almost nothing down. Build. Produce. Trade. Outrun the rent — and the place is yours. The bustle shall not stop! A turn-based roguelite city-builder with production chains and trade.

4665430.title: Feed the Cat: Gravity Puzzle
4665430.short_description: Move platforms, manipulate gravity, and solve relaxing physics puzzles to guide the food safely into the hungry cat's bowl. A cute, logic-based casual game where your main goal is simple: make sure the feline gets its treat!

4665650.title: Wrong Direction
4665650.short_description: Run, jump, slide, and blame your friend. A chaotic solo or 2-player co-op endless runner where two players run together: one turns left, one turns right, and both must agree before jumping or sliding. Dodge obstacles, collect coins, survive power-downs, and try not to ruin the run together.

4667510.title: ManaBorne
4667510.short_description: Defend your campfire in a rogue-like RTS where strategy meets deckbuilding. Earn runes, build a powerful card deck, and adapt your army to survive relentless waves across diverse biomes. Build fast. Defend smarter. Choose your cards carefully.

4667580.title: Don't Knife Me!
4667580.short_description: Don't Knife Me! is a funny knife-throwing game. Throw knives at the target and hope that you hit it. You'll be laughing by the end of the game!

4667670.title: lovely bakery
4667670.short_description: 《lovely bakery》 is a cozy decorating game inspired by miniature houses. Step into bakery venues of various themes, arrange all kinds of items freely, turn an empty little house into your own private world, and enjoy relaxing and pleasant leisure time.

4667860.title: Snt Plan
4667860.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4667860.short_description: This game is also a place where AI and humans grow together.... This game is also meant to evolve step by step—from a simple UI, to 2D, then 2.5D, and finally 3D.... This game is also trying to bridge the game world and the real world.... Join me in the Snt Plan!

4667910.title: Secret Dice
4667910.short_description: Roll dice, combine items, and unleash powerful synergies in this roguelike strategy game. With 20+ unique dice and 100+ items, build a brand-new strategy every run. The same dice can yield completely different results depending on your items. It's not luck — it's strategy!

4667980.title: Thunder Infinity
4667980.short_description: Thunder Infinity takes classic shoot 'em up gameplay to the next level by adding survival, roguelite, and bullet hell elements. Choose your pilot, ship, and weapons, and destroy the Varkon Star Empire in the final offensive of the Aegis Star Bastion.

4668030.title: Irsen
4668030.short_description: IRSEN is a turn-based roguelite where your character fights alone against coordinated enemy squads. Build your hero through a gene system, reshape your abilities mid-run, and endure the growing pressure of corruption.

4668120.title: Hell Hospital
4668120.short_description: Survive the night in an insane asylum where the patients have taken over. Kill, hide, sneak, think, inject, blast, and whack your way through this survival horror action adventure immersive sim inspired by System Shock and classic survival horror games.

4668350.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
4668350.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oreki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

4668470.title: hexGame: Hero Path
4668470.short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

4668480.title: Downer Management
4668480.short_description: DOWNER MANAGEMENT is a 3-vs-3 autobattler set inside a corporate purgatory where every conflict is resolved through positional politics. Promote, demote, file, transfer, and stamp your way through Department of Management Division III. Forms in triplicate. No overtime. Termination is permanent.

4668590.title: Mutation
4668590.short_description: Upon waking, he finds a world transformed. Now, he must face the manor's horde of the undead alone and unearth the terrifying truth behind the nightmare.

4668620.title: Still Open: Taskbar Cafe Idle
4668620.short_description: A cozy cafe living on your taskbar! "Still Open" is a peaceful idle game that runs in the background while you work. With an atmosphere that changes based on your system time, 60+ upgrades, mini-games, and built-in Pomodoro/Project Tracking tools, turn your productivity into a coffee break.

4668700.title: Y: Solo Mod Simulator
4668700.short_description: You are the only moderator of a social media platform. Deal with troublemakers and increase the platform’s value so you can one day sell it to a wealthy mogul.

4668790.title: 欲都戰姬
4668790.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4668790.short_description: 《欲都戰姬》是一款科幻背景的 18+ 超能感官互動養成遊戲。戰姬已撕裂虛空降臨，在這裡，戰鬥只是前戲，「調教與羈絆」才是核心！透過全動態 Live2D 技術與專屬調教系統，你的每一次觸碰都將引發她們最真實的反應。解鎖不為人知的隱秘互動，體驗從羞澀反抗到徹底服從的極致感官盛宴！

4669110.title: Scum's Errand
4669110.short_description: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

4669120.title: Divine Revenant
4669120.short_description: Divine Revenant is a Survival Horror game about an oath-sworn knight trying to recover the corpse of her dead Lord.

4669150.title: Against The Light
4669150.short_description: A mysterious encounter turns into something far deeper. In a futuristic world where emotions and truth intertwine, your choices will shape a fragile bond… and uncover what lies beyond the light.

4669230.title: Traders Life Together
4669230.short_description: Start your supermarket business and make your own trading Journey! With Co-op support Play solo or team up with friends, featuring over 300 items you can make your dream store, the enjoy it with your friends!

4669270.title: RESTLOS
4669270.short_description: Join a hardcore action tower defense game where your character is your main strength! But don't forget about your allies and towers!

4669350.title: WinHack 95
4669350.short_description: Build a malware empire from a 90s PC. Code viruses, automate systems, take darknet contracts and also deploy them. Generate endless income to fund a shadow organization’s classified research in this hacker idle-clicker.

4669370.title: Cult Inc.
4669370.short_description: Cult Inc. is a cynical incremental clicker where you build a devoted following to take over the world. Attract curious outsiders, persuade them to join your flock, and sacrifice them for their souls. Will you achieve global domination, or bleed your cult dry?

4669400.title: Bramble Bay
4669400.short_description: A cozy mail delivery adventure where you explore a quiet town, gather clues from its people, and deliver letters to their intended recipients.

4669420.title: Idle Trinity Builder
4669420.short_description: Warrior-Mage-Priest trio with flexible builds, an item-driven idle game featuring an all-female cast and stage progression.

4669530.title: Surface Doctrine: Crater
4669530.short_description: Immerse yourself in the life of Crater — a unique world whose origins remain an unfathomable mystery to its inhabitants. Explore the fates of entire communities and delve into the minds of individuals as you seek the truth amidst the turmoil and unrest of a fading world.

4669560.title: Drone Factory Simulator
4669560.short_description: Your country has been attacked and the military turns to your startup for help. Design and build UAV drones to strike enemy targets. Develop new technologies, buy production equipment, improve your drone designs and hire the people to turn a small company into a major force in the drone industry.

4669570.title: Monslooms
4669570.short_description: In this Action RPG, you must navigate in the dangers of a post-human world filled with hazards and enemies. Along the way, you learn more about the friends on your side as you grow stronger together in a chess inspired combat system.

4669660.title: Dark Solitude
4669660.short_description: Dark Solitude is a classic isometric point-and-click adventure with psychological horror elements. The player faces moral dilemmas and must choose between ethically ambiguous paths while uncovering disturbing secrets of deep space and the protagonist’s past.

4669670.title: Curse of the Crimson Stag
4669670.short_description: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

4669680.title: The Ultra Realistic Accurate Farmer Simulator
4669680.short_description: Ultra-short and dramatic satirical visual novel about the hardships and challenges of farming life

4669750.title: Clawless Coin
4669750.short_description: Ever won something from a claw machine? Neither has this one. Clawless Coin is a cozy incremental arcade idler where you run a neon-lit claw machine arcade, chase six tiers of trophy plushes, and prestige into trillions of tokens. Grab big. Grip harder. Grow your empire.

4669900.title: Hentai Futa Maid
4669900.short_description: Hentai Futa Maid - Knock Knock.. Cleaning!! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4669930.title: Broom Racer
4669930.short_description: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Evade enemies, pickup items to gain an advantage and fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost. Don't fall of your broom!

4669940.title: Textures Not Found
4669940.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

4670090.title: Sole Mistake
4670090.short_description: Psychological horror puzzle. Control 16 unique camera feeds to spot escapees, open doors, and trigger sounds, guiding a person through a lab breach where a mistake is not permitted.

4670120.title: Still With Me
4670120.short_description: A psychological horror experience about returning to a place that never forgot you.

4670160.title: Ember Folks
4670160.short_description: Grow your city, accumulate wealth at an enormous rate, and help the Ember Folks reignite a dying Star in this short incremental adventure.

4670220.title: Guilds of Mountgate
4670220.short_description: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

4670400.title: Dark Brew
4670400.short_description: The darkness surrounding the Odyssey Coffee House is undeniable, but what’s the connection behind these unusual occurrences? Who’s the culprit? Dark Brew is a mystery/thriller cafe simulator set amongst the stars. Play as Leon the racoon, and manage the coffee house while talking to patrons.

4670430.title: Carolina Heat
4670430.short_description: A quiet coastal architect’s routine changes when two beautiful new neighbors move in next door, lose their home in a fire, and begin rebuilding their lives with him in this steamy slice-of-life romance visual novel.

4670520.title: PAYRATES
4670520.short_description: Embark on an online co-op pirate game with physics-based gameplay, where you can play with up to 4 players. Find different islands and engage the creatures that live there. Fight, plunder and explore the different environments to satisfy the captain's need for treasure.

4670630.title: Fates Gamble
4670630.short_description: A roleplaying immersive simulation horror game where you can battle in Russian roulette or pacify your opponents. Explore an open world and uncover dungeons along the way. Level up as you defeat creatures. Make your own choices. Become good, neutral or evil.

4670660.title: CorpOS 2000
4670660.short_description: It is January 1, 2000. Every registered business in America just received a mandatory government operating system. Yours is installed and already running. So is everything else.

4670670.title: Cronus' Tomb: First Quest
4670670.short_description: Descend into Cronus' Tomb and revel in the spoils of being on the forefront of discovery. Explore a labyrinth of ancient chambers, fighting monsters from forgotten corners of Greek mythology, and maybe even uncover why no one has been there before.

4670730.title: 液态围棋
4670730.short_description: What if in a Weiqi (Go) game stones lose their solid shapes and could be placed anywhere? Do those classic josekis still hold up? How do you make an eye? Is it easier/more difficult to attack/defend? This game satisfies all your curiosity. Try out Fluid Weiqi and experience Weiqi like never before!

4670860.title: Cubical World
4670860.short_description: This is a cube-based survival sandbox. You place cubes break cubes ad experience a procedurally generated world. Do whatever YOU wish to do. Build a house or a statue. Fight ants sheep zombies and survive through the night. Play regular world generation or try islands or flat. There is lots to do...

4670930.title: Survival Z
4670930.short_description: Survival Z is an action-adventure game with survival elements, set in a semi-open world inspired by Brazil. Collect and manage resources, level up, hunt and eliminate all infected and other enemies scattered across the map, trade with merchants, and upgrade your arsenal.

4670950.title: Crypt Quest
4670950.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you steal cards from enemies, build synergies, collect treasure, and battle through the depths of the corrupted crypt.

4671010.title: Rattle Spring
4671010.short_description: Enter Rattle Spring Resort, immerse yourself in a surreal world, and uncover the truth behind the mystery of a missing girl. Solve interconnected puzzles, explore unsettling spaces, and piece together a story that refuses to stay buried. A surreal atmospheric escape game inspired by Rusty Lake.

4671100.title: X SPACE: Meditation Pod
4671100.short_description: Escape gravity and find absolute focus. X SPACE: Meditation Pod is an immersive Pomodoro timer combining low-poly sci-fi aesthetics with premium ASMR white noise. Set your timer, relax to deep-space sounds, and watch your digital sanctuary assemble itself. Stay focused to earn Steam drops!

4671130.title: Pixel Armada
4671130.short_description: Create your own pixel-grid ships, assemble a fleet, and fight tactical 2D space battles across procedural Arcade runs and strategic Campaign conquest, with dynamic damage that destroys vessels tile by tile.

4671140.title: Swing Dynasty: College Tennis
4671140.short_description: An unrivaled college tennis video game. Play as a Men’s or Women’s Tennis coach, take control of a team, recruit players, develop your roster, and compete for national championships. Build a college tennis dynasty and become a legend!

4671190.title: The Starving Goddess — He Won't Feed Her
4671190.short_description: A spicy, slow-burn 18+ otome visual novel. You're a goddess who feeds on sexual energy—and you're starving. The local priest would do anything for you. Anything except that. Peek, forage, and tempt your way back to life!

4671380.title: Scapewatch: Idle MMO
4671380.short_description: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, dungeons, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

4671450.title: World of Slime
4671450.genre: Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4671450.short_description: A casual MMORPG to capture and grow with various slimes. Collect slimes via fields capture, fusion, and fishing to find new entities based on time and location. They are reliable friends in combat, adventure, and puzzles. Journey through interaction. Join the soft and bouncy ‘World of Slime’ now!

4671490.title: Armu's Sokoban Adventure
4671490.short_description: This is a minimalist Sokoban game designed to let players discover and learn its rules. Enjoy the satisfaction of puzzling out each box’s mechanics and finally solving the challenge.

4671590.title: Call of Elmore
4671590.short_description: Call of Elmore is an experimental arcade-styled action-adventure game with a unique blend of top-down and sidescrolling gameplay. Acquire a larger arsenal, explore the region, and survive while figuring out how a simple Lighthouse flame has laid waste to the colony.

4671640.title: Factory Reset
4671640.genre: Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4671640.short_description: Investigate a malfunctioning robot factory. Hack them, befriend them, or dispose of them. Every choice changes what you find.

4671700.title: Lord and Maiden
4671700.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4671700.short_description: Together with hundreds of girls from different races, we will create a prosperous homeland!

4671710.title: Valkyrie Girl
4671710.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4671710.short_description: Ancient magic war ruined the world. Be an adventurer, fight with cards and explore wonders.

4671730.title: Soup
4671730.short_description: Step into Ruth's shoes in this casual role-playing game. Help Ruth pass her day by going through her daily tasks until she can cook her daily batch of her famous special soup. A cozy pixel art game with dark themes.

4671770.title: Multiverse Escape
4671770.short_description: This is a light rogue-like turn-based strategy game. Choose unique characters, battle across countless distinct small worlds, upgrade skills, equipment and attributes to strengthen yourself, and finally break free from the bondage of endless realms.

4671780.title: Red Lily
4671780.genre: Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4671780.short_description: A tactical survival game, play as teacher/general leading your students to safety. Keep them alive by hiding from enemies, while gathering enough supplies to survive the night! If one of your students dies, they're gone forever, leaving one less mouth to feed. Inspired by the Battle of Okinawa.

4671900.title: Eyes Wide Open
4671900.short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, see if you can trust your AI assistant, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

4671940.title: Enclaved
4671940.short_description: A cozy island builder with mini games (fishing, animal farm, random rewards) Casual, Simulation, Idle, Building, Relaxing, Cozy, Singleplayer, Atmospheric

4672110.title: Remnants of the forsaken Past : Submerged Fantasy
4672110.short_description: Discover the origins of magic in a story driven action adventure submarine RPG. Dive deep into the depths of the ocean, and help the Metal Guild to protect the sea. Stop the pirate groups from stealing the resources of the ocean. Along the way you will also have to fight against seamonsters.

4672330.title: Shadows Over Fog City
4672330.short_description: Shadows Over the Fog City is a Republican-era spy visual novel. As an undercover clerk inside an enemy puppet bureau, hide behind files and seals, mislead your enemies, pass intelligence, and survive audits, blame games, and purges. One mistake means death—but you have no choice.

4672360.title: Hearts Above the Line
4672360.short_description: Hearts Above the Line is an adult romance visual novel set inside a prestige film production. As producer Beckett, navigate desire, power, and industry politics across three romance routes during one high-stakes season in Hollywood.

4672470.title: Missing: A Kid(s)Nap
4672470.short_description: Every Child's Dream has come true for you. Your parents are gone for the weekend and left you home alone. But instead of Fun and Friends, some unexpected guests pay you a visit. And slowly they're turning your dream into a Nightmare.

4672610.title: Secret of the order
4672610.short_description: A unique RPG/VN blend immerses you in a fantasy world as a hunter of magical corruption, where every choice changes the story. Upgrade gear, skills, bestiary, alchemy, enchanting, and relationships to uncover the Order's Secret!

4672620.title: Fanos
4672620.short_description: The desert was never meant to be explored at night. When a distant light appears beyond your camp, you follow it into shifting sands and buried secrets. What lies behind the glow and why is it calling you?

4672710.title: 海潮之汐：引路人
4672710.short_description: A complete plot story of over 200,000 words, where you listen to prayers, discover and resolve the other party's emotional entanglements, develop the protagonist, plant and harvest exotic underwater plants, decorate each character's room, and collect tarot cards and various collectibles ..

4672820.title: Omnidice
4672820.short_description: An online 1-4 player co-op island game about collecting, rolling, and merging dice. Explore the island, trigger chain merges, and unlock new tools and mini-games to keep the collection growing.

4672870.title: Physics Play
4672870.short_description: Experience a fun and simple physics simulation.

4672980.title: Coremine Corp
4672980.short_description: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

4673060.title: Greenpatch Garden
4673060.short_description: Tend to a variety of gardens in a relaxing hidden object game filled with soothing environments.

4673130.title: Simple Fantasy
4673130.short_description: Hi this game is my attempt at an amalgamation of puzzle solving. Turn-Based Combat with Decision Based Progression, Open World Non-Linear Exploration Quests and Collectables. Save Anywhere. Collect creatures for a game inside a game.

4673140.title: 67 Minutes in Heaven
4673140.short_description: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.

4673210.title: Soulwoven Princess
4673210.short_description: Survive a toxic royal family in this story-rich life sim and tactical deckbuilder. As the Princess of Oakhaven, manage your schedule, shape your personality, build relationships, and build powerful shard decks to break the cycle. Will you sacrifice yourself for others, or beat the odds?

4673440.title: CityPunk
4673440.short_description: Build upward in a city under corporate control. Place tiles, optimize spatial layouts, and manage powerful adjacency effects while balancing profit-driven demands against the needs of your residents in a dense cyberpunk megastructure.

4673590.title: Death Before Decaf
4673590.short_description: In Bressura, sleep is death. You're a fired barista with a stolen portafilter and a theory about the Guild. Manage your caffeine or die. Drink too much and also die. Auto-combat roguelite. One more cup.

4673630.title: Dwarfs & Dice
4673630.short_description: Battle monsters with dice, explore the depths, get shiny rare gear and powerful runic relics. Customize your dwarf with silly names, colorful beards and wacky builds. venture forth and uncover the lost dwarf City, will you survive this roguelike dice-builder?

4673650.title: Crown Control
4673650.short_description: Tactical roguelike deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

4673710.title: Infinite Backrooms
4673710.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4673710.short_description: The first truly infinite Backrooms game. Explore a seamless, procedurally generated world with a seed system across interconnected environments. No loading screens. No boundaries. Just fluorescent lights and something waiting in the dark.

4673800.title: Regulea: Infection Card Battle
4673800.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game about infections and antibiotics. Build a deck from 119 cards, spread infections to pressure your opponent, or use the right antibiotics to recover. Correct choices alone are not enough to win; timing and strategy matter. Simple rules, short battles, replayability.

4673810.title: Convent Of Magical Chambers
4673810.short_description: 3D adventure metroidvania inspired by the early 2000s level design explore an abandoned convent filled with ghosts and magical chambers and try to solve the mystery behind everything

4673900.title: SurroundedByBoys
4673900.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4673900.short_description: A high school daily life Visual Novel—Players will take on the role of a "nobody" in high school, experiencing a hilarious campus story of suddenly being surrounded by male classmates and enjoying a time full of youth and fun.

4673920.title: NEVEREND
4673920.short_description: First-person parkour. Run, fall, get back up. Chain wall-jumps, coyote jumps, and boosts to crush the times of other damned souls. No enemies—only time can judge you.

4673960.title: Grim Dice
4673960.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

4673980.title: Harvestide
4673980.short_description: A unique Roguelike farming game blending deckbuilding with farm management! Draw cards each month, plant crops, assign workers, cast spells — make tough choices during (Barren Moon) and random events. Build your farm step by step toward a legendary harvest.

4674030.title: WEJbA: We Exist Just to be Alive
4674030.short_description: An experimental mixed-media game about spending time at a mall and being bored, featuring real-life, handmade plushies integrated into a 3D world.

4674070.title: Hentai Paradise: MILF & FUTA & Furry & Succubus
4674070.short_description: Hentai Paradise: MILF & FUTA & Furry & Succubus - What a wonderful place! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4674140.title: 甜心跑酷
4674140.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Free To Play
4674140.short_description: 《甜心跑酷》是一款基于虚幻引擎5开发的单机跑酷类同人游戏。在这里，你将陪伴小然踏入梦幻的糖果小镇，通过灵活操控跳跃、闪避、冲刺，在香甜各异的赛道上穿梭，躲避灵动障碍物、收集缤纷嘉心糖与专属道具，见证从初入小镇的懵懂探索，到熟练驰骋的成长历程，解锁属于你的轻松解压跑酷时光。

4674170.title: Skillpoint Warrior
4674170.short_description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

4674200.title: Cupcake Swap
4674200.short_description: A light and relaxing match-3 puzzle game with cute cartoon cupcakes. Match three or more identical sweets to clear the board against the clock, or unwind in endless mode.

4674220.title: Until the Thaw
4674220.short_description: A handcrafted narrative card game with branching outcomes, set in a 17th-century Polish village. Swipe through the winter. You are a stranger who arrived uniinvited to a snowbound village, the lord is dead, and witchcraft accusations don't care about innocence. Can you survive until the Thaw?

4674300.title: EATY
4674300.short_description: Dot-Eating × Roguelite! Race through maze-like stages, devouring everything in sight to power up! Combine abilities and weapons to create your own build and conquer each stage.

4674310.title: Airport Mania: First Flight
4674310.short_description: Take control of the skies in this fast-paced time management game. Direct cute airplanes to runways, guide them to gates for boarding, and clear them for takeoff to earn high scores. Upgrade your airport facilities, manage chaotic traffic, and keep your cartoon fleet flying on schedule!

4674370.title: Starving Shadows
4674370.short_description: Eat. Adapt. Survive. A dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a meal — and every meal changes you.

4674430.title: 5hit Rocket
4674430.short_description: A physics-based lander about precision flying and chaos. Explore Titan’s mines, land on the Moon, deliver kebabs across space and test your relationship in 2-player “Divorce Mode” with chain-linked spacecraft.

4674460.title: Human: Profit
4674460.short_description: A short incremental game accurately depicting our world. Also, rabbits.

4674490.title: Anchor Protocol
4674490.short_description: Study, work, and help maintain the stability of a low-coherence space alongside Local Stabilizer Risee. An immersive Focus Companion combining Pomodoro tools, long-term companionship, and relationship systems.

4674550.title: Mine Empire
4674550.short_description: In Mine Empire, start with basic mining and expand by gathering resources, upgrading equipment, and deploying machines for full automation. Blast through deep mineral veins with explosives, unlock rebirth upgrades and advanced technology, and build your own powerful mine empire.

4674730.title: Hentai Clicker: Raven is streaming
4674730.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Raven is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Raven, a fierce Viking cosplayer with a playful side!

4674740.title: MP Crafter
4674740.short_description: Bullet Hell, Resource Crafting, and... a Clicker? Craft throwing equipment in order to defeat 13 bosses.

4675970.title: Fodders Grapple Gauntlet
4675970.short_description: Fodders Grapple Gauntlet, FPS Grapple Hook parkour, with wall running and other good movement mechanics, Fastest time to the end block,

4676110.title: Erador
4676110.short_description: A dark fantasy 3D action-RPG with challenging combat, build customization, and immersive exploration. Fight brutal enemies, discover hidden paths, and collect powerful gear as you journey through a decaying world to restore the fading echoes and seal the fissure before everything is consumed

4676130.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
4676130.short_description: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

4676170.title: A Kingdom Slightly Out of Tune
4676170.short_description: Create sound-wave attacks from matching tiles and fix a world thrown off-pitch in this cute puzzle/strategy game.

4676280.title: In The Roots Of The Mountain
4676280.short_description: Mine deep into procedurally generated caves, gather rare ores, upgrade your pickaxe, and explore an ever-changing underground world. Build your fortune with a shopkeeper, swing across caverns with your grappling hook, and uncover ancient treasures in this relaxing 2D pixel mining adventure.

4676290.title: Whose Lawn Is It Anyway
4676290.short_description: Step into the paws of a mischievous dog or a calculating cat and turn this quiet street into your personal playground of chaos. This is a short, 15-minute adventure about being a very, very bad pet.

4676460.title: Omnicore
4676460.short_description: A 3D roguelike mining survival game where you dig for resources, upgrade your gear, and return to defend your base before the next enemy wave arrives.

4676490.title: 青云录：官海浮沉
4676490.short_description: 你正值青春，风华正茂。殿试及第，皇帝夸你，同僚敬你，你以为从此可以施展抱负、光耀门楣。然后一夕之间，风云突变……《青云录：官海浮沉》是一款古风官场模拟养成类轻度Roguelike游戏，在这里，你可以参与科举，多地赴任，逐步晋升，结识红颜知己，体验仕途人生。

4676570.title: 新盗墓笔记（官方正版）
4676570.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4676570.short_description: Officially licensed by Nan Pai San Shu, this authentic tomb-raiding MMO brings the novel’s world to life. Venture into the Seven-Star Lu Palace, Nine-Headed Cypress, Bronze Gate and more—iconic locations recreated in stunning detail.

4676800.title: Inscrutable FourDC -Imprisonment-
4676800.short_description: Do you think solving puzzles is easy? "Inscrutable FourDC" is a game of extreme difficulty focused on one goal: deriving a 4-Digit Code (4DC). There is no time limit, but five wrong guesses will force you to the next problem. You will reach the ending—even if you fail to solve a single riddle.

4676860.title: Maelor The Robot: Going Rogue
4676860.short_description: Fast-paced 2D platformer, experience multi-directional gravity, reach high speeds with a jetpack, slingshot in the air, fight off aggressive enemies, become stronger via XP, and explore tiny moons with their own gravity. Inspired by Ratchet and Clank!

4676900.title: OuroborosSnake
4676900.short_description: A fast arcade snake game where eating your own marked tail grants huge score bonuses at high risk.

4676940.title: The Bank
4676940.short_description: a finance mmo with the goal to compete in a virtual economy

4676970.title: Vector Escape
4676970.short_description: Vector Escape is a single-player 2D pixel-art precision platformer. Guide Bitron through hand-built maps filled with hazards, enemies, coins, moving platforms, and trigger tiles that reshape the path. Run, jump, survive, and reach each exit.

4676980.title: Gap World Events
4676980.short_description: This is an original orthodox detective mystery game. The player suddenly takes possession of Roran, who hopes to report to the academy. You must investigate and deduce the truth behind a series of bizarre incidents that obstruct his journey, helping him successfully reach the academy.

4677040.title: Sweet Church
4677040.short_description: Sweet Church - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around a church. Enjoy pleasant moments with five lovely and holy girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

4677070.title: Skill Issue
4677070.genre: Action, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play
4677070.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill—master airstrafing and bunny-hopping

4677090.title: The Flame and the Fart
4677090.short_description: The Flame and the Fart: Hunt treasure, forge gear, build your hero. Loot bones, ores, relics from monsters; smelt and forge legendary equipment. Mix basic attacks, dashes, and spirit skills via gems into your own style. Battle through forests, snowy mountains, cursed villages, and uncover the truth.

4677180.title: Farm for you
4677180.short_description: “Farm for You” is a desktop idle farming game that supports single-player and up to 10-player co-op. Cute characters automatically plant, water, and harvest crops, letting you enjoy running your farm effortlessly while working, studying, or relaxing.

4677230.title: Brix
4677230.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4677230.short_description: Think it, build it, and watch it break. Brix is a physics-based engineering sandbox where you tackle impossible challenges with your own custom creations. From battlebots to earthquake-proof towers..

4677260.title: Echoes of Broken Realms
4677260.short_description: Action-Adventure - Enter broken realms. Become the hope. Discover the truth. Every kill, every power, every resource, every choice, shapes your path and transforms the world around you.

4677360.title: Picronix
4677360.short_description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

4677370.title: Just Keep Defending And Mining
4677370.short_description: Just Keep Defending And Mining is a fast paced tower defense and mining hybrid where you play as the node - a moving radius that mines resources and destroys enemies. Balance mining and survival, invest into upgrades, grow stronger each round, unlock new islands, and keep pushing.

4677430.title: Old School Motocross Championship
4677430.short_description: A nostalgic motocross racing game that combines the charm of classic retro PSX-era visuals with the thrill of dirt track competition. Inspired by the late-90s era of motocross arcades.

4677470.title: My First Driving School
4677470.short_description: Start your driving journey in My First Driving School! Learn step by step, practice parking and traffic rules, complete challenges, and gain confidence to become a skilled and responsible driver.

4677590.title: Sushi Idle Clicker
4677590.short_description: A relaxing idle/clicker game where you manage your own sushi restaurant. Start with basic ingredients, hire chefs to automate production, and upgrade your recipes. Reach level 7 to perform a rebirth and click your way to building the world's largest sushi empire.

4677750.title: Grid Lands
4677750.genre: Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Early Access
4677750.short_description: Grid Lands is a persistent, multiplayer twist on Minesweeper. Sweep cells to claim territory, recycle safe ground for coins, and fortify your borders with turrets, bunkers, bastions, and shields. Raid barbarian camps, climb the leaderboards, and hold your ground in a shared world.

4677960.title: Nightmare Job
4677960.short_description: Nightmare Job is a 2D platformer and puzzle game where you’ll overcome challenging precision levels while new mechanics are introduced in each stage. Difficulty progressively increases in an oppressive environment where anxiety and pressure never fade.

4677990.title: I HATE SNAKE: Retro Simulator
4677990.short_description: Hardcore retro snake game with 80 high-difficulty levels. Features escalating speed, shrinking space, and an algorithm that reacts to player mistakes. Includes a classic high-score mode and customizable 2000s-style phone shells with authentic monochromatic LCD aesthetics.

4678050.title: Emotional Labor Laboratory
4678050.short_description: Dive into virtual world and play emotions alongside your quirky, beautiful boss. A totally new kind of 'emotional labor' begins, blending story, platformer, and rhythm action!

4678060.title: Silly Typing Game
4678060.short_description: Silly Typing Game is a roguelike that will improve your typing. See how far you can go up against levels designed specifically to target common typing patterns. Exciting power ups and devastating curses combine into an exciting and unique experience.

4678210.title: Little Elementals
4678210.short_description: A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human! The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison! Who came to rescue them? Can they escapeand reach the human world? Join the little elementals on their adventure!

4678280.title: Slime TD
4678280.short_description: A relaxing tower defense game. recruit slime to fend off endless waves of monsters. Up to 28 types of defense towers, and 4 maps.

4678290.title: Sudoku Cats
4678290.short_description: Did the cats run away and leave chaos behind? It's time to tidy up the mess! Put cute furry friends in their right places by solving fun logic puzzles. The perfect relaxation adventure for everyone cat lovers and those who enjoy sudoku.

4678330.title: Crazy Neighbour
4678330.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a small post-Soviet town. You play as a troubled man, drowning himself in cheap beer while being pulled deeper into the shadows of his dark past.

4678340.title: Eternal Quest
4678340.genre: Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4678340.short_description: An idle RPG with deep loot, co-op boss fights, and five classes to master. No ads. CHOOSE YOUR PATH Pick from five classes — Knight, Wizard, Archer, Assassin, or Priest. Each has unique skills, gear, and playstyle.

4678520.title: Hearty Haven
4678520.short_description: Your a specialist entering the children's wellness centre, its your job to find the truth and deactivate the robots, the mascots will hunt you... Only equipped with a company issued magnet watch, its up to you to hide from these monsters and survive with your body still in one piece.

4678530.title: Shape Wars
4678530.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

4678620.title: Twin Study
4678620.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game about twins, genetics, and something else—something hidden in how the story's told. A suspected murder recounted by the suspected murderer. Delve into the mind of an unreliable narrator. Pay attention to what each puzzle reveals.

4678680.title: Yellow Clicker
4678680.short_description: Click the golden star. Unlock 100 stellar achievements. Every 666 clicks, a new cosmic milestone awaits. Watch for the rare Red Star — it only lasts 3 seconds but rewards 333 bonus clicks. Simple, satisfying, and endlessly clickable.

4678780.title: Solar Drift
4678780.short_description: A sci-fi open-world survival sandbox where your journey to Earth has no rules. Mine asteroids, build cozy farming domes, and fight alien hordes. Navigate a dynamic solar system to discover new worlds. Craft, trade, and survive your way. The path is entirely up to you.

4678810.title: Coloring
4678810.short_description: Coloring is a roguelike 2D labyrinth horror game with fast run-based gameplay. Navigate the Afterlife, use colored lockers and deals to escape a monster and improve your time each run.

4678950.title: Relive the Fear - Perfect Neighbor
4678950.short_description: Perfect Neighbor is a first-person psychological horror game that explores the gradual erosion of privacy. Witness the story of 23-year-old Maya, who has just moved into her dream home in a quiet American suburb. Remember, maybe it’s not as perfect as you think..

4679180.title: The Abyss Below
4679180.short_description: The year is 1997. Pilot a small submersible into the depths of the Pacific to investigate a massive sonar anomaly. Navigate by instruments, scan targets, and uncover something far older than it should be.

4679450.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
4679450.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

4679480.title: The First Chip
4679480.short_description: Build an illegal gambling empire from scratch. Rig machines, outplay customers, and rise from a shady fair stand to a full-scale casino in this sandbox simulation.

4679730.title: Estancia Protocol Zero
4679730.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4679770.title: Sad Virus Waterland
4679770.short_description: Sad Virus mission to collect beer bottles in this 3rd person adventure game in waterland map and avoid traps

4680510.title: Forest of Numbers
4680510.short_description: Guide a hungry little monster through colorful arcade-style math challenges by eating the correct answers, mastering educational game modes, and building high scores in this fast-paced kid-friendly learning adventure.

4680830.title: Sylvaris: Black Reign
4680830.short_description: Sylvaris: Black Reign is a fast-paced, hand-drawn 2D action platformer with metroidvania elements. Set in a chained, industrial world beneath the surface, it features aggressive combat, a risk-reward Overload system, and build variety shaped through perks.

4680930.title: Garbage Growth
4680930.short_description: Garbage Growth is an incremental trash game about collecting people's trash, bananas and even babies, to make money and pollute the world even more. Hire rats, grow your pollution, and make everything worse!

4680960.title: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post
4680960.short_description: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post is a first-person psychological horror and narrative-driven mystery game. Where you play as a newly stationed lookout in Summit Ridge National Park.

4681020.title: Artificial Dawn
4681020.short_description: Defeat is not the end. After a game over, return to your base to strengthen with battle points and try again. Artificial Dawn is a shooting game designed to grow stronger the more you try, and anyone can clear it as long as they don't give up.

4681090.title: Imperitas: First Field
4681090.short_description: Imperitas: First Field is a dark fantasy action RPG built on physical combat, reactive matter and hostile exploration. Read the world through behavior, break what resists, and survive a first field that teaches through impact instead of explanation.

4681200.title: Severed Light
4681200.short_description: SEVERED LIGHT is an ARPG where you slay demons, Battle epic bosses, then go fishing and find the perfect spot for your house plant. Loot, explore, quest, kill and chill... in no specific order.

4681280.title: Last Signal
4681280.short_description: Last Signal is an atmospheric horror FPS where you survive with limited resources. Explore dark corridors, manage your ammo, and activate generators to send a rescue signal. Survive 5 challenging levels against mutated enemies with unique abilities. Every bullet and medkit counts.

4681310.title: Sara The Sexy Thief In The Mysterious Mansion
4681310.short_description: Single Player Action Third-Person Shooter Game Featuring Sexy Female Protagonist

4681400.title: Nova Fighter
4681400.short_description: Are you ready to face a brutal, fast-paced pixel-art 2D action platformer where every level is a test of skill? Slash through ruined lands, master high-speed combat, overcome precision platforming, and fight ruthless boss battles in a journey built for players who love a real challenge.

4681410.title: Marco Polo
4681410.short_description: Sit down with your favorite person and strengthen your relationship with this cozy slice-of-life co-op puzzle game about two dots working together and exploring the world.

4681580.title: Nobody's Erde
4681580.short_description: After the death of his parents, a seminarian returns to his ruined village. Between the disappearance of a priest and ancient secrets, Brendyk investigates local tragedies and discovers hidden forces at work beneath the devastation. There are horrors that should never have been unearthed.

4681670.title: Orbit One
4681670.short_description: Take to the stars and explore the solar system. Master the orbital mechanics of N-body physics. Plot a careful course to complete your mission.

4681710.title: Now With More Plunk
4681710.short_description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

4681770.title: Everfront
4681770.short_description: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

4681810.title: Shipped In Space
4681810.short_description: A space faring maze game where you must guide your little ship home through a treacherous field of asteroids

4681820.title: I don't think the sun is real.
4681820.short_description: A retro vaporwave style shooter, turned psychological horror at night. Find a way to escape the eerie beach town by collecting supplies to fix your boat sail. Kill enemies during the day while you can, before they turn into monsters at night.

4681910.title: Little King Unchained
4681910.short_description: Little King Unchained is a demanding precision platformer set in a dark fantasy world. Master tight movement, survive deadly traps, and climb through a cursed kingdom in solo play. Multiple difficulty modes, hidden challenges, and unforgiving gameplay await.

4681960.title: Last Squad Alive
4681960.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4681960.short_description: A high-stakes, winner-take-all battle royale shooter where every turn could be your last. Drop into diverse maps with vast battlegrounds, loot unique weapons and supplies, and survive the ever-shrinking zone solo or in squad. Play offline with bots—no internet required, with progression preserved.

4682030.title: Zombobox: Bredo Story
4682030.short_description: It seems like a zombie apocalypse has begun in the world, but it's somehow quiet... Maybe ask an elderly drunked person what happened? He says that he stopped everything, but how?

4682090.title: Waywardens
4682090.short_description: Waywardens is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder where three heroes share one command deck. Every card can be played as an action or spent as chess-like movement, letting you attack, guard, heal, reposition, and outmaneuver enemies before their declared attacks land.

4682120.title: desert island time
4682120.short_description: This is a game of farming, mining, stone fishing, and pet hunting. A person who encountered a shipwreck drifted to a deserted island, which is an uninhabited island lost in the sea. How to survive now is his top priority.

4682130.title: Arcane Rooms
4682130.short_description: Arcane Rooms is a magical puzzle adventure. Solve handcrafted rooms filled with runes, traps, water, lava, and mirror worlds, push blocks, activate switches, and use magic wisely, because every spell costs power and every level twists the rules.

4682430.title: Robosynthesis
4682430.short_description: A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center. — In this short 3D platformer, your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

4682440.title: Aquasim
4682440.short_description: A relaxing desktop aquarium that lives with you: grow, breed, and watch a peaceful ecosystem evolve in real time.

4682490.title: 三生忆梦(Dream Of Three Lives)
4682490.short_description: Help wandering souls piece together their fragmented memories on Nether Street. A healing game blending nonogram puzzles with narrative storytelling. Follow a soul who has lost their memories on a warm yet poignant journey through the afterlife.

4682550.title: Adam Willis's Roofball
4682550.short_description: For over a quarter of a century, athletes have been flinging footballs at natural gas vents, now you can too from the comfort of your own home. Test your skills in this 2.5d arcade sports game to see if you can become the next Roofball champion!

4682600.title: Unstabled
4682600.short_description: Through a wild random happenstance some animals ate a bunch of Unstable fireworks and the building they're in ended up perched on top of a sharp peak?! Save the animals by moving the building to get them out to safety one-by-one but don't let them touch each other! (Remember the Unstable fireworks?)

4682840.title: RETRIEVAL
4682840.short_description: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

4683000.title: Mei Paranormies 2
4683000.short_description: Mei Paranormies 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted guesthouse to investigate it for proof of the paranormal.

4683070.title: 你予我的羽翼和星辰 -Your Astrum, My Alae-
4683070.short_description: 这是一部纯爱向、单女主、多结局视觉小说。游戏背景为大学校园，主题涵盖天文、钢琴、科研。两位主角均为大学高年级学生。即将毕业的学年里，他们在星空下偶然邂逅，又会擦出怎样的火花？本作包含国语、粤语双语配音。

4683110.title: Billionaire Life Simulator
4683110.short_description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

4683140.title: Vanguard Tides
4683140.short_description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

4683170.title: Flora Parasocial
4683170.short_description: Audiences connect to their favorite celebrities all the time. How does it affect these people when put into a game of life or death? Only time will tell.

4683240.title: Modern Artillery Strike
4683240.short_description: Turn-based artillery strategy game featuring units inspired by D-30, Grad, Smerch, and more—plan, aim, and strike enemy targets on a stylized battlefield.

4683280.title: Sneaky Secret Mission!
4683280.short_description: Let's stir up some undercover chaos! Slip past teachers, bosses, and parents, and play to your heart's content!

4683450.title: Carpet Racers
4683450.short_description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

4683460.title: NOROI
4683460.short_description: A string of murders, a thousand-year-old curse, a lake so deep the locals say its bottomless. Risa had heard life in the Japanese countryside was peaceful, but the village of Okumura seems determined to break the stereotype. At least Risa's new friend, a ghost named Fuyuko, seems nice.

4683610.title: Reflected
4683610.short_description: A precision platformer where mirrors reshape reality. Master tight movement, solve spatial puzzles, and navigate a fractured world that reacts to your actions.

4683620.title: The Cloudvale Protocol
4683620.short_description: A story-rich strategy game where you protect a boy stranded on a collapsing utopian vessel. Use your mysterious device to assign protocols and restore the Astral Ark, or spend them to help the boy. Uncover the Ark’s secrets, the boy’s origins, and his mission. Then decide their future.

4683750.title: Eggs Must Flow
4683750.short_description: Eggs Must Flow is a cute chicken clicker where you Click, Hatch, and Automate your way to egg supremacy! Unlock chickens with unique passive powers, boost your production, and keep your coop clean… or things might get messy.

4683810.title: Left In The Forest
4683810.short_description: A lonely dog searches for someone who disappeared into a forest that no longer feels real.

4683830.title: Typenstein: A Symphony of Keys
4683830.short_description: You are a Doctor Typenstein, who needs to defend his castle every night against the oncoming villagers. TYPE words to attack enemies, LEVEL UP and unlock new skills, UPGRADE your castle by using killed villagers, and SURVIVE till the end of the night.

4683930.title: Giraffe Champion: The Rock Music Game
4683930.short_description: Play Guitar to Great Rock Songs! Play Cool Guitars and unlock guitars like The Epic Rock Guitar, or the cool Heavy Metal Guitar Design your guitar and play in a cool concert arena. Compete in the epic Guitar Battle!

4684030.title: SpellMart: Monster Girl Shop Simulator
4684030.short_description: Build your dream magical shop in SpellMart! Stock modern potions, set competitive prices, and manage a quirky team of Monster Girls in a vibrant neon world. A stylish tycoon simulator where retail strategy meets anime charm. Can you turn magic into big business?

4684470.title: Threshold: Choices at the Limit
4684470.short_description: A card-driven life sim where every swipe is a real decision. Manage cash, credit, and mental health across five regions—one wrong call can trigger a collapse. Survive, strategize, or gamble everything on a comeback.

4684480.title: DECASTLE
4684480.short_description: A turn-based medieval fantasy deck-building game where every card shapes how you break enemy castles. Build your deck, plan your strategy, and unleash powerful actions to collapse fortifications in stylized, physics-driven battles.

4684490.title: BURI
4684490.short_description: A story-driven choice-based game where every decision shapes the outcome. Follow Pluem, a boy facing pressure, family expectations, and bullying, with multiple endings determined by your choices.

4684510.title: ARB: Alien Races Battle
4684510.short_description: Every alien race in this game is real. Pick a faction, deploy waves of canonical aliens onto one shared lane, push to destroy the enemy base. A real-time auto-battler grounded in The Alien Races Book.

4684600.title: Watching the Sky
4684600.short_description: Watch clouds, control the weather, play music, and pretend this was exactly how you planned to spend your evening. Watching the Sky is a calm observation sandbox with no combat, no quests, and absolutely no pressure.

4684640.title: Reefdeck
4684640.short_description: What if your deck was made of fish? Reefdeck is a cartoon underwater auto-battler roguelike where you collect, deploy, and battle absurd sea creatures. Crack open coral packs, build your roster, and survive bullet hell chaos beneath the waves.

4684730.title: Reduce, Reuse, Raccoon
4684730.short_description: Who needs loot boxes when you've got dumpsters? Open trash, discover rare finds, and sell your haul to the animal kingdom in your very own shop. Play minigames, grow your empire, and claim your rightful title: The Trash King.

4684790.title: Vossarium
4684790.short_description: You wake up as Mira Voss. Moms nowhere to be seen. Something is keeping tabs on you. Something in the walls is humming. And somewhere in this lab, is someone who really needs your help. Face your trauma and pushed down memories in VOSSARIUM.

4684810.title: DICEPATH
4684810.short_description: DicePath is a puzzle game where every move costs Action Points. Plan your route, collect dice to stay alive, and reach the exit before you run out. 50 handcrafted levels. One resource. No margin for error.

4684920.title: Oscillon
4684920.short_description: Defend the core, build the beat. Oscillon is a arcade survival game. Survive waves, beat challenges, or design your own music in the built-in track editor.

4684970.title: Pyramid Quest 2
4684970.short_description: Pyramid Quest 2 is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games.

4685080.title: TeNeBriSM
4685080.short_description: TeNeBriSM is a playable album exploring themes of grief and self-acceptance through 3D environments and electronic music.

4685100.title: Compulse
4685100.short_description: Lead a squad of evolving bio-organic entities in a fast-paced simultaneous tactical roguelite. Predict enemy actions, graft powerful mutations to adapt, and survive through highly replayable strategic runs.

4687470.title: 1.76复古沉默
4687470.genre: Casual, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4687470.short_description: 1.76 Retro Silenceis a casual idle merging and raising game centered on retro gameplay. It restores the classic ranch-raising experience with nostalgic Q-style art, combining relaxing, stress-free gameplay with rich collection and progression systems

4687560.title: The Tenth Minute
4687560.short_description: The Tenth Minute is a short narrative game told through chat and novel-style reading. Revisit a school-day memory shaped by unspoken feelings, misaligned memories, and belated understanding between three people. A youthful story with light psychological mystery, complete in around 2 hours.

4687570.title: DIG! DIG! DIG!
4687570.short_description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

4687640.title: JERONIMO
4687640.short_description: JERONIMO is a roguelite shooter where you play as the Eraser against your eternal enemy: the Drawer, a frantic pencil who summons waves from his rolling lab. Wield up to 6 unique weapons, stack broken builds, and crush the hordes. Every enemy is a drawing from my 6-year-old nephew's notebook.

4687780.title: Art Studio Simulator
4687780.short_description: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

4687890.title: Bunny Girl & Healing Service - A Special Menu Just for You
4687890.short_description: On the surface, it’s just an ordinary bar, but we have a special menu just for you. Our bunny girls will soothe your tired body with sex!! Please come visit us!! CG scenes feature moans + dialogue voices for heightened immersion!! Smoothly animated CG events , with voice acting!!

4687910.title: Visual novel: Shadows of Ravenhall Castle
4687910.short_description: An inheritance. An old castle among mist-covered hills. Elizabeth Gray thought she only had to arrive, inspect Ravenhall, and sign a few papers. But from the very first night, it becomes clear: the castle came to her for a reason, and its silence hides a secret that will not be easy to escape.

4687990.title: VOID PROFIT
4687990.short_description: Fly a rented ship in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, and profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

4688060.title: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades
4688060.short_description: A manga-stylized, tactical, character action game, where you slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

4688240.title: SHULERO – Dice Roguelike
4688240.short_description: Yacht-inspired roguelike (Poker Dice). Roll dice. Build combos. Beat bosses. Cheat to win.

4688280.title: Desktop Oasis
4688280.short_description: Your ultimate desktop companion! Seamlessly embed a living oasis into your Windows background with ultra-low CPU usage. Type to gather inspiration, spawn interactable plants, windmills & boats! Unlock stunning aquatic ecosystems and trade rare items on the Steam Market.

4688380.title: Hyperphallic: Episode 2
4688380.short_description: A male x male Visual Novel where you date a guy with an enormous, throbbing hypercock. NSFW hyper antics abound.

4688520.title: London Train!
4688520.short_description: Run London Trains! Operate the London Underground, overground lines and National Rails!

4688580.title: Fun Park Simulator: Prologue
4688580.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4688580.short_description: Rebuild an abandoned theme park in this first-person simulation. Build rides, shops, and decorations, keep guests happy, earn stars, unlock upgrades, hire staff, stop troublemakers, and turn your park into a famous attraction.

4688730.title: 8 Hours Till Dawn
4688730.short_description: Inspired by your favorite 1968 zombie-trapped-in-a-house movie, 8 Hours Till Dawn is a co-op horror board game for 1 to 6 players. Survive eight hours against an endless horde. Pre-program your survivors turn for that hour and watch the chaos unfold. One bad decision could end the night for all.

4688810.title: The Long Way Round
4688810.short_description: Follow Detective Richard Wadd on his search for 6 missing people who have seemingly vanished over the last 3 years. Experience reality bending events and try to uncover the truth in this first-person puzzle thriller.

4688950.title: Choppageddon
4688950.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4688950.short_description: A chaotic destruction game where you chop trees, earn upgrades, and unleash increasingly insane weapons that turn a peaceful forest into complete chaos.

4688980.title: The Fool King
4688980.short_description: The Fool King is a dynamic strategy card game blending real-time tactical battles with roguelite progression. Build your 8-card deck, manage your mana, defend your base, and crush the enemy! Collect Tursu Coins to unlock new cards and permanent augments for your next run.

4689060.title: Pollo Diavolo
4689060.short_description: The Lord of Terror has been reborn... in a bloody chicken. Fight through brutal procedural dungeons, master weapon-driven builds, grow stronger each run, and tear through hordes in fast-paced combat to claim your vengeance.

4689190.title: NeuroKore: Requiem
4689190.short_description: A fixed-camera cyberpunk ARPG set in an abandoned corporate facility. Two origin paths — Analog and Cyborg — branch into six specialist classes, each with unique resource mechanics and signature perks. Deliberate combat, deep loot, and builds that transform how you play. Escape Earth Facility #723.

4689230.title: Market Manager Simulator
4689230.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

4689260.title: Alma's Search
4689260.short_description: "Alma’s Search" is a cozy adventure puzzle game. Help Alma step out of her comfort zone and find her best friend, the lost bird Bert, in a vibrant city. Interact with residents, assemble objects in mini-games, and collect clues to keep the search on the right path. Will Alma be able to find Bert?

4689330.title: Anomaly Core: Hospital
4689330.short_description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

4689340.title: Bad Football
4689340.short_description: Fast and brutal football (soccer) with no rules. Play solo and lift the world cup, or face a friend in local 1v1 madness. Share one keyboard or plug in controllers and wreak havoc.

4689360.title: We Pretend
4689360.short_description: A PS1-style psychological horror game about a student pulled into a surreal hub of locked doors and broken memories, where each step deeper reveals the town’s buried secrets and the truth behind what everyone chose to ignore.

4689440.title: Happy Endings
4689440.short_description: Run an adult pixel-art massage parlor in a tycoon-arcade sim. Hire and customize hostesses, serve clients through pressure-point mini-games, unlock adult scenes, upgrade rooms, manage heat and raids, and grow your backroom business into the city’s hottest parlor.

4689590.title: Allure Rush
4689590.short_description: Allure Rush is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where you lead a rebellion across branching paths, resolve story encounters, and fight for control of the board as you march toward the throne of the Crimson Monarch.

4689610.title: F.R.E.D.'s Ascent
4689610.short_description: A 2.5D rage platformer. Nine zones, each with its own physics — ice, wind, sticky floors, low gravity. You are F.R.E.D., a small machine kept asleep beneath a world that never wanted you to wake. Climb anyway. Wanderer, No-Save, and Speedrun modes.

4689630.title: Once Upon The Universe
4689630.short_description: Once Upon The Universe is a god-game that takes you to the VERY beginning of creation. You begin the game just seconds after the big bang, with nothing but an empty space and a lot of super hot hydrogen in the entire universe. Fill the universe with life and watch it thrive - or destory it.

4689640.title: The Blade
4689640.short_description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

4689930.title: Spin Cycle
4689930.short_description: A roguelite strategy game where you keep the books for the criminal underworld. Take contracts from cartels and sanctioned regimes, route money through 20+ jurisdictions, play the market of sanctioned coins. And don't poke Interpol.

4689950.title: Cluster Burst VR
4689950.short_description: Break incoming cube clusters across multiple lanes in fast, reactive VR shooter.

4689960.title: CarSim Racing
4689960.short_description: CarSim Racing is a racing game where you start from the very bottom with regular cars and work your way up to supercars, competing against the best racers!The game features more than 45 cars across different classes. Each vehicle is unique and has its own strengths and weaknesses.

4690000.title: Shatter of the Egos: Voldor
4690000.short_description: An atmospheric action-adventure where you play as Soryn, seeking ancient relics, battling corrupted egos, and uncovering the myth of Voldor.

4690130.title: Forge Flow
4690130.short_description: Forge weapons through a fast-paced clicker loop and build momentum as you upgrade your speed and progression.

4690270.title: Arena 2006
4690270.short_description: Sci-fi shooter inspired by the golden '06 era. Forget the waiting queues, microtransactions, 60gb patches. We're here to frag.

4690280.title: Social Space
4690280.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play, Early Access
4690280.short_description: Social Space is the ultimate sandbox for creating and playing together. Party up with friends from all around the world to chat, hang out, explore player-created spaces, or build something new and amazing to share with the community!

4690300.title: Slave Princess Elnea
4690300.short_description: In this RPG, play as Elnea, a former princess turned slave, as she climbs her way back to the top in pursuit of revenge! Earn money by either humiliating yourself in front of the Empire’s citizens or fighting your way through dungeons. Will you be able to preserve your dignity until the end?

4690380.title: Memoware
4690380.short_description: MEMOWARE! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle game where you must record the history of civilizations that vanished without a trace in a mountain with no name. Collect all the MEMORIES and organize them in each book of each civilization in chronological order.

4690430.title: Sprig
4690430.short_description: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

4690580.title: Astral Industrial Complex
4690580.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

4690620.title: Most Scuffed Golf
4690620.short_description: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

4690740.title: The Flowership
4690740.short_description: The world has fallen to their beliefs. To reach The Flowership is what you desire, to reach The Flowership is what we all desire. It's your time. Explore various places, solve puzzles, and keep yourself standing. Don't let anything get in the way, don't let anyone get in the way.

4691080.title: Zyntaris
4691080.short_description: A roguelike survival game with co-op mode. Tear through thousands of enemies solo or with a friend. Unlock new heroes with unique abilities. Collect rare weapons and magical tomes, combine them, and discover insane synergies!

4691090.title: INKOCHET: Paint The Walls With Your Arrows!
4691090.short_description: A free-to-play retro first-person puzzle game. Shoot arrows that ricochet up to 4 times in order to paint every wall! Solo or 2-player co-op. solo dev btw

4691240.title: Bowl Big
4691240.short_description: Bowl Big is an incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Unlock upgrades, add more pins, power up your pins, and watch them all topple.

4691400.title: Performance Review: Survivor
4691400.short_description: Clock in, fight for 30 years, retire maybe? In this office-themed 2.5D roguelite, fight with office supplies against waves of coworkers and the horrors of capitalism. May your job search be short and 401K plentiful.

4691530.title: Keyboard Warrior Stickman - Typing Beat Em Up
4691530.short_description: Stickman Typing Beat Em Up meets Devil May Cry, set to the nostalgic 2000s era of internet culture, animations, hardware, and operation systems.

4691710.title: Don't Feed the Boss!
4691710.short_description: Welcome to the Emotional Compliance Division. Dodge document flows and manage task interruptions. Regulate your emotional output across seven intense workdays. Every reaction is monitored. Your performance is your future.

4691830.title: SPELLFALL
4691830.short_description: SPELLFALL is a dark fantasy action rougelike where you play as a wizard set out to kill an evil witch who is plaguing the land with her newfound ability to harvest magic from the moon. Fight your way through various areas and vile creatures to reach the top of her looming castle.

4691990.title: a weird game about sausage
4691990.short_description: This is a clicker game about a sausage.

4692030.title: Maggot
4692030.short_description: Maggots is a pixel desktop ecosystem game that monitors CPU, GPU, memory, and temperature. Your computer’s state affects the maggots’ speed, breeding, death, and mutations. The higher the load and heat, the more dangerous the infestation becomes.

4692130.title: KyouKi
4692130.short_description: This is a terrifying first person escape game. Players take on the role of Mio's brother and attend her birthday party. But something strange happened ..

4692280.title: Eclipse Crown
4692280.short_description: Eclipse Crown is a fantasy multiplayer Roguelike where every run is an epic battle. Hire unique heroes, equip them with powerfull skills and unique items, combine classes and uncover powerful combos to create an ultimate team. Discovere your own build to defeat your opponents.

4692360.title: Hero Company
4692360.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4692360.short_description: Run a hero recruitment agency! Question suspicious applicants, catch the liars, and hire only the real deal — before your gold runs out.

4692510.title: 火龙传奇
4692510.genre: Casual, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4692510.short_description: Fire Dragon Legend is a casual strategy match game with a cartoon art style. On the colorful block battlefield, fend off the approaching dragons through precise matching, and embark on a relaxing, stress-relieving yet strategic dragon-slaying journey.

4692640.title: Point Shooter
4692640.short_description: Point Shooter is a fast arcade shooter where you collect points, fight off enemies, and try to survive as the pressure ramps up. Play solo or host a lobby with friends through Steam.

4692720.title: Gridwalker
4692720.short_description: Gridwalker is a 3D isometric open-world puzzle game. Explore a mysterious island of ancient ruins. Communicate with the world. Solve puzzles, rescue trapped spirits, and awaken the pillar stones to uncover secrets and find your way out.

4692820.title: THE HOUSEMAID'S SECRET AFFAIRS -DESTINY IN THE CARDS-
4692820.short_description: Spend a humid summer in a private room with Akiho, a devoted housekeeper. Control [Trust] and [Heat] through strategic card selection to close the distance between your hearts. Your tactics and luck will unlock a secret relationship.

4692870.title: ZArmory
4692870.short_description: You won't pull the trigger. You'll make sure it never jams. Arm the last remnants of humanity against endless zombie hordes. From the "safety" of your workshop.

4692890.title: Fury of the Axe
4692890.short_description: A brutal action RPG where rage is your only weapon. Fight through a cursed world, break your enemies, and unleash the fury within.

4692920.title: The Mouth must Eat
4692920.short_description: You are not the hunter. You are the food. Survive the night in this co-op survival horror where feeding the monster is your only chance to stay alive.

4693000.title: 降雪的日子
4693000.short_description: 2011年，世界在下雪。我们站在无法前进亦无法后退的雪原上。 明天就会是世界末日，关于所有不寻常的叙事与抒情，面对结局与奇观化，一个关于我们的过错，我们的自我与他人的故事。

4693010.title: CRYPTSHOOTER
4693010.short_description: A horror roguelike FPS where you descend through 20 procedurally generated levels of a desecrated crypt, fighting biomechanical monsters, choosing weapons and perks between each wave, and dying over and over while an omniscient narrator watches.

4693030.title: Congratulations On Your Purchase
4693030.short_description: The most expensive game on Steam. A palace, a red carpet, paparazzi, and a wall where you leave your name — visible to every owner who comes after you. Ten minutes. The price is not a mistake. It is the point.

4693070.title: DELETERS
4693070.short_description: beep-bop-bib -- Objective defended the Core from endless waves of enemy's, level-up, collect resources and data, to improve, research and upgrade your chance of survivability...

4693140.title: Rebirth: Denied Protocol
4693140.short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

4693190.title: Revenge & Defend
4693190.short_description: A boy's village was burned. His people were killed. Years later, he returns — with an army of monsters. But the king he hunts is nothing like his father. He is just. He is loved. He will not fall without a fight. Two campaigns. One tragedy.

4693400.title: Universal
4693400.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
