4693400.short_description: Universals is a first-person narrative game exploring synesthesia. Play a deep-sea researcher who forms a neural bond with a lost siphonophore, descending through chapters that translate mirror-touch, chromesthesia, and number-form synesthesia into poetic puzzles.

4693460.title: The Dreams in the Peacock House
4693460.short_description: Wake up from a never-ending slumber and find your lost dreams in the shadows of the Peacock House.

4693540.title: The Last Tale
4693540.short_description: Embark on an odyssey through Northern realms in this 2D couch co-op adventure. Play as siblings Torsten and Annika, using gifts from the gods to avenge your village and hunt the mysterious Ivar. Combine axe, bow, and magic to overcome mythological beasts and puzzles to save the world from darkness.

4693550.title: Дорога Жизни
4693550.short_description: A narrative-driven truck driver simulator set within a historically reconstructed World War II setting, taking place on the route across Lake Ladoga (“Road of Life”) during the Siege of Leningrad.

4693570.title: Earned Today
4693570.short_description: Want to see your earnings tick up every second? Want to feel the rush of money rapidly stacking up on screen? Earned Today brings it to life! Keep your piggy company, earn Carrot Tokens, and collect more piggy styles~

4693590.title: Magical Ascent
4693590.short_description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

4693600.title: Please Act Normal
4693600.short_description: "Please Act Normal" is a live-action comedy about the agonizing pressure of social etiquette. Navigate awkward dinners and tense meetings through frequent dialogue choices, or embrace chaos and use your "Secret Weapon". Will they yell, laugh or just stare in pity? There’s only one way to find out.

4693780.title: Trouble in Our Skies
4693780.short_description: Lammy is a mechanical caregiver bot that has been long dormant but is suddenly revived admist the chaotic remnants of the once-greatest city in the sky. He must now take up the task of finding out the source of such far-reaching destruction and fixing it.

4693790.title: Survive The Apocalypse
4693790.short_description: Turn-based roguelite. Make your way out of this ruined city. Eat well and sleep well.

4693800.title: Knock Again
4693800.short_description: This is not a normal clicker. It’s a psychological horror game where mechanical progress hides something dark, twisted, and unsettling. Knock on the door to earn money, upgrade your abilities, and keep knocking. It all seems simple… until it isn’t.

4693930.title: Dragons Die
4693930.short_description: Permadeath strategy about a flight of named dragons, a small dragon named Peggs who minds the eggs, and the long table that remembers everyone who didn't come home. Every dragon falls. Their names stay carved. Their bones arm the next flight. Hunt the reach. Carry them home.

4694100.title: SwarmFall
4694100.short_description: Top-down co-op shooter powered by explosive EDM/Metal beats. Survive endless hordes solo or with up to 4 friends online. Intense roguelite action where every drop shakes the arena. LET'S GO SWARM!

4694270.title: Backrooms: Code Yellow
4694270.short_description: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the Backrooms with your fellow employees.  Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

4694350.title: Nightmare Fishing Tournament
4694350.genre: Action, Adventure, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play
4694350.short_description: A fishing sim with a HORRIFYING twist!. It's not enough to simply HOOK a fish, players must ENTER THE WATER and take them on using WEAPONS like spearguns and floating mines! Once a fish is STUNNED, it must be REELED IN before it RECOVERS! Upgrade your ITEMS and use scales to CRAFT PERKS!

4694380.title: Today Tomorrow and the Next
4694380.short_description: A simple game about using a crane to crushing scrap metal into cubes to make money. Use the money to buy upgrades like crane speed and scrap value.

4694390.title: Crazy Bird Hunt
4694390.short_description: Crazy Bird Hunt is a fast-paced incremental arcade game inspired by the Moorhuhn games of the 2000s. Hunt birds, collect materials and medals, unlock weapons, and invest in permanent upgrades through a skill tree.

4694460.title: Shady Business
4694460.short_description: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

4694580.title: Reel Bad Fishing
4694580.short_description: Catch the legendary fish: use machines, a gun, or scratch off tickets. Upgrade abilities, collect items, and defeat beasts across the sea in this absurd incremental adventure game!

4694610.title: ScreenCade
4694610.short_description: Turn your wallpaper into a living neon arcade. Watch smart AI master high-energy originals like Void Ball while you work, or jump in and take control at any time. Active play, idle vibes, and global leaderboards—all running seamlessly behind your desktop icons.

4694670.title: But Why Together
4694670.short_description: Play solo or with up to 8 players in a chaotic penguin parkour adventure where every obstacle makes you ask: But Why? Run through crazy courses, dodge giant snowballs, avoid collapsing platforms, and sabotage your friends in a short multiplayer platformer full of laughter and rivalry.

4694690.title: Haunted Lakes of Austin
4694690.short_description: Explore the real Haunted Lakes of Austin, boat and fish for hidden treasures, and survive the darkness in this eerie adventure where every cast could awaken something beneath the surface. BOAT, FISH, SURVIVE

4694770.title: HELLBENT
4694770.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4694770.short_description: HELLBENT is a souls like inspired game where you play as a knight of the Heavenly Order tasked with defeating a lord of hell who resides in purgatory.

4695010.title: Deskwaters
4695010.short_description: Fishing companion that sits on your taskbar while you work. Bites come every few minutes - react with a single click, fill an illustrated journal of saltwater reef fish, watch your catches drift in a personal aquarium.

4695200.title: Wordrix
4695200.short_description: Crack hidden words using letter clues, play daily challenges, and progress through a campaign of short mission phrases across multiple difficulty levels.

4695220.title: Against The Godds
4695220.short_description: Death has vanished, and nothing can die. Lead a party, battle the Godds, and forge your fate in this turn-based rogue-lite where every move is decided by the roll of the dice.

4695500.title: Hello Mayor
4695500.short_description: As the new mayor, tackle poverty and industrial decline in this city-building sim. Use policy-making, investment, and capital management to revitalize your city. Ensure your people thrive and lead your metropolis to new heights!

4695960.title: Jurassic Genesis: We Are Aliens
4695960.short_description: Your planet exploded. Your escape pod crash-landed 65 million years ago. You — and one other survivor — are the first humans on Earth. JURASSIC GENESIS is co-op prehistoric survival where dinosaurs hunt by day, the night is colder than space, and every footprint you leave becomes history.

4696040.title: Always Summer Out Here
4696040.short_description: Always Summer Out Here is a visual novel about life in a small post-soviet town with management elements. Atmospheric locations, soulful dialogues, non-linear questlines, and tough decisions that shape the game world await you. Welcome to the Province!

4696080.title: No More Demon
4696080.short_description: Fight relentlessly in a fast-paced FPS roguelite against relentless yokai hordes. Choose your elite anime heroines, unlock powerful weapons, craft unique builds, and descend into the deepest realms to face the Yokai Lord.

4696190.title: 江湖藏锋
4696190.short_description: Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based RPG about party building, skill choices, and dangerous expeditions. Explore mysterious realms, manage supplies, learn techniques from different sects, and forge your own hidden path through the jianghu.

4696210.title: Five Nights at Bowl City High School
4696210.short_description: You've just been hired at Bowl City High School, but its not what it seems... Use your flashlight to light up the office and look for lurking teachers, locate hiding spots to survive, and block off vents to stop them from getting into your office. Most importantly, however, you must stop Mr. Gut...

4696270.title: HITLER Fart HENTAI Lust
4696270.short_description: This lust fueled RPG story begins with an encounter with Hitler, he plans to take over a peaceful town using his new breeding program, to stop him you'll need to attract farting, furry and futa characters among others while unlocking erotic, adult scenes along the way! Can you achieve them all?

4696440.title: Bloomtide
4696440.short_description: A 9×9 board × roguelike deckbuilder × explosive multipliers. Reshape your pool with daily 3-picks. Chain symbol combos through an event queue, and push your build until the numbers break. From the 12-rent campaign to endless score-attack — see how far one good build can go.

4696540.title: Working95
4696540.short_description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

4696610.title: The Ministry for Anomaly Observation
4696610.short_description: A retro anomaly observation game where a government ministry tasks you with monitoring CCTV feeds and identifying anomalies to construct case files. Missed anomalies corrupt the shift and its case file evidence.

4696680.title: Skillful Pixel Dungeon
4696680.short_description: A roguelike RPG refined over 10 years with nearly 1M mobile downloads. Choose from 4 unique classes, explore procedural dungeons, and defeat epic bosses. Every run is different.

4696710.title: Combo Carnage
4696710.short_description: A fast-paced 2000s style arcade brawler where you chain combos, earn cash, unlock weapons, and dominate the leaderboard, featuring aggressive, over the top, no filter dialogue. (Contains strong language and mature themes)

4696740.title: Body Kounts
4696740.short_description: Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death. Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

4696780.title: Hentai Akira
4696780.short_description: Hentai Akira is a fast-paced puzzle game where you follow a determined sprinter on her путь to victory. Complete memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, as the intensity and rewards grow with each level.

4696880.title: Idle Defense
4696880.short_description: Endless cubes. Seven colors, seven currencies. Click to crush or build auto-turrets. Upgrades, prestige system, perks, and boss waves. Neon minimalism. Endless progression.

4696920.title: Bumper & Thumper
4696920.short_description: A chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, collect scrap to level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses, and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

4697030.title: CoreShot
4697030.short_description: CoreShot is a classic arcade style space shooter, where you pilot the spacecraft HonestWing to destroy the cores of evil. As you soar through enemy spacecraft, psychic pyramids, and grim castles, you will be tested against enemies with a variety of attack styles and epic boss battles. Blast away

4697120.title: Hearts in Open Water
4697120.short_description: Hearts in Open Water is an adult romance visual novel set aboard a 55-meter superyacht during a high-pressure Mediterranean charter season. As Captain Reeve, choose one of three romance routes and discover what a season-ending decision really costs.

4697140.title: Galaxiwilds
4697140.short_description: Explore a collapsing multiverse, make first contact with 75 alien civilizations, and uncover the truth behind reality’s unraveling—one discovery at a time.

4697150.title: Tiny Kingdom Siege
4697150.short_description: Medieval vs Machines is an incremental tower defense auto-battler where you build a medieval army to defend your castle against endless machine hordes from another dimension. Recruit warriors, lancers, archers and monsters, unlock skill trees and watch massive battles grow into chaotic.

4697170.title: Memo R.I.P.
4697170.short_description: First‑person psychological horror card game with 900+ handcrafted horror events, real‑time voice multiplayer, a final boss, and progression aboard a cursed spaceship.

4697190.title: 断光のウルバスティア
4697190.short_description: 断光のウルバスティアはシミュレーションRPGです。隣国や無法者との戦いを描いたダークな世界観のファンタジー、総勢35人の個性豊かな仲間と共に困難を切り開いていきます。

4697320.title: Veilbreak
4697320.short_description: A story-driven dark fantasy JRPG with strategic turn-based combat and character progression. Explore a fractured world, seal deadly rifts, battle otherworldly creatures, and uncover why something beyond the Veil is hunting you.

4697430.title: Bench Simulator
4697430.short_description: You are a park bench. Watch strangers sit, talk, break down, fall in love, argue, and reveal their secrets in a story-rich narrative simulation where your smallest reactions can change everything.

4697570.title: Backrooms: Case Violet
4697570.short_description: Investigate the disappearance of Violet Blackthorne as a detective trapped in the endless Backrooms—survive, gather resources, and uncover clues while evading deadly entities.

4697700.title: Battlefield Rats
4697700.short_description: Medieval co-op looter simulator for 1-4 players with horror elements. Scavenge fallen warriors on battlefields, manage greed versus fear, avoid patrols and unexpected dangers, sell your loot and upgrade gear. Play with friends and discover who'll abandon their buddy first for a golden chain.

4698010.title: Soul Clicker
4698010.short_description: If you like to torture yourself by clicking a button for small rewards and have hours to sink from not touching grass then this game is perfect for you.

4699620.title: The Cypress Family : Surprise Gift
4699620.short_description: Embark on a surreal journey to find answers hidden within a broken home. Explore shifting realities in this low-poly horror game where the truth is the ultimate price. A meta-horror experience that knows its player.

4699660.title: Penguin Runner
4699660.short_description: Dodge icebergs, unlock penguins and beat the leaderboard in this addictive arctic endless runner!

4699670.title: Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game
4699670.short_description: Rrrr! The wonderful world Of Nooks and Nonsense is launching with PIRATES! Just past the seven seas is another less popular and more strange sea. Pirate hovels, mermaids, volcanoes and a whole lot of hidden objects in this hand drawn world. Come and prove your finding abilities. See you at sea.

4699710.title: Fearia Clicker
4699710.short_description: Fearia Clicker is a unique take on the horror genre. You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact that is being used to power an army of monsters and entities, all while fending them off in combat. Please read the "About This Game" section for more detailed info :)

4699730.title: Fluff Up
4699730.short_description: 《Fluff Up》 is a charming yet challenging game where you control a chubby little bird flapping through a fantastical sea of clouds. Master your speed, manage your stamina, and ride the clouds to reach the highest skies.

4699760.title: String Mace
4699760.short_description: Smash through swarms of enemies by swinging a huge spiked ball on a string! Build absurd combos, crush towering bosses, and chase the highest score you can reach!

4699880.title: Gnorlbeam
4699880.short_description: An on-rail shooter where you control an alien saucer, which effectiveness depends on your score. Be good alien, destroy bad aliens. Gnorlbeam your way to world domination!

4699890.title: 7 DEADLY DEMONS
4699890.short_description: An incremental roguelite where you slay hordes of demons to level up. Click to collect powerful loot, develop your skills, master spells and attacks to test your true power! Are you capable of defeating the demon lords?

4699950.title: Crowned Games
4699950.short_description: A party game collection for groups of 2–8. Six wildly different minigames, one shared lobby. Bring your own images, audio, and quizzes — or just jump in and play.

4699980.title: Flesh Buddy Research
4699980.short_description: Perform research upon a strange flesh homunculus by stabbing, shooting, exploding, and sometimes feeding it.

4665110.title: Birdbrain Bash
4665110.genre: Action, Casual, Sports, Free To Play
4665110.short_description: A chaotic 2v2 bird party game where beach volleyball takes flight! Gather your friends to master the court with a colorful cast of birds, each boasting unique abilities and specialized stats. Every bird brings its own flavor to the flock!

4665150.title: Lettuce Fish
4665150.short_description: Fish for vegetables by controlling the hook itself, while trying to get as deep as possible for greater rewards.

4665830.title: Frog Up!
4665830.short_description: A retro pixel arcade-style collection game for those who appreciate FROGS! Complete your Frog Log by clicking on the frogs hopping across the screen; unlock different habitat ecosystems with their own unique kinds of frogs & rarities; and get those sweet, sweet Frogbucks!

4665880.title: Hell Is Other People
4665880.short_description: A psychological horror adventure game about social anxiety.

4665920.title: Mad Merchant
4665920.short_description: Build, arm, and command a merchant train across a hostile wasteland. Choose your routes, trade for profit, upgrade your wagons, and survive deadly ambushes on the rails.

4666010.title: Coredump
4666010.short_description: A bullet hell where the game windows come to life. Explore the digital world within the windows!

4666180.title: Obscurium
4666180.short_description: A tactical roguelite deckbuilder inspired by dark Brazilian folklore, featuring ritual card battles, risky sacrifices, evolving builds, and legendary creatures shaped by myth and nightmare.

4666290.title: Cursed Soulless Vagabonds
4666290.short_description: Master a dark fantasy rogue-incremental game. Steer your character through massive enemy hordes while your chosen build of floating swords fights for you autonomously. Survive intense, short runs without active skills or healing potions. Die often, keep your loot, and unlock permanent upgrades.

4666380.title: Corrupt Knight
4666380.short_description: Corrupt Knight is a game that combines a deep story with hardcore gameplay, where you can acquire up to 10 abilities, loot equipment from enemies, lose your abilities upon respawning to rebuild them, but retain your earned equipment, allowing you to return stronger every time.

4666430.title: The old house
4666430.short_description: A journey through Gravewood's woods reveals a small town's secrets. A spontaneous vacation, new friends, and a horror-detective story reminiscent of classic PS1 games. Fear grows slowly but is constant.

4666440.title: Crounds
4666440.short_description: Crounds is a online PvP chess rougelike where you draft game breaking upgrades to create devastating combos and disrupt your opponents plans. After key points in the game players take turns to pick upgrades that define their strategy.

4666520.title: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
4666520.short_description: A cozy fishing adventure sim where you can finally just... fish. No farms. No mines. No monsters. Just you, your boat, your lures and the lake. Learn the water, cast your line, set the hook, fight the fish, and lose yourself in the most relaxing lake you've never visited. It's time to go fishing...

4666660.title: POPIRORAI
4666660.short_description: POPIRORAI is a bizarre puzzle adventure in which you must decipher texts written in a mysterious language and overcome obstacles as you set out to discover what has happened in this minimalist 1-bit world. Find the light, Roppi...

4666670.title: A Yellow Nut
4666670.short_description: “Yellow Nut” is an individual living with a mental disorder; it embodies the "puppet" persona of short-video platforms. Perhaps, at times, it serves merely to encourage us to step outside and explore—precisely because it can no longer do so itself.

4666750.title: Lang Ops: Corrupted Files
4666750.short_description: Malicious virus attacked your PC which contained all your files! During the recovering process, file code showed as letters in different languages. Therefore, you've created special forces of cursors to counter the corrupted files!

4666770.title: Showdown of Luck
4666770.short_description: This is a PvP auto-battler game that blends deck-building with slot machine mechanics. Players purchase cards and symbols to assemble their own game machine and battle, with the core lying in the clever combination of cards and symbols. Spin fate, build victory!

4666960.title: desol
4666960.short_description: Cross an ominous desert as a lone traveler searching for a mythical Sea you have only seen in dreams. Gather water, follow fragmented clues, and learn the patterns of colossal Cube Monoliths that reshape the sands. There are no quest markers or checklists. Only your curiosity can guide the journey.

4666970.title: SCI±FL
4666970.short_description: Beat the simulator, beat the game. Test your combat abilities against an alien projector and buy items and upgrades to help on the way through its different floors.

4667170.title: Heart Duels
4667170.short_description: Heart Duels is a tactical card battler with RPG elements and deep lore. Three unique factions. Three unique playthroughs. Every NPC has a card. Win ranked duels against NPCs to unlock cards, character stories, quests, world lore. Over 80 NPCs, over 120 cards. All cards unlocked for multiplayer.

4667180.title: Bounce and Love: Cupid's Puzzle
4667180.short_description: Play as Cupid in a relaxing physics puzzle game. Aim your bow, calculate the perfect angle, and ricochet arrows off clouds and obstacles to strike people's hearts. Restore love in a decaying world, enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art, and unlock classic poetry with every perfect shot.

4667250.title: Mycelium Conquest
4667250.short_description: A deep automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

4667260.title: Prison Queen
4667260.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

4667300.title: Left Hand Magic
4667300.short_description: In a world where all the Dungeons have been conquered and monsters civilized, a down-on-her-luck mage finds herself recruited by Left Hand Solutions. A company that prides itself on finding positive ways to used 'Dark' magics. From Blood Magic to Necromancy, they believe every magic has its place!

4667340.title: Rome City Builder
4667340.short_description: Build your Roman city. Gather resources, build structures, train soldiers and defend against Barbarians at night. How many days can your civilization last?

4667450.title: Backrooms: Savior
4667450.short_description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

4667460.title: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
4667460.short_description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

4667570.title: Bouncy Ball
4667570.short_description: Your goal: hit the red button with the ball! Each click teleports the ball across the screen, jumping between all four corners. Time your clicks, control the movement, and land every shot.

4668010.title: Full Belly Breakout
4668010.short_description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

4668670.title: 探偵Rと預言者J
4668670.short_description: Gather evidence and uncover the truth through your interactions with others in this mystery adventure game about a case where past and present collide.

4668740.title: Lustflame Bonsai
4668740.short_description: Lustflame Bonsai is a game that blends sandbox exploration, relationship simulation, and narrative storytelling. Players must carefully balance various elements: the stamina costs of gathering resources, the seasonal cycles of farming, the drop rates within mysterious dungeons

4668820.title: Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue
4668820.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4668820.short_description: Zbuduj i prowadź własny sklep hobbystyczny w tej pierwszoosobowej symulacji zarządzania sklepem. Zamawiaj towar, uzupełniaj półki, ustalaj ceny, łącz zestawy z farbami dzięki systemowi Hobby Basket i pozwól klientom ożywiać swoje projekty przy stołach montażowych.

4669030.title: Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness
4669030.short_description: In Rusted Hills: Welcome to the Wilderness, survival is the only rule. After economic collapse and civil war, America has become a hostile wilderness. Scavenge, build, explore, and prepare. Any night could be your last.

4669130.title: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
4669130.short_description: Build a wildly different mage every run in a fast-paced action roguelite. Combine spell schools, loot, boons, items, and risky challenges to survive endless enemy waves, defeat bosses, and push your most broken build as far as it can go.

4669260.title: Cold Engine
4669260.short_description: Operate a corporate train through a world of endless cold. Choose your routes, deliver mysterious cargo, upgrade your train, and make hard decisions to survive the storms, meet the quota, and chase the next promise that the system will let you go.

4669460.title: Rolling Front
4669460.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4669460.short_description: A real-time strategy game about building your kingdom of rolling balls and destroying the enemies.

4669610.title: Rogue Quest
4669610.short_description: Play poker hands to deal damage. A Pair chips, a Flush crushes, a Royal Flush ends fights. Build a deck across 5 classes, stack 88 power cards, and ascend a cursed spire where every run reshuffles the odds.

4669800.title: miniquest
4669800.short_description: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

4670050.title: Going All In
4670050.short_description: Cheat the cheaters in a corrupt city where illegal gambling rules the streets and every game is rigged. After having lost everything, it's time to turn your luck around. Uncover their tricks, exploit the games and gamble your way to the top.

4672140.title: WinBolo
4672140.genre: Action, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4672140.short_description: A multiplayer top-down tank game for up to 16 players. Capture bases and pillboxes, harvest trees, build roads and walls, lay mines, and battle for control of the island. The Macintosh classic, rebuilt for modern platforms — free, open source, and cross-platform across desktop, mobile, and web.

4672200.title: 捉迷藏 - Hide and Seek
4672200.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4672200.short_description: 长泽小学的一年级女生结奈，和青梅竹马的好朋友真也约好了一起玩捉迷藏。但是，最近他们的身边似乎出现了可疑的人物，街道的氛围也变得紧张了起来。即便如此，今天放学后也要去公园玩捉迷藏哦……

4672340.title: Ink & Void
4672340.short_description: A storybook tower defense where stationery knights fight the Void. Deploy pencil swordsmen, fountain pen mages, and eraser monks across four chapters. Evolve units via class changes and build your deck with cards earned each stage. Languages: Japanese / English / Chinese

4672380.title: H-Virus: Succubus Outbreak
4672380.short_description: H-Virus: Succubus Outbreak is a third-person shooter where you fight off infected succubi. As one of the last humans left, you are forced into hunting across decaying environments. Fight through relentless waves of succubi and survive the nightmare that has claimed the rest of humanity.

4672510.title: PlayIndex
4672510.short_description: PlayIndex is a casual idle trading game where video games become the market. Buy low, sell high, track player count trends, and compete on the global leaderboard as game values rise and fall every 10 minutes.

4672630.title: Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot
4672630.short_description: A strategy game that blends side-scrolling defense, deckbuilding, and light roguelite progression. Choose from different playable characters, deploy buildings, traps, and tactical cards against zombie hordes attacking from multiple entrances, hold your ground, and push ever deeper underground.

4672680.title: After School: Days Gone By
4672680.short_description: After School: Days Gone By is a collectible battle game about childhood corner-store duels. Challenge friends with marbles, round cards, and spinning tops; collect rare toys, build decks, customize tops, and relive the noisy fun of after-school play with light roguelite progression.

4672750.title: Final Rites
4672750.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

4672860.title: Donut Smash
4672860.short_description: Donut Smash is a fast, simple, and absurdly hungry arcade game where you feed a cat with donuts, avoid suspicious vegetables, and chase the highest score possible. Tap fast, don’t miss, and never trust broccoli.

4673040.title: Week of the MEP
4673040.short_description: A tiny, fan-made visual novel featuring Pavolia Reine. Experience a working week filled with unexpected encounters and humor behind the peafowl persona.

4673070.title: LUCREA: LABAN
4673070.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4673070.short_description: Stranded on an unknown island with no way home and no one coming to help. Team up, each bringing unique abilities to the fight, coordinate with your squad, and work together to find a way off — if you're ready for what you'll uncover along the way.

4673080.title: Sloperator Inc.
4673080.short_description: Welcome to Neo-Uryupinsk - there is no exit, only the update. In a world where corporations replaced nations and AI replaced conscience, you are Gleb, making life-or-death decisions while reality begins to fracture. A psychological cyberpunk visual novel where truth collapses.

4673370.title: Interzone
4673370.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

4673420.title: Chickens. Chickens? Chickens!
4673420.short_description: 🐓 Fight ridiculous chicken hordes in a fast, casual arena shooter. 🐓 Move, dodge, shoot, survive waves, chase a better score, and try not to get buried in feathers.

4673450.title: Hitchhiking to Hell
4673450.short_description: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.

4673460.title: Cursor.exe
4673460.short_description: Navigate a living system that lies, shifts, and fights back as you race to complete its objectives. Activate nodes, deliver signals, and adapt as it begins to learn you.

4674130.title: The Lakeview Orb 2: Consequences
4674130.short_description: A linear first‑person psychological horror game focused on completing objectives, exploring environments, and progressing through visual cutscenes as you play as Dr. Jim in the next chapter of the Lakeview Orb story.

4674560.title: Immunity Protocol
4674560.short_description: Pilot an immune-cell sentinel in a neon pixel-art horde-survival auto-shooter. Move manually, auto-fire evolving weapons, draft upgrades, equip symbiotes, and survive escalating pathogen swarms inside a collapsing biotech system.

4674750.title: Hellpurge
4674750.short_description: Hold your ground against the demons of Hell and bring down their evil overlords, in this 2D action survivors-like.

4674800.title: Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales Prologue
4674800.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4674800.short_description: In this free prologue to Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales, build a life from scratch in the heart of nature. Cultivate the land, manage resources, help the valley residents, and write the first pages of a world full of mysteries. Your farming legend starts here!

4674900.title: Koshary Chaos
4674900.short_description: Run a koshary cart on the most chaotic street in Egypt. Manage orders, survive junkies, bribe gorillas, and pray Unc Friday doesn't find you.

4674920.title: The Server
4674920.short_description: A FULLY ENGLISH-VOICED otome mystery visual novel set in a fog-shrouded coastal town. Work as a waitress at an exclusive supper club, romance four men hiding dangerous secrets, and uncover the truth buried beneath. Every choice you make shapes your path and where it ends.

4674940.title: Armored Mayhem
4674940.short_description: Vehicular PvP combat with mid-match build crafting. Start with nothing, collect randomized weapons and upgrades, and adapt your vehicle.

4674970.title: Cheese Stack
4674970.short_description: Cheese Stack -  is a cozy puzzle game where you arrange falling pieces of cheese into perfect rows. Simple rules, delicious graphics, upbeat music, and a highscore table you'll be tempted to beat. It's the perfect way to relax for 5 minutes or lose yourself in the game for an hour.

4675030.title: Gal Sumo
4675030.short_description: A group of high school girls dedicate their youth to women’s sumo. Their intense battles are brought to life through tabletop sumo in this competitive action game. Simple controls, deep mind games. Includes Arcade, Local, and Online Versus modes.

4675040.title: Kemonauts Planet
4675040.short_description: Recruit anyone you meet—every NPC can become your companion. Kemonauts Planet is an old-school dungeon RPG across a vast star ocean. Travel dungeon-like space routes, face danger, and find unique weapons in a procedurally generated universe.

4675130.title: surfass
4675130.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Free To Play
4675130.short_description: surfass is a speedrunning parkour game that goes really fast! Let your legs burn, they are the price of speed. Master the slide jump and climb the leaderboard!

4675180.title: Mid Evil Nights
4675180.short_description: Mid Evil Nights is a dark medieval survival game where you gather resources, craft gear, build shelter, and defend yourself from creatures that emerge after sunset. Explore, prepare, and survive the dangers of each night.

4675210.title: Train of Thought
4675210.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: survive

4675230.title: MUGI
4675230.short_description: *MUGI*, released in May 2026 as an MSX2-exclusive cartridge, is now on Steam. An action-puzzle game with mystery-solving elements. The PC version adds arranged BGM, a ranking system with name entry, a tutorial, and a stage editor for creating and sharing custom stages.
developers: 反動のゲームちゃんねる
publishers: 反動のゲームちゃんねる

4675260.title: Cinematic Business
4675260.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4675260.short_description: Manage a movie studio in a deep film industry simulation. Hire talent, greenlight productions, shape marketing campaigns, chase awards, and fight for box office success as you build your reputation in the competitive world of cinema.

4675330.title: Soothe
4675330.short_description: You awaken at the bottom of a rusted pit, another forgotten machine amongst a pile of those who came before. On your right, an extendable grappling claw, and on your left, a melted screen. You are given only one goal - reach the light above.

4675410.title: Volcano Watch
4675410.short_description: Build a scientific station on a remote volcanic island. Fund it through research, farming, or off-the-book channels. Then survive the eruptions: helicopter evacuations, lava flows to hold back, decisions made under pressure. The volcano always comes back.

4675590.title: BOBA
4675590.short_description: Boba is a co-op FPS horror game. Journey through multiple floors, stopping at each one to route power back to the Elevator of Life in order to continue your journey. The floors are always changing so you never know what to expect. Be very careful! Those who ride the Elevator have never returned...

4675640.title: Sellsword
4675640.short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

4675840.title: Deep Frost
4675840.short_description: A singleplayer social-deduction roguelike. Twelve named researchers, nine days, the Thaw is wearing some of their faces. Read faces, plant clues, survive the blood test. No multiplayer. No microtransactions. No cheaters. Just you, twelve liars, and the helicopter.

4675850.title: Crownborne
4675850.short_description: A fully English-voiced action-romance visual novel. Pulled from the modern world into a kingdom at war, wield an ancient power, romance four heroines, and steer branching battles where every choice you make reshapes alliances, fights, and which ending you reach.

4676350.title: Aschente
4676350.short_description: Shape how your magic moves, splits, chains, and explodes across the battlefield in firework-like bursts of chaos!

4676380.title: Grind 'Em All
4676380.short_description: Grind 'em all! Experience the ultimate satisfaction of shredding monsters and growing stronger in this intense incremental game.

4676420.title: Galaxy Scavengers
4676420.short_description: Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge the stars in a resource-management sim focused on base building and survival. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to thrive in a hostile galaxy. Fortify your temporary base and secure your haul for a clean escape before it’s too late.

4676620.title: Astra Nauta
4676620.short_description: An incremental colony sim set on a generation starship. Scavenge the stars and recycle everything possible to survive the end of the universe.

4676670.title: Challenge 99
4676670.short_description: A highly challenging game made for platformer enthusiasts.

4676750.title: Tap Dungeon
4676750.short_description: Pixel-art isekai roguelike dungeon crawler! 5 classes, mix skills & items freely in turn-based combat across deadly random dungeons. Fight goblins, orcs, undead; collect artifacts, beat hidden bosses. Death = rebirth, endless builds await. Become the hero saving the kingdom!

4680720.title: STARSHIP BLOOPERS
4680720.short_description: STARSHIP BLOOPERS is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?

4680890.title: May There Bee Flowers
4680890.short_description: Balance light and water in May There Bee Flower, a strategic roguelike deckbuilder. Build unique decks, enchant cards, and collect trinkets to reach full bloom. Dodge vicious weather attacks or sacrifice your health to protect your garden. Will you survive the storm?

4681380.title: B.L.U.E.
4681380.genre: Indie, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4681380.short_description: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is an multiplayer PVP space sandbox engineering simulator. As an BlueHeaven Aerospace Engineer, you design spaceships that follows real world physics, load it with maximum fire power, and test it against your best friends. Note: mind the heat!

4681560.title: Leadville
4681560.short_description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outthink and outmaneuver their rivals.

4681870.title: Heliodawn
4681870.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4681870.short_description: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.

4682150.title: Crafty Marbles
4682150.short_description: Craft the most epic marble runs you can imagine! Use tons of interactive gadgets or create your own. Then choose your marbles and watch them race!

4682450.title: Dungeons of Desolation Remastered
4682450.short_description: Descend beneath the rain-soaked town of Desolation in a remastered loot-driven dungeon crawler from the Xbox Live Indie Games era. Fight monsters, gather gear, master skills, survive the Wheel of Fate, and uncover the dark secret behind a town built on adventurer dreams.

4682670.title: HELIOBIOTIC
4682670.short_description: Explore the floating islands of a ruined alien world, unearthing the secrets of its lost civilization in a fast-paced time loop.

4682760.title: Silk Home: echoes of the forbidden
4682760.short_description: SILK HOME: ECHOES OF THE FORBIDDEN is a surreal puzzle blending Chinese alchemy with horror. Audit Yan Song's shattered mind, weave cursed silk on bone looms, and sync pulse resonance under the Emperor's gaze. Collect memory cubes to break the Ming cycle or embrace a painful awakening.

4682910.title: Hide or Seek: Container Island
4682910.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4682910.short_description: Hide or Seek: Container Island is COOP, PVP or solo game where you can hide as a cat or seek as a dog. While hiding, you have to hide through multiple areas in Container Island using magic potions from Dhugs, while evading creatures. While seeking, you have to capture all cats.

4682990.title: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
4682990.short_description: A dark-fantasy archaeological puzzle game with Roguelite elements. Play as a silent archaeologist delving into the depths of a forgotten civilization. Master "Rune Resonance" to clear ancient stones stacked upon the Rune Altar while intercepting the shifting Guardian Echoes that obscure your path.

4683050.title: The Order Of The Damned
4683050.short_description: THE ORDER OF THE DAMNED is a story-driven 2D action-RPG set in a grimdark Arthurian world. As one of the last knights of a fallen order, battle through the decaying land in a brutal quest to uncover the mystery of the Spectre that haunts you and destroy the ancient darkness of The Revenant.

4683260.title: Project Rabbit
4683260.short_description: Reimagining Alice in Wonderland as an East-meets-West dark fantasy enriched by a proven Webtoon IP, it builds a unique universe for global audiences.

4683520.title: Late Ming: County Magistrate Simulation & Management
4683520.short_description: Late Ming: Magistrate Simulation and Management is a county-building sim set in the chaotic late Ming Dynasty. Rule as a magistrate, rebuild your border town, raise troops, gather intelligence, explore underground treasures, and expand your power across overseas islands amid endless chaos.

4683530.title: BRAVO
4683530.short_description: A 20‑minute playable thriller that will blow your mind.

4683710.title: 空匣子 Empty Box
4683710.short_description: Empty Box is a 2D narrative choice game set in a city of humans and beastfolk. As a poor unemployed journalist, you accept an invitation from a hyena to start an investigation. Like Reigns, your binary choices affect four stats. Keep balance to uncover the hidden truth and the real culprit.

4683940.title: Cafe Connect
4683940.short_description: Repair, build, and upgrade customers' PCs to make your dream of owning your own internet café come true.

4684040.title: Space Fetus Attack Idle Clicker
4684040.short_description: Click, automate, and scale your damage in a ridiculous idle clicker. Capture space fetuses, defeat bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades. Numbers will spiral out of control.

4684770.title: Averi the Accursed
4684770.short_description: Shunned outsider Averi becomes her small planet's last hope against the tyrannical Lord Kroff and Lady Psonos in this action-packed 2D pixel art platformer.

4685050.title: Sharkarama
4685050.short_description: Buy sharks, raise them, and sell them for profit, or take control of any shark to hunt fish yourself. Collect 150+ real-world species from dwarf lanternsharks to great whites. Spot rare albinos.

4685060.title: Crown & Applause
4685060.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4685060.short_description: Crown & Applause is a narrative rhythm game about a royal jester whose performances stir a kingdom ruled by silence. Dance through grand spectacles, face a restless crowd, and shape what remains when the final curtain falls.

4685070.title: Far Mining
4685070.short_description: Far Mining is a short and relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Mine resources, upgrade your ship, unlock new tools, and find your way out of deep space.

4685110.title: Dies Irae:  tactical puzzle
4685110.short_description: Dies Irae Tactical Puzzle is a grid-based tactical roguelite where every move changes the board. Create chain merges and matches, evolve pieces, manage resources, and survive the enemy advance while unlocking islands, biomes, and unique abilities.

4685150.title: The Farthest Islands
4685150.short_description: Become a settler arriving in an archipelago on the edge of civilization. Life here is harsh and dangerous. But great rewards await the brave and the lucky! You have only a small ship at your command and the determination to find your place in this new world. Ready to set sail?

4685210.title: ROCKS.EXE
4685210.genre: Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4685210.short_description: ROCKS.EXE is a dark terminal-style idle market simulator where you mint resources, enter exposure, resolve global events, earn timed Steam inventory drops every 3 hours, and collect marketable items through cases and fixed-odds rewards.

4685310.title: Chrongrid
4685310.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4685310.short_description: Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative experience. Inside an author's story blueprint, you make your own choices and the world responds in its own way — every choice echoes, no two journeys alike. Built-in blueprints are the start; play others' stories or write your own, in any language.

4685380.title: Portucale Sword and Subtlety
4685380.genre: Casual, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4685380.short_description: Portucale is a strategic card-battler set in a brutal new kingdom. Build prestige, fortify borders, and weaponize treachery with the unique Cheat mechanic. In this tense psychological duel, your walls generate gold while you dismantle your rival’s legacy through sword and subtlety.

4685400.title: Operation Paranoia
4685400.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

4685570.title: GOLIATH
4685570.short_description: Twin-stick boss-rush bullet-hell with an emphasis on arcade-style scoring. Blast away Titans and dodge exciting attack patterns, all the while improving and upgrading your character. Compete with friends online for the high score, or grab a buddy and fight together in couch co-op.

4685790.title: Hentai Nectar
4685790.short_description: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Nectar, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

4685830.title: Cozy Finds
4685830.short_description: Settle in and unwind with a cozy 3D spot-the-difference game. Rotate, zoom, and explore the charming miniature office as you search for every small change. No stress — just careful observation, good music, and satisfying discoveries.

4685870.title: MAGOSTOP
4685870.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Korean-style card games. Will you choose GO to multiply your score, or STOP before greed ruins everything? Acquire Benefits, transform your cards, and push for an even higher GO!

4685880.title: LOOP: NEW REALITY
4685880.short_description: Play as Maya, a beta tester trapped inside a broken VR simulation. Manifest items to navigate hidden digital layers, purge anomalies, and escape the terrifying Warden. Manage battery life and corruption, search your virtual desktop for clues, uncover the secret truth, and shatter the endless L00P!

4685890.title: Echoes of Creation: Origin
4685890.genre: Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4685890.short_description: An open-world 3D action RPG with real-time combat, class advancement, and loot-driven progression.

4686000.title: Swish Ball Clicker
4686000.short_description: A cute, pixel-art cozy basketball idler that every click is a swish. Automate your shots, upgrade your players, and go from being rookie to an ALL-STAR in this relaxing 2D indie baller. Perfect game to keep open in the background while you work.

4686110.title: Agents 404
4686110.short_description: Agents 404 is a physics-based co-op stealth comedy set in an absurd parody world. As incompetent assassins, infiltrate guarded locations, use goofy disguises, and hide bodies. Work together to eliminate caricatured villains, or watch your clumsy teamwork end in hilarious chaos!

4686230.title: 大侠博士
4686230.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4686230.short_description: Dr. Hero is a story-driven RPG seamlessly blending Eastern Wuxia with hardcore medical science. Playing as a surgeon transported into the human body's microscopic universe, you will recruit diverse allies and cure the Divine Emperor's five intractable diseases.

4686240.title: Death`s Revenge
4686240.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4686240.short_description: A 3D survival roguelike with retro PSX visuals. Fight endless hordes, evolve 20 weapons through the Ascension system, sign Ancient Pacts at the Shrine and craft unique builds. Every run is a new death and a new chance to survive.

4686280.title: ROGUETRIP
4686280.short_description: Synthwave driving roguelike. Race NYC to California through 12 states and 7 biomes. Collect 140 items, discover 40 synergies, outrun cops and bosses. 8 unique cars, daily challenges, 33 mutators. Every run is a new road trip.

4686290.title: Encoria!: A Circus Game
4686290.short_description: Step right up! into the role of a newly appointed ringmaster to orchestrate a circus, forge meaningful relationships with your backstage crew, and uncover secrets as you progress. Based on a true story.

4686320.title: Žolík
4686320.short_description: Classic Central European card game brought to Steam. Build melds, race to empty your hand, and outscore your friends. 2–4 players over Steam, or solo against AI bots. Three rule presets, custom rules, full Slovak + English.

4686390.title: Redemption: The Sin Eternal
4686390.short_description: Redemption: The Sin Eternal is a supernatural horror action-adventure game where a priest returns to a haunted orphanage filled with demonic forces, missing children, disturbing secrets. Featuring split-screen co-op, and first- or third-person gameplay.

4687800.title: AirDrive
4687800.short_description: Defend the last stronghold on a ravaged Earth against relentless enemies. Take control of your fighter jet with your whole body and face the overwhelming waves of foes. AirDrive is a defense motion-action roguelite featuring endless dogfights, diverse parts, and webcam-based motion controls.

4687860.title: Guns & Dragons
4687860.short_description: Dragons? Magic? Who cares? Fight with overwhelming firepower in this co-op FPS roguelite. Fight, choose, grow stronger. Science vs. magic. Fight enemies in dungeons, pick runes and artifacts to craft your own build, use materials to expand your base, develop deadlier weapons, and take down dragons.

4687900.title: My New Car
4687900.short_description: Have You Even Been Blackmailed? A psychological horror game centered around a young woman named Lilas, who sets out with her friends to pick up a new car—only to reveal a ploy to question her humanity- a trap. A game.

4688100.title: We Are Lost II
4688100.short_description: We Are Lost II is an Erotic Visual Novel and a sequel to We Are Lost. Proceed from the story of the first game and find out what happened to get our heroes in this situation. You will be able to import your choices from the first game for a true continuation of your story!

4688420.title: Cableman
4688420.short_description: Move to the rhythm of the world, find your way through the levels and don't let the spark catch up to you in this rhythm puzzle game.

4688470.title: Donlan Men's Athletic Academy: Before the Line
4688470.short_description: Set in a private MMA academy, the story follows a disciplined, restrained trainee and an unpredictable rival as they clash through training, combat drills, and late-night tension, until their rivalry gradually becomes something else.

4688570.title: Bound By A Curse
4688570.short_description: A two-player asymmetric horror game where one player explores a dangerous environment while the other guides them from a control room. A curse causes you to swap positions throughout the game at random times, letting you experience both roles and creating chaotic moments.

4689160.title: Fruit Snake Arena
4689160.short_description: A fruit-fueled action snake game for solo or local two-player play. Grow longer, dash-bite through enemies, fight chapter bosses, enter portals, and spend earned points on skins, tools, and extra lives.

4689210.title: Pro Kick Online
4689210.short_description: Pro Kick Online is a fast-paced online soccer game focused on skill, teamwork, and competitive multiplayer action. It offers realistic ball physics, fluid gameplay, and intense matches where every touch matters.

4689350.title: Iron Dogs
4689350.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1930's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

4689420.title: Hachishakusama | 八尺様がいた夏休み
4689420.short_description: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

4689980.title: ParaDive++
4689980.short_description: ParaDive++ is an incremental first person shooter where you dive into a surreal dimension, defeat it's strange inhabitants, and cash in your collected "Psychomatter" (and Prestige Tokens) to upgrade your astral vessel and keep up with the ever growing hordes.

4690030.title: Weaper
4690030.short_description: Be the last standing against Halloween's monsters and each other in this social spooky shooter game. Team up with others or go solo as you brave the woods, haunted house, and other creepy locations perfect for having fun, getting scared, and shooting at friends.

4690210.title: Snowday Co
4690210.short_description: Start with just a shovel and build your snow plowing business across an open-world town. Take on jobs, expand your territory, and keep up with whatever the winter throws at you.

4690240.title: Cozy Country
4690240.short_description: Cozy Country is a world-builder where you shape a living island landscape of forests, rivers, and buildings, then step inside and explore everything you've created ❤️

4690880.title: Brand of Betrayal
4690880.short_description: In this NTR RPG, play as Rein on a mission to defeat the Demon King. With your wife and two childhood friends, fight enemies, explore, and grow stronger as you unlock steamy events. Power comes at a cost though, and you will not be the one to pay it. How far will your team go to achieve its goal?

4691130.title: Sultan's Decree
4691130.short_description: A card-based strategy game across 623 years of Ottoman history. Swipe to decree, balance four powerful factions, and guide 36 real sultans from the dynasty's founding in 1299 to the birth of the Turkish Republic in 1922. Every choice reshapes history.

4691370.title: AI Agent Lover
4691370.short_description: A terminal-style desktop game: manual approval calls on streaming logs, traps to dodge, streaks to chase. About ten scenes per /start. Optional log-only display windows (up to 16) for passive multi-monitor desks. Single-player. Japanese and English UI. Core play works offline.

4691430.title: The Punchbag Machine
4691430.short_description: Pixel-neon rhythm roguelite. Notes fall, punch to the beat, six strike directions, 27 machines. Collect punch cards, stack artifacts, hold the combo — miss the score target and the run is over.

4691650.title: Hell Girl
4691650.short_description: Fight through zombie-infested dungeons in this fast-paced third-person shooter combining intense combat and puzzle-solving.

4691890.title: Unlander
4691890.short_description: Unlander is a survival video game where you explore the never-ending world of the banished. From hunger to monsters, everything is set to kill you. Uniquely, every action must be played with dices. As you progress, you will find upgrades and you’ll craft stronger items to defeat the nightmares.

4692400.title: Minefront
4692400.short_description: A tactical online 1v1 duel inspired by Minesweeper. Place mines, clear your opponent’s board, and compete in fast matches where every second counts.

4692590.title: Veles: Rise of the Damned
4692590.short_description: A dark fantasy action roguelite where you battle endless hordes, forge powerful builds, and survive against overwhelming odds in a world inspired by Slavic mythology.

4692780.title: Little Master
4692780.short_description: Little Master is a top‑down action RPG blended with challenging puzzles. Pick up your sword, bow or a magic staff, and embark on the mission to uncover the seven keys.

4693210.title: Hyper Glee Semik
4693210.short_description: Hyper Glee Semik is a first-person shooter where you play as Glee, a teenage girl who has to survive a horde of candies. Keep the pace, and shoot them all!

4693530.title: HyperSurge
4693530.short_description: Become an unstoppable force of destruction as you climb an endless tower of darkness. HyperSurge is a fast-paced boomer shooter roguelite with retro graphics, insane power-up synergies, and an evolving arsenal of weapons.

4693580.title: Shelf Shock
4693580.short_description: Shelf Shock is a first-person puzzle game taking place in a wacky warehouse. Follow clues, place items, make trickshots, and dodge lasers as you stock the shelves within the time limit.

4693700.title: The Infinite Library
4693700.short_description: Build the realm's greatest library one word at a time. Choose genres, discover rare Words, craft Phrases, and fill shelves until reality buckles under the weight of knowledge. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers. A narrative incremental game where the UI tells the story.

4693720.title: BlackColled Madala Force 2
4693720.short_description: BlackColled MF2 brings Fictional WW3 Scenario to gamers with 10 maps and dozens of operators. Play with bots or other players through many locations across the world and unlock different operators from various fractions.

4693740.title: Sexy Furries: Mythic
4693740.short_description: You arrive on an island where no man has set foot in years. Long ago, all furry men left for war... and none ever returned. Now, only the girls remain. In Sexy Furries: Mythic, you’ll meet three unique types of furry girls: dragon girls, feline predators, and winged beauties.

4694290.title: Ultra Dungeon, Retro Game Virtual Console
4694290.short_description: A pixel art auto-battler dungeon crawler inspired by the Game Boy era. Build your team, choose their skills and equipment, and climb floor by floor through a dangerous dungeon filled with monsters. Plan your strategy carefully and let your heroes fight automatically as they grow stronger.

4694420.title: Octogun - Idle
4694420.short_description: Octogun takes on the trope of arena shooters with an idle twist. While wielding 8 weapons simultaneously you defend yourself against waves and waves of enemies coming for your gold. Farm money, upgrade weapons, level up and defeat your enemies in style.

4696380.title: My Shut-In Demon!
4696380.short_description: My Shut-In Demon! is an 18+ visual novel, where you help a shut-in demon girl slowly overcome her social anxiety! This is a wholesome, lighthearted game, with plenty of comedy and emotional moments!

4696530.title: KRYONULL
4696530.short_description: Kryonull is a branching sci-fi visual novel about a landing on Europa, a fragile link to Earth, and a first contact that may begin with silence.

4696630.title: Hi-Lo: Card Roguelike
4696630.short_description: A cozy roguelike deckbuilder where every card flip is a bet. Predict if the next card is Higher, Lower, or Equal, stack jokers, build score combos, survive story-driven events. One deck. Endless decisions. Will you bet it all?

4696950.title: The Sphere
4696950.short_description: A grieving mechanic. A sphere that fell from the sky. A mystery that was never meant to be found. The Sphere is a short, atmospheric point & click adventure about loss, wonder, and the unknown.

4697060.title: Gobballing
4697060.short_description: Become the hero no one saw coming! Play as a ambitious goblin who dreams of glory and smashes his way through monsters using nothing but his trusty rock!

4697290.title: Penguin Rescue Run
4697290.short_description: A 3D platformer where you guide a penguin through obstacles, platforming challenges, and creative puzzles while exploring different environments filled with danger, precision jumps, and exciting challenges along the way.

4697420.title: SwordRequiem Crack
4697420.short_description: This is a Roguelike type chess game.Here, you will continuously defeat enemies to acquire skills, equipment, and other materials to continuously strengthen your allies, and use skills and tactics in a reasonable combination to defeat the tide of enemies. Experience the joy of free cultivation.

4697890.title: Ways Unknown
4697890.short_description: Surf the dunes of a strange desert, discover secrets hidden in plain sight, and unravel the story behind the sudden disappearance of your boyfriend in this surreal, open world mystery.

4698100.title: Super Duper Siege
4698100.short_description: Build, defend, and upgrade your kingdom in Super Duper Siege! A tower defense roguelike where you must survive an endless onslaught from the forces of darkness.

4698120.title: FAST FOOD FUNKIN'
4698120.short_description: Have some beats with yo' mickey dee double-cheese. A high-caloric FRIDAY NIGHT FUNKIN' parody game made for the annual Flash Forward Jam on Newgrounds

4698200.title: SoulBound - Lys Fragments
4698200.short_description: A souls-like cooperative boss rush for 1 to 4 players. Pick from 5 classes, master MMO-inspired raid mechanics.

4698230.title: Bean There, Jumped That
4698230.short_description: Hop in. Figure it out. Jump everything. Small bean. Big jumps. Go right. Or up. Or… wherever that sign says. Precision platforming with a bounce.

4698340.title: The Incident
4698340.short_description: The Incident is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a closed circus, destroy evidence before investigators arrive, and avoid someone still inside watching your every move.

4698350.title: Haggle Saga
4698350.short_description: Haggle Saga – a shop management sim where haggling becomes card bluffing. Suits and ranks fuel psychological warfare: will the customer give in, or flip the table? You never know.

4698410.title: Heirs of the Moon
4698410.short_description: A survival adventure about playing as a wolf. Heirs of the Moon features a perma-death system, pack management, and emergent gameplay. Will your legacy go on?

4698530.title: Mortumn Quest - Homecoming
4698530.short_description: Mortum Quest is a horror puzzle game. It includes ghost stories, local beliefs, and Thai folk rituals. The game is 2D point and click style. Give it a try if you want to experience Southeast Asian horror.

4698660.title: I Chew, Therefore I Am
4698660.short_description: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

4698680.title: Femboy : Rescue Mission
4698680.short_description: Femboy: Rescue Mission follows a team of lifeguards balancing high-stakes rescues with a blooming romance. Watch the shores and follow your heart as duty turns into a deep seaside love story. Can you handle the heat of the beach and the thrill of new love?

4698700.title: Deep Space Observatory
4698700.short_description: An atmospheric short incremental game about deep space exploration. Gather scientific data, upgrade your observatory, and collect all the discoveries!

4698780.title: Voidline
4698780.short_description: Survive relentless machine swarms in the collapsing Voidline. Loot upgrades, evolve your ship, and stack game-breaking builds as each run grows faster, harder, and more chaotic. Unlock new ships and become unstoppable.

4698870.title: King's Skirmish
4698870.short_description: A turn-based chess battler where every capture becomes a tactical duel. Use unique piece abilities, reposition your own pieces, play against bots, challenge friends locally, or progress through Story Mode.

4698960.title: Hentai Police Girl
4698960.short_description: Hentai Police Girl is a seductive puzzle game where you complete levels to unlock revealing illustrations of a confident police officer.

4698970.title: Batsy
4698970.short_description: Batsy is a 2D-physics-based platformer, where you play as a bat, called Batsy, who's trying to find his lost pillow. Batsy has had trouble sleeping lately and he can't do it without the comfort of his pillow. Help Batsy find his pillow so he can return to his peaceful slumber.

4699010.title: Anatolian Horror Stories : Curse In Bayramdere
4699010.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4699010.short_description: Anatolian Horror Stories:Curse in Bayramdere is a third-person survival horror game that puts you in the shoes of an ordinary young woman facing an unknown evil.No special skills.Just the desperate need to find out what happened to the people she loves and the will to survive long enough to do it.

4699020.title: INTUS
4699020.short_description: Rent an apartment to finish your work and survive a night that grows increasingly strange. A first-person psychological horror game where routine, silence, and paranoia turn an ordinary place into somewhere impossible to leave.

4699060.title: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame
4699060.short_description: WW2 turn-based aircraft war game that puts you in the USAAF/USAF, RAF or Luftwaffe air operations HQs. Build your squadrons, wings, air bases & pilots. Engage in bombing missions, dogfights & interceptions over Britain, N. Africa & Europe. Historical & what-if fighter/bomber airplane game scenarios

4699110.title: Crococo
4699110.short_description: An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York. Go down there… and see for yourself.

4699180.title: Chime of Y
4699180.short_description: 《Chime of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过把握攻防转换的时机、调整战斗节奏并推进角色成长，在连贯而富有节拍感的单人流程中体验以时机决策为核心的回合制玩法。

4699200.title: Server Farm Idle
4699200.short_description: When the numbers finally end, you’ll know how long it took. Build a server empire from one ratty laptop to the singularity in a finishable idle clicker.

4699220.title: Lone Lines: RPG
4699220.short_description: Control a living warrior on wheels in a procedural off-road RPG: fight, choose, uncover the hidden, and survive in the beautiful yet brutal Dead World.

4699250.title: Blood Being 2
4699250.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

4699320.title: Secret Base
4699320.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a boy traveling between a peaceful secret base and a home that slowly begins to change.

4699350.title: Clinical Waifu
4699350.short_description: Clinical Waifu is a sensual puzzle game where you select any two shuffled image blocks to swap them, solve growing grids, use hints, and unlock artwork.

4699430.title: The Birth Cry
4699430.short_description: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

4699480.title: Tenebrix
4699480.short_description: Descend into a living dungeon where hesitation empowers the darkness. Build your deck, command creatures across tactical lanes, and survive a roguelike descent shaped by fear, strategy, and the echoes of your past failures.

4699490.title: Invaders Loop
4699490.short_description: In Invaders Loop, which combines classic arcade spirit with roguelite mechanics, survive relentless waves of enemies raining down from the depths of space, dodge bullets, equip yourself with various items from the market, and defeat epic bosses.

4699600.title: Catawanna Mine Tours
4699600.short_description: Trapped deep in an abandoned mine, you are not alone. Explore the darkness, solve puzzles, and find a way out.

4699700.title: Desktop Reptiles
4699700.short_description: Desktop Reptiles is a cozy desktop idle reptile sim. Care for a leopard gecko, decorate and upgrade its enclosure, unlock gear and terrarium layouts, and let a quiet reptile habitat bring relaxing moments to your busy workday.

4699780.title: The Vlog
4699780.short_description: A first-person comedy horror adventure where you play as an aspiring livestreamer exploring a strange abandoned building while entertaining your viewers. Complete ridiculous chat challenges, solve puzzles, capture viral moments, and uncover the terrifying mystery hiding behind the stream.

4699850.title: Coffee & Fox
4699850.short_description: Manage your café, meet new friends, and serve unique drinks as new stories unfold every day in Coffee & Fox! Can you handle everything this place has to offer?

4699990.title: Inertia 2: Definitive Edition
4699990.short_description: From the creator of Inertia - a first-person movement platformer built on fluid, refined mechanics. Run, create, and compete in the definitive movement experience.

4700000.title: Pichhal Peri
4700000.short_description: A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room.

4700090.title: Eternal Fracture
4700090.short_description: In Eternal Fracture, you play as officer T. A grieving police officer that gets dispatched to the Bayou Mall in Louisiana to reset a known malfunctioning security system. What was supposed to be just another late-night routine sweep turns into dread. You are being watched.

4700180.title: LumenFall
4700180.short_description: A first‑person atmospheric stealth horror game about exploring an abandoned neighborhood, solving environmental puzzles, and surviving the presence created by the Engineer’s broken experiment.

4700250.title: Sisyphus's Worst Day (again)
4700250.short_description: Build traps, manipulate the environment, and engineer the perfect loop to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit in this comedic isometric 3D puzzle game.

4700260.title: Judgment: Ankara 01
4700260.short_description: Truth is a binding consequence. Can you escape the truth?

4700280.title: Ironfields
4700280.short_description: A single-player RTS where you capture existing structures instead of building a base from scratch, and success comes more from good decisions than fast reactions.

4700290.title: Under the Elm
4700290.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4700290.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's cabin and the woods she loved. Forage real mushrooms, brew the recipes she perfected, fill the field guide she left unfinished, and tend to the villagers she took care of for 40 years. A cozy game about coming home.

4700300.title: Copy Cats
4700300.short_description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

4700320.title: Rage Spin
4700320.short_description: My first game. For masochists, aliens with issues and speedrunners.

4700330.title: All 9 Lives
4700330.short_description: Trade your lives for POWER. Fight with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

4700340.title: Break Her Silence
4700340.short_description: Break Her Silence is an immersive 3D adult experience where you seduce devoted wives inside a luxurious mobile truck with a one-way mirror. Make them moan and reach explosive orgasms while their husbands watch their own reflection - until the moment of truth when the mirror turns transparent.

4700370.title: Worlda
4700370.short_description: Welcome to Worlda! Worlda is a 2D topdown pixel art sandbox adventure where you play as grizzly bear cub Jonas as he sets forth into a large, infinite world, starting with nothing but a special staff.

4700390.title: MUTS NO TYPO
4700390.short_description: Enter a dystopian typing contest where speed, accuracy, and obedience are measured. Type carefully. Continue when instructed. Pay attention. GLORY TO THE HAND THAT NEVER SHAKES.

4700420.title: SKEW
4700420.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

4700460.title: Arthur’s Tale
4700460.short_description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

4700520.title: Days Of Reckoning: Last Battle
4700520.short_description: A turn-based strategy where modern military forces face an unknown, unnatural enemy. Command elite units, manage morale, and survive in a world where the rules of war no longer apply.

4700550.title: Handwalk
4700550.short_description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

4700560.title: The Girl in the Window
4700560.short_description: You have been trapped in a scary house. Solve the puzzles to escape.

4700690.title: Red Door or Blue Door?
4700690.short_description: This is a psychological horror where for 14 days in a row you have to choose either a red door or a blue door. Make even one mistake - you die, and you have to start all over! Welcome to a terrifying puzzle with no room for error. And know this: someone is watching you.

4700720.title: In Game Leader
4700720.short_description: Become your teams In-Game Leader and lead your team of 5 agents to victory.

4700740.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
4700740.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4700740.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

4700790.title: Quadris
4700790.short_description: QUADRIS is a falling tetromino puzzler pulled in four directions at once. Guide the falling blocks through four rotating lanes, clear lines before the stacks reach the center, and switch columns fast enough to keep the core alive. This unhinged take on the genre will put your limits to the test!

4700820.title: Hentai World Nice
4700820.short_description: A simple yet addictive game that blends relaxation with mental challenge, pushing your focus and memory as you progress through increasingly complex levels.

4700830.title: Project Phoenix 涅槃计划
4700830.short_description: The apocalypse is here. Break it down. Build it up. Project Phoenix – a hardcore top-down zombie survival game. Establish your safehouse, stockpile resources, and uncover the truth behind the disaster.

4700910.title: Astrojumper
4700910.short_description: Astrojumper is a fast-paced hybrid shooter. Seamlessly jump between orbital fleet battles and ground assaults to reclaim human worlds from the Anunnaki and uncover their true purpose.

4700930.title: BLASFEMY
4700930.short_description: You are being hunted by an immortal deity with an infinitely long neck. The only way out is to beat the platformer handed to you by his "followers."

4700970.title: Fortuna
4700970.short_description: A roguelite deck-builder based on "Daifugo". If you can't play a card, you take damage: (Field Total) x (Multiplier). Use battle rewards to customize your deck and special cards in the shop. Strategize and upgrade to defeat even stronger enemies!

4701040.title: Arms Dealer Simulator
4701040.short_description: Buy, build, and distribute. I’m not pro-war, I’m pro-business. Procure weaponry, attachments, and ammunition. Expand your armory, fulfill contracts, and manage your own scalable logistics fleet. Your trade, your profit.

4701190.title: Poker Double or Nothing
4701190.short_description: Play Poker Double or Nothing, and double your credit by correctly guessing next card and the gambling phase. The game supports custom community-created graphics packs, including cards and wallpapers
