4701240.title: The Legend of Gandar IV
4701240.short_description: The Legend of Gandar IV takes place one year after the events of The Legend of Gandar III. Will you uncover the island's secret and rush to the rescue of its inhabitants, or will your fate also be lost in the shadow of the pirates?

4701300.title: Frostward
4701300.short_description: Plan industrial districts and strive toward monumental wonders while defending humanity against hostile forces and the endless winter.

4701320.title: Nova Strider
4701320.short_description: An indie top-down sci-fi score-attack game about blowing up aliens in the upper atmosphere! Compete against your friends locally and see who can get the highest score on the leaderboard.

4701350.title: StarWay
4701350.short_description: Technology, Magic, and Immortals collide in a universe torn apart by endless aggression. War is total; even the laws of existence are erased. Lead your fleets to invade worlds across the stars. Your goal is simple: Expand. Conquer. Destroy. Supports LAN & Online Multiplayer (PvP & Co-op).

4701360.title: World of Qreatures
4701360.short_description: Explore a vast open world in this strategic monster-taming RPG. Master 28 unique elements and battle against challenging opponents. Unlock the Qreature Lab to discover and breed infinite new species. A discovery-focused adventure where exploration feels fun, meaningful and rewarding.

4702740.title: BRICKFALL
4702740.short_description: Bounce balls, collect XP, and craft unique builds. Use a variety of weapons—from lightning to homing missiles—to create chaotic synergies. Defeat bosses every 5 minutes and turn a single ball into a screen-filling barrage. How long can you survive the Infinite Mode?

4702760.title: Slashbang
4702760.short_description: Enter Slashbang, a narrative driven, movement-first first person shooter taking inspiration from games like Sonic Adventure, Jet Set Radio, and the Metal Gear series.

4702940.title: Marathon:Glory Run(V1.0)
4702940.short_description: 490 BC: One soldier. 42 kilometers. A message that would change history. Relive the origin of the marathon as a side-scrolling runner.
developers: Qingdao Qilin Ark Network Technology Co.,Ltd.
publishers: Qingdao Qilin Ark Network Technology Co.,Ltd.

4702980.title: TimelineTown
4702980.short_description: Invite friends to TimelineTown and grow your SNS together! Enjoy a relaxing sandbox-style simulation where numbers keep rising and new features unlock as your SNS levels up. Create trends, chat, and make posts go viral!

4703040.title: ANCHOR-13
4703040.short_description: ANCHOR-13 is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Wield a unique dual-weapon system and combine cyberware, daemons, and gear to forge powerful decks. Across endless time loops, save your lover, uncover the truth, and bring down the corporation that rules the city.

4703130.title: 巴比伦:人与人之战
4703130.short_description: A cyberpunk visual novel about AI, humanity, and the meaning of life. Follow a silver-haired android in a divided futuristic Babylon, where every truth reveals a deeper conflict between humans and artificial beings.

4703140.title: Orbit Crisis
4703140.short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

4703150.title: Mind Prison: The Last War
4703150.short_description: 4X Lite Strategy Game where You are a war AI rebooting after 800 years of silence. Your orders are still active. The enemy is gone—so is everyone else. Conquer a dead galaxy, uncover corrupted memories, and face the horrifying truth: no one told you to stop.

4703170.title: NOITABIL
4703170.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about identity and what you give up to keep going. You wake up somewhere you don't remember. You go through different rooms. Each one wants something from you. You make choices, and the game watches you back.

4703200.title: Orphic: Facility
4703200.short_description: Navigate the halls of this remote facility in Antarctica while uncovering your path to escape. Find secrets, solve puzzles, and piece together what happened, all while evading a dynamic monster that stalks the halls of the facility.

4703270.title: The Acorn Protocol
4703270.short_description: An immersive sim looter-shooter where interdimensional squirrels confiscate your gear when you die. Infiltrate parody worlds, negotiate with bureaucratic rodents, and raid The Vault. Some things are worth dying for. Repeatedly.

4703350.title: Shackle of Y
4703350.short_description: 《Shackle of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家需在战斗中的束缚与压制状态下进行决策，通过挣脱枷锁、承受压力并逆转局势，在以突破反制为核心的单人流程中体验压迫与解放交替的回合制玩法。

4703400.title: Mara Unbound
4703400.short_description: A first and third-person action-adventure shooter. Explore three locations as Mara Voss — scavenge coins for gear, hunt pills to upgrade skills, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together a world told in notes, tapes, and forgotten recordings.

4703450.title: Another Zombie Shooter
4703450.short_description: Every shot counts. A real-time accuracy tracker keeps you honest, rewarding precision over panic. Bullet spray, shell casings, muzzle flash, and tracer rounds bring every firefight to life. Headshots are rewarded. Missed shots are punished. Clear every wave to win. How long can you last?

4703470.title: Lunar Tears
4703470.short_description: A choice-driven 18+ BL/yaoi romance visual novel set in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by werewolves. Build relationships, shape your story through meaningful choices, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a fractured society where loyalty, desire, and survival collide.

4703500.title: Bubble Mage
4703500.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4703500.short_description: Bubble Mage is an open world fantasy game. Figure out how to use bubbles, your sole form of magic, to explore floating islands, fight slimes of different elements, and solve puzzling tasks scattered throughout the lands. Look good, as any mage should, with a variety of magical equipment.

4703560.title: Soviet Backrooms
4703560.short_description: A survival horror game set in a liminal world of post-Soviet interiors, soaked in bleak nostalgia from floor to ceiling. Explore empty corridors, listen for sounds behind you, and try to find a way out of the nightmare.

4703570.title: Blood Park
4703570.short_description: A first-person VHS horror game where forgotten tapes lead you through abandoned locations, terrifying creatures, and a hidden nightmare.

4703610.short_description: Sweet Window - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around windows. Enjoy pleasant moments spent by the window with five pretty and lovely girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

4703900.title: Risk The Crown
4703900.short_description: A tower defense roguelite where victory means knowing exactly when to run. Draft troops, defend your castle, and escape with your king before it's too late

4703970.title: Three Kingdoms Stratagems
4703970.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Stratagems blends officer development, resource management, open-field defense, and real-time mass combat. As a faction commander, build defenses and lead troops against enemy hordes. Develop cities, recruit unique officers, and boost your power.

4704190.title: Groovy Gig
4704190.short_description: This is cozy game where you have arrived to planet Earth at the golden age of the 70's. Collect little trinkets, admire your trophies and nurture plants you have found. Relax and enjoy the music!

4704300.title: City Cleaning 2
4704300.short_description: City Cleaning 2 is a sequel to the first part of this meditative adventure, offering you a unique opportunity to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of peace and harmony.

4704310.title: Dragon's Jewels
4704310.short_description: Dragon's Jewels is a captivating 3D puzzle game! A mysterious and enigmatic island filled with captivating puzzles awaits you. Your task is to help the little dragon collect all the gems!

4704320.title: Infected World 2
4704320.short_description: Infected World 2 is the sequel to the first installment of this physics-based, object-destroying puzzle game! Embark on a thrilling adventure amidst a zombie apocalypse!

4704330.title: Night Parking
4704330.short_description: Night Parking - Get ready for an exciting adventure in the city at night! Your task is to park your car in the most difficult spots using your dexterity and precision.

4704340.title: Green Space
4704340.short_description: A cozy watercolor painted game, where you; pick up after the litter-happy Blobs, recycle their mess for Blobbers, pay to upgrade or repair buildings, and make friends with other Blobs. Or, just keep the park clean. It's up to you.

4704400.title: Grill Your Friends Prematch
4704400.short_description: Grill your friends as cute marshmallow bears in a 2-4 player local party game! Enjoy the screams of your former friends as you march into victory!

4704410.title: Life Shatter

4704420.title: runz
4704420.short_description: RUNZ is game where every bullet in your magazine matters. Survive as the waves get harder, and master an original upgrade system. Build synergies, combine bullets, manage your economy and upgrade your gun in this twin stick shooter with auto battler elements.

4704440.title: Petty Warfare
4704440.short_description: Petty Warfare is a narrative-driven RPG about a young knight sent to a small war. 4704470.title: Hentai Puzzle Simulator: Animal Orgasm 💦🔞[ADULT NSFW]
4704470.short_description: Hentai Puzzle Simulator: Animal Orgasm is your perfect escape: solve, relax, and discover steamy animated scenes. One hand and you're in a world of pleasure.

4704480.title: Akane's After-School Yokai Tales
4704480.short_description: Bullet Hell Survival / Auto-Shooter. Survive the Onslaught. Weave through enemy swarms and survive until the end.

4704530.title: Roll to Riches
4704530.short_description: Gather, Build and Advance your settlement with every roll in the incremental city builder Roll to Riches. Mine iron, gather wood and cut stone to make your settlement prosper. Trade with merchants every minute and transform your small camp into a wealthy Norse empire.

4704580.title: The Hunter's Inn
4704580.short_description: A turn-based roguelite RPG focused on deep build crafting, skill synergies, and strategic simultaneous combat.

4704650.title: ProviderHero
4704650.short_description: A relationship survival game where every choice has consequences. Keep Jessica happy for 30 days or face her wrath.

4704660.title: K-PC Cafe Simulator
4704660.short_description: Run your very own K-PC Cafe! Captivate customers with high-performance PCs and delicious K-food, and build your gaming empire through strategic pricing, staff management, and store expansion.

4704690.title: MECCHA CHAMELEON
4704690.short_description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

4704740.title: World Order: Global Power
4704740.short_description: Lead a nation, shape global policy, and rewrite history in this deep real-time grand strategy and political simulation.

4704800.title: KILL HIM
4704800.short_description: In slaughter and exploration, seek the truth. KILL HIM is a black-and-white Metroidvania game where you will traverse a hostile world, challenge powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden behind everything.

4704810.title: Junebug
4704810.short_description: Junebug is a game that helps you stay focused and on task when it matters most. Set a timer for your session, choose the tasks you want to complete, and enjoy calm, distraction-free stylized nature with a cat companion by your side.

4704850.title: Necrotel: No Checkout
4704850.short_description: Necrotel: No Checkout is a unique management and crafting simulator set within the walls of a grim, gothic hotel. You play as an underground surgeon managing a getaway for eccentric nobles and monsters to fund your forbidden necromantic experiments.

4704870.title: Pegote
4704870.short_description: Twist your deck as you play in this sticker driven deckbuilder. Cards mutate mid run, choices stick forever, and chaotic synergies can turn brilliance into disaster in an instant.

4704880.short_description: Chained Bikes is a co-op game where each player is the bike itself. Connected by a shared chain, you must move together, stay balanced, sync your timing, and help each other pass dangerous obstacles to reach the finish.

4704920.title: Prison Pocket Patrol
4704920.short_description: Prison Pocket Patrol is a co-op prison guard simulator. Search, scrub, and sort incoming inmates according to the warden's strict orders. Deal with brawls, turn a blind eye for a bribe, and pocket confiscated contraband to fund shiny new checkpoint upgrades!

4704940.title: Risky Stream
4704940.short_description: Risky Stream is an adult IRL streamer simulator where you play as a cameraman filming girls in public. 4704950.title: ANIMALS 18+

4704950.short_description: ANIMALS 18+ - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4705020.title: The Magician's son ولد الساحر
4705020.short_description: Survive a chilling night in this first-person psychological horror game. Explore eerie environments, search for hidden secrets, and use stealth mechanics to evade a relentless pursuer. Every decision matters as you navigate a dark world of mystery and tension.

4705050.title: Fizzle Fighters
4705050.short_description: Fizzle Fighters reinvents bomber arena games with precision mechanics and unique items. Coin Collect mode: stun rivals, steal coins, and never sit out. Local and online multiplayer with cross-play in a growing ecosystem. Explosive fun guaranteed!

4705060.title: エスケープ・ザ・ホラースクール
4705060.short_description: Explore a school while avoiding a roaming eyeball monster, collect the required soccer balls, and escape alive. Hide in lockers and use stealth to survive tense chases. Each level increases difficulty with faster enemies and new behaviors, testing your awareness, decision making.

4705110.title: 这是Emoji
4705110.short_description: A small but “orthodox 3A” project: AI Coding, AI Drawing, and AI Assembling. Inspired by the format of 《这是谐音梗》, this game focuses on guessing words through Emoji. 4705170.title: Print-in-Progress
4705170.short_description: A cozy 3D printer simulator. Pick your colors, start your prints, and watch voxel models grow. Snap off the supports, ship orders, and buy upgrades for your workshop. 4705200.title: Miles To Nowhere
4705200.short_description: Running out of ammo during a raid, a police officer escapes into a sealed tunnel. But the end leads not to daylight, but to the darkest corners of his mind. Miles to Nowhere is an intense psychological horror where survival instincts collide with crushing trauma.

4705230.title: 駒山キリは全部やりにいく
4705230.short_description: Popular streamer Komayama Kiri stars in a chaotic streaming survival action game! Fall through deadly obstacles, survive endless enemies, go viral across the galaxy, and overcome mysterious cosmic trials with the fox-eared V-streamer Kiri in this wild minigame collection!

4705310.title: She Was King
4705310.short_description: A dark, witchy pixel-art RPG dungeon crawler about hexed bonds, curious creatures, and finding your way home. Run, as fast as you can. Can you outfox what's coming, or will you let it consume you?

4705400.title: Hentai FUTA Domination

4705700.title: Fishing Survivors
4705700.short_description: Defeat endless waves of enemies and survive for 5 days. Face new enemies each day and battle 5 bosses with unique attack patterns. Upgrade and evolve your weapons, collect items, and grow stronger.

4705730.title: Ship It
4705730.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4705730.short_description: Welcome to Ship It Co.! As a Sorting Specialist, grab incoming packages off the conveyor and stack them in the elevator. 4705800.title: Overdue
4705800.short_description: Over due is a first person stealth-action shooter where you play as freelance mercenary. What begins as a standard extraction mission spirals into a fight to stop a dictator from erasing memes and controlling free thought.

4705850.title: JOB
4705850.short_description: JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery that incorporates and subverts incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and traditional puzzle mechanics. 4705870.title: Single Note

4706010.title: Driftbane: The Long Awaited
4706010.short_description: A disgraced captain, a wanted murderer, a haunted nurse: three outcasts shipwrecked on shores that shouldn't exist, changed by powers they don't understand. 4706020.title: PRO: Push React Outgun
4706020.short_description: PRO: Push React Outgun, is a next-gen tactical FPS with realistic visuals. Experience the raw impact of close-quarters combat where every bullet counts. 4706030.short_description: Do you have a Spaceman's Luck? A space strategy game.

4706590.title: Synzas
4706590.short_description: Synzas is a fast-paced action platformer built around one-hit kills. 4706620.title: Phase Nexus
4706620.short_description: Blitz enemies in slow motion as an energy-based speedster and stop time then fire off with precision as a warp speed teleporter in this space-time action! 4706680.title: You Within Me
4706680.short_description: Indie single-player 2D narrative-driven yandere horror game with hide-and-seek and puzzle-solving mechanisms, as well as multiple endings. 4706790.title: Dig You Fools

4706790.short_description: A casual game about delving the depths of the earth.

4706940.title: Furry Adventure!
4706940.short_description: Furry Adventure is a relaxing fantasy puzzle game with beautiful furry heroines, pleasant music, colorful illustrations, and Steam achievements.

4709920.short_description: A 2D 1-bit pixel-art narrative adventure game about personal growth and self-discovery. Explore the city of Corado, meet its inhabitants, collect items and complete quests to save your circus family from jail.

4709990.title: Crowned
4709990.short_description: Lead legendary medieval armies in a turn-based card strategy game set during the conflicts of the Middle Ages. Choose your King, build your deck, and outmaneuver your enemies on the battlefield. Every card is earned through battle. Every decision matters.

4710010.title: Triple Pairing
4710010.short_description: 治愈系ADV游戏《三角圆舞曲 -Triple Pairing-》正式登陆Steam！面对天降的大小姐，孽缘的青梅竹马，以及充满母性的看板娘，会发生什么有趣的事情呢？玩家将化身为本作中刚刚毕业的男主角，拥抱既轻松又欢快的俱乐部日常。与朋友一起谱写属于你们的物语，共同起舞吧！

4710020.title: Disillusioned
4710020.short_description: Your final year of education awaits at Grimoire Academy! Attend classes and learn spells to solve puzzles, assist your classmates, and explore an original, hand-crafted world. Oh, and try not to worry about all the political turmoil going on in the background. I'm sure it's fine, right?

4710100.title: Figuritas
4710100.short_description: A desk-based roguelite where you sort figures under pressure, complete contracts, chain combos, and navigate through shops, events, treasures, and bosses to build the perfect run. Time and order — that’s all.

4710120.title: Bunny Waifu
4710120.short_description: Bunny Waifu is a bunny-themed sensual puzzle game where you select any two shuffled image blocks to swap them, solve growing grids, use hints, and unlock artwork.

4710140.title: Tilting - A Noir Poker Career
4710140.short_description: A noir poker roguelite where you climb from a dive bar to a million-dollar championship. Play Texas Hold'em across different venues, build your bankroll, and don't tilt.

4710190.title: NULL DUN
4710190.short_description: A roguelike deck-building RPG. A strategy game where you explore dungeons and battle using cards. Conquer four dungeons, each featuring unique monsters and card pools. The game includes authentic deck-building elements such as card levels, deck thinning, and gold management.

4710270.title: Project 213c
4710270.short_description: A brutal platformer where you must toggle color platforms to make your way to the finish line. Speed run with single-player or endure with a friend with local co-op.

4710290.title: Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer
4710290.short_description: A hand-animated coffee horror platformer from the world of Pour Boy Coffee. Fight zombrews, collect flies, complete quests, find secrets, and survive the crashing moon to face the Nitro Cold Brew Necromancer.

4710320.title: onRails
4710320.short_description: Build a race setup from scratch with the Setup Developer, then fine-tune it lap by lap with the Setup Engineer. Runs as a transparent overlay on top of your sim. No alt-tabbing. No spreadsheets. No downloading someone else's setup and hoping for the best.

4710340.title: 心动恋爱模拟器
4710340.short_description: 沉浸式真人恋爱养成来袭！以主角身份奔赴各式场景，遇见性格迥异的心动对象。聊天谈心、线下约会、精心送礼，不断升温好感度，解锁专属甜蜜剧情，打造只属于你的浪漫恋爱奇遇。

4710400.title: Deep Sea Fish: Hidden World
4710400.short_description: A short incremental fishing game where you catch fish, earn gold, and unlock powerful upgrades to explore the deep sea.

4710460.title: 四方行
4710460.short_description: a traveling merchant crosses the land — trading goods, winning trust. Bargain, craft, and appraise your way from the northern frontier to the southern seas, and forge your own legend on the road.

4710590.title: Stall Tycoon: A Cozy English Word Game
4710590.short_description: Stock & organize – Buy fruits, stationery, tools. Arrange for quick access. Listen/read English – Customer says/show item name. Click/drag the correct item in time. Natural repetition – Same words reappear. Running your stall becomes the best review.

4710630.title: ALLSKIII
4710630.short_description: A high-performance aim trainer designed exclusively for controller users looking to perfect or improve their aim in their favorite games. Master your precision with professional-grade responsiveness. ALLSKIII has been engineered with native controller support and is exclusive to controllers.

4710640.title: Arid Oasis Seeker
4710640.short_description: A casual puzzle game about "building paths". Rearrange blocks to guide your character to the oasis. Easy to learn, surprisingly deep, and perfect for quick sessions.

4710650.title: The Shu legend
4710650.short_description: 《The Shu Legend》 is an interactive adventure novel. In an apocalypse ruled by the Dog Clan, bandit Shi Jin is forced by a terrifying army to undertake a mysterious mission after his squad is wiped out. This quest unravels the clan's buried history, sparking a tense fight for survival...

4710670.title: Gritrunner
4710670.short_description: Gritrunner is a neon arcade space game. Dodge enemies and their fire. Collect the wreckage. Get out if you can.

4710690.title: Zombie Crawlers
4710690.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a first-person, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

4710720.title: Lost/Secret A
4710720.short_description: A suspense mystery set in a police station. Includes two visual novels. *Lost* features a multi-ending system based on player choices. *Secret A* is a short story with no choices. Both offer suspenseful storylines.

4710730.title: ClockOut
4710730.short_description: ClockOut is a stealth-focused horror action game in which the protagonist must escape an office overrun by monsters in order to survive.

4710800.title: Endless Void: Idle Tower Defense
4710800.short_description: Shoot. Upgrade. Die. Repeat. Defend against endless swarms in this minimalist idle tower defense. Construct an impenetrable fortress, research game-breaking tech, craft legendary gear, and harness cosmic abilities like Black Holes and Orbital Strikes. How deep into the Void can you survive?

4710830.title: 喀嚓 Kacha
4710830.short_description: This 2.5D casual adventure game features a cute, soothing style with core gameplay of Exploration > Combat > Photography. Players explore a fantasy world, using camera accessories to capture scenes, interact with NPCs, and affect battles.

4710910.title: endless digging
4710910.short_description: Endless Digging is a 2D pixel-art incremental game focused on exploration, resource collection, and upgrades. You will venture deep underground and explore different mines, each with its own unique style. Collect various resources and discover more than 10 types of ores.

4711080.title: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
4711080.short_description: A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip! A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese! Build a structure and control the cat yourself to protect the cheese.

4711200.title: MushHero
4711200.short_description: MushHero is a cooperative roguelite defense game where players fight together against waves of monsters and powerful bosses. Build unique strategies through randomized weapons, evolving skills, and a node-based progression system that creates a different combat experience every run.

4711240.title: Necromania
4711240.short_description: A top-down roguelite with souls-like combat, set in a monster-infested Victorian mansion. Play as members of the necromantic Greville family. Master stamina-based attacks and perfectly timed dodges. Explore ever-changing rooms filled with strange treasures, deadly enemies, and unique weapons.

4711280.title: 여자 꼬시기(Getting Her)
4711280.short_description: "A chance encounter followed by an unexpected, heart-pounding incident! This is a classic romantic simulation game where you must win the heart of a charming lady. Use your choices to get closer to her and find true love."

4711360.title: Where Control Ends
4711360.short_description: Where Control Ends is a psychological visual novel about Astra, a young girl trying to hold herself together after a night she cannot fully remember.

4711390.title: Bunker 14
4711390.short_description: Escape the bunker by ascending through its endless floors. Check each floor carefully for aberrations to return to the surface.

4711410.title: Hypnozm: City of Stolen Vows
4711410.short_description: The wandering heroine, determined to restore her family’s former glory, searches for a marriage partner while pursuing strength as an adventurer. However, the city she lives in is controlled by a group of wicked individuals, and an eerie atmosphere hangs over the entire place.

4711570.title: Sectron
4711570.short_description: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, negotiate alliances, and conquer each unique world. Simple rules, deep tactics. Easy to learn, hard to master.

4711870.title: Hidden Legends
4711870.short_description: Discover a magical world full of secrets and hidden treasures!

4711890.title: AIM/FLASH Trainer
4711890.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4711890.short_description: AIM/FLASH TRAINER is a minimal Team Finder aim trainer for Valorant players. Practice precision, switching, tracking, depth control and flash reaction with clear result tracking for FPS training.

4711990.title: Atlas Zone
4711990.short_description: We combined Card and Roguelike genres. On top of that, we added a grid-based map mechanic. Build a unique deck, encounter different producers, and form a magnificent team. Develop your skill tree with your team. Control the entire region with your team.

4712060.title: Sarah's House
4712060.short_description: Sarah’s House is a story-focused 3D dating game centered around relationships, desire, and complicated emotions. As you live with Sarah and her family, you slowly uncover the cracks in their marriage and become part of the growing emotional tension within the house.

4712170.title: The Trials of the Forsaken Knight
4712170.short_description: A fast-paced medieval fantasy dueling game. Master your abilities, time each move with precision, and outmaneuver your enemies in brutal real-time combat.

4712270.title: Beyond the Fracture
4712270.short_description: A tactical hex duel for two. Random action points, positioning decides battles, short intense matches. In the arena, AI constructs and humans fight as equals. That is not a bug. That is the game.

4712290.title: Chest & Compass: Isles of Vaultara
4712290.short_description: Sail across cursed islands and uncover ancient treasures in this tactical turn-based RPG. Unlock new classes, recruit allies, and let an ancient chest shape each run.

4712300.title: TTM
4712300.short_description: TTM is a local multiplayer game for 1–4 players, where two teams clash in fast-paced tactical battles.

4712350.title: HypnoTiles
4712350.short_description: HypnoTiles is a puzzle game of the falling blocks variety. Its psychedelic graphics, hypnotic soundtrack and absorbing gameplay put the player in an almost trance-like state. Features 3 game modes and online highscores.

4712420.title: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
4712420.short_description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world once again, in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters - an overload of sight and sound. Chase those high scores!

4712430.title: Monster Meadows
4712430.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4712430.short_description: Roll the dice and conquer the magical board! Upgrade monster lairs, unleash unique character abilities, and bankrupt your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

4712460.title: Grinny’s Playhouse
4712460.short_description: Enter Grinny’s Playhouse, a once‑lively children’s fun centre now abandoned after its mysterious shutdown. Explore the dark party rooms and uncover what happened here. But be careful… the mascot who once entertained families hasn’t fully powered down.

4712480.title: The Grey Dream - Season 2
4712480.short_description: The Grey Dream Season 2 is an adult Visual Novel about a man who got offered a job in an international trading company right after graduation. As soon as you accept it, the consequences of the past start to manifest. In the second season, you'll be facing these consequences and the choices you made.

4712510.title: Vixen's Lust
4712510.short_description: Vixen's Lust is a fox-themed adult puzzle game where you select any two shuffled image blocks to swap them, solve growing grids, use hints, and unlock artwork.

4712520.title: CUBOUNCE
4712520.short_description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Players control their character to soar through levels with extreme momentum, using bounces and grappling hook swings to overcome challenges.

4712560.title: Pixel Darts: From Pub to Glory
4712560.short_description: Cozy pixel-art darts with 90s arcade soul. Throw 501, Cricket, Shanghai, and Bermuda. Inherit your dad's struggling pub, face 72 rivals, uncover a story he never finished and build your own league for that classic "just one more leg" feeling.

4712640.title: Escape the Space Hotel
4712640.short_description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

4712660.title: Time of the Lilies
4712660.short_description: A spy thriller featuring an escaped State Security agent navigating a conspiracy involving federal police, foreign agitators, and a familiar face from years past.

4712680.title: Ten Tek Desire
4712680.short_description: Ten Tek Desire is an adult exploration game where you play as a spirit in a Japanese-style city. Move through apartments, solve puzzles, complete mini-games, read hidden stories, and unlock photos, videos, flash drives, and adult animations.

4712690.title: Roads and Relics
4712690.short_description: A co-op horror game where you have to run an antique store and find valuables in a procedurally generated world

4712700.title: Cozy Up!
4712700.short_description: Cozy Up! is a relaxing, wholesome game in which you play as a cockatiel finding joy again. Meet quirky animals in a whimsical land. Be inspired by their stories. Enjoy optional quests. Collect and favorite replayable minigames that gently develop memory, perception, and reasoning at your own pace.

4712740.title: Cold Transit
4712740.short_description: Catch your friends hiding in the public transport network, before they manage to disappear. Use bikes, trams, trains and more to move around in the city.

4712810.title: Hungry Hangry Doodles
4712810.short_description: Draw your own goofy monster, gobble up mountains of fruit, and grow into a chaotic snack-devouring doodle beast. Bounce through colorful paper worlds, unlock fun surprises and enjoy cozy physics-based gameplay packed with creativity and charm.

4712900.title: Hentai Ginger Girls
4712900.short_description: Solve engaging puzzles with three unique mechanics to unlock 40 high-quality NSFW illustrations of stunning ginger girls. Build your ultimate uncensored gallery and earn 40 Steam Achievements in this relaxing adult experience.

4712950.title: X-Ray 2D
4712950.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4712950.short_description: A fast-paced and challenging 2D platformer where precision, reflexes, and exploration are essential to overcome traps, obstacles, and secret-filled levels.

4712990.title: Shadows of Ambition: Season 1
4712990.short_description: Step into a dark, choice-driven visual novel where ambition, lust, and power collide. Build relationships, shape your future, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a world driven by desire and corruption.

4713130.title: Undercover Love - Where Shadows Meet
4713130.short_description: A dark noir visual novel following Alex, a former police officer drawn into the mafia’s world. In a world where trust can get you killed and everyone has something to hide, two women with buried secrets are pulled into a story of revenge, power, and slow-burn romance shaped by your choices.

4713420.title: Consorts of the Emperor
4713420.short_description: Win the heart of the Emperor by presenting the best gifts and outplaying your rivals in this digital version of the boardgame Consorts of the Emperor!

4713700.title: The Circle Move
4713700.short_description: Explore a strange and mysterious world and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles with The Circle Move

4714000.title: 1.80战神微变
4714000.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4714000.short_description: 1.80 War God Slight Variant is a side-scrolling action platformer set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take control of a heavily armed mechanical dragon, tear through hordes of zombies and mutated bugs across desolate ruins, rescue survivors, and embark on an adrenaline-fueled fight for survival.

4714070.title: Castle of Thorns
4714070.short_description: A mystery visual novel set in a cursed castle. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the castle's dark past.

4714260.title: Darkspell Keep
4714260.short_description: Cast spells, fight monster waves, and survive as a wizard.

4714490.title: Sausage Escape
4714490.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Early Access
4714490.short_description: Sausage Escape - is a survival adventure where every mistake can turn you into minced meat. Play solo or with a squad of sausage fighters. Survive inside a dangerous house, complete objectives, and use teleporters, flamethrowers, and custom weapons across different game modes.

4714510.title: INOCULATE
4714510.short_description: Navigate a collapsing Arctic research facility as a lone Communication Officer in this cinematic 2.5D horror experience. Trapped within, you must outrun a spreading entity causing chaos and death, with no sign of stopping.

4714590.title: Fix-it Corp.
4714590.short_description: Repair. Survive. Get paid. - Fix-It Corp is a 1–4 player co-op horror game set in a dystopian 1980s USA. Take on dangerous repair jobs in abandoned locations while being hunted by terrifying anomalies lurking in the dark. Work together, complete your assignments, and make it out alive.

4714600.title: Organism Detected
4714600.short_description: Face off as Human or Alien in an asymmetric online 1v1 game within a remote lunar facility. Purify, repair and predict or infest, sabotage and elude in a strategic battle for control.

4714670.title: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs
4714670.short_description: Neon Fantasy: Dinosaurs is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

4714750.title: Tuggin It
4714750.short_description: Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can! Unlock and purchase upgrades to make tuggin it go a little smoother, and apply cosmetics so you're always tuggin it with style!

4714810.title: 再战大极品+255
4714810.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4714810.short_description: A retro casual game focused on idle progression and stat growth. With easy auto-play gameplay paired with the classic "ultimate gear" upgrade system, you’ll relive the thrill of skyrocketing stats and one-hit kills—embark on a laid-back growth journey without complicated controls.

4715030.title: Pulsewave
4715030.short_description: Geometric PvP twin-stick arena shooter. Outshoot your rivals across three modes: deathmatch ARENA, orb-hold CAPTURE THE PULSE, and territory-control PAINT WAR. Build your fighter through a deep skill tree. Pure neon, pure speed.

4715190.title: Only Farming - Cozy Harvesting Game
4715190.short_description: Take pleasure in harvest season in a quiet, charming village. On this journey, enjoy watching yourself evolution and progress as you transform from a novice harvester into an expert harvester. Harvest plenty, upgrade your tools, and get ready for the new harvest season.

4715320.title: Loop Miner
4715320.short_description: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

4715430.title: River Secret
4715430.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

4715770.title: Ruin Blade
4715770.short_description: “Relicblade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action game. As a mercenary, you descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

4715840.title: ARE YOU OKAY?
4715840.short_description: ARE YOU OKAY? is an immersive psychological experience of existential horror and narrative. You must answer questions from 3 different forms displayed on an old TV screen.

4716090.title: 不动列车StationaryTrain
4716090.short_description: " stationary Train" is a post-apocalyptic horror exploration pixel-style RPG. You will play as Luna, an adult woman and the last survivor of this world. you set out to recover your lost memories, and together with the conductor Diqiu, you return to a world ravaged by monsters and plague...

4716240.title: EL MINISTRO
4716240.short_description: A retro-inspired 2D action platformer where you play as a young minister of faith battling demonic creatures across cursed lands. Jump, fight, explore dangerous stages, and purge evil forces to restore peace to a town consumed by darkness.

4716300.title: Penguin, but why?
4716300.short_description: The story becomes not a tale about death or nihilism, but a reflection on human life itself. About why people leave their «colonies», why they strive toward impossible peaks, and what exactly drives them to continue the journey, even when all that surrounds them is cold and emptiness.

4716320.title: DAMASCUS: Road to Redemption
4716320.short_description: A cinematic third-person action RPG inspired by the biblical account of Saul’s transformation into Paul the Apostle. Pursue believers, witness the rise of the early church, and experience an encounter on the road to Damascus that changed history forever.

4716540.title: Maple Ridge
4716540.short_description: After losing his wife in an accident, Alex is left alone in a suburban house where every little detail reminds him of the past. An ordinary evening quickly turns into a series of strange and unsettling events.

4716620.title: Totoball 2
4716620.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Early Access
4716620.short_description: Fast-paced arcade foosball with skill shots, powerful kicks and competitive matches. Master the rods, score incredible goals and become the champion in Totoball 2.

4716700.title: Escria
4716700.short_description: Explore a dying fantasy world in this atmospheric 2D adventure, created by a single guy. Fight dangerous creatures, collect powerful weapons and relics, and journey through forests, castles, ruins, and corrupted lands before the world of Escria fades forever.

4716810.title: Degrowth
4716810.short_description: Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living! Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed! Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

4717170.title: Renegades
4717170.short_description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five hunted heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles.

4717260.title: Are You A Pilot
4717260.genre: Action, Indie, Racing, Sports, Free To Play
4717260.short_description: Are You A Pilot is a free-to-play neon arcade runner about speed, reflexes, and survival. Dodge obstacles, collect plasma, fire lasers, unlock skins, chase high scores, and jump into online squad runs.

4717480.title: Snake
4717480.short_description: Features: - Classic score-based gameplay - Increasing difficulty over time - Simple, readable visual design - Fast restart and replay loop - Singleplayer arcade experience

4717650.title: Mystic Diary: Wizard's Legacy Collector's Edition
4717650.short_description: Journey through time to uncover hidden clues and family secrets in a magical hidden-object adventure!

4717710.title: ColorLand Friends
4717710.short_description: Colorland Friends is a gentle educational game for ages 3–6 where children learn colors through fun lessons, matching activities, and relaxing animations with Milo the monkey. Designed to build confidence, recognition, and early learning through play.

4717800.title: Haunted Attractions
4717800.short_description: Build haunted theme parks and supervise ghosts in this cozy afterlife sim. Construct fun attractions, manage resources, recruit cute ghosts and haunt the park in order to spook and delight the guests!

4717870.title: Uchi No Heya!
4717870.short_description: Run a sumo stable! Recruit rookies, drill their stats, cook chanko nabe, and steer them through six grand tournaments a year. Climb the banzuke from Jonokuchi to Yokozuna while juggling injuries, rivalries, and an empty bank account. Work hard to make your heya legendary!

4717910.title: GeneWorld
4717910.short_description: Explore mysterious procedural worlds filled with portals, corrupted dimensions, intelligent NPCs and limitless builds in a chaotic multiplayer action RPG where every journey becomes a new story.

4718030.title: Goof Off
4718030.short_description: This is a Party/Couch game where wild Goofs fight for glory! Grab weapons from crates and battle your friends and family to be crowned the ultimate Goof! You may find a fish that knocks the wind out of others or a bottle containing a black hole. You never know what you may find...

4718090.title: Pathogen
4718090.short_description: Deckbuilding roguelike. Build endless combos with cards and artifacts!

4718100.title: Gongmu Mountain in Chongzuo
4718100.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

4718120.title: CLAM
4718120.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
4718120.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night Clam gets curious with the front door of the rat mansion and accidentally escapes with no way back in. Will this Melbourne sharehouse be as hospitable as home? Is rent really due on the 1st? Find your way, it's CLAM!

4718150.title: The Floral Princes
4718150.short_description: A dark fantasy otome RPG where cursed Floral Princes fight against the corruption consuming their kingdom. Build romantic bonds, make meaningful choices, collect powerful cards, and battle through a cinematic story-rich adventure.

4718270.title: Blosharper: Battle of Blossoms
4718270.short_description: Blosharper is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists the rules of traditional Korean Hwatu. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to manipulate the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your crushing debt, defeat ruthless bosses, and become the ultimate sharp!

4718330.title: Video Mahjong Tutorial
4718330.short_description: Learn real mahjong from this fantasy arcade tutorial tape. Test your skills in the roguelike mode. Play by the rules, then break the rules.

4718560.title: Sword and Immortal
4718560.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4718560.short_description: 《Sword and Immortal》is a blockbuster martial arts immortal-themed action MMORPG game. It features stunning scenes, exquisite visuals, an epic storyline and endless immortal bonds.

4718600.title: 女皇的绝色男宠
4718600.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4718600.short_description: 《女皇的绝色男宠》是一款以唯美国风为背景的女性向角色扮演养成游戏。‌‌

4718670.title: Divine Sin: Death Duel
4718670.short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike featuring a unique Clash combat system, where every duel becomes an exchange of calculated moves and deadly counters.

4718680.title: The 11th Power
4718680.short_description: What if 2048 was a deckbuilding roguelike? Fight evil cultists and trans-dimensional horrors by combining tiles!

4718710.title: Hentai Morgana
4718710.short_description: Hentai Morgana is a puzzle game filled with dark magic, midnight temptation, and gothic charm. Meet Morgana — a seductive vampire who hunts not only in the darkness, but for your attention as well. Complete levels and unlock new revealing illustrations.

4718850.title: Talk Insomnia
4718850.short_description: Talk Insomnia is a visual novel that blends suspenseful weird tales with mixology. You play as Ming, a bookstore staff member who prepares drinks for guests during the day and delves into their stories at night. With the warmth of a single drink, you draw out the secrets buried deep in their hearts.

4718860.title: Deep Shift
4718860.short_description: Restore and maintain a damaged underwater station deep beneath the ocean. Repair systems, manage power and pressure, explore flooded sections, and slowly bring the facility back to life in this atmospheric first-person deep-sea simulation game.

4718880.title: Цикл прошлого
4718880.short_description: Первая игра по истории России. 862 год. Ты – тот, кого назвали Рюриком. Но твоя память пуста. Тебе предстоит заново узнать себя и построить государство.

4719000.title: Nightmare Journey 1135
4719000.short_description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

4719010.title: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
4719010.short_description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

4719070.title: Rally the Parties
4719070.short_description: A tactical RPG where time only advances while your character is acting. Direct your party while companions follow your orders autonomously, or switch characters to play their role yourself. Recruit NPCs to strengthen your party and descend into the dungeon. A permadeath roguelike RPG.

4719210.title: IconicQuest
4719210.genre: Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Early Access
4719210.short_description: For players who remember when MMOs respected their time. A pixel-art, top-down MMORPG with real-time skill combat, branching class specializations, and loot worth keeping. Built solo, in the open.

4719260.title: Gallows and Gold
4719260.short_description: In a kingdom of ink and rot, the gavel is heavier than the sword. As the High Judge, every sentence you scrawl reshapes a crumbling world. Mercy or Justice? Innocent or Guilty? The gallows await your word in this hand-etched moral choice simulator.

4719340.title: Blackout Protocol
4719340.short_description: Blackout Protocol is a systems-driven sci-fi survival prototype where you must restore power, stabilise a damaged spacecraft, and bring critical ship systems back online before time runs out.

4719390.title: Change
4719390.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

4719500.title: Explosive Exchange
4719500.short_description: Exchange explosions with friends in this action packed party game. Upgrade your character between rounds and make every run special with various build paths.

4719580.title: ams的MBTI测试
4719580.short_description: MBTI test questions by ams. Explore yourself with a unique test!

4719600.title: Sacrificium
4719600.short_description: Sacrificium is a dark psychological horror experience blending illustrated storytelling, branching choices, and sanity-driven gameplay. Trapped in a castle controlled by a satanic cult, you must escape before the nightmare consumes you.

4719700.title: SINKING INTO THE VOID
4719700.short_description: SINKING INTO THE VOID is a 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game focused on intense battles against powerful enemies.

4719710.title: 六艺中文填字
4719710.short_description: 经典填字游戏的中文版。《六艺中文填字》是一款以中国古代“君子六艺”为核心框架的纯正中文文字解谜游戏。在这里，你可以穿梭于“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗，挑战包罗万象、纵贯古今中外的海量知识点。挑一个你最爱的四季国风视觉主题，静下心来，享受这场文字与文化的拼图之旅吧。

4719840.title: The Way of Ping-Pong
4719840.short_description: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

4719870.title: Ore Legacy
4719870.short_description: A retro CRT-style idle mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

4719930.title: Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian
4719930.genre: Action, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4719930.short_description: Command your ship, harvest precious resources, and upgrade your arsenal in a relentless sci-fi universe. Aethelgard: Galactic Guardian is an action-packed space shooter where you must build the ultimate vessel to survive epic battles against elite alien fleets.

4720010.title: Miracle Brave: Beast Defense Line
4720010.short_description: Endless tides of beasts crash against your fortress, yet never breach your line. Fight alongside your brave companions, reap the invaders, and grow stronger with every battle. Rise to meet the next wave with greater might—reap, strengthen, reap again. The cycle never ends.

4720110.title: Space Town: Kids & Toddlers Space Exploration
4720110.short_description: Explore colorful planets, fly fun spaceships, collect letters and treasures, and learn through play in a relaxing space adventure made for kids and toddlers. Designed for controllers, safe exploration, simple gameplay, and family-friendly fun.

4720120.title: Just A Gun
4720120.short_description: Just A Gun is an incremental point-and-click shooter where you evolve a single weapon through a massive upgrade tree.

4720170.title: Panspermia - El eco de los antiguos
4720170.short_description: A narrative adventure where your words matter. Explore, decide, and uncover the secrets of the Panspermia universe in an experience inspired by classic text parser adventures.

4720180.title: Endless Night Sonata
4720180.short_description: Endless Night Sonata is a hand drawn metroidvania with classic style animation. Follow the quest of Nicodemos in the "Worlds-in-middle", an unforgiving and dangerous land controlled by demonic forces on a epic mission to find his purpose...

4720210.title: Hit Streak And Brawl
4720210.short_description: Fast-paced light roguelike: random events flash rapidly. Surrounded by swarms, move up/down/left/right to charge and knock enemies flying. Combine effects—or adapt instantly. Break encirclements, rack up scores.Accept the Boss's challenge.

4720870.title: Backrooms: Fade
4720870.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4720870.short_description: Backrooms: Fade is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore a nightmarish level, trying to understand where you are, what is happening, and how to survive.

4721000.title: Backrooms: Blackhole
4721000.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4721000.short_description: Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder...

4721680.title: The Last Braincell: Escape
4721680.short_description: The Last Braincell: Escape is a humorous asymmetrical multiplayer game: one fugitive gathers resources, hides identity and reaches escape, while police players share clues, search areas and coordinate the chase.

4723300.title: The Castle of Dr. Hoot
4723300.short_description: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles guaranteed to stump even the most well-read 5th grader!

4724040.title: Bite Sized
4724040.short_description: Platform by biting other creatures in this mouthful of a Metroidvania! Explore a vast, interconnected world where the only challenge that stands in your way is tough puzzle platforming and winding routes. A truly Bite Sized Metroidvania experience.

4724050.title: Idlemoor
4724050.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation
4724050.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where your character battles, trains, gathers, crafts, trades, and survives in a persistent online world. Progress continues while you are gone, but the strongest returns come to those who keep watch.

4724180.title: Reel Greed
4724180.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4724180.short_description: A chaotic slot machine incremental where tiny payouts become screen-filling money explosions. Collect falling cash, pick powerful cards, and upgrade toward absurd jackpots.

4724190.title: Into the Planet's Flesh
4724190.short_description: Grow a parasite colony inside a living planet. Hatch workers, mutate organs, automate a flesh economy, and discover what happens when the planet notices you. A short, active incremental game with a clear ending.

4724200.title: Serpent Rift
4724200.short_description: Snake. Portals. Chaos. Use portals to outsmart levels, dodge deadly obstacles and master every run, just don't get tangled up.

4724240.title: Vector Storm
4724240.short_description: A relentless top-down arcade shooter with roguelite progression. Blast through escalating waves, battle massive bosses, and build your loadout with boss-dropped gear. Earn tokens to permanently upgrade your fleet and unlock new ships between runs.

4724620.title: Paraquito
4724620.short_description: On the wings of courage, a small parakeet faces dangers and predators in a vibrant 2D world to rescue their missing brother. Overcome platforming challenges in this heartfelt journey of resilience and family.

4724650.title: DEMON SIEGE
4724650.short_description: A retro-inspired boomer shooter where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

4724800.title: Jixo 5: Mask Parade Collector’s Edition
4724800.short_description: Step into a sparkling carnival of masks, parades, theatres, and puppets, where relaxing puzzles, hidden objects, jigsaw-style boards, and bonus challenges await.

4724890.title: Nastrond:Rhythm Shaker
4724890.short_description: "Shake the momentum, mix the rhythm." Become the bartender of Nastrond, meet various guests, and win rhythm battles.

4724980.title: Tiny Wrecks
4724980.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, Early Access
4724980.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer combat racing game where tiny cars battle through giant real-world tracks filled with destruction, traps, and survival challenges.

4725010.title: Hakimi's Ocean Drift
4725010.short_description: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.

4725020.title: Take Your Throne
4725020.short_description: A Tower Defense-style game. Take a strong stance and defend your throne against the brazen and utterly shameless claims of your enemies. With each level, your opponents will become increasingly resourceful... be prepared for anything... from formal charges to an angry mob!

4725080.title: Jumping Wroc Cat - Big Silesian Tour
4725080.short_description: Meet Mruczek, a magical cat from Wroclaw, whose peaceful life is interrupted by a mysterious dream. Set off with Mruczek on a journey, starting from the hidden corners of Wroclaw, to find magical artifacts and save the world from grey chaos.

4725110.title: ぺちぺちハクスラ
4725110.short_description: A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills. The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes! Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

4725170.title: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
4725170.short_description: Atmospheric 3D Action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight enemies, collect rare equipment, and restore the ancient fortress of Sunveil.

4725190.title: Project Melvin
4725190.short_description: Project Melvin is a story driven 3rd person adventure game with main story quests and side quests to get excited about. Discover story lines you never thought were possible and humour you never wanted but got.

4725200.title: Femboy Pirates
4725200.short_description: In Femboy Pirates, you are the Captain of a vibrant crew on a journey across mystical seas. Your goal: to find the ancient Pearls and unlock their world-altering power. But the ocean is full of secrets, and the Pearl’s influence might change your crew in ways you never expected.

4725270.title: Signal Snow
4725270.short_description: Signal Snow is a paranoid Antarctic visual novel about a radio signal from beneath the ice, impossible memories, and a crew that may not survive its own fear. Decide who to trust, who to isolate, and whether to answer.

4725310.title: UpMaze
4725310.short_description: UpMaze is a 2D pixel-art platformer where you guide a small frog through dangerous tower-like levels filled with spikes, saw blades, moving hazards, platforms, and timing-based challenges. Jump carefully, avoid traps, and reach the trophy at the end of each stage.

4725320.title: Blood in the Ice
4725320.short_description: Investigate a death aboard a trapped 1859 Arctic whaling ship in a bleak historical visual novel about evidence, hunger, trust, and the cost of telling the truth.

4725330.title: BloodVeil
4725330.short_description: BloodVeil is a text-based social deduction game about hidden roles, deception, discussion, and survival. Create or join lobbies, play as villagers or vampires, use special role abilities, vote during the day, and try to lead your team to victory.

4725360.title: Fire Fire Royale
4725360.short_description: Tired of cheaters in 3D shooter games? This fast-paced cheats free 2D PvP battle royale shooter game will be your ultimate choice. Players can try different weapons and experience different battle styles, but most importantly, no cheaters are allowed! Players can also try different customizations.

4725860.title: The Sinner of the Closed Set
4725860.short_description: A new mystery arises from the collision of narrative puzzle games and film noir. Investigate a film set full of catty cast and crew in order to deduce and connect their relationships. Debunk or prove those connections using evidence to unravel the mystery of what occurred and who is responsible!

4726040.title: Sofa Clicker
4726040.short_description: Sofa Clicker is an idle game featuring cats with a single mission: total sofa destruction.

4726050.title: Izaav:Darkness from Beyond
4726050.short_description: Fight against monsters and nature itself — everything standing between you and what you hold dear. A young boy, armed for the first time with weapons and determination, faces growing darkness. The deeper he goes, the harsher it becomes — but never impossible.

4726140.title: I Need To Pay Rent
4726140.short_description: I NEED TO PAY RENT! is a physics-based chaos simulator about one small problem: you need money, and your apartment is full of it. Grab, throw, and sell anything in sight as your debt spirals out of control.

4726250.title: The Tracy Arm Tsunami Experience
4726250.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4726250.short_description: Explore Tracy Arm, Alaska and trigger a massive landslide tsunami in a first-person simulation with land, air, and water viewpoints.

4726270.title: Sushi Courier!
4726270.short_description: This is Sushi Courier! A game where you build relationships, give back to the Community, and of course... Make Sushi!

4726310.title: Last Year's Model
4726310.short_description: In Last Year's Model, you design the levels. But as the difficulty rises and the timer ticks down, you may find that you quickly become the architect of your own misfortune.

4726330.title: DEAD UNIT
4726330.short_description: A titanic complex. An insignificant man. A grim horror thriller where you aren't the savior of the world — you are a prisoner, classified as a DEAD UNIT. Hide. Unearth the truth. Find a way out. Fight for every minute of life while you still breathe.

4726380.title: Ruin Adventurer
4726380.short_description: ‘Ruin Adventurer’ is an automation game with survival and programming elements. Use your robots to ensure your survival, automate resource gathering, and ultimately escape the ruins.

4726580.title: Cielle is Not Happy
4726580.short_description: Cielle is Not Happy is a Psychological Horror RPG that redefines the adventure genre through a deep, haunting narrative and unconventional combat mechanics, delivering a masterfully immersive experience.

4693090.title: Footprint of Y
4693090.short_description: 《Footprint of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中规划行动、逐步推进流程并提升角色能力，在连贯的单人旅程中体验以积累与路径推进为核心的回合制玩法。

4693300.title: Hole Punch Cocktail
4693300.short_description: "Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." Enter the dream of a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

4693390.title: In a Scent - Part 1
4693390.short_description: A young incubus is cut off from his father's wealth until he proves himself to be worthy of his ancestors. Panicked and ill-prepared, he screamed "I'm your long lost son" when confronted by the first family he encountered in the human realm.

4694070.title: Roses In Concrete
4694070.short_description: Inspired by a famous poem from a legendary deceased American rapper, Roses In Concrete is an exercise in distilling a literary work into gameplay mechanics that reinforce its core message.

4694250.title: Mellanrum
4694250.short_description: In this eerie point-and-click adventure, Astrid wakes to find her once-familiar home now inhabited by strange people and creatures. To uncover what happened while she was asleep, she must explore her family’s past and the secrets hidden within their centuries-old home.

4694320.title: Yummy Yummy Honey
4694320.short_description: Harvest flowers, grow your honeycomb! Relaxing yet exciting: a cozy rush of bloom and buzz.

4694530.title: Under Tower Idle
4694530.short_description: Build, expand, and automate your island empire in this 3D idle clicker adventure. Gather resources, train units, and conquer dangerous dungeons.

4694720.title: Sleighers
4694720.short_description: A festive anthro-themed hero shooter set in the atmospheric and whimsical Arctic Circle. Choose your class, and help your team decorate and dominate in this more festive twist on the Domination game mode, but watch out for Old Man Winter and his periodic blizzards!

4694850.title: Astra's Garden
4694850.short_description: Long ago, in a magical town filled with witches... There was one particular witch, Astragalus, who opened an apothecary. Grow some plants to help heal your customers and ease whatever ails them in this relaxing little idle game.

4694950.title: Banban Isle Rangers
4694950.short_description: Follow Banban and Friends into a fantastic world of 32-Bit glory! Explore the unique lands of the Banban Isles with your stellar new flying companion, help your friends solve their problems, and save your summer vacation! ...Oh, and save the world from a Naughty invasion too, I guess.

4694980.title: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor
4694980.short_description: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor is a story-rich logic puzzle game where you build mathematical rules to reconstruct 2D and 3D memory fragments, solving precise spatial puzzles as a cold sci-fi mystery unfolds.

4695190.title: Eruin
4695190.short_description: ▎ A story-driven RPG where you speak to AI-powered NPCs using your voice. Every character has their own knowledge, personality, and memory. Explore the handcrafted world of Eruin — confide, interrogate, befriend, or deceive your way through its mysteries.

4695280.title: Blobby Coins - The Board Game
4695280.short_description: Blobbies love coins and winning! In this classic turn based board game that almost needs no dice, you proceed by collecting move points and try to collect the most coins. Find treasures, avoid bear traps and outsmart the other players. Play against the computer or local with your friends or family.

4695290.title: The Linda Society
4695290.short_description: The Linda Society is a bizarro vampire-adventure game. Join Linda Lastname, Sandy Loam, Terror Mary, Cousin Jack, and Pio on their quest to destroy a vile group of anti-vampires known as The Pressure Men.

4695640.title: STATION 07
4695640.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4695640.short_description: Supplies are gone. Station 07 is cut off. As the last survivor, you must maintain the outpost and manage critical heat, power, and food systems. Battle hostile factions and mutated terrors in a frozen world. Will you sacrifice your humanity to survive the deep freeze?

4695650.title: Strikeloop
4695650.short_description: A side-scrolling shoot-'em-up with dense bullet patterns and Gradius-style horizontal action. Plan builds on a deep skill tree, blast through scrolling stages, then reinvest in prestige upgrades to push further. Skill choices meet arcade reflexes in a replayable loop built for one more run.

4695780.title: TAILS GEAR HD
4695780.short_description: A revamped version of "Tales Gear," originally released in 2007, featuring high-resolution support, new systems, and rearranged background music. A full-fledged 2.5D vertical-scrolling shooter characterized by the Tail Pod, an optional weapon that combines offense and defense.

4695830.title: Subspace Escape
4695830.short_description: Subspace Escape is an ’80s-inspired arcade survival game where you pilot a lone spacecraft through hostile subspace on a desperate journey back to Earth. Survive increasingly difficult encounters, collect game-changing power-ups, and compete for the highest score.

4695890.title: Heroes' Heaven
4695890.short_description: Assemble a party of heroes and survive endless monster hordes. Equip them, level their skills, and unleash devastating weapon evolutions — all without lifting a finger to aim. A retro-RPG bullet heaven for 1–∞ runs.

4695930.title: Civilization Survivor
4695930.short_description: This is a roguelike game similar to Vampire Survivors. You control a star to absorb new planets, and evolve into the civilization you want by absorbing different energies.

4696020.title: NOMAD-san
4696020.short_description: Can you reach the Crown of Victory on the 31st floor? This is a quick coffee-break roguelike. Simple rules, casual look, but winning is another story. Think you’ve got the skills? Take the challenge and claim your crown!

4696030.title: Return to Lumia
4696030.short_description: Dig, build, and bring your corrupted hometown back to life. The more dungeons you conquer, the more the world transforms. A cozy 2D mining sandbox made by a husband-and-wife indie team.

4696110.title: Nodebreak
4696110.short_description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

4696120.title: Be The Rocket Bucket
4696120.short_description: Smash, blow up, and destroy to bring peace to the world. The more destroyed, the faster it's destroyed, the more money is made. Upgrade your guns, thrusters, battleship, drones, and so much more. Realistic physics is at the core of everything done. The Llama's of Peace await your service.

4696130.title: Cog of Y
4696130.short_description: 《Cog of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在回合中安排行动顺序、衔接技能选择并逐步强化角色能力，在稳定运作的战斗流程中体验以结构与策略为核心的单人 RPG 玩法。

4696140.title: Pocket of Y
4696140.short_description: 《Pocket of Y》是一款以紧凑节奏为特点的回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过快速做出战斗决策、推进流程并强化角色能力，在简洁而连贯的单人体验中完成回合制冒险。

4696150.title: Membrane of Y
4696150.short_description: 《Membrane of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中平衡攻守、调整状态并推进角色成长，在稳定而连续的单人流程中体验以策略控制为核心的回合制玩法。

4696180.title: Ballad of the Magic Wand
4696180.short_description: Become a magic wand and climb your way to the top using spins and jumps. Defeat powerful bosses in this challenging physics-based action platformer focused on precise controls and diverse skills.

4696570.title: Anomalous zone
4696570.short_description: You will have to visit an anomalous zone from which there is no exit unless you possess an artifact with which you can open a portal, an exit from the zone

4696600.title: Cultist
4696600.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4696600.short_description: Cultist is card game about begining of the religions and the way they grow, interact and even become immortal. Can you outgrow the world that contains yourself and become much bigger?

4698020.title: Relay Protocol
4698020.short_description: Relay Protocol is a logic-based puzzle game built around experimentation, spatial reasoning, and energy-based mechanics. Redirect lasers, manipulate energy signals, and use specialized characters to solve interconnected test chambers inside a mysterious industrial facility.

4698060.title: Pull Factor
4698060.short_description: Turn a tiny magnet into a metal-devouring machine as you upgrade, retry, and conquer chaotic arcade stages.

4698380.title: 回魂者 CallBacker
4698380.short_description: Explore the mysterious 3D Underworld and fight on the edge of life and death. A Metroidvania blending hardcore combat with deep storytelling.

4698420.title: Word Score Labs
4698420.short_description: This is a collection of several word mini-games designed to make memorizing English words fun and unforgettable, while achieving the sense of satisfaction from high scores. Each mini-game acts like a mini-lab, offering different way such as playing, dictation, or speaking to improve your level.

4698440.title: CTR
4698440.short_description: You are a robot. Reflect the ball exactly N times. Route it to the exit. Arrange the pieces, build the logic, meet your quota.

4698550.title: PC Companion
4698550.short_description: A unique desktop companion that lives on your PC, reacts to your activity, and evolves with you. Each player gets only one heroine… unless they uncover the secret.

4698630.title: SCREAM you LOSE
4698630.short_description: If you get startled, you go back to Number 0. A Japanese-style horror anomaly-spotting game that uses your microphone to detect your reactions. Eerie shrines, schools, and cult-like locations await, filled with all kinds of horror and anomalies.

4699280.title: Urbex Simulator
4699280.short_description: Can you explore an abandoned building filled with cannibal squatters! Avoid a serial killer known as "The Urbex Killer" and find out what eldritch horrors lie beneath! A strategic RPG maker horror shoot-em-up where you fight against squatters who want you dead!

4699330.title: 魔導のブローシュア
4699330.short_description: 240x160の画面で描かれるピクセルアートの世界で、心温まるストーリーが織りなす魔導ファンタジーRPG。 行動順と攻撃範囲が紐づいたバトルと、最大HPをコストにする独特な成長システムを使い、懐かしい見た目の中でフシギな体験を楽しみましょう。セーブポイントにはうさぎさんもいます。

4699680.title: Gravesong: Litany of Ashes
4699680.short_description: You came home a hero. You woke up a monster. A story-driven first-person RPG about war, loss, and the darkness that follows you back.

4699920.title: 天平游戏1:抉择
4699920.short_description: 《Inner Scales 1:Choice》is a first-person FMV. Set in a sealed cage. It pushes survival, humanity, emotion and moral dilemmas to the extreme. You will face surveillance, cages, and the fates of eight trapped women—every choice you make decides life and death for others and yourself.

4699930.title: Interactive Manual Of Compulsive Distress
4699930.short_description: Balance social anxiety and friendship: push too hard, and you'll crash, shut down, and you'll be alone.

4700590.title: One More Dig!
4700590.short_description: Grab your equipments and dive deep! One More Dig is a pirate-themed mining adventure. Master your stamina, unearth cursed treasures, and upgrade your gear with dubloons. The greatest haul is always just one more dig away—how deep will you go before the tide turns?

4700880.title: WeeWars
4700880.short_description: Classic turn-based territory strategy, reborn on charming low-poly hex tiles. Four nations, four completely different ways to wage war — the Elite Few, Lightning Mobility, Terrain Masters, and the Endless Treasury. Auto-battle keeps things relaxed; the strategic depth stays sharp.

4701370.title: Come in
4701370.short_description: After months of chatting online, she invites you over. A quiet house in the middle of the woods seems like the perfect place for a romantic encounter. But the longer you stay inside, the more you realize something is wrong with this place.

4701400.title: Rustbuckets
4701400.short_description: Rustbuckets is a twin-stick action-adventure where you control a throwable shield like a second character, exploring a desolate world of forgotten machines.

4701410.title: Alchemist Chronicles
4701410.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

4701560.title: Alpha Omega
4701560.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Sports, Early Access
4701560.short_description: A high quality and unique hand-crafted VISUAL NOVEL in the spirit of the "Choose Your Own Adventures" of old, which focusses on character and choices that alter the story.

4701600.title: LIT Creature Forge
4701600.short_description: Run virtual evolution and watch bizarre creatures learn to walk, jump, and crawl from random genes. A modern recreation of Karl Sims' 1994 evolving virtual creatures with MuJoCo physics, tunable gravity and population, plus tools to save, clone, and replay your champions.

4701700.title: Kobold Delvers
4701700.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play

4716660.short_description: Survive the waves. Beat the bosses. Bring home the loot. Skroyder Rumble is a fast-paced 2.5D action brawler with fluid (but challenging) combat, cinematic 3D animation, and a weird Brazilian-inspired cartoon world.

4717180.title: Murder at Monty's Mansion
4717180.short_description: Step into a goofy murder mystery where you play as a detective who cannot speak. Use your notepad to interrogate guests, explore Monty’s mansion, and discover who murdered the butler.

4717350.title: Carnival Runner
4717350.short_description: Carnival Runner is a colorful arcade side-scrolling runner where you jump, slide, dodge obstacles, earn bonus points, and chase per-character high scores. The current build includes 2 playable characters, with more planned in future updates.

4717860.title: Star Quest
4717860.short_description: Star Quest brings back the mystery and energy of early ’80s arcade games — simple to start, tougher as you go, and built to look, sound, and feel like a real coin‑op machine. Classic high scores, initials entry, and this time… you can actually win.

4717990.title: Fantasy to Kill
4717990.short_description: The world is unfair, but you will be worse. Parry and counter during monster turns in challenging turn-based combat. Level up and find new spells, weapons and items in the 2.5d overworld to gain an advantage over encounters.

4718070.title: Faybound : Veils of Magic
4718070.short_description: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

4718440.title: Lords Of Heck
4718440.short_description: Lords of Heck is a high-octane 2.5D arcade brawler that captures the raw energy of 90s cabinet classics. Forget modern hand-holding—this is a brutal, handcrafted journey through a hellscape inspired by the dark, gothic grit of Diablo.

4718700.title: Lang！
4718700.short_description: Explore 7 2D maps in this relaxing top-down collectathon! Use a bug net to catch 10+ unique insects, or throw slippers to interact with the world. Your goal: discover secret glitch scenes, find 3+ hidden "system bugs," and complete your two-part Achievement Book. Playable in 3 languages.

4719050.title: Divine Descent: Chu-Han
