4719050.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4719050.short_description: Six (currently only two) young warriors from a future planet accidentally fall through a spacetime rift into the Chu-Han battlefield of the 3rd century BC. Armed with futuristic weaponry, they stage a time-traveling "divine intervention" on the ancient battlefield.
developers: Qingdao Qilin Ark Network Technology Co.,Ltd.
publishers: Qingdao Qilin Ark Network Technology Co.,Ltd.

4719360.title: Duel Mahjong
4719360.short_description: "Duel Mahjong" is an online multiplayer mahjong game incorporating item cards and superpowers. During matches, there are many ways to acquire item cards. By combining various card effects, you can devise winning strategies, enjoy a thrilling game of Mahjong with your friends!

4719630.title: Dream's frog
4719630.short_description: Dream's Frog is not just a retro-style arcade puzzle game, but a magical adventure of a cute frog in a dream world where logic, memory, and speed will help you overcome any obstacles. Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of the 8-bit era and guide the frog through all 20 mazes!

4719720.title: Poping Aquarium
4719720.short_description: A cozy idle block breaker for the side of your screen. Instead of a ball, fish with unique traits bounce around, break blocks, and collect rewards.

4719730.title: Giant Waifu Wash Simulator 💦
4719730.short_description: Clean the city, serve a giant superstar, and shape your relationship in this relaxing power-washing simulator set in a vibrant resort town. No pressure, just satisfying gameplay and choices that matter.

4719820.title: Arkada
4719820.short_description: Play difficult arcades and test your sanity in handcrafted pixel art world

4719980.title: Man of Y
4719980.short_description: 《Man of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过主导攻击、防御与技能释放的节奏，在不断变化的单人战斗中形成自己的行动逻辑与对抗风格。

4720150.title: Pixel Rain
4720150.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4720150.short_description: A chill falling-sand pixel physics sandbox. Paint with hundreds of interactive materials — water, lava, acid, crystals, plants and more — discover recipes, build your own elements in the Workshop, and watch it all react in real time. No goals. No pressure. Just pixels.

4720360.title: VERLIES III - Resurrection
4720360.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler featuring intense rhythmic combat in a world consumed by despair.

4720370.title: Die Die
4720370.short_description: Die Die is an active deck-building dungeon crawler. It follows a dice-headed dealer as he descends into the casino’s depths, hand of cards at the ready, to take down the threats hiding in the shadows.

4720380.title: 在线地球：Earth Online
4720380.short_description: 继《芝士财商》之后，宋雅网络第二款游戏《在线地球》来了。这是一款像素风多人联机生存游戏，你将与全球玩家共同生活在一颗圆形的像素地球上：收集资源、搭建庇护所、抵御黑夜生物，还要提防其他幸存者。游戏支持数十人同服协作或对抗，可组部落开荒，也可孤狼探险。动态天气、季节变化和完整的生活制造体系，加上地球自转带来的真实昼夜与资源分布，让生存充满变数。Steam即将上线，在这颗低像素、高自由的小小星球上，活出你的故事。

4720530.title: Number Naughties
4720530.short_description: Awake each night inside a quiet three-bedroom house turned nightmare, forced to complete increasingly challenging scavenger hunts set by unsettling cartoon numbers. Search, hide, and survive as you are stalked by a relentless, unstoppable entity in this terrifying stealth horror experience.

4720650.title: Hanta Hearts
4720650.short_description: A biotech thriller-romance visual novel. As CEO Holt, race a twelve-week EUA countdown while three formidable women enter your orbit. One decisive weekend splits the story into three routes—each with its own institutional stakes, adult scenes, and endgame.

4720660.title: Hentai Clicker: Cassia is streaming
4720660.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Cassia is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Cassia, a fierce Roman gladiator cosplayer with a playful side!

4720690.title: Apology Video
4720690.short_description: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!

4720780.title: Confections & Conversations
4720780.short_description: Confections & Conversations is a cozy bakery simulator about baking sweet treats, managing a small business, most importantly getting to know a cast of colorful customers, and helping guide them through heartfelt conversations all in a modern isekai fantasy world.

4720800.title: Backrooms: The Endless Halls
4720800.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4720800.short_description: Backrooms: The Endless Halls is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. On your own or with friends, you’ll dive into an unknown world where everything will seem familiar to you, yet at the same time frightening and very confusing. Try to make it out alive, if that’s even possible...

4720830.title: Backrooms: The Incident
4720830.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4720830.short_description: Backrooms: The Incident is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. On your own or with friends, you'll explore the game world, trying to figure out what's going on, where you are, how to get out of there, and whether it's even possible.

4720850.title: Backrooms: The Wrong Reality
4720850.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4720850.short_description: Backrooms: The Wrong Reality is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Explore a distorted and hostile reality alone or with friends as you search for answers, avoid what lurks in the dark, and struggle to survive a place that should not exist.

4720860.title: Backrooms: The Wrong Door
4720860.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4720860.short_description: Backrooms: The Wrong Door is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. A single wrong door leads you into a shifting nightmare where reality feels broken, familiar places become hostile, and every step forward may bring you closer to something watching from the dark.

4722780.title: Sticks and Stones
4722780.short_description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid (or asteroids) impact.

4724020.title: Incremental Quest - Dungeon Depths
4724020.short_description: An incremental RPG where you venture into a dungeon to delve as deep as possible—fighting monsters, looting, and leveling up. Can you defeat every boss? How deep can you go?

4724380.title: Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance
4724380.short_description: Project Sentinel is a 16-bit inspired run and gun platformer that blends arcade action with dystopian law enforcement. Intimidate suspects into compliance with a cybernetic roar, make arrests, rescue civilians, or enforce order through overwhelming firepower.

4724580.title: Exhibition of the Heart
4724580.short_description: Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

4724860.title: Ark of the Apocalypse
4724860.short_description: Earth destroyed by nuclear disaster. For 150 years, humanity's last hope, the 'Ark', drifts through space. Food dwindles, distrust grows. As leader, your mission: secure provisions, maintain order. Can you and 500 crew members survive to rekindle humanity's flame?

4725000.title: MyBiz: Pomodoro Desk Tycoon
4725000.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy
4725000.short_description: A cozy pixel-art office sim powered by your real Pomodoros. Focus sessions earn cash + XP — decorate, hire staff, level up. Music, ambience, break-time minigames. Productivity tool by day, tycoon by every minute.

4725060.title: Dogma Shutdown
4725060.short_description: A satirical roguelike deckbuilder where suffering fuels power, sin becomes currency, and faith is performative spectacle.

4725290.title: Escape Line
4725290.short_description: Yandere · Monster Romance · Y/N game · Philosophical · Sci-Fi · Visual Novel Shipwrecked and stripped of memory, you awaken on a fog-shrouded island with nothing but the aid of two sirens — so, what's the price?

4727090.title: Hentai FOOT Fetish
4727090.short_description: Hentai FOOT Fetish - Hey, sweetie, did you fall? I almost stepped on you. Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4727100.title: Hentai Horny FUTA
4727100.short_description: Hentai Horny FUTA - It got hot...!!! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4727130.title: Backrooms: The Void
4727130.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4727130.short_description: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

4727140.title: Backrooms: The Entity
4727140.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4727140.short_description: Backrooms: The Entity is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Deep within a distorted and decaying reality, something intelligent is hunting you. It watches, adapts, learns your behavior, and grows more aggressive the longer you survive.

4727160.title: 图说八道
4727160.short_description: Pic Talk Nonsense is a casual puzzle game about guessing Chinese puns from pictures. There is no timer and no penalty. Just relax, think freely, and enjoy the fun of solving visual pun puzzles.

4727320.title: Cook Knights
4727320.short_description: Become a CookKnight! Explore a misterious dungeon, fight monsters and the evil undead forces of a necromancer, help people in need, pet a sheep and most importantly, cook amazing dishes to become stronger in this cute voxel action game.

4727330.title: HEXHOLD: SIX FORMATIONS
4727330.short_description: Hex grid, 30 waves of endless night. Build your Six Formations, summon Three Kingdoms heroes, and defend the last stronghold through deckbuilding synergy.

4727350.title: Giraffe Champion 2: Football Rock
4727350.short_description: Play Guitar to Great Rock Songs! Play Cool Guitars and unlock guitars like The Epic Rock Guitar, or the cool Heavy Metal Guitar Design your guitar and play in a cool concert arena. Compete in the epic Guitar Battle!

4727390.title: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
4727390.short_description: An interactive visual experience at the intersection of psychological horror and art installation. Explore fractured spaces, collect symbolic objects, and uncover a multi-layered truth. Episode 1 of a planned trilogy, built by a solo developer.

4727630.title: Sudoku Infinity
4727630.short_description: Sudoku Infinity is a classic sudoku game with unlimited sudokus, four difficulties, saved games, notes, colors, statistics, history, Steam achievements, and optional aids so you can play at your own pace.

4727680.title: Dream Game
4727680.short_description: Triggered by the "Sleep Letter", an endless nightmare begins. Day: Race against time to forge your destiny. Night: Survive high-stakes, real-time tactical battles. Die twice? Instant Game Over. Countless fates intertwine in the multi-ending SRPG DREAM GAME. Will you survive tonight?

4727720.title: Crowned Sun
4727720.genre: Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4727720.short_description: A 3D isometric MMORPG rooted in Yoruba, Candomblé, and Afro-Brazilian mythology. In the spirit of Ragnarok Online and Tree of Savior — choose from four peoples, master Base and Job levels, and find your place in the Mirage Kingdom under a sun crowned in legend.

4727810.title: Blooming Winter
4727810.genre: Indie, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4727810.short_description: A old-school top-down dungeon crawler where you explore and fight through the gardens of an old, abandoned castle. The game starts off simple, with new mechanics and more complicated room layouts being added as you go.

4727820.title: content moderator.
4727820.short_description: To pay for your mother's surgery, you take on a shady part-time job: "content moderator" Your task is to delete the "forbidden images" that must never see the light of day. Survive the creeping curses of this abnormal office.

4727910.title: Tisis
4727910.short_description: Tisis is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and sanity management as you navigate the thin boundary between light, darkness, and madness.

4727930.title: Deadlight Maze
4727930.short_description: Deadlight Maze is a tense horror maze game where players must survive deadly traps and escape relentless zombies using strategy, flashlight colors, and quick decision-making. Navigate dangerous mazes, freeze zombies with matching light colors, and survive the darkness before the maze consumes you.

4727950.title: CATARACT - Autobattler Roguelite Deckbuilder
4727950.short_description: Experience JRPG-inspired autobattles featuring unique combat mechanics. Recruit characters, level them up, choose their skills, loot monsters, and achieve perfect synergy to finally free the realm from the Allseeing's gaze.

4727960.title: The Deepest Shift
4727960.short_description: A psychological horror game about working night shifts in a remote underwater facility, maintaining equipment, completing tasks, and making it through another night.

4728070.title: The Crystalline Realm
4728070.short_description: The Crystalline Crystal is a fast-paced twin-stick roguelike where every run is a fight for control in a fractured, hostile universe.

4728140.title: Observation Protocol
4728140.short_description: A first person horror game where you monitor a liminal office space for anomalies from an external post. When the power cuts, protocol requires you to enter and continue your work from the inside.

4728230.title: Forbidden: A First's Obsession
4728230.short_description: Meet Nemesis; Ascendent being and terminally bored. Until the shimmer at the end of Creation, known as the Void, becomes her fixation - and her undoing. A short linear visual novel with gorgeous hand-painted illustrations; a mythic tale of curiosity and consequences.

4728250.title: Chrome Survivor
4728250.short_description: Make raves safe again! In this bullet heaven roguelite combine weapons into powerful evolutions, collect items to enhance your runs, equip and craft powerful cybernetic augments that change the way you play. Can you complete a 9 modded nightmare difficulty run and become John Cyberpunk?

4728350.title: DRIFT & GRIP
4728350.short_description: Master DRIFT and GRIP in one stylish racing experience. Adapt your driving style to dominate every track.

4728390.title: Sack Investigation
4728390.short_description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

4728500.title: Something on the Floor
4728500.short_description: You are left alone in a hotel where everyone has disappeared. Search the endlessly repeating floors for hidden anomalies, eliminate them, and escape. Trust nothing. Something is on this floor.

4728590.title: Sentry
4728590.short_description: Raid dungeons by day, defend your town by night. Slay hordes of monsters, loot gear, and master skills in a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler — then return home to build traps, place towers, and hold the line against the swarms, Clear every dungeon before the town falls

4728600.title: Sunnytime Friends: Episode 1
4728600.short_description: As a technician working for a local electrical company, you are tasked to restore power to an old animation studio which used to produce the state-wide cartoon Sunnytime Friends. Use your flashlight, Go through obstacles, And, most importantly, Don't. Get. Caught.

4728610.title: 古咒迷途2渊海 lost curse 2 abyssal
4728610.short_description: On a nightmare-devoured continent, players take a thrilling trip of trust and betrayal. Keeping the original classic JRPG turn-based combat, it blends fast-paced twist-packed shuangwen-style storytelling, delivering the ultimate thrill of uncovering truth in fatal fights against mimicking monsters.

4728660.title: Midnight Nasi Goreng
4728660.short_description: Experience the grit of the Indonesian night shift. Manage a street food stall through accurate architectural spaces and eerie corridors. In this world of meticulous dread, the grind never ends—and something in the shadows is watching.

4728670.title: Drifting Beyond
4728670.short_description: A nameless boy, in seek of a better afterlife, decides to drift to the end of the world. He will sail a boat, venture into a dark and dangerous yet wonderfully diverse world, and use his harpoon to deal with troubles along the way.

4728730.title: Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators
4728730.short_description: 1995. The legendary for a home console digital pinball classic "LAST GLADIATORS" finally comes to PC — 30 years later! What do the last warriors — the "LAST GLADIATORS" — fight for? Welcome to the Bloody Arena! Put an end to two thousand years of war, Last Gladiators.

4728960.title: Little Crimson Heroes
4728960.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
4728960.short_description: Little Crimson Heroes is a cute 3D tower defense game. Command young fighters of the Red Star Republic, build defenses, deploy machine guns, cannons, mines, and troops, then take direct control to stop the White Moon Federation’s invasion. Hold the line!

4728970.title: Escape, Chef Danegade!
4728970.short_description: Freely type or speak to AI-driven NPCs in this psychological horror RPG. Investigate a mysterious restaurant, gather clues and food, manipulate a dangerous killer, and survive long enough to escape.

4728990.title: 白色归途
4728990.short_description: Control a small white square, solve puzzles, gather ■●●●, and reach the exit.

4729020.title: Les jeux du cycle
4729020.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play
4729020.short_description: Les Jeux du Cycle turns your Bluetooth FTMS trainer into a cycling party game: sprint, dodge, team up, add bots, and outplay friends across 25+ minigames.

4729090.title: Senti Metrica
4729090.short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

4729230.title: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator
4729230.short_description: Open a plant shop in the heart of the city in this cozy management game. Grow plants, stock your shelves, decorate your shop, and get to know the locals as you build your own little green oasis.

4729250.title: Airline Founder
4729250.short_description: Starting from a single base airport, build your own airline. Establish routes, and fine-tune your pricing and service strategies; manage flight schedules, your staff, your fleet, public reputation, and more. Ultimately, grow from a regional carrier into a global aviation network.

4729280.title: Rogue Reels
4729280.short_description: Rogue Reels is a pirate roguelike where you build a slot machine to survive the Flying Dutchman’s toll. With over 100+ symbols and unique mechanics you can create combos to outrun a ghostly toll, and climb the global leaderboards. No real-money gambling included

4729290.title: Sweet Elevator
4729290.short_description: Sweet Elevator - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around elevators. Enjoy pleasant moments with five pretty and cute girls inside an elevator, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4729300.title: DeMon Researcher 2
4729300.short_description: A third-person sci-fi survival horror shooter. Enter the Green Dungeon, battle AI-transformed enemies, and uncover the devastating truth behind a monster born not from evil, but from a mother's grief. Explore, survive, and face what hides in the dark.

4729330.title: EGGCONSOLE RELICS MSX2
4729330.short_description: Seize enemy bodies to brave the mysteries of the deep! Featuring the unique "Spirit Ride" system and a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, Bothtec’s legendary 1986 masterpiece remains a timeless action-adventure.

4729340.title: 乱世江山
4729340.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4729340.short_description: 《乱世江山》集即时战略与沙盘征战于一体，立足三国乱世疆场，主打临场指挥战术交锋与宏大团战，在古战场纵横对决，尽享策略博弈与争霸豪情

4729410.title: The Song of Veridia
4729410.short_description: A fantasy top-down RPG with Souls-like elements. Uncover the mysteries of Veridia on an epic journey to stop an Evil Witch controlling the land. You must explore, fight and form connections in order to stop her.

4729420.title: Mewracle Brew
4729420.short_description: Help Smokey the cat save his home! Run a traditional Warung Jamu in Village Meow, master ancient herbal recipes, and brew the perfect cure for your neighbors. Listen to their stories, cook with care, and earn enough to pay off the ruthless loan shark, Bos Oyen, before time runs out!

4729460.title: Wanderblue
4729460.short_description: Wanderblue is a rhythm-roguelite that combines musical commands with tactical squad control in an original world: you’ll get to explore a living ocean filled with islands, recruit a crew from characters you meet along your journey, and plunder mysterious haunted treasures to grow stronger!

4729480.title: Last Ember
4729480.short_description: We fused deckbuilding and roguelikes into the ultimate single-player experience. Build a unique deck, summon dinosaurs to crush your enemies, and discover powerful relics to protect the Last Ember.

4729510.title: Assassin and Sister
4729510.short_description: Embark on a journey to save the world in this bullet-filled adventure, born from our desire to mix the joy of open-ended exploration with a top-down shooter's juicy game feel.

4729520.title: Apestin Explorer
4729520.short_description: In the early 2000s, a series of horrifying incidents shattered countless lives across the world. No one truly understood the purpose behind them. Some called it corruption, others called it power beyond humanity. The real monsters were never demons, but humans with absolute control over others.

4729600.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
4729600.short_description: You're a lighthouse keeper on a dark shore. Sweep your beam to guide lost souls home, and burn back the dark creeping in from the sea.

4729730.title: DYLIA
4729730.short_description: DYLIA is a 2D adventure game with a strong emphasis on exploration and narrative. This is a journey of a mysterious girl and a mysterious duck. As the game progresses, you will learn their true identities and the truth of the world.

4729900.title: FussyCraft Survival: Sandbox
4729900.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4729900.short_description: Dig, build, cook, cast spells and survive royal levies in a darkly funny 2D pixel sandbox. Explore dangerous locations, manage resources, fight strange creatures and grow strong enough to challenge the king.

4729910.title: Piece Block
4729910.short_description: This is a falling blocks game featuring rich gameplay and engaging strategic competition. Various mechanics are introduced across different modes, including capturing objectives, charging up energy, fulfilling specific conditions, and depleting the opponent's health.

4729960.title: Orbit Breaker
4729960.short_description: Choose a geometric core, survive escalating waves with automatic weapons, and evolve matching weapons and passives into stronger builds. Explore sectors, find unlocks, and defeat the boss.

4729990.title: Kill The Super Duper Big Monster
4729990.short_description: KILL THE SUPER DUPER BIG MONSTER is an idle/incremental game where you face different monsters while the game is running. Defeat various monsters to improve your skills, unlock cosmetics, and customize your island.
developers: Campus Cámara de Sevilla - Centro FP Superior

4730010.title: BomBee
4730010.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4730010.short_description: BomBee is a free-to-play skill PvP arcade about honey-bomb combo timing. Ranked is strict four-player free-for-all (~3 min max). Customs: 2–4 players—free-for-all or team setups. Grid blasts + free movement on one map. Cosmetics only; dedicated-server fairness.

4730100.title: Lizard Slayer
4730100.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
4730100.short_description: A pixelated adventure RPG set in Slavic mythology.

4730130.title: AITA: The Dark Domain
4730130.short_description: AITA: The Dark Domain is a dark fantasy roguelike card battler where every descent reshapes your deck, blessings, and risks. Build brutal synergies, survive mythic encounters, manage scarce resources, and push deeper toward Aita.

4730160.title: Wobble Ops!
4730160.short_description: Wobble Ops! is a fun, physics-based co-op platformer. Complete the course as fast as possible and lead your team and country to the top of the leaderboard.

4730170.title: Meow Mart
4730170.short_description: Experience the immersive fun of first-person restocking and cashiering. Launching with 6 distinct cat breeds—breed them freely, sell them for a profit, or keep them as collectibles in your store to boost customer traffic.

4730210.title: Organic Evolution
4730210.short_description: Organic Evolution is a neon platformer set in a microcosm. Jump across organic structures, break blocks, avoid hostile creatures, and find keys to navigate through 8 biological environments.

4730230.title: Cycle of Echoes
4730230.short_description: Cycle of Echoes is a dark sci-fi top-down action RPG featuring tactical exosuit combat, weapons, abilities, loot, upgrades, hostile machines, alien ruins, and boss encounters in a mysterious universe where something ancient has awakened.

4730270.title: Project Neon
4730270.short_description: Project Neon is a stylized evolution of the classic 2048 puzzle game. Slide, merge, and master the board to unlock new themes that redefine your visual experience. Simple mechanics meet new aesthetics in this addictive chase for the high score.

4730280.title: Hellsino Pokerlike
4730280.short_description: Stop playing blind luck. This is tactical grid combat. Deploy cards onto a ruthless 5x3 board to trigger overlapping horizontal and vertical sets. Master the Nexus Multiplier to unleash massive triple damage combos, outsmart a rigged house, and save your soul from absolute bankruptcy.

4730290.title: Dark Workshop Simulator
4730290.short_description: Dark Workshop Simulator is a first-person dark-fantasy shop sim. World events: plagues, war bands, shifting prices, keep suppliers unpredictable and demand in constant flux. Explore and unlock new rooms, brew potions, forge weapons, and sell to a clientele that is always a little strange.

4730300.title: Soliton Burst
4730300.short_description: An arena shooter where the arena keeps folding into something new: a Torus, a Möbius strip, a Helicoid, or others. Hundreds of enemies stream at you the whole time while you curve your bullets along the space.

4730320.title: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
4730320.short_description: Defend the city’s protected data from evil robots in a fast-paced keyboard shortcut action game built around speed, precision, and mastery.

4730330.title: CacaClicker
4730330.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4730330.short_description: The most absurd clicker on Steam! Click, produce, prestige, and dive into Corrupted Mode. Face bosses, challenge the casino, unlock 25 skins, 33 wallpapers, and dozens of achievements. A wacky universe for hundreds of hours of gameplay.

4730350.title: Jack Bonecroft 4
4730350.short_description: An outsider. A different world. A warrior who isn't finished yet. Lunara Mistwalker is thrust into a realm of secrets and ancient powers. Four kingdoms. One mission. Jack Bonecroft 4 is a story-driven action RPG. Based on true events witnessed during my business trip to this sector.

4730360.title: LIMINALITY
4730360.short_description: After his daughter disappears under mysterious circumstances, Liam Henderson takes matters into his own hands to find, investigate and safely bring her back from the depths of a multi-faceted cacophony of rooms known as "The Complex". Will he find her? Only time can tell, but it's unreliable here.

4730480.title: Deep Focus
4730480.short_description: Play as a camera-headed detective and partner with a superpowered girl to solve memory manipulation crimes. Gather clues, piece together the truth, and shatter fabricated lies in this unique mystery game.

4730540.title: TAILROUGE
4730540.short_description: TAILROUGE is a fast-paced minimalist action roguelite where your tail is your weapon. Move with the mouse, boost through danger, circle enemies, slice through swarms, and collect powerful cards to evolve your build in short, intense arcade-style runs.

4730580.title: Before the Tee
4730580.short_description: Before the Tee is a top-down golf course management sim. You run the links, not the round. Design the course, set tee times, manage the cart fleet, drive the maintenance cart around to fix issues, and watch groups arrive to play their way through a full day from sunrise to sunset.

4730630.title: ORBTRUDER
4730630.short_description: ORBTRUDER is a tactical roguelite action platformer about a ricocheting killer robot ball. Climb ever higher up a mysterious skyscraper. Ricochet, attack, slow down time, respawn, and try again.

4730690.title: Capybara: The Great Journey
4730690.short_description: 4-player co-op farming adventure. Play as a capybara and your animal crew to save your home from bankruptcy! Plant, repair, upgrade, work and explore from the forest to the city to pay your farmer's debt.

4730870.title: Cloud Clicker
4730870.short_description: Click the cloud. Earn achievements. That's it. Cloud Clicker is the ultimate achievement hunter's game: 100 unlockable achievements, one single button, and endless skies. How many times can you click?

4730950.title: BrightGlade Tales
4730950.short_description: Brightglade Tales is a forest-themed card game inspired by Point City and Splendor. Gather resources, recruit units, complete missions, and compete for control of key locations to outmaneuver your opponent in a fast-paced, tactical duel.

4730960.title: The Radio Tower
4730960.short_description: Your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine.

4730970.title: Center Of The Galaxy: Desktop Idle
4730970.short_description: An idle pixel-art space game. Your ship travels toward the center of the galaxy on its own asteroids get in the way. Break them, upgrade your ship, unlock new ones. Reach the center, and the next universe begins harder than the last.

4731010.title: VHS // Anima 021
4731010.short_description: VHS // Anima 021. Explore liminal labyrinths in search of anomalies in a first-person “found footage”-style adventure featuring retro graphics. Avoid the entities lurking in the shadows and uncover the truth hidden within the VHS tapes.
developers: Campus Cámara de Sevilla - Centro FP Superior

4731030.title: Webs of Reverie
4731030.short_description: Webs of Reverie is a first-person Survival horror game where you must explore the halls of Ironveil Psychiatric Hospital, solving puzzles, avoid detection from the staff, and managing your sanity levels. Will you decipher the clues and safely escape or fall victim to what hides in the shadows?

4731090.title: Etymancy
4731090.short_description: Etymancy is a dark fantasy roguelike dungeon crawler where every spell is a word. Craft your pile of magic letter tiles, collect strange grimoires to grow stronger, smite enemies, and descend deeper into the Lexicon.

4731120.title: Waifu Potion
4731120.short_description: Waifu Potion is a potion-themed adult puzzle game with 10 Early Access levels, direct two-block swapping, growing grids, hints, stage progression, and unlockable artwork.

4731130.title: Gospel Snow Town
4731130.short_description: Town is a post-apocalyptic AI survival simulation. Eight AI residents think, decide, and converse on their own, struggling to survive in extreme cold. You are an observer, watch them iterate through reincarnation cycles, memories and refining decisions until all survive.

4731150.title: Myth Finders 3
4731150.short_description: Dive into MythFinders 3, a hidden object adventure. Explore the world, uncovering secrets and legends of the past.

4731160.title: Read of Mask
4731160.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

4731180.title: The York Realms
4731180.short_description: Twelve years after your father sealed the demon lord Remus, the seal is breaking. Darkness rises, kingdoms start to crumble, and you are the last hope. Inherit your father’s power, face Remus, and decide the fate of a world on the edge of annihilation.

4731210.title: Antidote
4731210.short_description: 30 minutes. That is all the time you have left before the infection consumes you. Bitten and lost in the heart of a procedurally generated bunker, your only chance of survival is to locate and inject the antidote hidden within its depths. The countdown has begun.

4731250.title: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
4731250.short_description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

4731330.title: Abjure
4731330.short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

4731440.title: AIRSKIPPER
4731440.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

4731510.title: The Last Experiment
4731510.short_description: THE VIRUS IS INSIDE YOU. Play as an infected scientist trapped in a facility destroyed by the XPT-120 outbreak. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive hallucinations where reality breaks apart and nothing can be trusted. Wishlist now.

4731580.title: Aligned Hearts
4731580.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set in a San Francisco AI lab during a twelve-week sprint to launch a frontier model. Play as Pierce, Helion AI's co-founder, caught between three powerful women as deadlines, depositions, and go/no-go votes close in.

4731590.title: ChargeDrop
4731590.short_description: A physics-driven tower defense game where one massive cube does everything: fight, build, activate, and survive. Drop into a neon sci-fi battlefield, hold back waves of Chaos Dice, and power up your defenses through energy, momentum, and precision.

4731630.title: Bug Spray
4731630.short_description: Blast through swarms of unwelcome pests with your trusty can of bug spray in Bug Spray! Spray wasps and flies but avoid spraying fireflies! That's just mean. Experience realistic graphics clash beautifully with 2D bugs in this fast-paced, arcade-like game. Try to beat your high score without letting it get below zero.

4731830.title: Nahualli
4731830.short_description: Hide among the stalls of a bustling Mexican mercado as a shape-shifting Nahualli — or hunt them down before time runs out. But beware: when the clock hits zero, surviving Nahuallis transform into terrifying beasts, and the hunters become the hunted. 2-8 players. Party meets panic.

4731980.title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
4731980.short_description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

4732030.title: Don't Click, Hantavirus
4732030.short_description: Don't Click, Hantavirus is a game in which you control the doctor's hands by threatening to press the Red Button and apply an antivirus, while at the same time doing additional things in the laboratory.

4732270.title: Vibrant Vector
4732270.short_description: Vibrant Vector is a neon arcade roguelike where geometric entities collide in chaotic and vibrant battles. Create absurd builds, survive increasingly intense waves, and face powerful bosses in an abstract universe full of energy and motion.

4732330.title: Skelemancer TD
4732330.short_description: A tower defense game where you command an army of skeleton wizards. Unlock multiple magic skills on each skeleton wizard and switch between them mid-battle. Master fire, ice, lightning, and more to survive increasingly brutal waves of enemies.

4732340.title: Penance
4732340.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

4732420.title: Lovecraft Survivors
4732420.short_description: A Lovecraftian survivor-like. Wield forbidden tomes and cursed sigils against endless hordes of cosmic horrors. Survive 30 minutes against a rotating pantheon — Cthulhu, the Black Goat, the Eldritch Entity — and unlock 5 weapon evolutions before the Final Awakening.

4732450.title: Infinity Ship
4732450.short_description: Merge cards, pilot unique ships, and survive the cosmic chaos. A fast-paced space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

4732610.title: Hentai Age Airport
4732610.short_description: Enjoy a tranquil puzzle adventure where every completed challenge reveals another stunning portrait. Free from stress and designed for pure relaxation, it offers a calming escape filled with gentle gameplay and beautiful imagery.

4732700.title: Kingdom of Ashes - Fallen Era
4732700.short_description: A single-player roguelike deck-builder set in a fallen kingdom. Draft cards, chain elemental resonances, fight through procedural maps of battles, shrines, and bosses. Spend Ash at the Forge for permanent upgrades. Eight heroes, brutal Ascension tiers.

4732810.title: Gunk
4732810.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4732810.short_description: The world has been overrun. .  They are coming for everything you love, your mother, your father, your children, but most importantly they're coming for you.  Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity  Can you save us all?

4732820.title: Select Kiss +Plus
4732820.short_description: Select Kiss +Plus is a lighthearted visual novel where you choose two people from a colorful cast of six and lock them inside “The Room You Can’t Leave Until You Kiss.”

4732840.title: 邪恶厨师大战
4732840.short_description: Evil Chef Showdown is a cartoon-style puzzle game. Players accidentally enter a counterfeit cooking competition and must complete dishes within a limited number of moves. Through interactions with various characters, they gradually uncover the truth and conspiracy behind the tournament.

4732870.title: Tidal Strings
4732870.short_description: 《Tidal Strings》 is a falling-note rhythm game: light roguelike, custom creation, desktop wallpaper. All tracks have exclusive dynamic background. Full customization of audio, charts, wallpaper. Freely create your own tracks.

4732930.title: Don't mess with Er Kui
4732930.short_description: Don't Mess With Erkui is a pixel-style side-scrolling action game. It features satisfying combat, humorous stories, and fun puzzles. Fight various enemies and unique bosses, enjoying an exciting and hilarious adventure.
developers: Rizhao Youdian Yisi Animation Design Co., Ltd.
publishers: Rizhao Youdian Yisi Animation Design Co., Ltd.

4732960.title: Don't Go to the Bathroom
4732960.short_description: You woke up in grandma's house at midnight and need to reach the bathroom alone. Observe the hallway carefully. If something feels wrong, turn back immediately. If nothing changed... keep walking.

4733000.title: NEONFALL
4733000.short_description: NEONFALL is a fast twin-stick roguelite shooter set inside a flooding neon megatower. Grapple between rooftops, slow time mid-air, roll five weapons, and fight four bosses across seven biomes — solo or in Steam P2P co-op, with a full original synthwave soundtrack.

4733100.title: PNR: Point of No return
4733100.short_description: A 2D shooting space opera roguelite where you take direct command of a spaceship!

4733250.title: Defying Fate: 60 Days to the Exam
4733250.short_description: Only 60 days left. As a mysterious teacher, guide outcast students on the brink of ruin. In an abandoned rooftop classroom, use hardcore time management to skyrocket their grades. A top university rewrites their destiny; failure means the abyss. Their fate is in your hands.

4733420.title: Metro Architect
4733420.short_description: In Metro Architect, you will design, expand, and optimize realistic metro networks inspired by real-world transit systems. Build stations, manage trains, reduce congestion, and keep your city moving.

4733460.title: Moto Trial Turbo
4733460.short_description: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

4733500.title: PP Inflation
4733500.short_description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

4733550.title: White Signal
4733550.short_description: Manage a remote mountain shelter, rescue stranded survivors, and survive the brutal cold.

4733660.title: KRENDEL
4733660.short_description: KRENDEL — A soulful hand-drawn quest inspired by the finest traditions of Czech point-and-click adventures. Immerse yourself in the living world of Pip, a tiny knit wanderer. Watch ancient houses awaken on desolate piers, where clever puzzles are solved without a single word. Crafted by a solo dev

4733700.title: Terminal Cursor
4733700.short_description: Terminal Cursor is a fast‑paced reflex arcade game where you dodge evolving bullet patterns and survive as long as possible. Every movement matters. Features intense runs, rising difficulty, high‑score focus, and an original soundtrack by David‑Ștefan Horecica.

4733760.title: NEUROSLOP
4733760.short_description: On a rainy night, the protagonist steps into a café that has never been on this street before. Inside are strange visitors, conversations about how stories work, and an evening that lasts longer than it should. A short linear visual novel.

4733800.title: Kick The Dungeon
4733800.short_description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the SRD 5.1 rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

4733840.title: Little Battle Simulator
4733840.short_description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

4733950.title: Exiled Ark
4733950.short_description: You play as a survivor to build strongholds, scavenge resources, forge weapons, and battle inside and outside the vessel, while gradually repairing its damaged cabins. Space survival exploration, roguelike combat, six attribute cultivation systems and four tech trees with multiple endings to unlock.

4733960.title: Heim
4733960.short_description: HEIM is a multiplayer party game for 2-6 players where you play as trolls and while avoiding sun rays, retrieve artifacts scattered in the forest to bring them back to your cave.

4734060.title: A Lucky Hunt With : Myrina
4734060.short_description: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Myrina, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Myrina's enticing layers.

4734070.title: Moonsong
4734070.short_description: Explore and fight your way through a hand-crafted, whimsical world filled with powerful enemies and mysteries.

4734220.title: Neon Sunset
4734220.short_description: A brave little sun has found himself in endless neon dungeons! Help him jump across platforms, collect coins, dodge devious enemies, and destroy blocks in search of hidden treasures.

4734240.title: Crisis Cabinet
4734240.short_description: Lead a nation through elections, unrest, war, scandals and economic collapse in this turn-based political strategy simulation. Spend political capital, manage budgets, survive crises and decide how far you’ll go to stay in power.

4734280.title: Rumble Rush
4734280.short_description: Pick a fruit. Jump, dodge, grab power-ups, launch rockets at your friends, and try not to fall off. First one to the finish line wins. Good luck.

4734310.title: Needle Guardian 〜針の番人〜
4734310.short_description: Unravel the walls and reshape the ecosystem alongside plush creatures.

4734320.title: Drone Arena
4734320.short_description: Drone Arena is a TPS arena shooter roguelite where you control a Drone wielding weapons at a time to fight off hordes of mechas. Choose from a variety of power-ups and items to create unique builds and survive to the top of the arenas. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

4734350.title: SpellBlind
4734350.short_description: In this hand-drawn platforming rogue-like, play as an explosion-blasting spell-casting wizard with a new career: delivering mail! Although life within city walls is routine, devastating magic has left the world between untamed. Harness powerful charms to blaze your trail through the lands of Typety.

4734400.title: BAFF A
4734400.short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

4734410.title: Horse Spirit Valley
4734410.short_description: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.

4734490.title: Hentai Clicker: Serona is streaming
4734490.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Serona is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Serona, a seductive pirate captain with a playful side!

4734560.title: Lost Carcossa
4734560.short_description: Ascend the great tower, Babel, in this rogue-like to confront the tyrannical King in Yellow. Plan your moves in Turn-Based combat to ensure your victory and become stronger. Perhaps even recruiting new allies along the way.

4734580.title: Picky Boating
4734580.short_description: Organize passengers, fit awkward cargo, and solve clever spatial puzzles in a cozy ferry adventure where every seat matters.

4734620.title: CharaDiary
4734620.short_description: CharaDiary is a customizable idle character-raising game where players can shape characters, stories, and visual styles. Players can load official or player-made content packs, turning clicks, keystrokes, and everyday computer use into character growth.

4734670.title: Built by Day, Bitten by Night
4734670.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4734670.short_description: Built by Day, Bitten by Night is a cozy voxel city builder with a small problem: the zombies. And pirates. And yetis, robots, UFOs. Build your kingdom by day — farms, fountains, mansions, dragons. Defend it by night. How long can your keep survive till dawn?

4736510.title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
4736510.short_description: The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back! Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders! His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

4736520.title: TIAN NUO
4736520.genre: Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4736520.short_description: "TIAN NUO" is a dark indie Chinese MMORPG in the mythical "Dahuang" realm, fusing Shan Hai Jing and ancient myth. Three classic classes, gear earned through drops, hunt monsters freely, epic boss loot, true free trading. Slay demons with brothers and save humanity in this pure hack-and-slash world.

4736640.title: Sinheritance
4736640.short_description: Sinheritance is a terrifying and mind-bending puzzle game. Explore every corner in an intensely oppressive atmosphere to piece together a chilling story. Every step must be taken with caution, for the deepest fears often stem from your own choices and your gradually crumbling sanity.

4736790.title: Tactics Wanderer
4736790.short_description: A classic SRPG featuring 40+ classes, deep tactical combat, and a gripping narrative.

4736820.title: Ghost Trap: Underworld
4736820.short_description: John Ghost is back with a vengeance in this retro-metroidvania. Fall to the underworld, and explore. Seek to calm the horrors below to ensure a peaceful rest for your loved ones.

4736910.title: Stigmata
4736910.short_description: Navigate a distorted reality where the line between your world and a hellish mirror is bleeding away. In this PS1 style first person survival horror, you must fight, run, and manage resources to survive. Something is waiting for you in the confession booth. Will your sins be forgiven?

4736920.title: GAL-Chat
4736920.short_description: GAL-Chat is a desktop AI visual novel powered by DeepSeek API. Chat freely with unique AI characters, no preset options. Dynamic sprites, scene switching, and memory system let your words shape the story. Experience a story that never repeats.

4737000.title: EverestBaseCamp
4737000.short_description: Manage a high-altitude expedition base camp on Everest. Prepare clients, allocate supplies, watch the weather window, and decide when to advance, retreat, or risk a summit push.

4737050.title: Garden Eternal
4737050.short_description: The cozy garden that keeps on growing. Garden Eternal is an idle clicker where you tap a glowing Heart, raise bees & buildings, and draft cards through every season. A calm place, mostly. But the garden keeps its own hours, and not everything that blooms after dark is a flower.

4737070.title: Digiclimb
4737070.short_description: Rush and jump your way through this fast-paced platformer! You've made a mission for yourself to find lost media, you'll do this by any means. Speed across the map, using anything (and anyone) to find your precious media, now lost.

4737120.title: Backrooms: Negative Levels
4737120.short_description: A non-linear Backrooms experience focused on isolation, exploration, and uncertainty. This is not a puzzle game — every level can lead to multiple destinations through unpredictable noclips.

4737130.title: 铁血霸业传奇
4737130.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play
4737130.short_description: 鐵血霸業傳奇 is a Three Kingdoms-themed legendary role-playing game. Explore war-torn lands, challenge monsters and bosses, collect equipment and materials, and strengthen your character through warrior recruitment, equipment upgrades, and character progression as you fight for your own empire.

4737290.title: HullRats
4737290.short_description: A sandbox simulation where you manage oxygen, pressure, heat but also the mental and physical wellbeing of your crew. Take command of ships, scavenge, build, craft, survive the harshness of space in an emergent story where the world does not care about you.

4737310.title: Parfait Crane
4737310.short_description: Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game. Drop, merge, and stack fruits with a crane, chase high scores, and try not to let your parfait collapse.

4737320.title: GANA FORCE
4737320.short_description: Gana Force is a Horizontal shooter where you'll unleash powerful firepower, skillfully dodge bullets, and utilize the terrain to maneuver and defeat enemies. Game environments include alien cell levels, scorching sun, space battleships, and more. Powerful bosses and bullet hell challenges await you!

4737390.title: Hwaseo
4737390.short_description: A Korean folk dark fantasy deck-building roguelike. Three souls. One bound fate. Three companions are bound to one shared deck — every draw is a party question, not a single hero's. Journey through layered shrines drawn from Korean folklore.

4737610.title: PegPigeon
4737610.short_description: PegPigeon: casual physics peg action—launch through bright boards, chain hits, settle in slots. Limited shots; between rounds draft one upgrade or relic. Varied stages; gold funds meta upgrades, pigeons, skins; achievements and per‑stage bests add goals. Cute, snack‑sized, easy to replay.

4737920.title: Crisis Commander: Strait Of Hormuz
4737920.short_description: A satirical 2D strategy game set in the Strait of Hormuz. Control fleets, play cards, and manipulate oil prices. Meanwhile, your incompetent general keeps issuing increasingly unhinged orders. Keep the price of oil where he wants it, or the world will pay the price.

4737950.title: One-Time Trigger
4737950.short_description: Observe seven patients. Identify the one anomaly. Shoot to survive. You have only one bullet and no room for error.

4737990.title: Lumina:Last Bloom
4737990.short_description: Lumina: Last Bloom is an atmosphere-focused short adventure game about spending the final seven days with a girl afflicted by the mysterious “Hanazaki Disease.” Explore a quiet fantasy world, uncover memories through conversations, and experience an emotional story told through pixel-art visuals.

4738000.title: My Sexy Fairies
4738000.short_description: Step into the enchanting world of My Sexy Fairies, where you become the trusted assistant of four charming fairy girls. Each fairy has her own unique personality, magical talents, and daily challenges — and it’s up to you to help them succeed.

4738020.title: Drink Factory Simulator - Prologue
4738020.genre: Adventure, Casual, Simulation, Free To Play
4738020.short_description: Build your own beverage empire from scratch! 🍹 Experiment with recipes, find the perfect blend, expand your factory and fulfill massive orders. Every drop is your call!

4738060.title: Pour Decisions
4738060.short_description: A cozy café management game where chill mornings give way to frantic rush hours. Drag, pour, and juggle orders with physics-based drink mechanics as you expand your café across town.

4738130.title: 冷泉-阈限空间
4738130.short_description: A 2D psychological horror survival game with no weapons. Every time you enter, the map reorganizes itself. Walls can be broken with an ice axe. Invisible entities can only be tracked by the sound of their footsteps. In an endlessly looping liminal corridor, finding the exit is your only way out.

4738330.title: Night of her vanishing in fireworks
4738330.short_description: The Night She Disappeared in the Fireworks is a short visual novel set in a small Chinese city and centered on esports. You play as Liu Lan, a high school esports player, as he faces three life-changing matches and, together with two heroines, witnesses a fate rewritten by fireworks.

4738350.title: Velvet Emergency
4738350.short_description: You are a waitress at a sealed political dinner when a dam failure warning hits. Decide who hears the truth, who gets lied to, and what can be carried from the kitchen before the wave reaches the glass.

4738400.title: The Swarm
4738400.short_description: The game is about destroying aliens and fighting never ending waves of enemies. It is a retro, bullet hell, arcade like game where you try to score the highest number of points possible. After you die restart from the beginning.

4738470.title: RePair in the Space
4738470.short_description: RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship. Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself!

4738490.title: Rebel Wraith
4738490.short_description: Rebel Wraith is a fast-paced action game. Instantly switch between three different characters and use each character’s unique abilities, parkour mechanics, and combat style to defeat enemies in a smooth and satisfying way.

4738540.title: Time to Love
4738540.short_description: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

4738550.title: Dig into the core
4738550.short_description: Dig deeper in a run-based mining clicker. Break rocks, collect resources, upgrade skills, artifacts and pickaxes, and uncover 33 mysterious zones on your way to the core.

4738630.title: XENOCIDE PROTOCOL
4738630.short_description: One dev. One roguelite built shot by shot, feedback by feedback. Power up, survive the waves, face ruthless bosses — then tell me what's wrong. Every review gets read. Every update is for you.

4738650.title: FZDDR
4738650.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4738650.short_description: A silly side-scrolling arcade game where you play as a flying demonic zombie dinosaur with a chainsaw for a tail. Dodge obstacles, collect coins and cut demons in half. How long will you resist in this madness?

4738830.title: Cricket Management 26
4738830.genre: Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4738830.short_description: Build your cricketing dynasty in a deep and immersive cricket management simulation. Manage tactics, transfers, finances, player development and matchday strategy across multiple formats including T20, One Day and red-ball cricket.

4738890.title: Turtle Up
4738890.short_description: Only up — with the turtle and skateboard!

4738910.title: Labyrinth A Way Out
4738910.short_description: Lost in a massive surreal labyrinth, you must explore, solve puzzles, and collect three keys to unlock the gate at its center. Wander freely through a minimalist world where every path may lead you deeper into the labyrinth or closer to escape.

4738930.title: REDLINE — Strings of Fate
4738930.short_description: A sci-fi otome game where your choices shape love — and the future of society.

4739040.title: DISCIPLINE SIMULATOR
4739040.short_description: Challenge a friend to a PvP duel of Discipline. Who can complete the daily ritual fastest? Relieve the tension quicker than your opponent and don't get caught! Upload your custom 'target photo' for inspiration. Dominate in massive crowd-vs-crowd multiplayer battles. Become the God of Discipline!

4739070.title: SpaceCasino
4739070.short_description: SpaceCasino is a simulation game where you freely customize your very own spherical planet. Earn chips at an authentic casino located in a dedicated area, purchase neon-lit buildings, and decorate your empty planet into a space of your own.

4739150.title: Multi Brick Breaker
4739150.short_description: Face off against an opponent in real time: destroy all the bricks before they do with your paddle and ball! Use power-ups (multi-ball, fireball, freeze, and more) to dominate each level. Easy to play, hard to master—can you earn 3 stars in every match?

4739280.title: Aislebound
4739280.short_description: Aislebound is a first-person retail management simulator. Start with a small empty store and build it into a thriving retail operation by ordering inventory, stocking shelves, managing deliveries, hiring staff, and keeping customers satisfied.

4739360.title: It's Hunting Time
4739360.short_description: Hunting season is open! It's time to make some money as you roam the unexplored expanses of the empire.

4739510.title: Becoming None
4739510.short_description: Becoming None is a philosophical JRPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

4739600.title: Go Trump GO!
4739600.short_description: Dash through chaotic political satire in this fast-paced arcade runner. Collect power-ups, dodge curses, and outrun accountability itself.

4739680.title: Textorio
4739680.short_description: Crash-land on Kepler-442b. With nothing but a terminal, build automated factories from raw ore. Power them. Fight back the wildlife. Descend 4 world layers to save 50,000 colonists in cryo-sleep. ASCII factory automation, deep and brutal. Pure text. Pure systems.

4739710.title: Crown Jewels
4739710.short_description: Crown Jewels is a turn-based digital board game where 2-4 players roll custom dice, collect and steal jewels, use ally powers, and race to complete a crown before rivals!

4740160.title: Abyssalis
4740160.short_description: Descend through the ocean layers, purify marine life, and survive the abyss in this bullet hell roguelite. Face colossal bosses, choose powerful upgrades, and uncover the curse's origin. Can you save the ocean before you become fish bait?

4740190.title: Words are Hard
4740190.short_description: Words are Hard is a roguelite deckbuilder where you spell to survive. Build tile racks, place words on a power-square-strewn board, then chain tomes, enchantments, and lexicon levels into score-explosion combos. 12 characters, 181 tomes, eight chapters of escalating chaos.

4740210.title: Revive the Moonlight with Stardust
4740210.short_description: Destroy stars, collect stardust, and revive the lost moonlight. Roam the night sky freely to discover mysterious celestial bodies. Experience incremental growth.

4740410.title: A Game About Clicking A Rock
4740410.short_description: Click on rocks. Dig for ores, smash through boulders and sell precious minerals on a market. Use your hard-earned cash to unlock upgrades, buy better equipment, and expand your operation. Hire workers, customize theirs uniforms, and automate your growing mining empire.

4740460.title: 十米爆爽超变
4740460.genre: Casual, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4740460.short_description: Ten-Meter Explosive Fortune Overdrive is a casual business simulation game centered on the thrill of striking it rich. Experience the rush of getting rich overnight and embark on a high-energy money-making journey!

4740470.title: Autobus - The Card Game
4740470.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

4740740.title: Homesider Survivors
4740740.short_description: HOMESIDER SURVIVORS is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. You find yourself far from home against countless hordes of aliens...but they're the ones who have to survive, because they kidnapped the wrong guy. Kill, die, level up, and try again until you get home.

4740920.title: Fox Idle
4740920.short_description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, grow your settlement, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

4741110.title: Pangy: Into The City
4741110.short_description: A narrative action‑adventure game where you guide a mother pangolin through stealth, exploration, and survival challenges in her journey from forest to city.

4741210.title: Aspectless One
4741210.short_description: An isometric action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Collect the shattered Aspects of Omnia, master your skills, and face enemies that will test your limits. This is just the beginning.

4741270.title: Happy Little Farm
4741270.short_description: Happy Little Farm is a cozy farming game where you grow crops, care for adorable animals, and build a peaceful little life. Just don’t check whether the animals are still happy after sunset.

4741450.title: Skyfire Stronghold
4741450.short_description: Build and grow an idle medieval town as fast as you can. Gather resources, assign jobs, construct workshops, craft goods for coins, and defend against escalating enemy waves in a race to slay 50 dragons.

4741530.title: BIOTONE.
4741530.short_description: A pitch-controlled brick breaker where you move the paddle with your voice. Travel through 8 biomes brought to life with retro-inspired sound and visuals.

4741570.title: Forge Cat
4741570.short_description: In a quiet village forge, a cat blacksmith strikes the anvil. Enhance swords from +1 to +30, sell them for gold, and train your craft to raise your odds. Each cat gets only ten chances — a cozy sword-enhancement sim where generations of cats chase the legendary blade, Myo-geom.

4741630.title: Submechanic
4741630.short_description: Submechanic is a short horror game where you take an after-hours maintenance job at Captain Frill's Bar and Grill. You're required to climb down into the tanks in order to perform various repairs.

4741740.title: Hentai Sexy Nurse
4741740.short_description: 🎮 Hentai Sexy Nurse — an erotic anime game about a mysterious nurse. Solve puzzles, unlock hot scenes, earn achievements, and dive into a world of temptation and fantasy.

4741750.title: Chickzilla
4741750.short_description: Destroy, evolve, and grow until no skyscraper can stand in your way. How much of the city can you erase before the clock runs out?

4741820.title: 4MECHEROS
4741820.short_description: A predatory contract forces a fragmented band composed of irreparable broken friendships to get together for a final show, and a coming-of-age story about shoegaze punk, playing the bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

4741850.title: Fart X Bully
4741850.short_description: Experience a day of being bullied by Sakura, your super-bitchy, super-bratty, mega-bitch university bully.

4742010.title: CellShocked
4742010.short_description: Twinstick shooter! Aim for the highest score before you are finally overwhelemed!

4742040.title: A World Between
4742040.short_description: The world between is an adult NSFW visual novel game with dark fantasy elemetns, where you get to fuck all kinds of creatures that you fantasize about!

4742190.title: THE ASHEN HEIR
4742190.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4742190.short_description: The king is dead and the throne is yours. Hold together a kingdom torn by hunger, war, rebellion and court intrigue as you control the people, the army, the treasury and the nobles; expand your borders, silence your enemies and reach one of thousands of possible outcomes.

4742200.title: City Party Tycoon
4742200.short_description: City Party Tycoon is a fast-paced board party game where each match takes under 10 minutes. Play solo, team up with a friend to clear stages, or join ranked matches against other players. Roll dice, buy properties, use cards, trigger events, and enjoy chaotic turnarounds.

4742330.title: Classic: Snake
4742330.short_description: A tribute to the timeless snake game. Use arrow keys to guide the snake, eat food to grow longer, and avoid crashing into walls or yourself. Unlock achievements, compete on global leaderboards. Simple to pick up, impossible to put down.

4742370.title: Dragon Girls
4742370.short_description: Defeat countless enemies and survive. Dragon Girls is an action game with roguelike elements. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of monsters can come after you.

4742450.title: NIGHT MULE
4742450.short_description: Two months behind on rent. An empty fridge. Then, a desperate choice. Step into the high-stakes underbelly of financial crime as a money mule. Withdraw illicit cash, outsmart aggressive robbers, and survive the dangerous streets shift after shift. How far will you go to secure your survival?

4742510.title: Liminal Dreams
4742510.short_description: The elevator should have taken you home. Instead, it brought you somewhere that shouldn't exist. Explore liminal spaces, evade terrifying entities, and uncover the truth.

4742540.title: Bug Buster Bros
4742540.short_description: Welcome to Exterminator Inc. The kitchen is infested, your shift just started, and the only thing between you and a paycheck is a swarm of cookieroaches. Click, crit, and crush your way through four nasty rooms in this cozy-chaotic survival clicker.

4742550.title: Road to Omaha: College Baseball Dynasty
4742550.short_description: A deep college baseball dynasty management sim where you build a program across endless seasons: recruit, set lineups and rotations, hire staff, manage schedules, develop players, and play or sim every game pitch by pitch. Can you become the greatest coach of all time?

4742690.title: Bytes and Knights - Adventure
4742690.short_description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale TCG set within an RPG world, with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets, collect cards, build your deck, and battle increasingly difficult opponents. Each new card brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

4742940.title: The Stinky Adventures of DungDung
4742940.short_description: DungDung, a martial arts dung beetle, sets out to defend the kingdom from Princess Petunia’s creeping corruption...only to discover that he's inside a glitching videogame! He must MASTER POOJITSU. He’ll HARNESS GLITCH POWERS. Can you save the realm AND the game in this love letter to the classics?

4742960.title: Wolfbane
4742960.short_description: A dark fantasy werewolf action RPG focused on exploration, hunting, and brutal melee combat. Hunt enemies, grow stronger in human and beast form, and explore a cursed medieval world filled with secrets and hunters.

4742970.title: Cell #31
4742970.short_description: Cell #31 is a twin-stick shooter bullet hell game where you play as a lone cell fighting for survival.

4743000.title: Critter Climb
4743000.short_description: Critter Climb is an online 2D platformer where you and your friends climb through unique biomes and dangerous hazards. There’s only one way to go... UP! The higher you climb, the harder it gets and maybe give your friends a little "kick".

4743320.title: Busy Bar - World Tour
4743320.short_description: Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

4743330.title: Send It!
4743330.short_description: You are mail. The mailbox is waiting. Dash and jump through deadly levels at absurd speeds to ensure delivery! Perfect your routes, chase medal times, and master 100 bite-sized levels built for speedrunning and replayability.

4743390.title: Empire Together
4743390.short_description: Build your commercial empire in Empire Together, a co-op management tycoon where every player can found, design, and grow multiple types of businesses within a living city — solo or online with friends.

4743550.title: Cakey & Tanaka : CandyLand Adventure
4743550.short_description: Protect the world’s sweetest cupcake! Cakey & Tanaka is a 3D roguelite shooter where you lead a fated duo. If either falls, it’s Game Over! Combine unique spells and unleash Rapid Fire to blast through candy monsters and survive the perils of CandyLand in this high-stakes, sweet adventure.

4743680.title: Wild West Desire - Naughty Jigsaw
4743680.short_description: Step into a seductive Wild West adventure in Wild West Desire – Naughty Jigsaw. Solve spicy puzzles featuring daring cowgirls, dusty saloons, and irresistible western charm piece by piece. 🤠🔥

4743710.title: Forbidden Codex
4743710.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling pixel-art narrative action game .No text and UI. Long war between humans and demons, two girls transcend fate and hatred, heading towards their final destination in a crumbling world. Heavy combat, cinematic presentation,dual-narrative structure.

4743720.title: Tank Them All
4743720.short_description: Chaotic top-down tank brawler for 2–6 players — local or online. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive poison clouds and air raids, and dominate 90+ arenas across 4 game modes including King of the Hill and Golden Shell.

4743900.title: Road to the Grand Master
4743900.short_description: A 3D fighting action game where character can grow both in stats and skills collection to worthy title of the Grand Master. Skills are inspired by different martial arts, and can be combined into chain of attacks while character can still be able to fall back on defense.

4744010.title: Butcher hero: hook'n'chew RPG
4744010.short_description: Survival RPG: fight monsters & aliens, upgrade gear, defeat bosses for survival

4744020.title: Super Sub: World Cup
4744020.short_description: Win the world cup through clever clicks, useful upgrades, silly own goals, and bending the rules. An active twist on incremental games that strips football down to just its beautiful beating heart: kick balls hard, score goals, earn money.

4744210.title: Sumeeper
4744210.short_description: Sumeeper is a puzzle dungeon roguelike where Minesweeper logic meets monster hunting. Uncover tiles, deduce monster levels from hint numbers, battle them in auto-combat, cook their drops, and descend deeper — or die trying.

4744310.title: Melancholy Lake - Camocipher12 Shorts
4744310.short_description: A surreal, abstract kinetic visual novel in which two girls go on a date in the middle of a broken world, using down-to-earth intimacy to survive the deteriorating nature and reality surrounding them.

4744390.title: We Belong Dead
4744390.short_description: Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living. It has been far too long since you passed. You have been gone for so long. But no longer. I will bring you back my love. No matter the cost.

4744400.title: Verdant Requiem
4744400.short_description: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

4744880.title: YOGENKYO
4744880.short_description: Here’s your chance to become a young ninja of the Beasts Ninja Squad 4! Roam the stunning hand-drawn 2D bustling metropolis glowing with endless neon hues. Step forth fearlessly to battle vicious yokai gangs, and swear to defend peace and serenity across the city called YOGENKYO!

4744960.title: Reel it! World Fishing
4744960.short_description: Embark on a fishing adventure around the world! Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!

4745010.title: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you
4745010.short_description: 실존 코스튬 플레이어 5인이 직접 등장하는, 실사 비주얼 기반 연애 시뮬레이션. 옛날부터 알고 지내던 누나의 부탁으로 작은 메이드 카페 「코스텔라」의 임시 매니저가 된 당신. 라강, 아희, 보미, 아소, 린땅 — 다섯 명의 메이드와 함께하는 예상치 못한 일상 속에서, 다섯 가지 마음의 이야기가 시작됩니다.

4745050.title: 千年玄剑
4745050.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4745050.short_description: QianNian XuanJian is a free retro 2D martial-arts MMORPG focused on quest guidance, monster hunting, equipment progression, dungeons, events, and online Jianghu-style interaction.

4745200.title: NUNBORA: Frostblind
4745200.short_description: NUNBORA: Frostblind is an Arctic-based 3D 4-player co-op PvE extraction shooter. Explore randomly changing bases to mine survival resources. With all actions turning into noise, endure extreme tension, strategically evade monsters, and escape safely with your team.

4745310.title: Tachyon Fire
4745310.short_description: Tachyon Fire is a hectic movement-focused arena shooter that pits you against an army of surreal mechanical creatures in a nightmarish dreamscape. Ski, slide, and launch yourself through the air while tearing apart the horde with unlimited firepower and a magic hammer.

4745330.title: Backrooms Complex
4745330.short_description: Explore endless backrooms complex alone or with friends in the atmospheric horror experience. Survive hostile entities, uncover strange environments, and descend deeper into the unknown.

4745430.title: Spikes&Traps
4745430.short_description: A brutal 2D action platformer filled with deadly spikes, traps and enemies. Master movement, combat and skills to survive. Every level is a new challenge. Do you have what it takes?

4745440.title: Blackwood Lodge: The Siblings
4745440.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Blackwood Lodge in this atmospheric psychological horror game. As John Wilson, use your lighter to brave the dark, explore fractured spirit memories, and solve puzzles to piece together a tragic crime, all while evading a terrifying supernatural stalker.

4745450.title: Cradle of the Dark Brood
4745450.short_description: A dark fantasy incremental breeding game where you cultivate a monstrous brood, inherit stronger traits, unlock mutations and automation, then send your evolving creatures into conquest across a hostile corpse-world.

4745550.title: Shell Inside
4745550.short_description: Shell Inside is a psychological horror game with stylized graphics. Dive into the depths and confront your fears. Explore dark locations, search for items, and solve intricate puzzles while hiding from the terrifying ghosts of your own mind.

4745780.title: Desk Kanojo
4745780.short_description: Bring charming 3D anime girls straight to your Windows desktop! Watch beautiful 3D anime-style girls dance, pose, and move naturally with stunning cartoon rendering. Your personal desktop companions that make every day more lively and enjoyable.

4745890.title: LastWatch
4745890.short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror set in an abandoned subway station. Monitor cameras, manage your sanity, and survive the night shift while something moves through the tunnels.

4745980.title: Cow
4745980.short_description: The steaks have never been higher! Cow is the one and only fast-paced game about a cow riding a skateboard in a volcano above a pool of lava 🤘. Hop on your deck and milk each level, or become a well-done dinner.

4749110.title: 再见犹丽迪茜
4749110.short_description: 《再见犹丽迪茜》是一款关于音乐与校园青春题材的GalGame。高三艺考生李莫正处于低谷期。某天放学，他在本应空无一人的出租屋客厅里，遇见了一位陌生少女。她自称“犹丽迪茜”，很是古怪，却从此自然而然地闯入了他的生活。玩家将在游玩过程中体验一份别样的校园青春恋爱，并在结局处做出抉择。

4749290.title: Deeplords
