4749290.short_description: A dark HD-2D turn-based tactical RPG. Navigate by boat through hostile biomes, harpoon the Deeplords, and fuse them to evolve their rarity. Master the dice in battle and bend fate to your will. Build the perfect team or be swallowed whole.

4749360.title: Kung-Fu Space Fighters
4749360.short_description: Kung-Fu Space Fighters is an auto-battling roguelike deckbuilder where martial artists battle alien warriors through a slot-based card system. Build your deck, tune your cost curve, trigger combos, collect artifacts, and survive a cosmic kung-fu tournament.

4749600.title: Star Fable
4749600.short_description: Play as the last Star Princess in a magical Metroidvania adventure. Transform into Stardust to slip through walls, or summon a Slurp to squeeze into hidden spaces. Restore the broken wishes of a land in mourning.

4749820.title: IsoDead TD
4749820.short_description: Isometric hybrid aesthetic zombie tower defense. Variety of towers with upgrade paths, heroes with unique passives, multiple maps and difficulties, plus an Endless mode with card passives sistem. Solo indie, no microtransactions. Good luck, and have fun.

4749860.title: OH NO, NOT ANOTHER L
4749860.short_description: A classic puzzle game in a recognizable genre. No skills, progression, or plot. Just you, falling pieces, and the desire to beat your own high score.

4749870.title: Decline
4749870.short_description: Welcome to your new night shift inside an abandoned underground drainage facility, you should handle the power problems nobody else wants to deal with. Your main task is simple: monitor the security cameras, manage your limited electricity, and survive until dawn. But don't HIDE, they see you.

4749940.title: Knights v Zombies
4749940.short_description: Knights. Zombies. Pirate ships. Giant robots. A chaotic 1-4 player couch co-op hack and slash that starts medieval and ends in maximum carnage. If that sounds like the ravings of a six-year-old, that's because it is! It was designed by a kid with crayons and built by his dad in Unreal Engine.

4750050.title: Critical Fall

4750350.title: Kings of Oros

Control the chaos with endless build variety.

4750370.title: Crimson Grace

4750400.title: The Whisper Shift

A reporter investigating strange murders at a police station, and uncover details related to the mysterious deaths through notes scattered inside of the building.

4750520.title: ISO/2004
4750520.short_description: ISO/2004 is a grounded psychological horror game about guilt, trauma, and disturbing memories rotting inside a decaying provincial home. Step into a suffocating, atmospheric nightmare where raw emotional tension slowly warps reality. Face what you left behind before the shadows consume you.

4750540.title: Hapunan
4750540.short_description: Sell balut. Survive the night. Hapunan is a gripping story-driven horror game inspired by Filipino culture. When a routine permit run uncovers the Barangay Captain's violent secrets, Niko must fight a corrupt system to protect his family. Dinner is served.

4750550.title: Pink Slip Hearts

As CPO holding the layoff list, three women enter your calendar—and one choice turns corporate procedure into personal consequence.

4750850.title: Colorace
4750850.short_description: It will be an extraordinary ride! Drive your car through walls made of colored blocks, collect useful power-ups, avoid obstacles on the road, and compare your skills with other players.

4750920.title: Emberline
4750920.short_description: Emberline is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command a train through dangerous biomes, using cards to control your train's speed, defend your engine, fight off enemies and survive harsh environments. Explore the newly found continent of Pacifica and build the best card deck to ensure your safety.

4750930.title: Rabbit Claw Party
4750930.short_description: Catch lively rabbits with a claw in a cute scoring stage game. Read each rabbit’s movement, clear levels, complete tasks, collect stickers, decorate your photo wall, fill the rabbit catalog, and enjoy local two-player co-op or competition.

4751010.title: The Flesh Beneath
4751010.short_description: A dark-fantasy card-roguelike about giving the cathedral below what it asks for — one piece of yourself at a time. Sever your own flesh for power. Press blood-stones into your cards. Permadeath. Every name is remembered.

4751080.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
4751080.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

4751170.title: You Are Vacuum
4751170.short_description: A short incremental game about a robot vacuum. Pick up dirt and clean up floors! Purchase upgrades to move faster, increase suction, and increase battery life.

4751250.title: The Twisted Zone
4751250.short_description: A collection of two short stories filled with mystery and confusion.

4751270.title: KUMANO
4751270.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

4718160.title: 門 GATE
4718160.short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

4718590.title: 透明罪 - Blue Tears
4718590.short_description: A novel, a game, a judgment document, a self-confession letter. On an ordinary summer morning, the arrival of an unexpected visitor awakened the dormant memories of a small island. You will play the role of Lynn, and face your "Invisible Sin" by searching for a "Non-existent friend".

4718990.title: Sinemorsk: oil inclusive
4718990.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4718990.short_description: A visual novel about an environmental disaster. Coordinate volunteers, make difficult decisions, and try to survive as you try to save a coastal town dying from an oil spill.

4719350.title: A DAY TO REMEMBER

4720040.title: Terrafarm

4720160.title: CHIP & THE RED STORM

4720160.short_description: Run as fast as you can through this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling platformer! Deal with wacky enemies and bosses covering every track of your path. Sit down by yourself or with friends in this pixel 80's-90's inspired indie game and seal your decided fate of their world.

4720520.title: Gunsfield

4722210.title: Vampire Invasion
4722210.short_description: Lead a vampire horde in this reverse tower defense. Upgrade your units, assign your formation and breach the human's defenses to take back your lands. No more hiding behind towers. Be the mighty attacking force!

4723320.title: Eternal Dread
4723320.short_description: Eternal Dread is a Medieval Dark Fantasy Horror game. You wake up in a dungeon. Everyone is gone. Have your premonitions finally come true? You must use what you can find around you to survive.

4723450.title: Just Luck
4723450.short_description: Roll poker-style hands, collect powerful items, and build absurd synergies in this roguelike dice builder. Adapt your strategy, break the score counter, and survive increasingly difficult rounds as your build grows.

4724640.title: The Impossible Waterboy
4724640.short_description: Hi, I’m Waterboy. Help me reach the exit through mind-boggling rotating puzzle-platform levels where floors become walls, timing matters, and every mistake teaches you something. It’s almost impossible, but I trust you.

4724760.title: Drawtris
4724760.short_description: Drawtris is a legendary puzzle game distributed in 1984 China. Place tetrominoes with precision and complete each figure to achieve the highest score.

4724900.title: Infinite Bread
4724900.short_description: Infinite Bread is a fully automatic bread-themed idle game. You are a giant loaf, endlessly feeding your breadfolk. Spend bread to expand your realm, watch your empire flourish, and enjoy soaring numbers. Everything runs hands-free — feed millions while your hands stay free for other royal duties.

4725340.title: Certi drone pro
4725340.short_description: Stabilized drone simulator for maintaining and acquiring skills in the field of aerial work.

4725400.title: LUREFOLD
4725400.short_description: In LUREFOLD, face solo PvE battles. Collect 100+ items to combo your deck. Simple cards trigger huge chain reactions to turn the tide! This poker-roguelike features 5-15 min runs. With randomized loot, every build is a fresh experiment. Embark on a journey of infinite possibilities!

4725420.title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby
4725420.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

4725520.title: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
4725520.short_description: Dive into Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn! Rebuild an Atlantean capital amid coral and ancient magic. Manage resources, explore the abyss, and revive a sunken kingdom in this unique marine city builder. The legend awaits you beneath the waves.

4725570.title: Elsewhere
4725570.short_description: The story of Anne, a 14-year-old who dives into the world of adults to find her brother. Strange, unwelcoming, and sometimes absurd — a black comedy adventure.

4725600.title: Ore & Ordnance
4725600.short_description: Ore & Ordnance is a Retro styled, Sci-fi, Bullet Hell. Survive endless waves of Pirates, Asteroids and Firestorms. Collect upgrades, complete missions and survive your shift! How long will you last?

4725670.title: The Grove Within
4725670.short_description: A chill city-builder with roguelite elements. You are playing as a tribe of forest critters trying to achieve prosperity while maintaining the sanctity of the forest. Discover more than 80+ different buildings to construct and combo around.

4725700.title: Midnight Scour
4725700.short_description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

4725720.title: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving
4725720.short_description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving is a bloody third-person action game with a deep sword-fighting system. Experience a gripping campaign using your vast arsenal. Explore levels and unlock new content.

4725780.title: 死写ZERO -SHISYA ZERO-
4725780.short_description: A new series launches on the paranormal channel [Tatarium]. Your mission is to examine photos submitted by listeners and speculate on the incidents hidden behind them. But with each examination, inexplicable disturbances creep into the studio.

4725830.title: Slipspace Panic
4725830.short_description: A trip through slipspace gone awry. Shoot and evade waves of attackers for your freedom in this twin-stick shooter micro-game!

4725890.title: 永眠之匣，雪上之樱
4725890.short_description: Funeral home visual novel about farewell and companionship. Two timelines: Xue Hao with Elsa (REMOULD girl) and Xuan Ming with Yue Hua. 250k words, linear story, 10+ EX episodes, meta story after full clear. About 10 hours.

4725970.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in London
4725970.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in London 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4725980.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Milan
4725980.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Milan 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4727060.title: Street Workout Challenge
4727060.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Sports, Early Access
4727060.short_description: Arcade Fitness. Highscores. Trophies. Pain. Can you beat the Street Workout Challenge?

4727260.title: Puzzles: Dog
4727260.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4727270.title: Puzzles: Fish
4727270.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4727290.title: Puzzles: Monkey
4727290.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4727750.title: Magi Tower
4727750.short_description: Face intense MMO-inspired raid battles without the grind. Fight through challanging boss encounters in solo or in 1–4 player co-op, learning intricate attack patterns while shaping your build with randomized upgrades each run. Gather your party, choose your class, and climb the Magi Tower.

4727880.title: Hold The Line
4727880.short_description: Hold The Line is a brutal 4-player co-op zombie survival FPS where you defend a crumbling power core against escalating waves of the undead. Fortify barricades, upgrade your arsenal, and outlast the horde — alone or with friends. How long can you hold the line?

4727940.title: OxVOID
4727940.short_description: OxVOID — a minimalist puzzle game where physics, logic, and environment work as a single system. Master the rules through carefully crafted challenges. Then push the boundaries — create your own levels in the built-in editor.

4728560.title: Solis
4728560.short_description: Join Nina and RAM with a friend to explore the puzzles and challenges of Solis. Discover the mysteries and the natural and technological wonders of Tortuga Island as you embark on a journey toward the abandoned factory. Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

4728920.title: 我的女友是杀手
4728920.short_description: 高中生秦越有一个愿望——安稳过完高中。然而转校生铃木静的出现打乱了这份计划。沉默寡言、身手利落的她，自称是来“保护”他的。还没等他消化这一切——八卦的百事通、骄纵的大小姐、深不可测的学生会长，以及那位笑容迷人却暗藏锋芒的美女老师……一段交织着谜团、守护与心动的恋爱喜剧，就此开幕！

4729050.title: Vibe Train
4729050.short_description: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

4729080.title: Lil Laundry Lane
4729080.short_description: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

4729110.title: Abyssfall: The Black Citadel
4729110.short_description: Abyssfall: The Black Citadel is a dark fantasy tower defense game where you build defenses, control a battle mage in real time, and gamble on a tabletop-inspired d20 Fate Dice system against waves of abyssal monsters.

4729740.title: C.A.P.Y. He's got a licence to chill... and a flashbang
4729740.short_description: Guns, Cards, Capybaras A crazy RNG roguelike deck builder with guns.

4729940.title: Roomrush Racer
4729940.short_description: Race through 20 chaotic rooms with 27 characters in a fast-paced arcade racer. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local split-screen, collect items, master speed classes, and win cups together.

4731050.title: Who Clicked My Bones?
4731050.short_description: Who Clicked My Bones? is short Incremental Game about ruling a massive amount of skeleton army to sacrifice in order to Summon Lich King. Upgrade your skeleton in Skill Tree. The Game is designed to be finished in 4 hour playtime.

4731380.title: Circuit Keep
4731380.short_description: Maze tower defense with no fixed paths — the INTRUSIONs walk straight over your towers, so you carve their routes yourself with FIREWALLs. A capped CHARGE economy and pause-anytime planning make every placement a pure puzzle of position. Build the maze. Hold the CORE.

4731470.title: Astropath
4731470.short_description: Draw your path through the stars. Dodge asteroids, survive encounters, and chart a course across each level in this fast-paced skill-based game.

4731610.title: New Science
4731610.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play
4731610.short_description: A card combination game spanning the entire history of human discovery. Combine Bread and a Knife to make Sliced Bread. Combine Sport and Competition to unlock the Olympics. 6,500+ cards to discover. How far through history can you get?

4731620.title: Fortune Mill
4731620.short_description: In this incremental game, you must make $1,000,000 in each room to escape. Throw darts, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and choose upgrades carefully as each room affects all the others!

4733330.title: 28天半衰期
4733330.short_description: Six interdimensional exchange students. One ammonia spill. Four weeks to find a girlfriend — or marry the childhood friend who can throw a cow. A survivalist biology student's final semester just got a whole lot more complicated.

4733610.title: Tilt It! Golf
4733610.short_description: Mini-golf with a twist, all for the price of a coffee! Tilt the entire golf course to guide your ball into the hole, dodge tricky obstacles, and beat the clock to earn star ratings across 300 progressively challenging courses.

4733630.title: Mechgrave Overdrive
4733630.short_description: Mechgrave Overdrive is a sci-fi arena shooter where you pilot a mech, fight enemy waves, collect materials and credits, extract your resources, and upgrade weapons and equipment to survive increasingly dangerous runs.

4733640.title: Neon Shard
4733640.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4733640.short_description: Neon Shard is a 2D Platformer game featuring challenging time limited levels. Jump and stomp! Break the shards to gather resources that will help you to upgrade your factory and your character to face harder challanges.

4733690.title: Sak Winik : The Appointed One
4733690.short_description: Prove to AI that you are both "excellent" and "human" — in 7 minutes. A conversational suspense game where you debate two AIs across closed-room scenarios: a wrecked spacecraft, a deserted island, an eerie mansion. Logic alone won't save you. Contradiction, emotion, and hesitation are your weapons.

4734040.title: Moon Rocks and Slimes
4734040.short_description: A sci-fi, base-building adventure where you build a 'ship' on an asteroid; explore space, battle slimes, raiders, space rhinos, and more. A story that includes following orders from a mysterious AI, shooting fish with a space grappling hook, invading space stations, fixing the exploded moon, etc.

4734170.title: Pornographer
4734170.short_description: Pornographer is, first and foremost, an interactive FILM. A film where you can influence what happens on screen. The dark and absurd humor will definitely leave no one indifferent.

4734380.title: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires
4734380.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

4734610.title: Reactor Critical
4734610.short_description: High-stakes starship combat on a hex grid. Outmaneuver your enemies, unleash devastating firepower, or swarm their capital ships with fighter squadrons. Every decision counts.

4734780.title: Cat or Potat
4734780.short_description: Okay, big guy. So you saw a cat and thought you are a cat-pro? Let's see how you address a simple question - what is it that you see? Is it a cat, or is it a potato?

4734790.title: Haligen Zero
4734790.short_description: Find the answer in the incident involving the Professor and unravel the secret of the Awakened.

4734800.title: Corrupted Dice
4734800.short_description: Corrupted Dice is a dice-driven roguelike deckbuilder where bad luck is just something waiting to be corrupted. Roll, reroll, upgrade and break your dice to build combos, survive escalating encounters, and turn terrible odds into your best run yet. Fate plays dirty — so should you.

4734960.title: Curse of the Night
4734960.short_description: Curse of the Night is a 1–4 player 3D co-op action roguelite where every run is a choice: extract with your loot, or push deeper into cursed worlds for stronger builds and risk losing everything.

4735070.title: Fu Sha 3: Night Clinic
4735070.short_description: Spend a terrifying night of uncertain life and death in a late-night hospital via text adventure. *Fu Sha 3: Night Clinic * has numerous side choices and over twenty endings. Every choice may trigger unbearable horror—can you make the right ones, avoid fatal dangers, and escape this death curse?

4735210.title: The Supper Club
4735210.short_description: A cozy tablescape decorating game about preparing intimate dinner gatherings while cleaning out your childhood home. Create beautiful table settings and dining spreads through delightfully satisfying object arrangement as a heartfelt story quietly unfolds through memories and belongings.

4735230.title: Pile 'Em High Episode 3: Convalescence
4735230.short_description: Deep in Colorado’s Rocky Mountains, a secluded estate becomes ground zero for terror. Pile ’Em High 3 throws you into nonstop action‑horror mayhem—cultists, zombies, abominations—all standing between you and the truth behind the world‑shattering Pandemic

4735450.title: OKUREK
4735450.short_description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

4735470.title: The Perishing World
4735470.short_description: Survive a collapsing world consumed by the Blood Plague in this emotional third-person horror shooter. Fight infected creatures, scavenge for supplies, and journey through semi-open environments as a prisoner trying to survive long enough to return home.

4735560.title: The Order of Things
4735560.short_description: The Order of Things is a short first-person horror memory puzzle game. New objects appear one by one. Remember what was added, choose them in the correct order, and escape before your mistakes run out.

4735580.title: Żerca
4735580.short_description: A 2–4 player tactical card game forged in Slavic myth. Serve the old gods, complete sacred Tasks, and outwit your rivals for their Faith. Summon photorealistic beasts and spirits, banish the fallen to Nawia — then call them back. Online ranked multiplayer. Cross-platform. No pay-to-win.

4735600.title: Chess Peace
4735600.short_description: Find your way back to the surface by learning new movement patterns, out-maneuvring enemies, and helping stray figures in a surreal chess-inspired metroidbrainia.

4735640.title: Alarm112: Fire Unit
4735640.short_description: Command fire rescue operations under pressure. Receive emergency calls, dispatch units and make critical decisions in a realistic emergency response strategy simulation.

4735660.title: Cyber Spartan
4735660.short_description: Top-down cyberpunk action set inside a machine world. Three game modes, 37 skills, an AI that judges your every move. Hotline Miami precision meets bullet-hell bosses, katana parries, and hacking. PRE-ALPHA — shape the game with us.

4735670.title: SEO or Die
4735670.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4735670.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

4735690.title: MachWire
4735690.short_description: MachWire is a single-player speedrunning platformer where you use a variety of tools to get the best time!

4735710.title: Ascension Clicker
4735710.short_description: A simple clicker game to pass the time! Can you break the game with your clicking power? Click to upgrade, upgrade to prestige, prestige to ascend, ascend to the end. Buy special upgrades, boosts and even minor automation to help you along your journey.

4735720.title: Pegs & Sorcery
4735720.short_description: Harness magic through an enchanted pegboard in a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every ricochet fuels powerful cards, wild combos, and exciting branching runs.

4735940.title: Booya!
4735940.short_description: Acquire the letters B-O-O-Y-A to win. Booya is a chaotic party card game of stealing, bluffing, redirecting, and sabotaging your friends before they complete the word first.

4735960.title: Delligatium
4735960.short_description: Delligatium is a surreal first-person arena RPG where you devote yourself to a Striver, Gods born from mortal desire. Fight close-range battles with naught but a butter knife, suffer lasting limb injuries, uncover forbidden lore, and keep your miserable little mortal alive long enough to matter.

4735970.title: The Options Menu
4735970.short_description: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

4736040.title: XV
4736040.short_description: The operation has begun. Mars has been colonized, the earth is no longer habitable, your only choice is Venus. Follow the story of King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard's 15th studio Album Infest the Rats Nest and journey straight to Hell! Fighting off demons and cultists in this 90's inspired shooter.

4736200.title: Dial Z to Zombie: Zombies Attack the Beach
4736200.short_description: Dial Z to Zombie is a retro-inspired old-school FPS where zombies have invaded the beach. Use ridiculous weapons, rescue survivors, discover secrets, and blast your way through a weird ’90s-inspired zombie apocalypse.

4736300.title: 20 Floors
4736300.short_description: You are left alone on the top floor of an apartment. Your only goal is to reach the ground. But as you descend, the corridor you once knew begins to warp into something grotesque. There’s no telling what horror awaits. Just don't stop. Keep going down.

4736440.title: Word Rift
4736440.short_description: A fast-paced word puzzle game featuring handcrafted levels, speedruns, endless mode, and global leaderboards.

4736470.title: Dead Sector
4736470.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

4736620.title: Reverie Unbound
4736620.short_description: Search for the truth within a fantastical dream. Play as a world-weary office worker drawn into a beautiful illusion. Is it a heavenly gift, or poison wrapped in sugar? Begin your adventure, uncover its secrets, and find your answer.

4736700.title: Old Mate Dave
4736700.short_description: Pachinko meets ragdoll physics in brand new shenanigans, be 'A Chad' and catch the falling Daves with your trusty gurney, shoot the Daves around the Pinball table and shoot for a Plinko high sore! Go ahead and treat yourself to a laugh and treat that Dave like the ball he isn't!

4736940.title: Mary Editor
4736940.short_description: A powerful slot machine theme editor and game platform that lets you freely customize icons, colors, sounds, and gameplay rules to create your own arcade experience.

4737110.title: 风之国世界
4737110.genre: Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4737110.short_description: This game is a fantasy style cultivation+MMORPG game, focusing on character development, pet matching, and guild territory confrontation. Players use forging and upgrading as the core growth line to participate in guild territory wars and win the title of king.

4737150.title: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics
4737150.short_description: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics is a railway game focused on shunting, freight transport, and logistics work on the tracks. Take on the role of a train driver and railway operator, operate locomotives, assemble trains, transport freight wagons, and complete tasks on sidings, stations, and railway lines

4737180.title: Sex Vault: The Lust-Tec Project
4737180.short_description: Zombies ate the world, but your semen is humanity's salvation. The System rule is simple: drive juicy girls to wild orgasms for heavy base buffs. Manage the bunker and fight off mutants by day, enjoy the moans by night. The babes are soaking wet and waiting for orders. Show them who is boss.

4737370.title: 弈统三国：三国五子棋
4737370.short_description: Three Kingdoms Gomoku combines classic Gomoku with Three Kingdoms themes and general skills. You can freely build decks from various factions, utilize generals' abilities to create brilliant tactical combos, and enjoy the unique fun of skill-based Gomoku.

4737700.title: Tempo Tabbies
4737700.short_description: Tap to the beat and swipe away notes in competition with your opponent in this 4 column rhythm game. Add in optional special effects to hinder your opponent or ease your gameplay while competing for the highest scores

4737940.title: 镜中的光怪陆离
4737940.short_description: You are no longer a mere observer—you simultaneously play the roles of the hunter, the killer, and the redeemer. Amid fragmented memories and shattered personalities, you must piece together the dark truth of a human experimentation conspiracy that took place twenty years ago.

4737980.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
4737980.short_description: Manage your spooky potion shop and meet monsters! Solve the tragicomic problems of vampires, werewolves, ifrits and trolls, or pit them against each other. Scavenge ingredients, craft volatile brews, and enjoy this chaotic management simulation!

4738050.title: MansionDungeon
4738050.short_description: “Mansion Dungeon” is a retro RPG-style adventure where you manage an apartment building while interacting with demons. Venture into dungeons featuring nostalgic 2D graphics, and bring back so many rewards that they won’t all fit on the small screen.

4738170.title: A Good Deed On Harris Avenue
4738170.short_description: Untangle a web of wants and wishes from the residents of Harris Avenue in this brief PSX-styled puzzle-adventure game. Bask in the piercing heat of a summer afternoon, explore an intricately hand-crafted environment, and discover what A Good Deed On Harris Avenue has to say.

4738450.title: Necro Pop
4738450.short_description: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!

4738580.title: Space Annihilator
4738580.short_description: Command a powerful space warship and fight your way through relentless waves of enmy ships and bases to achieve the ultimate victory!

4738740.title: Dodgeball
4738740.short_description: Charge. Throw. Outsmart. A fast-paced 1v1 PvP dodgeball arena where clone decoys, charged shots, and game-changing power-ups decide every match.

4738880.title: The Last Comfort
4738880.short_description: Descend into a dying child’s fractured subconscious in this dark 2D Metroidvania. As a simple toy thrust into a grueling nightmare, you must master heavy, deliberate combat and adapt your skills to slay massive monstrosities. Will you fight the inevitable, or embrace the final sleep?

4738940.title: Authorisation Engine
4738940.short_description: Turn a payment desk into a global authorisation network in this offline incremental strategy game about capacity, compute, mandates, quantum audits, and synthetic jurisdictions.

4738990.title: Purge Directive
4738990.short_description: Survive endless waves of the undead in Purge Directive — a 1–4 player online co-op FPS. Earn points per kill, upgrade your arsenal between waves, and see how long you and your squad can hold the line.

4740600.title: Ouch! Cargo!
4740600.short_description: 4-Player Online Co-op. Push Carts & Loot Cargo. Troll Crewmates. Fight Beasts. Hit the Quota to Evacuate.

4741590.title: Sketch Kingdom
4741590.short_description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

4742070.title: The Son of Stone
4742070.short_description: Play as Sosruko, a warrior born from stone, and fight through mythic battles using three distinct combat styles and stone bending abilities.

4742180.title: 開かないランドリー
4742180.short_description: A short first-person horror game where strange anomalies slowly begin to appear in a laundromat you casually visit. As you return again and again, you move closer to the ending waiting in this place.

4742780.title: Through Ash
4742780.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4742780.short_description: Through Ash is a first-person tragedy where you control a logistics rover from a failing bunker. You never leave the bunker, only guide the rover via terminals. As mistakes mount, the rover’s “critical package” reveals a deeply personal truth.

4743130.title: Cubic Haikus - hikikomori
4743130.short_description: Trapped inside your monitor, navigate your fragmented mind in this minimalistic physics-based narrative puzzle. Shift your color to manipulate the world around you and uncover the hidden haikus that will guide you through a poetic journey into yourself.

4743370.title: Castle Ruglia
4743370.short_description: Awaken with no memory and uncover the secrets of Castle Ruglia in this retro-inspired story adventure featuring puzzle-solving, exploration, and turn-based combat in a hand-drawn colored-pencil world.

4743520.title: Don't Fall
4743520.short_description: Climb. Fall. Cry. A 3D platformer-adventure where gravity is your worst enemy. Explore a vertical world full of secrets, alone or with friends — help them, save them, or push them off. Reach paradise and eternal glory… if you don't fall first. Don't Fall!

4743540.title: Cricket Champions
4743540.short_description: Cricket Champions is built for everyone who loves cricket’s thrill, intensity, and pressure moments. Experience competitive online multiplayer and a deep single-player journey, with a fresh career mode, physics-based gameplay, and full control over batting, bowling, and fielding.

4744260.title: Sprawl Life
4744260.short_description: A 2D open world cyberpunk life sim, rise from the slums doing odd jobs, and become the faction leader in a towering dystopia. Hack accounts, own real estate from vending machines to nightclubs, fight enforcers, and keep upgrading your gear and operations. Or just serve bar drinks. Your choice.

4744270.title: Chess Combat Platformer
4744270.short_description: Enemies that move like Chess pieces! A fast paced, 2D Pixel Art Game, where you play as a Pawn and fight Chess Pieces. Survive flying bishops, face down charging Rooks, and Boss Fight Pawns.

4744360.title: Benny's Big Rescue
4744360.short_description: Benny’s Big Rescue is a whimsical action-adventure focused on story quests, exploration, costume abilities, platforming, puzzles, and light combat. Rescue Mr. Cuddles from Rex across Fantasea’s pillow forts, toy cities, and carpet wilds.

4744560.title: The Lone Stick
4744560.genre: Action, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4744560.short_description: Embark on a journey to kill the man who murdered your adoptive father. Fight and kill everyone who stands in your way, from killing basic foot soldiers, to fun and unique bosses. Get stronger with stat and gameplay upgrades.

4744610.title: Infinity Grass Cutting
4744610.short_description: "Infinity Grass Cutting" is a top-down action game with roguelite elements. Take on the role of a lawn-mowing robot tasked with clearing a wild, overgrown garden.

4744730.title: Monke Brain
4744730.short_description: His monke brain is bored, needs stimulation. Use your superior brain to design the perfect deck of cards that makes number go up. Monke sees big number, monke stays happy.

4745230.title: Science Has Left The Chat
4745230.short_description: “When others greed, I dread. When others dread, I’m ahead. When others survive, I’m dead.”

4745500.title: This Time - Part Two: Chapter 4
4745500.short_description: The dark, choice-driven erotic thriller continues! Your time-freezing powers are challenged by terrifying new reality-bending forces. Import your save or start fresh. Navigate escalating mysteries, stunning adult romance, and branching paths. Will you save the city or rule it?

4745530.title: Again：Loop
4745530.short_description: Find anomalies hidden within a repeating hallway. Miss one, or make the wrong choice, and everything resets back to the beginning.

4745630.title: Claw Machine Shop Simulator
4745630.short_description: A first-person claw machine shop simulator. Operate the cranes yourself, recruit passersby off the street, and chase out troublemakers with your own two hands. Then a rival shop opens right across the alley — and the competition begins. Complete the full doll catalog.

4745770.title: DreamRace
4745770.short_description: DreamRace is a high-speed arcade racing runner where you blast through 30 levels across six unique worlds.

4745800.title: Heroes Must Die
4745800.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

4746060.title: The Organ Woman | 臓器女
4746060.short_description: A 1–4 player cooperative horror game set in an abandoned hospital in Japan. Work together with your friends, collect boxes containing organs, and escape from the hospital where something lurks!

4746070.title: Eldara
4746070.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4746070.short_description: Descend into Eldara, a dark fantasy idle game where every skill, every monster, and every whispered secret carves your path. Train 17 skills, hunt legendary beasts, command loyal pets, and unravel a forgotten realm — at your own pace, with progress that never stops.

4746090.title: COLORIZED
4746090.short_description: COLORIZED is the perfect escape from the monotony of everyday life. This 3D coloring game has you transforming interiors and solving aesthetic puzzles.

4746330.title: Bladeforged: The Seventh Sword
4746330.short_description: Bladeforged: The Seventh Sword is a fast-paced 2D pixel art Metroidvania. Wield a versatile guardian blade and a high-tech bracelet to execute fluid combo cancels, parry ruthless abstract enemies, and explore the interconnected world of Regis to stop a cosmic multiversal invasion.

4746350.title: Dungeon Dash: Relic Of Binding
4746350.short_description: The Relic of Binding has chosen you. Navigate puzzles, battle monster hordes, and hunt for treasure through a dungeon that never plays the same way twice. Master the relic's power, beat the clock, and return it to its sanctum before the darkness spreads forever.

4746360.title: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate
4746360.short_description: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

4746370.title: Neon Rebound
4746370.short_description: A high-speed, competitive sports brawler where players fight to smash a glowing core into the enemy net. Dash, wall-climb, and slap your opponents out of the way in intense, fast-paced matches.

4746480.title: Bezdna Pickup Point
4746480.short_description: You're a new employee at the “Bezdna” pickup point. Work carefully and quickly. Don't keep the customer waiting! And God forbid the mimic creature eats them. WTF? LOL?

4746540.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
4746540.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

4746610.title: The Disclosure Loop
4746610.short_description: The city is in chaos. The building won't let you leave. A first-person horror experience built on paranoia, anomalies, and alien frequencies. Out June 10, 2026.

4746640.title: Radial Chess
4746640.short_description: Radial Chess is a chess game that preserves all traditional rules and mechanics while reimagining the board as a radial spatial structure, where players compete against AI or locally in a transformed geometric interpretation of classic chess.

4746740.title: Planks Wars
4746740.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

4746890.title: Last Round at the End of the World
4746890.short_description: Dream the riddle. Question the village. Choose who drowns. A poetic folk-horror game about divine messages, guilty villagers, ritual games, and the terrible cost of keeping a place safe.

4746910.title: +=- Under control
4746910.short_description: +=- is a narrative video puzzle in which each story has been broken into several fragments. Your goal is to put the scenes back in the correct order to uncover the meaning of the story and discover its ending, which is often unexpected.

4746960.title: Voluntary Isolation
4746960.short_description: Are you sure you want to see what's lurking inside? It surely already has seen you.

4747040.title: Debt Free Dopamine
4747040.short_description: Buy. Scratch. Win money. Buy more. Don't win. Buy even more cards out of spite.

4747060.title: GobboQuestIdle
4747060.short_description: Help Gobbo escape a mysterious cave, grow stronger, collect pets, fight strange bosses, fish, farm, mine, craft, upgrade gear, and continue the adventure in an endless fantasy world.

4747090.title: Futanari Dictator
4747090.short_description: Welcome to where absolute authority meets pure pleasure! 🌍✨ Futanari Dictator is a visually stunning and immersive journey that invites you into the world of a powerful ruler. 🎀👑

4747110.title: Not A Customer
4747110.short_description: Good job! you just got hired at your local grocery store and have to serve customer, it's simple as it sounds but theres a twist, make sure you serve real humans and not dopplegangers or it might be your last shift...

4747150.title: Cockroach Simulation
4747150.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4747150.short_description: Cockroach Simulation A terrifying insect-perspective survival horror game that will make you fear every sound inside the house. You play as a tiny cockroach struggling to survive. Because the homeowner is not always alone.

4747160.title: Ribeiras
4747160.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4747160.short_description: Ribeiras is a casual simulation game set on the banks of the Amazon River. Manage your family’s restaurant, gather local ingredients, and face the challenges that impact the village. Become part of a riverside community in this new indie game.

4747210.title: Night Hike
4747210.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure game about memories and choices. Exploring some woods, finding perspective, and peace.

4747370.title: Finesse Frenzy
4747370.short_description: Finesse Frenzy is a fast-paced arcade game about eating fish while eluding hungry hunters to climb the food chain. Quick consumption temporarily fills the finesse meter, boosting both speed and points earned. Do you have the finesse to maintain the increased speed, or will you crash and burn trying?

4747390.title: Ghost Control
4747390.short_description: Working for the Pest Control company, you have been tasked with exterminating the 'pests' out of the haunted mansion. What they didn't tell you is that the pests are spooky ghosts!

4747480.title: CatDemn
4747480.short_description: An archdemon trapped in a cat’s body! Transform a mundane home into your personal slaughterhouse. Orchestrate gory executions, harvest souls to unlock terrifying eldritch powers, and remind humanity that pure evil has claws.

4747540.title: Frontline Total Warfare
4747540.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4747540.short_description: Join the battlefield in a fast-paced FPS and classic military shooter featuring intense modern warfare, tactical warfare, smart offline bots, multiplayer action, private matches with friends, and bot-supported online battles.

4747550.title: Body Pillow Royal
4747550.short_description: Competitive satire on romantic displacement in the ever encouraged death-spiral of the post-modern age. 2-4 player online / local splitscreen. Darkly humorous.

4747680.title: Minecard
4747680.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game inspired by Minecraft. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

4747800.title: Vibe Idler
4747800.short_description: Run a vibe coding consultancy. Hire AI agents. Ship contracts. Buy faster machines. See how far it goes.

4747860.title: Horny Ladies at the Members-Only Pool After Dark
4747860.short_description: A single-route adult visual novel set at a neon-lit members-only night pool. Spend a dangerously sweet midnight with three seductive women: Karen, Miori, and Sae. With uncensored voice acting and an intoxicating poolside atmosphere, lose yourself in a forbidden adult fantasy.

4747880.title: Hex Master
4747880.short_description: Hex Master is a neon-drenched arcade arena shooter inspired by retro chaos. Survive endless swarms, unleash devastating bombs, climb the global leaderboard, and become the Hex Master.

4749170.title: Puzzles Desert
4749170.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4749180.title: Puzzles Mountain
4749180.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4749420.title: Suck Game For Friend
4749420.short_description: 'Suck Game For Friend' is a hardcore 2D platformer that demands absolute precision and embraces intentional clunkiness. Free of complex storylines or tutorials, the game relies entirely on your raw mechanical skill to reach the top.

4749430.title: Bumper Bites
4749430.short_description: Four friends. One food truck. A mountain of debt. After getting fired from the restaurant they worked at for years, your team has 31 days to cook, serve, and survive. Team up with 2–4 players in BumperBites, earn money and fame, pay off your debt, and watch out for the agents.

4749450.title: Liminal Agent
4749450.short_description: A psychological liminal space horror experience set across surreal backrooms, empty shopping malls, endless tunnels, retro locations and haunting hotels. Something is always watching you.

4749470.title: SongSurfer
4749470.short_description: SongSurfer is a simple and relaxing rhythm experience where you control a small airplane using your mouse as it glides along a dynamic music-generated track.

4749520.title: Artificial Magic Language System
4749520.short_description: Create your own spells and play the content!

4750100.title: FERALPALS
4750100.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4750100.short_description: Feralpals is a chapter-based mascot horror game. Humanity was wiped out by a pathogen linked to Friendly Pals, genetically engineered creatures, granted human-like intelligence to serve mankind’s ambitions. The Pals are now left behind, imitating their creators' society long after humanity vanished.

4750110.title: Hour Flowers
4750110.short_description: Hour Flowers is a flower breeding game. Plant flowers, discover new traits, and cross breed new ones!

4750590.title: On the Green: Endless Golf
4750590.short_description: The golf roguelike. On the Green is a deckbuilder for the back nine. Your bag is the deck. Every swing rolls a die. Stack the deck, work the course, bury your rivals in the sand. One shot, one roll, one trophy at a time. Tee it up!

4750600.title: Planet Terminus
4750600.short_description: A top-down tactical co-op raid shooter focused on deliberate combat, stealth or loud approaches, reactive enemy squads, and atmospheric close-quarters operations.

4750700.title: Echo Pandemic
4750700.short_description: You are a bat, and the aliens are afraid of you. Stalk occupied towns by echolocation, bite a single host, and let the virus do the rest. A stealth game where your weapon is a disease. Engineer strains, manage outbreaks, and stay invisible. The hunt starts at dusk.

4751140.title: Queueue
4751140.short_description: An abstract, tile-based puzzle game where the moves you make are for turns not-yet done. Dodging through traps you will arrive at 2 turns in the future quickly becomes a mind-bending puzzle as the levels grow more complex. How hard can a level with only 6 tiles be?

4751190.title: DEGENERATE STAR
4751190.short_description: Investigate the S.S Vandermeer and discover the fate of those aboard.

4751280.title: Delphi
4751280.short_description: A political sim where you are Delphi, the AI that guides the world government. Manage laws, budgets and global crises while you pull the strings from the shadows. Will they shut you down… or will you seize power?

4751290.title: Shear Field
4751290.short_description: It begins with a single sheep and the satisfying snip of your first clip. Welcome to Shear Field, an incremental sheep shearing game. You are not just a shearer you are the architect of a massive woolly empire.

4751300.title: Antarda
4751300.short_description: Antarda is a psychological horror experience focused on exploration, sound, and tension over combat. Traverse unsettling environments, uncover fragmented story pieces, and survive in a place that reacts to you. Every step triggers events. Can you trust what you see or hear before reality collapses?

4751340.title: Organize my Shop
4751340.short_description: Bring flawless order to the store! Switch between shelves and find the right items in the pile on the conveyor belt. Sort cheeses, meat delicacies, aromatic pastries, and sweets strictly according to the labels. Enjoy the moment of perfect order!

4751350.title: Dyno Burst: Bubble Shooter
4751350.short_description: Shoot, match, and burst colorful eggs in a dinosaur bubble puzzle.

4751490.title: Spherebound
4751490.short_description: Survive endless waves of enemies without the ability to move. Use spells, combine elements, and prove yourself worthy of the power of the mysterious sphere.

4751530.title: MathPunk Chronicles
4751530.short_description: Repair a collapsing by mastering the universe’s mathematical logic mechanics alongside the sages of the world and your evolutionary companion in this captivating, non-combat solarpunk puzzle adventure.

4751620.title: Legend Dary
4751620.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

4751660.title: Screamcorp
4751660.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
4751660.short_description: Bottle up real players' screams with your friends. You work as monsters and step through real players' bedrooms. And if they scream, you win. Every kid is a REAL PLAYER. If they scream into their mic, THEY lose. An asymmetric monster to victim screaming game with voice chat as the lose condition.

4751670.title: Hentai Clicker: Akira is streaming
4751670.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Akira is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock daring outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Akira, a mysterious ninja with a playful side!

4751870.title: Play and Learn English
4751870.short_description: First we get you speaking, then we make you better. With just 1000 words, make your daily English fluent. In a story-driven RPG, your microphone is with you, and the game listens. Fully offline, no subscription.

4752130.title: Rollie
4752130.short_description: Rollie is a fast 2D endless runner where you jump over obstacles, grab rare gold, chase high scores, defuse bombs, and unlock new ball skins through skill and persistence.

4752220.title: SIGNAL PIT
4752220.short_description: A fast-paced monster arena roguelite where every beast has unique passive traits, active skills, and powerful overclock abilities. Build your mutation loadout, survive deadly fights, and evolve between runs.

4752280.title: BrickHub
4752280.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4752280.short_description: Build, fight and compete in BrickHub, an online sandbox shooter where players create maps, battle in PvP matches and shape their own arenas.

4752310.title: Black Hole Idle
4752310.short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

4752330.title: Hall Pass
4752330.short_description: Co-op survival horror in a pitch-black school overrun by sentient moss. Scavenge, craft, and burn your way to the exit before the stalker catches you. 1-4 players. Fire is the only thing it fears.

4752380.title: Arrownomics
4752380.short_description: Arrownomics is a short incremental game about shooting arrows. Hire archers, build and upgrade targets, unlock new abilities, and boost your income.

4752490.title: Redline Hero
4752490.short_description: Redline Hero is an arcade racer inspired by classic racing games of the 90s and 2000s that can be played solo or with friends! Explore an open world, compete in races, drift events, rally stages and side activities to unlock new cars and driving abilities.

4752630.title: Shadow Gates
4752630.short_description: A roguelite dungeon crawler where every death feeds your shadow army. Solo Leveling-inspired power fantasy: clear 5 gates, master 5 classes, climb 5 ascensions. Every hit lands, every death matters. Built for "one more run."

4752780.title: Girls vs Goblins
4752780.short_description: In a fantasy world overrun by endless goblin hordes, you are the chosen summoner who must lead powerful elf girls into battle. Defeat enemies, upgrade your defense towers, strengthen your abilities, and protect humanity from destruction in this fast-paced fantasy defense game.

4752870.title: Nyaginata
4752870.short_description: Welcome to the world of Nyaginata! A hard-fought journey awaits as you carve your way past an onslaught of enemies! React and outwit in order to survive. Go forth! Make rapid progress!

4752890.title: KNOCKOUT ARCADE
4752890.short_description: Fight to save the KNOCKOUT ARCADE in this stylish 2D pixel art fighting game! Battle with a cast of 6 hand-drawn characters in both local VS and a side scrolling campaign mode, featuring simple controls with a unique twist on motion inputs.

4752910.title: Android Who Dreams of Stars
4752910.short_description: A short sci-fi visual novel with 15 scenes and 4 endings. Eve Nova's future branches through your choices, and following each ending leads toward unlocking achievements.

4752980.title: Mandela Invasion VR: Alternates
4752980.short_description: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

4753000.title: Surface Tension: Eclipse
4753000.short_description: Move lights. Walk on shadows. Surface Tension: Eclipse is a surreal 2D puzzlevania where cast shadows become solid platforms, every room is a spatial riddle, and the darkness hides more than it reveals.

4753080.title: Decian
4753080.short_description: One player and multiplayer (in Testing) zombie game with a thirst and hunger system. You must rescue survivors to recruit citizens into your community. Every time you or a teammate dies, the citizen count decreases.

4753090.title: RobotSurvivors
4753090.short_description: Three robots. One titan. Endless enemies. Switch between Vanguard, Storm, and Striker in real-time, combine into a mighty Titan, and blast through waves of rogue machines in this fast-paced top-down survivors game.

4753210.title: Demon Rising
4753210.short_description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

4753270.title: Plus/Minus Zero
4753270.short_description: As a research android, complete your mission of living a normal student life in this bittersweet slice of life visual novel. Record new experiences, revel in mundanity, and be a strange machine and a strange person.

4753280.title: EClone Station
4753280.short_description: A lightweight desktop room app set in your own corner of a space station. Decorate an isometric room, play music, manage notes and tasks, and spend time with friends.

4753350.title: Cage of Kurikaesu
4753350.short_description: Cage of Kurikaesu is a turn-based roguelite where an ordinary person awakens in a dark cave and becomes trapped in an endless cycle of death and revival. Gather information through failure, grow stronger each run, and fight despair to uncover a way out.

4753420.title: Celestia
4753420.short_description: A real-time 3D space simulator and interactive planetarium. Travel to any planet, moon, star, or galaxy and view it from any point in space and time. Accelerate time, land on alien worlds, and expand the universe with community-made add-ons.

4753430.title: Rift Horizon
4753430.short_description: A survivors-like action roguelike. Slay swarming enemies to gather souls, offer them at altars to unlock and upgrade passives, and combine 25 skills to build differently every run. Each run lasts around 20 minutes.

4753450.title: Bluff Card Game
4753450.short_description: Bluff Card Game is a classic card game of deception and deduction. Each round, declare a rank — then play honest cards or bluff your way through. Can you outsmart two cunning opponents with distinct personalities? First to empty their hand wins. 30-second turns. Pure strategy and nerve.

4753720.title: Parallax Blue
4753720.short_description: A strategy tower defence where you create the towers! Gather resources, build towers, defeat bugs, and survive. Unlock new weapons, create towers, gather resources, and die. Don't fall short of the Company's expectations... these resources are worth more than any life, including yours.

4753760.title: Your Fiancée
4753760.short_description: Elegant Desktop Companion Bring a captivating mature beauty directly onto your desktop.

4753780.title: Animal Rescue Network
4753780.short_description: Animal Rescue Network is a cozy sanctuary life simulation centered entirely around animal care, healing, and compassion. You arrive in the storm-torn town, where the beloved local sanctuary has collapsed, and the community is struggling to recover.

4754000.title: I FORGOT TO TAKE THE CHICKEN OUT OF THE FREEZER
4754000.short_description: You forgot to defrost the chicken. Now there are zombies. Aim, shoot, sprint, and reload through a stormy graveyard in this single-player survival shooter, dodging a relentless boss named Um Fatima while reflecting on the dinner that could have been.

4754040.title: Chronicles of High Worlds 1
4754040.short_description: Epic cinematic fantasy kinetic visual novel.

4754050.title: Hidden Button: Emerald
4754050.short_description: The third game in the Hidden Button series, a puzzle game where every level is different. Explore each stage’s unique rules and activate the clear button.

4754110.title: INKUBO
4754110.short_description: Eve, who suffers from sleep issues and nightmares, takes pills from Dr. Isaac that put her into REM sleep. She becomes trapped in a loop inside a distorted, other-dimensional version of her own home. She must find anomalies, make the right choices, and survive deadly entities to break the cycle.

4754140.title: ENDLESS SIGNAL
4754140.short_description: An idle hack-and-slash shooter with fast-paced progression, playable in the corner of your screen.

4754150.title: Fengtinghe Reservoir
4754150.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4754160.title: Atom Horde
4754160.short_description: Atom Horde is a dark survivors-like action RPG that blends Diablo-inspired combat with the STALKER-like atmosphere of Soviet decay as you battle hordes of zombies and mutants through the Zone in search of a cure.

4754250.title: Ultimate Freaky Night
4754250.short_description: Survive the night shift. Watch the cameras. Manage your power. Try not to get caught by horny animatronics — but if you do, well... that's kind of the whole point. A love letter to FNAF with a very adult twist.

4754260.title: Beach Defense: Zombie Invasion
4754260.short_description: Command soldiers, survive zombie waves! A light strategy game mixing turn-based & real-time strategy, bullet hell, and backpack-like mechanics. Fit troops into limited backpack slots, build max firepower, challenge difficulty levels, and defend the last beach. Perfect for tower defense & fans.

4754380.title: Lost Mind
4754380.short_description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

4754410.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
4754410.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

4754430.title: S.H.I.F.T
4754430.short_description: Can you handle the crazy packages dropping from the cargo chute? When S.H.I.F.T. kicks in and things go wild, forget the warehouse rulebook! Kick ’em, yeet ’em, and smash through hundreds of falling cargo missions. In this logistics chaos, only the fastest survive!

4754460.title: Crystalyn
4754460.short_description: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

4754470.title: Mini Gladiators
4754470.short_description: Mini Gladiators is a satisfying physics-driven gladiator roguelite with survivors-like combat, where every build reshapes how weapons, enemies, and collisions interact. Every impact is physically simulated, turning force, mass, and speed into damage, knockback, and satisfying physics chaos.

4754650.title: Space Pew Pew
4754650.short_description: Aboard your ship, destroy the hordes of aliens attacking you by choosing your weapons and upgrades as you play, and defeat the final boss! In this roguelite, each ship has a different weapon layout, giving each one its own unique playstyle. Then create your ship and develop your own strategy!

4754660.title: Ruler of the Roost
4754660.short_description: Fight to become the Ruler of the Roost in this chaotic chicken battle royale shooter where heavily armed hens, explosive eggs, cursed power-ups, and unearthly poultry horrors turn the barnyard into an all-out feathered warzone.

4754670.title: Japanese with Mayu
4754670.short_description: A short Japanese-learning visual novel where you play as an exchange student in Japan, learn vocabulary through everyday conversations, and check words instantly with a hover dictionary.

4754740.title: Market Chain 98
4754740.short_description: Build your Market Chain in this retro incremental game set inside a nostalgic 90s operating system. Start with a small shop, manage bank loans, expand your logistics hubs, and unlock global upgrades through your Portfolio. Fill your desktop with windows and dominate the market!

4754780.title: MixCD
4754780.short_description: This Games Industry Darling of an A.I. Powered Driving SIM is Sooooo Amazing, it plays itself!

4754800.title: Aura Farming
4754800.short_description: Aura Farming is an incremental tower-climbing game where you play as an immortal warrior, rescue allies, and grow your Aura to reach the top and save the princess.

4754890.title: Meowdventure
4754890.short_description: Meowdventure - is an Adventure RPG game where you play as Phil, who must overcome all obstacles in his path to escape a lucid dream and return to reality!

4754940.title: MACH BRUTALE
4754940.short_description: MACH BRUTALE is a vicious, high-octane, speed-climbing platformer. Tear through the districts of Hyper America, using your foes themselves as your weapon.

4754980.title: Nitz's Debt
4754980.short_description: Nitz's Debt is a cute pixel art stealth platformer. Nitz, the small yet incredibly horny kobold, must do her best to collect treasure and repay a debt owed to her mistress, the Dragon.

4755080.title: Peg Cascade
4755080.short_description: Peg Cascade is a neon arcade-idle game of bouncing balls, rising scores, timed clears, prestige runs, and shareable Custom Boards you can build, export, import, and challenge friends to beat.

4755090.title: Snapshot Survivor
4755090.short_description: Snapshot Survivor is an action-focused take on Snapshot, inspired by games like Vampire Survivors with an extra dose of naughty story telling.  Roam around in an outskirt of Tokyo trying to survive taking upskirt pictures for profit to unlock new weapons and cutscenes!

4755150.title: Cataclysmic
4755150.short_description: A explosive and dynamic top down shooter where you collect time energy from strongholds that represent cultures and mythologies from history in an effort to restore order.

4755190.title: SAMA
4755190.short_description: A young girl lost in a dark forest must survive among terrifying creatures, harsh nature, and her own fear.

4755220.title: Herald of Moira
4755220.short_description: Explore the region of Rosevale, craft potions through alchemy, lead an investigation against five suspects, and uncover the truth behind a massacre in this semi-open world gothic fantasy RPG.

4755370.title: Obstacles: Gems of Power
4755370.short_description: Slide between obstacles to collect gems and collect points in this bullet time arcade game! In Obstacles you're encouraged to take your time and plan your action to dodge obstacles which only move when you move.

4755380.title: The Wickers House
4755380.short_description: An atmospheric first-person horror game. You wake up after a road accident. Before you stands a house where you thought you could find help. But this house is a trap for those who dare enter...

4755470.title: Pixel Kitten Desktop
4755470.short_description: A cozy pixel desktop pet that brings companionship and comfort. It wanders around, curls up for naps, and gets hungry on its own — you can feed it, brush it, and watch it stretch and yawn beside you while you work. A quiet little companion that stays by your side while you study, work.

4755560.title: RPS Rumble!
4755560.short_description: Pick 5 cards before each match and use them to mess with your opponent, protect yourself, or flip the whole round. Simple to learn, surprisingly deep.

4755610.title: Welcome to Victorville
4755610.short_description: Your name is Gary Patterson. After waking up in a strange facility with your work partner Victor Adams, you must make a choice: Play along with Victor's plans? Or go it alone and make an escape? Only YOU can decide.

4755630.title: Space Invasion Infinite

4775700.title: Space Nomads

4775700.short_description: Build your own story in this procedurally generated galaxy, recruit specialized crew, design modular ships, take on contracts. Every choice shapes your ship, your crew, and your future.

4775770.title: Gelatinous Blob

4776040.title: The Moment of Panic

4779990.title: thimble dungeon
