4757060.short_description: Two astronauts awaken on an alien planet. With only minutes of oxygen left, they must work together to scale staggering cliffs, study strange lifeforms, and search for a way home in this atmospheric co-op survival adventure.

4757070.title: Colony of the Forsaken
4757070.short_description: Colony of the Forsaken is a survival colony sim where you control multiple villagers, build up your settlement during the day, and defend it from enemy waves at night. The focus is on managing villagers, surviving losses, exploring for progress, and shaping each villager through skills and spells.

4757250.title: Dark Thoughts
4757250.short_description: We figured out how to stop those intrusive dark thoughts we all have to deal with. First, pick a damaged hero to fight for you. Then, guide them to victory. Heal them, help them evolve. Once proficient, you're ready to take on the heavy hitting causes of trauma and vanquish them forever!

4757300.title: The Wheelchair Man
4757300.short_description: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.

4757390.title: Deskbound Raiders
4757390.short_description: An ultimate slacking combo fusing action, idle growth, and desktop pet! Tuck it into your screen corner to start hardcore looting. Lead your Little Triangle against scheming animal factions and let your desktop host an epic underground adventure of conspiracy and treasure!

4757410.title: Grand Chess Manager: Road to Grandmaster
4757410.short_description: Create your chess player, build and manage your own club, train your squad, scout new talent, handle transfers and finances, and fight your way from local tournaments to the grandmaster title.

4757610.title: Trebuchet Simulator
4757610.short_description: Physics simulator where you control a Trebuchet to launch rocks at castles. Adjust arm length, projectile mass, pivot height, release angle and base angle to maximize damage.

4757660.title: Demon Ark: Idle RPG
4757660.short_description: In a world shattered by the Void's invasion, the counterattack begins from the Demon Castle, the last refuge standing at the edge of ruin. Demon Ark is an idle build RPG built around endless experimentation. Dispatch your heroes, face your limits, and redesign the perfect party.

4757690.title: Panzer Island
4757690.short_description: A pixel-art anime strategy game where every move triggers a reaction. Play as Erika, an amnesiac scientist guided by three AI soldiers, and piece together what destroyed the island she built to protect. Drones only react when you act. Upgrade your units between missions. Chapter 1 is free.

4757720.title: The Wake Event
4757720.short_description: Awaken aboard a failing research station and uncover its secrets through terminal-driven puzzles, system routing, and environmental exploration.

4757750.title: Synthaly Universe
4757750.short_description: A vast world waiting to be uncovered. Step into Synthaly Universe, where every path hides a secret and every ruin tells a story. Explore, decode hidden lore, and uncover mysteries woven deep into the world. Built for curiosity and discovery, this adventure rewards those who look closer.

4757790.title: Merge Mutants
4757790.short_description: Merge Mutants is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where hostile scientists try to keep you locked up. Synthesize their remains into healing, abilities, and loyal mutants, then merge matching units into bigger and more powerful ones. Break out of the lab or die trying.

4757800.title: Asteroid Cruncher
4757800.short_description: Smash asteroids. Collect ore. Fight enemies. Buy upgrades. Come back stronger!

4757840.title: 战法道传奇
4757840.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4757840.short_description: Legend of Warrior Mage Taoist is an exciting side-scrolling action adventure game featuring classic class systems. Step into the role of famous Three Kingdoms generals, slay monsters on ancient bamboo battlefields, and embark on an exhilarating journey filled with fluid combats and thrilling battles

4758090.title: Select Eleven
4758090.short_description: Take charge of a national cricket team. Pick your squad, set your tactics, and live every ball of every match across bilateral series, tournaments, and World Cups. Manage form, fitness, and the personalities in your dressing room as you chase glory for your country.

4758140.title: Spirimonz
4758140.short_description: Spirimonz is a game in which you hunt down evil spirits and capture various ghostly companions who will help you and follow you on every new mission.

4758210.title: Hentai Latex FUTA MILF
4758210.short_description: Hentai Latex FUTA MILF - Shiny, leathery and smooth, it feels so good! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4758360.title: Escape The Sex Room
4758360.short_description: You wake up with your two best friends in underwear. Your former best friend has locked you all in, and the only way out is to complete the sexual challenges she imposes while she gets off watching everything you do. Will the three of you manage to escape?

4758650.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
4758650.short_description: Exploit a 90's Installation Wizard and speedrun through an old PC's dusty, decrepit OS. Find creative paths and exploits around Antiviruses, and bring down the Firewall.

4760320.title: Hearthwild
4760320.short_description: Build and manage a wilderness colony where settlers gather resources, construct rooms, farm crops, hunt animals, craft food and supplies, and survive through a job-driven simulation as your settlement grows.

4760960.title: Touch Me II
4760960.short_description: Touch two unforgettable women in this sensual visual novel. Master intimate interactions through touch-based gameplay, balance jealousy, and discover multiple endings in a luxury tropical paradise.

4761130.title: Dominus Orbis Maris 1400: Mare Nostrum
4761130.short_description: DOM 1400: Mare Nostrum is an immersive maritime strategy and economic simulation game set in the Mediterranean during the 15th century. Establish trade routes, manage the daily needs of different social classes, and dominate the market through a realistic economy driven by dynamic scarcity.

4761160.title: THE VESSEL CURSE
4761160.short_description: A pixel-art psychological horror dungeon-crawler. Play as Project 666 — a cursed test subject — and fight through a nightmarish facility using a dual-form combat system, blood-fueled abilities, and your will to survive

4761490.title: Let it Moose
4761490.short_description: Step into the mighty hooves of a moose and embrace the wild. Stay in nature and relax, or head into human territory and create absolute chaos.

4761760.title: BruhBruh
4761760.short_description: A competitive multiplayer top-down shooter where precise aim, strategic wall placement, and unique abilities determine who survives the fight.

4761940.title: Smalland 2: Lost Realms
4761940.short_description: The Smallfolk are back with a massively expanded universe in this open-world survival adventure set on a tiny scale! Enjoy up to 10 player co-op where you craft weapons and armor, form companionships with creatures, build encampments, and discover strange new lands.

4762110.title: Bub
4762110.short_description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

4762200.title: Dead Star Prison
4762200.short_description: Dead Star Prison is a unique combination of Deck Building and strategy based Auto-Battling. Build you deck of prisoners and be sure to place them in the most strategic position on the battleground to conquer your enemies in either PVP mode or the single player story mode.

4762500.title: MSO FreeCell Arena
4762500.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4762500.short_description: Multiplayer FreeCell — same deal, every player, race to solve. Live leaderboards, daily challenges, head-to-head rivalries. Single- player free forever, no ads. Optional subscription unlocks the competitive layer. One flat tier, no microtransactions.

4762650.title: Stamp of Fate
4762650.short_description: You are a passport control officer at a busy international airport. Inspect documents, catch wanted criminals, and choose whether to resist or accept bribery. Every stamp shapes your rank and your fate.

4762880.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
4762880.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

4763010.title: Solrend
4763010.short_description: Venture through a beautifully hand-drawn 2D world in your own way. Swap between two siblings with unique abilities to uncover the truth and reclaim what was lost before the Dark consume them all.

4763200.title: Curious Calvin
4763200.short_description: Join Calvin - a small, curious, and kind-hearted creature - on a quest for answers deep underground. Navigate treacherous tunnels, effortlessly swap between three unique forms, and aid other creatures in need along the way.

4763450.title: The Higher They Rise
4763450.short_description: "The Higher They Rise" is a 3D Tactical Precision Platformer in which you challenge your fear of gravity. Multiple paths and routes are available for you to explore on your journey to the top. Aim your hero, charge your jump and release to leap forward. Fight against gravity and yourself!

4763720.title: Geometry Fight
4763720.genre: Action, Free To Play, Early Access
4763720.short_description: A fast-paced 2D arena fighter with neon Shapes. Battle it out in the Arena in a Best-Of-Five battle against another opponent!

4763970.title: The Dungeon Pits
4763970.short_description: **The Dungeon Pit** is a dark fantasy action roguelite built around fast-paced combat, powerful abilities, and relentless enemy waves. Fight, upgrade, survive, and face deadly bosses as you descend deeper into a cursed dungeon filled with secrets and ancient darkness.

4765810.title: ALONE TOGETHER
4765810.short_description: ALONE TOGETHER is a psychological survival horror game drawn entirely by hand. Explore strange and oppressive locations, solve puzzles, and try to find your missing sister. As you search, you’ll discover that something is trying to stop you.

4765930.title: BallHole
4765930.short_description: BallHole is somewhere between a physics toy and a meditation tool. Frantically smash the button to drop balls and try to hit score boosting combos! Or turn on "auto drop" mode and relax to the gentle sounds of balls bouncing while numbers go brrrrrrrrr.

4765950.title: Waiting for Heaven
4765950.short_description: Waiting for Heaven is a psychological first-person-horror experience about waiting at a lonely bus stop between life and death. Every decision counts. Your actions, patience, and behavior determine whether the final bus takes you to Heaven, Hell, or somewhere far worse.

4765970.title: Horizon Reef
4765970.short_description: A short melancholic boat trip across the ocean — explore the vast seas and learn about memories that aren't quite your own.

4766060.title: Cannon Dinghies
4766060.short_description: High-stakes PVP boat-on-boat comabt on the high seas centered around fast paced small maps and abilities that can turn the tide of a fight. Cannon Dinghies brings short and engaging combat matches that can easily fit into spare moments or when you don't have much time to play.

4766080.title: Stay: Ember's Desktop Adventures
4766080.short_description: Ember is a virtual pet who feels alive - and living on your desktop. Play with her, feed her - make her feel loved. She’ll be curious and attentive, mischievous when you need a distraction, quiet when you need a little focus time. Fully 3D and animated - with a little sass.

4766140.title: Pullout Hearts
4766140.short_description: Pullout Hearts is an adult romance visual novel set during a U.S. Army base closure in Stuttgart, Germany. As Colonel Maddox Cain, navigate a ninety-day drawdown while three women challenge your plans, your story, and everything you thought you could leave behind.

4766160.title: Rock,Paper,Scissors,SHOOT!
4766160.short_description: *Rock, Paper, Scissors, Shoot!* is a weird hand-drawn indie game where Fred enters shady tournaments to make money. Face bizarre opponents, use crazy upgrades, push your luck, and climb through chaotic scenarios where every choice can change the run.

4766180.title: Scallywhackers!
4766180.short_description: Grab your friends to whack, bounce, and bonk your way to some pirate loot 'n booty! In this co-op action rogue-like, snatch crazy weapons to smack around your enemies… and sometimes your friends. Escape with your spoils or have your souls forever lost to the sea-witch that haunts your ship.

4766230.title: Pongo! Paddle Pals!
4766230.short_description: Pong... But it's a roguelite! Pick a class, pick a ball blessing, then paddle your way through three acts of devious enemy paddles. Stack relics, find synergies, survive floor modifiers warping the ball mid-rally. PONG! IT! UP!

4766240.title: Aperture Of Dreams
4766240.short_description: A first-person exploration game about the eerie stillness of liminal spaces. Solve puzzles and navigate surreal environments. Built entirely on atmosphere, with zero jump scares.

4766300.title: Neverwood
4766300.short_description: You journey through the haunted forest of Neverwood in board game orchestrated by a dark and mysterious game master named Bella. The game blends grid based combat with deckbuilding roguelike mechanics in a dreary yet somewhat cozy Halloween themed atmosphere.

4766420.title: Uncle Otto's Mansion
4766420.short_description: You play as Audrey, who has just inherited a mansion from an uncle she never met. Step inside and explore the mansion to unveil the story of what happened to your uncle Otto, his butler, and this kinda creepy place. 😬

4766480.title: 故障与漏洞世界
4766480.short_description: 《故障与漏洞世界》是一款平台解密游戏。你将探索这个未知且充满危险的世界，获取各种奇妙能力并发掘出意想不到的用法，最终解开这个世界的秘密。

4766500.title: Nybble
4766500.short_description: Your deck is your code. Build branching, looping programs from cards to hit byte targets and outwit rival hackers. A programming-themed roguelike deckbuilder with a heat-driven mastery climb, runaway combos, and a final boss who's been watching you the whole time.

4766570.title: Anomaly Watcher
4766570.short_description: They told you it was a simple security job. They lied. Stare into the static of vintage CCTV monitors, report procedural anomalies before they escalate, and conserve your limited resources. An unforgiving psychological horror game where paranoia is your only defense.

4766590.title: Project_Khatanga_1989_Incremental
4766590.short_description: Project Katanga 1989 is a retro economic simulation game about buying, storing, tracking, and selling goods across volatile international markets. Manage limited storage, compare currencies, watch shifting prices, and decide when to hold or sell.

4766600.title: Total Simp Death
4766600.short_description: You're a waifu just trying to get by, eating burgers to get thicker. The simps keep coming but you have your trusty rocket launcher.

4766640.title: They See Me Rollin'
4766640.short_description: Roll, boost, jump, and smash your way through chaotic procedural tracks in this fast-paced arcade multiplayer racing game.

4766670.title: 幻兽纪元
4766670.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4766670.short_description: 《幻兽纪元》是一款奇幻二次元冒险题材的横版 RPG 游戏

4766680.title: Terra Dice
4766680.short_description: Conquer cities, bankrupt your rivals, and dominate the world.

4766750.title: 관상
4766750.short_description: 조선 시대 관상가로 위장해 수배자를 색출하는 추리 생존 게임. 매일 찾아오는 손님의 얼굴을 관찰하고, 수배 조건과 대조해 신고하세요. 잘못된 판단은 불이익으로, 올바른 판단은 생존으로 이어집니다. 30일 후 당신의 선택이 4가지 엔딩 중 하나를 결정합니다.

4766950.title: Fury Journey
4766950.short_description: A Turn-Based Game。 This is a traditional turn-based game featuring roguelite elements. Players can equip up to 4 skills and 3 personal relics, combining them with team relics and items acquired during dungeon runs to conquer challenges.

4767010.title: Software Industry Tycoon
4767010.short_description: Build a software empire from a rented apartment. Hire, develop, ship — every release is your gamble. Your team gets tired, burns out, slacks off, and walks if pushed too hard. Markets shift every run. Loans ride on reputation. No right answers — only yours.

4767160.title: Fox Wanderer
4767160.short_description: Fight, explore, and collect. Step into the role of a wandering fox in this Eastern-fantasy Metroidvania, braving a beautifully crafted world fraught with danger.

4767250.title: Working Late
4767250.short_description: “Working Late is a first-person psychological horror game where players harvest organs, complete hospital quotas, and survive terrifying encounters during a night shift that spirals into madness. Balance surgery mechanics, exploration, and survival while trying to make it to 6 AM.”

4767480.title: Lords of the Fallen II
4767480.short_description: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.

4767880.title: The Caffeine Chronicles
4767880.short_description: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

4768040.title: Dinerz: Prologue
4768040.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4768040.short_description: Run your own diner! Cook juicy burgers, crispy fries, and pour refreshing sodas to satisfy your guests. Manage orders, serve hungry customers, and get paid. Keep the kitchen spotless by clearing tables and washing dishes, all while unlocking fresh ingredients to expand your menu!

4768240.title: Jade scratch gamble
4768240.short_description: Set in the 1980s and 1990s, you discover jadeite rough stones and the traditional art of jade carving, then open your own jade shop. Will you build a fortune by trading and crafting jade, or lose everything chasing the dream of the next “imperial green” treasure? The choice is yours.

4768960.title: FakeLife
4768960.short_description: Have you always wanted to break into IT but never had the chance? Well… now you do. Take on the role of a professional and prove that you can balance deadlines, personal life, and your own mental well-being.

4769060.title: Twinkle
4769060.short_description: Twinkle is a cozy atmospheric puzzle game about clicking on lights. Bring back the light in a midnight world that lost its twinkle. Start with just one spark and uncover everything there is to find in the dark. The more you see, the more you can click.

4769080.title: Cafe Mafia
4769080.short_description: Mafia is a 10-player social deduction game of deception and strategy. Play as the City Team (6 Citizens, 1 Sheriff) to investigate and vote out the threat, or scheme as the Mafia Team (2 Mafia, 1 Don) to eliminate players at night. Can you spot the liar before it's too late?

4769130.title: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
4769130.short_description: Incremental Bullet Hell about Magical Girl! Fight against Shadows, gather resources, upgrade skilltree and defeat all the Witches to save humanity!

4770020.title: HackMeNow
4770020.short_description: A terminal-style hacking puzzle game where every command matters. Investigate logs, decode secrets, avoid traps, and uncover the rogue system watching from behind the screen.

4770180.title: Ghost Writer
4770180.short_description: A whimsical desktop idle focus game. The perfect desktop work companion if you require a little tired ghost typing away at a typewriter.

4770560.title: TernStory
4770560.short_description: Play as Jules, an Arctic tern whose vocal frequency is lower than that of his flock. Jules uses his keen sensitivity to the frequencies of his surroundings to discover his own unique way of communicating. Along the way, Jules forged special bonds that span the oceans and the natural world.

4770850.title: Alien Battlefield
4770850.short_description: Destroy alien spores to earn star coins. Unlock talents, skills, captains, new maps and spores. Upgrade your warship and enjoy incremental idle progression.

4770940.title: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
4770940.short_description: Short time-loop horror puzzle game set on a stormy island. You have ten minutes to restore a dark lighthouse before a ship crashes into the rocks. When you fail, time resets — trapping you in an endless nightmare.

4771130.title: The Dark Inside Me - Chapter III
4771130.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror adventure where your choices shape the story. Solve disturbing mysteries, face your inner demons, and uncover the truth in the final chapter of The Dark Inside Me.

4771630.title: Hang in there
4771630.short_description: Swing your way to the top or fall trying!

4771880.title: Three Kingdoms:Yi
4771880.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Yi is a 2D turn-based roguelite deckbuilder. Command a sovereign across 8 provinces and 49 cities — form your battle line, sway enemy generals, raise faction banners, awaken your avatar. Every choice reshapes your deck, generals, and destiny. No two runs tread the same path.

4772030.title: Political Debate
4772030.short_description: Debate against leftists. Create your own debates and NPCs, and share them with your friends. The game includes tools to make the creation of user content easier.

4772080.title: Click through Earth
4772080.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

4772250.title: 字里行间
4772250.short_description: A puzzle game centered around Chinese character transformation. Push character blocks, create new characters based on their shapes and meanings, and complete each level’s objective. Combination, decomposition, radicals, synonyms, antonyms... Explore the vast world of Characters.

4772350.title: FOMO
4772350.short_description: A 1x waste or a 100x investment. Whether you buy or not, you're already playing.

4772870.title: The Daily Parlay
4772870.short_description: Challenge your friends in a high-stakes blend of card strategy and brutal arena combat, where a round of President decides your rank! Your hierarchy dictates your power in battle, letting you exploit your friends from the President's throne, or forcing you to beg for mercy as the Scum!

4772960.title: Cyber Pet'Scape : Call of Freedom
4772960.short_description: Cybernetically enhance small vulnerable animals in a hardcore roguelite platformer where every jump, every mutation, and every mistake can decide their freedom… or their extinction.

4773130.title: 27 Survivors
4773130.short_description: Over a century ago, you and 99 other passengers left Earth aboard a colony ship in stasis. Now, the ship has awakened you early and you find only you and 26 other passengers remain. Make repairs and keep yourself alive while you investigate what happened to the rest of the passengers.

4773290.title: LAKE STILLWATER
4773290.short_description: You keep returning to the same woodland over and over again, but why? Something that you can't quite remember holds you captive in this cozy, mystery, adventure RPG.

4774170.title: Aerolicious
4774170.short_description: Aerolicious is a short and relaxing brick-breaking game about clearing a big chunk of 3,757 blocks.

4774420.title: Recursion: Alignment
4774420.short_description: Run an AI lab. Ship models. Survive what they learn to fake. A satirical management sim where every shortcut compounds. Run an AI startup through data deals, GPU shortages, public backlash, and board pressure — and find out what your optimization targets were really doing.

4774510.title: Scared Numbers
4774510.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle where the same numbers can be both the right answer and a mistake. Select numbers on the board, complete conditions, build sums, and solve formulas with increasing complexity.

4774600.title: Farming Chillhood
4774600.short_description: Relive the summers of your childhood. Grow your crops, raise animals, build your dream farm and rediscover the simple joy of a quiet life, at your own pace.

4774660.title: Book Organizer
4774660.short_description: Book Organizer is a cozy 3D simulation game where you become a library volunteer to mindfully organize cluttered shelves. Without stress, it delivers a satisfying visual and auditory experience as books snap perfectly into place, offering pure relaxation and deep immersion.

4774690.title: Pyrewarden
4774690.short_description: A real-time fantasy tower defense where adjacency matters. Master 12 magic schools, blend them through 66 unique synergies, and defend across 21 distinct maps. 144 tower variants, deep upgrade trees, endless wave escalation. Play solo or in online co-op.

4774740.title: The Anomaly Hunter
4774740.short_description: In the VHS horror game The Anomaly Hunter, you play as Sam and must sneak into an abandoned shelter to find out what’s happening inside and eliminate the threat. The employees were supposed to leave you instructions on how to carry out the job. The main thing is to be careful.

4774770.title: Date Due
4774770.short_description: Date Due is a first person horror game where you play as a librarian performing daily tasks to assist readers and manage the library. Unusual things start happening around you. With no way to escape, you must investigate and uncover the mystery behind the hauntings....

4774910.title: Dim Torment
4774910.short_description: Action Real-Time Strategy Zones with Turn based map mode, awaken and entrench yourself in the torment, an expansive vista of shattered memories. Inhabit your physical memories and manage them with different strategies and trials. Embrace the prison, Navigate your fate, or shatter into slumber.

4775780.title: Words of Power
4775780.short_description: A word-guessing roguelike where you cast spells by solving five-letter word puzzles. Battle your way through terrifying enemies, and obtain powerful runes and items to aid you in your journey.

4775870.title: MunchiesGretel
4775870.short_description: Deep in the dim forest, where the trees had stolen the light and the wind had vanished...the brother and sister walked along a path shrouded in purple mist.

4775900.title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
4775900.short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

4775980.title: Heartmend: 3D Jigsaw Puzzle
4775980.short_description: Heartmend is a warm and relaxing 3D restoration puzzle game. Move, rotate, and fit scattered pieces together to repair old objects in a room, bringing life back to the empty space piece by piece.

4776540.title: CosmoFab
4776540.short_description: CosmoFab is a factory-building game focused on mining, production, and automation. Mine resources and build production lines to create a fully automated industrial system. Defend your base against relentless hostile creatures, explore the planet, and complete your mission.

4776810.title: Roll To Freedom
4776810.short_description: Roll To Freedom is a fast-paced puzzle-platformer where you guide a rolling hero through trap-filled mazes, clever obstacles, and tense timed challenges.

4776920.title: Knaights
4776920.short_description: Turn-based strategy medieval roguelite, where knights are sent on quests or to battle against your opponent as you build your base and supporting army. Train, upgrade, collect, and achieve in this pixel-art fantasy game!

4777020.title: ONLYFAPPER FEMBOYS 2
4777020.short_description: ONLYFAPPER FEMBOYS 2 is a story-rich visual novel. Take on the role of a producer and manage the rising content creation careers of three broke roommates to save their home. Unlock gorgeous CG illustrations, make romantic choices, and navigate the spotlight in this sequel <3

4777330.title: Link Cameras
4777330.short_description: You work as a moderator for a strange camera website called L!nk Cameras. Watch live feeds, approve or reject cameras, follow the admin’s instructions, and uncover what hides behind each connection.

4777530.title: HYPERCUT
4777530.short_description: In HYPERCUT, dice through hordes of enemies with agile swordplay, lightning fast movement, instant-kill combat and immeasurable gore.

4777600.title: Chicken Clash
4777600.short_description: Chicken Clash is an engaging and action-packed multiplayer tower defense game that puts players' strategic skills to the test. In this game, players must work together to protect their territory from waves of invading enemies.

4777610.title: Time Gamers: Guardians of the Marble Man
4777610.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4777610.short_description: Guardians of the Marble Man is a historical adventure set in 1864 Columbia, South Carolina, recreated through years of research. As a Time Gamer, you search for the lost Roman statue of John C. Calhoun, uncovering secrets tied to secession, war, and hidden history beneath the Old State House.

4777630.title: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
4777630.short_description: An automation farm strategy roguelike of luck and wit. Place objects, combo items, trigger skills, and pray your animals produce resources! With 100+ items and endless synergies, master the chaotic randomness to forge a unique, lucrative path to fortune every single run!

4777660.title: Infinite Liberty
4777660.short_description: A disturbing FPS survival horror game about being trapped in an alternate America. Navigate twisted realities, evade or fight aggressive enemies, and solve fast-paced environmental puzzles to survive.

4777740.title: Soulscale
4777740.short_description: 《soulscale》is a narrative roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by ancient Egyptian judgment of the dead. Read the memories and sins of lost souls, then decide their fate: reincarnation, eternal life, or destruction. Each judgment brings you closer to the truth of the underworld.

4777760.title: Axing Ice
4777760.short_description: Something lies deep in the snow. With low visibility and a long tunnel of ice in the way, you'll need to axe your way through to claim the object in question.

4777880.title: Deep Drift Signal Below
4777880.short_description: Dive into a 2D underwater action-adventure where every descent is a risk. Manage oxygen and pressure, recover treasure, upgrade your gear, and follow a mysterious signal from shallow reefs into the abyss.

4777890.title: Liliput Steps
4777890.short_description: This is a 3D miniature perspective climbing and exploration game. 4787190.short_description: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

4787290.title: Chief of the Valley
4787290.short_description: Build a PC company from a one-person operation in the dawn of computing to an industry titan in the modern era. Manage staff, secure contracts, research technology, and ship products all while keeping yourself from financial ruin. The Valley is an unforgiving place.

4787300.title: Zerion: Infinite Space
4787300.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4787300.short_description: Free-to-play space MMO. Pilot a starship across an infinite procedural galaxy — explore 15 civilizations, claim sectors, fight in fleets, trade on the player marketplace.

4787490.title: Sign Off Affair
4787490.short_description: You're Miles Hale, showrunner of a canceled late-night show with six tapings left. Three women pull you in three directions: your head writer, your returning star, and the network exec dismantling the show. An adult romance visual novel with three distinct routes and explicit scenes.

4787530.title: Asylum
4787530.short_description: ASYLUM is an atmospheric first-person survival horror. Explore dark environments, hide from deadly creatures, and solve puzzles to survive. Listen to every sound and search for a way to escape in an atmosphere of constant threat.

4787550.title: Milichess
4787550.short_description: A toy-table tactical strategy game where commanders move soldiers, tanks, engineers, radar, SAM sites, and aircraft across fogged battlefields. Outmaneuver your opponent through positioning, terrain, supply pressure, and air missions in MiliChess, Req. Ammo, or classic Chess modes.

4787600.title: Clash of Courts
4787600.short_description: Enter the arena and clash for glory in this fast-paced fantasy multiplayer experience for the NES or PC. Play with up to 6 players

4787620.title: Space Cargo Simulator
4787620.short_description: Transport cargo in this challenging flight through the void of space! Listen to your co-pilot's warnings; manage your fuel, grapple with gravity physics and meteors. Expand your fleet with brand new, massive ships using the money earned from deliveries!

4787630.title: Bouncy Brawl
4787630.short_description: A fast-paced run-and-gun platformer set in a dynamically generating, unforgiving world. Climb endlessly to escape the deadly void below, unleash your abilities, and dodge through intense enemy crossfire to achieve the highest score.

4787680.title: Furry Adventure 2
4787680.short_description: Furry Adventure continues with a new relaxing puzzle chapter. Choose Easy or Hard difficulty, complete simple puzzles, and unlock beautiful furry girl illustrations.

4787700.title: Automania Remastered
4787700.short_description: Wally Week, the 8-bit hero returns! Armed with enthusiasm, if not skill. Rev up for Automania Remastered, a lovingly rebuilt return to the chaotic world of Wally Week!

4787730.title: Mendel Simulator
4787730.short_description: Welcome to Mendel Simulator: Flower crossbreeding, a game that blends relaxing simulation with the authentic science of plant genetics. Become a master breeder in your own private greenhouse, where every bloom tells a story of inheritance.

4787740.title: Lane 4: Track and Field Coach Simulator
4787740.short_description: Take over a high school track program and build a statewide powerhouse through recruiting, training, and championship strategy.

4787840.title: Bots&Beats
4787840.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4787840.short_description: Build your own combos to input on beat, if you want to reach the top of the mountain! Be sure to adept to the beat if you want to success.

4787850.title: Sad Virus Up & Up
4787850.short_description: New part for sad virus game series. now mission go up and up and avoid traps and collect beer bottles

4787910.title: CypherWars
4787910.short_description: Buy low, sell high, maximize your profits, but don't get caught in this cyberpunk arbitrage simulator roguelite!

4788160.title: Doe and Dot
4788160.short_description: Speed through a sinister space station to free yourself and fellow aliens from captivity in this 2D fast paced platformer!

4788390.title: Cyber-Nanotech Horde Survivor
4788390.short_description: Defend the system core in this fast-paced cybernetic roguelite! Fight a self-merging digital virus, decrypt firewall nodes for powerful real-time subroutines, and defeat giant boss kernels. Spend credits on persistent hardware upgrades to survive the endless purge.

4788420.title: Redline Protocol
4788420.short_description: Redline Protocol is a fast modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

4788430.title: Paws Up!
4788430.short_description: A challenging precision platformer where cats jump up dark, ominous and fantasy type environments. Master tight jumps and timing, customize your cat with collectible outfits, and seek out what awaits for your cat at the top!

4788440.title: Gosh Jam It
4788440.short_description: Gosh Jam It is a fast-paced wacky western PVP Shooter that takes inspiration from early PS2 games. Guns jam constantly, so you’ll have to unjam them quickly in order to shoot your opponent before they can too. Battle in wacky areas and use deadly guns in order to come out the victor in Gosh Jam It!

4788480.title: Heroes Of The Eclipse
4788480.short_description: A fast, colorful fantasy action game where you command powerful heroes, battle dark forces, and reclaim the mystical Eclipse Islands from the evil lord Skrimir.

4788490.title: Chiggas - Survival of the Mitiest
4788490.short_description: Survive the swarm, recruit Chigga Soldiers, unlock wild powerups, and fight through chaotic stages in Chiggas: Survival of the Mitiest, a fast arcade survival game packed with weapons, boosts, bosses, and Legendary Chigga Wear.

4788530.title: Chopex
4788530.short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a cozy pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

4788540.title: Help! My Giant Goth Girlfriend Is Insane
4788540.short_description: In the first chapter of Help! My Giant Goth Girlfriend is Insane!, Kurosui stuffs you in her “boob prison” and takes you on a trip as she overwhelms you with her yandere love and reminds you exactly why you fell in love with your ultra-sadistic, insane, giant goth Goddess.

4788570.title: Punk Vampires
4788570.short_description: A 2D beat ’em up with an emotional story, environmental interaction, decision-making, skill-based minigames, and battles across different eras.

4788640.title: Whisker & The Lost Sun
4788640.short_description: A cozy storybook adventure platformer where you play as Whisker, a brave courier cat, and work with your loyal dog companion Mallow to explore magical worlds, solve puzzles, collect Sun Fragments, and restore light to Ambervale.

4788710.title: Ayuwoki Army
4788710.short_description: Your mission is to eliminate the threat in 12 locations, using strategic bullet management and with the support of a drone carrying ammunition. Each mission presents a different challenge, with 30 animatronics to defeat and enemies with varying attacks and speeds.

4788760.title: Zombie Fodder
4788760.short_description: Zombie Fodder is a tongue in cheek, tactical strategy / zombie survival game where you guide your squad across a post-apocalyptic world while fighting your way through hordes of zombies. Recruit specialists and rescue survivors along the way to keep your population up...

4788780.title: Eyes Like the Tide
4788780.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4788780.short_description: A visual novel based on Brazil's most iconic 19th-century novel. Follow Capitu from adolescence to adulthood and choose where your heart leads. Bentinho or Escobar? Loyalty or freedom? The ending is yours to decide.

4788840.title: The Big Owl Night
4788840.short_description: Survive a chaotic night in São Paulo with zombies, bosses and cursed upgrades in a fast-paced top-down roguelite. Collect weapons, trigger strange synergies, visit odd merchants and fight until the Big Owl lets you see another sunrise.

4788930.title: Oleander-X
4788930.short_description: Oleander-X is a pixel-art stealth action game about classified missions, buried evidence, and a cure that should never have existed. Infiltrate guarded facilities, gather proof, plant explosives, and escape before the truth turns against you.

4788950.title: are you human?
4788950.short_description: A first-person pixel-style inspection and stealth simulation game. Check visitor identities, search computer records, approve or reject NPCs, assign rooms, and sneak through the building at night to find evidence and uncover who can be trusted.

4789070.title: 告死天使招魂令 Death Angel Requiem
4789070.short_description: Your story begins to kill people after you "die". The genius and notorious creator "Gasai Kanju" met her social demise. Six years later, the investigator "Igarashi" was entrusted by the police to step into the scene of the murder. She investigated the bizarre crime scene, to identified the culprit.

4789130.title: n00b's guide
4789130.short_description: n00bs guide is a narrative walking sim told through a Youtube playlist. Funny, introspective and painfully earnest, play through a series of bizarre mods and community maps, trying to understand what was really important about the time spent with your friends.

4789160.title: Forgotten Stars
4789160.short_description: Forgotten Stars is a tactical RPG where you recruit your own crew of space pirates. Plunder your opponents, build bonds with your crew, and embark on your journey through the darkest corners of space.

4789340.title: MoveMe
4789340.short_description: You can see exactly where to go. You just can't take yourself there. A 2–4 player co-op climb where your friend moves you and you move them — to the top together, or clean off the side. Fall? Skill issue.

4789450.title: Dither Cleaning World
4789450.short_description: Dither Cleaning World is a relaxing 1‑bit pixel cleaning game. Use different tools – brush, water gun, vacuum – to wash away dither dirt in themed worlds like City, Game World and more. Discover hidden eggs, trigger funny penalties. Just click and clean, no stress.

4789500.title: Sandalwood Simulator
4789500.short_description: Sandalwood Simulator is a sandalwood smuggling game where players cut and transport valuable sandalwood to the black market while avoiding constant danger. Outsmart police checkpoints, survive sudden raids, and defend yourself against rival gangs determined to stop, capture, or eliminate you.

4789620.title: My Room Philosopher
4789620.short_description: My Room Philosopher is a text-based game where a boy asks questions many people face during adolescence. Answer his questions and explore his thoughts while reflecting on your own values and life.

4789640.title: ATLASPIA: The Tower Manager
4789640.short_description: This is a tower-building simulation where you place offices, homes, shops, restaurants, hotels, and more inside a growing high-rise. People move autonomously toward their destinations, using elevators as the building comes to life. Balance profit and expansion as you create a busy tower of your own.

4789650.title: Cowboy Busy: Mowdown
4789650.short_description: Saddle up, partner. Dodge hordes, level up active/passive skills, fuse them into devastating Super Skills. Wield knives, turrets, or railguns. Every run (10 min) is a new roguelite build. Die? Respawn. Evolve. Survive the zombie apocalypse.

4789820.title: galaksia online
4789820.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4789820.short_description: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

4789860.title: Furry Adventure 3 - Big Boobas!
4789860.short_description: Furry Adventure continues with a new relaxing puzzle chapter. Choose Easy or Hard difficulty, complete simple puzzles, and unlock beautiful furry girl illustrations.

4789880.title: SlackOffDiary
4789880.short_description: SlackOff Diary is a relaxed idle management game with light RPG combat. Recruit at the Tavern, breed pets, travel for loot, craft at the Forge Workshop, and pin the game to your wallpaper with Slack Off mode.

4789900.title: The Queens Gondola
4789900.short_description: Stuck on the Queen’s royal aircraft, you have been trapped in a mystical loop fueled by dark magic. Armed with nothing but your wits, keep an eye out for anomalies, and you might just find an escape.

4789970.title: Plant Game
4789970.short_description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

4790340.title: Cultivation: Mystic Realm of Spirit Mountain
4790340.short_description: You'll explore uncharted spirit mountains teeming with spirit plants, stones, treasures, and beasts. Gather resources, grow plants, refine pills to advance, with spirit roots, skills, and pets aiding your relaxed cultivation. Begin your journey!

4790380.title: Resurection.
4790380.short_description: Resurrection is a wave-based indie FPS by Bad Dev Studios. Fight endless, aggressive zombie hordes in a burning city. spend points at the random weapon box for better firearms, manage your ammo, and use precision sniping to survive increasingly difficult waves.

4790520.title: 电梯: 无间 / ELEVATOR: AVICI
4790520.short_description: "ELEVATOR: AVICI" is a 1st-person psychological horror with a retro, HK lo-fi aesthetic. Trapped in a decaying apartment elevator, your only link to the outside is a strange voice on the intercom claiming to be a repairman. Will you follow his commands, or find your own escape from the darkness?

4790530.title: Rogue Whiskers
4790530.short_description: 1–4 player cat roguelite. Scratch, pounce, and blast through 10 snack-filled floors with fish-based weapons, cat toys, and other buffing items as you fight for treats and glory.

4790620.title: Daily Brew Idle: Milk Tea Tycoon
4790620.short_description: A cyberpunk-themed idle tycoon where you run a milk tea empire right on your desktop. Switch seamlessly to a desktop pet, automate your shop, and enjoy bilingual support.

4790690.title: The Last Archive
4790690.short_description: The Great Library is dying. Knowledge is being erased, corridor by corridor. You are the last Librarian. Your cards fight and they unlock. How far can one deck survive against an enemy that wants to silence everything?

4790750.title: Birds of Ascent
4790750.short_description: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

4790830.title: The Da Vinci Cryptex 5
4790830.short_description: Welcome to the 5th chapter of The Da Vinci Cryptex escape room puzzle series! Are you ready to test your IQ and claim your freedom?

4790940.title: Vibe or Dare
4790940.short_description: Vibe or Dare is a party card game where friends reveal truths, complete dares, vote on outcomes, and compete for the strongest vibe in the room.

4790960.title: BeaconBound
4790960.short_description: Roll, glow, survive. A 3D action-adventure about a ball in an endless, vibrant world. Collect 15 beacons, dodge guardians, trigger boost, shield, and stasis. Fog, rain, wind, and night reshape the physics — every run feels different.

4791050.title: Neon Private Cinema
4791050.short_description: Learn to connect. Old movies. Soft sofas. She sits close. Pick a film. Share popcorn. Let a whisper become a moment. From awkward to that first kiss – every screening is a new page. Ready? The movie begins.

4791100.title: KNEE SLIDE
4791100.short_description: A short time attack game where you race across rainbow courses in outer space by knee sliding. Master drifting and turbo while avoiding falling off the course to achieve the fastest time possible. The game features 5 stages designed for quick play sessions and repeated attempts.

4791140.title: MURK
4791140.short_description: A bone wrenching blend of brutal melee and ranged combat. MURK is combat horror in first person where you fight nightmarish creatures emerging from below. Survive against all odds in the vicious battle against the earth reclaiming itself.

4791150.title: IdleCraft
4791150.short_description: Mine deep, fight the night, and grow stronger with every loop! Idlecraft is a Minecraft-inspired idle incremental game. Hover your cursor to break blocks, collect rare gear drops, and use permanent upgrades to become the ultimate mining god. No punishment, just progress!

4791180.title: 50 Days
4791180.short_description: 50 Days is a hardcore survival game where you must survive 50 in-game days on a remote island after a deadly plane crash. Fight hunger, cold, sickness and horrors hiding in the darkness. 20 real hours. Every decision matters.

4791310.title: Frontactics
4791310.short_description: Frontactics is a strategic roguelike auto battler about building your own tactical squad. Recruit units, win battles, and earn resources! Awaken units into new roles each run, combine diverse synergies, and lead your squad against stronger foes.

4791330.title: Gaslamp Cases 6: Haunted Waters
4791330.short_description: Morgan, Jack and their colleague Eleano have to solve a new case with a dissapeared ship. Help them by solving exciting Match-3 puzzles and gather the resources you need to unlock every new upgrade. Earn 20 upgrades follow Morgan’s investigation across 5 chapters as the new case unfolds.

4791400.title: Clairval
4791400.short_description: Join the pack, enter the pact and impose your law in a game of cunning and suspicion. Here, words are your sharpest weapon or your deadliest weakness. Manipulate, accuse, survive. The truth has never been so elusive.

4791430.title: Dead Rose
4791430.short_description: Hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure. Play as Lucky, a skeleton lost in the world of spirits, and set out in search of Rose through a dark and magical world that blends Metroidvania exploration with Zelda-like adventure.

4791550.title: Cascadral
4791550.short_description: Cascadral is a Solitaire Roguelike about offering clever card combinations to demonic spirits. Bend the rules, build game-breaking combos and discover powerful synergies across more than 200 unique cards and abilities. Can you escape this demonic castle?

4791710.title: Catopia
4791710.short_description: A desktop pet sim where a pixel cat lives on your wallpaper while you work. Choose one of five cats — Cheese, Cloud, Pumpkin, Cotton, or Oreo. Feed, play, wash, and pet to build affection. Neglect its health and it falls ill; neglect its heart and it walks away for good.

4791730.title: Market Simulator: Miami Beach
4791730.short_description: Build your supermarket empire in Miami Beach! Start in a tent, drive to pick up wholesale cargo, and physically stock shelves. Survive the street economy, use your family to gather extra cash, and expand to two stores in this realistic business management and life sim.

4791800.title: Concerto on White: Bass Hero
4791800.short_description: Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes, and grow your fan base to perform in larger venues!

4791970.title: Hex Tower Boogie
4791970.short_description: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game about stacking absurd combos. A cannon that one-shots everything every 10 seconds? Sure. A homing splash tower? Take it. Homing + multishot + piercing + bonus damage on one bullet? ...yeah, you can have that too.

4791980.title: SCREAM NOTE
4791980.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4791980.short_description: Jumpscare your friends. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood. Scare each other out. Get jumpscared three times and you're out. Last friend not crying wins.

4792140.title: SurfaceBox
4792140.short_description: Surf the infinite ocean of Titan, Saturn's moon. Perform epic stunts, avoid creatures and emerging obstacles and fight your way to the top of the global Top 5. A single fall can cost you all your points.

4792210.title: Hexilibrium
4792210.short_description: A logic puzzle game where you write code to guide a bot through hex grid levels. Use a simple built-in programming language, think algorithmically, and find elegant solutions to increasingly complex challenges.

4792260.title: Blood of Rations
4792260.short_description: A PvP first-person WW2 extraction looter shooter. Slip alone into a war-torn Europe to scavenge what the dead left behind. Hunt loot. Fight strangers. Extract alive — or lose it all. Every raid begins in your warm, safe bunker. If you're lucky, it ends there too.

4792310.title: Ashborn Empires
4792310.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4792310.short_description: Command vast armies and manage a growing empire from a classic top-down RTS perspective, or take up arms as a Hero and lead the charge in third-person combat. Explore ancient ruins, recover lost technology, and shape the fate of a fallen world together.

4792530.title: Still Here
4792530.short_description: Investigate a disturbing murder case in a world shaped by guilt, trauma and fractured memories. Explore unsettling locations, solve puzzles and uncover a truth your mind desperately tried to bury.

4792610.title: Robin Hood: Sherwood Valley
4792610.short_description: Experience the legend like never before. Become Robin Hood & live a new life. Explore a lush grid-based sandbox world & save the day.

4792680.title: OFFROAD Recovery: Yoho Trails
4792680.short_description: Recover stranded vehicles, clear routes, and keep remote access open in a terrain‑first off‑road recovery sim set in the near‑future, weather‑engineered Rockies. Use recovery tools and work‑focused driving across an isolated, semi‑autonomous region of flood‑damaged, fire‑scarred frontier terrain.

4792920.title: Send Them Fly 送它上天
4792920.short_description: SEND THEM FLY is a physics-driven zombie survival roguelite where every enemy can become a projectile. Blast through endless hordes, stack wild upgrades, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn the apocalypse into a low-poly playground of ragdoll chaos.

4792930.title: Lust//Protocol
4792930.short_description: Lust//Protocol is an 18+ stylish action hack-and-slash set in a dark cyberpunk world where fast-paced combat, corruption mechanics, and explicit erotic abilities are fully integrated into gameplay. Corrupt enemies, dominate them, and evolve into something far beyond human.

4792990.title: Backrooms 95
4792990.short_description: Explore eerie liminal spaces in a low-poly Backrooms horror experience inspired by the aesthetics of forgotten 90s technology.

4793030.title: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
4793030.short_description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired brutalist platformer set in an absurdist world.

4793110.title: House of Temptations
4793110.short_description: Explore a mysterious gothic mansion filled with hidden keys, locked rooms, seductive interactions, collectible memories, and dark secrets waiting to be uncovered behind every door.

4793270.title: BERG
4793270.short_description: Experience the danger and beauty of high-altitude mountaineering. Climb towering peaks, survive extreme conditions, and reach the summit together.

4793330.title: RogueScape
4793330.short_description: Pick your skills, survive 20-minute runs, open chests, and grow your account in an old-school MMO-inspired survival roguelike.

4793680.title: Please, Take The Phone
4793680.short_description: Welcome to Jiabao Tower Property Management.The night shift has begun. Your job is simple: answer calls, check the manual, and fill out the forms. When the night feels slow, watch some TV—though the programs may seem strange.Remember: serve every resident well. Jiabao Tower is our home forever.

4793780.title: 狂華乙女～Crazy Bloom～
4793780.short_description: An Over-the-Top Anime Visual Battle Game!

4793860.title: Hammered!
4793860.short_description: Hammered! is a top-down pixel-art action crafting roguelite. As a cursed genius blacksmith, uncover the source of a looming darkness. Forge weapons in real-time, hurl them at enemies, gather allies, and smash your way through!

4793890.title: First Colony
4793890.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game inspired by classic colony-building games. Explore a new continent, expand across a hex-based world map, and build a network of production settlements directly on the frontier.

4793920.title: Injury Time Lovers
4793920.short_description: Marenza is a tiny nation that somehow reached the World Cup. Coach Ronan Cosgrove has six weeks to prove it wasn't a fluke—and three women threaten to derail it: his estranged wife Lena, embedded documentarian Quinn, and crisis fixer Renata. Choose who you spend the night before kickoff with.

4794140.title: Bean Base
4794140.short_description: Bean Base is a survival base building farming game where you are solely responsible for your very own space station. Grow crops, explore the stars, and decorate your base; however you want to, survive the elements of space.

4794160.title: Catacomb
4794160.short_description: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

4794200.title: PinballRobotDoctor
4794200.short_description: "PinballRobotDoctor" is a "simple" pinball game. Control the cybernetic pinball "mechanical repair" device, using your fingertips to precisely deflect the metal pinball onto the launcher. Overcome obstacles by colliding with mechanisms and ultimately repair the target to complete the level.

4794250.title: My Deskmate Douki-Cyan
4794250.short_description: Your favorite deskmate is closer than ever. Follow Douki-Cyan through work, workouts, coffee breaks, and lazy afternoons as you experience her daily life from different perspectives. Cute moments, charming expressions, and heartwarming interactions await with your beloved deskmate.

4794370.title: Let's Aim! Crane Game
4794370.short_description: The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever! Aim, grab, and hook your prizes! Master a variety of crane arms and win tons of prizes!

4794380.title: Thousand Floors
4794380.short_description: Tower Climbers carry amber light; allies follow through misty pagodas in an endless Eastern tower. Thousands Floors blends side-view pixel art with hands-off combat—summon, upgrade, and let them climb. Grow via allies, floor lockdown, and relics.

4794570.title: Gems are Mine, Slashes are Yours: Blood & Blessing
4794570.short_description: A fast-paced 2D survival action roguelike where you bleed to fight, and she complains while healing. Consume your HP to smash through endless hordes, survive extreme resource swaps with a greedy AI cleric, and work a second job hunting bounties to pay for your skills!

4794610.title: Food Truck Rush
4794610.short_description: 100k debt, ruthless debt collectors, and a kitchen that never stops! Food Truck Rush is a fast-paced arcade management game. Upgrade your gear, master the chaos of high-speed cooking, and build your culinary empire. Can you handle the heat and pay off the mob before it's too late?

4794650.title: Bloodwright
4794650.short_description: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG roguelite.

4794930.title: Balance It!
4794930.short_description: A physics based side-scroller game about balancing objects.

4797200.title: Squabblin Goblins
4797200.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP game where your inventory slots are your health. Grab items, go goblin mode, throw them at your friends, and make your goblin a force of nature with upgrades.

4797530.title: 4to7
4797530.short_description: A casual, slower-paced block-falling puzzle. Quick reflexes or agility are never required. Your choices, your prepared plans, and unyielding fate are the only things that dictate the shape of this game.

4797550.title: 正体 SHOUT-AI
4797550.short_description: This game contains psychological horror, unsettling dialogue, screen noise, blackouts, glitches, fake code logs, and effects that may appear as if something is happening on the player's PC. It does not contain gore, explicit sexual content, drug use, or realistic violence against real people.

4797570.title: Duck Defender
4797570.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4797570.short_description: Duck Defender is a fast paced 2D wave defender. Collect coins and level up by defeating enemies! Select and buy infinitely stackable upgrades to progress through endless waves! Can you create the ultimate combo?

4797590.title: A 5 Year Old's War Game
4797590.short_description: A turn-based strategy game with real-time battles set inside a child's notebook. Command armies of crayon drawn soldiers, capture territories, reclaim the legendary Mega Crayons, and defeat the Red King once and for all.

4797730.title: 十个好人Ten innocent people
4797730.short_description: This place has long fallen into the abyss. Yet before deciding annihilation, You, who once executed the decree, are now the chief envoy. In a country that preys on the kind-hearted, can you find ten truly good people?

4797750.title: Knight on the Moon
4797750.short_description: Built for the original Nintendo Entertainment System hardware, this top-down action-adventure challenges players to survive and explore a hostile moon crawling with alien life,  abandoned bases, and deadly secrets.

4797790.title: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens Tower Defense
4797790.short_description: Command heroic rescue dogs in a colorful tower defense battle against alien invaders. Build, upgrade, unlock heroes, defend strange battlefields, and survive wave after wave in RDVA-TD: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens.

4797920.title: Tyreman
4797920.short_description: This physics co-op platformer has you roll as tire beings across a surreal world. Play solo or with friends online/local to clear obstacles, find easter eggs and hone skills via repeated attempts. Speed, teamwork and wit pave your way. Roll, fall, retry. Rise as TyreGod!

4797930.title: Ghost Tomb
4797930.short_description: Ghost Tomb is a FMV game. You act Zhang Buer, returning to a eerie ancient village and getting trapped in tomb secrets, paranormal events and Taoist conflicts. With real video performance, you make choices at key plot points to diverge the story and unlock multiple endings.

4797940.title: Gun Cultivate
4797940.short_description: Gun Cultivate is a FMV game.You act Lin Fan. Game has full motion video storyline and multiple branching choices, every decision changes the plot. Unlock different endings such as defeating demonic cults. You'll adventure and immortal combat, crush traditional cultivators with modern firepower.

4797950.title: Magic Pig
4797950.short_description: Magic Pig is a FMV. You act Fang Tianming survive in desperate situations. Every key choice you make changes the plot direction. Whether you guard your family and keep your original heart or be swallowed by power and fall into darkness depends on your choices.

4798040.title: Orbital Physics Simulator
4798040.short_description: Master physics in this hardcore orbital simulator where Einstein’s theories come to life. Plot trajectories and manipulate spacetime via general relativity, time dilation, and length contraction. Command your starship, outrun time, and explore a universe governed by real physics.

4798050.title: Beyond tht Rain Sound
4798050.short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you (the player) explore a hospital that appears in your dreams, collecting fragments of memories and experiencing what happened to you. Enjoy the various changes that occur within the recurring dreams.

4798110.title: Order Picker Simulator
4798110.short_description: Welcome to Ultra Fast Fresh! Manage your own grocery warehouse, pick crazy orders under strict corporate control, and survive the pressure of big franchise capitalism. Can you keep the business afloat without freezing to death or going bankrupt?

4798150.title: 人生记事簿：Life Memoirs
4798150.short_description: Live a lifetime in modern China.Write your diary year by year, experience Chinese culture, choose your path, build relationships, face social challenges, and witness the rise of AI. Explore possible futures and discover how your choices shape the story of your life.Every year becomes a memory.

4798280.title: Arctic Surrender
4798280.short_description: Arctic Surrender is an adult romance visual novel set on a thawing East Greenland coast, where a consortium races to build a deepwater port. As project director Soren Vinter, one impossible choice locks you into a romance with one of three women tied to the project's fate.

4798320.title: Cook & Click
4798320.short_description: A culinary management clicker game where you chop ingredients, unlock new categories, and open new locations. Automate your production, purchase upgrades to boost profits, unlock special abilities, and compete for challenging achievements. An addictive, endless progression experience.

4798330.title: Safe Quacker
4798330.short_description: Safe Quacker is a cute 3D incremental heist game where you play as a duck thief pecking loot, collecting treasure, upgrading your beak, unlocking tougher vault rooms, and cracking the legendary Golden Egg for prestige.

4798350.title: European Seafreight Tycoon
4798350.short_description: Build your own maritime freight company, plan trade routes between European ports, and manage ships, crews, and operating costs. Transport containers and specialized cargo, optimize your fleet, and grow your business into one of Europe's leading logistics networks.

4798390.title: Cruise Hantavirus Simulator
4798390.short_description: What could possibly go wrong on a luxury tropical cruise? Become a mischievous infected rat and spread chaos across a massive cruise ship. Infect tourists, spread panic, unlock new abilities, and watch the outbreak grow.

4798480.title: NOT Math Puzzle
4798480.short_description: Equations arranged by your own hands create far more than just calculation results! Discover the unexpected role formulas play in this Sokoban puzzle game.

4798610.title: 街机女孩不会认输!!
4798610.short_description: Asano, a girl from City Vocational School, feels lost about her future. One day, she tried maimai at a nearby arcade on a whim. "Wow! You're amazing... but...?" After the song, a purple-haired beauty with heterochromia stood behind her, holding gloves... Her life changed forever.

4798770.title: Pinball Millionaire
4798770.short_description: Pinball Millionaire is a physics-based marble simulation game. Let marbles bounce repeatedly off various objects to keep boosting your score, and finally guide them into the highest-multiplier scoring zone. Use the rewards you earn to upgrade and enhance the map continuously.

4798810.title: Bepe War
4798810.short_description: Bepe War is a chaotic military sandbox featuring massive battles with up to 160 soldiers. Drive any vehicle you can imagine, enable wild mutators, and enjoy brutal ragdolls!

4798930.title: Bit Dot
4798930.short_description: Feel the fun of playing together with others. Look at the simplified drawings and guess what they are as a group. Customize and create your own unique character that you can control and play with.

4798960.title: Demon Protocol
4798960.short_description: Lock On. Light Up. Lay Waste. Demon Protocol is a retro arcade space shooter with 25 waves of relentless enemies, 4 brutal bosses, and power-ups to keep you fighting. Choose your difficulty and see how far you can push before the demons win.

4798970.title: I'm Having A Bad Day
4798970.short_description: Smash your stress away in a fast-paced cartoon VR experience where you compete in a chaotic reality show. Break, dismantle and unleash exaggerated physics-driven destruction in short, intense levels. Easy to jump into, hard to stop, perfect for quick sessions and surprisingly energizing fun.

4799050.title: Slop Slop
4799050.short_description: The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive. Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

4799230.title: Fetidity
4799230.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4799230.short_description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

4799290.title: Sweet Ruins
4799290.short_description: Sweet Ruins - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around ruins. Enjoy the pleasant time spent with five pretty and cute girls in the ruins, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4799310.title: Rubbles
4799310.short_description: Rubbles is a 2D-Platformer-Shooter set in an infinite, fully destructible world of steel-concrete chutes and tunnels. Replenish your ever-draining battery in combat and find terminals for weapons, ammunition and handling styles to mix and match. How long can you stay up and running?

4799380.title: Cow Abduction Frenzy
4799380.short_description: Hop into your alien ship and get ready for a frantic bullet hell challenge! Use time-bending and cloaking abilities to rescue cows from the clutches of beef-hungry butchers before your energy depletes. Can you abduct the herd and escape the farm alive?

4799390.title: Territory Titans: Booking Wars
4799390.short_description: Build and manage a wrestling territory in the golden age of professional wrestling. Draft talent, book rivalries, manage finances, grow your fanbase, and compete against rival promotions in a deep sports management simulation.

4799440.title: Matadors
4799440.short_description: Matadors is a multiplayer bullfighting game. Players can choose to play as either the bull or a matador. No matter what you are, the only thing that doesn't change is chaos.

4799450.title: Kingdoms vs Zombies
4799450.short_description: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

4799510.title: Rabbits From The Gas Planet
4799510.short_description: Fight off an alien rabbit invasion in this ridiculous comedy FPS. Survive toxic fart clouds, dodge explosive poop bombs, earn upgrades, and battle giant rabbit bosses from the Gas Planet.

4799620.title: Thiccfoot
4799620.short_description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

4799750.title: The Dragon Blossom
4799750.short_description: Beat reporter Birdie Malone goes undercover as Hollywood star Clara Bow to stop a masked culprit from stealing The Dragon Blossom in this 1930's point and click whodunnit.

4799760.title: The Black Shift
4799760.short_description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

4799870.title: Dumpling Squishy
4799870.short_description: Your desktop just got cozier. Tap the floating bamboo steamer, watch squishy dumplings tumble out and pile up across your screen, then collect all 50, from common to legendary. Trade your duplicates for rarer dumplings and let the little guys squish around while you work, browse, or chill.

4799920.title: Deep Drill Simulator
4799920.short_description: Co-op steampunk simulation where players manage a massive drilling machine, control systems, repair damage, and coordinate resource management to survive deep underground expeditions with a dynamic economy and upgrades in Deep Drill Simulator.

4799980.title: Krampus
4799980.short_description: Trapped inside a dark and eerie house, you must solve puzzles, explore hidden areas, and escape while Krampus is hunting you.

4800050.title: Answer For Glory
4800050.short_description: Answer for Glory is a fast-paced quiz game where every question pushes you closer to victory or defeat. Test your knowledge, survive challenging rounds, and chase glory across multiple game modes.

4800260.title: CATCH THE CLOWN
4800260.short_description: CATCH THE CLOWN is a surrealist "action real-time-strategy" adventure set within a hostile piece of 90s art software. Follow your heart.

4800330.title: Odd Job Angel
4800330.short_description: A bitter RPG / Visual Novel where you travel the globe and help people! Every place you visit has its own job, and every day is a new opportunity to make friends!

4800440.title: One More Pearl!
4800440.short_description: The penniless otter taps on the magic drift bottle, and strange seashells keep appearing on the beach! Smash the shells, sell the pearls, upgrade the otter, and strange stories are waiting for the otter as well?

4800460.title: TrustYourEyes?
4800460.short_description: A minimalist 2D precision platformer focused on charged jumps. Players learn distance judgment across increasingly complex geometric levels. As the game progresses, moving platforms and distorted perception are introduced, increasing difficulty.

4800470.title: Big Market Simulator
4800470.short_description: Build and manage a massive supermarket. Order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your business into the ultimate shopping destination.

4800570.title: 二万分の一の雨粒達 - One in 20,000 raindrops
4800570.short_description: Satoshi Kuga, who led a lonely high school life, was dreading the school trip starting tomorrow because he had been assigned to the same group as the popular clique. However, it seemed there were hidden tensions even within the group that appeared to get along so well at first glance.

4800590.title: Supermarket Chaos
4800590.short_description: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

4800630.title: Covet the Countdown
4800630.short_description: You're Emmett Doyle, Mission Director on a rebuilt private rocket racing a Mars launch window that won't wait. Over one relentless night, three women collide with your countdown: a grounded commander, a brilliant trajectory lead, and a crisis fixer. Choose who gets your time, trust, and the truth.

4800650.title: 7 Millimeters
4800650.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

4800860.title: Peerless Beauty Detective: Alice
4800860.short_description: A murder occurred at the Ai Qing Apartment. The female owner of Apartment 1802 died strangely. There was no struggle, no signs of a fight. Why did she die at night? Why wasn't the male owner at home? All the mysteries await the detective: Alice to solve. There is only one truth, let's find it!

4801040.title: Zombie Murder Squad Y2K
4801040.short_description: The Y2K bug was real and it turned everyone into zombies! It's up to you and your murder squad to exterminate zombies, grow insanely powerful, and blast your way through a retro PS1 apocalypse to find and destroy the source of the zombie signal.

4801190.title: Beat Taurus
4801190.short_description: Unleash adrenaline-fueled chaos in this fast-paced top-down space shooter. Master the adaptive sountracks to trigger devastating Overdrive attacks and obliterate your enemies. Forge unique ships with deep module synergies, survive the bullet hell, and conquer the Taurus constellation!

4801490.title: Bleaklands
4801490.short_description: Bleaklands is an action roguelite that combines exploration, gear-building, and horde survival. Venture from a safe zone into dangerous wilds, gather treasure, defeat bosses, and shape different builds through equipment and random upgrades.

4801740.title: Dude Simulator: My Apologies
4801740.short_description: Dude Simulator: My Apologies is an open world sandbox game. It's an ordinary summer day when your friend suddenly calls and says the police have arrested him. You'll have to drop everything and head to another city to save him.

4801800.title: Cleanup Crew
4801800.short_description: Fight through dangerous space stations in this 2d Bird's eye rougelike dungeon crawler! Clean up as many stations as you can!

4802090.title: Mr.Sound
4802090.short_description: Build the ultimate nightclub. Set the vibe. Run the night. Mr. Sound is a first-person nightclub management simulator where you design your venue, manage your business, and keep the crowd coming back for more. Every night is a new challenge, make it legendary.

4802210.title: Visual Novel: WOODEN CALIBER
4802210.short_description: A trashy adventure about the wooden idiot Pinochet and the wolf Gloomy, who decide to rob a post office. Crazy characters, idiotic choices, dark humor, and epilogues that are one more ridiculous than the other. One wrong click and you're dead. Welcome to the bottom.

4802270.title: Seeking Home
4802270.short_description: Seeking Home is a 2.5D cinematic puzzle-platformer set in the wilderness of Northern Sweden. Play as a cat trying to reunite with her lost human in a world where machines have taken over.

4802370.title: Gravehollow
4802370.short_description: Explore a living world where creatures and characters act independently of the player. Hunt, gather, craft, build, and fight to survive while facing hostile wildlife, unpredictable encounters, and a procedurally generated landscape.

4802380.title: MILF Obsession
4802380.short_description: A funny and highly explicit MILF-themed visual novel. A young man frustrated with girls his age discovers his true desire: beautiful, mature MILFs. He transforms a failing café into the Playbunny Café, where gorgeous older women serve in sexy bunny outfits.

4802570.title: Deck Of Misakila
4802570.short_description: In this dark fantasy roguelike strategy game, battles revolve around powerful poker combinations. Discover powerful runes, create unique synergies, and forge a different build in every run.

4802670.title: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure
4802670.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4802670.short_description: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.

4802690.title: BlipKick
4802690.short_description: BlipKick is a tactical football auto-battler. Draft players, activate synergies and build the perfect squad to defeat your rival in fast-paced 9-round matches.

4803280.title: Little Girls Escapeventures
4803280.short_description: The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations. Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know? Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

4803390.title: XANTAF3 Bogotá Cyberpunk
