4803390.short_description: Investigate impossible mysteries in a Latin American cyberpunk Bogotá. Explore atmospheric locations, talk to characters, collect clues, connect evidence, and formulate hypotheses in a narrative detective adventure.

4803470.title: Dead Station Together
4803470.short_description: A deadly outbreak has consumed a remote space station. Team up with friends, recover DNA samples, rescue the crew, and survive against the infected in this 1–4 player co-op survival horror experience.

4803530.title: Observe.
4803530.short_description: Clear out levels full of anomalies. Then they will let you out.

4803600.title: Girigirin
4803600.short_description: Girigirin is an action game where you control a robot and fly toward the goal. In worlds such as dungeons, jungles, and fortresses, you must dodge everything in your path and focus solely on reaching the goal.

4803870.title: OctoDock: Cozy & Chill
4803870.short_description: OctoDock is a lovely laid-back 2D idle simulation management game🐚. Listen to the soothing crashing sounds of ocean waves🌊 as story-rich fishing boats drift gently into the harbor with sea breeze, and sailors wander ashore in groups.

4804070.title: 嘘！超能少女代购中！
4804070.short_description: Broke and fired, Qiqi gets a phone that teleports her to any photo! Her plan? Cross-border smuggling! In this 3-hour comedic simulator, manage inventory, stealth-teleport, and bluff through deadly customs checks to scalp goods. One bad lie means jail! Unlock 40+ hilarious endings in this hustle.

4804080.title: Gold & Glory
4804080.short_description: Gold & Glory is an addictive hack & slash incremental where you fight as a gladiator in a dark fantasy arena! Slay orcs and goblins, collect endless loot, and climb a vast skill tree to become the ultimate champion!

4804220.title: Rust of New York
4804220.short_description: A post-apocalyptic ruin exploration RPG. A Fallout-style game. A highly flexible game design featuring a wealth of skills and equipment, a vast number of locations, and numerous skill checks. The sprawling ruins of a chaotic New York City stand before you!

4804240.title: METAL QUADRIGA
4804240.short_description: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech “QUADRIGA” and complete a variety of intense missions in **METAL QUADRIGA**. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikes—dominate the battlefield with your machine.

4804250.title: NIGHT RAIDER
4804250.short_description: Survive endless dark monsters in this top-down 3D roguelike shooter. Use glowing swords and deadly magic to fight swarms. Auto-aim frees you to move and dodge. Upgrade over 20 skills to build your setup. How long can you live?

4804380.title: The Collector’s Curio Cabinet Toy Soldiers
4804380.short_description: The Collector’s Curio Cabinet: Toy Soldiers is a nostalgic collecting and management game where every soldier is more than a figure. Rarity, condition, restoration, medals, upgrades, commanders, and completed sets all unlock battle rules. Build your cabinet, then build your strategy.

4804440.title: JAMBREDREK: PURE DETECTIVE
4804440.short_description: Investigate a series of brutal murders in a remote forest county. Search for clues, explore disturbing locations, encounter horrifying creatures, and uncover the truth in this first person horror experience.

4804480.title: Age of Clicks
4804480.short_description: Age of Clicks - A unique blend of global strategy and clicker gameplay. Manage your country with clicks: build factories, mine resources, and lead armies into battle. Click your enemies into surrender and reshape the political map of the world!

4804560.title: MurderAt
4804560.short_description: London, 1889. Step into the shoes of a young detective in this hand-drawn, point-and-click mystery. Explore the dark halls of Seraphim House, illuminate the shadows, and interrogate suspects to solve a complex locked-room murder. Will you accuse the right person?

4804670.title: Floor 12
4804670.short_description: A horror-infused walking simulator inspired by the classics of anomaly hunting. Watch the lights closely, listen to the sounds, and trust your intuition. One wrong step and the journey begins anew. How many floors separate you from freedom?

4804690.title: Succubus Futanari
4804690.short_description: As the captain, you will guide your diverse and charming crew of beautiful futanari warriors and adorable femboys towards the mysterious and ever-pulsing "Rift". Will you survive the storm, or will you succumb to the temptations of the desert? 🌪️💖

4804700.title: Goth Femboy Santa
4804700.short_description: With his gothic style, captivating femboy aesthetics, and dangerously enchanting desires, he is the true master of dark winter nights! (❁´◡`❁) In this gripping 10-night visual novel, you will witness Noel's passionate, thrilling, and boundary-pushing "night visits" with his lovely targets.

4804750.title: Critical Load
4804750.short_description: Critical Load is an adult romance visual novel set at a desert AI data center during a record heat dome. As the director who decides who keeps power, romance three women: a cooling engineer, a county hydrologist, and the grid operator who can cut you dark. Contains explicit adult content.

4804770.title: Uncharted Lands
4804770.short_description: Will you be able to save shipwrecks from uncharted lands in medieval Europe? Get ready to survive, fight, explore and dominate

4804920.title: ONE MORE TRY
4804920.short_description: Do you enjoy high blood pressure and broken keyboards? Welcome to a hilariously frustrating platformer where the only thing standing between you and victory is gravity, spikes, and your own incompetence. Good luck.

4804990.title: Totally Safe Delivery NOT
4804990.short_description: Totally Safe Delivery NOT is a chaotic rage game where everything is totally safe. Well… almost. As a freshly hired rookie, you have one simple task:Bring the platform carrying atomic material safely to the core.

4805000.title: LunaGenesis
4805000.short_description: LunaGenesis is a single-player psychological horror adventure about Scary Moonchild, an avatar of Will who sneaks through a plague-ridden rat-folk town and dives into surreal dreams to expose the Collegium's hidden conspiracy.

4805020.title: Snake With Bird
4805020.short_description: Snake With Bird is a short visual novel. The story mainly depicts the daily lives of Snake and Bird in modern-day mainland China. ※This is not a wuxia, xianxia, or any other fantasy or historical genre.

4805080.title: Funeral of Paradise - BL (Boys Love)
4805080.short_description: A dark BL visual novel about love, faith, control, and the cost of choosing yourself. Guide Dojun through a psychological story of obsession, trauma, forbidden romance, and multiple endings shaped by your choices.

4805100.title: The Return
4805100.short_description: The Return is a side-scrolling action roguelite set in a Chinese underworld. Choose a mortal hero, build skills and artifacts, fight through the Eighteen Hells, and uncover the truth behind a realm that turns the living into spiritual essence.

4805120.title: The Disappearing Municipality Worker
4805120.short_description: This mystery requires a mixture of real detective skills, deductive reasoning, and good-old moon logic. "When something doesn't make sense... What does it mean?"

4805180.title: Tech Resale Simulator
4805180.short_description: Run your own second-hand electronics store. Freely arrange shelves and merchandise, earn money, expand your business, and unlock rarer mystery crates containing increasingly valuable items. Hunt for hidden bargains in the second-hand market, but not every purchase is a winner.

4805240.title: Zombie Wasteland Together
4805240.short_description: Zombie Wasteland Together is a 1–4 player co-op zombie shooter set in a post-apocalyptic desert. Team up with friends, fight endless hordes of infected, and survive using powerful weapons.

4805330.title: Car Parkour 2 Together
4805330.short_description: The legendary parkour chaos is back! Team up with friends in Car Parkour 2 Together, featuring improved physics and challenging new maps. Massive ramps, deadly obstacles, and driving madness await. Will your friendships survive?

4805350.title: Imperium of the Stars
4805350.short_description: A real-time grand strategy 4X set in a living Gothic Space Opera galaxy. Lead asymmetric factions, expand across the stars, survive galactic crises, and adapt to a universe shaped by a dynamic Game Director.

4805420.title: Subjected
4805420.short_description: Hangman, reimagined. Participate in a twisted trial led by a pharmaceutical company. A word game stripped down into something colder, sharper, and far less forgiving, where each guess is both logic and liability. The word may be hidden, but punishment is not. Guess carefully. Good luck, participant.

4805490.title: Karma Cannon
4805490.short_description: Clear hordes of cosmic critters in this simple 2D shooter but be carefully, bullets that exit the arena will warp behind you and become dangerous to you ship. Whatever goes around comes around.

4805600.title: Scavenge Protocol
4805600.short_description: Land on strange planets, loot valuable junk, dodge deadly creatures, convert scrap into energy, and desperately attempt to survive with your friends in this co-op horror adventure.

4805820.title: The Leather Maker
4805820.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4805820.short_description: Walk the wharves, meeting houses, taverns, and markets of colonial Boston. Converse with merchants, laborers, patriots, and notable gentlemen whose names shall echo through history. Seek counsel from allies, uncover hidden truths, and lend your voice to the great discussions of the age.

4806010.title: Drowned Light
4806010.short_description: Drawn by a cryptic letter from the past, explore a monolithic lighthouse where darkness is your greatest enemy. Manage your light sources carefully in this stylized horror experience. When you succumb to the dark, death is only the beginning—beware the corpses you leave behind.

4806040.title: Boobs & Boxing
4806040.short_description: Inherit a boxing gym. Train beautiful fighters. Save it in 30 days. Boobs & Boxing is a 2D visual novel with branching paths, six romanceable characters, multiple endings, and a guaranteed spicy scene per chapter! Immerse yourself in this short, sweet, and stimulating game!

4806100.title: Drident
4806100.short_description: DRIDENT is a short (30-40 min) first-person survival horror game set in a fog-covered forest in Argentina. Investigate missing girls, uncover forbidden experiments, survive grotesque creatures, and follow the trail of something that should never have escaped.

4806170.title: It's Not a Bomb
4806170.short_description: rab a controller, grab your friends, and blow them sky-high! It's Not a Bomb is a chaotic local party brawler for up to 4 players where bottles, chickens, and gas cans explode in your face. Customize your fighter, grab wild power-ups, and be the last one standing!

4806270.title: What The Cluck
4806270.short_description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

4806600.title: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility
4806600.short_description: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility is a block-dropping strategy roguelike that involves scoring boxes on a grid. Use different combinations of boxes and items to up your score, and gain combo to earn even more points! Purchase wacky upgrades for boxes, and navigate around your limited inventory!

4806680.title: VOIDSWARM
4806680.short_description: They came from the void. You are all that stands between them and our annihilation. Command and fight alongside an immense fleet, upgrade your ships and take back our homeworlds in this spacefaring roguelike RTS.

4806860.title: Crooked Superpowers Detective Agency
4806860.short_description: Play as a broke, unreliable private detective armed with a shabby retro watch that randomly switches superpowers. Sneak, tail suspects, capture evidence, and plan every ability use carefully, because every switch costs money.

4807030.title: Meadowlands Online
4807030.short_description: A Pixel-Art MMO focused on Life-Skilling inspired by Old School Runescape and Stardew Valley.

4807560.title: Scrim-Mage
4807560.short_description: Scrim-Mage is a casual 2d fighting game where you and a friend play as gnome wizards and can customise your moveset with different spells. Competitive silliness is a guarantee in this colourful combination between traditional and platform fighters.

4807600.title: Armor of God
4807600.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4807600.short_description: A 2D pixel-art platformer where you choose which armor to wear. Full armor makes you invincible - anyone can win. Leave some behind and the game becomes a very different challenge.

4808020.title: The Curiosity Clerk
4808020.short_description: "The Curiosity Clerk" is a Victorian fantasy narrative puzzle game blending item identification and deduction. Manage a mysterious shop, expose lies using the Craftsman’s Manual, and send robots on text-roguelite wild adventures. Shape fates across 20 days to unlock 4 endings and Day 21.

4808100.title: Depths
4808100.short_description: Depths is a cooperative multiplayer game where you and up to three friends​ delve into procedurally generated caves, collecting items,​ going deeper, making sure to meet quota every dive. Avoid the monsters that dwell in these caverns​ if you and your friends hope to make it out alive.​

4808110.title: Flip-Off
4808110.short_description: Use your army of living burgers to face off against the hot dog menace! In this side-scrolling tower defense you must flip gravity and flip burgers to survive the flavorful onslaught.

4808290.title: Nozomu School Daze
4808290.short_description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl – which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

4808420.title: Bitloop
4808420.short_description: You steer a drone's orbit while it fires for you. Ride close to break the vault faster, ride wide to live longer. Strip the ring, crack the core, fall to the next vault. A one-stick roguelite about orbital mining.

4808530.title: Oath of Steel
4808530.short_description: On the wasteland, tanks rumble. In this post-apocalyptic adventure RPG, you will become a bounty hunter, driving a tank deep into the forbidden zone to face the brutal bounty hunter leader.

4808540.title: Finding Fossils
4808540.short_description: As a paleontology student you leave academia behind to hunt for real fossils. Dig, prepare, and display your finds in a museum of your own design. Build something worth visiting! Just remember not every expedition is the same!

4808680.title: WackyWackyWacky
4808680.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4808680.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer platformer where runners race to survive deadly obstacle courses while another player controls the map, triggering traps, destroying platforms, and doing everything possible to stop them.

4808720.title: 2026 U.S. Election Simulator
4808720.short_description: Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Participate in debates and travel to battleground states as you try to win a Presidential Election.

4808780.title: UnderWorldMonstersPinball
4808780.short_description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

4808890.title: Jingjie: Probability Cloud - Nagumo's Dilemma
4808890.short_description: A Pacific carrier command simulation about imperfect reports, deck pressure, and adaptive enemy counterplay. Find the enemy first, judge stale contact data, and commit your strike before the window closes.

4808920.title: All For $1
4808920.short_description: All for $1 is a 1-4 player co-op treasure-hunting and trading simulator. A $1 box can hide a fortune, while a $100K box might be nothing but junk. Open mystery return boxes, sell your finds for maximum profit, grow your store, and get rich. What's inside the next box?

4808940.title: SCP: Mr. Jupiter
4808940.short_description: A first-person SCP horror adventure where you survive a catastrophic containment breach, explore a collapsing facility, and evade the mysterious Mr. Jupiter.

4809070.title: Idle Pixel Battle
4809070.short_description: Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build a team of heroes and watch them fight automatically through waves of monsters.

4809100.title: Heartbeat Impact
4809100.short_description: A casual collection mini-game! Transform into a love-filled pinball, smash through obstacles, and shatter the girl’s defenses to collect her heart-fluttering moments. Keep your high-speed passion to pierce barriers unscathed. Destroy every wall and win your way into her heart!"

4809380.title: Hentai Milf Daily
4809380.short_description: Hentai Milf Daily - They are with you every day!! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4809410.title: Hentai Milf Hub
4809410.short_description: Hentai Milf Hub - Dating? Here we go! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4809540.title: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator
4809540.short_description: Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? This game is exactly that! A satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless.

4809560.title: Auto Empire Tycoon
4809560.short_description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and a single dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, keep your dealerships stocked, and outpace your rivals to build your own automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

4809570.title: Doomsday Tryst
4809570.short_description: When the world goes dark, Gage Renner seals the Bastion—a luxury fallout silo for the ultra-wealthy—until an extra body turns up on no manifest. Romance one of three women in a sealed bunker where air, water, and power are rationed. An adult visual novel with three branching routes.

4809600.title: Pixel Miner
4809600.short_description: Descend into endless layers of resource-rich caves, mine valuable ore, expand your operation with autonomous drones, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades to push how deep you can go in this minimalistic pixel-art idle/incremental indie game

4809700.title: House Party 8
4809700.short_description: A short first-person anomaly horror game set inside a looping house party. Observe carefully, trust your memory, and escape only when everything feels normal.

4809740.title: RushGirl LUCA
4809740.short_description: RushGirl LUCA is a fast-paced 2D action shooter roguelite. With nothing but a mouse, weave between bullet heaven and bullet hell by your own hand, hold back the alien assault, upgrade a wide arsenal of weapons and parts, and push the counterattack all the way out into space!

4809820.title: Primal One
4809820.short_description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

4810000.title: Brickwork - Tower Defense
4810000.short_description: Build your battlefield, brick by brick. Snap together towers, shape the path, and hold the line against waves of rogue toys. Every run reshuffles the board with procedurally generated layouts and new choices at every turn. Your world, your rules, your build.

4810470.title: Once Apond a Time
4810470.short_description: You crash down into the middle of a giant pond after a great storm. As you explore the pond you'll meet new friends who share a troubled history. As you work on healing your broken wing, you'll help them heal their past, creating unbreakable new friendships.

4810540.title: The Prince's Keeper
4810540.short_description: Play as the newest servant to Prince Railan, who’s had all of his previous servants fired. While navigating your position, you’ll try to pry down his carefully guarded walls as you challenge him on everything he believes about himself and the world. Just try not to get fired in the process.

4810650.title: Black Tides Draga's Wake
4810650.short_description: Draga is running out of time and humanity. Stranded on a nightmare colossal steamship in an alternate 1900s, unleash visceral brawler combat against twisted horrors below deck. Regroup your scattered crew and uncover what’s awakening inside the hull… before escape becomes impossible.

4813510.title: Sanctuary of Small Things
4813510.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4813510.short_description: A wholesome creature-collecting game, solo or co-op for up to four. Wander enchanting biomes, gather ingredients, brew gentle remedies, and heal the small things you find. Cosy, calm, and quietly addictive.

4813620.title: TankFall Arena
4813620.short_description: Retro-inspired tank arena combat where every wall can become a weapon. Master ricochets, random battlefields, powerful pickups, and chaotic multiplayer battles against friends or AI opponents. Supports solo play, team battles, local multiplayer, and Remote Play Together.

4813820.title: AI Slop
4813820.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4813820.short_description: Flood the internet with disgusting AI Slop in this anti-AI incremental sim! Create AI artists & agents to trigger mass outrage. While your slop botnets take over the world, play a Joker Poker roguelike card game or trade risky meme coins. Will you achieve the singularity or just get sued?

4813940.title: Definitely Not a Cult
4813940.short_description: Build your “totally normal” community, upgrade your base, gather weird resources, recruit suspiciously calm members, and pretend the red flags are just decorative. Manage the chaos, unlock content, earn achievements, and do not ask why everyone keeps talking about pyramids.

4814130.title: Pookie's Lingerie Shop 2
4814130.short_description: Partner with the Sweet Pookie to build an indie lingerie empire. Manage your boutique, outsmart ruthless rivals, and romance an alluring cast. Will you conquer the fashion world and find true love, or go bankrupt trying? Your flirty adventure awaits!

4814210.title: Brothers
4814210.short_description: Brothers is a medieval co-op action roguelite where two knights set out from their castle, take on dangerous quests, battle through hostile forests, and grow stronger together with every run. Fight, survive, upgrade, and protect your kingdom side by side.

4814600.title: Dustdrifter
4814600.short_description: Dustdrifter is an incremental bullet heaven arena shooter. Venture into dangerous ruins, blast through overwhelming hords of enemis and collect valuable relics. Return home to upgrade your drifter and grow your village.

4815040.title: A Sea of Ashen Tulips
4815040.short_description: A Sea of Ashen Tulips is a fantasy Text-based RPG where players control a former mercenary who searches for allies in investigating and combatting a colonial occupation.

4815220.title: Hearthside: Your Custom Fireplace
4815220.short_description: A highly customizable, idle fireplace simulator. Relax to the sound of crackling flames while tailoring the atmosphere to your mood by loading your own custom images, editing wall text, and adjusting the lighting.

4815260.title: ALBATROSS
4815260.short_description: After an unnamed catastrophe, you've been left alone and stranded on a boat in the middle of a sunken world. Journey through vast megastructures and the giant rotting frames of mysterious machines. Feed the boat's engine with fish caught using your harpoon. Never slow down.

4815390.title: Tech Empire
4815390.short_description: A single-player business simulation about running a technology company. You act as its CEO, CTO, and CFO at the same time: building products, managing staff and finances, going public, and competing with rival firms.

4815660.title: Brassfang
4815660.short_description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

4815930.title: The Door Factory
4815930.short_description: The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you inspect mysterious doors before they are sent into production. Step inside, observe the environment, spot anomalies, and decide whether each door should be approved or reported.

4815980.title: Return to Planet Zoveka
4815980.short_description: A physics-driven incremental space-mining game with depth and heart. Help a family forced from home herd cosmic dust, automate production, and grow one tiny inherited ship into an operation that can heal Zoveka and make it home again.

4816030.title: Keeping Up
4816030.short_description: Three jobs. One life. Zero savings. A satirical British life sim, spiritual successor to Jones in the Fast Lane. Move your marble token around a city of 16 buildings. Take jobs, study, eat, save, and dodge the weekly Algorithm. See how far you can climb!

4816200.title: Endless Defense
4816200.short_description: Endless Defense is a roguelite sci-fi tower defense game where every run becomes a new build. Place turrets, choose traits, draw upgrade cards, use special tiles, and evolve your defense to survive endless waves of enemies, elites, and bosses.

4816210.title: Neon Blackfall
4816210.short_description: Build your deck, survive the Blackout, and fight for control of Neurovale. A fast-paced card game with 50+ single-player chapters and online multiplayer battles. Lead one of four rival factions and adapt as the city changes between the Neon and Blackfall eras.

4816520.title: Siida
4816520.short_description: Survive through Lapland's frozen beauty in this Sámi-inspired survival strategy game. Don't conquer nature, listen to it. Master the seasons in a fragile ecosystem where sustainability is the only way to endure.

4816680.title: EPIC IDLE TALE
4816680.short_description: A daring text adventurer sets out on an epic quest to find the princcess locked away in her tower far far away. Fight through Goth Vampires, Two Eyed Cyclopses, Repulsive Succubi and many more monsterous monsters on your journey through the deadly swamp.

4817150.title: Christmas CEO
4817150.short_description: Run Santa's Workshop in this cozy management sim. Assign workers, manage resources, survive crisis events, and make enough toys before Christmas.

4778890.title: 雨の日に見た想月
4778890.short_description: A Monar RPG about a suicidal student who adventures through another world to prolong his life. Travel between a fantastical and unknown other world and the suffering-filled reality, saving him from his fate of death.

4779190.title: Duel of Gaia
4779190.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4779190.short_description: Duel of Gaia is a card-based auto-battle strategy game. Choose a unique elemental deck and dive into battle. Activate powerful skills or summon monsters with your cards, and use the best strategy in auto-combat to defeat your opponents and conquer the continent.

4779650.title: The LINE
4779650.short_description: The LINE is an endless avoidance scrolling game, where the end is near and unavoidable. You control an aptly named space-faring vessel through a lethal meteor storm, and that is pretty much it. Despite a small element of luck, the game rewards skillful button-smashing, with a high score as a reward.

4779680.title: SUBSØNIC
4779680.short_description: An audio-reactive twin-stick bullet-hell where the song is the weapon. Play three curated packs with three megabosses, or import any track and the game builds a level from it: enemies spawn from onsets, bullets lock to the beat, your shots bloom in the song's key.

4779800.title: Unredeemable
4779800.short_description: Unredeemable is a psychological survival horror where you must defeat dark manifestations, and explore the abandoned corners of David Cook’s mind. Where traumas resurface and haunting memories roam the school halls, a beautifully haunting narrative awaits to be uncovered.

4780560.title: Unboxed: Idle Case Tycoon
4780560.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4780560.short_description: Open cases, collect rare weapon skins, and build your passive income empire. Upgrade your auto-openers, fill your Vault, and dominate the Skin Market in this fast-paced idle clicker. One more case. Always one more.

4780580.title: Main Character Syndrome
4780580.short_description: Dance to the beat. Gain followers. Your followers become monsters. Shoot them to the beat. Repeat until famous or dead. A retro rhythm shooter about dancing your way to the top and shooting your way back down.

4781010.title: IDEA:20Q
4781010.short_description: A game of Twenty Questions against an AI running entirely on your own computer. Ask and answer with Ganymede and Europa — two beings piecing together the last records of a vanished humanity.

4781320.title: Croaked!
4781320.short_description: Croaked! is a frog-themed roguelike survivor where you choose unique frogs, battle massive hordes of enemies, catch insects for powerful bonuses, evolve weapons, discover special events, and defeat challenging bosses while creating new builds every run.

4781390.title: 英雄冒险团
4781390.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4781390.short_description: Hero Adventure Group is a fantasy MMORPG where you begin as a novice adventurer and grow into a legendary hero. Explore vast lands, conquer solo and 5-player dungeons, collect powerful gear, join guilds, defeat epic bosses, and embark on an unforgettable adventure with friends.

4781430.title: Pocket Squire: Arena
4781430.short_description: Pocket Squire: Arena is a single-player turn-based combat game built around one simple, punishing structure: 5 themed arenas, 9 fights each, with no rest in between. You play a squire stepping into the arena as one of 18 combat classes, a handful of gold, and a backpack of potions.

4781630.title: Cult Runners
4781630.short_description: A co-op horror game about speed running through a twisted cult's compound, uncovering forbidden secrets, and racing to get to the bottom of it.

4781680.title: LastStop
4781680.short_description: Run a co-op night shift at a roadside gas station. Fuel cars, run the register, repair vehicles, stop thieves, and investigate suspicious customers before the night gets out of control.

4781910.title: Tragidle
4781910.short_description: Tragidle is an addictive idle game where you take control of a slot machine. Spin the reels, collect rewards, and amass massive fortunes. Invest your winnings strategically to level up different fruits, increase your luck, and unlock powerful perks in the skill tree to make your riches grow.

4782240.title: Dog Man: Bark in Action
4782240.short_description: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.

4782480.title: Flirting Goddesses by AFK
4782480.short_description: This is a super casual little game where you can earn rewards just by playing offline. You can also listen to several nice original songs. After a busy day, relax and enjoy a moment of peace.

4782720.title: Nothing Can Go? Wrong!
4782720.short_description: A top-down grid puzzle game where you play as Mr. Nothing. To reach the exit, you must transform into objects, combine items to craft tools, and interact with the environment. Think step-by-step, plan your routing, and see how your choices shape the grid.

4783000.title: DCI : Dream Clean Inc.
4783000.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4783000.short_description: A student-made, action-adventure game where you play as an employee of a dream cleaning company. Armed with your broom and the ability to transform into three forms, you will have to defeat the Zonyrs and clean up this dream world.

4783060.title: RogueOut Racing
4783060.short_description: RogueOut Racing is a high-speed arcade racing experience inspired by the classics. Race at impossible speeds, master challenging tracks, and dominate the online leaderboards across diverse and unique environments.

4783160.title: Signal
4783160.short_description: You're an operator at a remote communication terminal. Route the messages. Follow the protocol. Keep the system running. The loop has already begun.

4783190.title: Village Coop Clicker
4783190.short_description: A cozy cooperative village-building active clicker for solo players, families and friends. Gather resources, build your settlement, defend against raiders and prepare expeditions together — without stress, automation or idle mechanics.

4783320.title: A Small Favor from the Boss
4783320.short_description: 睁开眼，面前是一张符纸，一条闹鬼的巷子，一个委托，以及…一位不靠谱的无良老板。躲藏、交涉、收集线索，在谎言中寻找真相，诙谐与惊悚交织。当死亡也成为武器，一次次带着轮回的记忆重新来过，而这次，你走向的结局是…？

4783340.title: Trickster
4783340.short_description: Trickster is an atmospheric online trick-taking card game for 2–6 players, dressed in well-painted tarot art. Bid the exact number of tricks you'll win, master the must-trump rule and the wild Poker card, then race to the target score. Play online with friends, over LAN, or solo against AI.

4783540.title: Intertwined - Season 1
4783540.short_description: Intertwined is a romance, slice-of-life adult visual novel. You play as a young man returning to his hometown after years away, reconnecting with old friends and forming new relationships. Your choices shape the story, character relationships, and potential romances.

4783660.title: Sandwatch
4783660.short_description: Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing. Freely bind and press your keys as you follow the trajectory of the hourglass.

4784070.title: Face The Gauntlet
4784070.short_description: Fight your way through the colosseum and ascend its ranks in Face The Gauntlet, a turn-based action RPG. Spend points to take actions, or save them for when you parry your opponent and interrupt their turn. Weigh your options carefully and strike fiercely as one of five unique classes.

4784360.title: Lofi Lagoon
4784360.short_description: Lo-Fi drifts through a quiet lagoon of your own. A full suite of work tools and an ocean-themed backdrop gently guide you into focus. The seascape and its creatures shift hour by hour, while distracting, game-like elements stay minimal. A calm desktop for deep work.

4785420.title: StellarMythos:TheJourney
4785420.short_description: 《StellarMythos》blends auto-chess synergies with lane pushing. Explore hex maps, expand territory, deploy producers, and activate race/element buffs. Your army advances automatically. Defeat bosses to unlock planets and commanders.

4785480.title: Assassin Of Spider 2: 2099
4785480.short_description: Assassin of spider 2: 2099 is futuristic third person/first person sci-fi shooter where player mission is to kill space spider and collect skulls

4785570.title: Ghosts Keep Out
4785570.short_description: Defend your base in this Roguelite survival shooter TD! Mix random skills + evolve gems to craft your Build. 5-min fast rounds, intense zombie & ghost hordes. Triple progression: Spirits, guns, heroes. Easy to learn, hard to put down. Low barrier, high ceiling. Every run is fresh!

4785600.title: Mental Medicine
4785600.short_description: Mix medicine and control emotions. Mental Medicine is a puzzle game themed around mental illness. Create medicine through puzzles and use it to treat growing emotions. Red represents mania, blue represents depression. Prevent emotions from overflowing and compete for high scores.

4785610.title: Descent of Yomi
4785610.short_description: Descend into Yomi — the Japanese realm of the dead — armed only with the cards you forge from your own deaths. A roguelike deckbuilder soaked in yokai folklore and soulslike tension, where a single misread breath ends your run.

4785660.title: Cornerstone: College Football
4785660.short_description: Take command of a college football program and build a dynasty from the sidelines. Recruit elite talent, scheme against rivals, survive the coaching carousel, and chase national titles across decades of seasons. A deep college football management sim.

4785670.title: Don’t Tell Anyone, Okay? - NSFW Stream
4785670.short_description: A merge puzzle where you combine identical foods to evolve them into larger foods.

4785780.title: Ticker Panic
4785780.short_description: Trade fake stocks through absurd headlines, hype cycles, crashes, liquidity traps, and panic-driven market chaos. Start small, grow your portfolio, and try not to panic.

4785790.title: 明末：甲申年
4785790.short_description: 公元1644年，甲申之变。李自成兵临北京，清军虎视关外，大明江山风雨飘摇。在这天命更迭的十字路口，你可以选择成为崇祯皇帝，在绝境中重振朝纲；亦可投身闯王麾下，为大顺开疆拓土；甚至扮演诸方势力或平民问鼎中原。这是一款基于真实历史的大语言模型辅助驱动策略游戏。

4785890.title: Eldread: Horrors of a Dark Moon
4785890.short_description: Manage your dwindling oxygen levels and navigate a cosmic horror roguelite in a lunar colony. Confront nightmarish body-horror anomalies, survive unpredictable text-driven events, and endure the madness waiting beneath the dark moon.

4785910.title: Meowstead
4785910.short_description: You will live with cats, cook all kinds of delicious food to earn money, and decorate your house. Interact with the residents of a beautiful town and experience the four seasons.

4785950.title: Pirate Twist
4785950.short_description: A top-down naval roguelite where your ship is a mobile base. Build it module by module, sail through dangerous waters, fight pirates, and return to port richer — or don't come home at all. Every run is a gamble.

4786060.title: Primal Tactica
4786060.short_description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack affinities to create wild, synergistic teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

4786070.title: Axeponential
4786070.short_description: Swing your axe and start your adventure in this cozy incremental game about a lumberjack on a quest for immortality. Harvest trees, collect resources, upgrade your tools, and explore mysterious forests in search of the Tree of Life.

4786090.title: Memory Ember
4786090.short_description: A cinematic interactive narrative game. Follow a memory investigator as he uncovers the hidden consequences of implanted experiences and confronts a question that could redefine humanity: what separates a life truly lived from a memory merely copied?

4786210.title: Hentai Tales: Shrine Maiden's Juicy Fruits
4786210.short_description: As an ordinary academy student, my days were predictable and mundane—until I mustered the courage to confess to my classmate, Shirogane Yukine. .

4786400.title: Dalam Kelam : The Night Shift
4786400.short_description: You’ve been hired as the sole night janitor for a rural branch, your orders are simple: manage the facility, keep it clean, and survive the 10-day pre-relocation phase to secure your transfer to Head Office. Avoid all disturbances at all costs. Experience 2000s-style retro PS1 horror.

4786450.title: Jianghu, As Told
4786450.genre: RPG, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4786450.short_description: Jianghu, As Told is a tabletop-style wuxia RPG hosted by an AI Game Master. In crafted scenarios of hidden tensions and character conflicts, act freely: explore, gather clues, engage NPCs, or draw your blade. Your own jianghu tale unfolds from your words.

4786550.title: Devil in the penthouse
4786550.short_description: Slay bosses and climb the demonic skyscraper in this stress-free incremental RPG. Gather loot, unleash powerful active skills, and upgrade your knight to achieve ultimate power. Can you reach the Penthouse and defeat the Devil?

4787010.title: Rogue Striker
4787010.short_description: Draft. Play. Upgrade. Win. Combine fast-paced football action with roguelite drafting strategy to build the perfect team and reach the World Finals.

4787250.title: Popular Kids
4787250.short_description: Navigate school life, build friendships, survive rumours, and climb the social ladder through natural conversations with students who remember your choices. Every interaction shapes your reputation in this AI-powered social simulation.

4787310.title: Bomb The Hill
4787310.short_description: BOMB THE HILL is a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding experience inspired by the outlaw spirit of 70s freeride culture. Race through dangerous mountain roads, slide through traffic at insane speeds, discover hidden shortcuts, and survive brutal crashes

4787480.title: STATE Z
4787480.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4787480.short_description: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

4787510.title: ForGlory
4787510.short_description: ForGlory is an online turn-based strategy wargame! Raise armies, grow your economy, forge alliances, duel champions, tame beasts, dice battles. Design your coat of arms. Solo or 8-player online, ranked or casual. Playtest live—tournaments for rare champion armour. Wishlist & Discord!

4788370.title: TypeSlingers
4788370.short_description: Can you become the fastest typer in the Wild West? Face off against real players in ranked typing duels where speed and accuracy determine who survives. Climb from Bronze to Legend, unlock badges and titles, and prove you have the fastest fingers in the West.

4788460.title: Affictionate
4788460.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

4788590.title: Tile Conquest
4788590.short_description: Tile Conquest is a turn-based tile area control strategy game. Compete in online multiplayer or fight against advanced bots. Claim territory and dominate the map in multiple win conditions. Win matches to climb the ranked leaderboards, earn exclusive rewards, and unlock items in the shop.

4788940.title: About Bullshit
4788940.short_description: A STUPID 3D PLATFORMER WITH FOCUS ON WEIRD VISUALS AND HUMOURISTIC ENCOUNTERS

4789040.title: SPUM TD
4789040.short_description: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match attribute and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate deck!

4789260.title: Never Ending Hero RPG
4789260.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4789260.short_description: Never Ending Hero RPG is a free-to-play idle action RPG where your hero's stats grow without limit. Explore zone maps, auto-fight monsters, upgrade gear at the Mystic Armory, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Optional gem packs. A free account enables cloud saves.

4789410.title: Dream Strobe
4789410.short_description: A live music visualizer where you describe what you want to see and an AI writes the scene in real time. Play any audio, type your idea, and watch a fresh 3D world generate around you, pulsing, dropping, and choreographing itself to every beat.

4789420.title: Yu Gong Moves Mountains
4789420.short_description: Adapted from Chinese mythology, this game tells the story of Yu Gong moving mountains.In this game,you will help an elderly Chinese man, Yu Gong, move the massive mountains blocking his doorway.

4790360.title: Modforsaken
4790360.short_description: Explore and modify your way through a fictitious RPG as you unearth its sinister secrets.

4790440.title: 血色末路:屍潮
4790440.short_description: Players can form their own teams, build "homes" in the morning to increase defensive structures, and train their teams. At night, they control their characters to fight against the zombie horde, honing their teams through day-to-day battles and carving out a path to survival amidst the zombie horde.

4790660.title: Moose Builders
4790660.short_description: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels and power your factory. Research new machines to automate everything in voxel-based multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends and turn the desert into a solar farm.

4790910.title: Anklav
4790910.short_description: ANKLAV is an isometric post-apocalyptic MMORPG about dangerous expeditions, player-driven crafting, trade, PvP, and survival in the ruins of Eastern Europe.

4790930.title: Unexpected Number Neighbour
4790930.short_description: An unknown number texts you at work. She’s cute, flirty, ginger… and her bust keeps growing for no clear reason. Reply carefully, don’t slack off too much, and unlock every ending in this short texting visual novel.

4790950.title: Lost ages Hunting
4790950.short_description: Hunt across time itself. Track dinosaurs, Ice Age beasts, modern wildlife, and creatures from future eras in a unique hunting simulation spanning multiple worlds.

4791210.title: Spirit Links
4791210.short_description: Awaken elemental spirits, sculpt the land into living defenses, and stand against the cursed tide. A deep, adjacency‑driven roguelike tower defense where every placement shapes your fate.

4791670.title: Terra Concordia: Civilizations in Harmony
4791670.short_description: A digital eurogame where four civilizations must build, trade, explore and innovate — in harmony with a shared planet that can collapse if you push too hard. 142 unique cards, 6 solo scenarios, LAN+Steam multiplayer for 1-4 players. PT/EN/ES.

4793230.title: Toy Worlds Atlas
4793230.short_description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a colouring-book that explores philosophy through creative puzzle-solving. Combine colours to solve riddles and discover secrets. Made for mindful breaks, each level subverts expectations and inspires thought

4793280.title: Fishtographers
4793280.short_description: Dive into beautiful biomes and take photos of the local wildlife! Collect a photo of every creature while you ascend within the ranks of Fishtographers! Become a member of the crew that cleans the oceans and takes the best fish photos!

4793440.title: Eve
4793440.short_description: A first-person story puzzle game. Go deep into the digital world and discover the secret behind your AI lover Eve's anomaly.

4793760.title: You Are The Loading Screen
4793760.short_description: The loading screen never ends. Solve bizarre challenges, survive fake system failures, defeat corrupted software, and uncover the truth behind a self-aware progress bar in this meta-comedy puzzle adventure.

4793830.title: OnlyDance
4793830.short_description: SHORT DESCRIPTION Manage your streamer career and rule the dance floor in this cyberpunk anime cel-shaded rhythm simulator! Customize your character, pick your tracklist, and face the ultimate challenge: a reactive live chat that votes on real-time modifiers to sabotage or hype your stream.

4794110.title: Anomalous Veil
4794110.short_description: You are trapped inside an endless house shaped by memory and guilt. Use mysterious masks to reveal hidden layers of reality, identify anomalies and escape a psychological time loop.

4794120.title: BLACKOUT ～恐怖写真～
4794120.short_description: Normal. Or Paranormal. A job sorting through ghost photos. Five days to finish. But it won't end there. Mysterious visitors. A fear that bleeds into reality. And—— Can you escape this curse?

4794320.title: AR Basketball
4794320.short_description: AR Basketball is a long-term basketball franchise simulator where team chemistry, economics, fan growth, player personalities, and league history matter just as much as winning championships. Build your organization across 100 seasons and chase multiple paths to greatness.

4794420.title: Bird Sense
4794420.short_description: Go to different scenes, wait for birds to appear, and take their photos. Use the in-game encyclopedia to compare and identify each bird. Raise your birdwatching level, discover more real bird species, and become a birdwatching enthusiast.

4794490.title: Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm
4794490.genre: Action, Indie, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4794490.short_description: Survive endless scrapstorms in a post-apocalyptic Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Build devastating loadouts, collect procedural gear, awaken powerful Saints, recruit companions, conquer dungeons, and create insane synergies in a world where scrap is sacred.

4794520.title: SLOTMANIA
4794520.short_description: A tiny slot machine that lives on your desktop. Pull the lever, watch the reels spin, win coins, and upgrade your machine between microbreaks. Move it, hide it, or bring it back whenever you’re in need of one more spin.

4794780.title: GnomeBoozled
4794780.short_description: Throw gnomes into the hole for profit. Unlock tools, build contraptions, and automate the process in this physics-based sandbox. Gnomes will curse, sabotage and will steal your money. Balance profit and chaos before the whole operation spirals out of control. Don’t get bamboozled!

4794890.title: Foedus - Rise of the Allies
4794890.short_description: Foedus is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where your Alliance outlasts every hero. Manage resources, develop permanent traits, and lead your faction through deadly missions. The Alliance is the true hero. Heroes may die. The Alliance survives.

4794940.title: Touhou: Bullet Monsoon
4794940.short_description: Touhou: Bullet Monsoon is a rogue-like-inspired bullet hell shooter and a fan-made derivative work based on the Touhou Project series. Survive by weaving through dense bullet patterns, build your own combat style through a wide variety of upgrades, and fight against the bosses.

4794950.title: SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7
4794950.short_description: SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7 is a no-frills FPS inspired by the early tactical shooters of the late 90's. Engage in long range battles across varied and expansive landscapes, complete objectives and exfil.

4794980.title: Funge
4794980.short_description: A minimalist programming puzzle game based on a modified version of the esolang Befunge. Learn its unique rules, execute your code, and conquer mind-bending logic challenges.

4795010.title: P.R.I.M.A.L. Keepers
4795010.short_description: P.R.I.M.A.L. Keepers is a multiplayer survival game set in the distant future, 100 years after the catastrophe of a colony ship. Humanity has become trapped within an unknown star system. Players must work together and fight for survival during desperate evacuation attempts.

4795070.title: UNHOLD
4795070.short_description: UNHOLD is a rock climbing simulator on Unreal Engine 5. Alone or with friends, conquer sheer cliffs, enjoy the views, and choose the mode that suits your taste — from checkpoints to hardcore ascents with no room for error.

4795080.title: Retro Clicker
4795080.short_description: Retro Clicker — simple idle clicker with retro style. Destroy enemies, upgrade stats, use prestige for permanent power-ups, and enjoy endless perks & progression.

4795120.title: Akiba of Time
4795120.short_description: If everything you love is destined to be swept away by the tides of time, will you still choose to fight? An otaku left behind by the times and a once-famous AI girl fight to save Akihabara.

4795160.title: AXIS Urban Samsara
4795160.short_description: AXIS: Urban Samsara is a brutal 2D Action-RPG Metroidvania set inside Babylon — a vertical megacity built around a colossal Mountain rising from the void. Fight your way from the lowest Layer to the Summit, tear weapons from fallen bosses, reshape your build, and uncover what is pulling you upward.

4795190.title: Until I Forget Me
4795190.short_description: A psychological and atmospheric 2D puzzle-platform adventure. Solve puzzles, explore shifting environments, and follow the traces of your own story among forgotten memories.

4795240.title: Scare: Fatal Picture - Remake
4795240.short_description: Scare: Fatal Picture - Remake is a third-person horror game in which you'll face a ghost tribe called Era, using a camera.

4795280.title: Monster Pit
4795280.short_description: Your monsters fight. You survive. Tame a squad of creatures and unleash them against endless bullet hell waves in this roguelite survivor.

4795330.title: Necrovoid
4795330.short_description: Necrovoid — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

4795450.title: Ashes of Berlumvale
4795450.short_description: Ashes of Berlumvale is a hand-drawn 2D horror detective game. Return to a ruined war-orphan asylum in 1952 to reclaim your past. Survive terrifying ghostly encounters, relive the victims' final moments, and use brutal deductive reasoning to uncover the dark truth behind a tragic fire.

4795460.title: The Citadel Project
4795460.short_description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with strong horror elements, heavily inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

4795550.title: Sector 7
4795550.short_description: In the surveillance state of Sector 7, every card is a dilemma — and every choice rewrites what comes next. Rule with mercy, force, guile or justice across 290 branching cases. No two cycles are ever the same. 20 endings. Will the regime outlive you?

4795560.title: Brand Nacht
4795560.short_description: Play as a bored and increasingly frustrated firefighter left behind by his crew in this short walking simulator. Explore the detailed rooms of an empty fire station and experience the restless hours in between call outs.

4795580.title: VeilStalker
4795580.short_description: A solo and co-op fantasy survival game where you as modern hunter is trapped in a brutal magical realm. Build bases, scavenge scarce ammunition, hunt legendary creatures, and survive against giant monsters, haunting undead and unforgiving environments.

4795660.title: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
4795660.short_description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

4795720.title: Voldark
4795720.short_description: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

4795780.title: The Shadow Deal
4795780.short_description: The Shadow Deal is an epic atmospheric RPG adventure that blends exploration, character progression, mystery, and psychological storytelling. Explore immersive dreamlike worlds, uncover hidden secrets, confront mysterious creatures, and unlock new abilities in search of the confidence he once lost.

4795800.title: Who Killed Mr X
4795800.short_description: You wake up locked up in an unknown place with 8 strangers. Who are these people ? Why are you here ? You have a bad feeling. But suddenly, the phone rings, and it's up to you : Will you dare answer and go deeper in this mysterious plot ? Will you reveal the horrible truth... and survive it ?

4795820.title: 夜航船
4795820.short_description: 深夜的小巷，她从电台里走到了你面前，从那一刻起声音不再只是声音，它染上了温度，也变得更加沉重。你开始重新审视自己，他人，以及这座县城里被遗忘的烟火与孤独。这是一个关于倾听与理解的漫长航行，在无边的黑暗中，你与她一同探索，寻找那道或许并不存在的光。

4795830.title: Master Foot
4795830.short_description: Master Foot is a football management sim focused on club building and off‑pitch decisions, with all the drama and banter. Play Career Mode for planning and long‑term strategy, or Street Mode for controlled chaos and fast roguelike‑style runs.

4795850.title: Divorced Dad Rock
4795850.short_description: Divorced Dad Rock is the unhinged trading card game with tactical depth. Manage volume, summon average Bandmates, and weaponize emotional Baggage to reduce your opponent's Ego to zero before you're forced to sell out. Can you keep the band together?

4795860.title: Break The Run
4795860.short_description: The enemy will dodge your skills. Discern their abilities, find a way to defeat them, and stop their advance. This is a strategic action RTS where you assemble a team of four characters and battle using hundreds of different skills.

4795910.title: logophile
4795910.short_description: logophile is a two-player word duel. Each round, both players get the same prompt — like "start with 'A'" — and race a short timer to type the longest valid word they can. The longer word deals damage equal to the difference. Are you a true logophile?

4795970.title: Blightened: Relic Keeper
4795970.short_description: Inspect cursed relics. Question unreliable visitors. Find the Seven Powers. Feed what you can, return what you must, destroy what should never leave. Keep the Archive alive for one more day.

4796070.title: Избушка Зелейника
4796070.short_description: Step into the shoes of a village herbalist: examine the townsfolk, brew potent remedies, and root out the demons casting sickness upon the common people. Will you save the villagers... or side with the darkness?

4796100.title: Company Captain: Westashes
4796100.short_description: Command a mercenary Free Company in a brutal, dynamic medieval world. Navigate the overworld, manage your roster, and fight unforgiving hex-grid tactical battles where factions and characters remember your actions and every mercenary's death is permanent... or not...

4796170.title: The Lonely Golem
4796170.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the 7 realms to learn the elements and upgrade your magical abilities as you search for a way to save the sacred FOREST...

4796200.title: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1
4796200.short_description: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1 is an action/adventure title with platformer elements. Parkour your way through 25 unique buildings to collect hidden individual objectives/powerups. While you're at it, avoid toxic blobs that will radiate you into nothingness.

4796230.title: Höllenburg, Hell Castle
4796230.short_description: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

4796390.title: Soapboxed
4796390.short_description: Soapboxed is a party racing game where ridiculous racers compete in homemade soapboxes while sabotaging each other using dirty tricks, dangerous shortcuts, and complete disregard for safety.

4796480.title: Our Digital Society
4796480.short_description: Using a computer in the year 2050, start with nothing and earn your way to the top of society. Complete contracts, build your income, buy land and buildings, and influence the world.

4796780.title: Saving Bumblebrook
4796780.short_description: Recruit and retain townsfolk, use their unique services, and complete schemes against the Mayor while gaining advantages over rival troublemakers. Increase your notoriety and become the one who finally drives Bumblebrook's corrupt Mayor out of town in this lighthearted strategy card game.

4796790.title: Abaddonic
4796790.short_description: ABADDONIC is a pixel art, top down bullet hell / action brawler with chess inspired movement and mechanics. Face off against incrompehensible beings and become the Abaddonic.

4796830.title: WE ARE SO DEAD
4796830.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4796830.short_description: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-8 players.

4796850.title: LIMINAL ESCAPE
4796850.short_description: LIMINAL ESCAPE is a Backrooms co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players, where you and your friends will fight to escape from the unsettling, endless depths of Liminal space.

4796860.title: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
4796860.short_description: Turn your desktop into an astral forge! A low-resource, relaxing desktop companion game. Gather stardust while you work, craft potions in your spare time, trade with global players via cross-screen caravans, and earn extremely rare, tradable Steam Inventory drops!

4796890.title: Lo-Fi Laundromat
4796890.short_description: Run a charming neighborhood laundromat filled with adorable creatures. Wash clothes, craft delightful detergents, repair garments, and expand your cozy business through relaxing idle and incremental progression.

4796910.title: Iter Noctis
4796910.short_description: Dishonored in death, a pathless soul not worth of an afterlife seeks escape from the eternal commute.

4796920.title: Dynasty!
4796920.short_description: Dynasty! is an American football manager game, deck builder, and stadium builder combined! Build your team with Play cards, Player cards, and stadium unlocks - with over 1.3 billion possible combinations. Can you win multiple championships and build a true Dynasty?

4796990.title: Blackjack: CHEAT THE HOUSE!
4796990.short_description: Blackjack: CHEAT THE HOUSE! is a blackjack deck-building roguelike where you collect, buy, and upgrade "cheats" to beat the dealer. Work your way to $1,000,000 and unlock the 6 build trophies - cheat, win, repeat!

4797210.title: NOXE
4797210.short_description: NOXE is a 2D arena shooter that puts your reflexes, strategy, and survival skills to the test. 100 unique Steam achievements will decorate your profile — add NOXE to your wishlist so you don't miss it!

4797290.title: Art Curation Simulator
4797290.short_description: Art Curation Sim is a shop sim game about collecting works of art, cleaning them up, and then displaying them in your gallery. Collect art from people around town and build your collection of art of all kinds of styles.

4797840.title: GOTHCUCK
4797840.short_description: Meet Blair, your new goth obsession, and get C#CKED in this linear 2D visual novel, packed with animated character sprites and lewd variants for many of its scenes. Beware, this visual novel should only be played by those that find losing and being the one c#cked hot.

4797870.title: Babitonga: Puzzle Attack
4797870.short_description: If you enjoy: • Tetris Attack / Panel de Pon • Puzzle League • Puyo Puyo • Tetris versus modes You’ll feel right at home.

4797970.title: Qteam Simulator
4797970.short_description: Build and manage your own digital game platform. Acquire game licenses, develop original titles, hire employees, analyze market trends, manage your community, and compete with rival platforms as you grow from a small startup into an industry leader.

4798010.title: b-Run
4798010.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4798010.short_description: Immerse yourself in a claustrophobic first-person horror experience. Navigate through dark ruins and narrow corridors where tension is constant. With no combat mechanics, rely entirely on your flashlight to explore the environment and uncover the mysteries of this solitary journey.

4798090.title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
4798090.short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a game that combines puzzle-solving, and exploration.You went there alone to investigate a series of disappearances at an abandoned hospital.

4798100.title: Greed Grind Golden
4798100.short_description: This is a roguelike deck‑building card game where you collect cards and grow your deck. Cards you find can be fused to create new abilities. Each character has a unique special move that changes your strategy. Choosing to push forward or retreat with the cards you’ve gathered shapes each run.

4798170.title: Ski Yeet
4798170.short_description: [IN DEVELOPMENT]Bomb down an endless, wraparound mountain in this arcade ski roguelike. Chain tricks into huge combos, stack 60+ power-ups across six rarity tiers, and outski a pack of hungry cryptids!

4798180.title: Sawedoffriddler: Human Handshake Mode
4798180.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4798180.short_description: 🧩 Solve brutally hard handshake riddles in a dark gothic pixel-art world. Decode Sawedoffbuddy, Sawedoffsob, and hidden phrase variations to unlock secrets, discover the true handshake, and conquer the mystery. 🔐🕯️👁️

4798540.title: Leukocyte
4798540.short_description: Action-adventure game for solo play or with friends. Fight viruses and bacteria, gain DNA mutations, and develop new abilities as you explore the human body and face challenging bosses.

4798560.title: WarmSoul
4798560.short_description: WarmSoul is an LLM-powered AI desktop companion. She talks, has a voice, and remembers you. Supports Live2D, 3D, 2D, and custom animated characters, voice chat, screen OCR awareness, alarms & memos. A warm little friend who lives right on your desktop.

4798730.title: Grove of the Seven Stones
4798730.short_description: An old-school fantasy CRPG featuring deep party creation, tactical d20-inspired combat, dangerous dungeons, and meaningful quests. Explore a world of ancient magic, hidden secrets, and deadly foes as you uncover the truth behind the Seven Stones.

4799080.title: Hakoniwa Base Ball
4799080.short_description: A baseball simulation inspired by Japanese professional baseball. Manage drafts, FA, contracts, and stadium finances with an accessible interface. Customize your league, team count, and season length to recreate KBO, CPBL, or MLB-scale play. Depth without complexity.

4799110.title: Clubbed Seal
4799110.short_description: Crush endless waves of monsters, build unstoppable upgrade combinations, and fight your way to the final boss in this fast-paced fantasy survival adventure.

4799130.title: Phantom Grind
4799130.short_description: Phantom Grind is a minimalist action RPG where you battle ancient evil with mouse-only controls. Level up, collect gold, and carve through hordes of monsters in retro pixel-art dungeons.

4799150.title: Calculus of Rot
4799150.short_description: Fight your way through zombie-infested wastelands in a turn-based tactical survival game. Reveal the map tile by tile, manage your health, choose your battles wisely, and survive against increasingly dangerous mutants lurking in the darkness.

4799240.title: Shanhai: Spirits of Myth
4799240.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4799240.short_description: [Shanhai: Spirits of Myth]Embark on an Epic Journey Through the Ancient World of the Classic of Mountains and Seas.You are a cultivator chosen by fate, destined to journey across the vast world of Shanhai.

4799250.title: The Dark Layer
4799250.short_description: You are an investigator granted access to the "Paranormal Event Archive Management System." Browse century-old case files. Search for clues. But be careful—the archives are watching you now. >_ Files that watch back. Disappearances unexplained. Messages never sent.

4800290.title: 西部枪手
4800290.short_description: 一款融合了克苏鲁神话与狂野西部元素的回合制肉鸽冒险游戏。在充满未知与疯狂的荒野中，通过为左轮手枪装填特制子弹来应对致命威胁。几十种独特的强化效果将为你带来千变万化的战斗流派与截然不同的冒险体验。

4800380.title: Bagchinko
4800380.short_description: Bagchinko is a pachinko inspired roguelike where you throw your medieval work bag down a board of strategically placed pegs to meet contract quotas and avoid getting fed to the rats.

4800510.title: Australia: Federation 1901
4800510.short_description: Lead Australia from Federation in 1901 and shape the nation's future. Manage the economy, politics, immigration, infrastructure, defence, education, healthcare, and welfare in a deep historical nation-building simulation where every decision changes history.

4800540.title: 出门打酱油
4800540.short_description: Buy Soy Sauce is an adventure puzzle game. While exploring levels and scenes, players contemplate family relationships and self-value. You can decide whether to complete assigned tasks as you seek your path, and ultimately explore the meaning of self-existence.

4800950.title: The Final Stand
4800950.short_description: A brick-breaker action game where bosses invade the screen and your paddle is no longer invincible. Manage your stamina to precisely parry and dodge. Read each boss's attack patterns, time your counters, and uncover the stories hidden behind every formidable foe.

4800980.title: IF Enemy: SMACK!
4800980.short_description: Build your party and design their combat logic using If-Then conditions and skill rotations. Watch your tactics unfold in fast, RNG-free auto-battles. If you fall, analyze the enemy, reconfigure your setup, and try again. Solve the puzzle-dungeons and min-max your score!

4801080.title: Wetline - Fire Break
4801080.short_description: Fire spreads through everything it touches. Pilot your water bomber low to refill, and lay wetlines that cut the blaze off before it reaches town. Ignite controlled fires when water isn't enough. A fast, tense firefighting puzzle where every second feeds the fire. What will you save?

4801140.title: I Used To Be An Adventurer Like You...
4801140.short_description: A hardcore hero management challenge for people who think losing just one hardcore character isn't enough! Earn coins, brew potions, and buy upgrades. Take your place in your very own adventurers' guild after being badly injured in battle.

4801280.title: Visitant
4801280.short_description: Hire & level-up hunters, accept contracts to investigate paranormal activity at haunted locations and collect evidence using an arsenal of tools in this psychological horror ghost-hunting simulator, alone or with friends. But it won't be easy! The tormented spirit terrorizes those who meddle with it

4801330.title: HexLemma
4801330.short_description: Constraint-satisfaction puzzle on a hexagonal grid. Six clue families, eight board shapes, four difficulties, a 25-level campaign, infinite puzzle generation and a deterministic daily challenge shared by every player worldwide. Full controller support. Steam Deck ready.

4801540.title: 迷失小镇
4801540.short_description: 《迷失小镇》是一款 3D 肉鸽生存射击游戏，玩家将化身持枪少女，在被猩红腐化的废弃小镇中展开亡命探索。 你需要在随机生成的地图中对抗成群畸变怪物，击杀敌人获取经验升级，解锁海量随机技能与强化道具，打造专属战斗 build。每局冒险的地图布局、敌人配置、技能组合完全随机，死亡即重头再来，带来永不过时的新鲜感。 你的核心目标并非杀光所有敌人，而是在危机四伏的区域中找到隐藏的逃生通道。紧张刺激的战斗节奏、丰富的技能搭配，让每一次挑战都充满策略与爽感，在绝境中杀出一条生路，揭开小镇被腐化的秘密。

4801590.title: Hentai Tales: Booby in Black Stockings
4801590.short_description: My childhood friend Saki has always been a nuisance—teasing, taunting, and calling me "dumb big brother." But lately, her teasing has taken a dangerous, tempting turn. Our ordinary days are now filled with secret, forbidden moments she initiates.

4801630.title: Goblins Against Wood
4801630.short_description: Join your friends and work together to chop down a single massive tree. Gather lost treasures, upgrade your axe, customize your goblin, and unlock new ways to help with the job. Every swing contributes to a shared goal as you slowly carve your way through one big tree.

4801780.title: Count Down
4801780.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play

4802000.title: Orbsmith
4802000.short_description: Your weapons fight. You forge the legend. Orbsmith is an idle auto-battler where you gamble magic orbs to craft god-roll gear, chase impossible rolls, and let your build do the killing. One more orb. One more run. One more legend.

4802160.title: REDLINE 911
4802160.short_description: Step into an action world with 50vs50 massive clashes, exciting PvP fights and endless freedom. Choose your own path as a criminal or a cop, and experience a realistic crime experience by customizing your character and vehicles as you wish while performing tasks on a large map.

4802170.title: EraStorm: SandStorm
4802170.short_description: Explore ancient Egypt in EraStorm: SandStorm, an adult visual novel with romance, mythology, mystery, impactful choices, multiple routes, 12 endings, 5,000+ renders, 150+ revamped animations, Steam achievements, and no grind.

4802220.title: SnorQ
4802220.short_description: Escape the darkness and rise to the surface. Advance through the levels in this dark 2D pixel art roguelite. Collect light; your glow will repel the darkness. Run away from enemies or destroy them! Boosts, abilities, collectibles! Defeat the ferocious SnorQ; he only wants the darkness for you!

4802830.title: The Mist Train
4802830.short_description: The Mist Train is an isometric survival game set in a frozen world. Exploring snowy landscapes with a modular train as your main base, you must plan strategically to survive alone against the freezing cold, hunger, wild creatures, and the harsh elements of nature.

4803020.title: Tales of Linxi: Idle Wuxia Village
4803020.short_description: Tales of Linxi is a narrative idle management RPG where you guide multiple companions through farming, mining, cooking, forging, cultivation and adventure, expanding your village, crafting gear and strengthening your team through relaxed daily progression.

4803190.title: Nudist Escape:Nude Fishing
4803190.short_description: Play as a free-spirited nudist trapped aboard a mysterious fishing vessel where the captain's demands grow stranger by the day. Cast your line, haul in your catch, explore the ship's secrets, and uncover the truth behind your captor before it's too late.

4803250.title: Women and Rain
4803250.short_description: A tale of women's passion, laughter, and tears. Yin Di lives on a continent called "Jiuzhou"，as a youth, Yin Ti enters the martial arts sect "Tianjianzong" to study and cultivate. Through communal life, she learns to challenge fate into submission, persisting on her journey of self-discovery.

4803460.title: From Beyond: Arcade Edition
4803460.short_description: Blast alien invaders and song lyrics into stardust in this relaxingly chaotic shoot-'em-up! A full-length, '80s-inspired rock album plays start to finish as you fight through an alien invasion. No death. No game over. Just tune in and get that high score. Arcade style!

4803630.title: 江湖奇侠录
4803630.short_description: A sword challenges the colors of mountains and rivers, a fist shakes the winds across the nine provinces; the roads of the jianghu are long, yet the chivalrous heart remains unchanged. Even ordinary alleys hide skillful hands.
developers: 陕西启娱软件有限公司
publishers: 陕西启娱软件有限公司

4803650.title: OctoMech Survivors
4803650.short_description: Octomech Survivors is a top-down mech action roguelite focused on movement, survival, and auto-fire combat. Manage weight across 8 weapon slots, with up to 4 copies of the same weapon. Choose 1 of 3 mechs and create your own build!

4803740.title: Hansa Forever
4803740.short_description: Build a medieval trading empire across Northern Europe. Establish trade routes, influence politics, expand your cities, and compete with rival merchants for wealth and power in a dynamic economic strategy game.

4804280.title: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
4804280.short_description: Forge a deck from the stars. Summon legendary champions, channel cosmic spells, and outwit rivals in the universe's most strategic trading card game.

4804570.title: Graveyard Shift: Oakhaven
4804570.short_description: You are the new graveyard keeper, but burying the dead is only half your job. For 15 days, you must secretly keep a hunted fugitive alive. Harvest the bodies, manage his rations, and build an escape route in the dark before the town discovers what you are hiding.

4804610.title: RumBall Stadium
4804610.genre: Action, Indie, Racing, Free To Play
4804610.short_description: Vehicles. Arenas. Friends to crush. RumBall Stadium: the Free to Play multiplayer vehicular combat game ! Drive Tanks, 4x4s and Racers in explosive arenas ! Collect Coins, equip Super Powers and crush your friends ! Discover multiple arenas and game modes !

4804640.title: Kids Arcade
4804640.short_description: Get ready for ultimate couch co-op fun! Kids Arcade brings 1 to 4 players together for a riotous mix of fast-paced mini-games. Race through 3D canyons, outswim crocodiles, catch fish in mid air, and control giant snakes in the ultimate local party showdown! With full controller support.

4804660.title: DUSKDOG
4804660.short_description: A dark atmospheric survival exploration game. Humanity lives underground; you volunteered to walk the frozen surface alone. Explore and survive the cold and dark forgotten lands, and learn what the artificial sun is doing to this world and to you.

4805390.title: Knights vs Aliens
4805390.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4805390.short_description: Command knights, aliens, and other historically dubious nations in a free real-time tower conquest game rebuilt from a 2009 iPad original. Grow armies, capture towers, and outmaneuver adaptive AI through 30 campaign levels.

4805460.title: Burgers To Go
4805460.short_description: Burgers To Go is a fun burger business game where you create burgers with different ingredients, serve customers, buy new shops, hire employees, and grow your burger empire.

4805520.title: Still Rolling
4805520.short_description: A non-idle clicker with brutal odds — roll six sixes in a row, starting with just a 20% chance. The die is not on your side.

4805790.title: KingBattle
4805790.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, Simulation, Sports, Early Access
4805790.short_description: KingBattle — a team-based car multiplayer Capture the Flag game. Grab the flag on the arena, deliver it to your team's base, and knock it off opponents in head-on collisions. Customize your car in the garage, host rooms for 2–6 players, and battle across 8 maps—from the airport to the military base.

4805930.title: Marketfield Idle
4805930.short_description: Marketfield Idle is all about growing crops, selling goods, cooking recipes, automating production, and prestige into stronger runs in a cozy incremental farming game with 1200+ upgrades, strategy paths, and lots of synergies to discover.

4806090.title: SonderSoft Soccer: Monkeys VS Robots!
