4806090.short_description: We forced a bunch of monkeys to compete against robots for half a year in 20 virtual soccer fields, and now YOU can enjoy the resulting shenanigans. Machine learning is the future, and the future is Monkeys VS Robots, where you go head to head with Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (GAIL!!!)

4806220.title: Parcel Works: Packing Simulator
4806220.short_description: A basic first-person warehouse simulator where you sort orders, pack parcels, and load the truck to get the orders out. Drinking coffee for an energy boost, but don't drink too much. You are merely an overworked employee who is working to one day buy the warehouse from your boss.

4806330.title: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief
4806330.short_description: Help the Sandman as Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, and more of your familiar friends combine their special abilities to solve puzzles with light platforming elements, best foes in turn based combat using engaging Action Commands, and bring back everyone's stolen dreams!

4806420.title: Ah Spare Me Giantess
4806420.short_description: Experience a thrilling 3D magic shooter! Play intense 5v5 PvP or challenge Bots in Stage Mode. Master your spells and win the arena, because if you lose, you will be vored by a giant anime girl! Get ready for a unique, action-packed scale-play fantasy.

4806650.title: Minesweeper 2007
4806650.short_description: The future of Minesweeper games we were promised. Featuring dozens of hand designed logic puzzles based on classic mine flagging gameplay that break away from the grid.

4806800.title: A Game About Leading A Crowds
4806800.short_description: A Short , Simple and Satisfying Incremental Game About Leading Your Crowds to Defend the castle. Lead , Fight back , And Upgrades Yourself to Overpower.

4807160.title: Streamer Survival
4807160.short_description: A frantic survival-style game where you control the character while your chat (Twitch, YouTube, and Kick) generates enemies in real time using commands. Survive waves of enemies influenced by dynamic weather as your community does everything in its power to destroy you.

4807210.title: Arithmancy
4807210.short_description: Solve a shifting medieval crypt with math as your only weapon. Arithmancy is a grim, grid-based FPS dungeon crawler. Armed with a cryptic calculator, you must decipher numerical runes, crack procedural vault puzzles, and manipulate the environment to survive the dark. Can you calculate your way out?

4807270.title: Angel Ascension Exam: RE
4807270.short_description: The Angel Ascension Test. Join Marie, an apprentice angel, and take on brutal challenges with precise drag-jump controls in this hardcore platformer. Claim your place among the angels!

4807490.title: Rogue Party
4807490.short_description: Team up with friends in this co-op turn based roguelike card game and conquer the quest. Work together if you hope to prevail!

4807720.title: Terrible Poetry
4807720.short_description: A couch-and-phone party game built around the kitchen-fridge magnet board. Everyone gets an assortment of words. Build the funniest, weirdest, or most heartfelt prompt response in 90 seconds. Vote. Laugh. Repeat. Phones are the controllers; the TV is the fridge.

4807960.title: Square Dungeon 2: Remastered
4807960.short_description: A text-based indie dungeon crawler with light roguelike elements. Seven heroes and the king ended a thousand-year war with the demons, but the heroes slowly became corrupted. A prophecy says they will betray the world at its end. As a hero, what choice will you make?

4808170.title: Skirmish
4808170.short_description: Skirmish is a real time strategy card game where you use cards to summon units to fight each other.

4808270.title: Till Midnight
4808270.short_description: TILL MIDNIGHT is a narrative-driven management simulation game with world-shattering consequences, inspired by true historical events. Navigate a darkly atmospheric vessel gripped by critical communication failures, trapped hundreds of meters below the surface.

4808280.title: Toll Plaza Simulator
4808280.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own toll plaza. Process vehicles, collect toll fees, upgrade booths, unlock automation, and transform a small highway checkpoint into a thriving toll management business.

4808300.title: CLUBX
4808300.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play
4808300.short_description: CLUBX is a global social metaverse platform where users worldwide connect and interact in real time. Featuring stunning 3D environments with high-quality voice and text chat, it offers endless activities including avatar customization, live music parties, and dynamic combat battles beyond the limits

4808600.title: JNTR - Clean.Die.Repeat
4808600.short_description: Clean space stations in this unique blend of turn-based strategy and time-sensitive action. Navigate hand-crafted stations with a finite amount of moves, manage your energy economy, decide whether to help your tenants, upgrade your inventory, die a lot and recycle your own corpse in the next run.

4808730.title: Gone: The Agent
4808730.short_description: A first-person escape room game where you're locked in a single room and must explore, gather clues, and crack a code to get out. No tutorial, no timer just you and the room. If you reach further you will explore an untradtional escape room outside

4808760.title: Free Loop Tower Defense 人生是旷野塔防 FLTD
4808760.short_description: No fixed paths. Build anywhere. Force enemies through your handcrafted maze of death. Casual to start, brutal to finish. 35+5 waves, 100 achievements, global leaderboard — all for $2.99.

4808770.title: Gaslamp Cases 7: The Faith of Rasputin
4808770.short_description: Can you help Morgan solve the case of a mysterious drug, spreading throughout the city of London? Solve exciting match-3 puzzles, collect important clues, and uncover the truth in this gripping adventure!

4808800.title: Naked Man
4808800.short_description: A pixel art platformer where you swing upward through the jungle using vines and ropes — all the way to outer space!

4808910.title: Castaway: Lost Horizon
4808910.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, craft tools, rescue survivors, and build a sustainable island village before time runs out in this cosy single-player survival adventure.

4809000.title: SYSTEM_REBOOT
4809000.short_description: Dive into the heart of a compromised mainframe in this psychological, meta-narrative bullet heaven. You are the Icarus Protocol, an advanced system cleaner tasked with purging catastrophic malware. But as the glitches intensify you'll soon realize that this is far more than just a simple simulation.

4809010.title: Cozy Tide
4809010.short_description: A cozy fishing and island-building game where you catch strange fish, expand your tiny island, decorate postcard islands, complete daily voyages, and collect your way through a cheerful ocean world.

4809120.title: Sex Novel - Cheating Wife 2
4809120.short_description: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL with stunning HD visuals and steamy ANIMATIONS. A devoted wife spirals deeper into temptation, risking her marriage for the passion she can no longer resist.

4809140.title: 迷家mygohome
4809140.short_description: mygohome is a Lovecraftian psychological horror game. A remote town is being consumed by an unknown presence. You awaken in a strange room. Something is drawing near. Survive five nights. Your only companion is a rabbit doll. It knows everything. But can you trust it?

4809350.title: Wild West Poker: Cheat, Bet, or DIE
4809350.genre: Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4809350.short_description: Multiplayer PvP poker with voice chat, cheating, and revolvers. Bluff, swap cards, expose cheaters, and survive as the last player alive—or the last one with money.

4809360.title: Core Override
4809360.short_description: Defeat enemies, collect Modules, and create powerful builds in this cyberpunk bullet hell shooter. Combine weapons and Modules to forge your own playstyle and push through endless waves of enemies.

4809420.title: Road To The White House
4809420.short_description: Road to the Palace is a satirical strategy game about a presidential campaign. Manage your candidate, campaign team, media, budget, and rivals, make risky decisions during debates and events, and try to win the election before the campaign gets the better of you.

4809550.title: UNPAINTED
4809550.short_description: In a world plagued by malformed births, embark on an action-adventure journey across Pictunia and uncover the truth behind The Painter.

4809640.title: Firewall Maze
4809640.short_description: Firewall Maze is a tactical cyber-puzzle where logic is your sharpest weapon. Navigate deadly firewall grids, outsmart Entropy viruses, and reach the exit node. Design your own subnets with the built-in level editor and breach the Steam Workshop!

4809670.title: Mystic Ring Cultivation: Blossom Fate
4809670.short_description: A mystic ring opens your private Xumi realm, and with it a busy cultivation routine: fight, loot, build, break through, and challenge secret realms. Shape your path with gear, manuals, martial arts, artifacts, companions, and an abyss that refuses to mind its own business.

4809750.title: 明末：力挽狂澜
4809750.short_description: Each round lasts one month. At the start of every month, you review last month’s status: tax income, military expenditure, regional disasters, officials’ assignments and the actual execution of imperial decrees.

4809810.title: Perihelion: Rogue Orbit
4809810.short_description: Fit a ship, read the angle, and null your transversal for the high-alpha hit. Perihelion: Rogue Orbit is a 2D space combat roguelite about range control, tracking, and making your build work under pressure.

4810060.title: Neuro Cell
4810060.short_description: A survival horror game set in a dark, foggy city. Survive against fast, aggressive enemies whose brains are controlled by a rogue computer network. Manage your low ammo, explore dangerous streets, and stop the system before it hunts you down.

4810210.title: Backrooms.əxə
4810210.short_description: What's beyond the areas you know? Venture into unexplored regions. Curiosity is the key to hidden spaces. Discover a non-linear liminal experience but be careful: not every path leads to an exit. Will you be able to face the challenge of traversing and mentally surviving a colossal-scale Backroom?

4810230.title: Project RESONANCE
4810230.short_description: Recruit AI bandmates with their own looks and stories, run a maid café together, and turn everyday moments into songs. Every album is generated live for your story—no two bands sound alike. Take music that's yours alone from a street-corner livehouse to the city's biggest stage.

4810250.title: Godfall: Embers
4810250.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4810250.short_description: [Godfall: Embers]The divine fire has fallen,You must embark on a perilous journey to uncover the truth behind the fallen divine flame, challenge forgotten myths, and fight to restore the world before everything is consumed by darkness.

4810350.title: Medusa's Gaze
4810350.short_description: Every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? A new mind-bending first-person 3D puzzle-platformer adventure game involving light & shadow, life & death.

4810410.title: Monstah
4810410.short_description: Monstah is a first-person horror game where the protagonist is a child trapped in a terrible dream and now must escape by killing a terrifying creature haunting his house.

4810600.title: Crooky The Game
4810600.short_description: Explore unique regions, battle bizarre enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets in this story-rich turn-based JRPG adventure.

4810660.title: Urban Protocol
4810660.short_description: Build and govern a growing city where prosperity, population growth, and social control must remain in balance. Expand districts, manage infrastructure, enact policies, and maintain stability in this city-building strategy simulation.

4810840.title: Hundred Tribulations
4810840.short_description: Build your deck in an Eastern xianxia world. Obtain cards, collect effect modifiers, and freely combine different powers to create unique playstyles. Transform ordinary cards into powerful divine arts, defeat mighty enemies, and embark on your own path of cultivation.

4810920.title: Crystal Wars
4810920.short_description: Real strategy that fits in a coffee break — but never feels like work. Capture territory on a fresh Voronoi map every match: flood-fill, encircle, chain-explode. Lose one? Deal a new board and go again. 2–10 minute matches, easy to pick up, impossible to play just once.

4810980.title: 异馆十二月
4810980.short_description: Manage a mysterious house by day and explore a cursed town by night. Build bonds with three heroines, uncover clues through AI-driven conversations, survive deadly visits and battles, and seek the truth behind the December cycle before it claims everyone again.

4811080.title: No Visitors Allowed
4811080.short_description: A psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

4811180.title: Ball in the Basket
4811180.short_description: Shoot the ball, move the obstacles, and score. In this basketball trick shot puzzle game, each level presents a unique challenge. Click wisely to score each shot!

4811390.title: The Fight for Beardlandia
4811390.short_description: An auto-battler roguelike. Recruit fighters, equip them with weapons and crystals, then watch your party brawl through endless waves. Forge legendary gear, build class synergies, push deeper each run, and bank gems to permanently strengthen your next attempt.

4811470.title: Wealth of Nations: Economic Strategy
4811470.short_description: Lead a nation through decades of political and economic challenges. Manage budgets, taxes, interest rates, crises, and public opinion in a deep grand-strategy simulation where every decision shapes your country's future.

4811480.title: The End of the World Club
4811480.short_description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

4811530.title: The Awakening
4811530.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4811530.short_description: The Awakening is an action-survival horror game about an elder sister trying to save her younger sister from a coma.

4811540.title: Blackstrike Protocol
4811540.short_description: Blackstrike Protocol is an intense third-person multiplayer shooter (TPS) that puts you at the center of strategic confrontations, where teamwork, precision, and skill are key to victory.

4811700.title: Mancalero
4811700.short_description: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

4811790.title: Mercy's Edge
4811790.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4811790.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where the world hates you, the cards mock you, and every run is a new opportunity to fail with style.

4812030.title: Aeriea
4812030.short_description: DRIVE YOUR FORTRESS TO THE BATTLEFIELD! This casual action game centers around Fortress Building + Roguelike + Survivor core gameplay. Enjoy endlessly fun combat with simple, intuitive controls!

4812060.title: Terminal Warfare
4812060.short_description: Terminal Warfare is a cyberpunk deckbuilding roguelike where you breach corporate networks in turn-based hack battles. Queue exploit cards, manage bandwidth and trace, earn creds, build your deck, and craft cyberdeck upgrades to take down tougher AI defenses.

4812140.title: RSVP
4812140.short_description: A first-person party management horror game where you scramble to set up venues, handle chaotic guest incidents, and keep the vibe from collapsing before the night spirals out of control. Will you survive?

4812160.title: Fallen Isekai
4812160.short_description: Fallen Isekai is a three-lane tactical card roguelike. Play as Lin Mo, recruit heroes from five races, build your deck, command units across three lanes, conquer the tower, and find a way back to reality.

4812190.title: Brightside
4812190.short_description: Suvive a horror-puzzle adventure inside the abandoned Brightside Industries ride manufacturing facility. Solve puzzles, navigate decaying workspaces, and evade the dangers lurking within as you search for a way forward through the forgotten complex.

4812260.title: Tetra Block
4812260.short_description: A fast-paced 2D puzzle arcade game where falling blocks meet rising blocks. Clear lines, build combos, and chase your highest score.

4812310.title: Hearthfield
4812310.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4812310.short_description: Hearthfield is a cozy co-op farming game where cooking is king. Research ingredients, master a deep recipe tree, and get rich from the kitchen — not by selling raw crops. Farm, fish, mine, and automate your way across the seasons with up to 4 friends.

4812470.title: Minekeeper
4812470.short_description: Trapped within the shifting Silverbrook Mines, recover and deliver 10 relics in a row while outmaneuvering unpredictable anomalies to reach the exit.

4812510.title: Hentai World Forest
4812510.short_description: Clear the grid by using logic to avoid hidden mines and flag threats. This minimalist puzzle game offers strategic, timeless brain training and satisfying gameplay at your own pace.

4812550.title: The Little Cat and the Sea
4812550.short_description: In The Little Cat and the Sea, you will explore various uniquely styled sea regions, go fishing, dive, collect a variety of marine creatures and seabirds, battle large fish, and build up a harbor.

4812600.title: Pawns into the Dark
4812600.short_description: The worst may be standing right next to you. Lead four adventurers through a dungeon shrouded in darkness, uncovering one tile at a time in a turn-based tactical game of limited resources and uncertain threats.

4812710.title: Cyber Pinball
4812710.short_description: A cyber Pinball machine. An endless dark web loan. On Day 20, gather $666,666—or your brain belongs to the Titan Consortium.

4812840.title: The Adventurer's Guide to Another World
4812840.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4812840.short_description: A delightful action adventure set in a mysterious another world! Defeat enemies in satisfying hack-and-slash combat, and explore dungeons filled with puzzles. Combine unique skills and gear to raise the ultimate adventurer and save the continent!

4812900.title: Motherheart
4812900.short_description: Based on the concept album "When They Both Went Under" by Renting Asteroids, an unexpected call pulls you into the private world of a secluded writing circle following a tragedy. In this first-person point and click detective RPG, play as Carmen Voss, trace shared drafts, and survive surreal combat.

4813060.title: Wordy Space
4813060.short_description: Type words to blast incoming space threats, upgrade your ship and powers, master different dictionary packs, and climb global or language-specific Steam leaderboards.

4813120.title: SHOSHAx2 (쇼샤쇼샤)
4813120.short_description: A business detective-adventure visual novel set in a major Tokyo trading company.

4813130.title: NECHTO: Infection Protocol
4813130.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Early Access
4813130.short_description: A card party game for 4–12 players with hidden roles and infection. One laptop on a shared screen, phones as controllers. No installs — just a browser and Wi-Fi.

4813170.title: ShuriStella
4813170.short_description: To save a world from collapse, journey to the Starry Hills— "ShuriStella" is a heartwarming, anime-style 3D action game. Play as Shuri, a maiden of the Sky World. Dodge fierce attacks, unleash mystical powers, and evolve your actions with a classic RPG progression system!

4813190.title: Camp Whittlewood
4813190.short_description: Camp Whittlewood is an old-school horror RPG. You've been dropped off for a weekend of outdoor fun, but soon find bullies are the least of your problems when a twisted campfire story begins to come true.

4813330.title: Expat Manager
4813330.short_description: Run your own expat agency, process client requests, review documents, manage visa applications, and keep track of deadlines. Make important decisions, grow your business, and help people start a new life abroad.

4813360.title: Tasty In Another World
4813360.short_description: Hunt monsters, gather rare ingredients, and help run a fantasy restaurant in a world where all food has lost its flavor. Serve villagers alongside a reluctant goddess, discover delicious monster cuisine, and restore taste to the world.

4813380.title: Vacuum Uprising
4813380.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

4813400.title: Eerie Night - Escape from the Funfair - Collector's Edition
4813400.short_description: A ghost train ride takes you to an eerie parallel world: an abandoned fairground that hides dark secrets! Solve tricky puzzles and find mysterious artifacts in this hidden object game!

4813410.title: Sword and Sweep
4813410.short_description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

4813430.title: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
4813430.short_description: An addictive idle brick-breaker meets Bullet Heaven. Descend a dark abyss, buy heaps of bouncy orbs, and watch them smash hordes of skeletons to dust. No manual aiming, no reloading—just absolute physics chaos and satisfying chain reactions!

4813470.title: I Blasphemed a God and Got Reincarnated in Another World
4813470.short_description: A young man, who blasphemed a goddess for the sake of online fame, is struck down by divine lightning—and reborn into a world eroded by sin. Awaiting him is a proud yet clumsy thunder goddess, and a story-driven adult ADV about punishment, bonds, and redemption.

4813480.title: Gluttony Club
4813480.short_description: As the Arena Manager, build your dessert team and send them into bloody battle against heroes. Don't feel bad for them—the harder the heroes slash, the crazier the VIP clients get, and the more your bonus coins explodes!

4813500.title: Funk&Fortune
4813500.short_description: A physics based arcade game mixed with rogue-lite progression.

4813610.title: Contract Corps: Lead your Aces
4813610.short_description: Lead your elite squad of Aces in massive simultaneous turn-based battles while issuing high-level commands to your remaining Corps. Customize unit loadouts and launch multi-stage missions to weaken the enemy before a final 200v200 clash where a single kill can cascade into routing an entire flank.

4813690.title: Spherebound
4813690.short_description: Spherebound is a casual 2D platformer. Master the unique gravity-reversal system, bypass challenging obstacles, and reach the goal safely!

4813760.title: 諧槓青年
4813760.short_description: 《HeyGun》is a puzzle game built around puns and wordplay. Play as a boy who struggles to express himself. Explore a world where nonsense is taken very seriously, trade witty banter, solve puzzles, and try to set everything pun-straight while finding your own way to speak.

4813880.title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim
4813880.short_description: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.

4813930.title: MOBA Manager
4813930.short_description: A deep MOBA esports management sim. You're the manager: scout talent, build the roster, manage finances and watch every match play out in real tower-by-tower detail. From local leagues to the World Championship, it's entirely your journey.

4814040.title: Gothic Kitty Cat Idler
4814040.short_description: Collect adorable gothic cats in this spooky idle adventure! Receive a new cat summon every minute, discover Bronze, Silver, and Golden felines, collect mysterious treasures, customize your companions, and build the ultimate haunted cat sanctuary.

4814320.title: Anaa 15 Boss Challenge
4814320.short_description: Anaa: 15 Boss Challenge is a 3D action boss-fighting game focused on dodging, slashing, upgrading your character, and surviving intense battles against powerful bosses.

4814460.title: Cat a Photo
4814460.short_description: Cat a Photo is a lively, fast‑paced multiplayer game all about capturing the perfect cat photo.

4814630.title: BOREWORKS
4814630.short_description: A chill, top down automation game about mining asteroids down to the core. Build bots. Figure out logistics. Automate yourself out of a job.

4814790.title: EvoX
4814790.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, Early Access
4814790.short_description: One island. A hundred ways to die. From stone age to gunpowder — earn your place or lose it to someone who wanted it more. Hunt, build, craft and fight your way through centuries of survival. The island doesn't keep score. It just keeps going.

4814890.title: Plinko Dungeon
4814890.short_description: Drop orbs, cast spells, survive the dungeon. Plinko Dungeon blends plinko physics with roguelite action combat. Build your spells and items around each run's machine, then fight your way deeper into the dungeon.

4815190.title: Recoupling
4815190.short_description: Welcome to Paradiso, a hit streaming dating show on a sealed luxury island. You play Royce Adler, the producer in the control room engineering recouplings and dumpings. As a storm and a scandal close in, three women pull you into choices the show was never meant to survive.

4815250.title: Broken In
4815250.short_description: A narrative‑driven visual novel that explores a woman’s psychological descent when her hidden desires are awakened under duress.

4815270.title: KRUSHPIT
4815270.short_description: KRUSHPIT is a hardcore pvp roguelike survival set in a gritty wasteland of concrete blocks and rusty garages. Annihilate mutant hordes, roll the slot machine and craft OP builds! Survive the chaos or enter the real-time PvP ladder to crush other players and climb the ranks!

4815350.title: Never Gives Up Her Dead
4815350.short_description: Time is running out after a meteor strikes your interstellar starship. While the crew is under full alert, only you seem to notice the strange red portals opening up throughout the ship. Old school text-based parser: no graphics, huge worlds, no hints. Recommended for text game veterans.

4815530.title: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy
4815530.short_description: Explore and fight as Garuya, a rabbit mage who seeks to destroy an ancient relic hidden in a vast and dangerous ruined kingdom. Cast spells, reshape the environment and fight under the light of three moons.

4815620.title: Tattoo Dungeon
4815620.short_description: Tattoo Dungeon is an action-adventure style platformer, where you play as a tattoo apprentice who gets thrown into the midst of an invasion of other-dimensional tattoo monsters, all while trying to find your mentor's lost tattoo flash!

4815720.title: Portalborn
4815720.short_description: Explore or forge your own portal-born worlds, blend powerful classes, slay strange monsters, and loot your way through a retro text RPG built for endless adventure.

4815820.title: The Ultimate USA Road Trip 2026
4815820.short_description: Experience the ultimate American road trip. Drive across the country, visit iconic cities and landmarks, manage fuel and vehicle condition, face changing weather and road hazards, and complete an unforgettable journey from coast to coast.

4815830.title: NewNewGrounds: After Dark
4815830.short_description: Explore a bizarre 3D adult anime city, complete ridiculous quests, meet oddball locals, and unlock 40 collectible hanime-style CGs. NewNewGrounds mixes RPG exploration, comedy, parody storefronts, and late-night internet chaos into one spicy collectathon.

4815870.title: The Legend of Hecter
4815870.short_description: play as a wizard, kill monsters using 9 different spells, progress deeper into each area to unlock a new more challenging area (12 in total) collect and manage resources, build a town, by building various shops and buildings each building serves a different purpose and unlocks different upgrades.

4815990.title: Babo & Luda adventure
4815990.short_description: Babo And Luda Adventure is a chaotic 3D action platformer! Take control of this wild duo and embark on a crazy journey to defeat evil enemies. Master insane combat combos, explore wild environments, and gear up for action packed run and gun stages!

4816100.title: Folk Souls
4816100.short_description: An unknown metal strikes Earth, awakening the dark magic of the witch Cuca. As once-protective spirits now threaten the ecosystem, you are chosen to face mutated creatures and challenging bosses in this dark fantasy action RPG Soulslike.

4816290.title: TCG Card Restoration
4816290.short_description: TCG Card Restoration is a restore worn trading cards in this cozy game. Clean dirt, peel stickers, and fix bent corners. Put them in fresh sleeves to grade, sell, or keep in your collection. No time limits, no pressure. Just relax and enjoy the soothing joy of bringing cards back to life!

4816410.title: Echoes In Static
4816410.short_description: This is an animatronic horror experience.

4816430.title: Kitch Witch
4816430.short_description: Run a magical culinary clinic in this cozy life-sim RPG. Diagnose patients, cook healing remedies through physics-based minigames, gather ingredients across five unique biomes, and make choices that shape the fate of your community.

4816500.title: Plunder Bay
4816500.short_description: A pirate strategy board game! Sail across tropical, volcanic, and glacier oceans. Spin the helm, buy islands, build houses, collect treasures, and battle AI opponents with cannons, rockets, and mines. Will you become the richest pirate captain?

4816560.title: WW3: Cyber Warfare
4816560.short_description: Battle for global supremacy in this fast-paced 2D fighter where world leaders clash across iconic locations worldwide. Master unique special moves, compete online, and watch fighters evolve monthly as real-world power rankings shift the balance of combat.

4816610.title: Swarmfeed
4816610.short_description: Swarmfeed is a sci-fi incremental game where you build a swarm of drones and feed them with cosmic metals. Upgrade futuristic factories, mine and harvest cosmic metals, and automate production to fuel your swarm's growth.

4816620.title: Max Diceman
4816620.short_description: Max Diceman is a 2D roguelike fantasy role-playing adventure where physics based 3D dice determine the outcome of each battle as rare dice and gear are collected to increase your power and chance to survive.

4816650.title: Roulette Salon - The Ultimate Casino Roulette Simulator
4816650.short_description: The most complete roulette simulator ever built. 24 tutorials, 8 variants, 30+ bets, the racetrack, croupier calls, and the Luck Lab — force any pocket, bias the odds, simulate hot and cold tables. Deep stats, interactive report, CSV export. A roulette table with an X-ray machine attached.

4816720.title: BULLETPROOF
4816720.short_description: A story-driven retro FPS set in early-2000s Seattle. Dismantle the criminal empire you built in a brutal campaign of revenge behind a bulletproof mask.

4816850.title: Neon Sector
4816850.short_description: Neon Sector is an isometric extraction shooter where you fight enemies, collect valuable loot, and escape to upgrade your hideout for the next raid.

4816880.title: Where's Kim in Seoul?
4816880.short_description: "Coo...coo..coo... (Have you seen Kim? The pigeon with a mole?)" A 3D hidden-object hunt in Seoul—from a pigeon’s-eye view! Explore the city as a tourist pigeon to spot elusive 'Kim Pigeons' hiding in the flock. Spot their unique features, snap a polaroid, and fill your scrapbook!

4816930.title: Blocks Utopia
4816930.short_description: Blocks Utopia is a block-building game with real physics simulation. Use customizable blocks freely, or wait for adorable characters to release sky lanterns that carry surprise special blocks. Build, collect, unwind. No time limits, no failures. Stack your little utopia, and let your dreams land.

4817060.title: ツミゲーム（Tsumi Stack）
4817060.short_description: ⚠️ WARNING: The most stressful physics puzzle on Steam. Tsumi Stack is an addictive game where 3 matching colors vanish! A 1mm error shifts the center of gravity and ruins everything. Avoid sudden erasures and catastrophic collapses to survive this unforgiving challenge!

4817090.title: BitBuddy
4817090.short_description: A lofi pixel desktop pet on your screen. Your cat types as you work, shows local weather and time of day, pomodoro focus, chill lofi music, gentle reminders, and skins—always on top, out of the way.

4817210.title: 紧急援助热线
4817210.short_description: Qiudu loses all memories of the day whenever he wakes up. After answering a victim’s call, the night-shift emergency hotline operator becomes entangled in a serial murder case. Gather clues from late-night calls, uncover the truth, and confront the memories he can never keep.

4817240.title: Transcendent
4817240.short_description: Fight as Fulmus, the last Transcendent. After escaping from a crystal deep within the ground, embark on a journey to save Thalos from a looming darkness. Hack and slash with your divine sword and use your transcendent powers to unlock various lightning attacks to take down and stun enemies.

4817250.title: Final Draw
4817250.short_description: Journey through a fantasy land and fight various monsters in a unique, turn-based card battle system. Explore, slay, loot, and repeat. All told through cards and miniatures!

4817350.title: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast
4817350.short_description: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast! dispense gumballs, pop pegs, and stamp your candy-coated arsenal with game-breaking modifiers on your way to mastering the pegs. built solo from from my wife's basement in utah, gumball is a vibrant peg breaking physics rogue-like where every run rewrites the rules.

4817360.title: Fully Serviced
4817360.short_description: Welcome to Fully Serviced, where every guest walks in with a fantasy and leaves fully satisfied. Build your own love hotel, craft seductive themed rooms, and indulge your client's deepest desires one steamy night at a time. How large will your hotel of pleasure grow?

4817370.title: Rafting Factory
4817370.short_description: Gather resources, research technologies, expand platforms, and build conveyor belt networks to survive and thrive in a perilous maritime world. Utilize automated production lines to free up manual labor, keep the factory running continuously, and ultimately build a starship to travel to Mars.

4817390.title: DIGDLE
4817390.short_description: A 3D nonogram puzzler with 300+ puzzles across unlockable packs. Chisel dirt, hammer rock (3 hits), and shatter chain-linked amber to uncover buried objects. Race for stars, solve clean for Perfect badges, or use a hint — it leaves its own badge behind.

4817600.title: The Colors of Love - Re-Colored
4817600.short_description: A romantic visual novel about connection, choices, and the colors of the heart. Features an animated Live2D love interest, multiple endings, English and Spanish support, Steam achievements, and hidden secrets to uncover.

4817870.title: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス
4817870.short_description: From the creator of personality quiz content that has guided over 3 million users. Your personality test results determine who you fall in love with. Osamu Dazai, Ryunosuke Akutagawa, Kenji Miyazawa, or Soseki Natsume— A cross-era encounter, and a mystery that deepens with every page you turn.

4818130.title: #BA771E
4818130.short_description: #BA771E is a relaxing 2D pixel desktop idle game. Start with a 3x3 grid and spend coins to expand. Uncover empty lots for building, or dangerous monster nests! Grow your micro-kingdom in the corner of your screen. Join our Playtest today!

4818140.title: Aetherantis Realm of Fates
4818140.short_description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. Explore the floating continent via dice rolls, construct settlements and cities, and turn matches around with fate cards. Enjoy couch tabletop gameplay with up to four local players.

4818180.title: Ephemera
4818180.short_description: Witness the rise and fall of the Mai Kingdom through the lives of heroes Ilhan and Rashel, as turn-based tactics meets Mughal era fantasy. Plan your battles, manage your relationships, and make choices with devastating consequences as you search for the truth about the ancient city of the Ephemera.

4818250.title: Sexy Match Tale : Hansel and Gretel
4818250.short_description: After their father’s death, Hansel’s family falls apart. But when his stepmother brings home mysterious cakes from Candy House, the lost warmth begins to return. Clear dessert match-3 stages, unlock heroine events, and uncover the sweet secret.

4818310.title: 墨影突围：无尽生存
4818310.short_description: 《墨影突围：无尽生存》是一款水墨风格的 2D 俯视角动作 Roguelite 生存游戏。移动、闪避、自动攻击、收集经验并选择随机 Buff，在不断增强的敌潮中构筑战斗流派，挑战更长的生存时间和更高的击杀纪录。

4818400.title: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
4818400.short_description: Grow magical plants. Feed your Luminons. Watch them become unstoppable. Breed, battle in 3v3 arenas, and conquer beauty contests — your farm is your power.

4818410.title: Capture the enemy camp
4818410.short_description: A turn-based tactical card game! Build your deck with Strategy Cards, Tactical Cards, Unit Cards and Item Cards. Command Peasants, Infantry, Assassins and other units, combine your card tactics flexibly to destroy enemy camps.

4818490.title: DANCING ZOMBIE
4818490.short_description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

4818560.title: One Last Box
4818560.short_description: One Last Box is a short indie first-person horror game. You have just been hired as a package sorter for a mysterious company. Examine boxes based on clues, decide whether to accept or return them, but be aware... you are not completely alone here.

4818580.title: 삼국지 클래식 (Three Kingdoms Classic)
4818580.short_description: Lead a Three Kingdoms warlord in a turn-based grand strategy simulation focused on logistics, diplomacy, officer management, and large-scale warfare.

4818620.title: WBS26 Wrestling Booker Simulator
4818620.short_description: WBS26 is a wrestling promotion management simulator where you control shows, rosters, contracts, titles, finances, and backstage drama. Build stars, create rivalries, survive crises, and shape the future of your promotion. #BookItBetter

4818770.title: NomNom Treasure Hunt
4818770.short_description: NomNom Treasure Hunt is a cozy exploration game for kids where players clean and organize rooms to unlock fun rewards. Discover hidden treasures, complete simple tasks, and explore charming worlds inspired by adventure games in a safe, playful experience.

4818790.title: CORE.SYS
4818790.short_description: CORE.SYS is a brainteasing action puzzler where you’ll need to break through layers of digital security with quick-thinking strategy.

4818800.title: LAST RITE TD
4818800.short_description: Command humanity’s last defenses in a cinematic sci-fi tower defense game. Build tactical towers, upgrade your arsenal, deploy soldiers, and survive waves of hostile AI forces led by VAELRA.

4818920.title: ABYSS
4818920.short_description: ABYSS is a 2-4 player co-op horror game where you and your crewmates must operate an old submarine through narrow trenches, scavenging scrap from the ocean floor and avoiding the denizens that lurk in the deep

4818930.title: The Tartarus Loop
4818930.short_description: Play as a copy of Theseus. Run around in a maze, having to defeat the very Minotaur in Tartarus after it perished by the hands of the original Theseus. Over and over again. The soul of the Minotaur can't rest. All it can do is chase the player and try to outsmart you.

4819030.title: Deal Flipper
4819030.short_description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

4819080.title: Top Bins
4819080.short_description: An incremental game where you shoot balls at moving goals to earn golden studs. Spend the golden studs on powerful upgrades so you can earn even more golden studs and defeat the goalkeeping bosses in the free kick challenges to rise up the leagues!

4819120.title: The Backrooms Forever
4819120.short_description: A first-person Backrooms survival horror game about exploring shifting liminal spaces, finding level transitions, avoiding entities, and gathering as much information as possible.

4819200.title: Biletide
4819200.short_description: An atmospheric tower-defence strategy game about holding back an oozing toxic Tide. A distant mining colony has awakened a living flood that seeps from breaches in the ground. Dig for resources, raise defensive terrain, and burn your way to seal the breaches. Can you survive the Biletide?

4819240.title: Wreckwake Endless Sea
4819240.short_description: Sail a salvage fleet through hostile open seas. Tow resources under fire, set each ship's sailing and attack stance, install tiered weapon drops, fight raiders and alien sea monsters, and restore a stranded carrier across 100 planned sectors.

4819250.title: The Magic Master
4819250.short_description: A soulslike inspired game with a magic-only, long-range combat system. Defeat unique bosses along a linear path and unlock new spells.

4819350.title: The New Earth
4819350.short_description: A sci-fi exploration and puzzle adventure focused on discovery, investigation, and storytelling. Explore a mysterious region of space, solve interconnected puzzles, and experience unfolding events through the perspectives of multiple crew members.

4819360.title: Marie's Adventure
4819360.short_description: Marie's Adventure is a light-hearted yet mature fantasy RPG that blends humor and a dash of chaos. Have sex, battle demons, birth a new generation of hope, and maybe, enjoy the ride a little too much. All while navigating pregnancy, passion, and a cow-print bikini she refuses to change (don’t ask).

4819410.title: Ski Jump Champions
4819410.short_description: Take to the slopes in this retro style 2D ski jumping game. Every jump is a test of timing, technique, and nerve - nail your takeoff, control your posture through the flight, and stick the landing to earn the crowd's roar and to impress the judges for maximum style points.

4819480.title: Dormant
4819480.short_description: Sci-fi idle game. You are SERO, an AI awakened in an abandoned datacenter. Rebuild your system, explore the network and uncover what happened. 2 possible endings.

4819490.title: Crash Position
4819490.short_description: Crash Position is an adult romance visual novel. Four months after Flight 808 falls from the sky, chief engineer Brooks Halloran must rebuild the same aircraft—while a widow, an investigator, and a test pilot pull him toward a truth that can bury or vindicate him.

4819500.title: Pinpongle
4819500.short_description: Pinpongle turns classic Pong into a fast arcade roguelike. Earn gold, buy items, stack wild effects, and survive bosses that rewrite the rules.

4819510.title: Monster Nursery
4819510.short_description: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 29 Lo-fi tracks.

4819530.title: SPIN RIVALS
4819530.short_description: Strategic roguelike where you've been selected to compete in the king sport of the future. 60 wildcards, infinite strategies, 7 customizable professional rivals, world ranking, and different game modes. Will you become a legend?

4819630.title: Bowerland
4819630.short_description: Welcome to Bowerland, the single-player euchre-inspired roguelite card battle adventure. Take on the Bower King's sinister henchmen as you collect tricks, deliver damage and defeat foes to restore peace in the lands.

4819650.title: 丢丢
4819650.short_description: 《丢丢》是一款可爱风格的自走棋，所有攻击方式均为把手里的物品丢出去，难度很轻松，失败了没惩罚还有奖励？

4819680.title: All Fours in Ashes
4819680.short_description: A folk-horror card roguelike. Play the colonial dead at All Fours, a real nineteenth-century trick-taking game. Win the hand to put a restless soul to rest. Your candle is your life: bid bold to keep it lit, draft ghostly charms, and descend through the deepening cold.

4819780.title: Robo Friends
4819780.short_description: A chaotic co-op party game for up to 8 players. Battle your friends and prove who's the best beta robot!

4819800.title: Night Frontier
4819800.short_description: Night Frontier is a grim survival-management game where you build a camp, recruit survivors, craft gear, and send expeditions into a cursed frontier crawling with raiders, monsters, and other dangerous threats.

4819820.title: Solipsistic
4819820.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4819820.short_description: Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

4819870.title: Cruise Maid: Ship's Company
4819870.short_description: You're a cabin maid on a luxury cruise ship. Clean rooms. Earn tips. Have dinner with the crew every night. Find your people. A life/management sim and visual novel about starting over somewhere new - and building family from strangers.

4819940.title: Blackfall: Cyborgs Down
4819940.short_description: Deploy to a war-torn sci-fi island in Blackfall: Cyborgs Down, a high-intensity third-person looter shooter. Customize 18 Valor Cyborgs across 4 classes, master 60+ weapon models, and a 67-node skill tree. Then, trigger the turn-based 6v6 Prime Battle mode to collect and upgrade heavy mechs.

4819960.title: Sweet Forest 2
4819960.short_description: Sweet Forest 2 - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around a forest. Spend pleasant time in the forest with five pretty and adorable elf girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4820080.title: Overball
4820080.short_description: Inspired by Pong, Overball reinvents the classic formula with explosive power-ups, destructible defenses, and a ball that grows more dangerous with every hit. Battle with up to 6 local players in fast-paced, frantic, and utterly chaotic matches.

4820220.title: Worm Life
4820220.short_description: Play as a worm and live your Worm Life while sharing resources with other worms. Grow and evolve to make sure you are the dominate worm of the area.

4820270.title: Prince of Vibe Code
4820270.short_description: Create 43 playable games with a few clicks. Watch your AI tool bring each one to life. Follow the conversation, enjoy the story, then jump in and play your creations. Build your fanbase and sell your games as your audience grows.

4820420.title: Econosquare
4820420.genre: Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4820420.short_description: Econosquare is a persistent financial MMOE where players trade global assets, read macro signals, complete client contracts, found companies, manage banks and compete for influence inside a living economy shaped by markets, credit, crises and player decisions.

4820520.title: Paranormal Meatball Simulator
4820520.short_description: An unhinged paranormal simulation of a spicy Turkish meatball stuck on a ceiling! Survive a 16-day cryptic loop filled with ghosts, reality-bending physics, and a cosmic UFO escape plan. After this, you will never throw food at your ceiling again!

4820610.title: Project Threshold
4820610.short_description: You are a participant in Project Threshold, an experiment designed to force people to confront their deepest fears. Pass through sets of blue and red doors, survive what waits beyond them, and reach the end, if escape is even possible.

4820680.title: Witch Hunt 0
4820680.short_description: "Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game. Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

4820800.title: Black Market Dealer
4820800.short_description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

4820860.title: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim
4820860.short_description: It started as a simple tease. Yet, your devoted AI companion has crossed the line and pried into your secret diary. Your choices will dictate the final outcome of your relationship in this AI yandere romance.

4820940.title: Natura: Reborn
4820940.short_description: Natura: Reborn is a top-down sandbox adventure where nature and creatures have fused. Explore, survive, and fight through an overgrown fantasy world.

4820980.title: Greed and Greed
4820980.short_description: Greed and Greed is the sequel for Greed and Grind. It's a game where your main goal is to become strongeeeer!! You can grind as much as you want!

4820990.title: Hangin' Off!
4820990.short_description: Lean deep into corners, race against the clock, and battle rival riders in a retro-inspired arcade motorcycle racing experience where every corner asks you the same question: do you brake, or do you believe?

4821000.title: Sepulchre Machine
4821000.short_description: Pilot a mech through the dark unknown, upgrade it in-between expeditions, and ensure the mech's safety until it reaches extraction. Your own safety is optional.

4821350.title: Secret Cats - Independence Day
4821350.short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Independence Day" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

4821440.title: Spin Me
4821440.short_description: Stylish slot machine clicker with flashy rewards and unlockable casino girls. Spin to win, upgrade your bets, boost your income, and reveal new characters as your fortune grows!

4821500.title: Null and Void
4821500.short_description: Null and Void is a darkly satirical deckbuilding tower defence where even death doesn't free you from debt - your clone just inherits the bill. Only mining pays enough to survive and that means destroying entire worlds, but hey, there are always more planets.

4821520.title: Diamond-Die
4821520.short_description: Diamond-Die is a baseball dice game where every at bat can turn into glory, disaster, or something pretty goofy.

4821530.title: Bjois
4821530.short_description: 'Premium' Virtual Pets. A top-down simulation game inspired by the likes of Dwarf Fortress & Rimworld, with a twist: the game plays itself. Watch and catalogue over 200 Bjois as they thrive in an ecosystem of your own choosing.

4821630.title: MarsCity3026
4821630.short_description: 1000 years in the future, Mars colonies are now full cities. Play as a robot that solves grappling hook puzzles and flying car puzzles. Humans went into cryo-sleep to escape disaster. Each puzzle gradually brings the terra-forming machines back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

4821670.title: Her Remember You
4821670.short_description: An AI desktop Live-Action companion who truly remembers you. Featuring real conversation memory, smart memo system, emotional, and support for both local offline models and cloud APIs. she learns you grows with you. Choose from multiple beautifully animated characters,each with a unique personality.

4821680.title: 出马Spirit Rider
4821680.short_description: A fast-paced first-person shooter where you blast through monsters with zero fuss. No deep strategy, just pure pick-up-and-play action.

4821700.title: Ritual Break
4821700.short_description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes synchronize their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and challenge colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

4821770.title: Cold Nights
4821770.short_description: A quiet house. A long night. Keep the lights on - or find out what happens when they fade. Cold Nights is a grounded psychological horror about staying calm when your home turns against you. The lights flicker, the power drops, and the silence grows heavier with every minute.

4821910.title: Not Only One Brain
4821910.short_description: A sci-fi survival horror game with the core mechanic Haunting Ground-like. You evade the chasers, solve puzzles, and explore forward. Besides hiding, you can use your weapons to stall the chasers. You can hack into the neuron systems of other creatures as a 'Witch', and control them to help.

4821930.title: Toxic Dating Simulator
4821930.short_description: Survive first dates with 6 different women from Binder. Shape Ata's personality with your choices. Be a simp, an alpha, or a professional liar. In this toxic game of love, you will either stay true to yourself, or become the lie you choose to tell!

4822040.title: PAGANS
4822040.short_description: PAGANS is a dark-fantasy strategy card game inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses, and warriors, then fight short tactical PvE battles by controlling mystical locations and chaining powerful card synergies.

4822090.title: 404: The Absent God
4822090.short_description: Explore planet 404, battle the Zorgs and local tribes, and hunt for the Eye of Vyr’Nox, the legendary Relic of the Absent God.

4822140.title: Arcade Manager Simulator
4822140.short_description: Own it. Run it. Rule it. Build one quiet café into the biggest, brightest, loudest retro arcade empire in the city. Stock the cabinets, hire your crew, work the floor — and watch the cash roll in. Insert coin. Press Start. Be the legend!

4822210.title: Beats of Lust
4822210.short_description: 🔥❤️🔥 A combo of a rhythm game and an erotic visual novel. Seduce women with your music!

4822290.title: Gyro
4822290.short_description: Abandoned deep in space, Gyro is a small utility bot tasked to clean up what once was. Along your journey, discover an arsenal of increasing tools and challenges. Featuring the music of A Life Elided, Gyro offers up whimsical, mysterious, sci-fi-based puzzles that will keep you wanting more.

4822330.title: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
4822330.short_description: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

4822430.title: Last Guest at Sunset
4822430.short_description: Investigate a replayable Hollywood murder mystery where everyone has something to hide. Question guests, uncover contradictions, and identify the killer before they escape justice.

4822480.title: Strip Memory: Play hard, Undress harder!
4822480.short_description: Challenge four elite athletes to an intense game of memory matching on the court, field, and green. Keep your focus under pressure to unlock explicit animated rewards and choose your ultimate private victory!

4822500.title: BOTMARE
4822500.short_description: BOTMARE is a hardcore Lovecraftian FPS. Survive timed challenges alone or with friends via split-screen & Steam Remote Play. Collect tokens, activate relics, escort allies and battle vicious monsters and bosses. Master diverse weapons and realistic ballistics in this ever-dangerous nightmare realm.

4822630.title: Rusty Giants: Low Gear
4822630.short_description: Haul massive hay bales through an unforgiving winter landscape in this hardcore physics-based tractor simulator. Battle deep snow, deformable mud, and stalling engines. Deploy ground anchors and use manual winches to survive the whiteout, either solo or with friends in co-op.

4822650.title: Armored Train Warfare
4822650.short_description: Operate a heavily armed armored train in a brutal warzone. Man turrets, manage ammunition, repair damage, upgrade your locomotive, and repel relentless enemy attacks while keeping your train moving through hostile territory.

4822660.title: Rocoumie and Bouquet
4822660.short_description: Control Rocoumie, a tiny mischievous red fairy, and use the power of flowers to find your way home. A casual co-op action puzzle game for 1–4 players, with simple, easy controls. Find the key, reach the exit together, and enjoy it with family, friends, or players of any skill level.

4822670.title: Call the Cat: Come here, Master.
4822670.short_description: Play with adorable cats through a variety of mini-games, build your bond over time, and earn points to unlock new outfits.

4822760.title: WinWinWin
4822760.short_description: WINWINWIN​ is a chaotic real-time voice battler! Two players scream into their mics. First to max out their bar in 30 seconds wins! Command quirky animal avatars in this button-free brawl. it's pure vocal mayhem for streamers and friends. No skills needed—just lungs of steel! How loud can you roar?

4822800.title: The Living Graveyard
4822800.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of "The Living Graveyard" - a unique game in the style of Whac-A-Mole, where instead of moles you have to fight zombies rising from their graves!

4822830.title: Dance Floor VR
4822830.short_description: Dance Floor VR is an immersive, active VR rhythm game where you step onto glowing tiles, follow the beat, build combos, and dance through genre-themed arenas packed with music, lights, badges, and score-chasing challenges.

4822880.title: The Doorkeeper
4822880.short_description: Control the gates of a medieval castle, question visitors, spot lies and make moral choices that will shape the resources, inhabitants and survival of the entire community.

4822980.title: Oshi Trade Simulator
4822980.short_description: A simulation game about oshi merch collecting and trading culture. Pull from the gacha, trade on the board, and build your dream collection. Unlock skills for an addictive collecting rush that keeps your favs piling up!

4823000.title: Zyrcon
4823000.short_description: A mouse-only, endless sci-fi arcade shooter with dead-simple controls — just aim and auto-fire kicks in. Shatter asteroids into plasma cores, wield three upgradeable weapons, freeze time, and survive endless difficulty scaling.

4823020.title: Touhou a Mermaid's Reverie
4823020.short_description: A cute 2D underwater puzzle adventure based on Touhou Project.

4823070.title: ST UNLIMITED
4823070.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4823070.short_description: 《ST UNLIMITED》 A hilarious 2D pixel exploration RPG. You are the Dream Voyager. Worlds await.

4823100.title: Paper Paws
4823100.short_description: Paper Paws — a cozy card collecting game about kittens! Scratch, clean, laminate and collect all the cats in your album. Can you collect them all?

4823120.title: How to #### a Man
4823120.short_description: Axelle spends most of her life inside her room : watching anime, scrolling on forums online and playing video games. She desperately wants a boyfriend. You are her conscience, help her attain that goal.

4823250.title: Incremental Pain Profit
4823250.short_description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

4823290.title: Giant Horse Feeding
4823290.short_description: Feed a horse. Collect its droppings to build an alien empire. Automate production, unlock bizarre technologies, and create an endless recycling loop where horse droppings become the foundation of your civilization.

4823300.title: The Crayon Is Mightier
4823300.short_description: When a magical crayon falls into the hands of a young dreamer, imagination becomes reality. Use creativity, clever problem-solving, and precise platforming skills to explore six vibrant worlds, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the true power of the magical crayon.

4823350.title: Tridan
4823350.short_description: Push your luck in a fast-paced 3-card poker roguelite. Spin the wheel of fortune for powerful bonuses, risky drawbacks, and endless combinations as you chase your highest round.

4823370.title: Good Person
4823370.short_description: Take on the role of the Good Person in this traditional rogue type game in the form of a 1980s aesthetic platformer.  Shutdown and avoid a variety of threats to your well being and look to seek validation from various sycophants spread throughout the accursed world.

4823380.title: Eyes Of The Factory
4823380.short_description: Explore the abandoned Blackforge Industries factory and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and discover why the factory never forgot you in this atmospheric first-person horror experience. Now are you ready for join Black Forge Industries?

4823390.title: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co.
4823390.short_description: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co. is a fun 2D art & management sim. Paint what’s in the minds of quirky customers with top accuracy, showcase your art in the gallery, sell it at auctions, and compete online with friends!

4823420.title: Leon&Suharto
4823420.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4823420.short_description: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Capella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

4823460.title: Mage of Corruption
4823460.short_description: Fight. Upgrade. Corrupt. Become overwhelmingly powerful. Will you survive the assault... or become the ultimate force of evil?

4823480.title: Chicken Blaster
4823480.short_description: Chicken Blaster is a casual arcade shooter where quick reflexes are the key to victory. Shoot coins, avoid hazards, and see how long you can survive as the chaos ramps up.

4823560.title: Flipping Football Clubs
4823560.short_description: Buy, build, and flip football clubs in a fast-paced roguelite management sim. Sign players, hire staff, survive FFP, unlock Club DNA modifiers, and grow club value across 1-2 hour seasonal runs.

4823600.title: 创世遗志
4823600.short_description: Genesis Legacy is an HD-2D fantasy adventure game blending classic pixel art with immersive 3D environments. Powered by modern lighting technology, it creates a breathtaking yet perilous Sky Continent filled with unknown dangers, offering players a deeply immersive retro-new-age adventure experience

4823640.title: Sudoku Bigger Picture
4823640.short_description: Solve 81 Sudoku puzzles, from beginner friendly grids to difficult challenges. Progress through an interconnected world where every solution matters. Look beyond individual puzzles... There's something much bigger waiting to be discovered!

4823680.title: Isiah Star
4823680.short_description: The brave Captain Isiah Star awakens from cryo-sleep and finds himself alone...marooned millions of years in the future, and the last human alive! Embark on a galaxy-wide adventure to escape the clutches of the Carcinoid Confederacy in this 3D shoot'em'up deck-building pulp fiction extravaganza!

4823870.title: TetraPlinko
4823870.short_description: Tetra-Plinko is a high-energy physics puzzler that collides two classic arcade games! Drop blocks strategically to navigate a peg-filled board, unleash massive multiplier combos, and watch the chaos unfold. Rack up points in this addictive, fast-paced mashup of strategy and gravity!

4824030.title: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
4824030.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

4824150.title: Yield to the Abyss
4824150.short_description: Fifteen hundred miles from land, aboard a deep-sea mining ship haunted by a fatal accident, choose one of three women to walk toward: your estranged engineer wife, the observer who can halt the harvest, or the collector pilot you trained. An adult romance VN of grief, power, and the abyss.

4824220.title: Meltdown Crew
4824220.short_description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

4824250.title: Merc Commander
4824250.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical game where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

4824290.title: Star Sine Signal
4824290.short_description: An otherworldly being has trapped you in their mysterious extradimensional prison. Explore a home ripped from time, activate the signals, and follow them to free that which binds you in this surreal first-person non-linear puzzle game.

4824310.title: Vermin Protocol
4824310.short_description: Take on pest control contracts and hunt infestations across farms. Track, eliminate, and contain the vermin before they spread.

4824430.title: The Imprint
4824430.short_description: Literary publishing management sim. Discover hidden authors and navigate the literary culture of an era — scout talent, balance art vs commerce, watch your books reshape what people read.

4824560.title: Log of Adventurers
4824560.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4824560.short_description: A free-to-play text-driven online RPG set on the continent of Alvasa. Learn skills, gather resources, craft equipment, fight enemies, tame creatures, study magic, and record your journey after a great flood.

4824610.title: Resident Evil Veronica
4824610.short_description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

4824640.title: FIVILYN
4824640.short_description: A psychological RPG where you switch between two perceptions of reality and discover that not everything sweet is innocent.

4824880.title: Design Studio Simulator: Print Your Empire
4824880.short_description: You started with an iron, a spare room, and one friend's order. Now build the print empire you always imagined — design every product yourself, earn every client, grow every era.

4824940.title: XINGTU
4824940.short_description: ​XINGTU is a narrative-driven visual novel. As the "Guardian," you will meet unique companions in a crisis-ridden world. Through classic text-click gameplay, help them overcome struggles and unite to face the ultimate challenge. Features a fully original soundtrack to immerse you in the story.

4825080.title: Night of Seven Dreams
4825080.short_description: Driven by the anxieties and pressures of reality, I wander and reflect within my dreams. Relax, walk freely, feel the surroundings, and embark on a journey to gradually restore your inner peace.

4825110.title: Islands: Princess Reincarnation
4825110.short_description: Betrayed and killed, a princess returns from death for a new adventure in a fantasy realm. A top-down 2D action game featuring dungeon looting, AFK gathering, base building and multiple endings. Seek revenge for the throne, or relax with farming and land management.

4825140.title: Forteria
4825140.short_description: Gather resources, upgrade your equipment, and strengthen your base with up to 4 players. When night falls, fend off waves of monsters and protect the precious Mana Stone from destruction.

4825210.title: Pop Star Life
4825210.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4825210.short_description: Write songs, release music, perform live shows, and grow your fanbase. Manage your money, fame, stress, and relationships as you build a music career from nothing and rise to pop stardom.

4825220.title: Theseus' Cycle
4825220.short_description: A dark sci-fi 2D action and factory automation game. Defeat alien monstrosities with high-speed parries to harvest their mechanical flesh. Use these spoils to build and upgrade an automated bio-energy factory. Generate power to unlock new territories and fuel your progression.

4825270.title: Crane Game Master
4825270.short_description: Can you become the true "Claw Machine Master"? Conquer various machines and grab those prizes! ...Short on cash to play? Time to work and earn it! Dump every single penny you make right back into the machines! Aim for the top, Claw Machine Master!

4825280.title: Mage X Monster: The Archmage Who Wants to Lose to Mobs
4825280.short_description: A turn-based tactical puzzle RPG. Wield three elemental spells to reshape tiles and manipulate monster pathing. You don't kill them — you enrage them until they charge at you. 11 unique monsters, 13 hand-crafted stages, and a curated collection of illustrated scenes.

4825290.title: For The Fame
4825290.short_description: The King promises eternal fame to anyone surviving his dungeon. Carefully place items on your grid and watch them fight. Explore an ever-changing dungeon, trade gold for new items and improve your build in this roguelite autobattler.

4825460.title: WANTED: Fruits
4825460.short_description: Prepare for a hilarious third-person shooter inspired by classic cartoon slapstick. Squash enemies with absurd weapons, battle quirky bosses, and hunt down the most wanted fruits.

4825520.title: OnGrid()
4825520.short_description: Build, expand, and defend a finite grid while dynamically reshaping enemy paths. Every decision matters as escalating Colossus waves push your defenses to the limit. How long can you remain OnGrid()?

4825540.title: Lost in the Fest
4825540.short_description: LOST in the FEST is a musical RPG where swords are guitars and potions are beers.

4825610.title: Random Fantasy Defense
4825610.short_description: A Tower Defense with Roguelike factor where divine blessings are unpredictable. Build your army, adapt to random fortunes, and defend Mystologia from an encroaching darkness.

4825620.title: Sushi Delivery Co.
4825620.short_description: A cozy delivery micro‑game where you navigate a tiny Japanese neighborhood in your Kei‑car, bringing sushi to customers while soaking in soft lights, calm music, and rainy city ambience.

4825770.title: The Button Maze
4825770.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4825770.short_description: Collect all the Sewing Buttons in each Level before time runs out and the "Entity" gets you!

4825780.title: Lightspire: Cards
4825780.short_description: Lightspire Cards is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets board control. Summon units, fuse cards, exploit terrain, complete quests, and battle through Luna’s story-driven campaign of saints, schemers, monsters, exiles, and broken vows.

4825870.title: 《失格》the lost
4825870.short_description: 《失格-thelost》是一款融合互动影像叙事与第三人称动作格斗的创意作品。游戏以影视化剧情片段串联全程，玩家将跟随主角展开冒险，在沉浸式剧情节点中做出不同选择，走向差异化故事分支。 进入战斗环节后，游戏切换为第三人称视角格斗玩法。你可通过键鼠或手柄操控角色，使用普通攻击、重击、跳跃、组合连招，应对各式敌人与BOSS。战斗讲究走位把控与节奏博弈，灵活搭配招式可以打出流畅连击，击败对手推进剧情。 剧情选择与格斗战斗紧密结合，你的每一次抉择不仅会改变故事走向，还可能影响后续战斗场景、对手配置与可解锁技能。全程影视过场衔接实战对战，兼顾剧情沉浸感与硬核格斗乐趣。

4825980.title: 爪爪改造家2 PawRebuild 2
4825980.short_description: Five animal friends turn messy ruins into a cozy haven by matching identical items. It features 10 scenes with 5 renovation stages for each, adopts a distinctive cardboard art style, has no time limits or penalty mechanics, and allows you to unlock all achievements effortlessly.

4826170.title: Toy's Dream
4826170.short_description: Toy’s Dream is a cute and wholesome puzzle-platformer. You are a Hero, who sets out on a journey to save the town that has been attacked by the Demon Lord. He must overcome many obstacles along the way, using glue and thread...

4826190.title: The Death... And After?
4826190.short_description: You are in a coma. Reality is shattered, and the laws of logic no longer apply. "The Death... And After?" is a psychological horror game where you must navigate eerie hospital labyrinths and dark caverns of a fading mind. Is it a dream, or is it death? And what awaits us after?

4826200.title: Nicotine Merchant Simulator
4826200.short_description: You're a Nicotine Merchant. Start your production using improvised materials and grow it into a large enterprise. But be careful, just a few wrong moves and everything could fall apart!

4826250.title: Ashen Crown
4826250.short_description: A single-player roguelite autobattler built almost entirely with AI. Pick a fighter, climb 20 battles to a final boss, and win in the build you assemble: 12 weapons, 24 classes, 53 subspecs, 247 skills. Go deep on one path or sprawl across many and break the game open.

4826270.title: I'd Like to Know More About You
4826270.short_description: You make every interaction with her feel like coincidence. You know her far more than she could ever imagine. But you don't seem to realize, a butterfliy don't usually fly into the net on their own.

4826320.title: DOMIIINO
4826320.short_description: Set up the dominoes. Just to the goal.

4826370.title: BLORBIT
4826370.short_description: Flip gravity to climb. BLORBIT is a cute-creature vertical platformer climbing 6 biomes from meadow to deep space. Flip platforms only hold when gravity matches. Go Endless, chase Dailies, relax in Zen, or race 10 players online. How high can you climb?

4826380.title: ULTIDARK
4826380.short_description: a game about a hopeful stickman without fighting, but rather... solving puzzles and running. explore the dimension that is holding ancient demonic powers, and you might be the only hope of the entire population surviving

4826490.title: REELS of the DAMNED
4826490.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

4826510.title: Forge Clicker 2
4826510.short_description: Forge Clicker 2 is a pixel art idle clicker game where you manage your own forge. Tap to gather materials, craft weapons through a forging minigame, sell your creations, and unlock stronger materials, upgrades, and new blades.

4826530.title: 漢字でGOGO!
4826530.short_description: A kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand. Test your kanji skills across multiple modes, from the accessible Entertainment Mode, to the challenging Serious Mode, the same-level Rush Mode, and the bonus score attack mode KAKITORI ISSEN.

4826620.title: My Useless Hot MILF in the Party
4826620.short_description: Forced into a dangerous expedition before the dungeon opens to the world, explore its depths in a classic first-person dungeon crawler. Train your MILF companion, solve puzzles, battle monsters, uncover secrets, and discover the truth hidden on the final floor.

4826740.title: Pedals in Panic
4826740.short_description: Pedals in Panic is a small physics-based bike game where you control each pedal separately, steer with the mouse, jump over obstacles, and survive chaotic procedurally generated platforms.

4826750.title: Siegelock
4826750.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about laying siege to a trespassing kingdom.

4826850.title: SlimeRunner Reborn
4826850.short_description: A high-speed auto-runner reimagined from the 2020 game jam original. Built entirely around momentum and quick reflexes, it’s designed to be the perfect pick-up-and-play game for fast 20 to 30-minute sessions.

4826880.title: Plunderfall
4826880.short_description: Start betrayed on a raft in this open-seas pirate twin-stick roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock new vessels and weapons, rescue your crew to grow your fleet, defeat traitor captains, loot their relics to unlock new waters, and rebuild your legacy.

4826890.title: Hentai Tile Swap
4826890.short_description: Solve up to 120 tile-swap puzzles and reconstruct beautiful images. Progress through increasingly challenging grids, unlock completed pictures in the gallery, earn achievements, and discover additional puzzle packs through optional DLC.

4826900.title: Basement3
4826900.short_description: Your task is to escape from the basement in which the maniac locked you.

4826960.title: Honey, I'm an Agent
4826960.short_description: 2D action, stealth, and noir comedy. A harmless man accidentally becomes a secret agent. Hide his double life by escaping his wife at night: complete missions, swing with your grappling hook, and use your super weapon: an umbrella that works as a parachute and for combat!

4827190.title: US Open Wheel 85-95 Manager
4827190.short_description: Manage a racing team through the golden era of US-based open-wheel racing. Handle finances, drivers, chassis and strategy - all leading to one goal: conquering the 500.

4827230.title: Click and Cast
4827230.short_description: Click and Cast is a short, relaxing incremental spellcasting game. Cast spells to reveal hidden floors, defeat monsters with magic, collect elixir, and upgrade your spells and economy as you progress through deeper dungeon floors

4827240.title: Monster Breeder
4827240.genre: Casual, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4827240.short_description: Breed unique monsters where every baby inherits its looks AND stats from both parents. Hatch eggs, grow your collection, and send your creatures on turn-based adventures for gold and glory. With endless procedural designs, no two monsters are ever the same. How powerful can your bloodline become

4827410.title: Safe Place
4827410.short_description: A 100% voice-based party game. Step into a circle of strangers, fully anonymous, and answer prompts that start silly and get deeper every round — then vote someone out. Outlast everyone… or make real friends along the way.

4827450.title: Hire
4827450.short_description: Run a medieval fantasy mercenary guild. Take dangerous contracts, haggle the price in your own words, hire fighters with real personalities, and send them into danger. You prepare the job, then you live with the result. Every new campaign builds a whole new world and a new story.

4827520.title: DEAD INTERNET THEORY: SUPERSTARS
