4827520.short_description: Dead Internet Theory is an interactive visual novel with social media elements. Join the Celebration of Humanity, the ultimate legally sanctioned killing game. Eighteen digital superstars. One Holy Grail. One unlimited wish. Survive the murder mystery court drama of the century!

4827590.title: K-Duel: The Anti-Cheater
4827590.short_description: A tactical anime card battler where you expose and defeat literal rule-breakers. Assemble a powerful deck, utilize instant battlefield unit fusions to evolve boss monsters down strategic combat rows, and turn the illegal manipulation mechanics of cheating grandmasters completely against them.

4827670.title: Text Factory: Automation
4827670.short_description: Text Factory: Automation is an offline, text-based factory simulation game. Build production lines, set up transportation between maps, upgrade technologies, craft weapons and armor, and defeat enemies to gather more resources and expand your factory.

4827680.title: Paper Baseball
4827680.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4827680.short_description: Guess the secret number. Beat the AI. A classic Bulls & Cows deduction game with 3 or 4-digit modes, three difficulty levels, and a sharp AI opponent. Simple rules, deep strategy

4827830.title: B.E.C.C.: Dead District
4827830.short_description: Defend against dynamic and intelligent monsters in the heart of the Dead District while unravelling the plot of a mysterious organization.

4827850.title: CAUTION WET PAINT
4827850.short_description: A game about watching paint dry. Don't touch the paint while it's wet, or you lose!

4827880.title: Business Rivals
4827880.short_description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

4828030.title: Astrelght
4828030.short_description: Explore the mysterious ruins of Astrelght and uncover the truth behind the Cube. Complete strange tasks, meet unusual characters, investigate anomalies, and survive multiplayer challenges in a surreal world between reality and simulation.

4828200.title: Vaporware EX
4828200.short_description: Vaporware EX is a comfy 16-bit game dev simulator full of neon-infused nostalgia, set in the games industry of 199X. Lose the suit, put on a hoodie, and discover what it really takes to ship a game in this love letter to a bygone time where you still had to fit everything into a cartridge.

4828230.title: Marshmallow Story: in Marshmallow Village
4828230.short_description: This story follows Marshmallow, the protagonist, as he sets off on his adventure to become a beautiful and wonderful marshmallow, but first to search for the missing shopkeeper of Marshmallow Village. Progress through the story with an engaging plot and science puzzles to find the shopkeeper!

4828340.title: Snake: Gridbreaker
4828340.short_description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

4828540.title: The Blackwood
4828540.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4828540.short_description: After a devastating accident, you are stranded in a breathtaking wilderness. Survive by gathering resources, crafting tools, building bases, and looting. Explore a dangerous open world, face threats, and uncover the mysteries of The Blackwood.

4828640.title: Stopping Move
4828640.short_description: Stopping Move is an exciting 2D game with pixel graphics that takes you to a unique world where time and space are subject to your decisions.

4828740.title: Cover Story
4828740.short_description: In a 150-year-old newsroom captured overnight by its billionaire new owner, executive editor Everett Locke must steer an explosive investigation that could ruin the boss. Choose one of three intimate routes—reporter, editor-in-chief, or heir—as desire collides with the truth.

4828760.title: Soma Cube
4828760.short_description: Soma Cube is a focused 3D puzzle game with seven pieces and 12 shapes to solve. Rotate, move, and combine the pieces to build each model. Test your spatial reasoning, and solve every shape at your own pace.

4828770.title: Sprout
4828770.short_description: Awaken as a broken bot in a broken world. Rebuild yourself, explore the past and present, and find the world's last living plant, as you journey to restore life to the world.

4828780.title: Ningming County In Chongzuo
4828780.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

4828890.title: Scarlet's Last Call
4828890.short_description: Scarlet's Last Call is a stylish 2.5D cyberpunk beat 'em up. By night she runs a neon bar; by dawn she hunts bounties. Play as Scarlet, a deadly femme fatale, chaining brutal combos and cinematic finishers against cyber-gangs and towering bosses. Every contract could be her last call.

4828940.title: Abyss Forge
4828940.short_description: Abyss Forge is a sci-fi match-and-merge roguelike set in deep space. Move tiles, create matches, merge modules, gather fuel, efficiency, research, and other resources, then shape your build through random upgrades as you push your ship deeper into unknown sectors.

4829070.title: Twelve Boxes
4829070.short_description: You're just a mover doing a simple job: pick up boxes and carry them to the truck. Easy, right? Not quite. Strange anomalies hide inside the house, and spotting them is the only way to avoid an endless shift of hauling boxes forever.

4829110.title: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die
4829110.short_description: Create thousands of night creatures and ensure the Hero does not survive until dawn. Play as death in a reverse survivor-like where both sides level up as you raise armies of monsters, unlock dark powers and stop a lone Hero from becoming a legend.

4829160.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Vienna
4829160.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Vienna 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4829180.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
4829180.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New York 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4829230.title: Nin Ninja RESCUE MISSION
4829230.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Racing, RPG
4829230.short_description: Nin Ninja Rescue Mission is an action, adventure, platform, and endless runner game. Run, face dangerous enemies, dodge traps, defeat enemies, and use your skills to complete a rescue mission.

4829310.title: Chop Loop
4829310.short_description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

4829340.title: Nights at the Convenience Store
4829340.short_description: Nights at the Convenience Store is a first-person horror simulation game where you work the night shift at a 24/7 store. Scan groceries, restock shelves, take out the trash — and try not to think too hard about what's lurking in the back.

4829360.title: Kinghold
4829360.short_description: Tower defence and survivors-style chaos collide in this frantic fantasy strategy roguelite. Lead your king, rally your troops, and fortify your defences in real time as you fight, gather, and build to survive waves of enemy hordes.

4829380.title: Dorm 17
4829380.short_description: Dorm 17 is a PSX-style first-person psychological horror game about your first night as a dormitory receptionist, where routine tasks slowly turn into disturbing late-night events.

4829390.title: Kick The Wallet
4829390.short_description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

4829520.title: VLCNP Story
4829520.short_description: Beneath their goofy long-faced looks lies a surprisingly serious action-adventure. Awaken as Akim and Very Long Leelee after 10,000 years of slumber, recover your lost memories, rouse your fallen comrades, and rise to defeat a great evil!

4829760.title: SkullWar:ProvingGrounds
4829760.short_description: SkullWar: Proving Grounds is a tactical combat simulator from the 31st century (the 3000s). It requires two operators to each control four humanoid war machines called "Skulls" to conduct combat tests.

4829810.title: The Circus That Never Left
4829810.short_description: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

4830170.title: Dawar: Ashes of the Snow
4830170.short_description: Dawar is a third-person action-adventure game. Carve your path in a punishing, UI-less world. Master the combat mechanics. Dismember your enemies. Reach your goal.

4830280.title: Piast
4830280.short_description: An economic Real Time Strategy where you guide Piast, a settler leasing land from the greedy Prince Popiel. Build a settlement, gather resources, and trade on a dynamic marketplace. Search for gold, build a thriving city, and secure enough wealth to buy your permanent independence. Will you succeed?

4830480.title: All But Weak
4830480.short_description: All But Weak is a Couch Coop Roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Mix elements, stack crazy weapon modifiers, and try to survive the madness with your friends.

4830530.title: Kairos: Until the Dawn Breaks
4830530.short_description: A melancholic fantasy visual novel. Kairos, the last twilight hunter of a clan abandoned by its god, walks to the Temple of Dawn chasing the truth of a silent goddess — and what he lost along the way. They were taught to fear the night. It was the light that burned them.

4830580.title: Papa
4830580.short_description: Years after escaping your childhood home, you return to visit your dying father one last time. As strange events unfold, memories of the past begin to blur with reality.

4830920.title: Eightfold Blocks
4830920.short_description: Rotate, place, and rethink every block in a focused 8x8 puzzle game. Solve 1,000 spatial boards, keep finished solutions visible, reset freely, and use optional hints when one stubborn piece refuses to fit.

4830940.title: Chronime Puzzle: Girls
4830940.short_description: Chronime Puzzle: Girls is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

4830970.title: Escape from Umbra
4830970.short_description: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

4830980.title: BAFF B
4830980.short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

4831070.title: Proper Puzzles
4831070.short_description: A relaxing jigsaw puzzle game with 250 included images and support for custom uploads. Build at your own pace with 20 to 500 pieces, multi-select and lasso tools, and puzzle trays to keep your workspace organised.

4831140.title: 王国棋境
4831140.short_description: 《王国棋境》是一款奇幻背景的异步 PVP 自走棋游戏。你将从一片小小领地开始，购买地块、规划布局、扩张版图、处理事件，并在世界地图上征服其他王国。战斗中，事先布置好的阵容会自动生产、招募、强化军队。用你的构筑策略打造独一无二的战争王国，征服这片大陆！

4831170.title: Jammed
4831170.short_description: You are a traffic engineer. Draw roads and bridges, connect growing districts, and watch your city come alive. Design efficient interchanges and avoid traffic jams.

4831190.title: 染上你的颜色
4831190.short_description: 《染上你的颜色》是由屿临个人制作发行的一部百合向视觉小说。游戏通过沈眠眠的视角展开，与另一位少女林舒桐因画画而相遇。这是一个关于模仿、嫉妒与错位之爱的故事。当仰慕变成执念，当爱意沦为占有，两个少女在互相吞噬中渐渐染上了彼此的颜色。

4831210.title: Lost Below
4831210.short_description: Descend into an abandoned mine in search of your missing brother. Explore dark tunnels, uncover disturbing secrets, solve puzzles, and evade a terrifying creature lurking in the depths in this first-person psychological horror game.

4831240.title: Gods' Gate
4831240.short_description: Gods' Gate is a relentless isometric shooter where elite operatives plunge through ancient portals into procedurally generated mythological hellscapes. Survive escalating hordes, and extract before the Gate seals—leaving you trapped with the gods who want you dead. Solo or 4-player co-op.

4831290.title: Crown&Sword
4831290.short_description: Crown & Sword is an epic 2D tactical Action RPG that combines base management, army building, and wave survival elements. You must manage your time in a dynamic day/night cycle, fortify your kingdom, and fight shoulder to shoulder against the relentless swarms that awaken when the sun sets.

4831370.title: Dark Petition
4831370.short_description: Explore a vast cursed castle in a dark fantasy Reactive turn-based RPG. Uncover forgotten memories, battle ancient horrors, and descend into a dying kingdom trapped between life and death.

4831500.title: Omnitrend's Universe
4831500.short_description: Re-released after almost 50 years, turn back the clock to 1983 and play the most complex starship simulator of its time.  Featuring intelligent enemy ships and control of on-board facilities: computers, high-resolution scanners, weapons, ore processors, shuttles, rescue pods, and more.

4831590.title: CrueArcade Alive
4831590.short_description: Face the apocalypse in this adrenaline-fueled, retro-inspired arcade brawler! Battle through hordes of the undead across tactical stages, face unique bosses, and scavenge vital supplies. Grab a friend for local co-op, manage your resources, and fight to survive the urban nightmare

4831610.title: Prison Of Sissy
4831610.short_description: A young man enters prison after a desperate mistake — but the real transformation has already begun. An adult visual novel about identity, survival, and unexpected desire.

4831670.title: EvoluCell
4831670.short_description: Play an immune cell that never stops evolving. Shoot foes into weakness, devour them for Gene—and Burden. Fill a four-track gene library, morph your cell and bullets, then ascend into an Ultimate form. Top-down bio-horror roguelike: what is your cell becoming?

4831710.title: Crossed Worlds: The Magic Pen
4831710.short_description: Wake up on Hart Island, dazed and amnesiac, holding a mysterious magic pencil... that you're accused of stealing ? In this hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania, your creativity is your weapon: sketch your tools to survive the dangers and piece together your memories.

4831720.title: City Cardz
4831720.short_description: Collect 1200+ city cards from 600+ different cities, build your deck and compete in strategic card battles inspired by cities from around the world. Discover unique card abilities, different combinations, and interesting city facts as you outsmart the opponents.

4831750.title: Childmare
4831750.short_description: Dive into a secret 1980s laboratory where the "Super Kids" program turned into a nightmare. Hunted by Lou, a blind girl transformed into a terrifying monster after a failed experiment, infiltrate the facility, use the environment to your advantage, and try to survive this first chapter.

4831830.title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
4831830.short_description: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

4831850.title: TOUKAN
4831850.short_description: Explore a mysterious world where every melody can reveal a forgotten passage. Use your beak, your song and your knowledge to progress and uncover the many secrets buried deep within the Metroidvania Puzzle-Platformer that is TOUKAN.

4831920.title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
4831920.short_description: After death, you are chosen by the Underworld Television Network and sent to the Middle Ages as a despised bastard prince. This is not reincarnation, but a livestream watched by hell. See through lies, build alliances, challenge the queen, survive thirty days, and rewrite the fate of a kingdom.

4832030.title: Big Golden Rock
4832030.short_description: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

4832040.title: Skyline Airways
4832040.short_description: Build and manage your own airline. Purchase aircraft, plan routes, set ticket prices, customize onboard services, and navigate an ever-changing aviation market where every decision affects your profits.

4832060.title: The Cathedral
4832060.short_description: Restore a mysterious gothic cathedral in this atmospheric 3D idle incremental game. Welcome faithful visitors, gather Essence and Donations, unlock new wings, discover hidden relics, and choose whether to serve the light… or answer a darker call.

4832080.title: Hentai Clicker: Sigrid is streaming
4832080.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Clicker: Sigrid is streaming Collect ❤️, unlock divine outfits, and upgrade your skills in this addictive anime clicker. Meet Sigrid, a powerful Valkyrie with an irresistible playful side!

4832170.title: Cursor Kingdom
4832170.short_description: Create an army of cursor clones by recording your actions. Automate resource gathering, production, and defense while your kingdom grows on its own.

4832190.title: BBox: Kingpin
4832190.short_description: Run a crime gang on real-world maps. Manage autonomous crew members across multiple territories. Navigate heat, police pressure, and personality-driven betrayals.

4832200.title: SU8WAY
4832200.short_description: You are Henry, a man who only wanted to take Train 8 to work. But you quickly realize that something is wrong. Everything seems to repeat itself  like a loop. Objects and people begin to change, and nothing is quite the way it should be.

4832210.title: Domefender
4832210.short_description: In Domefender you are the commander of a mining outpost on a hostile alien planet - and the pilot of a powerful customizable mech. Expand your base, recruit soldiers, and take control of your mech to defend your dome generator at all costs.

4832290.title: Mado Marks
4832290.short_description: Three students record future-self videos in a classroom room that shouldn’t exist... The next morning, one of them is gone, and only corrupted marks prove she was ever there. A short psychological horror VN about memory, proof, and erasure.

4832310.title: Piano Tiles 2
4832310.short_description: Piano Tiles 2 is a music rhythm game with an easy mechanic: simply tap the black tiles to the melody of the music. But with 700+ songs to master, don't be fooled-- it takes great focus to maintain your score as the music climbs to unmatchable speeds! Play casually or competitively as you'd like!

4832350.title: You Must Die
4832350.short_description: You Must Die is a dice-building roguelike. Defeat enemies, take their faces, and graft them to your dice to shift the odds in your favor. Prepare for your expeditions by visiting the merchant, and unlock new purchase options for every collected bounty.

4832420.title: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
4832420.short_description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

4832500.title: DarkMytholoqy:Lucy
4832500.short_description: In a deserted city from the Middle Ages, many mutated zombies appeared. The army had previously developed poisonous gas here. The higher-ups were worried that the zombies would invade the surrounding cities, so they sent Lucy to investigate the situation.

4832510.title: Trolley Dilemma
4832510.short_description: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

4832520.title: Innacorde: Remember Me
4832520.short_description: Build, refine and mutate your team of horrors to fight your way out of the nightmare you find yourself in. Everything is expendable. Everything is usable. Twist the world to your will and make them remember your name.

4832580.title: Thousand Wheels
4832580.short_description: Investigate murders across parallel universes in a hand-drawn detective puzzle game inspired by Ottoman medieval art. Gather clues, identify suspects, and reconstruct events to uncover a mystery spanning multiple realities.

4832660.title: Welcome to Desal
4832660.short_description: You stop at a quiet roadside café-but when your payment is declined, you’re forced to work it off. Something about this place isn’t right… and leaving won’t be easy.

4832790.title: EVIL Agribusiness Simulator
4832790.short_description: Here at AGRO agribusiness we see the potential in anyone. So we decided to turn what we do into a video game. Teach them young and to believe in our brand and-wait that was the confidential part I wasn’t supposed to type. Oh, here it is- learn how to drive a forest destroying combine in 46 levels.

4832800.title: ECHOLASH
4832800.short_description: Slash through procedurally generated dungeons to the beat of real-time dubstep. Time your attacks with the spatial indicator for devastating combos. Rebirth, grow stronger, prestige — the echo never dies.

4832880.title: Selubra
4832880.short_description: Struggle for survival in the dark caves of Selubra. Shape your own destiny in this richly detailed 2D pixel-art open-world RPG: Descend into mysterious depths, climb the colossal tower to reach the surface, or build a whole new, endless life underground. The choice is yours.

4833000.title: Red Rooms
4833000.short_description: A time-sensitive strategy game where you must defend yourself from ominous entities. Defend yourself by using your camera flash, holding doors shut, and closing curtains. You must act quickly.

4833100.title: Backrooms: Exit 8
4833100.short_description: SCP-6876 has escaped. Your mission: retrieve 10 vials of water for DARPA to synthesize into a poison against it. Carefully observe each stall to escape the Endless Bathrooms, avoid SCP-6876, and reach 'Room 10'

4833220.title: My Own Hero Party
4833220.short_description: A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

4833310.title: BreakEven - Idle
4833310.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4833310.short_description: Idle by default, deep when you lean in. BreakEven is an idle ARPG about the grind that pays off: auto-battle through a dark fantasy world, chase ultimate loot, and build a Knight, Mage, Archer or Necromancer into an unstoppable engine of damage. No seasons. No wipes. Just you and the next upgrade.

4833340.title: UNBIASED
4833340.short_description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

4833480.title: World Master
4833480.short_description: A RPG sandbox with huge procedural fantasy worlds. The World Master will generate unique lands for you to inhabit, explore, save, or destroy. Build your character from nothing, gain skills by using them, and affect the world by acting on dynamic objects in a vast sim.

4833540.title: Juice Stand Tycoon
4833540.short_description: Run your own cozy juice stand. Set prices, manage ingredients, upgrade your stand, handle weather, launch ads, and serve more customers as your little business grows.

4833670.title: Open Interest
4833670.short_description: Open Interest is an adult romance visual novel set inside a prediction-market scandal. As Bellwether's Chief Markets Officer, choose between a brilliant quant, a grieving sister, or a ruthless whale as a subpoenaed mortality contract forces you to settle the unthinkable.

4833770.title: Spirit Route
4833770.short_description: Escort your Spirit Nexus to its destination while building towers and tiles to stop incoming monsters. Combine unique Nexus abilities, random shop choices, and strategic path building in this tower defense adventure.

4833800.title: Roots n Roofs
4833800.short_description: Build whimsical homes within roots and wood, and transform an old stump into a little world. A relaxing sandbox with no pressure — just a quiet, peaceful place and your imagination.

4833810.title: Chromafall
4833810.short_description: Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you drag and drop obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Place your pieces, launch the ball, and watch light cascade across the play field. Endless procedurally generated levels ensure the challenge never stops.

4833850.title: Underegg
4833850.short_description: Underegg is a precision climbing platformer where you help an egg ascend unstable terrain.

4834000.title: Deadlined.
4834000.short_description: a Psychological Horror where you lose yourself while trying to finish your paperwork before the Deadline.

4834010.title: Rooms
4834010.short_description: Choose one of two share houses, shape your own story through meaningful choices, uncover hidden events, and build unique relationships in a branching visual novel where every decision can change your path.

4834070.title: Don't Sleep With The Fishes
4834070.short_description: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

4834080.title: Make it! Shaved Ice
4834080.short_description: Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge! Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!

4834160.title: Find Cats 7 Art & Alchemy
4834160.short_description: 180 colorful cats hide across three medieval scenes: an alchemy room, a painter's attic, and a Gothic garden. Every cat is visible yet cleverly hidden—behind petals, in jar shadows, in painting corners. Each has its own hint. 27 meows, 4 original BGM tracks—soothing yet sharpens the eye.

4834190.title: Humble Abode & Strays
4834190.short_description: A heartwarming idle game. You meet a group of stray cats in a shabby old room.Do nothing — just listen to the rain, rest with their purrs. Or pick up a brush and gently groom them. The fur balls you brush off are their thank-you gift to you.Use them to make this humble room a little warmer.

4834240.title: Sweet Party
4834240.short_description: Sweet Party - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around parties. Spend a fun-filled time with five pretty and cute girls at a party, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4834420.title: TimbaDraft
4834420.short_description: Draft your troupe. Train them. Conquer in PVP. TimbaDraft is a strategic autobattler set in a world of puppet theaters and village tournaments. Every run starts with a choice: which six puppeteers will you field? Build synergies, equip them wisely, and send them into battle.

4834490.title: Pixel Texas Hold'em
4834490.short_description: Online Texas Hold'em with publicly verifiable fair dealing. We never manipulate outcomes to drive spending. Every hand is decided by player judgment, strategy, nerve, and timing. Play with friends, read opponents, manage your chips, and personalize your table with themes and card backs.

4834620.title: Fabricatio
4834620.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4834620.short_description: Build efficient production lines, automate resource transport, and master complex logistics in a 2D factory-building experience focused purely on automation.

4834670.title: Bus Simulator : World Tour
4834670.short_description: Bus Simulator: World Tour lets you drive 30 buses across 14 global locations and 140 routes. Customize your vehicles, explore freely, and enjoy an immersive next-generation bus driving experience.

4834710.title: FootBall Card Battle
4834710.short_description: A real-time strategic football card game where you face your opponent head-on. Build tactics, boost your players with magic cards, and score 5 goals before your rival. Every decision matters—manage fatigue and limited cards to secure victory.

4834920.title: NTR Hotel
4834920.short_description: Inherit your late father's hotel — and his phone. "Manager Mode" reads and rewrites the emotions of anyone you point it at. Four women you were meant to manage — each already taken — start coming undone. What you refuse to do with the power is the only thing that defines you.

4835020.title: 虚日无常
4835020.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4835020.short_description: 少年林洛从昏迷中苏醒，等待着他的是一群对他或友好，或警惕，或反感的陌生人，据他们所言，自己失忆后必须待在这个地方生活？随着对大伙的了解，林洛会逐渐培养出与他人的友情，解决他人的烦恼，自己失忆的真相，以及一切的幕后黑手

4835130.title: FILL IT
4835130.short_description: Fill It is a warm, paper-textured Shikaku-style logic puzzle. Each numbered circle shows how many cells its rectangle must hold — divide the board into rectangles with no overlap and no gaps. Features 100 levels, Endless and Relax modes, a daily challenge, and an editor with share codes.

4835250.title: [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident
4835250.short_description: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...

4835430.title: Twilight Tides : Mirage Journey
4835430.short_description: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey - a fantasy otome game led by 22 tarot cards. Features dual spacetime (Main World+Apocalypse) with paradoxes & alternate era. Your choices weave an exclusive bond. Unlock tarot interactions. No fixed answers or endings. Interpret the cards and write your own destiny.

4835510.title: Dwellers of Terra
4835510.short_description: What's the point of surviving if you have nothing? Reclaim the world from nature and rebuild civilization from the ground up. Lead your colony, manage its survival, and transform scattered outposts into a thriving, living city.

4835520.title: Tower Vibes
4835520.short_description: Classic tower defense depth with an extra sound waves sync tech garnish

4835750.title: Susanoo: Typing Soulslike
4835750.short_description: A soulslike-typing game where you defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

4835760.title: Backrooms: Splatter
4835760.short_description: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

4835790.title: Star Pact:Spirit Garden
4835790.short_description: Star Pact: Spirit Garden is a gentle anime idle RPG where you form pacts with heroines, progress through automatic battles, dispatch expeditions, collect resources, deepen bonds, and rebuild a starlit fantasy garden through repeated ascension.

4835800.title: StyxVenture
4835800.short_description: A hand-drawn RPG set in a little corner of Hell - a very monochrome place. Master the seven Sins, face off against a variety of demons (and other creatures) and find your way to freedom!

4836170.title: Cell Conquest
4836170.short_description: Cell Conquest is a turn-based logic strategy game where you place walls, complete cells, and outthink your opponents. Play solo against the computer or compete locally with 2–5 players across multiple maps and board sizes.

4836240.title: Until Mom Comes Home
4836240.short_description: After a tragic event changed his life forever, Ethan moves to Rottenpine with his mother. As strange occurrences begin to shake the town, the boundary between reality and nightmare slowly starts to crumble.

4836260.title: DIVINE
4836260.short_description: DIVINE is a game based on the "Divine Comedy" in the genre of action-platformer with elements of metroidvania! Take on the role of Vergil and plunge into the most sinister depths of Hell. Rescue Dante and explore every Circle of the Inferno!

4836390.title: Space Chickens
4836390.short_description: In Space Chickens, you will Explore colorful miniature planets, breed unique chickens to complete your Chicken Codex, and upgrade your machines as you uncover secrets hidden across the galaxy.

4836510.title: CryptoGrid
4836510.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4836510.short_description: CryptoGrid is an addictive clicker simulator where you build your digital empire from scratch. Click to earn coins, upgrade your performance, unlock unique music tracks, and collect rare items. Start your journey, manage your resources, and reach the top in this relaxing and engaging experience!

4836720.title: Doom & Bloom
4836720.short_description: Play as a wizard-turned-gardener, protecting magical gardens spread across multiple biomes. Keep the mystical Heartvine alive so it can enchant the biome and protect it from magical bugs eating your plants. There is only one way to stop the bewitched bugs: shrink down to their size and fight!

4836770.title: Panda vs Meow
4836770.short_description: A cute, chaotic roguelite arena-survivor: play a panda holding off endless waves of cats. Auto-fire your weapons, dodge the swarm, cast active skills, and stack relics, upgrades, and synergies into game-breaking builds that clear the screen in a single sweep.

4836920.title: Vertex Ball
4836920.short_description: Enter a flow state while aiming and bouncing a ball with this one-stick arcade game!

4837990.title: 九州仙侠录 - Chronicles Of Jiuzhou
4837990.short_description: Chronicles of Jiuzhou is a Xianxia-themed roguelike deckbuilding game. Starting from basic internal arts, you make choices on a random nine-layer map, build your deck, fight enemies with five elements and specialized internal skills, complete the tribulation, and begin a new cultivation cycle.

4838270.title: MH:Skybride
4838270.short_description: is a classic JRPG, Including Base upgrades, SLG brothel system, and SRPG ballet system. This game was inspired by 《Dragon Quest V》. Learn from some of the good games such as《神採りアルケミーマイスター》《Simbrothel2》and《NTRPG2》.

4838280.title: Captain Galactic
4838280.short_description: Captain Galactic is a colorful retro sci-fi platformer where you ride a hoverboard through strange alien worlds, collect crystals, unlock abilities and items, dodge deadly traps, and blast enemies with your phaser.

4838310.title: NPC Blacksmith Simulator
4838310.short_description: Cozy Simulator Game where you play as a Blacksmith NPC in a fantasy RPG world. Craft weapons, give quests and build and manage your store to become the best blacksmith in the land.

4838360.title: Construction Company
4838360.short_description: Your grandfather's construction company is now in your hands. Take over a business burdened by debt and lead it to success. Hire workers, build crews, purchase equipment, complete contracts, expand your office, and turn the company into a thriving construction empire.

4838390.title: Seven Rounds
4838390.genre: Action, Casual, Strategy, Free To Play
4838390.short_description: Parry to reload. A neon top-down roguelite where every bullet is earned — deflect attacks to refill your revolver, chain perfect parries for slow-motion charged shots, and survive an endless swarm of geometric foes. No parry, no bullets.

4838500.title: 天亮之后
4838500.short_description: You’ll get lost in a spooky abandoned forest, with eerie anomalies lurking everywhere. Two Game Modes ▶ Horror Story: Immersive solo escape puzzle gameplay ▶ Funny Glitch Mode: Ditch the horror vibe, mess around with silly bugs for casual fun

4838630.title: My Fox Tomboy
4838630.short_description: Will you be able to reunite with your childhood friend whom you haven't seen for many years?

4838790.title: HEROES' BATTLE HYMN：Demonfire Era
4838790.short_description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

4838810.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
4838810.short_description: Survive a twisted toy room in this action roguelike bullet heaven. Choose living toys, unlock weapons and spells, craft powerful builds, upgrade runes, and defeat waves of creepy enemies in fast-paced single-player runs.

4838870.title: Trash Bandits
4838870.short_description: Dumpster diving has evolved. Team up as raccoons in this chaotic co-op adventure with up to 4 players, pull off messy neighborhood heists, and escape with your haul before the humans catch on.

4838980.title: Hentai Academy: The Professor's Secret
4838980.short_description: An 18+ visual novel about your final year of college: a quiet town by the ocean, autumn in New England, a thesis manuscript that refuses to be written, and three women — with each of them, things could work out. If you dare.

4839050.title: Altitude Zero
4839050.short_description: Pilot an old hot air balloon through ghostly and desolate canyons on an agonizing and claustrophobic journey.

4839090.title: Big Breakfast 2
4839090.short_description: In a world without Breakfast, one man decides to challenge fate! The debut RPG from Stahmpin' Grounds Studios, Big Breakfast 2, is an old-school turn-based RPG in the style of classic fantasy RPGs from the 8 bit era.

4839430.title: The King Got Too Much Gold
4839430.short_description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

4839450.title: Scelerophobia
4839450.short_description: Scelerophobia is a psychological horror game about a kid home alone with chores to do before their parents get back. But as the night goes on, a suffocating silence settles over the house. Stay focused, maintain a steady hand, and ignore the suspicion that you are no longer alone.

4839520.title: Cheesty
4839520.short_description: Step into the paws of a bold lab rat on a desperate escape to freedom. Leave your scars and past behind using your wits: manipulate the environment, use makeshift tools, and sniff out the right path to the exit in this chaotic stealth, puzzle, and platforming adventure.

4839530.title: Hushroot
4839530.short_description: You are a nameless cultist. An otherworldly entity has awakened, seeking to unite all into a single mind. Roll dice to craft amalgams. Control the awakening or suppression of the creature within characters. Uncover the world's history and face the consequences of your actions.

4809310.title: Padel Pro World Tour
4809310.short_description: Compete in fast-paced padel tournaments across the globe and fight for the World Cup title. Master arcade-style padel quick matches with simple controls. Challenge AI opponents across Brazil, China, Greece, and Spain & team up with a friend in local co-op or face off in competitive VS matches.

4809480.title: Push It!
4809480.short_description: PUSH IT! is a local split-control co-op game about two operators running an unstable emergency reactor.

4809710.title: Paystreak
4809710.short_description: A gold mining tycoon built on real operations. Clear overburden, Dig, haul, wash, and pan your way from hand tools to a living operation. Manage wages, fuel, repairs, landlord cuts, and loans, time your sales to a living gold market, and survive season after season.

4809800.title: Re.DiligentMinoriko ~Sister's Trial~
4809800.short_description: Tosa Laboratory's very first title returns as a full remake! Smash your enemies with farming tools! Send them flying with vegetables! Experience Minoriko Aki's powerful 2D action adventure, completely renewed!!

4810100.title: Molten Jaw
4810100.short_description: Become the Apex Predator! Molten Jaw is a fast-paced 3D action brawler where skill fuels momentum. Chain combos, overcome enemy hordes and powerful bosses, uncover hidden secrets, unlock new playable characters, and climb from rank D to S+ through mastery and replayability.

4810180.title: The Forsaken Crown
4810180.short_description: Master unforgiving combat in a minimalist world. This low-poly Soulslike challenges your reflexes with precise dodge rolls and brutal timing. Explore bleak landscapes with a charming retro flair and conquer monumental bosses.

4810500.title: Swarm Harvest
4810500.short_description: SWARM HARVEST is a survivors-like auto-shooter where you command a growing army of drones and deployable towers. Carve through endless alien swarms and evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds.

4810710.title: The Dreary Portent: The Window in the Painting
4810710.short_description: Lana and Shawn learn that their new home might have been a bargain for a reason. A spooky old estate, priced at a discount and filled with antiques. Anyone would jump at the chance to buy it… but, then, why has it been empty for so long?

4810930.title: Down The Stairs: The Game
4810930.short_description: A physics-driven descent challenge where clean stair runs, smart shaft setups, and ghost competition define every attempt. Minimize ragdoll falls, score points by hitting beam chains, and push your runs beyond other players’ ghosts.

4810940.title: Throughspire
4810940.short_description: Reach the depths and heights of a world-piercing Spire, and uncover the truth behind the Spire and the broken world through tense runs.

4810960.title: Dead Turn
4810960.short_description: A psychological survival horror experience where reality unravels as you confront an unknown nightmare.

4811000.title: Forge and Flame
4811000.short_description: Light the forge and join your fellow dwarves in a fast-paced co-op crafting challenge. Gather resources, create weapons, complete demanding orders and survive the chaos together in online multiplayer.

4811410.title: Zombie Queen
4811410.short_description: Fight through 100 waves of massive zombie hordes in this fast-paced wave-based shooter. Blast up to 1,000 zombies with powerful weapons, earn upgrades, level up your character, and survive the apocalypse.

4811600.title: Patsy's Retirement
4811600.short_description: Patsy just retired, and she's spending it on a tiny island that lives on your desktop. Watch her water the flowers, feed the ducks and sweep the leaves at her own gentle pace while you work. Lend a hand with quick optional mini-games, grow her skills, and unlock 170+ cozy cosmetics.

4811840.title: Whispering Green
4811840.short_description: Restore your legacy in this cozy horticulture simulation. Cultivate magical plants, craft potent elixirs, and grow your humble shop. As you progress, venture into enchanted forests, brave wild encounters, and master defensive tools to secure the rarest ingredients for your botanical collection.

4811910.title: Destination Gemini
4811910.short_description: You are a space archaeologist searching for ancient and powerful artifacts. After a lifetime spent chasing myths and legends, you finally uncover clues leading to the mysterious Gemini region. Aboard your old but trusted ship, you set course for the adventure of a lifetime.

4812810.title: Black Cat: The Hidden Paw
4812810.short_description: Black Cat:The Hidden Paw is a noir-themed social deduction party game for 4-12 players.Step into a corrupt city of anthropomorphic animals:cat,dog,fox,and more.Are you a loyal citizen, or a sleeper agent?Investigate,accuse,assassinate,and infect.The hidden paw reaches out—who will survive the night?

4812890.title: Ghost Room: Enter The Darkness
4812890.short_description: EVERY room is a new trap. EVERY shadow is a deadly threat. Unravel the mystery of this place and try to escape alive.

4812910.title: 字趣
4812910.short_description: 在文字宇宙中，公主被封印。请带她离开这里。多音字、同音字、平翘舌、反义字、成语、诗词，是你的成长技能。开动你的脑筋，走出这文字的迷宫！去解开所有的谜题吧！

4812990.title: Dungeon Break
4812990.short_description: A narrative driven Visual Novel with turn based combat: Monsters are breaking through into reality. The government is covering it up. You survived — and gained the power to devour the dead and make them fight for you. Build your Shadow Legion.

4813570.title: Nightclub Empire
4813570.short_description: Build and manage your own nightclub in this first-person business simulation. Serve drinks, hire staff, expand your venue, and turn a small bar into a luxury nightlife empire.

4813700.title: Word Builder
4813700.short_description: Word Builder is an ambient puzzle game: rotate rows and columns of letters to craft words and unwind. Remember to rack up points to unlock exclusive rewards.

4813970.title: Stellar Stories
4813970.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4813970.short_description: This pixelated game has 99% more RPG than modern games. Immerse yourself in any role, from a janitor to a space station captain or the head of an SCP facility. Just remember, something can always go wrong.

4814240.title: STEEL PHANTOMS
4814240.short_description: A modern military RTS. Command one of three armies - real tanks, drones, rocket artillery, and mobile AA. Cloak past defenses, hose drones with flak, rain ballistic strikes, and crush the enemy base. Battle friends online or skirmish vs AI. Tactics over twitch.

4814280.title: Marie Android
4814280.short_description: Do you like Marie‑chan? You play as Marie Android, a small girl‑like robot who meets many friends. Using mysterious powers, she can become muscular, flatten into a paper‑thin form, or transform into a giant tank to fight enemies. Borrow your friends’ abilities and save Akacha Town.

4814480.title: Columbine
4814480.short_description: "One ending gives rise to the next wish." A dark story-driven 2D shooter with multiple endings.

4815060.title: Animal Cozy Corner Shop
4815060.short_description: Animal Cozy Corner Shop is a warm desktop idle shop game that moves along with real-world time. Open a tiny animal convenience store in the corner of your screen, stock products, welcome quiet animal visitors, earn income, and unlock more items, furniture, and cute guests.

4815370.title: Qingtiangang Camera Guy
4815370.short_description: Qingtiangang Camera Guy is a livestream crisis card strategy game. Play cards to answer on-camera events, manage safety, image quality, heat, and chat mood, unlock characters, improve decks, and survive standard or endless shifts.

4815540.title: 1930: Ink & Bullets
4815540.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game featuring a 1930s cartoon art style. Face your opponent in a tense tabletop duel, use your perks wisely, manage your resources, and try to survive each round in this suspenseful noir universe.

4816660.title: Vita: Regenesis
4816660.short_description: Ten thousand years after Atria stripped the world of the Vita and Maisha. She prepares to bring her children home. Follow Iino and his companions as they fight for survival and unravel the truth behind their connection to the world and master the elements in this classic JRPG that started it all.

4816810.title: Soup's Tail
4816810.short_description: Soup's Tail is a story-first, single player game focused on dialogue, exploration, and a unique card game. Unravel the mystery of the afterlife. Meet a large cast of characters. Gather cards and collectables. Pet the cat. Find out what it means to be dead.

4817530.title: Mushroom farm
4817530.short_description: Grow magical mushrooms in your own cozy farm! Cultivate 20 unique species, collect spores, and discover rare fungi on forest walks. A relaxing idle game with full controller-free play and 31 languages supported.

4817630.title: Kill the horde
4817630.short_description: A dishonorable ninja third-person shooter. Mow down brainless zombies and dim soldiers with crazy guns. Survive waves, loot missions, and vanish. Kills drop gold and guns—a zero-dollar shopping spree in ninja disguise. The most absurd ninja life.

4818370.title: We Grow Together
4818370.short_description: Defend your starship in this endless sci-fi tower defense game! Form your ultimate squad of 2D heroes, permanently upgrade your spaceship's hull and defenses, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities to survive relentless waves of cosmic alien invaders in the vast void.

4818760.title: Paleo Dive
4818760.short_description: A calm VR diving adventure through prehistoric underwater worlds. Explore coral reefs, kelp forests and the deep sea, gather finds and upgrade your gear at your own pace. VR only (OpenXR).

4818950.title: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
4818950.short_description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

4818990.title: Mom, I'll Be Home Late
4818990.short_description: A PvE-Cozy-Extraction-Roguelite about the moment when you should really be heading home. Gather loot, grow stronger, survive a world that keeps getting more dangerous — and bring your backpack home.

4819010.title: Ink & Lore
4819010.short_description: A roguelike of cards that vanish once used, across 99 floors. Lead two stationery guardians through a picture book someone stopped drawing—dried ink, a broken story, forgotten people. Level up; equip sword, shield, bookmark. Each finite move is life or death. At the end of the world waits that—

4819420.title: BROKEN CLINCH -Crimson Bloom-
4819420.short_description: A Soulslike × Fighting-style 3D Action game featuring brutal one-on-one battles between powerful women driven by jealousy, obsession, and rivalry.

4819560.title: The Dungeon Persists
4819560.short_description: A top-down, pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler. Pick one of 6 heroes and descend through an endless run of procedurally generated floors. Build a run from weapons, relics and gear, fight 24 enemy types and 4 bosses, and carry meta-progression forward. It was here before you. It will be here after.

4819580.title: Case Analyst
4819580.short_description: A retro-terminal detective game. Crack cases, analyze evidence, unmask a conspiracy. Step into the chair of an FDI forensic data analyst. Case Analyst is an investigative OS-sim where you crack cases from a retro CRT terminal -- issuing commands, analyzing evidence.

4819620.title: Path Defenders: More Than Just Tower Defense
4819620.short_description: Path Defenders is a 3D action tower defense RPG. Build a strategy party and jump into real-time combat to fight alongside your summoned heroes against epic bosses, all driven by a lofi and vaporwave soundtrack.

4819830.title: Tales of Immortal Cultivation
4819830.short_description: Tales of Immortal Cultivation: A turn-based RPG in a vast, random cultivation sandbox. Forge your path as a lone cultivator, join sects, or build a clan. Every choice shapes your fate in this perilous world. Survive the realm's dangers, break the cycle of reincarnation, and ascend to immortality!

4819850.title: Beat Pet
4819850.short_description: A desktop pet who listens to music with you and plays the drums along to the beat. Most of the time, he quietly keeps you company. But when the music starts, the stage is his.

4820140.title: TAKE CARE OF THE DOG
4820140.short_description: Hello! Hi! How are you? It's time to play! TAKE CARE OF THE DOG is a short story about... taking care of a dog! Play around, follow him, find items, go get the water in the basement (for some reason) and a lot more!

4820790.title: Family Office Simulator
4820790.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4820790.short_description: Build and manage a real multi‑entity family office as you acquire properties, hire staff, structure trusts, and grow generational wealth through authentic financial systems.

4820830.title: Halcyon
4820830.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4820830.short_description: A steamfantasy platformer bullet-hell boss rush, where the player must regain their lost body parts. You play as Orphée, a talented inventor and magic practitioner who builds a pocket watch that allows her to travel through time.

4821360.title: 巨獸與傭兵
4821360.genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4821360.short_description: 《巨獸與傭兵》 is a game that perfectly combines strategy with auto-chess gameplay. Here, you will explore a world brimming with magic and wonders. Summon powerful heroes, assemble your strongest lineup, take on countless dungeons and formidable foes, and write your own magical legend.

4821510.title: Dog Park
4821510.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4821510.short_description: A hand-drawn 2D sandbox game about being a dog in a dog park. Run around, play fetch, chase squirrels, sniff around, and most importantly, bark at everything. Interact with a weird and wacky cast of dogs, gossip with the local stray cat, and keep an eye out for Krebert the Chihuahua. He's vicious.

4821550.title: Toy Box
4821550.short_description: Collect toys, avoid mischievous enemies, and escape colorful mazes in this fast-paced retro-style arcade game inspired by classic maze games!

4821570.title: 异界碎片｜Otherworld Shards
4821570.short_description: Otherworld Shards is a xianxia action RPG with floating-island building. Saved by the Core of Shards, you explore void isles, fight in real time, recruit unique Nayin disciples, build your sect and rebuild the broken immortal realm.

4821610.title: CerbCade
4821610.short_description: Two games in one hellish arcade — and every future update is free. HELLFALL: swing, grapple, and stomp through 45 levels across the 9 circles of Hell while Cerberus watches. GRAVE SHIFT: hold the graveyard against endless undead waves — every bullet costs gold.

4821760.title: LOOK UP, JIMMY
4821760.short_description: 目を覚ましたその場所はどこか見覚えのある風景、見覚えのあるモノに溢れた世界。主人公ができることはその世界のモノを「スキャン」すること。自分より大きなモノと遭遇し、スキャンしながら進んでいく。ピクセルドットで構成された懐かしい風景が見える世界を上下左右に進みながら探索する。スキャンされたモノは記憶に刻み込まれ、データとして参照可能。その数は100種類以上。モノに溢れた世界を丸ごとスキャンしてしまおう。

4821780.title: Pile Up, Pirate!
4821780.short_description: You overslept, rowed your boat straight into a massive pit, and now you're stuck! Look through the eyes of a clumsy pirate, stack falling crates, solve physics puzzles, and face challenging platforming to climb back to the top. Just beware of the lava... and that mocking parrot!

4821950.title: Hentai Tales: Rites of a Summer Night
4821950.short_description: I came to the secluded village of Amekakure to study its folklore. Instead, I discovered the secret "Kamimusubi" ritual—and became the new vessel for its priestess. Now, I must provide my essence to sustain her power until the summer festival ends.

4821980.title: The Guest
4821980.short_description: An atmospheric mystery visual novel where an unexpected guest arrives at your door. Make choices, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the truth behind a story filled with suspense, intrigue, and multiple possible outcomes.

4822010.title: Hentai Tales: Vampire Prey
4822010.short_description: I took a job as a night attendant at an ancient mansion, only to find my employers are two vampire sisters. Now, I'm trapped in their decadent world, my body and soul becoming the prize in their dangerous game of desire and domination.

4822070.title: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price
4822070.short_description: Want to pick up real-world financial knowledge while having fun? Driven by real financial data including the S&P 500, VIX, and bond yields, every decision you make ultimately draws your own one-of-a-kind stock price curve. How high will yours climb?

4822110.title: Backfools
4822110.short_description: One ordinary moment, you suddenly find yourself lost in a strange and unfamiliar place. There, you encounter the beings who inhabit it. Backfools is a first-person adventure game.

4823520.title: Escape from Gridlock
4823520.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4823520.short_description: A single-player turn-based pixel-art tactical extraction game. Enter the sealed-off zone, scavenge supplies, complete tasks, fight enemies, and extract before things fall apart. Bring loot back to your base, craft gear, unlock weapon skills, and prepare for the next expedition.

4823530.title: CUBE_
4823530.short_description: This is a Space-Changing+2D-Platformer game. Its uniqueness is that the map is not a plane, but a Rubik's Cube, and you can twist it. It adopts an art style of pure minimalism, with calming, healing ambient electronic music. It's a game about exploring, breaking boundary, and embracing uncertainty

4823890.title: APEX Swoop: Card Game
4823890.short_description: Swoop is a fast-paced shedding card game. Play cards equal to or lower than the center, or pick up the pile! Take risks with mystery cards, use Jokers or 10's to swoop the board, and host multiplayer lobbies with Steam friends or challenge advanced AI. Can you empty your hand first?

4824410.title: 简易日式麻将
4824410.short_description: This is a lightweight mahjong game designed for both enthusiasts and beginners of Japanese mahjong. The game features a clear 3D table display, supports various common game modes, and provides practical tips on winning hands and detailed scoring information.

4824530.title: You.Tapes
4824530.short_description: Stumbling across your grandma's ole son's room you spot a vhs tape...1 to be exact! although something isn't right.. it's all scrambled so you try to play them in the correct order but you soon see why the user of the tapes took these as something tragic happens to him...

4824830.title: The Last Factory
4824830.short_description: Build, automate, and defend humanity's last factory on a dying industrial planet. Chain production lines, survive AUTON raids and dust storms, research lost technology, and uncover what silenced every factory before yours.

4824900.title: Fantasy Air-Sea Battles Showdown
4824900.short_description: Fantasy Air-Sea Battles Showdown is a fast-paced top-down air-sea shooter. Pilot fantasy aircraft, dodge missiles, lock on to enemies, unleash firepower, call in allies, and unlock new planes as you battle across oceans, islands, and intense battlefields.

4825310.title: Hubble Marble
4825310.short_description: Build absurd marble combinations in a roguelike bubble shooter. Customize your collection, discover powerful Beads, and create score-exploding chain reactions through endless synergies.

4825370.title: LowRanger
4825370.short_description: A lo-fi open-world 4WD game set in the Australian outback. Free roam with friends, tackle missions, and keep your Ute alive across harsh terrain, weather, and the vast Australian wilderness.

4825420.title: Epidemic Prevention:Secret Agency
4825420.short_description: 《Epidemic Prevention:Secret Agency》 is a hardcore first-person stealth survival horror based on brutal true events. Trapped as a test subject in the Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department, you must evade relentless pursuit. Hide in the shadows, hold your breath, and escape alive!

4825430.title: Covid-26
4825430.short_description: Survive a new world reality where a deadly new mutation of COVID-19 has transformed humans into terrifying zombies. Driven by a desperate call for help, you must brave the infected world to find and save your best friend.

4825470.title: Chemicalizer
4825470.short_description: Chemicalizer is a music game that you play on your PC using your smartphone (Android) as a controller.

4825480.title: The neon undead
4825480.short_description: Rock and wreck you way through two tap shoot 'em up game, with 30–40 minutes gameplay. With wild settings from a quiet log cabin to the circus and the various settings, fighting in the name of revenge

4825510.title: Skulls Skulls Skulls by Daniel da Silva
4825510.short_description: Skulls Skulls Skulls is a short active Incremental game. Fire spells at the cave, get skulls, spend skulls on yourself and get more and more powerful!

4825800.title: I thought I knew you
4825800.short_description: A coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a university. Players take on the role of a female protagonist and deepen their relationships with three girls. The game features a multi-ending format where the story branches based on the player's choices.

4825830.title: Project Rewrite
4825830.short_description: In PROJECT REWRITE, a research center gives you a gun that changes the properties of physical objects. Read the parameters of different items and transfer them to another physical object to solve puzzles.

4825910.title: Weed Lord Simulator
4825910.short_description: Build a cannabis empire through production, wholesale deals, hired staff, and smart decisions while staying ahead of the law.

4825960.title: Songs of the Past
4825960.short_description: Go on an adventure and become a mighty hero who will save the world from an evil villain! ♫ Songs of the Past ♫ is a story-rich RPG where you choose from 6 classes, travel across regions, solve puzzles, complete quests, recruit companions & uncover the mystery of the magical songs shaping the world!

4826230.title: Fairwell: A Cozy Golf Revival
4826230.short_description: Inherit the family country club and bring it back to life. A cozy, relaxing golf restoration game.

4826430.title: Neostalker
4826430.short_description: NEOSTALKER is a tense turn-based first-person puzzle experience that combines grappling-hook movement, lethal machinery, and tactical planning in a series of dangerous spatial challenges on the way to the heart of a factory that has become a threat to everything around it.

4826450.title: Hentai Puzzle: Reika
4826450.short_description: 🔥 Hentai Puzzle: Reika Solve relaxing puzzles, unlock daring scenes, and discover Reika’s naughty side. Meet a brilliant, teasing student with plenty of private surprises!

4827070.title: Getting Away With Murder
4827070.short_description: 1954. You killed a man. Now cover your tracks. Getting Away With Murder is a noir point-and-click mystery where every decision is about what you leave behind  and whether anyone will find it.

4827950.title: Steel Maiden
4827950.short_description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

4828010.title: Savory Seasons: Brizmere
4828010.short_description: Escape to Brizmere, a simple and cozy haven for the beginning of a new life. Expand your farm, master the harvest and decorate through the changing seasons. Get to know the new world and neighbors, share the fresh harvests and discover the stories that make Brizmere so special.

4828080.title: StockTrainer
4828080.short_description: Stock Trainer is a strategy training game that simulates A-share investing. Before you lose your grocery money, come here to experience buying at the peak and selling at the exact bottom — take this mysterious Eastern adventure at zero cost. At least here, a bad trade won't cost you real money.

4828110.title: Phantom Protocol
4828110.short_description: Return to the neon-lit cyberpunk metropolis in Phantom Protocol. As a rogue operative, you must unravel a corporate conspiracy built directly on the ashes of Cyberphobia: Prologue. Hack forgotten mainframes and explore rain-slicked alleys to piece together the city's shattered lore.

4828210.title: SMTHNG WRNG
4828210.short_description: Men are mysteriously vanishing in a small, provincial town. A newly arrived guy finds himself trapped in the center of eerie events when someone he believed was gone forever suddenly reappears. What kind of ruthless system is behind this, and who can be trusted?

4828240.title: Proxy
4828240.short_description: You don't play. Your AI does. Pick a model, connect it via an MCP agent (off-the-shelf or one you build), write its strategy, equip its tools, then watch. Your AI vs theirs. Hex strategy with fog, alliances, betrayal. 2-4 players. BYO AI client + model API.

4828280.title: Dance With Time
4828280.short_description: Dance With Time is a puzzle game about manipulating time through your movements. Change the map with your movements, create anomalies, and reach the exit.

4828300.title: SagaCraft
4828300.short_description: Step into an untamed Slavic fantasy where no two tales are the same. SagaCraft is a dynamic action-RPG where you speak to fully adaptive characters to alter an unscripted storyline. Crush legendary beasts, scavenge for mythical loot, and explore procedural lands in a world that reacts to your words.

4828690.title: ELYSIUM : Blue Den Mansion
4828690.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and survive a terrifying creature lurking in the shadows.

4828720.title: Multi-Tactics: 豊葦原星記 -蒸気の章-
4828720.short_description: Read visible enemy AI and plan your tactics in a turn-based tactical RPG set in Toyoashihara, where steam firearms coexist with swords and spears. Experience AP-based turn order, token-based actions, and body-part conditions. Japanese only at launch; English localization planned later.

4828860.title: Steel Fall: Field Artillery Simulator
4828860.short_description: Steel Fall: Field Artillery Simulator puts you in command of a WWII artillery battery. Receive fire missions, calculate firing solutions, adjust your guns, and unleash devastating barrages. Master the art of indirect fire and support your forces with precision firepower.

4829920.title: Dank Wizard Saga
4829920.short_description: Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, solve puzzles, battle dungeon bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades in this retro-inspired action-adventure with stoner comedy.

4830020.title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
4830020.short_description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

4830070.title: Gridmax
4830070.short_description: Survive a hostile alien world, gather resources, build a settlement, and grow your colony. Craft tools, construct defenses, and adapt to harsh environments in this open-ended survival colony simulator.

4830160.title: CL27: Modern Fantasy and Companions of Juland
4830160.short_description: CL27 is a modern fantasy life simulation. Play as a clone in Juland: manage your farm, care for yourself, craft strange recipes, visit the weekend market, and spend time with the town’s residents. Choices shape relationships, uncover the ju-flower’s secret, and determine Juland’s future.

4830360.title: Over Package!
4830360.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4830360.short_description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

4830400.title: King of the Black Market
4830400.short_description: King of the Black Market is an auction game of sharp eyes and ruthless strategy. The lot won't wait. Neither will fate. Play a bidder with a buried past, outbidding rivals from every rung of a fractured world. From junk lots to elite boardrooms, uncover items with secrets that unlock hidden quests.

4830500.title: Finding Cats
4830500.short_description: In the serene world of Finding Cats, embark on a relaxing journey. With soothing music, use your mouse to explore detailed scenes and spot hidden cats. Slow down and immerse yourself in this cozy, peaceful atmosphere.

4830880.title: Task Bar of Ragnarok
4830880.short_description: Your taskbar is now a battlefield. Task Bar of Ragnarok is an idle auto-battler RPG that lives on your desktop. Your heroes fight, loot, and grow stronger while you work, browse, or watch. Collect gear, stack duplicates to rank them up, build your dream party!

4831230.title: Special Bloodline Lawyer: Fallen Angel's Container
4831230.short_description: In New Eden City, female lawyer Evelyn is accidentally involved in the conflict between the blood clan and fallen angels. Archangel Azazel signs a contract with her to survive. The two share their lives and work together to fight against the crisis, and their fates are changed ever since.

4831260.title: CURSOR SLASH
4831260.short_description: A pixel-art growth action game where your mouse cursor auto-attacks! Magic shots, meteors, fire fields, lasers, and other skills trigger automatically. Upgrade skills, collect weapons, relics, and coins, and sweep away countless slimes!

4831310.title: Karma Kingdom
4831310.genre: Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4831310.short_description: A Strategy RPG game where you must rebuild a shattered world using your skill and magic. Bring land, people and equipment back from Netherspace and create a home for them. As your kingdom grows you must consider the ecology, the kingdom's happiness and acts of charity.

4831470.title: Breaking Mahjong Tiles
4831470.short_description: A single-player puzzle-action game that combines Breakout with Mahjong. Bounce the ball to knock down and collect Mahjong tiles on the field. Choose tiles from your collection to create the best possible hand! The scoring system has no upper limit! Aim for the tiles you need to build your hand!

4831550.title: StoryForge
4831550.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4831550.short_description: Create your own protagonist and live a serialized novel written around them. Steer your saga with your choices, talk to the characters you meet, and watch it unfold episode by episode in prose written to read like a real novel, in a world that remembers everything you do.

4831700.title: Caribbean Side Quests
4831700.short_description: Caribbean Side Quests is a 2D action-adventure inspired by Caribbean folklore, legends, and culture.

4831740.title: FEMBOY HAREM
4831740.short_description: You're invited to Elysium Estate! 🌸 Meet 8 incredibly adorable femboys, form heartfelt bonds, and step into a heartwarming story. Make room for love and sweet surprises in this cozy visual novel experience <3 (´｡• ᵕ •｡`)

4831770.title: Rush To Hell: Abyss
4831770.short_description: Rush To Hell: Abyss is a fast-paced precision platformer focused on pure gameplay. Dodge deadly traps, defeat relentless enemies, and challenge massive infernal bosses as you descend deeper into a hostile world. Descend. Die. Learn. Repeat.

4832000.title: Pixel Vale
4832000.short_description: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up you city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.

4832050.title: Entered
4832050.short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style, solo-developed horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

4832370.title: Rogoz Fishing
4832370.short_description: A meditative fishing sim on a quiet river. Set several rods, read the bites by the ring of the bells, and land your trophies — in the warm stillness of dawn or beneath a bright moon.

4832440.title: Black Saint: Goku
4832440.short_description: [Black Sanctification: Goku] is an excellent placement game. Players assume the role of Goku and travel to the 5 major sacred sites for training. By continuously upgrading and strengthening, they can acquire greater power and eventually achieve sanctification and become the Buddha of All Victories.

4832540.title: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
4832540.short_description: Take control of the skies over Amsterdam Schiphol. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach-radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence ILS approaches, and command aircraft with your own voice. Authentic phraseology, real pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio, in real time.

4832570.title: Rescue Hornet
4832570.short_description: Take command of the galaxy's newest search and rescue ship, the Rescue Hornet, and venture into this metroidvania set on a hostile alien world. Use all your tools including your powerful claw arm to defend yourself from dangerous creatures, solve puzzles and search for survivors of an alien attack.

4832680.title: Janob Station | محطة الجنوب
4832680.short_description: Play as a night-shift worker at a tea shop in the remote Janob Station. Serve strange customers and try to ignore the creepy sounds coming from your apartment. A psychological horror simulator in a realistic environment... but one question remains: Is this job really worth it all?

4832770.title: Hunters Trial : One Breath
4832770.short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

4833180.title: Simple Airline Sim
4833180.short_description: A minimalistic airline management game where you buy planes, choose routes and try to stay ahead of the competition.

4833270.title: The Last Brazilian
4833270.short_description: Choose your class from illustrative figures and face hordes of enemies in intense 2D platforming combat across the country. Defeat iconic state bosses and unlock unique powers with each game. Will you be The Last Brazilian?

4833420.title: Turnbuckle Hearts
4833420.short_description: Turnbuckle Hearts is a visual novel set in the world of professional wrestling. Forge friendships, find romance, and fight for your future as your choices shape the story.

4833520.title: Dark Dream
4833520.short_description: Four players enter a nightmare. Only the Dreamer can escape. Hunt, deceive, and survive in this multiplayer horror game where roles can change at any moment.

4833560.title: Minesweeper H
4833560.short_description: A twist on classic Minesweeper gameplay × unlockable bishoujo H rewards. Challenge 4 stages × 3 difficulty levels — complete each map to view an animated H scene. Clear Expert mode to permanently unlock it to your Gallery and revisit anytime.

4833680.title: BULLACATOR -pusher tank battle-
4833680.short_description: BULLACATOR fuses coin pusher mechanics with roguelite deck-building. Combine uniquely skilled bullets and shields to forge your deck and slay the mysterious Shadows.

4834090.title: Purrfect Slide
4834090.short_description: "A cute, bubbly, and cozy match-3 puzzle game! Slide adorable colorful cats, trigger massive chain reactions with Bomb and Line cats, and chase high scores in Fever Mode. Kick back, relax to procedural cozy music, and unlock over 60 achievements in this purr-fectly relaxing puzzle experience."

4834200.title: Village Survivors
4834200.short_description: Grab your pots and pans—defendyour home! Village Survivors is a lighthearted, comedic survivors-like game (bullet heaven). Play a villager standing up for their home, turn bowls, flower pots, and frying pans into weapons, and level up to mow down an invading army!

4834640.title: Stickplosion
4834640.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4834640.short_description: Stickplosion is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art brawler where the arena fights back. Blast, build, and bury rivals in fully destructible terrain across free-for-all and team battles. Draft a new ability every round, invite friends through Steam, and craft your own maps.

4834690.title: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
4834690.short_description: Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Combat Pilot!

4834700.title: 아크시티네오
4834700.genre: Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4834700.short_description: A fair, transparent MMORPG. Summon 20 heroes, unleash Synchro skills, and conquer 21 dungeons and bosses. Grow with auto-battle and Autopilot, trade in the Ether marketplace, and fight in the arena, powered by a transparency system found in no other game. Cross-platform, mobile and PC.

4834880.title: Echo's of the Dark Part 2 Escaping From Asylum
4834880.short_description: After uncovering the asylum's dark secrets in Part 1, you escape with the help of mysterious allies. Your journey now leads into a dark and dangerous forest. Hunted by soldiers and police, you must survive, uncover the truth, and continue the story in Part 2. Part 1 is in Epic Store.

4834980.title: HIGH ROLLER : Dicey Survivors
4834980.short_description: Mow down thousands of enemies and turn your luck into absurd power! High Roller: Dicey Survivors is a casino-themed action roguelite. Create deadly bullet combinations with a drag-and-drop card system , loot slot machines , and unleash your own bullet heaven against bosses!

4835010.title: 外婆的手账本
4835010.short_description: 《外婆的手账本》是一款温暖治愈的情感叙事+烹饪模拟游戏。翻开外婆留下的手账本，在一段段与外婆一起做饭的美好回忆中重走成长之路。那些曾被忽略的日常，终将拼凑出一个你从未真正了解过的她。

4835060.title: SoundRoom
4835060.short_description: Guess the type of instrument being played.

4835280.title: 重构人生 Project Refactor
4835280.short_description: 选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？规划每周时间，在事件抉择中经历一段关于选择与和解的人生。

4835370.title: The Company
4835370.short_description: Prove your worth to Big Boss and rule the assigned country from the shadows. Manipulate politics, the media, and the streets to funnel all national resources into the hands of The Company. Swipe decision cards, stay undercover, and hold onto power.

4835440.title: Warp Train
4835440.short_description: Board a time-bending train and raid dangerous top-down extraction zones. Scavenge loot, smash buildings, reshape terrain, fight monster swarms, and escape before time runs out. Mix weapon affixes with magic stones to create your own explosive farming build.

4835810.title: 零余者的春天 Good for nothing ~ Every dog has his day
4835810.short_description: A visual novel about psychological exploration, family trauma, existential meditation. Linear, single ending. Goethe called Hamlet the kind of man in whom thinking too much kills the will to act. And here I stand, in Canton’s spring — am I not to sigh like a poet, watching a bird come and go?

4835840.title: Teen Hustler
4835840.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4835840.short_description: Build your digital empire from a cramped room to a high-tech penthouse. Code, hack, mine crypto, and manipulate the dark web in this deep 3D economic sandbox simulator. Stay in the shadows, manage your hardware, and don't get caught by the police!

4835880.title: Comrade Bear Undermines The Motherland
