4835880.short_description: Betrayed by the regime, you are the last survivor of a sunken submarine. Mine for vengeance, rebuild your wreck into the ultimate war machine, and ignite a rebellion. Defend against waves of corrupt fleets and monsters in this brutal roguelike action miner and then blow the Kremlin sky high.

4836650.title: Penguin Lifter
4836650.short_description: Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...

4836740.title: Feed Me Harvest
4836740.short_description: "Feed Me Harvest" is a first person horror farming game set in a eerie location. Plant crops, harvest , and feed the hungry head nearby to earn money. Use your rewards to buy upgrades, unlock seeds, and survive the night long enough to grow the key to your escape.

4836840.title: Centuria Quest
4836840.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4836840.short_description: Lead a party of 12 hero classes through turn-based battles. After each victory, choose your path — shop, recruit, forge, or push forward. Invest gold in permanent talents, unlock achievement perks, and climb 100 stages.

4836900.title: Finding Ruby: Hidden Object Adventure
4836900.short_description: 🔍🐱 A cozy hidden object adventure inspired by classic puzzle books. Join Ruby and her loyal friends on a journey across the world to uncover the mystery of her missing archaeologist parents through beautifully hand-crafted and highly detailed scenes.

4836910.title: Grand Vista Hotel
4836910.short_description: Build, expand and manage your own growing hotel. Upgrade rooms, optimize elevators, keep guests satisfied and transform a small family hotel into a luxury destination.

4836970.title: The Magic Bookstore
4836970.short_description: Play as a young witch named Willow, who has just inherited a bookstore from her grandmother in the magical town of Lindow. Learn magic, help the townsfolk with their problems, and run the bookstore. There’s a lot to learn about selling not just books, but potions too!

4837040.title: Legends of Canadia
4837040.short_description: Welcome, Legend, to the realm of Canadia, where Dragon-sized Canada Geese rule the skies. In this turn-based RPG, gather your party of punk-rock Beavers, noble Gooseborn and stoic Moose, master the magic of colour, and paint a corrupted world back to life

4837050.title: Kyklos
4837050.short_description: In this Turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, cities, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

4838000.title: AstroBoost
4838000.short_description: Fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action. Tap to jump, hold to boost, destroy obstacles, and survive the dangers of deep space.

4838150.title: Orangie
4838150.short_description: *Orangie* is a rare 3D AI desktop pet made for gaming companionship. She can chat, interact, perform actions, cheer you on, joke with you, and enjoy game stories together. She supports Chinese, English, and Japanese with high-quality voices. Join her on your next adventure! (ฅ´ω`ฅ)

4838450.title: 极乐妹土！2
4838450.short_description: 《极乐妹土！2》国际中文版正式登陆 Steam 平台！本作是由日本美少女游戏品牌 MOONSTONE 精心打造的一款视觉小说。故事发生在暑假期间，七濑家的父母远赴海外旅行，留下主角与五位性格迥异的妹妹共同看家。玩家将化身为这位温柔的哥哥，在带领妹妹们齐心参与各项活动的过程中，共同编织出一段温馨又欢乐的夏日成长物语。

4838590.title: What Killed Rachel
4838590.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

4838710.title: MAKINA
4838710.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

4838900.title: Custom Pinball
4838900.short_description: A roguelite pinball game where your bumper setup seals your fate. Rely on luck, skill, and strategy to aim for the endless horizon!

4838940.title: Above the Sun
4838940.short_description: Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, sets out to reach the top of the Acid Tower using the power of steam. With the eerie acid closing in, climb the randomly generated platforms — climb, climb, CLIMB! ...Wait — did I just fall? LOL.

4839030.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
4839030.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful walking sim with restaurant sim elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

4839040.title: X-Keepers
4839040.short_description: "X-KEEPERS" is an independent game that combines classic minesweeper logic, apocalyptic rescue, base construction and character development. Interpret digital clues, flag danger, rescue survivors, and build your own safe haven behind the ruins.

4839160.title: Copter Dude
4839160.short_description: Challenging arcade action game designed for players who enjoy difficult levels. You control a dude with a tiny helicopter, armed with a grappling hook. Dodge deadly traps and hostile enemies, and master challenging obstacle-filled stages where every crash is fatal. Expect a serious challenge.

4839180.title: SHADOW WIZARD MONEY GANG
4839180.short_description: A game about greed. A chaotic heist co-op roguelike shooter where wizards blast through rooms, gamble with magic, and turn money into health, power, and upgrades. LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS

4839200.title: Breachers: Outbreak
4839200.short_description: Breachers: Outbreak is a 4-player co-op zombie extraction shooter where you and your friends are dropped into infected quarantine zones to recover the key to preventing an undead apocalypse. Fully cross-play with friends across flatscreen and VR, so how you play is up to you!

4839300.title: CivilBrawling
4839300.short_description: CiVilBrawling is a turn-based strategy card battler. Choose Chinese, Roman, or Egyptian civilizations, build a 25-card deck, and deploy land, water, and air units on a dual-row board. Manage gold and tech to advance through four eras and conquer 20 BOSS levels with unique AI tactics.

4839350.title: Yagodki
4839350.short_description: Run a package pickup point where every missing parcel is your fault. Serve impatient customers, find orders fast, buy gear, and survive the most absurd week in customer service.

4839460.title: Stardust Protocol
4839460.short_description: Between bullet hell, black markets, and star-map strategy, chart a branching route of your own. Combine Scatter, Missile, Homing, and Laser weapons with 100+ items and 30+ random events—each sortie reshapes your build. Balance risk and reward in unknown systems and blaze your trail through the void.

4839730.title: The Unskilled
4839730.short_description: Die. Retry. Learn the trap. A brutal precision platformer where every level is designed to trick you. Survive hidden traps, impossible surprises, and troll mechanics that punish confidence at every step.

4839770.title: Abyrith
4839770.short_description: Abyrith is a traditional turn-based roguelike. Each run lets you build a unique character by combining skills and equipment while exploring and conquering dungeons.

4839800.title: Silent Dread: Last Order
4839800.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a late-night delivery and the disturbing events that follow.

4839810.title: Pitch Girls
4839810.short_description: 《Pitch Girls》 is a football FMV. You lead a women’s football team to compete against diverse top women’s teams worldwide. It features retro command-based battles with dribbling, breaks, passes, feints, charged shots and aerial duels. Every offensive and defensive call shapes match results.

4839900.title: Buzz Buddies
4839900.short_description: A co-op game about being houseflies in a home that doesn't want you.

4840010.title: Fathom Reach
4840010.short_description: Dive drowned hab-shells in short deckbuilding runs: crack the Pressure-Heart, strip the harvest, haul it home. Build a shell of your own and other divers raid it while you sleep. A roguelike deckbuilder fused with asynchronous base defense, in a world the sea took back.

4840020.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
4840020.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

4840040.title: Hosting Simulator: 2026
4840040.short_description: Manage your own hosting company! Set up your servers, upgrade your infrastructure, create hosting packages, and serve your customers. Play solo or with friends in co-op, and turn your company from a small business into a large data center.

4840050.title: Buried Life
4840050.short_description: 1997. After a sudden mine collapse, you find yourself trapped inside an abandoned Soviet research complex where classified experiments were once conducted. Explore underground laboratories, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover why the facility was buried along with everything it contained.

4840100.title: Before I Sleep
4840100.short_description: A fast-paced single-player cyberpunk FPS where a half-human weapon battles through brutal mission and fractured dreams to recover the truth before each forced sleep.

4840120.title: Relic Restorer
4840120.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you play as a cultural relic restorer tasked with mending broken cultural relics.

4840190.title: VOIDRAVE
4840190.short_description: A bullet hell shmup with a secret. 100 waves, 20 bosses, and the slow realization that the sector you're purging isn't a sector. You are not crossing the void. You are inside it.

4840230.title: The Shadows of Dry Creek
4840230.short_description: A short kinetic visual novel (about 45 minutes). Silas Reed returns to his hometown of Dry Creek… but something feels wrong in the abandoned town.

4840250.title: Stellar Stranded
4840250.short_description: Stranded on an uncharted planet after a failed mission, Lyra must find a way to escape. But she isn't alone. A hostile alien race is occupying the world to harvest its resources. Avoid their patrols, use the environment to your advantage, and guide Lyra safely home.

4840300.title: The Pawn Broker
4840300.short_description: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

4840320.title: Sex Passion and Lust
4840320.short_description: Sex Passion and Lust is the ultimate adult open-world sandbox game where your deepest fantasies come to life. Indulge in fully animated, uncensored sex scenes (solo, partner, and group), deep character customization, and complete cinematic control. No filters. No limits. Just pure, raw freedom.

4840340.title: Royale Battle
4840340.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer
4840340.short_description: Get ready for a legendary battle royale experience set in the Middle Ages!

4840410.title: Gatebound: Chronicles of Valor
4840410.short_description: An Fantasy Arena Action RPG. Choose from 3 classes and 9 specializations, upgrade your gear, find mythical weapons, and crush hordes of enemies in deadly arenas and dungeons, facing powerful bosses. Master the Trial of the Gods and choose powerful roguelite modifiers. There's no rest for the strong!

4840420.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
4840420.short_description: Evade a relentless threat and survive your inner terrors in this atmospheric retro-horror game. Explore a stylized, shadow-drenched world, solve cryptic puzzles, and piece together fractured clues to uncover a disturbing truth in a tense, mind-bending psychological horror experience.

4840430.title: Prove it Blob!
4840430.short_description: Prove It Blob is a relaxing puzzle game where you solve riddles and use the power of telekinesis to rearrange the appearance of the world.

4840480.title: The Inducted
4840480.short_description: Co-op PvE arena survival for up to 4 players. Fight escalating enemy waves in a sci-fi colosseum, choose hero classes, place tactical defenses, and survive together.

4840590.title: 宽恕我（Show me mercy）
4840590.short_description: SHOWMEMERCY is mystery otomegame. Play as Lilith, a widowedduchess who must eliminate those threaten herself or others. Choose method, plan thecrime. Every decision leads to different outcome. Build relationships with characters— stepson, priest, sheriff,and apothecary. Trust them, or deceive them

4840700.title: The Boo Club
4840700.short_description: The Boo Club is a co-op haunted-house adventure for 1–4 players. Explore a haunted mansion, locate the ritual altar, and complete a dangerous ritual, under the attack of the monster horde!  Use teamwork, quick thinking, and a lot of crazy items, and exorcise the mansion!

4840720.title: 奇尔杜克塔伦山谷 CHILDUHTARON
4840720.short_description: 《奇尔杜克塔伦山谷》是一部点击类的视觉小说游戏。您是一位年轻的先生，跟随天降的巨额财富，您将走进被古老密咒笼罩的巨石山谷，在探索中揭秘传说背后的真相。

4840830.title: Enchanted Oceans Inc.
4840830.short_description: Take to the seas and help bring life back to a shattered ocean archipelago in this third person ocean adventure created by a marine biologist! Make use of your trusty vessel, deep sea diving skills, and a sprinkling of magic to achieve your goals and help the people of Rhu.

4840840.title: Lust in Time
4840840.short_description: One date, infinite tries. Take advantage of a time loop to learn more about your date, and discover how many different ways she'll let you fuck her. With real-time high end physics crafted for VR.

4840850.title: No Beer Left Behind!
4840850.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved. But sometimes you need to drink a beer!

4840860.title: Go! 408 Differences: SPOT THEM ALL!!!
4840860.short_description: Find all 408 hidden differences across 30 hand-drawn illustrations,… or test your observation skills in endlessly replayable procedurally generated challenges!

4840880.title: ESKINITA
4840880.short_description: ESKINITA is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.

4840890.title: 落境：未知记忆
4840890.short_description: Bring characters to life on your desktop. Luo Ci Jian is a Windows AI companion app featuring animated characters, text conversations, character settings, and interaction memory. Customize their display and import local Mods or images.

4840980.title: Bound to Rot
4840980.short_description: Bound to Rot is a dark fantasy hardcore ARPG. Descend into the Anima, follow the Pulse, and push as deep as you dare for rare loot and brutal combat. Stray from the Pulse and the darkness will collect what you owe.

4841030.title: Hollow Signal
4841030.short_description: Hunt through a corrupted noir-fi transmission. Master evolving weapons, survive escalating waves, and confront monstrous signal-born bosses in an arcade roguelite nightmare.

4841070.title: Cursed Ciddy
4841070.short_description: Follow Betty as she explores the abandoned ruins of Comical Entertainment in search of answers. Solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and survive the dangers hidden within a once-beloved entertainment center concealing a dark mystery below. Nothing is as it seems.

4841200.title: Nuns With Guns
4841200.short_description: Four nuns. One church. Hell picked the wrong parish. Nuns With Guns is a gothic top-down bullet-heaven defence game where four armed sisters protect their church from waves of demons, upgrade between battles, and survive as long as faith, firepower, and deeply questionable theology allow.

4841280.title: Hacklash
4841280.short_description: Hacklash is a typing horror game where you type against the clock while a hostile AI has a turret aimed at your spine. Survive as long as you can, beat your best scores, and climb the global leaderboards across multiple modes and modifiers.

4841370.title: WARPED
4841370.short_description: WARPED is a fast, retro-inspired twin-stick space shooter where you blast UFOs, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship, and fight across the solar system with your robot companion Zippy to uncover the source of a mysterious signal.

4841390.title: Curse of Baghdad
4841390.short_description: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

4841430.title: GERPHYON: The Ender Mansion
4841430.short_description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'FRIENDS' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

4841480.title: Chicken Battlefield
4841480.short_description: Chicken Battlefield is a chaotic roguelite where you command battle-ready chickens fighting against rival factions in an all-out war. Arm your flock, defend your bases, survive relentless enemy assaults, and adapt your strategy with unique upgrades, weapons, and battlefield traits.

4841490.title: Team Rush
4841490.short_description: In this beat-'em-up choose from a diverse cast of fighters, each with their own unique abilities, special attacks, and playstyles. Chain together powerful combo strings, master advanced movement techniques, and adapt your strategy on the fly as you battle for victory.

4841500.title: Cosmic Survivor
4841500.short_description: Cosmic Survivor is a space arcade survival game: pilot unique ships, face waves of meteors, alien swarms, and colossal bosses while unlocking weapons, achievements, and new challenges.

4841510.title: Organ Failure
4841510.short_description: A turn-based surgery in medieval times, against a silly Plague Doctor. Find the Sick Organ, kill less patients and extract their Hearts for an upper hand.

4841560.title: Way of the Wind
4841560.short_description: Way of the Wind is a grand-strategy monster terrarium: a living feudal map where cities, ogres, heirs, shrines, rot, snow, and rescued characters all visibly grow into long-term consequences — with the immediacy of a toybox instead of the friction of a spreadsheet.

4841590.title: Dungebra
4841590.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

4841640.title: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
4841640.short_description: Explore the world of GlowPits, collect valuable resources, defeat rival explorers, unlock unique characters, and upgrade powerful abilities in a fast-paced arena adventure filled with creatures, challenges, and endless progression.

4841650.title: More War: Iron and Arcane
4841650.short_description: An incremental war game where technology and magic clash. Gather resources, unlock units and upgrades, and grow from small battles to massive wars.

4841680.title: Nanma, A Tecelã das Sombras
4841680.short_description: Nanma: A Tecelã das Sombras is a Brazilian dark high-fantasy visual novel where the loom of fate is in your hands. Take on the role of Nanma and discover whether your powers are a gift or a curse.

4841700.title: Concert of Power
4841700.short_description: Rule a shattered North America where every claim can become a crisis, and every crisis tests the balance of power. Build industry, command trade, forge treaties, isolate rivals, and decide whether to preserve the fragile order or become the power that breaks it.

4841780.title: LIVORA
4841780.short_description: LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where money, work, relationships, health, family, weather, world events and pressure all connect. Build a life, face the consequences, recover from mistakes, chase ambition, fall in love, start again, and see how different every life can become.

4841830.title: Gun X Race
4841830.short_description: This is a high-speed racing game combined with survival against assassination attempts on the racetrack. Not only do you race, but you also have to get out of your car and take up arms to defend yourself from enemies. Enjoy chaotic and intense races with a variety of challenges and unique modes.

4841870.title: Hephaestus Protocol
4841870.short_description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

4842060.title: Project Sol
4842060.short_description: Project Sol is a Sci-Fi colony sim set in the future when you civilization is just beginning to reach for the stars. Take control of your Empire, build massive orbital satellites, defend from roving pirates, and conquer the galaxy!

4842120.title: Deadclaim
4842120.short_description: A hardcore third-person extraction shooter on a persistent post-collapse Frontier. Carry in what you dare, fight raiders and AI for loot, and extract — or your kit drops on your corpse. Your progression stays safe; build an outpost, host your own server. No pay-to-win.

4842190.title: The Art Keeper
4842190.short_description: Inherit a house and a job that keeps changing. Decorate freely with 100+ interactive items, then curate a gallery of 29 paintings across 15 escalating rounds — timers, colors, ciphers, and more. A cozy sim with a mystery underneath.

4842330.title: Malevolent Star
4842330.short_description: Malevolent Star is a first-person shooter with retro graphics, an eerie narrative experience, and simple, engaging combat. Fight against clever enemies, crazy enemies, and terrifying enemies (in approximately that order) to uncover the mysteries of the last of the living machine planets.

4842420.title: Paper Brawl
4842420.short_description: The casual doodles on the grid paper actually came to life. Grab your weapons and have an exhilarating battle with the evil dust stains!

4842460.title: FloraFarm
4842460.genre: Adventure, Casual, Simulation, Free To Play
4842460.short_description: Build, grow, and expand your own isometric farm. Plant rare flowers, harvest valuable crops, dig up hidden diamonds, and unlock unique vendors as your land grows. A cozy, relaxing farming sim where every tile counts.

4842470.title: 武道余晖 The Last Glimmer of the Martial Way
4842470.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4842470.short_description: In real-time action games controlled by mouse and keyboard, players defeat enemies to level up and learn skills, collect equipment to enhance their strength, and complete objectives within levels. After defeating all bosses, they can successfully save the world and complete the game.

4842490.title: Fleck & Grus
4842490.short_description: Help Grus escort his friend Fleck safely back to his hometown in this fast-paced precision platformer. Navigate tight levels packed with tricky jumps, bouncing mechanics, and deadly hazards. Stay sharp, react quickly, and master each challenge to survive the journey.

4842550.short_description: Your family is murdered before your own eyes leaving you in a mentally debilitated state. You must now open your mind and accept the truth of what has happened to free yourself from a spiral of emotional degradation.

4842640.title: Subsector Zero
4842640.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

4842660.title: Heroes And Calls
4842660.short_description: On a fantasy continent ravaged by endless war, train heroes, collect powerful treasures, summon a variety of unique creatures, build multiple one-of-a-kind armies, defeat formidable enemies, battle other players, and become the supreme ruler of the land.

4842810.title: The Night Librarian
4842810.short_description: You are the new night librarian at Ashwood. Shelve the impossible returns, answer notes left by a patron who appears in no register, and piece together what the library remembers. A short, atmospheric mystery told over five nights and twenty-two puzzles.

4842910.title: Terrablox
4842910.short_description: A voxel-based virtual tabletop with full 3D building, movement, and fog-of-war. Place voxels in any color with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc. Import any image as custom standees. Detailed GM control over player vision, teams, dice, and more!

4842990.title: Old Time Hockey
4842990.short_description: Arcade hockey like you remember. Big hits, fast goals, and fights that are completely ridiculous. 24 made-up clubs, captain abilities, a franchise mode that keeps you playing, basic pond hockey, online and couch play.

4843070.title: One Stroke Hunter
4843070.short_description: A brainy roguelite monster-hunting game fought with a single continuous stroke. Connect grid squares in one unbroken line to build attacks, defenses, and spells, then slay your enemies. Deeper levels bring more complex fields and a new map every run. Draw the perfect path.

4843080.title: DUPED
4843080.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4843080.short_description: Finishing your shift in 2008, a fast emergency broadcast changes everything. In a flash, you're ripped from your office and dropped into a scuffed, synthetic wilderness. Explore a hidden buzzing laboratory, interface with strange retro-technology, and survive a reality that is unraveling around you.

4843140.title: YOLKA: 90s New Year Simulator
4843140.short_description: Snow and chill outside, but warmth in your heart. In this nostalgic first-person simulator, dive back into childhood and get ready for New Year’s Eve. Decorate the tree, build a snowman, play, and fully immerse yourself in the cozy vibe of the 90s.

4844370.title: Keep Shearing
4844370.short_description: A cozy incremental game about shearing sheep, collecting wool, earning gold, and unlocking upgrades to grow your flock.

4844380.title: Skillbound
4844380.short_description: Sprint through an ever-changing world, dodge deadly projectiles, conquer towering obstacles, level up, and unlock powerful abilities in this fast-paced 2D endless runner.

4844500.title: Here, There Be Monsters
4844500.short_description: Captain your ship through a relentless bullet-heaven on the high seas. Weave through storms of cannonballs, survive waves of mythical monsters, and craft powerful upgrades to escape Davy Jones' Locker in this naval rogue-lite!

4844720.title: Legumi Lagoon
4844720.short_description: Uncover the lost histories and legends of the mysterious Legumi in a stressfully relaxing survival RPG like none other.

4844800.title: Hentai Succubus Puzzle
4844800.short_description: A seductive adult puzzle game where each completed level reveals more of a mysterious succubus. Solve 100 image-based puzzles, unlock the gallery, and progress toward intimate rewards.

4844920.title: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu
4844920.short_description: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu is a narrative management game set in southwestern China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. You keep a mountain inn—running the business, receiving travelers, and witnessing and shaping their stories.

4844940.title: Luman Lars: Dichotomy
4844940.short_description: Two worlds, one blade between them. A 2D pixel-art open-world action-adventure where your playstyle reshapes your abilities, the soundtrack reacts to your every move, and your choices decide which truth — and which ending — is real.

4845020.title: 恋爱，我就借走咯
4845020.short_description: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的生活费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演代理熟人、倾听者乃至专属搭档的虚假契约掩护下，女性们不为人知的内心秘密与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实考验，当一层层伪装剥落之后，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？充满谎言与心跳的喜剧就此上演。

4845130.title: FruitSnoot: The Snake Roguelike
4845130.short_description: The snake roguelike. Capture fruit, grow your tail, chase rare finds, and unlock quirky characters and equipment in a cute, chaotic action roguelike set across colorful ocean islands.

4845150.title: Samurai Space Cowboy
4845150.short_description: A cyberpunk samurai gunslinger action roguelite. Carve through endless robot hordes with an energy katana and a six-shooter, dash through the chaos, chain upgrades into builds that snowball out of control, and see how far one run can take you.

4845230.title: Spinebreaker
4845230.short_description: This precision platforming rage game will test your ability to master simple mechanics and frustration management when your movement is restricted to two buttons for rotating. With this game recreating the pathway for learning any new skill, you will need to learn how to pick yourself back up.

4845270.title: Welcome To Steam Next Fest
4845270.short_description: Explore upcoming games, and try out free demos. Wishlist your favorites to get notified when they release!

4845290.title: SwipSwap
4845290.short_description: A 3D fast-paced action game. One hit Kill. Control a shadow dancer whose shade replicates your moves with a 2-second delay. Swap positions with it, avoid traps, and unleash deadly AoE attacks to survive. Create your own build to overcome the challenges! Can you defeat Dracoulous?

4845420.title: Adam Vandell - Black Neon
4845420.short_description: Detective 26 from the La Herida 5 police department is hunting a mysterious killer in a world of rain, smoke and neon light.

4845430.title: BEHIND THE WALLS
4845430.short_description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you explore a secret place, solve mysteries, and uncover the dark truth hidden behind the walls.

4845490.title: Future Scout
4845490.short_description: Future Scout is an exciting, fast-paced game where you take control of a space vehicle and race through the vast expanses of a space tunnel!

4845500.title: Snow Route
4845500.short_description: Snow Route is a dynamic 3D driving game where a true winter adventure awaits! Get behind the wheel of a truck and drive along snowy roads to the finish line.

4845510.title: Tense Parking 2
4845510.short_description: Tense Parking 2 is the second installment of the exciting parking simulator, which takes you to a bright and sunny metropolis!

4845520.title: Winter Creatures
4845520.short_description: Winter Creatures is an exciting 3D puzzle game that will transport you to a mysterious snowy island full of mysteries. Your goal is to help the little slugs descend to earth!

4845540.title: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
4845540.short_description: A free Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

4845650.title: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love
4845650.short_description: Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love is a first-person gothic mystery game about memory, loss, and a love the Ashrose family tried to erase. Explore a forgotten manor, uncover hidden clues, restore a damaged portrait, and reveal the truth behind Julian Vale’s disappearance from history.

4845700.title: Football Commissioner
4845700.genre: Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4845700.short_description: The definitive, first-of-its-kind American football league management sim. Take control of the newest spring football league by customizing the structure, teams, ticket prices, salaries, and more. Sim games week by week to grow your league from a startup into a thriving sports empire.

4845880.title: Mothman: Shadows of Point Pleasant
4845880.short_description: A former military investigator travels to Point Pleasant, West Virginia, to solve a series of murders and child disappearances. Follow the legend of the Mothman into secret underground facilities, government conspiracies, and unimaginable horrors hidden beneath America.

4845900.title: Apprentice Ascending
4845900.short_description: Master forbidden magic. Dodge the rent. Survive the Tower. You are an apprentice wizard in a real-time card game brimming with terrible ideas. Pray for coin, study forbidden texts, and climb floor by floor before hunger and the Hunters close in. Seven fates await. Dare to earn the right one.

4846030.title: Project: Annwn
4846030.short_description: Following the manifestation of paranormal entities rooted in historical folklore, the United Paranormal Department of Research (U.P.D.R) was formed to contain and study them. As lead engineer at the Annwn site in North Wales, a deliberate outbreak forces you face to face with the unknown. Survive.

4846060.title: Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead
4846060.short_description: An HD-remaster of a comedy-horror visual novel from 2009, mixing classical Russian literature with anime, zombies and glam rock.

4846090.title: Hentai Senpai: Noir Vice
4846090.short_description: Sex, crimes, and a saxophone bleeding through the rain. Noir Vice drops you into a corrupt city where badges mean nothing and every woman has a dirty secret. Solve puzzles. Unlock explicit scenes. The city never sleeps and neither do they. 🎷🖤

4846100.title: Hentai Senpai: Pirates! 2
4846100.short_description: Set sail for ultimate pleasure in Hentai Senpai: Pirates! 2! Solve puzzles solo or in 4-player co-op to undress a crew of fierce, sexy pirate queens. Enjoy one-handed gallery browsing, deep character profiles, Steam Deck support, and epic anthems as you claim the sexiest booty. Yarrr!

4846240.title: Scorched Dominion
4846240.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy game about competing for territory and assets. Command unique units, disrupt enemy advances, and expand your power. Features five factions, five AI difficulty levels, and local two-player battles.

4846250.title: Aaron Drake: Ace Detective
4846250.short_description: Become Aaron Drake and experience the thrill of the hunt as you interrogate suspects, spot contradictions, and corner killers across three murder cases — alongside a rookie partner who is trying her very best.

4846310.title: Corner Dungeon
4846310.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

4846330.title: Monoka
4846330.short_description: A multiplayer card game about trying to confuse the enemy before they confuse you, lest you get sent into 12 different mechanics you've never seen before, as you and your soon-to-not-be friends bend the rules in your favor.

4846480.title: Front Line
4846480.short_description: A side-scrolling action shooter where you push through enemy lines, switching between handgun, machine gun, shotgun, and sniper rifle. Weapon choice and reload timing can mean the difference between life and death. No extra lives. No continues. One life to conquer the battlefield.

4846550.title: Trenite Engineer
4846550.short_description: You don't pilot the ship-you run it. Manage power, fuel, gravity, life support and other systems, repair failures and engineer your way through a hostile solar system.

4846570.title: Wimple and Habit
4846570.short_description: Help Wimple and Habit, nuns in The Chapter's special investigations unit, to uncover the case of the missing janitor in this point-and-click puzzle adventure.

4846630.title: Crimson Crawl
4846630.short_description: Crimson Crawl is a dark fantasy pixel-art roguelike RPG that combines dungeon exploration, deckbuilding, and turn-based horde battles. Buil blood-themed card synergies, conquer endless swarms of enemies, and descend into ever-changing labyrinths where every run offers new challenges and rewards.

4846780.title: Shootrix
4846780.short_description: Shootrix is a fast-paced strategic puzzle game where you shoot and place blocks to create explosive 2x2 combos. Master chain reactions, outsmart opponents, and compete in real-time arena battles against players worldwide.

4846800.title: 1000 Princes: ChouChou Condo
4846800.short_description: This is an AI-powered online otome game, You move into ChouChou Condo, where the entire building is filled with 1,000 princes who love only you! Unlock daily posts, mini-games, and light visual novel stories. Chat with the princes or post in the group to receive their sweet responses.

4846830.title: Parcel Empire
4846830.short_description: Build a parcel delivery empire, from your first click to an automated logistics network. Buy vehicles, expand storage, unlock trophies, and optimize your production.

4846840.title: Vonkelveld
4846840.short_description: Kindle a world where every light is a living soul. Shape it — never command it — then fall from the heavens to a single life and follow it. Ask why about anything and get the real causal chain. The stakes always win; how long and how brightly your world burns is the score.

4846880.title: Dogfight Era: Origins
4846880.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 32 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

4846920.title: PropHaunt
4846920.short_description: Hide. Hunt. Survive. A multiplayer horror prop-hunt where four survivors morph into any object — a chair, a candle, a discarded barrel — to escape The Butcher's axe. Repair the generators, stun the killer from above, or become the predator yourself.

4846930.title: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes
4846930.short_description: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes is a hand-drawn, cozy-dark first-person dungeon crawler. Explore a forgotten labyrinth, battle strange creatures, craft potions, unlock Ley Magic, and return to the surface before the darkness changes you.

4846960.title: My Giant Goth Wife
4846960.short_description: Experience a day of being married to your 298 cm tall, BDSM-obsessed, yandere, goth wife who loves tormenting you. Being married to a giant sadistic goth has its challenges, but luckily for you, every single one of them is a dream come true.

4847040.title: On Hold - Call Center Simulator
4847040.short_description: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.

4847080.title: Mirror of Destiny
4847080.short_description: Mirror of Destiny is a post-apocalyptic RPG. Build a party of companions with hidden secrets, face unknown threats through choice-driven quests and turn-based tactical combat, and shape the fate of a broken world ruled by corporations, wasteland factions, and superpowered beings.

4847090.title: Pools of the Deep VR
4847090.short_description: Explore eerie pools and surreal spaces as you search for hidden puzzle pieces and coins, using your bow and arrow to silently eliminate the enemies that drift through the depths of these forgotten halls.

4847120.title: Trance World
4847120.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4847120.short_description: A game where you take on an entire army ...by yourself ...as fast as you can.

4847210.title: Astro Boost
4847210.short_description: Through a space journey, explore multiple asteroids in search of rare resources! Play as Mineos, an astronaut equipped with a jetpack that will allow him to easily explore the asteroids and thus retrieve rare materials even in the most difficult-to-reach corners.

4847550.title: Argosy
4847550.short_description: Begin with a single ship and a handful of coin. Buy low, sail far, sell high — then turn profit into power. Build trade routes, factories, and fleets across a living economy, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to master of the seas.

4847690.title: KOKO Dungeon Mania
4847690.short_description: KOKO Dungeon Mania is a dungeon crawler adventure where you explore mysterious chambers, solve puzzles, battle monsters, and uncover the path forward. Each new level expands the dungeon with more chambers, tougher enemies, and greater challenges to overcome.

4847780.title: Chaos Warrior
4847780.short_description: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

4847800.title: DeadboySkeleton
4847800.short_description: A third-person action game from beyond the grave. Wake up dead and explore multiple maps, hunt for hidden items, and smash undead corpses out of your way. Inspired by TeamSesh as a love letter to the team and the fans.

4847880.title: Lucifaria
4847880.short_description: After two other priests vanish, a retired exorcist is called upon to eradicate an ancient demon. Enter a thrilling single-room turn-based horror RPG requiring strategy, sacrifice, and perseverance.

4847940.title: Huiyu AI Trip
4847940.short_description: Huiyu AI Trip is an interactive travel experience — a visual journey you can control. Hold W/D to move forward through the scene, hold S/A to rewind time backwards, release to pause. flicker-free forward and reverse playback.

4848090.title: Shadows of Eldemir
4848090.short_description: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

4848170.title: Vigilum
4848170.short_description: A first-person survival horror with roguelike influences. Prepare during the day by brewing potions, crafting sigil materials and gathering resources. Survive through the night, where Dr. Hayden will trace your steps, react to your actions and adapt his strategy to hunt you down.

4848200.title: AV Actress's Magical Adventure
4848200.short_description: Three years into my marriage with my wife, Ichika, I was working as a magazine editor, entrusted with projects with the renowned photographer, Mr. Oshima. During a meeting one day, Mr. Oshima said to me, "I need an amateur female model in her 30s. How about your wife?"

4848220.title: CHANNEL ZERO
4848220.short_description: As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

4848270.title: Jean's Survival
4848270.short_description: Jean's Survival is a tense day-night survival game where light is your only weapon. Scavenge dark, supply-rich buildings by day, then hole up at night and ration your light to burn back the infected without summoning the horde. Read the weather, trade with hidden survivors, and outlast the dark.

4848340.title: Deadly Warrior
4848340.short_description: Deadly Warrior is a loot-driven Action RPG. Venture into a magical fantasy world, battle endless monsters, explore dangerous dungeons, and challenge powerful bosses. Collect vast amounts of equipment and rare treasures to create your own ultimate build.

4848370.title: Fungidemi
4848370.short_description: Fungidemi is an incremental RPG game where you gather your party, sharpen your skills, find magical weapons and explore unique maps while fulfilling small quests in a heart-warming story.

4848480.title: CUEQUENCE
4848480.short_description: CUEQUENCE is a single-player roguelite billiards card battler set in Q-LAND. Aim with precision, build your deck, unlock powerful cues, and use magical cards to control the table.

4848560.title: Quadra
4848560.short_description: Put your logic to the test with this sleek, minimalist puzzle experience. Your goal is simple: use the tiles to hide every dot on the grid

4848610.title: Todd The Tubby Toad
4848610.short_description: Todd, a tubby toad that can't jump or walk, but with an incredible grappling-tongue, has found his way into a mysterious wish-granting wizard's tower. Zip, swing and puzzle your way through multiple levels in this physics-based 2D platformer!

4848670.title: Color Recollection
4848670.short_description: 不具合を抱えた自動人形たちの運命を左右する決断を下す、近未来ヒューマンドラマADVです。プレイヤーは人形職人「仕立て屋（テイラー）」となり、対話から重要な手がかりを見つけ出す「キーワード収集」や、色あて・混色といった直感的な「色合わせパズル」に挑みます。報告書の作成やパズルのプレイ結果によって「感情の尊重」か「修正の推奨」へパラメータが変動し、マルチエンディングへ分岐します。ホログラフィックな尖ったUIとチルな演出に包まれながら、「ロボットに家族のような役割を求めた時、記憶や感情はどこまで人間と同等に扱うべきか」という重厚な倫理・哲学的テーマを体験できる作品です。

4848760.title: The Greatest Sect Master
4848760.short_description: Powered with the cliché cultivation system, recruit disciples, manage growing sect and fight strategic turn-based battles in this Xianxia/Wuxia inspired rougelite RPG fantasy to become the greatest sect master under heaven.

4848840.title: DREAM OF HOMELAND
4848840.short_description: 《Dream of Homeland》 is a story-driven coming-of-age adventure. Follow Yuanyuan through a small southern Chinese town in the 2000s, make friends, explore childhood memories, and witness her journey toward adulthood.

4848890.title: State Breakers
4848890.short_description: State Breakers is a chaotic top-down PvPvE extraction shooter. INTERSTATE A.I. has turned against humanity! They must be infiltrated and destroyed! Resist solo or in a team - kill zombies, hack the map, outwit rival humans, loot, level up - and overthrow the clanker scum!

4848940.title: Wave Planet
4848940.short_description: A bullet-hell planet defence game where you orbit, shoot, and upgrade your way through escalating waves of asteroids and brutal bosses.

4848950.title: Whisker Tales
4848950.short_description: Join wise cats in an ancient, peaceful library! Click to gather knowledge crumbs, expand your library, bring color to a gray world, and send your cats into epic battles in the mysterious Sakura Room. A heartwarming, fully automated cozy/idle adventure awaits you!

4848960.title: Hurl
4848960.short_description: ARCADE HURLING! Play as the mythological giants of Irish mythology and beyond, with playable characters such as Queen Maeve and Finn McCool. Feel the speed of the world's fastest sport and experience the physicality first hand with bone crunching tackles and skill based special moves.

4849010.title: FOCUS
4849010.short_description: Surveillance footage is slowly being rewritten. A point-and-click observation horror game where you find what changed and report it.

4849020.title: Splatapult
4849020.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4849020.short_description: Aim. Charge. Launch livestock. Watch castles crumble in glorious physics chaos. Knock archers off towers, defeat grand wizards, "rescue" the princess. Build custom sieges with the map editor and share them on Steam Workshop for others to play.

4849130.title: Kıvam
4849130.short_description: A calm marbling craft set in 18th-century Istanbul. Float pigment on water, comb it open, lift it onto paper — every pattern happens once and never returns. In the wake of master Hatip Mehmed Efendi.

4849240.title: Duel: The Game Show
4849240.short_description: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 diverse minigames testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?

4849300.title: Squad Survivors - Rule-breakers
4849300.short_description: Co-op top-down horde survival. Pick from 10 elemental heroes, stack game-breaking roguelite builds, and mow down endless swarms — solo or with friends online. Bosses, daily runs, endless mode. No pay-to-win.

4849330.title: SYSCALL: RING ZERO
4849330.short_description: Reverse-engineer a private 1990s BBS. Read disassembly, patch broken checks, optimize a nine-core rack, and write assembly firmware that locks onto live scope traces. With 200+ puzzles, full controller support and offline play, you can refine your assembly skills on all your devices!

4849360.title: Silesian Wars
4849360.short_description: Rule Silesia through a thousand years of history. Wage war, forge alliances and build duchies on a map of real provinces, against cunning historical AI leaders or your friends online — from pagan tribes to the modern day.

4849440.title: Sticky Rooms
4849440.short_description: Rug first or table first? Sticky Rooms is a room decorating game where the furniture is stickers, the order of placement is a puzzle, and mistakes can't be undone. Follow Clara's adventures: from uninspired office worker to renowned interior designer.

4849560.title: Capy Farm
4849560.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

4849960.title: The Laws of Probability
4849960.short_description: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

4850230.title: Actually Rocket Science
4850230.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
4850230.short_description: You and your friends are the crew of the world's cheapest space program, and you have to fly an actual rocket to moons and planets. Reach your destination using a wall of about four hundred switches and buttons. Then upgrade your ship and do it all over again, farther. It's only rocket science. How hard can it be?

4850370.title: lemonade stand
4850370.short_description: You'd think that you and your friends run a lemonade stand in a mall. The lemonade is real. But it's also not what you're selling at all. Real players walk up, some want lemonade. Some want... "lemonade". And they ask in code you have to read, so the cops won't hear. Full proximity voice/text chat.

4850510.title: HKO: Advanced Survival
4850510.short_description: An open-world survival experience that combines exploration, suspense, resource management, tactical combat, and cooperative multiplayer. Explore dangerous islands, customize weapons, survive against the Penitents and escape with friends in The Phantom Runner experience.

4850520.title: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl
4850520.short_description: Turn your entire keyboard into a driving surface in Skoot: Keyboard Brawl. Navigating sharp dodges and collisions with opponents in a fast paced brawl-styled keyboard arena. Boss fights, Online PVP and endless mode!

4850560.title: DiceVenture Dungeon
4850560.short_description: DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler. Plan routes on a node map, roll and reroll dice in tactical combat, combine elements to trigger skills, and collect relics and traits. Dice challenges gate the best exploration rewards—every run builds differently.

4850810.title: Lune 13: triskaidekaphobia
4850810.short_description: Lune's mother left after a stranger called him "Little Bunny," promising to return in 13 minutes. She never came back. Explore a surreal psychological horror world shaped by triskaidekaphobia—the fear of the number 13—and help Lune uncover what happened to his mother.

4850850.title: FitBlocks～Wooden block puzzle～
4850850.short_description: FitBlocks is a relaxing wooden block puzzle game. Drag, rotate, and place every piece into the tray to complete handcrafted pixel-art shaped stages. Enjoy simple controls, cozy music, and increasingly thoughtful puzzles at your own pace.

4851000.title: Sheepping
4851000.short_description: Sheepping is a relaxing farm simulator in which you take care of your sheep, shear fluffy wool, spin it into yarn, and weave it into cozy clothing.

4851060.title: Source aged like fine wine: ballad of jets
4851060.short_description: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

4851080.title: STATO
4851080.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

4851090.title: 忌品管理部
4851090.short_description: My mother passed away. It was dismissed as an unfortunate accident... But was it truly just an accident? I need to know... what happened that day. Will the son hunting for answers reach the absolute truth? The player's choices and actions will divide the final outcome.

4851140.title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Blackberry
4851140.short_description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful blackberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

4851180.title: level test
4851180.short_description: Level Test is an action roguelike game with free‑build customization. Players can freely choose their weapons and skills, then select branching paths and upgrades to challenge random bosses.

4851270.title: The Hollow House
4851270.short_description: A co-op first-person horror game. Search a mysterious wooden house suspended above the clouds, complete objectives, and escape before the creatures hunting you close in. Play solo or with friends across multiple difficulty levels.

4851300.title: Pocket Pond
4851300.short_description: A tiny angler who fishes on your desktop while you work. Pocket Pond is a cozy idle overlay where a pixel-art fisherman auto-casts, reels in 130 species, and fills your codex - no clicking required. Just let him drift in the corner of your screen and see what's biting.

4851420.title: Cozy Cleanup
4851420.short_description: Clean up after a big party, collect trash, and earn money for better tools and new areas. Play at your own pace, customize your equipment, and find hidden rubber ducks. No violence, no stress, just relaxing cleanup.

4851430.title: Path to Goldhorn
4851430.short_description: Path to Goldhorn is a short adventure game with a focus on exploration. Explore, find new abilities and upgrade them. Fight bosses and mini-bosses.

4851450.title: Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid
4851450.short_description: Ilya, a worker in New York, merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua due to an explosion and gained superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee during the day and investigates the FX Group at night. He also has a complex entanglement with his proud boss, Natalie.

4851580.title: Rewinded
4851580.short_description: Rewinded is a puzzle platformer game where you play as an android robot rewinding time to undo a catastrophic project failure. Record your actions and replay them to complete your mission!

4851600.title: plink
4851600.short_description: One drop. Zero room for error. Can you master the physics of the bounce?

4851620.title: Royal Flush
4851620.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy
4851620.short_description: Royal Flush is a turn-based card battler where you play one card at a time to unleash powerful effects, drain your opponent's health, and outsmart your rival. Read the table, time your moves, and battle a cunning AI or real players online.

4851650.title: DamnedSchool
4851650.short_description: A school staff meeting. Boring! That’s about to change: Experience a VR FPS with co-op for up to 4 players. Cast powerful spells or engage in physics-based melee combat.

4851710.title: A Roguelike Tower Defense
4851710.short_description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

4851960.title: Service Desk Sim
4851960.short_description: The ticket queue never stops. Climb 42 floors of MegaCorp, resolve absurd IT tickets against the clock, and decide whether to side with humanity or with Synergy-AI : the AI that's being so very helpful about replacing you.

4852040.title: Code Rescue
4852040.short_description: A cozy coding game. An AI made Code City forget how its own code works – and the city went dark. Find the bugs, close the gaps, and bring it back to life one line at a time.

4852330.title: The Evening Custodian
4852330.short_description: Complete cleaning tasks, interact with school environments, hide from danger, and uncover the truth behind Upton-Tree Middle School in this first-person survival horror experience.

4852380.title: Dropoff
4852380.short_description: Work as a postman for a company, then build an empire ran by you, cause that is cool. 👍

4852460.title: Sweat Equity
4852460.short_description: A Milan luxury fashion house hides a death inside its supply chain. As prosecutors, unions, and a make-or-break runway close in, CEO Sandro is drawn into three forbidden romances, each woman holding a piece of the truth. An adult romance visual novel of desire, complicity, and cost.

4852500.title: The Confidential Disclosure
4852500.short_description: Pilot a UFO over an infinite voxel world that curves like a tiny planet. Abduct, destroy and uncover what humanity hid — while the army, the police and the men in black hunt you across a living, fully destructible sandbox.

4852570.title: Pidgeon Pocket
4852570.short_description: A flock of adorable pigeons. A park full of clueless picnickers. You can see where this is going. Pidgeon Pocket is a kawaii, chill heist incremental: snatch shiny things, upgrade your flock, and watch the loot pile up. Steal, upgrade, repeat.

4852650.title: Cues From The Past
4852650.short_description: A first-person horror investigation game set against a wartime backdrop. Explore an abandoned asylum, use psychometric abilities to uncover a criminal case from the past, solve puzzles, and collect evidence before time runs out.

4852680.title: Blackwater Exchange
4852680.short_description: Run a basement black market pawn shop in a gritty 1990s city. Inspect questionable goods, negotiate with desperate sellers, resell through shady contacts, manage heat, survive raids, and decide whether each item is a payday, a fake, a trap, or a liability.

4854360.title: Pro Tukey Hunting
4854360.short_description: Experience virtual spring gobbler hunting at it's finest! Game play centers around the four wild turkey sub-species residing in North America; easterns, osceolas, rios and merriams. Harvesting each sub-species is referred as a 'Grand Slam'. Do you have what it takes to earn the 'Grand Slam'!

4854380.title: The Stars Are Not Ready
4854380.short_description: A neon arcade roguelite where momentum is the only weapon. No trigger to hold: surf a vast dark void and smash asteroids, towers, and hunters apart at full speed. Chain dashes, charge your core to OVERLOAD, mutate every run, and break the guardians at the edge of the dark.

4854540.title: Sluice That Goose!
4854540.short_description: An incremental game where you sluice huge flocks of gooses and farm their loot to further enhance your goose sluicing behaviors. Unlock powerful upgrades, discover hidden events, and SLUICE. MORE. GOOSE.

4854550.title: Paradise Corner 2
4854550.short_description: Paradise Corner 2 is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.

4854680.title: Pictures at an Exhibition
4854680.short_description: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

4854700.title: Goblin Solitaire
4854700.short_description: Relax with a cozy fantasy-themed Klondike solitaire experience. Customize card designs and backgrounds, unlock achievements, track statistics, and enjoy a charming goblin-inspired world while playing the classic card game you know and love.

4855380.title: Idle Regenerator
4855380.short_description: Idle RPG with 125+ powers, deep equipment forging, sidekick roster, dungeons, constellations, prestige resets, and offline progress. No energy timers. No pay-to-win. Just depth.

4855460.title: Dino Quest VR
4855460.short_description: Step into the world of Dino Quest VR, an adventure where exploration, survival, fossil hunting, and dinosaurs come to life around you.

4855490.title: clear cherry ice.
4855490.short_description: Did I really save this pretty boy ten years ago...? A fresh summer youth BL visual novel about memory, promises, and mutual salvation. [clear cherry ice.] Get closer to Jiwon and Chaehyun, and see whether your bond becomes friendship—or something more.

4855560.title: Kingdom Chronicle
4855560.short_description: Take command of a warlord house and unify a war-torn continent in this turn-based fantasy strategy SLG. Master governance, diplomacy, alliances, and cunning schemes, and command six troop types in war. Recruit or capture officers from a cast of 168—every run a new path to conquest.
developers: スタジオ白猫斎 / Studio Hakubyousai

4855580.title: The Rise Of The Undead
4855580.short_description: A dark fantasy epic necromancy game

4855670.title: idle koi!
4855670.short_description: Hatch koi eggs, breed unique bloodlines, evolve rare traits, and send 3-koi teams into idle battles. Build a living collection where genes, rarity, lineage, and battle growth decide every koi's value.

4855720.title: Latticefall: Zombie setting
4855720.short_description: Latticefall is a slow-burn colony sim. The disaster doesn't strike — it creeps: an infection seeps quietly across the land. Build your settlement, hold the line, and reclaim ground one step at a time — paused and deliberate, never twitchy. Every advance has a price; you see it before you commit.

4855760.title: Tung Tung Tung Survival
4855760.short_description: Tung Tung Tung Survival is a first-person single-player survival horror experience set across a dense, isolated 1km × 1km island. Search every corner for the scattered parts you need to repair your boat and escape. But you are not alone. You were never alone.

4855780.title: ISLAND：THE LAST
4855780.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG
4855780.short_description: A third-person sandbox survival escape game. Hack and kill mutated beasts, gather resources to craft melee weapons; seize scarce energy sources and build vehicles upward before sea levels rise. Cooperate or raid—engage in deadly competition with 23 players for a chance to enter the "Dome."

4855950.title: SpaceLift
4855950.short_description: Wake up as an engineer on a failing space elevator in this narrative-driven side-view 3D sci-fi adventure. Explore spacecraft and service decks, repair broken systems, solve light puzzles, and uncover what happened to the missing crew.

4855960.title: BitVoxel
4855960.short_description: BitVoxel is a 3D voxel sandbox where you build real digital circuits. Connect gates, switches, LEDs and wires to create simple circuits, reusable components, or massive logic systems limited only by your imagination.

4855970.title: Highway Station Simulator
4855970.short_description: Build and run a highway rest stop from the ground up. Pump fuel, stock shelves, charge electric vehicles, and reinvest your earnings to grow the station.

4856010.title: GigaGoth
4856010.short_description: Experience a day with Kuroshi, your 293 cm tall, yandere, goth, mega-sadistic girlfriend who treats you as her personal slave, pet, and fucktoy.

4856150.title: White Creek
4856150.short_description: As Alicia Morelli, manage resources, investigate haunted locations, and choose whether to kill the possessed or save their souls.

4856180.title: Dear. My Marionette
4856180.short_description: A narrative-driven, turn-based RPG set in a cold, Nordic-inspired world. Master strategic card combat and make choices that will shape the fate of this frozen land.

4856190.title: Tech Store & Repair Simulator
4856190.short_description: Build the ultimate tech store empire! Buy wholesale electronics, stock shelves, and sell the latest smartphones. Master hardware repairs for extra cash. Manage your hunger in a life sim open world, hire staff, and expand your retail tycoon business.

4856250.title: Spire of Legends
4856250.short_description: Ascend a mysterious spire in this deckbuilding roguelike. Master unique characters with passive abilities, active skills, and powerful ultimates while building decks, collecting relics, and battling through ever-changing encounters.

4856330.title: Hentai Maid Shira
4856330.short_description: Hentai Maid Shira — help the charming maid Shira reveal all of her most alluring looks! Complete mini-games, solve puzzles, unlock beautiful anime illustrations, and expand your collection.

4856380.title: Just Rats
4856380.short_description: Atmospheric quick deathmatch sessions for up to 6 players, where rival rats battle for dominance on the streets.

4856470.title: SOFIE SCOUT and the Road to Poland
4856470.short_description: Run fast, jump high and support a great cause! Guide Sofie across Europe to reach the World Scout Jamboree in Poland. All profits help real scouts attend the event!

4856650.title: Y2K Coin Pusher
4856650.short_description: Enjoy this 2000's inspired coin pusher game with 13 unlockable levels, each corresponding to their own song and vibe, all in delicious PS2 inspired graphics.

4856670.title: 夏まつり零
4856670.short_description: とある夏の日、二人の少女と村で遊ぶことに 的あて、水鉄砲、虫相撲、輪投げ、金魚すくい、花火… しかし夜になると、突然一人だけいなくなってしまい… いろんな遊び満載の、とある夏の日の出来事

4856710.title: Fjellward
4856710.short_description: Fjellward is a 2D sandbox game set in a procedurally generated world. Gather pixels, find villagers and rebuild your town.

4856820.title: Тоskа-74
4856820.short_description: Toska-74 is a psychedelic, open-world survival-horror game set in a fictional 1974 Siberia. In a moment's notice the sky turned grey - and the chairs rose to the ceiling. The Yankees and Commies have settled. Something will be done, no matter the costs.

4856840.title: .FARM RACING.
4856840.short_description: Welcome to Farm Racing — a muddy off-road tournament where speed is not your choice, it is your problem.

4856850.title: Aéro: speedrun labyrinthe
4856850.short_description: A third-person speedrun puzzle game set in a mysterious sci-fi laboratory. Complete experimental rooms, master your route, improve your best time, follow Aves’ voiced guidance, and search for the 12 hidden bonus eggs.

4856920.title: Domineering Mediator's Forbidden Surrender
4856920.short_description: Axel died unexpectedly and was reborn after being taken over by the consciousness fragments of a photon soul refiner. He developed a forbidden bond with Lena, the guardian of the inheritance, due to the secret clauses in the family charter, and they jointly fought against the FX Group.

4856930.title: Weak Mistress's Disguise
4856930.short_description: Dylan merged with a super digital life form in a subway accident and discovered traces of FX experiments with Tasnim. Sophia came for the inheritance agreement. The two explored the truth in the attic of an old house in Barcelona but were poisoned.

4856960.title: Gorgeous Spy Kneels For Me
4856960.short_description: Traffic analyst Alexander unexpectedly gains the power of the Silicon Dream Weaver and becomes a Slag Newcomer. He discovers the conspiracy behind the data and meets the gorgeous spy Beatrice. The two will fight against the enemies together.

4856990.title: Plantify
4856990.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4856990.short_description: Plantify is a third-person farming game which focuses on a small cat learning how to properly take care of plants.

4857170.title: Monster Smoosh
4857170.short_description: Drop monsters into a jar and smoosh the matching ones together to climb an 11-creature ladder — from humble fuzzball to derpy elder god. A physics-chaos merge game where combos run big, cows are currency, and death is a feature, not a fail-state. Easy to start. Gloriously hard to put down.

4857340.title: Florida Man Court
4857340.short_description: Prosecute. Defend. Bribe. Brawl. Judge. Deliver justice. Climb the bench, crush opposing counsel, and make friends or enemies in procedurally generated Florida Man trials where laughter is inevitable and dignity is nonexistent.

4857510.title: Silent Nightmare: Willow Lane
4857510.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a young woman whose ordinary evening slowly descends into a nightmare. Uncover the truth, make the right choices, and survive the night.

4857540.title: CONTRAL
4857540.short_description: Control two characters simultaneously with your keyboard and mouse! Use your left hand to guide the robot toward the goal while your right hand creates platforms to pave the way forward. Master a unique single-player, dual-control action puzzle experience.

4857620.title: Hentai Puzzle: Cathy
4857620.short_description: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Cathy, a naughty furry cosplayer. Complete challenges, unlock images and scenes, and enjoy playful adult progression in Hentai Puzzle: Cathy.

4857730.title: The Rifted Skies
4857730.short_description: The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover - can your home ever be saved?

4857750.title: Anime-Draft Survivors
4857750.short_description: Anime Draft Survivors is a dark-fantasy anime bullet-heaven roguelike built around one simple twist: every run begins with The Draft. Choose your weapon pool up front, shape your build as you level, and chase the perfect evolution before the Eclipse rises.

4857760.title: GUNBUTCHER
4857760.short_description: Survive an alien invasion in 90 seconds with your loyal Rooster companion! Exterminate your enemies using powerful weapons and collect upgrade cards to boost your character!

4857870.title: Longway Down
4857870.short_description: Longway Down is a high-speed downhill longboarding game built on real physics. Point your board down the hill, let gravity take over, and find out how far you can push speed before the road finds you first.

4857960.title: CHU!! KARATE URANAI VOXEL
4857960.short_description: Karate and fortune-telling become one――KARATE URANAI. When two warriors meet, fate is placed beneath the fist. Face a charging tiger, birds in flight, a floating sage master, and the phantom dragon. Throw an avocado, offer a bow, or perhaps――

4857990.title: Pitchforks & Paragraphs
4857990.short_description: Pitchforks & Paragraphs is an arcade-style medieval typing game where you defend the castle gates from waves of rioting peasants. Type the words on their signs to cast spellballs, stop the advancing mob, build score multipliers through accuracy, survive longer, and climb the global leaderboards.

4858030.title: Infinite Ball Heaven
4858030.short_description: A pinball inspired game set in infinite ball purgatory, where only your score can get you into heaven. Face bosses, create broken synergies, and reach massive heights in the first ever Infinite Ball roguelike.

4858060.title: Stories Best Left Untold
4858060.short_description: Stories Best Left Untold is an anthology of 10 chilling visual novel horror stories, each with its own characters, mysteries, and nightmares. From abandoned houses and forgotten apartments to roads that lead nowhere, every story reveals a new terror waiting in the dark.

4858110.title: Dracula 2
4858110.short_description: Dracula is trapped and you have to help him escape or else he will never escape in this sequel to Bram Stoker's beloved novel.

4858120.title: HiveBreak
4858120.short_description: Hivebreak: a top-down wave shooter where the hive adapts to how you play. Survive solo or in online co-op.

4858190.title: A Game About Shooting Ducks
4858190.short_description: In this incremental game, you shoot ducks and earn money. Use your earnings to buy dogs and traps and hire hunters to help you hunt even more ducks. Progress through levels, battle powerful bosses, and work toward making the entire duck population extinct!

4858320.title: Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants
4858320.short_description: In this First Person Shooter, you are Robin Hood. Steal from the evil, rescue the poor and become a Legend.

4858330.title: Pro Football Legacy
4858330.short_description: Pro Football Legacy is a franchise simulation built around the decisions that define a dynasty — Manage your roster, scout new talent, set your strategy, build your dynasty.

4858490.title: Real backrooms
4858490.short_description: Explore the deepest parts of the Backrooms in an attempt to escape alive, alone or with your friends! Are you ready to face this dangerous world? Or will you accept your fate and die? Choose, or the Backrooms will choose for you!

4858520.title: Overlab
4858520.short_description: Combine atoms to create molecules and fulfill orders to survive as long as possible.

4858550.title: MiniCook
4858550.short_description: MiniCook is a cozy life simulation game about running food stalls, serving customers, earning money, and discovering new ways of living. Experience the charm of city life through cooking, business, and personal growth.

4858620.title: AetherSync
4858620.short_description: A visual novel dating sim about the connections you make, the ones that surprise you, and how far you're willing to go to hold onto them. Swipe. Sync. See where it takes you.

4858720.title: Forsaken Rules
4858720.short_description: A challenging action roguelike with PS1 retro aesthetics where you use a shield as a weapon. Master the combat, make high-risk decisions, and go through three surreal hells in a pact with the Devil that will decide your survival.

4858990.title: Navy Mission
4858990.short_description: Command a single warship and fight off enemy fleets and aircraft from all directions in this 3D naval shooter. Master the main gun, Phalanx, and missiles across 30+ missions at four difficulty levels! An endless survival stage is also included. Feel the tension of naval combat!

4859050.title: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage
4859050.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4859050.short_description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

4859100.title: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定
4859100.short_description: 『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲーム！個性豊かなキャラクターのスキルを駆使し、チンチロの役によって変化する攻撃力を味方につけて勝利を目指そう。知略と豪運が交差するバトルを楽しもう！

4859110.title: Horn Of Africa
4859110.short_description: Horn of Africa is an open-world survival and piracy game set on the coast of East Africa. Start with a small fishing boat, collect containers at sea, raid ships, trade contraband, and build your own pirate operation.

4859230.title: Frogs Aren't Fresh
4859230.short_description: Frogs Aren't Fresh is a cozy, logic puzzle game, where you complete increasingly complex laundry orders! Take your time, and figure out the placement order to make sure everyone gets their clothes the way they like them.

4859360.title: Qwerty's Quickies
4859360.short_description: Want to type longer and harder in the bedroom? Look no further than Qwerty's Quickies! An adult comedy typing survival game. Type to survive as security chases the streaker through aisles of a busy supermarket. See how long you last in Qwerty's Quickies. Including minigames with more coming soon.

4859500.title: Zombie Scavenger
4859500.short_description: "Zombie Scavenger" is a first-person interactive narrative game. Play as K-7, a cleanup robot on a zombie-ravaged, retro-futuristic Earth. Clear the ruins, photograph "habitable" life, and prove humanity can return—until you start to feel human, and the system marks you for deletion.

4859540.title: Word Puzzle Master
4859540.short_description: A cozy word puzzle. Trace neighbouring letters to spell hidden words and clear the grid — calm, unhurried and impossible to lose. Themed packs, daily puzzles, endless and time-attack modes, and three stars to chase on every level.

4859700.title: By My Side
4859700.short_description: Survive the wild with a loyal dog at your side. Wash up with nothing, tame a stray and raise it as your companion — build and power a home, outlast brutal winters, and face a world that fights back.

4859790.title: OUTWORKS
4859790.short_description: Build a towering 3D fortress and hold the line. Stack floors, raise walls, and place turrets by altitude to survive escalating swarms of ground and flying machines closing on your core — then watch one collapsing tower take everything with it. A lean, neon, code-built base-defense roguelite.

4859830.title: Pluck Em!
4859830.short_description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

4860010.title: Medieval Ascendant
4860010.short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

4860070.title: CluDoku
4860070.short_description: A murder mystery blended with sudoku-style logic. Explore suspicious rooms, examine weapon evidence, and piece together clues through sharp deduction to reveal the killer. Play alone or work online with up to 4 detectives to solve the case together.

4860100.title: OxyDungeon
4860100.short_description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

4860390.title: WreckingBall
4860390.short_description: WreckingBall is a physics-based pinball roguelike where one perfect shot is never enough. Fire the ball, manipulate the room, use wild abilities, and build the path forward room by room as the moving goal gets harder to reach.

4860480.title: Breadwalk
4860480.short_description: There is war going on. But you need to buy bread.

4860490.title: Mafia: Night falls
4860490.short_description: A Mafia social deduction game for up to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

4860510.title: Recognition
