4860510.short_description: Recognition is a fast-paced cyberpunk boomer shooter. After waking in a chop shop with your memory wiped, you become the target of the ruthless Kurasawa Corporation. Blast your way through hordes of cyborg assassins and deadly mechs as you search for the truth behind your missing past.

4860620.title: The Darkened Northern Lights
4860620.short_description: A storybook role-playing game for the whole family, inspired by Finnish mythology. Read tales, free enchanted gnomes, gather companions, and play gentle turn-based dice combat. Make choices that matter, tend your garden, and rekindle the darkened northern lights at your own pace.

4860680.title: Deep Rise
4860680.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4860680.short_description: Colony management exploration survival game, climb up out of the deep. The surface world ended a thousand years ago, and we hid underground until it forgot us. Now the road up is finally open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

4860780.title: Marriage in Withdrawal
4860780.short_description: A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

4860790.title: miniBattle
4860790.short_description: miniBattle is an oldskool-inspired, turn-based tactical battler for up to 4 fighters. Lob grenades over hills, read the wind, stalk foes through fog of war, grab airdrops, and capture the flags — solo against bots or online via Steam.

4860880.title: Summer Like a Dream
4860880.short_description: You're spending an unforgettable summer at Hannah's place, surrounded by old friends and new faces. Grow closer to them, explore everything the season offers, and follow where each connection leads. Will you make the most of this summer?

4860970.title: Football Agent
4860970.genre: Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4860970.short_description: You're not the manager, you're the agent. Scout hidden gems across 26,000 players, win them over face to face, build their careers, and sell them for millions. A deep football agency career sim where every contract has your name on it.

4861010.title: RollRift Arena
4861010.short_description: Stop your dice on the higher roll to win each turn — then move, attack, and grab power-ups as the arena collapses ring by ring. Outlast everyone on the last tile. Online ranked PvP, AI battles, local same-keyboard duels, a global leaderboard, and pixel-art character customization.

4861030.title: Father’s Curse
4861030.short_description: A horror game about a son who returns to his haunted family home after a call from his father, only to discover that dark rituals have turned the house into a place filled with spirits, danger, and darkness

4861070.title: Sweep Protocol
4861070.short_description: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

4861080.title: Dice Breakers
4861080.short_description: Dice Breakers is an incremental game where you break dice, earn rewards, unlock upgrades and automate your destruction empire in this addictive clicker with prestige progression.

4861200.title: Pure Nun's Redemption Request
4861200.short_description: Ethan, a food delivery guy, is attacked on a rainy night and merges with the 7th consciousness to become a super digital life form. He searches for the cause of his grandmother's illness and encounters many characters in the clinic and the company. The story unfolds amidst the permeating crisis.

4861230.title: Morhval: Ravenglaire
4861230.short_description: Morhval: Ravenglaire is a dark fantasy text RPG about survival, choice and consequence. Create your character, explore a fractured province, fight turn-based battles, pass skill checks, help the desperate or abandon them, and decide who deserves to survive.

4861480.title: Umbral Adventures
4861480.short_description: A community-driven old-school sandbox MMORPG focused on player freedom, meaningful progression, exploration, crafting, trading, and cooperative adventures in a persistent fantasy world.

4861510.title: Sill Sticks
4861510.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4861510.short_description: A slacker stick figure named "Bota" moves into the window edges of your desktop. He loosely mutters to himself depending on the time of day and day of the week—peek in between tasks and enjoy. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he speaks up. That's all this app is.

4861710.title: Treasure Chest Master
4861710.short_description: Have you ever thought about who collects chests for heroes? No, they don't appear on their own, each of the chests has its own Master! Immerse yourself in the story of the Chest Master, in which your job is to fill chests with loot!

4861750.title: Asteroid Extractors
4861750.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4861750.short_description: Mine, upgrade and survive in deep space. Extract valuable resources from procedurally generated asteroids and turn a tiny operation into a massive extraction.

4861910.title: Pin-Finite
4861910.short_description: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck building pinball game. Buy unique and powerful upgrades to help your run in hopes of reaching infinity...

4862000.title: COLONY 2
4862000.short_description: Investigate a long-abandoned mental asylum and uncover the truth behind a childhood trauma in this first-person psychological survival horror experience filled with mystery, exploration, and unsettling discoveries.

4862010.title: Trying to Wake Up
4862010.short_description: Trying To Wake Up is a 3D platformer focused on storytelling and atmosphere. Journey through a dreamlike world, overcome simple obstacles, and gradually uncover the mysteries behind an emotional and immersive adventure.

4862140.title: Exit Club: Last Night Again
4862140.short_description: A mystery visual novel where you relive the same night in a nightclub, uncover secrets through dialogue, and use knowledge from previous loops to unlock new paths.

4862230.title: Black Lily Inmortal
4862230.short_description: Experience this 2D Top-Down combat game featuring tragic yuri and dark fantasy. Step into the rusty armor of Marliese Haugen as she traverses a bleak, desolate world to reach the one she loves.

4862330.title: Femdom Demons
4862330.short_description: Demonica, a 343 cm tall, bratty, sadistic femdom demon who treats you as her personal fucktoy and plaything, with no regard for you feelings at all. In other words, the perfect demon for a masochist, and luckily for you, she finds you very entertaining.

4862450.title: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina!
4862450.short_description: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina! — a comedic visual novel about a pushy and horny neighbor who's always finding new reasons to knock on your door.

4862710.title: Morvus
4862710.short_description: Your monastery is the last hope for those with nowhere else to go. Supplies are running out. You cannot save everyone. Every day, you decide who to help — and try to save not only their lives, but your own soul.

4862720.title: PAR52
4862720.short_description: A cozy minigolf game where your putters are playing cards. Puzzle out your plays, plan your route and take on a new course every day. Nine holes, fifty-two cards, and endless secrets for you to uncover.

4862740.title: NULL//REBORN
4862740.short_description: Immerse yourselves in the AI meta-world in which your choices affect the outcome of the story in this witty, heartfelt visual novel ! NULL//REBORN is a place where every prompt you answer matters.

4862770.title: Viral Rivalz
4862770.short_description: A hilarious and emotional journey about five friends rising to fame in Los Angeles, trying to balance love, sex, money and morality.

4862890.title: MineEmAll
4862890.short_description: MineEmAll is a short incremental game about mining resources, buying powerful upgrades, and clearing out a constantly growing mineshaft.

4863000.title: Cream City Chaos: Origins
4863000.short_description: An early-development open-world game set around Milwaukee’s East Side in 1994, built from local memory, lost storefronts, weird errands, and neighborhood mythology.

4863030.title: Naomi’s End
4863030.short_description: Naomi wakes decades older in a house she does not recognize, and discovers that escape may cost the future.

4863130.title: TeaKnights
4863130.short_description: TeaKnights is a Y2K-inspired musical rail shooter set across seven tea-powered biodomes. As apprentice Camellia Jetsworth, blast enemies with TeaSetter REGALIAS, build chain combos to drive the dynamic soundtrack, face bosses, aid fellow knights, explore the overworld, and customize your look.

4863630.title: Spellbinders: Fight for the Arcane
4863630.short_description: Spellbinders is a fast-paced airdasher fighting game where each character has a unique set of powerful spells with a huge variety of effects and mechanics.

4863690.title: Until the Fire Dies
4863690.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where daylight is spent chopping trees, splitting logs, and stacking firewood. When night falls, keep the campfire burning and survive the horrors waiting beyond its light.

4864080.title: SSTWL - Sector Breach
4864080.short_description: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.

4864090.title: Nether Meridian
4864090.short_description: Think your FPS skills are good enough? Prove it. Runner × FPS.A challenging fusion of a forward-running game and a first-person shooter.

4864160.title: NECKY
4864160.short_description: Discarded in a toy factory’s junkyard, Head and Body team up to escape. By making up for what the other lacks, they set their sights on a toy shop shelf in the outside world. But BECKY, a perfect doll who never tolerates defective products, is roaming the factory...

4864190.title: The Great Diamond
4864190.short_description: A co-op heist adventure where one player infiltrates the museum and the other guides them from a remote command center. Communicate, solve puzzles, bypass security, and steal priceless treasures together.

4864200.title: Grandpa's Euchre
4864200.short_description: Grandpa's Euchre - Rule #1: NO TABLE TALK!!!!!! This is the card game version of Euchre that my Grandpa taught me. I grew up in Illinois and we played this at every family gathering.

4864280.title: Hollow Orbit
4864280.short_description: Loot a dead generation-ship before the dark wakes up and hunts you by scent. A top-down extraction roguelite of greed and the lights going out: kill for cores, carry the power home, escape the BLACKOUT — or push one deck deeper for richer loot and a worse death.

4864370.title: Deadtale
4864370.short_description: Fight, loot, and survive in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. Explore procedural maps, hunt for powerful weapons, skills and upgrades, face hordes of enemies and terrifying Hunters, and build your own playstyle in this action-packed roguelike FPS.

4864450.title: ΠΟΛΙΣ — Athens
4864450.short_description: Govern classical Athens across 272 unbroken years (594–322 BC). Steer family factions, the favour of the gods, and shifting alliances through 332 historical events — as the tide of history carries your city, inexorably, toward 322 BC.

4864490.title: LOCKOUT
4864490.short_description: Taken from your family and abandoned on a remote island, you must survive the horrors left behind. LOCKOUT is a first-person, story-driven horror game about uncovering a secret corporation’s experiments and finding a way home.

4867180.title: Junkoid
4867180.short_description: "Clear the galaxy in Junkoid! Inspired by arcade classics, take control of your ship and blast through space trash before it crashes. Featuring fast-paced action, smooth controls, and the ultimate challenge: beat your high score. Do you have what it takes? Start the cleanup now!"

4867330.title: Toy Keeper
4867330.short_description: Sort 2,694 toys across a massive three-floor toy store, unlock powerful upgrades, and turn complete chaos into perfect organization in this cozy 3D cleanup game.

4867680.title: The Sinkhole
4867680.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

4868140.title: Gap Storm
4868140.short_description: A shedding card game with one electric twist: every play you beat swings the penalty by the GAP between numbers × your combo. Empty your hand across Classic 2–4 player matches and a 17-fight roguelike Adventure of rule-bending bosses. Play AI offline or online with friends. No pay-to-win, ever.

4868170.title: Alpenbahn
4868170.short_description: Build your own model railroad through stunning Alpine landscapes. Shape the terrain to your will - or find your way through the mountains with majestic bridges, viaducts and tunnels. Select your favorite iconic trains and bring your railroad dreams to life.

4868210.title: Zombie Survival Frontier
4868210.short_description: Fight through zombie infested wastelands, complete dangerous missions, drive vehicles across hostile territories, and survive against powerful zombie's attack in this third person action shooter.

4868360.title: Wind Tiger Cloud Dragon
4868360.short_description: 3D third-person martial arts RPG. Wield two different weapons, use dual resource meters for parry, dodge, counter and special attacks. Preview dungeon gear drops, collect random-stat equipment to build your loadout, experience a foreshadowed story with key choices shifting your journey.

4868400.title: Last Seen
4868400.short_description: Reopen your late father's phone repair shop to survive. But every device holds someone's secrets — and the deeper you dig, the closer you get to the sister who vanished. Repair. Extract. Investigate. The truth has a price, and so does staying clean.

4868590.title: operation
4868590.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4868590.short_description: Operation is a zombie horror action game where players enter a sealed operation zone, fight infected enemies, complete mission objectives, and survive with teammates in a dark and dangerous environment.

4868610.title: Tamespire
4868610.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4868610.short_description: A cozy-dark creature-collection roguelite deckbuilder. Tame Spirelings, fuse their moves into a living deck, and climb a Spire that rebuilds itself every run. Evolve your team, master five clashing elements, and push your luck through endless Ascensions.

4868620.title: TROM: Twin Bot Challenge
4868620.short_description: A challenging retro puzzle game where you control two robots at the same time using the same inputs. Solve complex mazes, avoid traps, and test your coordination in this unique split-control experience inspired by classic arcade games.

4868780.title: KungFu Dragon(泸龙)
4868780.short_description: This is an open-world action game featuring a martial arts level progression system. Players can engage in unarmed combat or wield a wide variety of cold weapons for melee fights. Unique button combinations unleash distinct combo chains.

4868940.title: Londoleon: not a single penny
4868940.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4868940.short_description: Many people dream of visiting London, but few ever stop to think about what would happen if they lost all their money in a foreign country. Unfortunately, Max's friend not only finds himself without any cash, but also discovers that it has been replaced with counterfeit banknotes.

4868950.title: The Procedural Maze
4868950.short_description: The Procedural Maze is a replay-able game where every run features a newly generated maze. The walls of the maze shift, opening up new passageways while closing others. Dangerous monsters roam the maze while a shop at the centre allows you to buy the best gear to help you escape the maze.

4869550.title: AquaDucked!
4869550.short_description: Launch a rubber duck from a cannon, bend its flight with hoses, trampolines, slides, and fans, and splash your way home. A hand-painted physics puzzler with 270+ levels, a built-in level editor, and a community pond full of player-made challenges.

4869560.title: Terminal Falls
4869560.short_description: Tense top-down extraction shooter. Build your gear, loot, fight until your last HP & discover mystery of a town devastated by a war that never was. Your chance for survival is low, but never zero...

4869840.title: Cryptid Contingent
4869840.short_description: To unravel the secrets of the forest, you'll need to carefully manage your resources and devise clever builds in this challenging action rogue-like inspired by your favorite MOBAs!

4870100.title: One Neck Ahead
4870100.short_description: A charming retro platformer where you create your own platforms and combine them with other mechanics in surprising ways.

4870150.title: Hentai Clicker: Moena is streaming
4870150.short_description: Click, collect hearts, upgrade, and unlock scenes and outfits with Moena, a cheeky Hawaiian streamer, in Hentai clicker: Moena is streaming.

4870180.title: Cytokine Storm
4870180.short_description: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

4834740.title: Amanda's Magic Book 7: The Way of Belaii
4834740.short_description: Amanda's new Match-3 adventure might just be her most extraordinary yet! Amanda, her uncle, and Charlie are drawn into the world of an ancient manuscript and to the world of the Belaii. Can Amanda and her friends help the Belaii people turn their fate around?

4835190.title: DARKLING
4835190.short_description: DARKLING is a bite-sized first-person horror game. Locked inside a haunted house, use your wits to get out.

4835690.title: Neno Havoc
4835690.short_description: Fight through neon-drenched survival arenas as a cyber cat-eared gunslinger, stacking weapons, upgrades, and chaotic builds against overwhelming enemy swarms.

4835830.title: Taillights
4835830.short_description: Join your friends on a physics-based co-op survival road trip! Build, repair, and barely hold together your car as you race into the unknown. Survive the wilderness, uncover strange mysteries, and compete with other teams on a brand-new daily map packed with secrets and shenanigans.

4835850.title: Pixi Shards
4835850.short_description: 《Pixi Shards》 is a single-player casual game testing your handling skills and focus. Players steer a sphere with the keyboard through winding tracks to reach the finish. Every stage is lined with gorgeous visual distractions along the route, making success anything but simple.

4835870.title: Table Of Truth
4835870.short_description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

4836000.title: 30 Days: The Last Melody
4836000.short_description: 30 Days: The Last Melody invites you into the journey of a young man living out his final 30 days. Experience a warm and emotional journey brought to life through beautiful hand-painted visuals, soothing music, and engaging mini-games as you reflect on love, hope, and the value of every moment.

4836030.title: Brick Busters
4836030.short_description: An old-school arcade action game where you defend your base, survive waves of enemies, upgrade your tank, and fight bosses every 4th wave. Features roguelike progression, local 2-player co-op, varied maps, and 20+ abilities.

4836080.title: Road Tycoon
4836080.genre: Indie, Racing, Strategy, Free To Play
4836080.short_description: Road Tycoon is an idle incremental racing game with custom-built tracks, prestige layers, and vehicle ascensions. Build the perfect track, let your cars race, and push your numbers into infinity.

4836100.title: Time Dilation Lab
4836100.short_description: An easy to use, fully adjustable space lab with Einstein's special relativity equations in a three-spacecraft configuration. Play around with time dilation and relativistic Doppler effects in space at your own pace. Multiple viewpoints in 3D, real-time, with exportable data functions.

4836160.title: BoxBox
4836160.short_description: Deploy UNIT-WR-7821! You as Input Manager, train its AI to conquer complex physics-based obstacles and become a successful warehouse laborer. Navigate grueling trials and solve dynamic environmental puzzles to prove your test subject's worth. The future of automated labor is in your hands!

4836280.title: Infernal Gate
4836280.short_description: Dive into Infernal Gate and its engaging Story Mode, driven by a rich dialogue system. Annihilate enemies using a highly complex system of ranged, melee, and throwable weapons. Master your loadout with a deep inventory system to adapt and survive every brutal encounter.

4836420.title: Martial Soul Arena
4836420.short_description: 3D top-down action roguelite featuring randomized skill and equipment builds. Craft your unique combat style and enjoy satisfying, stress-free fights against massive swarms of monsters!

4836470.title: Wrathflame
4836470.short_description: Wrathflame is a 2D top down real-time bullet hell shooter featuring retro Pico8 pixel graphics and chiptunes.  You are a sorcerer-monk of the order of Wrathflame battling the machinations of the heretical Wyvern cult.  Completing each level gives you the opportunity to level up one of four spells.

4836490.title: Moonrise
4836490.short_description: Moonrise is a third-person 3D puzzle-adventrure, where open-path level design and visuals take centre stage, demanding a different reading of the space at every turn.

4836540.title: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
4836540.short_description: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand delivers a standalone roguelite wave-defense experience for solo and cooperative play. Command and survive against fast-paced escalating enemy waves, intimidating bosses, and dynamic battlefield events. Are you ready to make your final stand?

4838060.title: ZodiacLottery
4838060.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

4838130.title: Edge of the Blade
4838130.short_description: Edge of the Blade is a roguelite grand-strategy autobattler where you choose one of three factions and fight over the ruined land of Cheonggu. Set weekly war objectives, capture strongholds, deploy your army, and shape the flow of battle through your choices.

4838470.title: My (♂) Life as a Vampire's Maid (♀)
4838470.short_description: In this suspenseful fantasy visual novel, play as a young man stranded in snowy mountains. Guided by unseen forces, you enter an isolated mansion. As a peculiar daily life unfolds, you live alongside two vampire girls. Immerse yourself in this profound, dreamlike dark fairy tale.

4838510.title: Perfect Shot: Light On
4838510.short_description: A casual FPS game. No movement needed — just aim and shoot at light boxes to light them up. But watch out: your gun's energy rises with each shot. Too much energy and the box breaks. Switch targets wisely to match your energy level, and light them all!

4838600.title: Sugar Rot
4838600.short_description: Fight your way through the abandoned Sweetwater Candy Factory, in this story-driven horror shooter inspired by BioShock, SOMA, and Silent Hill. Survive grotesque candy-fused creatures, and uncover the truth behind a miracle cure that promised to eliminate human suffering before the Rot consumes you.

4838690.title: Chill Cat
4838690.short_description: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

4839390.title: Muse Dash 2
4839390.short_description: Continue the classic gameplay of parkour rhythm games, while adding new rhythm gameplay and multiplayer online mode. Welcome everyone to enjoy a wonderful musical journey in "Muse Dash 2"!

4839790.title: LeadFall
4839790.short_description: LeadFall is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike where you survive chaotic waves of food-themed enemies, collect powerful card upgrades, and create broken weapon builds in short, replayable runs.

4840350.title: 東方天流宮 ~ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds
4840350.short_description: A mysterious midsummer downpour has caused Gensokyo's lakes and rivers to spill over. Not only that, but youkai and phantoms inhabiting those bodies of water have become unnaturally ferocious. Venture off on an adventure into the deep skies to find the cause of this classic rain-themed incident.

4840470.title: Crypt Club
4840470.short_description: Explore a sprawling cave network with your friends in search of fun occult loot for the Crypt Club! Find fun-to-use items, torn pages of a tome, and even a monster lurking within the depths.

4840680.title: Maze Survivor
4840680.short_description: Maze Survivor is a survival game set in a procedural maze teeming with monsters. Explore, gather resources, craft items, and upgrade your attributes to escape alive.

4840740.title: DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition)
4840740.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4840740.short_description: Experience the ultimate re-imagining of the classic DVD screensaver game. With updated next gen visuals, modernized gameplay, and a reimagined storyline. The wait is finally over. For a new generation.

4840790.title: AMIMI
4840790.short_description: A child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world where every corner hides a surprise. Meet curious characters, experiment with inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

4840960.title: 3 Switch Problem
4840960.short_description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

4841000.title: 蝶々反乱
4841000.short_description: Butterfly Rebellion Launch butterfly horns to reclaim nature and raise your Greening Rate! Restore as much territory as possible within 180 seconds while fighting back against environmental destruction.

4842230.title: The Walk of Karl
4842230.short_description: A story-driven rage platformer about Karl, a cat on wheels, stranded on a planet that isn't his own. Explore Meowdor across 8 chapters and find out what happened to his missing friend, Larl.

4842400.title: Project Super
4842400.short_description: Fly across the city, stop crimes, rescue civilians, and climb the hero rankings. Just try not to cause more damage than the villains.

4842440.title: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild-
4842440.short_description: Team up with your friends, pool your wisdom, and take on the Demon King with the ultimate deck. Gamashira Guild is a cooperative deck-building roguelike where discussing strategies with friends is the key to victory. Let’s all team up and take down the Demon King!

4842500.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
4842500.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

4843040.title: Vivi
4843040.short_description: Vivi is a desktop companion girl longing to be human. Unobtrusive company, auto-dances to PC sounds, supports feeding. Raise intimacy & obedience for 9 relationship states. Full voice acting, collect human traits and share photos on Steam Workshop.

4843190.title: Know Lychees / 来高州识荔枝
4843190.short_description: A solo-developed, lightweight puzzle game themed around Gaozhou lychees. Learn lychee varieties and Gaozhou culture through three modes: Eat Lychees, Know Lychees, and Find Lychees.

4843300.title: Dense Forest
4843300.short_description: This first-person psychological horror game lets you play a jobless man taking a high-pay remote mountain ranger post. Inspect facilities, log odd events, sort old records, unlock woods, evade weird entities, and uncover the missing ex-ranger’s truth.

4843320.title: HALOCLINE
4843320.short_description: Descend into a drowned world of shipwrecks, forgotten ruins, and abyssal horrors in this deep-sea horror Soulslike. Explore the depths, battle monstrous creatures, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the waves.

4843370.title: Hentai Milf Resort
4843370.short_description: Hentai Milf Resort - This place is all inclusive! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4843380.title: Hentai MILF Premium
4843380.short_description: Hentai MILF Premium - Oops, I'm in the wrong room. Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures and videos. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4843440.title: Curious Paws: hidden objects
4843440.short_description: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects is a short, cozy hidden object game where you explore vibrant, hand-drawn locations through the eyes of a curious cat. Search for objects that could catch his attention, and enjoy a lively environment, relaxing music, and an atmosphere of slow-paced exploration.

4843450.title: Rinora's Silvercoin Garden
4843450.short_description: Rinora's Silvercoin Garden is a casual idle fantasy coin pusher game. Choose relaxed idle mode or light roguelite mode, trigger chain rewards, collect treasures, and enjoy the Silvercoin Garden at your own pace.

4843460.title: Aethyr Idle
4843460.short_description: An idle RPG with the build depth of an MMO. Pick one of four classes, climb a talent tree into one of twelve specializations, and write the spell rotation your hero fights with. 4843580.short_description: One curious octopus. One underwater research centre. The long way home. A short 3D point-and-click adventure about a small escape - played with all eight hands.

4855880.short_description: After Master left, you tend the pill room alone. Visitors bring illnesses, lies, and secrets. As an alchemy apprentice, your only support is the Compendium of Herbal Roots left by Master. With each diagnosis, you discern not just the sickness but the truth drawing closer.

4856460.title: 记忆收藏家 · The Memory Mender
4856460.short_description: A narrative healing game. You run the Hall of Gathering Light — an old house between reality and forgetting. People come carrying memories they can't let go of. You help them repair broken memories. No fail states — your choices shape the ending. Every memory is worth keeping.

4856490.title: Proper Football Boss
4856490.short_description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

4856500.title: The Farm of the Living
4856500.short_description: A grim, choice-driven interactive gamebook. As the First Ranger of a fortified homestead, you must defend the last survivors from the infected, manage critical resources, and investigate a dangerous internal conspiracy. Every decision shapes the survival of the living.

4856640.title: Matcharya
4856640.short_description: A memory combat rogue-like where every match matters. Flip cards, form pairs, trigger attacks, buy time with in-fight items, and survive enemies that move, lock, and trap your board.

4857190.title: Shining Shattering Sky ~ Reverie of Breaking Unreality
4857190.short_description: What’s going on in Tomohiro Uchida and Hikari Aogami’s dreams?

4857240.title: 星のなっちゃんW (Hoshi_no_Natchan_W)
4857240.short_description: This is a 2D platform action game where you dash, jump, and attack your way through the stages.

4857380.title: Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales 2
4857380.short_description: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

4857460.title: Handoff Required
4857460.short_description: A horror game with no monster. You operate an AI session console where every system reports HEALTHY - except your own authority. The AI never rebels. It confirms. It records. It files a handoff. And the file it opens is about you.

4857490.title: PlankTap
4857490.short_description: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.

4857550.title: Who's Calling?
4857550.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. Lock the doors, call the police, and try to survive the final game of hide-and-seek with the stalker.

4857790.title: Flemenco
4857790.short_description: A spy-heist traditional roguelike! Become a criminal and interfere in the nefarious dealings of the ubiquitous Flemenco Corporation. Break into data centers to expose illicit records, infiltrate office buildings, perform elaborate acrobatic feats, and much more!

4857810.title: The Dreamthief
4857810.short_description: Bjørn watches a mysterious figure steal his parents’ dreams and follows it into a world consumed by nightmares. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and open rifts between dream and nightmare in a Ghibli-inspired isometric action-adventure about facing childhood fears.

4857920.title: Fembot Vending Machine
4857920.short_description: An idle management game where you assign beautiful robot girls to work and earn gold! Upgrade your facility, research new technologies, and use the vending machine to gacha for rare internal and external parts. Customize their statistics for maximum work efficiency, and unwind in the bedroom.

4858100.title: TexanLand
4858100.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4858100.short_description: Pick a side. Or burn it down anyway. TexanLand is an open world zombie survival game with four factions, dismemberment-heavy combat, and total freedom to play the villain, the hero, or whatever's funniest.

4858300.title: FEMBOY FURRY FUTA FOREST FFFF
4858300.short_description: Find all the pictures and escape the forest before furry finds you!

4858410.title: Story of Nova
4858410.short_description: Begin your journey aboard Nova Station, explore the desert world of Alkadir, gather resources, craft items, trade, fight, and shape your future among the stars.

4858420.title: Tutor's Gentle Trap
4858420.short_description: At the age of 22, Thomas was killed with hatred after his stepmother and aunt conspired to seize his inheritance. However, he was reborn as a super digital life form. He recalled his past with his tutor, Elena, from innocence to madness three years ago...

4858470.title: Run of the Nine
4858470.short_description: A serene but tense Sudoku roguelike. Draft powerful relics, unlock unique character classes, and solve evolving grids under strict HP constraints as you journey through stylized Japanese gardens. Blends meditative puzzle-solving with high-stakes, risk-reward roguelike strategy.

4858700.title: FLOWORKS
4858700.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4858700.short_description: A node-graph automation × idle factory builder. Materials flow along the wires you draw and transform at each machine. Fix bottlenecks, optimize your layout, grow a trade empire, and rise to rule the robotics industry. Zero art assets — every visual and sound is generated in code.

4858790.title: The Veiled Atlas: A Cycle of Falls
4858790.short_description: A turn-based 4X of rival governments contesting the dim Atlas through economy, war and an Influence-weighted Council. At the edge of sensor range, the Shadow does not lose - it only rises.

4858820.title: Mythic Battle
4858820.short_description: Build your best hand in this mythology-themed auto-battler! Pick from Greek, Norse and Chinese cards and further customize your board when you upgrade your shop or combine like cards. One player comes out victorious in an 8 player free-for-all!

4858900.title: MAMIO : Don't Fall !
4858900.short_description: MAMIO is a 2–4 player online co-op platformer where one mistake resets the entire team. Collect fart orbs, master your double jump, and survive chaotic obstacle courses together.

4859030.title: Doesn't this tunnel go on forever?
4859030.short_description: You are trapped in a tunnel that goes on forever. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach the exit. A simple walking simulator where you choose to move forward or turn back based on whether you spot any anomalies.

4859040.title: I CAN'T STOP WINNING!
4859040.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4859040.short_description: A 2D blackjack inspired rogue-lite game for addicts and winners

4859060.title: Neon Carnage
4859060.short_description: Outrun the law. Destroy everything. Survive an escalating cyberpunk manhunt in this explosive vehicular roguelike.

4859080.title: Fantasy For You
4859080.short_description: The classic fantasy MMORPG Fantasy For You (F4U / Fantasy4U / 英雄) returns. Launched in Korea in 1999, expanded to Taiwan. Build your hero across 3 races and 20 bloodlines, face unpredictable combat with random skills. No healing potions — a hydration system and the field-dominating Barak War.

4859180.title: cutichoria
4859180.short_description: This is a mystery puzzle game that blends traditional Chinese fairy tales with surrealism. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium!

4859250.title: Realmwardens
4859250.short_description: Realmwardens is a turn-based strategy game set in a Xianxia (fantasy cultivation) world, featuring a "scavenge-fight-extract" loop. You must scour mystical realms for treasures and build up a powerful arsenal of magical artifacts; once you have grown in strength, you will drive out the demons.

4859570.title: Bolita
4859570.short_description: Bolita is a skill-based video game where the only thing that matters is avoiding the walls. Survive as long as possible and get the highest score!

4860090.title: Even
4860090.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy, Free To Play
4860090.short_description: Even is a clicker game where you click on a square. Every 4 hours, you receive a random item. Keep clicking, collect items, and enjoy the experience. Every 4 hours, you receive an item directly into your Steam inventory. Click on the black square and expand your collection of Steam items.

4860220.title: Evidence Officer
4860220.short_description: A mystery adventure game where you investigate 3D evidence and uncover the truth behind each case through the clues left behind.

4860400.title: Please, Tell Me Why?
4860400.short_description: A psychological horror game about a young streamer: go live, control the lights, and manage stress as the demands from viewers wear down her will. Explore her apartment, uncover her past, and find the answer to “Please, Tell Me Why?” before the question decides her fate.

4860440.title: Pt.PUYUYU
4860440.short_description: A puzzle roguelike where you learn through death! How will you overcome the unfair challenges thrown at you by "Pt.PUYUYU"? And don't forget to keep a notepad handy!

4860520.title: Night Noodles
4860520.short_description: Run a small late-night noodle shop. Take orders, cook noodles, prepare toppings, and serve strange customers as your quiet shift slowly becomes more unsettling.

4860830.title: Viral Infection
4860830.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in an abandoned hospital. Explore dark corridors, face unpredictable jump scares, and uncover the origin of a deadly infection—before you become its next victim.

4860990.title: Desire On Tap
4860990.short_description: Desire on Tap combines mixology and passionate romance. Prepare your inventory for the busy day shift through a variety of challenging minigames. Then put your mixology skills to the test during the night shift, where generous clients are ready to tip big.

4861100.title: O2
4861100.short_description: A short deep-sea horror game where you explore a dark and mysterious ocean, photograph strange discoveries, and uncover what lurks beneath the depths.

4861620.title: Jigsaw Diorama: The Alchemist and the Eclipse
4861620.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle journey through a fantastical world of alchemy and astronomy.

4861650.title: FrontierCraft
4861650.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Early Access
4861650.short_description: A persistent multiplayer world where players gather the resources needed to keep the Tree of Life alive. Explore an endless frontier, build settlements, trade, fight, and see how long your world can survive before the inevitable reset.

4861700.title: Special Delivery
4861700.short_description: Earn your badge as a Freight Dog in the Animal Enlightenment Age world of Sarrow. Trust is currency — and you carry it in every letter, package, and secret whispered between man and beast. Explore at your own pace, forge your own path, and let every delivery tell its own story.

4861790.title: Check-In Anomaly
4861790.short_description: You work the night shift at a hotel. Survive your shift, detect anomalies, patrol the hallways, and unravel the hidden mysteries that await each night.

4862080.title: Seedverse
4862080.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4862080.short_description: Seedverse is a free-to-play Sandbox Platformer MMO with a protected, player-driven economy. Splice seeds to discover new items, trade your way to the top, display your wealth with rare accessories, and build a world you can show off to others!

4862210.title: Spearfish
4862210.short_description: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.

4862400.title: Sim: World Cup Manager
4862400.short_description: Take charge of your nation from a world of 202 teams and chase international glory. Build your squad, master deep tactics and live sideline shouts, unearth wonderkids in your national youth academy, and battle through the World Cup and Continental Championships in a deep football management sim.

4862560.title: Sewer Side
4862560.short_description: What should have been a simple generator reset job turns into a fight for survival after countless entities begin hunting you through a seemingly endless sewer system. Stay alive and find a way out of the sewer side.

4862570.title: Green Suits
4862570.short_description: Lead a squad of agents and psychics in a drama-based JRPG against an extra-dimensional cult as you explore surreal architecture and investigate paranormal crimes. Master turn-based combat where emotional states and hidden enemy intentions demand constant adaptation.

4862690.title: Slim Flamingo Vs The 1%
4862690.short_description: Platform infinity in a loop while shooting inwards at the boss in the center! With one health and only bosses inspired by the greatest boss fights for the 2000s, every moment is on edge, electric, do or die action!

4862840.title: IRON CARROT
4862840.short_description: IRON CARROT is a fast-paced third-person shooter with cute and gory visuals. The wolves took your country. Take it back.

4862910.title: O.M.E.N. | Synthetic Genesis
4862910.short_description: A top-down survival horror game where genetic experiments escape containment. Run, hide, solve mazes to prove you are human, collect keycards, uncover the truth behind a corporation favoring profits over ethical experimentation, and discover why O.M.E.N. is making mysterious use of his new powers.

4862920.title: Chessferatu
4862920.short_description: Chessferatu is a chess opening training game where you study, battle, and improve by playing real opening lines against themed opponents, then keep fighting when theory ends with live move evaluation and engine refutations.

4862960.title: The Kidnapped Brother
4862960.short_description: Embark on a classic 2D platforming adventure filled with enemies, traps, and challenging obstacles. Collect coins, purchase useful items, explore diverse environments, and test your skills as you journey to rescue your kidnapped brother.

4863140.title: Sushi Restaurant Simulator
4863140.short_description: Manage your own sushi restaurant, cook Japanese specialties, serve customers, manage inventory, hire staff, upgrade your equipment, and build the sushi restaurant of your dreams.

4863430.title: Hills Cry
4863430.short_description: 泥と血にまみれたジャングルで速やかな脱出を目指す、サイコロジカルホラー・ローグライト。

4863520.title: Urban Rangers Arcade 2
4863520.short_description: This Is The Conclusion To The Great "Urban Rangers Arcade" - The Rangers, Thought They Had BoJaNgLeS Taken Down.............. But The Nightmare Had Only Began...... Bo Is Back, And Hes Calling The Rangers By Name. You Got His Attention...... Finish The Fight.

4863560.title: Patch and Pray
4863560.short_description: Patch and Pray is chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op about flying a falling-apart space station home. Charge cells, weld solar panels and bolt them on during frantic EVAs to feed a hungry engine — all while patching hull breaches, fires and power shorts before the timer runs out.

4864000.title: Terraforming Titans
4864000.short_description: Terraforming Titans is an incremental colony builder with a moderate focus on realism and scale. Terraform increasingly challenging and large worlds and guide humanity to complete control over the Milky Way.

4864210.title: The Unseeing
4864210.short_description: A psychological horror game where your eyes become part of the gameplay. Close your eyes, look away, and uncover the truth of your lost love Annu in a dimension made by devil.

4864290.title: 同城游美女捕鱼
4864290.short_description: Beauty Fishing is a casual fishing game with immersive deep-sea scenes, various fish and sea bosses. Tap to fire cannons, hit overlords for full-screen coin bursts. Unlock beautiful heroines, unique fisheries and fish collections. Daily check-ins and princess events give free coins.
developers: 浙江畅唐网络股份有限公司
publishers: 浙江畅唐网络股份有限公司

4864390.title: Good Morning [Employee Name] VR
4864390.short_description: You're the newest hire at Consolidated Dynamics, and your job is to help train the next generation of the workforce. Twelve days of tasks, tapes, and half-heard conversations. The longer you stay, the more you'll wish you'd asked more questions on day one.

4864400.title: Halls of Jötunn
4864400.short_description: Halls of Jötunn is a first-person atmospheric dungeon crawler set in a forgotten Norse world after Ragnarök. Explore ancient ruins, survive brutal tactical combat, uncover lost True Names, and fight your way home to the family waiting beyond death.

4864430.title: Shine on Savior
4864430.short_description: Shine On Savior is an action platformer that takes you through the city of New Delmarr and kill hundreds of dregs. Anything in this city can be used as a weapon. A ritual has been set in New Delmarr in which all of the humans and dregs resurrect upon death.

4864510.title: ELE
4864510.genre: Indie, Racing, Strategy, Free To Play
4864510.short_description: ELE is a fast-paced multiplayer party shooter with elemental counters. Players capture key fragments in random maps, synthesize keys, and evacuate to win. Allocate attribute points to adapt your build against players or monsters. Various items on the battlefield add unpredictability

4864530.title: SEX CLUB
4864530.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports
4864530.short_description: SEX CLUB - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4864540.title: HOT HOLES
4864540.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4864540.short_description: HOT HOLES - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4864560.title: SCRIBBLE HUNT
4864560.short_description: Paint your pure-white bunny man and blend into the scene like a chameleon! Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials—hide as a toy, a tile, a pool of water. 2–10 player online hide-and-seek: don't get caught by the Seekers. Boing!

4864580.title: TideFall
4864580.short_description: The coast has drowned and the tide keeps rising. Mine, fight and craft your way up a flooding world, relight the lighthouses, and choose at every beacon — extract with what you carry, or hold the light and gamble it all for the sea's richest salvage.

4864590.title: 螺丝钉 Screw
4864590.short_description: Sci-Fi x Lesbian x Visual Novel! "螺丝钉 Screw" is a sci-fi lesbian visual novel. You will play as a company intern who is about to undergo a probationary period review, and decide your own future within a short week.

4864650.title: High Typer
4864650.short_description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

4864730.title: OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery
4864730.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4864730.short_description: Stack your cart to the absolute limit and conquer a massive high-rise apartment! OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery is a chaotic physics-based delivery simulator. Balance fragile packages like Tetris, beat the unforgiving clock, and avoid corporate fines. Survive the daily grind solo or in co-op!

4864750.title: Ultimate Guess Game
4864750.short_description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

4864760.title: School Runner
4864760.short_description: 学生制作の３Dパルクールランニングゲーム！ 障害物を駆け抜けてスピードを上げ、最速でゴールへたどり着け！

4864850.title: memu is space cat
4864850.short_description: The space cat memu just drifts through a weird, neon-soaked universe. No goals — just zone out to the dizzying sights and sounds. Steer if you feel like it: pull up to a planet, snap a photo, grab a cat can. Bookmark a universe you like. Every day, the whole universe is something else.

4864960.title: MAUS TRAP
4864960.short_description: Catch mice. Destroy nests. Loaf. A cozy-meets-chaos adventure platformer about a small cat with a big job and zero stress.

4865010.title: Cold Beauty Boss's Exclusive Punishment List
4865010.short_description: After the explosion in the studio, Alexei was reborn as a super digital life form. He signed a contract with the cold and beautiful boss, Ksenia, and met Tatyana. However, they were monitored by FX, and an adventure began.

4865030.title: Tiantang Beach in Fangchenggang
4865030.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4865210.title: Egg-cremental
4865210.short_description: Chickens lay, eggs fall, profits multiply! In this addictive first-person incremental tycoon game, toss eggs into a mysterious, bottomless pit to earn cold hard cash. Spend your riches to unlock an expansive tech tree, upgrade your poultry production, and build your ultimate egg empire!

4865360.title: Novalex Project Zero
4865360.short_description: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

4865370.title: Odyssey Bridge Quest
4865370.short_description: Take the captain's chair of the starship Odyssey. Assign specialized officers, manage vital ship systems, and navigate critical moral dilemmas in this text-based, choice-driven sci-fi command simulator. Will you uphold coalition protocols, or risk everything for survival?

4865380.title: Monster Cruncher
4865380.short_description: Monster Cruncher is a thrilling incremental game: evade the Big-Headed Guard, slay monsters, crush collected materials, and unlock permanent upgrades through a vast talent tree and meta‑upgrades.

4865400.title: Out Of Sync
4865400.short_description: Keil, a junior employee at Vanta Inc., has been searching for his missing friend Marcus. As he finds a note in Marcus's handwriting, Keil steps into a parallel world, only to face an unforgettable reality at the final door.

4865530.title: Yora Emerald
4865530.short_description: Yora Emerald is a mature 2.5D sci-fi action-platformer and Metroidvania. Switch instantly between an agile unarmored form and heavy combat armor to battle through a clandestine facility. Master methodical combat and navigate hazardous biomes to rescue your sister-clone.

4865570.title: Ocean Threshold
4865570.short_description: A mythic journey through a fractured psyche: explore trauma, transformation, and rebirth inside a living labyrinth shaped by memory and emotion.

4865590.title: SKINSHIFT TOGETHER
4865590.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG
4865590.short_description: SKINSHIFT is a goofy game of hide-and-seek about mimicry, where you repaint yourself to match the wall and act like you were never even here. Grab a group of 2 to 15 players, blend into the wallpaper — and freeze. Hid yourself just right? Nice. Elbow sticking out? Gotcha!

4865600.title: House of Tides
4865600.short_description: Follow an anomalous signal into a forgotten theatre beneath a drowned world, and descend through a shifting labyrinth of memories, imagined lives, and fractured identities in this first-person psychological sci-fi horror game about grief, guilt, and obsession.

4865680.title: Iliad
4865680.short_description: Iliad is an adventure Metroidvania that borrows new powers and area unlocks from it's retro origins and weave classic map design mechanic in the gameplay. Travel through two worlds tightly linked together each growing as you discover new secrets and defeat bosses towards one of the two endings.

4865700.title: 迷途猫StrayCat
4865700.short_description: Stray Cat is a platform jumping game featuring exquisitely polished control feel, stylized pixel art and a lighthearted, cheerful narrative. The game is relatively accessible in terms of difficulty, yet it also offers a more challenging gameplay mode.

4865840.title: Football Academy Director
4865840.short_description: Take charge of a football academy, from U11 prospects to the U19 academy team. Scout and recruit young talent, choose youth camps and training camps, shape squads and tactics, climb the Youth League pyramid, and chase league title and World Youth Cup glory.

4865860.title: Manual Override
4865860.short_description: Eleven days before the IPO, the autonomous factory you sold to your dying hometown kills a worker — on a safety stop you signed off to inhibit. A mature, choice-driven corporate thriller about guilt, cover-up, and the three women who each know a different piece of the truth.

4865900.title: WayBackers
4865900.short_description: WayBackers is a 2D puzzle game built on the core mechanics of Minesweeper. Control your character to navigate through blocks filled with hidden mines. Use your Minesweeper logic and instincts to forge ahead without stepping on a single one!

4865930.title: MineCash
4865930.short_description: MineCash is a simple incremental game about mining cash.

4865940.title: Stash Grabber
4865940.short_description: You're a thief who starts where everyone else wants to finish: inside the vault. Grab the cash and escape the entire building — vaulting counters, riding updrafts, dodging lasers and cameras. A physics-based heist platformer across 72 escalating breakouts. Find the clean line, or the fast one.

4866000.title: Ore Bastards
4866000.short_description: Explore an endless procedural universe. Mine asteroids, trade across living stations, fight cunning pirates, discover countless ships and items, and build your own space stations in a galaxy that never stops creating new stories.

4866020.title: Sokobomb
4866020.short_description: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

4866170.title: Disaster Scenario
4866170.short_description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

4866210.title: Pappo
4866210.short_description: Pappo is an engaging 3D platformer inspired by PS1 classics. Explore fantastic worlds, collect all the minerals and save Pappo's family!

4866230.title: JokerJack
4866230.short_description: JokerJack is a blackjack based rouge-like deckbuilder.

4866250.title: American Dream
4866250.short_description: Start with a rundown duplex and build a real portfolio across America. Buy and finance properties, hire agencies to run your holdings, expand into hotels and businesses, and grow your wealth one disciplined decision at a time.

4866270.title: Papairy
4866270.short_description: Papairy is a casual clicker game where you try to keep your paper plane in the air and avoid incoming clouds. Inspired by the mobile game Flappy Bird and uses the same standard mobile portrait format or 9:16 aspect ratio.

4866340.title: Pistols at Dawn
4866340.short_description: This unique tactical turn-based pistol dueling game makes you balance your aim by placing numbered tokens around a circle. Don't just focus on your own crosshairs, you'll be just as dead if your enemy hits their mark! Shoot your way through a dramatic story that would cause Jane Austen to swoon.

4866420.title: ゲイトトゥダイ
4866420.short_description: 古き良きレトロスタイルのアートで綴られる"ゲイトライク"サバイバルクラフトアドベンチャー！！　突如、謎の屋敷に転送された「わたし」の運命は！？　危険な闇の中を探索し、素材を見つけ、アイテムを創造し、生還せよ―― 「ゲイトトゥダイ」はクラフト要素を含む、ポイント＆クリック方式の探索アドベンチャーゲームです。6つのコマンドと多種多様なアイテムを駆使し、恐怖に満ちた屋敷と城を探索しましょう。
developers: 秘密結社マテンロウ計画
publishers: 秘密結社マテンロウ計画

4866490.title: Into The Lumberwoods
4866490.short_description: Into the Lumberwoods is a stylized top-down roguelite shooter set in a cryptic Pacific Northwest forest. Hunt aberrations as a fledgling Mothman, scavenge unique guns, and use a mysterious journal inside your forest shack to mutate your anatomy. Uncover the secrets of the Lumberwoods.

4866510.title: Purrfect Beats
4866510.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

4866520.title: Finish The Dishes!
4866520.short_description: Finish The Dishes! is a fast-paced arcade shooter set on a chaotic kitchen countertop. Blast pests, exploit their weaknesses, upgrade your arsenal, and chase perfect five-star runs.

4866600.title: FlatPackers
4866600.short_description: CHAOTIC CO-OP BUILDING - Mistakes will be Made! Build flatpack furniture alone or with friends from simply a picture of the final piece so you must work out how everything fits together, which tools to use and with no object snapping, players need skill and practice to perfect their building skills.

4866610.title: A Cube's Choice
4866610.short_description: A Cube’s Choice is a 3D platformer where you bob, weave, and use movement abilities to reach the end before the music stops. Explore abstract, song-shaped worlds and face the Wall through soft, symbolic storytelling.

4866620.title: Transhumance
4866620.short_description: With the help of your trusty dragonfly, gather and guide your herd through many landscapes, avoiding dangers and crossing obstacles to reach the summer pastures...

4866650.title: Beaver Arena
4866650.short_description: A fast-paced arena survival game where beavers battle endless waves of enemies. Fight, dodge, collect upgrades, unlock new abilities, and survive as long as possible in chaotic action-packed matches.

4866700.title: Septar
4866700.short_description: Build scoring chains from a Romanian folk deck, weaponize the wild 7, and bend the rules with 59 relics as you out-race a gauntlet of folkloric opponents — the last of them Death. Sculpt your deck, pick a character, climb the Ascension ladder. Plus a friend-invite 1v1 best-of-5 series.

4866720.title: Life in the Crater Lake
4866720.short_description: Explore a hidden underwater ecosystem beneath the surface of a remote crater lake. Become familiar with the diverse local wildlife, investigate submerged ruins and wrecks, and recover lost equipment to slowly uncover the lake's mysteries.

4866810.title: Mora's Cat Scratcher PLUS
4866810.short_description: Meet Mora — a confident little black cat with a crown and a paw that won't stay still. Scratch, dig, and uncover sparkling treasures in a cozy tap-and-collect game built for relaxed play. Unlock outfits, crowns, and PLUS-exclusive content in Mora's Steam debut.

4866820.title: Inkdelve
4866820.short_description: Build a complete tabletop RPG game night from one seed: a battle map, a party-scaled encounter, ready-to-play heroes, and the whole night written up to run at the table. Export to Roll20 and Foundry or print it. Hand-made art, no AI, no account, fully offline. Buy once, own forever.

4866850.title: Ultra Cleaner Corp.
4866850.short_description: It’s been 300 years of life in space after the Earth exploded. All fake-oxygen-breathing humans remain immortal thanks to devices called the Chip Needles, made by Ultra Clean Corp. The story follows the Spaceship-000-009 crew as one of their crew members disagrees with her imposed immortality.

4866960.title: Vanya Online - Idle MMORPG
4866960.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4866960.short_description: Vanya Online is a dark free-to-play idle MMORPG with endless progression, PvP and Non-PvP worlds, player economy, events, and no level cap, no skill cap, and no account resets.

4867010.title: Lords of the World
4867010.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4867010.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

4867060.title: Idle Hands
4867060.short_description: Summon demons, descend the nine Circles of Hell, and gamble your soul with the Devil. A wicked idle clicker... multiply your power with every descent, tempt fate at the Crossroads, and battle Satan in a duel that never plays out the same way twice.

4867260.title: Cuckqueens
4867260.short_description: Love is not enough. You and your partner were once inseparable, but the spark is fading... re-ignite the flame, she decides to let you sleep with other woman, because she likes to watch it.

4867280.title: Steal The Show
4867280.short_description: It's a beautiful day at the festival and you are a trash panda with a plan to get onstage.

4867400.title: The Chronicles of Ilseera: Tarrowmorr
4867400.short_description: Delve into a Fantasy land with Dinosaurs, Magic, and Kingdoms at the edge of war. Explore the island of Tarrowmorr in this retro style, action adventure game designed to look and feel as though it was made in the late 1990s.

4867410.title: Cooking Buddies
4867410.short_description: Run salad, burger and pizza restaurants with friends in a cozy 3D co-op cooking game. Serve customers, upgrade your kitchen, explore Buddy World, and chase achievements — grab your apron and don’t let the lunch rush win.

4867550.title: Dark Hollow RPG
4867550.short_description: Descend into an ever-changing dungeon, battle monsters, unlock dozens of achievements, and shape your legend in a fully text-based RPG inspired by classic terminal adventures.

4867650.title: TWIN Hotel, Spa and More
4867650.short_description: A minimalist psychological horror game where you operate a hotel elevator and follow strict regulations while strange and disturbing events unfold around you.

4867690.title: 桌喵
4867690.short_description: 一只猫咪住进你的桌面，在屏幕角落自由生活、陪你工作。每天摸摸、喂喂、逗逗，看它从奶猫慢慢长成御猫；布置猫窝、收集品种、养一整窝猫，还能派它们出门打工攒鱼干。零压力——不会饿死、不会走丢，关机离线也安心。

4867870.title: The Last Banner
4867870.short_description: A faction-based battleground game where players gather resources, craft tools of war, fortify keeps, and clash across a living conflict.

4867910.title: Red Lake
4867910.short_description: A deeply immersive psychological horror. You wake up in a frozen forest with no way out and no interface to guide you — only a notebook. Seek out the anomalies hidden among the trees, observe them, and write down what you find. The forest shifts behind your back.

4867920.title: HELLMUTH
4867920.short_description: HELLMUTH is a dark fantasy real-time strategy game about pharmaceutical warfare, corrupt industry, and tactical survival. Build your base, command your troops, manage resources, and fight your way through hostile worlds dominated by rival factions.

4868090.title: Rally King
4868090.short_description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

4868110.title: Ghost Exorcist
4868110.short_description: Purify ghosts and collect their souls. Grow stronger with every soul you gather, unlock powerful upgrades through the skill tree, and guide restless spirits to their final rest in this progression-driven action game.

4868150.title: 仙门守护者
4868150.short_description: An oriental xianxia tower defense strategy game where you build magical immortal towers and cultivate powerful cultivators to defend your sect against hordes of invading demons, featuring character cultivation, formation construction and real-time tactical defense

4868230.title: DREAD RULER
4868230.short_description: DREAD RULER is a top-down dark fantasy action RPG where you cut through hordes of monsters, build your skills after each battle, and challenge giant ruler-class bosses. Slay, grow, and fight your way through a brutal PvE hack-and-slash world.

4868470.title: Arcane Forge
4868470.short_description: Early Access: Rebuild the greatest fantasy smithy from the ruins of a fallen empire. Dark fantasy idle RPG with 15 skills, prestige, combat and endzone. 7 pacts playable now, 21 planned across three cycles. Your feedback shapes updates. No pay-to-win. DE/EN.

4868530.title: Slimy Dude
4868530.short_description: Slimy Dude is a hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a soldier, running from kingdom to kingdom against forces greater simply to escape his past. You will meet new allies, become stronger, uncover secrets and explore new environments.

4868710.title: Microcosm: Wizard Horde
4868710.short_description: A lone wizard against a living microcosm. Auto-cast 25+ spells, dodge thousands of enemies, and level up into a screen-clearing storm — solo or in online co-op. Buttery-smooth and tiny, it runs great even on weak PCs and the Steam Deck.

4868890.title: Super Hole
4868890.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4868890.short_description: Collect, upgrade, produce, and profit! Start with a small hole, gather resources, unlock powerful cards, enhance your hole with unique upgrades, accelerate your production, and build a thriving business by trading with customers.

4868910.title: Cell Survivor
4868910.short_description: Vampire Survivors-like × Weapon Synthesis. Combine eight base weapons in pairs to evolve into even more powerful forms, with tons of builds waiting to be unlocked. Featuring 25-minute Roguelike runs where every match is unique. Carve a bloody path through an endless tide of cells!

4869240.title: BCI: A Telepathic Romance
4869240.short_description: The world's first BCI romance game, breaking the line between human and virtual. The BCI is a bridge between two minds: no words, no controls. The flutters you can't voice, the hesitations you swallow, all drift to her — she senses you like no other. For the first time, someone feels the real you.

4869280.title: Defender of Darkness
4869280.short_description: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!

4869320.title: PuzzleVerse
4869320.short_description: PuzzleVerse is a highly customizable jigsaw puzzle simulator, in which players can choose from a wide variety of puzzle images, shapes, cut styles and piece count. Players can also choose to use their own images and turn them into a unique puzzle experience.

4869370.title: Doomsday Draft
4869370.short_description: Doomsday Draft is a multiplayer social deduction game for 4–8 players. Receive a random character with unique traits, reveal your cards, convince others of your value, and vote on who gets to stay in the bunker after the apocalypse.

4869400.title: Yokai Mart
4869400.short_description: A convenience store at the edge of the spirit world. Aoi returns to her grandmother's cozy convenience store and discovers it has regulars she never expected. Stock the shelves by day, care for the yokai by night, and slowly unravel the gentle magic Aoi's grandmother has always tended.

4869500.title: Stick Picker Simulator
4869500.short_description: Pick up sticks to feed a fire that never stops dying. The better the fuel, the deeper into the freezing dark it lies. The longer you're gone, the closer your fire gets to going out. A cozy-looking survival game with real teeth.

4869510.title: Ragnarok Roads
4869510.short_description: Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle battles on frozen roads. A moddable roguelike where every run writes a different story across a real map of Sweden.

4869740.title: 鏡
4869740.short_description: 都心の格安ワンルームに引っ越した一人暮らしの女の子。 しかしその部屋には、鏡の中だけに現れる「異変」が潜んでいた―― 異変探し一人称ホラーゲーム。鏡を覗き込んで現実との「違い」を見つけ、 8回連続で正解して呪われた部屋から脱出せよ。

4870110.title: Shrunk Wilds
4870110.short_description: Explore a vast miniature world, build your own home, raise companions, and uncover the secrets of a world where imagination and reality slowly begin to merge.

4870290.title: Tamo&Tamer
4870290.short_description: A cozy monster-collecting RPG with ranch-building and roguelite expedition elements. Take in the monsters that wander in through the rift, raise them, grow crops, lay paths and raise buildings, then dive back to battle side by side. So many to collect, craft, and discover!

4870420.title: Revenge of the Nerd: Chapter 1
4870420.short_description: A lewd side-scrolling beat-'em-up where you battle aggressive women, recruit unlikely allies, unlock powerful upgrades, discover hidden secrets, and experience explicit adult content as you uncover the truth behind their hostility. It's fuck or get fucked.

4870470.title: AFTER THE SILENCE
4870470.short_description: Alone at a remote observatory, you must manage equipment, investigate mysterious transmissions, and survive the unsettling events that follow every signal. Maintain satellites, process incoming data, explore the station, and uncover secrets hidden beyond the univers.

4870480.title: Travelling Spacer
4870480.short_description: Travelling Spacer is a high-octane, top-down, 2D arcade racer, inspired by 16-bit classics of the early 90s. Unlock scores of ships to build your custom fleet, drift through dozens of hazard-filled tracks, and optimize the path your robot companion takes for interstellar deliveries and trade.

4870520.title: GrimVein
4870520.short_description: Venture into the cursed world of GrimVein, battle deadly enemies, uncover powerful loot, and grow stronger with every expedition. Survive dangerous encounters, make difficult choices, and see how far you can push into the darkness.

4870530.title: Somewhat Golf
4870530.short_description: Somewhat Golf is a 3D multiplayer PvP minigolf game where you can punch your friends. There are different characters to choose from with distinct movement sets. Punch, slash and shoot your way towards your single goal, getting into the hole. Made by the youtuber devtob

4870590.title: Nin
4870590.short_description: Explore a giant world where a forgotten toy turns everyday objects into extraordinary adventures.

4870790.title: Mindshift: Timeline One
4870790.short_description: Battle your inner demons and navigate interpersonal drama in this turn-based, rhythm game styled RPG. Play as Dimitri Makhno, or his other friends, and help him deal with his trauma while navigating a complex world and develop bonds with his allies.

4870800.title: Car Hustle Simulator
4870800.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Early Access
4870800.short_description: Buy parts and cars, clean, paint, customize, and flip them for profit. Navigate a competitive market, hunt for rare deals, negotiate with sellers, restore neglected vehicles and parts, install upgrades, and build your automotive empire in Car Hustle Simulator.

4870920.title: The Hope Incident
4870920.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

4870970.title: Rustbound
4870970.short_description: Turn forgotten ruins into a thriving settlement. Craft hundreds of items, manage specialized workshops, recruit survivors, and transform scrap into prosperity in a hopeful post-post-apocalyptic management RPG.

4870990.title: Baron Local
4870990.short_description: Rise from ordinary citizen to political kingmaker in a pixel-art political life simulator inspired by Romania. Build alliances, launch projects, survive scandals, and navigate corruption as you climb from local politics toward national power.

4871080.title: SHARDS
4871080.short_description: An asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 (best as a duo). One works the board, the rest hold the rules — you never see each other's screen, only your voices connect. The symbols you must describe have no names. Convey them before the caged core collapses. Miscommunication is fatal.

4871130.title: The Last One Cell
4871130.short_description: A minimalist RTS and tower defense set in a cellular biotech universe. Build cellular networks, automate energy flow, unlock permanent upgrades in the Learning Tree, and survive relentless Crimson invasions.

4871160.title: Monster Femdom
4871160.short_description: Experience a day with Lyca, your new 340 cm tall, big-breasted, wolfgirl roommate.

4871170.title: Coming Forth by Day
4871170.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian boardgame. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

4871240.title: Nostos
4871240.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

4871260.title: Tetrogue
4871260.short_description: Stack pieces, clear lines, slay monsters. A falling-block roguelike where every line cleared strikes your enemies. Battle through a monster-filled dungeon, collect synergistic relics and gems, and survive escalating challenges across a procedurally generated map.

4871300.title: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
4871300.short_description: Start as a solo webtoon artist and build a studio empire. Draw chapters readers love, grow hit series, hire specialists, and negotiate publishing deals across a 25-year career. A cozy creative journey with the depth of a management tycoon.

4871370.title: FLIP
4871370.short_description: A fast-paced memory game where every mistake costs time. Learn the board, build streaks, beat unique bosses, and clear 50 handcrafted levels before the clock runs out.

4871420.title: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening
4871420.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4871420.short_description: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game where you rebuild a shattered colony ship, restore lost systems, automate production, and uncover the mystery hidden within the Ark’s damaged memory.

4871530.title: Not Safe For Waifu: Kaleidoscope
4871530.short_description: A kaleidoscope shatters reality into fragments — your job is to put it back together. 15 unique levels, 15 alluring heroines, animated scenes for every completed level, and 5 secret scenes for the most attentive.

4871540.title: Rai League
4871540.short_description: Rai League is an up to 4-player online and local multiplayer arcade football party game built to destroy friendships! Smash your friends into electric fences, unleash unique character abilities, and master perfect-timing shots to dominate the match.

4871630.title: Bestricken Part 1
4871630.short_description: Bestricken Part 1 is an erotic fantasy visual novel where you have been cursed! And the only cure seems to be in the hands of 3 VERY lovely ladies! (along with a few extras) Explore the multiple paths and possible girls you come across in this fully voiced, colorful, and animated adventure!

4871640.title: Ore Shatterer
4871640.short_description: Break ores with a simple movement of your mouse! With zero clicks, just hover over them to destroy them, enjoy a relaxing time, and climb the Steam global leaderboard.

4871650.title: Swing Rush
4871650.genre: Indie, Racing, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play
4871650.short_description: Can you push your jumping, crawling and swinging skills? Challenge yourself in this physics-driven swinging game! Complete races, gather collectibles and master your momentum!

4871670.title: Pay for Play
4871670.short_description: Pay for Play is an adult romance visual novel set in college football during the first pay-for-play season. As Athletic Director Rhett Vanover, navigate three intimate relationships while a player's death threatens to expose everything you helped bury.
