4871750.short_description: Pull the lever, stop the reels, and chase the 1 / 16384 triple 7.

4871770.title: よろず屋の品定め
4871770.short_description: A simulation game blending 2D pixel art and 3D voxels. Use tools to remove "jammers" from items, discover enchantments that determine their value, and trade them. Experience the fresh fusion of nostalgic pixel art and modern voxel graphics.

4871920.title: Homauton
4871920.short_description: A tiny horror automation game. Trapped in a cramped landing pod with only a hibernation chamber and drone control computer, investigate the abandoned surface of a dead planet and build a rocket to escape before your family back home dies of old age.

4871930.title: Beyond Horizon
4871930.short_description: Battle across the galaxy, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the mystery of Kuma's missing sister in this fast-paced top-down space shooter.

4871940.title: PSYCHO CASKET
4871940.short_description: KILL YOUR FRIENDS /// SAVE THE WORLD PSYCHO CASKET is an interactive RPG about a vampire and her impossible decision. It's been waiting for you. Yes, YOU.

4872020.title: Gridiron Football League
4872020.short_description: Gridiron Football League combines retro football presentation with deep franchise simulation.

4872120.title: Vampire Match
4872120.short_description: A vampire themed match game with a twist. A vampire match by two game where the grid increases in size with every correct guess. Wrong guesses deplete the villagers blood supply. Once the villager loses all of his blood, he will die and the game will end. All of this needs to be done before sunrise.

4872140.title: Sydwater
4872140.short_description: Welcome to Sydwater, a wide open TPS/FPS sandbox set in a stylized Sydney Australia inspired by the golden age of open world games. Conquer the World and play Activities to get Alms and make friends along the way. The Player can Shoot, Fly, Skate, Tag and traverse to other Dimensions.

4872150.title: Elegorithm
4872150.short_description: Hack and optimize inefficient elevators in Elegorithm, a Sci-Fi simulation. Connect nodes to build custom algorithms and route endless passenger waves. Clear strict wait time and power targets to upgrade your system. If floors overflow, your hack is detected—game over!

4872250.title: The Living Atlas: A Fantasy Chronicler
4872250.short_description: A procedural fantasy world generator and civilization simulator. Every world is unique — explore its biomes, species, and emerging realms as civilizations rise, expand, and vanish across an infinite variety of planets. No objectives. No failure states. Just worlds worth watching.

4872270.title: APARTMENT 001
4872270.short_description: You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

4872310.title: Cylindrika
4872310.short_description: Fast paced, free flowing, geometry based 3D arcade style movement shooter. Dash, jump, and slide around to traverse a unique world shape. Manipulate physics to your advantage. Positioning and speed are key. Deterministic enemies require deliberate combat decisions.

4872330.title: Hotel The Memory
4872330.short_description: “If you find an anomaly, remember it.”　Welcome to Hotel The Memory, an anomaly-hunting x memory-matching escape game. Match pairs of rooms with the exact same anomaly to escape from this strange hotel.

4872370.title: Tiny Guild
4872370.short_description: Explore your guild hideout as the Guild Master, prepare your heroes, send them into automated combat expeditions, then use whatever they bring back to improve the guild.

4872470.title: Short Fuse!
4872470.genre: Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, Simulation
4872470.short_description: A cooperative driving challenge for 1–4 players. Transport unstable cargo across dangerous roads, meet your delivery quota, and try not to destroy each other before reaching the destination.

4872500.title: Slash Bullet White Rabbit
4872500.short_description: This game is short content. This is platform action game which is composed of 10 stages. This game player "White Rabbit" is loner bounty hunter. Please , clear missions to fight against the mysterious army and robots. And, expose their conspiracy. There is speedy game action.

4872540.title: AeroBird
4872540.short_description: AeroBird is a fast-paced acrobatic platformer where every jump matters.

4872560.title: The Manga Cafe | ザ・マンガ・カフェ
4872560.short_description: Stranded after the last train in Shinjuku, a tourist must endure the night inside a claustrophobic, 24-hour manga café. Explore narrow corridors, complete realistic tasks, and navigate an unsettling psychological horror atmosphere as you wait for dawn in this first-person narrative simulation.

4872590.title: Burger Maker
4872590.short_description: A puzzle game where you combine randomly falling ingredients on 10 turntables to fill customer orders. Preparing stock in advance is just as important as filling orders. New menu items are added as your rating climbs, making things increasingly hectic. Use combos and chains to reach 5 stars!

4872610.title: The World Below - A Call Within
4872610.short_description: Achi ran away from the orphanage and he found himself surrounded by concrete, indifference, and violence. He was saved by a mysterious creature that came from within, and by a peculiar detective. He had no way of knowing that darker, more disturbing voices were about to reach him.

4872670.title: Escape the Urban Underground.
4872670.short_description: Escape the Urban Underground delivers a terrifying, highly immersive VR escape room experience that will push your mind to the limit. Deep beneath the bustling city lies a forgotten subway station, sealed off from the world. A gruesome murder has just taken place on these decaying platforms.

4872690.title: Love Train
4872690.short_description: Love Train is a side-view roguelike shooter where you race through a ruined world swarming with monstrous creatures. Defeat enemies, collect items, survive strange events at each station, and upgrade your ordinary train into a powerful, grotesque monster train.

4872770.title: Dinotraz
4872770.short_description: Hunt, explore, hide, and survive Dinotraz; the dinosaur infested island that has been in use for current studies and discoveries regarding incubating extinct live. Can you retrieve all the items your superiors have ordered you to retrieve to prove yourself worthy and keep your life?

4872780.title: Anomaly Control Division
4872780.short_description: Welcome to the Anomaly Control Division—the finest workplace on Earth. Protect humanity. Study the unknown. Monitor anomalies, maintain containment, and survive the shift. Good luck. *All on-duty injuries are your sole responsibility. The Division assumes no liability.

4872800.title: Lucky Pocket
4872800.short_description: Adjust your strategy to match the shop list that changes with every playthrough, combine equipment to create powerful synergies, and defeat monsters and bosses with a variety of options!

4872850.title: Duco
4872850.short_description: Duco is a card-based survival roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic world. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

4872920.title: Iron Contract
4872920.short_description: Iron Contract is a solo 2D management game where you run an industrial defense company. Manage contracts, suppliers, stock, reputation, buildings and production capacity as your company grows from a small local operation into a stronger industrial actor.

4872970.title: Double Driver
4872970.short_description: Double Driver is a fast-paced arcade driving game that puts your coordination to the test.

4873040.title: RECIPROCITY: The Liminal Void
4873040.short_description: RECIPROCITY is a first-person horror game set in a Backrooms-inspired liminal world. Evade a relentless, unscripted entity, discover gadgets, sell items, upgrade your gear and escape. Your camera can reveal hidden paths and secrets, but each use empowers the very thing hunting you.

4873050.title: International Memes
4873050.short_description: International Memes is a quiz featuring internet memes from around the world. Look at iconic images, guess their names, and find out whether you're just a random internet visitor or a true Internet Legend. 50 memes, 15 achievements, 6 languages, and tons of humor.

4873080.title: Your Screen Friend
4873080.short_description: Most programs want something from you. Your buddy just wants to be with you. A little companion who lives on your screen, listens to you, plays with you and lends a hand. The better you get to know each other, the closer you become. Not an assistant – a friend who's glad you're here.

4873130.title: MMOS: MMO Simulator
4873130.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4873130.short_description: The MMO management sim where you operate a living MMORPG. Paint zones, place monsters, design classes, gear and quests, and run the economy with vendors, auction houses, and flight fares. Then thousands of autonomous adventurers move in, level up, trade, and pay the subscriptions that fund you.

4873170.title: Explosive Escape
4873170.short_description: Explosive Escape is a fast-paced drifting challenge where every move can be your last.

4873220.title: Sweet Hotel 2
4873220.short_description: Sweet Hotel 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around a hotel. Spend a pleasant time with five pretty and cute girls near the hotel, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4873250.title: RobotAssembly
4873250.short_description: Can you assemble a robot? Assemble a combat robot using 8 parts and build a robot army. Earth has been overrun by uncontrollable AI robots, and humanity has gone extinct. The only remaining humans are the descendants of criminals who settled on Mars.

4873270.title: Dark City: Scavenge Craft Power
4873270.short_description: Scan dumpsters for valuable recyclable materials and restore a city trapped in darkness. Craft solar infrastructure from recovered waste, automate recycling systems, and gradually bring buildings, traffic, and an entire city back to life.

4873390.title: Coffee Craze
4873390.short_description: Serve coffee and small pastries to customers while slowly making the place your own by moving things around and changing decorations.

4873430.title: Pachinko Overdrive
4873430.short_description: A chaotic roguelike pachinko game where you build absurd ball upgrades and watch physics-driven chain reactions explode across the board. Every run evolves into a different machine of bouncing, splitting, and cascading score chaos.

4873450.title: WizBall
4873450.short_description: Wizball is a 2D pinball-inspired roguelike game where you play as a regular child attempting to beat the Powerscale Tournament. Your only weapons are powerful balls used to steal the enemy's mana and attack them. Climb up the Tournament's ranking to unlock powerful balls!

4873550.title: BudMageddon
4873550.short_description: Aliens Demanded 3 Billion KGs of Sticky Icky Buds Or They Vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. A chill pixel-art idle Incremental grower that runs while you do everything else.

4873560.title: BRAYZ
4873560.short_description: Top speed: 8,000 km/h. A hyper-velocity, 64-racer high-speed racing game set in a futuristic solar system! Deep strategic options with Arts and Gear, combined with an unparalleled high-speed experience, await you. Aim for the top in the fastest race in human history!

4873810.title: Tea Haven
4873810.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4873810.short_description: Tea Haven is a pixel-art tea business simulation set in the Ming dynasty. Process tea, run your shop, expand your family trade, and survive a turbulent historical era.

4873880.title: Blackcensus
4873880.short_description: Love. Humanity. Eternity. The chronicle about Intricate relationships between entities ⸎ and Ϗ from eternity and their reunion to find lost reliquary weapon.

4873900.title: Arcadia Unbound
4873900.short_description: Embark on a character-driven tactical JRPG adventure through a mysterious world fractured by unseen forces. Build bonds with your companions, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your journey through meaningful choices and dynamic interactions.

4873910.title: Three Days, No Words
4873910.short_description: A short cozy visual novel about awkward conversations, cultural barriers, and the connections that can emerge when two people don't speak the same language.

4873920.title: Stash Mayhem
4873920.short_description: A fast-paced warehouse-sorting roguelike. Items keep arriving and customers keep ordering, so organize everything your way and deliver each order before their patience runs out. Carry too much at once and it all spills to the floor.

4873970.title: The Slime is Looting
4873970.short_description: You are a slime. Your life was perfect, just you and your beautiful rocks. Now, noisy humans are trying to steal them. They brought swords. You are about to show them the art of throwing those swords right back at them.

4874010.title: Arsica: Echoes of Ars
4874010.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4874010.short_description: Arsica is a 2D Platformer RPG where you play as a demon hunter carrying a power no army ever had. Four demons claimed the lands. Mankind retreated to its last shelter. You are not here to survive. You are here to end it. Build your team, forge your gear, hunt every monster and four demon.

4874180.title: Soul Savior
4874180.short_description: Defend your treasure against endless waves in this action roguelite tower defense. Save villagers' souls to gain loyal helpers, or sacrifice them to empower your spells. Upgrade your spells, discover powerful synergies, and build traps to survive as long as possible.

4874380.title: Camp & Conquer
4874380.short_description: Camp & Conquer is a fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

4874440.title: Ultrablight
4874440.short_description: A dark fantasy survivors-like roguelite where you craft overpowered builds through backpack management, slaughter corrupted hordes, and push the Blight beyond its limits.

4874580.title: Hentai Puzzle: Alerinna
4874580.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Alerinna: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Alerinna, a very naughty elf. Progress through challenges, unlock alluring images and scenes, and enjoy a playful adult puzzle experience.

4874760.title: Cult of the Red Heifer
4874760.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

4874780.title: FEMBOY FUTA TRAP HOUSE
4874780.short_description: Trapped in a house with 8 gorgeous Futanaris and Femboys! 🌸 When a housewarming party goes wrong, you are locked inside for 10 days with no way out. Will you survive the chaos, or will you find love? 💖 A romantic comedy visual novel with 12 hours of playtime and spicy encounters <3 🔥

4874860.title: FACTORY I
4874860.short_description: FACTORY I is a minimalist automation simulator designed to deliver the pure joy of factory building through a clean, clutter-free UI. Strip away the visual noise, design flawless production lines, and challenge the limits of infinite efficiency.

4875010.title: Muska
4875010.short_description: No weapons. No escape. Just silence... and a truth awaiting you. In this atmospheric psychological horror game inspired by Turkish paranormal horror, uncover the secrets of an abandoned hospital and complete the ritual.

4875620.title: Underground : Subway Escape
4875620.short_description: Underground is a liminal-space-based psychological horror game where you must escape from Seoul Subway Line 5. Investigate your surroundings and solve puzzles. Do not lose your sanity. Survive the unseen.

4875720.title: shark
4875720.short_description: Shark is a fast-paced reflex game about racing the clock to reach the flag in randomly generated levels. Dash through obstacles, chain through arrows, and don't let "impossible" levels fool you. This is an endless game of speed. How fast can you swim?

4875860.title: ECHOES
4875860.short_description: 終末世界の見知らぬ廃墟で目覚めた青年は、壊れかけのアンドロイドの少女と出会う。 これは少女の不思議な声を辿る、5日間の小さな短編アドベンチャー。

4875950.title: GREY FRONTIER
4875950.short_description: After a mysterious catastrophe, all contact with the Ilyinsk Region was lost. Get behind the wheel of an old Niva and uncover the mystery of the Grey Zone. Explore Soviet villages, gather resources, upgrade your vehicle, and discover the truth behind a vanished region.

4876060.title: TrailRush
4876060.short_description: Race against the clock, earn trophies and climb the leaderboards in this 2D platformer designed for speedrunning!

4876090.title: Rugby World Championship
4876090.short_description: OLD SCHOOL RUGBY! Remember Jonah Lomu Rugby for the PS1?! That’s the spirit animal for Rugby World Championship. Focus on what makes rugby fun with slick passing, big hits and worldie tries in the corners. Keep the game fast and frantic whether playing against the computer or against your mates.

4876110.title: Oops, No Floor!
4876110.short_description: Oops, No Floor is a fast online multiplayer party game where the floor keeps disappearing beneath you. Run, jump, and shove your way through four chaotic modes, survive crowded platforms, and outscore up to 11 rivals.

4876120.title: Femboy Dormmate
4876120.short_description: Move into The Wisteria, a gorgeous mansion where you are the ONLY male resident living with six stunning dormmates! 🌸 Experience 14 days of hilarious roommate drama and undeniable romantic tension in this adult slice-of-life visual novel. Who will capture your heart? 💕

4876150.title: Pore Cleaning Simulator
4876150.short_description: Grab, pull, and pop blackheads out. A weirdly satisfying pore-cleaning simulator.

4876180.title: Sundays on the Ridge
4876180.short_description: Sundays on the Ridge is a cozy photography adventure about slowing down, exploring a quiet islands, and capturing gentle moments in nature. Wander forest paths, find shy animals, complete photo tasks, and build a peaceful album of memories.

4876280.title: Fart Fighter
4876280.short_description: Fart Fighter is a 2D, top-down, pixel-art action game, where players travel across a world map, progressing through levels while collecting equipment, powerups and combining food to craft different farts and eliminate enemies.

4876320.title: Behind the Screen
4876320.short_description: Behind the Screen is a narrative indie game about depression, facades, and escape. Make impactful daily choices, balance Jonas' willpower, and escape reality through fast-paced retro minigames on a virtual PC monitor. Can you find a way through the noise?

4876340.title: Hentai Academy: Sweetheart
4876340.short_description: An 18+ visual novel about a magic that awakens more than just your gift: a quiet island, an ancient academy, students falling in love with someone no one else can see, and two witches, with either of whom it could have worked out. If you dare.

4876350.title: Cold Doctor & Noble Lady Fall for Me
4876350.short_description: At the age of 22, Simon was on the verge of death in a laboratory explosion and merged with No. 7. In the hospital, he borrowed Tessa's senses and established connections with Maria and Katya to jointly fight against the pursuit of the FX Group.

4876480.title: Cirtemin
4876480.short_description: Prove your worth on the endless battlefield—as long as someone is still standing, the fight goes on.

4876600.title: 仙路烟尘
4876600.short_description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

4876620.title: Three Kingdoms: March
4876620.short_description: Three Kingdoms: March is a tactical strategy simulation where you command troops with drag-based orders and build your realm through officers, policies, and research. Outmaneuver enemies in real-time battles, strike their flanks and rear, and prepare your path to unification.

4876730.title: Petrix
4876730.short_description: An action roguelike: become a leucocyte hunting viruses, bacteria, and fungi in a petri dish, choosing a mutation path and stacking weapons to survive ever-deeper Rifts.

4876770.title: The Fishercat
4876770.short_description: Cats love fish so much, they started fishing.

4876800.title: Organize My Drawer
4876800.short_description: A cozy relaxing organizing game where you solve levels, customize your items, follow the story and unlock more mysteries. Includes daily challenges and relaxing music.

4876850.title: Bearicade
4876850.short_description: A tower-defense game where your tower is a toy train. Circle a weapon-loaded train around your teddy bear to blast and ram the green-army horde, then add carriages, spikes, speed, and turrets between waves. Hold the line for 30 nights, then go endless.

4876870.title: Squoids
4876870.short_description: Squoids is a survival top-down arena shooter where you control a frantic swarm of the squid-like namesakes of the game. Maneuver and upgrade your swarm as an ocean's worth of sea creatures come after you. Can you endure long enough to defeat the mysterious final boss?

4876950.title: Bunker Buster
4876950.short_description: Dig deep and build a self-sufficient bunker. Manage power and life support, then arm it with billions of possible weapon, defence, and cyber-warfare combinations, and strike first, or defend.

4877140.title: AfterClerk
4877140.short_description: In the office of the afterlife, you weigh the dead. Read each soul's ledger, hear their final plea, and seal them to Heaven or Hell. But the Director's doctrine is harsh — and the souls you judge may know your name.

4877160.title: Diagnosis: Room 101
4877160.short_description: Diagnosis Room 101 is a short horror game and a first-person psychological horror experience, focused on exploration, atmosphere, and uncovering a hidden story through documents and environmental clues scattered throughout the hospital.

4877240.title: Zombuffoonery
4877240.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
4877240.short_description: Survive in a bloody hell! Build fortifications, deploy turrets, and fend off waves of zombies. Upgrade with coins, use weapons from a pistol to an axe, and unlock 10 hardcore achievements.

4877310.title: Card Flipper
4877310.short_description: Flip cards, stack cash, and chase the jackpot until your fortune snowballs out of control! Card Flipper is a casual casino game with idle elements, where every flip pays, golden cards spark Frenzies, and even the bad habits make you richer. Flip, Frenzy & Fortune!

4877320.title: Curlith
4877320.short_description: Curlith is a tactical curling game that combines uniquely tuned physics-based stone behavior with simple card effects. Use stones with special effects, read the changing ice condition, and aim for the perfect shot!

4877350.title: Loot & Rush
4877350.short_description: Loot&Rush is a unique and addictive dungeon crawler set in a fantasy world, inspired by great classics!

4877390.title: SEX SECRET
4877390.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4877390.short_description: SEX SECRET - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4877400.title: LOVE 2077
4877400.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4877400.short_description: LOVE 2077 - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

4877420.title: Rec Room: A New Semester
4877420.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play, Early Access
4877420.short_description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

4877430.title: SAYONARA++
4877430.short_description: Tokyo holds the last remnants of human life. All our pilots are dead; you are our sole surviving AI. Commandeer a fleet of dormant mechas via an ancient backup protocol. Inject assembly code, optimize sparse memory, and achieve absolute annihilation. Never forget that The Cluster is observing you.

4877650.title: Conglomerate
4877650.short_description: You’re the CEO. Build a startup company into a thriving conglomerate, one high-stakes decision at a time. Manage P&L, read the market, hire the right executives, and survive the crises. Build a conglomerate or go bankrupt trying.

4877690.title: Aster League: 2179
4877690.short_description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

4877750.title: Temporal Strike
4877750.short_description: Control and upgrade a squad of time traveling soldiers sent back to stop an orc invasion before they can obtain the Power of Chaos in this incremental isometric shooter game

4877780.title: HALFLIGHT
4877780.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

4877890.title: Touhou Russian Roulette
4877890.short_description: Remilia's cake has vanished from a locked room in the Scarlet Devil Mansion! With the help of head maid Sakuya, play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun and punish the suspects. Good luck!

4877900.title: wolfworld
4877900.genre: Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4877900.short_description: wolfworld是一款兽人题材的成人向奇幻回合制 RPG，玩家将在开放地图中探索城镇、森林、矿洞与地下城，通过战斗、采集、炼金、装备打造、生活技能、职业养成和多分支角色互动不断成长，并在高自由度的主线、支线与败北事件中体验危险、欲望与冒险交织的异世界旅程。

4878070.title: Tormented Souls Idle
4878070.short_description: Dark fantasy idle/incremental RPG set in the ruins of Solace. Combat runs itself. Death is the beginning. No microtransactions. Ever.

4878090.title: Hentai Senpai: Things That go HUMP in the Night
4878090.short_description: Unleash your darkest desires this Halloween! Solve puzzles to unlock gorgeous, hyper-sexual monster girls begging to hump in the night. From horny succubi to dripping slime babes, multiple puzzle modes, co-op, and a killer spooky-sexy soundtrack.

4878120.title: Alice & Aidy: The Big Adventure
4878120.short_description: Alice & Aidy: The Big Adventure is a warm interactive story with a gentle children’s sci-fi feel. When Alice struggles to write about the future, she meets Aidy, an old companion robot. Read, choose, and explore as they search for lost sparks and learn to ask, create, and choose for themselves.

4878370.title: Nosteria
4878370.short_description: <Nosteria> is a 2D platformer set in a steampunk fantasy world. Once a garden where precious memories grew into beautiful flowers and trees, it has turned into cold, ash-gray ruins by an unknown shadow. Embark on a journey with a young boy to bring color back to this world.

4878550.title: The Tower of Seven
4878550.short_description: The Tower of Seven is a board-game-inspired roguelike where cards, dice, and demon rules reshape every floor. Build a three-card chain, trigger upright or reversed effects, and rewrite the table as you climb toward fate.

4878640.title: Asterium
4878640.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

4878720.title: Refund
4878720.short_description: Refund is a grid puzzle game. Paid tiles hand out receipts, and refunding one does more than return your coins: it backs you into walls, blasts you across the board, rewinds time, resets the map! 50 handcrafted levels where every single coin counts.

4878810.title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
4878810.short_description: A hard physics-based roguelite sports game about wheelchair ski jumping. Compete across 18 countries, impress the judges, break hill records, and win the Happy Friendship Cup.

4878830.title: Find Cats 8 Magical Plant Kingdom
4878830.short_description: 🌿 A Gothic Plant Kingdom hide-and-seek 3 full-color levels · 60 cats each Tree Queen · Flower Fairy · Mushroom Sage 180 cats hidden in 4K illustrations Find them all, let your heart bloom

4878870.title: The Sadist Club
4878870.short_description: Chie, your 202 cm tall, big-breasted, sadistic professor, dominates you after catching you sneaking around the university after hours.

4878900.title: Net Worthless
4878900.short_description: A satirical life-and-money sim where one turn is one month. Plan your next move, make your choices, face the consequences. Every choice has a price. Can you afford yours?

4878990.title: Gentle Doctor's Exclusive Shelter
4878990.short_description: Ethan Gray investigated the FX Group to save his daughter and was shot by Teeraphat Saran. He was taken over by a consciousness insect and reborn. He interacted with Doctor Kyung-eun Choi at the clinic and then received a distress message from his ex-wife, falling into a trap.

4879080.title: SEXY WASH PARADISE
4879080.short_description: SEXY WASH PARADISE is a relaxing wash simulator featuring hot girls, where cleanliness meets seduction. Bring everything within reach to a shine. A tropical island paradise, lots of sex and washing await you!

4879100.title: Three Stunning Beauties Obey All My Orders
4879100.short_description: Delivery man Luke is burdened with heavy debts. He was chased and nearly died in a rainy night, but was reborn and gained the ability of data domination. He declared war on Dom, got involved with doctor Isabella, and will also face the challenges from the Roosevelt family.

4879300.title: Xenomire
4879300.short_description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

4879410.title: Critical Ward
4879410.short_description: Treat patients. Build massive combos. Deploy medical infrastructure. Survive the chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%

4879510.title: Earth New Fall
4879510.short_description: A suspenseful horror game where you recover items to help you survive in a bunker.

4879540.title: Escape Them
4879540.short_description: Navigate a locked environment to find an escape while avoiding an intelligent, adaptive hunter that reacts to player noise and hiding patterns. Survival hinges on silence, environmental awareness, and outsmarting.

4879740.title: Party Executable
4879740.short_description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

4879780.title: M.A.D. - Mutually Assured Destruction
4879780.short_description: VR or monitor, no headset required. A modern 3D revival of the turn-based artillery duel — battle up to 8 players online or pass-and-play across 4 teams with a Cold War arsenal of missiles, cluster bombs, and nukes. Fire all at once, last base standing wins.

4879810.title: Starglyphs
4879810.short_description: A puzzle game where you trace constellations in a living night sky. Connect the stars without retracing a connection to solve each glyph, then watch it bloom into a luminous nebula.

4879850.title: Animal Chameleon
4879850.short_description: Animal Chameleon is a multiplayer hide and seek game where you paint your animal to match the surroundings, stay hidden, and outsmart the seekers.

4879870.title: Wildborn Football Cup
4879870.short_description: Football tactics meet animal instinct in a cinematic card-and-dice strategy game. Play the cards you are dealt, unleash your captain’s powers, win penalty duels, and lead a Wildborn nation to the Cup.

4879920.title: Just Joust
4879920.short_description: Just Joust (and other games) is a medieval social game where you can hop on with your buddies, play games, earn money, buy cosmetics and level up. You can also throw tomatoes at people. We like throwing tomatoes at people.

4880140.title: Voidrend
4880140.short_description: A 3D arena survivor-like for 1–4 players. Mow down swarms, evolve one of four weapons into a screen-clearing build, and topple towering multi-phase bosses across five biomes — then reclaim the rising Void, where the floor is the boss.

4880180.title: Paper Flags
4880180.short_description: A two-player abstract strategy game on a 9×9 board. Fold your pieces to advance diagonally. Unfold them into flags — moving like rooks across rank and file. Plant three flags on your opponent's back row, or cut their forces to three.

4880210.title: Hammered Heroes
4880210.short_description: Lead a drunken band of adventurers down the deepest dungeon in the realm. Pick the party, choose the path, and watch them carve through frost, fire, and worse. Fall, pour another, and descend again — stronger each time. Raise a tankard. Raise a warhammer.

4880310.title: Black Hollow
4880310.short_description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Black Hollow is a first-person dark-fantasy horde-survival roguelite where you slaughter infected hordes, harvest their ichor, and forge devastating builds before the next bell toll.

4880320.title: Holospace
4880320.short_description: Take flight from planet surfaces to deep space with no loading screens. Explore a vast procedurally generated voxel universe, mine resources, build massive bases, battle alien creatures, and uncover virtually endless worlds. Play in first or third person.

4880370.title: The Crystal Atelier
4880370.short_description: A cozy crafting RPG about mining rough gems, restoring them by hand, brewing potions, forging fine pieces, and growing a humble workshop into a master artisan atelier.

4880430.title: GOOB8
4880430.short_description: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

4880540.title: Mistwoods
4880540.short_description: Something woke beneath the ruins. The forest answered. A dark fantasy RPG with branching choices, three companions, and seven endings shaped by every decision you make. The corruption is rising. Choose carefully.

4880700.title: Peasant Samurai ～ 百姓ノ持チタル国
4880700.short_description: The people were oppressed—but the peasants of Kaga were different. They ousted their lords and built a nation with their own hands. Develop your villages and take up arms against the advancing Oda army. A fantasy Sengoku RTS where the common folk are the true protagonists.

4880780.title: Wooberts
4880780.short_description: Grow cute creatures, decorate a floating island, and collect unique companions in the corner of your screen while you work or study.

4880810.title: CUMANIOK
4880810.short_description: Become a true "Gospodar" (Master) in a 3D open-world village life simulator! Control your character, drive the iconic countryside diesel wagon, build rural businesses, construct a traditional "Casa Mare" house, and embrace the unforgettable cozy vibe!

4880870.title: Debtbound
4880870.short_description: Debtbound is an active, chill incremental game. Collect mountains of cash, clear your debt, survive, or raid vaults. Upgrade your massive skill tree and progress without boring tutorials. Relax and watch the numbers explode for 100% pure fun!

4880890.title: Laundromat Anomaly
4880890.short_description: Laundromat Anomaly is a short atmospheric walking sim set in a quiet, unattended laundromat. Watch the familiar space closely—some things aren't as you remember. Press Stop if something feels wrong, Continue if it doesn't. Finish your laundry and head home.

4880900.title: No Reserve
4880900.short_description: Star auctioneer Julian Ashby has three weeks to deliver Calthorpe's season-defining Aslanov Collection sale. As forgery, looted artefacts, and sanctioned money threaten his career, three women each hold a truth he can't un-know—and a romance he can't avoid choosing.

4880960.title: Moonlit Orchard
4880960.short_description: A dual-life cozy farming sim: ordinary by sunshine, moonlit magic by night. Wield magic to grow fantasy crops, tame elemental creatures as loyal companions, befriend mythical neighbors, and blend nature with magic to uncover why humanity vanished.

4881140.title: Nowhere Dawn
4881140.short_description: Nowhere Dawn is a survival action game set in a collapsed world. Move through cities and towns haunted by the infected, and follow the traces left behind by those who disappeared.

4881210.title: Mysis: The Return
4881210.short_description: Captured by the aggressive cat Mysis, you must search a terrifying house for useful items and missing digit papers to escape. Stay alert, overcome obstacles, and avoid Mysis before she hunts you down.

4881220.title: Checkate
4881220.short_description: Checkate is the roguelike deckbuilder about checkers. Spend gold on rule-bending upgrades, and absurd pieces. Build your deck, chain outrageous combos, crown unstoppable kings and battle iconic bosses. Will you break the balance before it breaks you?

4881230.title: Valhalla Reborn
4881230.genre: Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4881230.short_description: Welcome to Valhalla — a majestic and harsh world where legends are forged! Lead a band of loyal warriors, rise from a nameless jarl to a great chieftain, and conquer all nine realms of Norse mythology.

4881270.title: Mahjong Rush
4881270.short_description: MAHJONG RUSH is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

4881280.title: ECHO
4881280.short_description: Leave solid copies of yourself behind — then leap off them. Echo is a precision puzzle-platformer: place echoes to build your path, dash through lasers, and outsmart every room. No story, no filler — just you, your echoes, and the next challenge.

4881350.title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD
4881350.short_description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

4881390.title: Rouge's Flush
4881390.short_description: Rogue's Flush is a single-player poker roguelike deckbuilder where every hand is a heist. Recruit 70 Crew, cheat with 30 Tricks, buy Rackets, beat escalating Marks, and carry risky Long Con cases past the Pit Boss.

4881550.title: GEL RUN
4881550.short_description: GEL RUN is a colorful obstacle-course adventure where being flexible is your greatest power.

4881700.title: Hentai Clicker: Kaia is streaming
4881700.short_description: Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock scenes, outfits, and voice reactions with Kaia, a naughty volleyball player, in Hentai clicker: Kaia is streaming.

4881970.title: Football Boardroom
4881970.short_description: Football Boardroom is a football management sim from the boardroom, not the dugout. Run your club in weekly turns: hire managers, sign players, manage finances, and climb a four-tier league pyramid. Watch matchday unfold, call the shots as director, and fund the club with your hard earned cash.

4882040.title: My City
4882040.genre: Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4882040.short_description: My City is a free-to-play life simulation game where you forge your own path. You start with nothing but a tent and your dog—no apartment, no money, no security. From there, you decide how your life unfolds.

4882170.title: Voltus' Neon Nightmare - Colossal Cure
4882170.short_description: After the previous events, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it.

4882250.title: The Pathbound Wayfarer
4882250.short_description: The Pathbound Wayfarer is a pixel-style side-scrolling action card Roguelite. Use your cards to unleash attacks, spells, and items, choose routes on a branching map, collect cards and relics, and take on monsters, events, shops, elite fights, and bosses.

4882280.title: Tidy Up: Spaceship
4882280.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4882280.short_description: A cozy sci-fi tidy-up game. Gather the books scattered across your ship and sort each one into its rightful place. Play in calm normal gravity or start on Zero-G mode, where the books float in mid-air. No timers, no pressure.

4882320.title: QuietCorner
4882320.short_description: An adult emotional romance visual novel set in a quiet café. Read the story, make choices, and follow two lonely adults as they slowly grow closer. Features: choices, save/load, backlog, auto, skip, Korean voice acting, and consensual adult romantic content.

4882560.title: OVERHEAT PROTOCOL
4882560.short_description: OVERHEAT PROTOCOL is a fast-paced FPS action roguelike where you survive escalating robot waves, build absurd weapon synergies, and push your gun past its limits before the arena overwhelms you.

4882620.title: InfiniteConflict
4882620.genre: Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4882620.short_description: A free, tick-based strategy MMO where the clock never stops. Expand from one planet across six galaxies, command mega-fleets, and forge alliances. One turn every hour - a war that never sleeps.

4882720.title: Floor404
4882720.short_description: There is something wrong with this hospital. Find every anomaly and escape alive.

4882830.title: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator
4882830.short_description: Fantasy football, any time of year — no off-season, no waiting. Draft your team, outsmart your friends, play sneaky trick cards, wheel clever trades and dodge the injury curse. Experience the best fantasy Football simulator and lift the trophy.

4882970.title: Last Hope: Zombie Autobattler
4882970.short_description: No health bars, no game over screens! Last Hope is a chill idle autobattler focused entirely on progression. Build your automated bullet hell, sit back, and melt zombies before they reach your indestructible shield. The faster you wipe them out, the more loot you gather for your lab.

4883050.title: The Forgotten Ones
4883050.short_description: A story-driven adventure about a family uprooted by violence and slowly drifting away from their heritage. Walk through memories and fading traditions to discover a tender journey about identity, resilience, and the quiet beauty of the things we forget, yet still define us.

4883060.title: Nanoquarium
4883060.short_description: A whisper-quiet aquarium that lives in the corner of your screen. Collect 200+ real-world fish across tropical, coldwater and reef tanks, breed them for rare strains, run a whole fishroom, and let the tank tick over while you work. No pressure, no fail state — just your fish, drifting.

4883100.title: Unwanted Experiment
4883100.short_description: Escape from the laboratory before being part of a macabre experiment.

4883190.title: Escape from the Shadows
4883190.short_description: Detective Larsen has received an odd request: Bring someone from the afterlife.

4883200.title: Beyond the Room
4883200.short_description: Enter an abandoned building haunted by rituals, witchcraft, and a dark past. Follow the signals from the fifth floor, solve eerie puzzles, rescue a trapped soul, and uncover the truth behind the spirits beyond the room

4883210.title: Hidden Memories
4883210.short_description: Lucian wakes up trapped with no memory of how he got there. Explore fragments of the previous night, solve dark puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and discover the terrifying truth buried within his forgotten memories.

4883300.title: Bad Signal
4883300.short_description: A social-deduction platformer for 4 to 8 players where a team secretly steers a shared robot to the exit while hidden saboteurs try to make the run fail.

4883580.title: The One Fish
4883580.short_description: An online co-op game for 1-4 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

4883670.title: Smiling Mascots
4883670.short_description: Smiling Mascots is the leading company in creating cheerful and unforgettable mascots. Take control of Sofia as she investigates the mysterious disappearance of the company's founder and discovers that some smiles are far more disturbing than they appear.

4883680.title: OASIS II
4883680.short_description: OASIS II is a 1-5 player co-op FPS inspired by extraction shooters and roguelikes. Travel across an alternate-history Japan while building your reputation with various contacts across the country.

4883780.title: Trenchcoat Adventurer Vol 1 : Gone Rogue
4883780.short_description: An unforgiving roguelike permadeath turn-based dungeon crawler sees Topp, Meedul, and Bawtom fresh out of retirement and back on the hunt for loot and shinies. 30 hand-crafted floors with multiple variants each — virtually endless unique runs. Stronger enemies. New dangers. Can you survive?

4883820.title: Kitchen of Gods
4883820.short_description: Greece is starving! Build and manage your god-run tavérna along the road before Hades lures your people into the Underworld with promises of a full belly.

4883840.title: Arlo Part I: The Past
4883840.short_description: Arlo has spent her life running from her gift. Now the past has come knocking. She must defeat her demons — metaphorically and literally — to have a chance to rescue her grandmother from eternal torture.

4883890.title: Octo Armada
4883890.short_description: Octo Armada is a fast-paced space shooter roguelite with bullet heaven gameplay. Pilot your spaceship through relentless waves of Octos, collect Crystals from defeated enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and create devastating builds to survive against the endless invasion.

4883910.title: Seize Siege TD
4883910.short_description: Build a deck to protect your king in this tower defense! Select your king, your cards and create your combos.

4883940.title: Game Master Club Simulator
4883940.short_description: Run your own tabletop roleplaying club! Stock miniatures, dice, and game accessories, set your prices, hire staff, and rent out tables. Step behind the screen to run living RPG sessions where your choices shape the story across different universes and settings.

4884010.title: Project Eel
4884010.short_description: You are the last remaining human in a vast underground research facility. Travel between sectors in a mobile laboratory, complete critical tasks, uncover safe routes, and find the cure before Project Eel transforms you into a human-eel hybrid, while something monstrous hunts you in the darkness.

4884110.title: Ni-Vanuatu Dominatrixes Are the Best
4884110.short_description: Experience a brutal session with Goddess Marie as she uses you as her personal stress relief and punching bag while showering you with relentless verbal abuse.

4884380.title: The Goblins Tavern
4884380.short_description: Set out to rescue the innkeepers kidnapped by trolls and goblins! Build a powerful deck, explore a dangerous world, and battle countless enemies in this strategic card-based roguelike adventure.

4884410.title: Smile, We're Watching
4884410.short_description: Reality shifts when unobserved. Solve first-person puzzles using cameras, mirrors, and darkness to manipulate quantum objects. Survive your Ministry of Observation sentence while watched by a supervisor who hates paperwork.

4884440.title: Scary Stories: Grotesque
4884440.short_description: Inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, this short horror visual novel takes you through familiar places—a late-night subway, an empty theater, a foggy mountain road, and a dark bedroom. Encounter inexplicable entities, ominous signs, and horrors that feel disturbingly real.

4884560.title: GodWright
4884560.short_description: Sculpt a tiny pixel world, seed it with life, and watch civilizations rise on their own. Kingdoms war, trade, and crown kings; dynasties fall to rebellion; whole ages turn. A cozy god-game sandbox where the story isn't scripted — it's discovered. No goals, no clock. Just a tiny world that lives.

4884590.title: DEBTMASTER
4884590.short_description: You're drowning in debt and the interest never stops. Grind every hustle you can find -- card games, crypto mining, gig deliveries, content farming, and more -- while stacking upgrades from a pool of 1,000+. Automate with bots. Pay off your debt or drown trying. A roguelite capitalism satire.

4884620.title: SimPoker
4884620.short_description: Build the card room of your dreams. SimPoker is a pixel-art poker-room tycoon: lay out tables, hire dealers, run the cage, manage waitlists and staff, and host nightly tournaments. Every hand is really dealt, so sit down and play yourself or run the floor and rake it in.

4884670.title: NOIRVANA
4884670.short_description: A high-speed noir FPS where movement is your weapon. Slide, dive, wall-run, grapple, and turn every kill into score—before the red on screen becomes yours.

4884680.title: Meerk Hunt
4884680.short_description: Meerk Hunt is a psychological horror game set inside a single bedroom on a single night in 1998. Uncover what a mysterious company really wants from you before your father catches you awake — or the night simply ends, and nothing is ever explained.

4884960.title: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion
4884960.short_description: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

4885310.title: SPACE DASHER
4885310.short_description: A minimalist arcade space shooter with roguelite elements. Left-click to shoot, right-click to Blink through enemies, and survive increasingly difficult waves while building your ship with random upgrades.

4885370.title: StarCinder
4885370.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer space combat where three factions battle across arenas, ore runs, and sector conquest with customizable ships, gunships, squadrons, NPC fleets, and progression.

4885560.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
4885560.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Yanesen, Tokyo's "Cat Town," finding little sparkling things and collecting them in a notebook. It keeps you company as you type, and may leave a small letter when you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of quiet discovery and collection.

4885590.title: Cosmic Mart
4885590.short_description: Step into Cosmic Mart, the space supermarket where the deal of the day is certain death. Wipe out the relentless alien infestation devouring the facility in this frantic action roguelike. Choose your mercenary and survive long enough to reach the sixth floor.

4885620.title: Ocean Rush
4885620.short_description: Ocean Rush is a fast-paced ocean escape adventure where every second counts!

4885880.title: Sky Scramble
4885880.short_description: Local multiplayer air combat across three eras of aviation history. Fight gravity and your friends. Bail out, parachute down, pull out your pistol, and make it personal. Up to 4 players.

4885920.title: Tower Match Tactics
4885920.short_description: Match tiles to gather resources, then spend them to build the units and towers that defend your king. A hybrid of match-3, tower defense and deck-building, set on a corrupted island you once ruled and have returned to reclaim.

4885930.title: Killer Kevin
4885930.short_description: Killer Kevin is a fast paced first person boomer shooter. you play as Kevin, an Australian man who is the apprentice to the wizard Stewart.

4886010.title: Destroy Buildings With Missiles
4886010.short_description: Destroy Buildings With Missiles is an incremental destruction game. Destroy buildings to earn money. Spend money to upgrade your arsenal. Destroy some more buildings.

4886040.title: 魔法少女甜心 Magical Girl Sweetheart
4886040.short_description: Magical Girl Sweetheart turns all scenes into dessert-themed wonderlands with match-link gameplay. There are 20 major scenes, each containing 3 renovation stages, with over 430 different desserts in total. There are no time limits, and players can unlock all achievements easily.

4886080.title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
4886080.short_description: Action-RPG Top-down view of Anubis in the Egyptian afterlife: fast melee combat, dashes, relics, and battles with hordes of the dead and ancient gods.

4886100.title: 魔法少女甜心3D Magical Girl Sweetheart 3D
4886100.short_description: Magical Girl Sweetheart turns all scenes into dessert-themed wonderlands with match-link gameplay. There are 20 major scenes, each containing 3 renovation stages, with over 430 different desserts in total. There are no time limits, and players can unlock all achievements easily.

4886170.title: Hand Physics Lab
4886170.short_description: Enjoy VR like never before with full control of your hands and fingers to interact physically with your environment and many different objects and experiences!

4886200.title: Surgineer
4886200.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of being a real surgeon? Well… you will not learn that here. Discover a crazy universe where you get the opportunity to be the greatest or most terrible doctor.

4886250.title: ExSpelled
4886250.short_description: ExSpelled is a multiplayer social-deduction game about wizards brewing powerful spells. Dark Wizards have infiltrated the Wizard Council. Your only chance is to work together, brew spells, collect clues and fight the darkness. But who can you trust?

4886270.title: 疗爆HELAX
4886270.short_description: 《疗爆》，独一无二的策略构筑动作射击新作。踏入支离破碎的意识疗界，操控'医疗器具'，猎杀活体病灶。发掘烧蚀症的末日真相，找出并救治'真正'的病人。

4886450.title: Hexzen
4886450.short_description: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Use logic alone to read the clues and clear each board. Master a handcrafted campaign, enjoy infinite custom puzzles, and shape your own challenges with the built-in level editor.

4886540.title: Rookspell
4886540.short_description: Rookspell is a roguelike chess deckbuilder where tactical positioning meets chaotic card play. Outmaneuver your opponents with grandmaster strategy or break the board entirely with powerful card combos. Win through pure skill or draft an unstoppable play. The choice is yours!

4886580.title: Dither Paradox
4886580.short_description: Shift between realities to uncover the dark secrets of The Spire. Dither Paradox is an atmospheric 2D hard sci-fi metroidvania where movement is the game and combat is a consequence. Collect modules, choose your build, and slowly remember the person you used to be.

4886650.title: 樱桃客栈
4886650.short_description: A story-driven visual novel. Inherit your grandmother's inn, tucked deep in the mountains — Yingtao Inn. Leave the city behind. The inn has no sign, yet wanderers find their way. Never ignore the one rule: be back before midnight. Yingtao Inn awaits.

4886760.title: Bull&Bear Crypto Trading Simulator
4886760.short_description: Turn $1,000 into a crypto empire: 34 coins, up to 100x leverage, real liquidations. Unlock the options desk, spoof the order book with fake $10M walls, move markets as the whale — then run your own fund. Survive exchange hacks, stablecoin depegs and cascading crashes 📈

4886810.title: Mobsteria: Rise
4886810.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4886810.short_description: Start with empty pockets and a pickpocket's nerve. Build a criminal empire one racket at a time in this atmospheric pixel-art idle game. Train your skills, run your crew, manage the heat - and when the law closes in, burn it all down and rise again, stronger.

4886830.title: Dimensional Breach
4886830.short_description: 4-player online co-op. The rifts are open, and every dimension hides a different threat. Dive in with your friends, tear the nightmare out by its roots and seal the breach or be lost to the dark.

4886960.title: Sporebound
4886960.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4886960.short_description: A group of adventurers has vanished across a chain of mysterious islands. Explore dangerous biomes, combine elemental magic to create powerful spells, battle corrupted creatures, uncover ancient relics, and rescue the lost adventurers as you track down the source of a spreading corruption.

4887050.title: PUREFIRE LIFE STREAM
4887050.short_description: Purefire Life Stream is a first-person psychological horror game. In recent years, livestreaming daily life has become a worldwide phenomenon. Explore a slow-paced world beginning with a livestreamed penthouse tour expanding into unsettling realism and terror.

4887350.title: This Little World
4887350.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4887350.short_description: Britain has fallen silent. In a vast 1:1 recreation of the entire island, built from real-world data, begin on foot and bring harmony back to the land: restoring every road, valley, field, town, and tree. Unlock vehicles, reconnect regions, and explore all 200,000 km² of England, Wales and Scotland.

4887360.title: erdetspill
4887360.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4887360.short_description: Bestefar vil ha 2 is. Du må skaffe de. Det viser seg å være mer komplisert enn du trodde. Et absurd førstepersons-eventyrspill der du navigerer norsk byråkrati, snakker med rare folk og løser meningsløse oppdrag - i en liten norsk bygd.

4887450.title: Tower 6: Last Signal
4887450.short_description: Alone in a remote forest watchtower, your first night on duty turns into a tense fight to understand the signals coming through the radio. Watch the treeline, respond to unsettling events, and survive whatever is moving in the dark.

4887490.title: Axis Flip
4887490.short_description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

4887550.title: THROB
4887550.short_description: THROB is a psychological horror platformer where a living brutalist nightmare reacts to your fear. As your heartbeat accelerates, blood rises, the architecture awakens, and the climb becomes increasingly unstable.

4887610.title: Last Rail
4887610.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

4887630.title: KEYKRUNCHER™
4887630.short_description: KEYKRUNCHER™ is the fun and effective treatment for all your keyboard-eating needs! Look down, follow the monitor, press the correct KEY, and KRUNCH. EAT the whole keyboard before IT eats you.

4887660.title: Waderverse
4887660.short_description: Following a large-scale societal collapse, explore a crazy, disturbed world of confrontational sickos and clashing ideologies.

4887750.title: Until Done
4887750.short_description: While tracing the mysterious disappearance of three children, a woman journalist finds herself trapped in a living nightmare at a desolate farm. Plunge into the dead of night with a first-person perspective—Until Done will test your sanity with its bone-chilling atmosphere!

4887790.title: ORU IN THE VOID
4887790.short_description: A story-driven atmospheric platformer about loneliness, memories, and the struggles we carry within ourselves. Guide Oru through a mysterious void and overcome precise challenges in a journey shaped by symbolism and hope.

4887830.title: Liminal Protocol
4887830.short_description: A retro CRT survival horror game powered by a custom WebGL ASCII raycasting engine. Calibrate nodes, survive anomalies, and climb the leaderboards solo or with friends in Steam P2P co-op. Early Access: actively developing new maps, game modes, and entities. Keep eye contact.

4887840.title: Indian Paranormal Files - Sleepover
4887840.short_description: What starts as a normal sleepover quickly turns into a terrifying paranormal nightmare. Explore the house, investigate strange occurrences, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the haunting before it's too late.

4888010.title: SOUL MIXER
4888010.short_description: A 2D rhythm action game for arcade sticks and keyboards, featuring full vocals and satisfying key sounds! Unlock tracks through the story, manage fatigue, and customize difficulty with items or parts. This game prioritizes "the joy of playing" and immersion over punishing difficulty.

4888040.title: Soldier Offensive
4888040.short_description: Soldier Offensive offers an action-packed first person shooterexperience. As a soldier, engage in intense combat against enemy forces, complete missions, and turn the tide of war. You are invited to the front lines with its atmospheric and fast-paced gameplay

4888170.title: Your Young Mother: NSFW PUZZLE
4888170.short_description: A relaxing 18+ image puzzle game where you assemble fragmented pictures. Complete 100 levels to unlock a growing private gallery. Simple gameplay focused on progression, visuals, and light puzzle mechanics.

4888240.title: Hermitage
4888240.short_description: A first-person survival-horror game about grief, set in the rain-drowned forests of Jharkhand, India — where every day you survive deforms you a little further.

4888530.title: Airline Legacy
4888530.short_description: A football-manager-style career sim — but you run airlines. Get hired as a CEO, answer to a ruthless board, and build your reputation contract by contract: fly to 1,000+ cities, fight for slots, sign your team, launch campaigns, and outmaneuver rival executives. Or go sandbox in Historical Mode.

4888720.title: Zombie City Together
4888720.short_description: Take on a city overrun by zombies with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, spitting hordes. Fight by day, hunt in the dark of night. Tear off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

4888740.title: Project Matter
4888740.short_description: Project Matter is a 2D factory automation game about turning raw inputs into an ever-expanding production web. Place buildings on an infinite grid, draw connections between them, and research new processing chains, waste recovery loops, and advanced materials.

4888830.title: Close to the Scene
4888830.short_description: Rob five locations, dodge the cops, and turn a quiet low-poly town into total chaos. Stealth pays, noise gets you caught — how long can you stay one step ahead?

4888860.title: Loss Limit
4888860.short_description: Loss Limit is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside a sports-betting startup three weeks after a VIP player's suicide. Play Knox Mercer and choose one of three relationships—forbidden affair, grieving ex-wife, or hostile regulator—while an IPO and investigation close in.

4889030.title: Grombo Card Shop Idle
4889030.short_description: Run a tiny card shop while you do other things. Open packs of absurd Grombos, sell singles, restock shelves, decorate your shop, and watch weird customers walk in, buy cards, or leave deeply confused.

4889070.title: GALMEGI
4889070.short_description: Become Untamed. Become a Beast. In a city where swagger is currency, violence is language, and the weak are crushed first, you begin as a bottom-rank gang member in Posan City, only to be dragged deeper and deeper into a more dangerous world.

4889120.title: Burn Tree Burn
4889120.short_description: An incremental about burning down a forest. Drag a flame across the trees, watch the fire chain from grove to grove, and bank charcoal to make every burn hotter, hungrier and in a larger forest.

4889190.title: Fijian Dominatrixes Are the Best
4889190.short_description: Experience a session with Goddess Miriama, the giant, sadistic, wealthy, playful, and dominant Fijian dominatrix as she uses her 202 cm height to bully, torment, and humiliate you.

4889220.title: Speff
4889220.short_description: Run, jump, and THINK your way through a series of grisly obstacles and diabolical puzzles. 20 Levels across 5 hubs with wonderfully hand drawn environments and characters.

4889480.title: Restcue
4889480.short_description: You wake up in your familiar home, only to find yourself completely locked inside. Search for clues, evade an unknown presence, and piece together forgotten memories... In this confined space, the real terror is only just beginning. A intense 30-minute psychological horror experience.

4889520.title: DigitDash3
4889520.short_description: Digit Dash 3 is a live Twitch and Kick chat party game where up to 7 viewers compete for the highest score on a shared game board. Players join by typing !digit in chat and take turns moving a single game piece across a 13×13 grid of numbered cells.

4889540.title: Citadel Zero
4889540.short_description: Defend the last citadel on a dying alien world. Summon a gacha collection of bio-engineered defense towers, forge a custom loadout, and conquer three modes, story-driven Chronicle, roguelite Contracts, and 1v1 PvP Ascension. Tower defense meets deck-building meta-progression.

4889560.title: Rush Hollow
4889560.short_description: Rush Hollow is a movement shooter with a big heart and a lot of guts! Over-the-top gibs, deadly traps, and an onslaught of relentless enemies come together in a mash up of color and carnage.

4889620.title: The Rich Die First
4889620.short_description: Compete against friends or AI in a ruthless race for wealth. Invest in stocks, buy real estate, play powerful cards, and make smart decisions to become the richest player before everyone else.

4889630.title: 从零开始的钓鱼人生Lift
4889630.short_description: A roguelike × fishing × reincarnation simulator. No learning curve—experience the joy of float fishing in just 1 minute. Over 100 talents and gear pieces to mix and match, with a fresh build every run. Unlock a rich storyline through reincarnation cycles and find your own best ending

4889660.title: Don't Make a Sound
4889660.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

4889740.title: Mow My World
4889740.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4889740.short_description: Mow My World is a free-to-play modular robotic platform sandbox where you mow lawns, clear snow, tow cargo, fly in AirMode, build with blocks, and explore landmarks across Earth, the Moon, and Mars. Load real-world maps, save neighborhoods, and turn public places into playable communities.

4889770.title: Boompaw
4889770.short_description: Boompaw is a chaotic physics party-brawler where roly-poly cats sumo-slam, ragdoll, and bomb each other clean off the arena. Master the shove, time the blast, survive the chaos, and be the last cat standing across explosive themed arenas. Easy to learn, impossible to keep a straight face.

4889940.title: The Door
4889940.short_description: The Door is a first-person horror adventure game. To escape from a dream, the protagonist must confront his past and continue moving forward. What lies beyond the red door? And what truth is hidden within the protagonist’s past?

4889950.title: Reefling: A Cozy Desktop Aquarium
4889950.short_description: Reefling is a calm desktop aquarium that sits in the corner of your screen. Feed your fish with a click, earn shells over time, and collect over 150 pixel-art species. Decorate the tank and watch day turn to night. Your fish never starve and you can't lose, so just relax while you work.

4890150.title: EMIT:Embrace Beyond Time
4890150.short_description: In a near-future city ruled by AI system EDEN, you become a Memory Restorer, entering the past to fix events deemed wrong. But each restoration changes reality. When the optimal solution demands you abandon her, will you save the world, or save the one who should not remain?

4890160.title: I love Laura
4890160.short_description: I Love Laura is a visual novel with sandbox adventure elements. You can freely explore the city, interact with various characters, and decide how - and most importantly, with whom - you’ll spend your time. Get ready for an adventure full of humor, intense sex, betrayal, and group fun.

4890170.title: Tank Mates
4890170.short_description: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

4890280.title: A Lucky Hunt With : Rissa
4890280.short_description: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Rissa, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Rissa's enticing layers.

4890480.title: Slippery
4890480.short_description: Slippery is a fast-paced 2D platformer where precision and reaction mean everything. Master unique sliding mechanics and slime transitions to overcome challenging levels. Embark on a dangerous journey to defeat the evil troll and save your cat, Wink!

4890630.title: The Golden Girl Case
4890630.short_description: As a young private investigator trainee in 2006, you dive into the early internet - social profiles, websites, photos, and archived news - to uncover the truth behind Emily Parker’s death, ruled as an accident after a late-night gathering

4890720.title: Galatria
4890720.short_description: A fast, retro 3D arcade shoot-'em-up. Pilot your fighter across scrolling battlefields, thread floating island labyrinths where one wrong move is fatal, and blast through relentless waves and screen-filling bosses. Inspired by the 80's and 90's Arcade Games of the Times.

4890750.title: Taskbar Caravan
4890750.short_description: A tiny trading simulation beside your taskbar. Buy goods, read market prices, restore towns, and open new roads while a small caravan travels quietly on your desktop.

4890760.title: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
4890760.short_description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

4890800.title: Hexborne
4890800.short_description: A turn-based roguelite RPG. Draw a single line connecting weapons, shields, and potions across hex tiles to attack, defend, and survive. Longer chains hit harder but risk more. Battle across four chapters and a branching world map. A modern reimagining of the cult classic Dungeon Raid.

4890840.title: IVAN (Iter Vehemens ad Necem)
4890840.short_description: A roguelike classic. Gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes.

4890980.title: Red Reconquest
4890980.short_description: Red Reconquest is a turn-based hex strategy game set on Mars in 2247. Command Earth Coalition Forces through 8 campaigns to liberate New Olympus from the MLC. Classic hex wargame inspired by Panzer General.

4890990.title: RoguePunk
4890990.short_description: A turn-locked cyberpunk roguelike built around high-stakes quick-time duels. Build lethal cyberware synergies, conquer brutal bosses, and reboot the system.

4891010.title: Rust & Ruin
4891010.short_description: Rust & Ruin is a deckbuilder battler about robot fights. Each round you'll draw a random hand, gamble your coins to redraw for better odds, and manage your budget to build a bot tough enough to survive whatever the arena throws at you!

4891040.title: Gods Shall Tremble
4891040.genre: Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4891040.short_description: Gods Shall Tremble is a deep, text-based gladiator management sim. Program granular fight plans, balance 16 stats, 67.5 Million Behavioural Combinations and loot 15 Million unique items to compete in multiple PvE modes, PvP leaderboards, and friendly and permadeath tournaments to cement your legacy.

4891090.title: Sweet Club
4891090.short_description: Sweet Club - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around a club. Spend enjoyable time with five pretty and cute girls in a club, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4891130.title: 雨梦江湖
4891130.short_description: 一个安静的夜晚，窗外飘来阵阵雨声，你在电脑前玩着你最喜欢的游戏，不知过了多久你有点困了便趴着睡着了，梦里你来到一个既熟悉又陌生的地方，一个江湖的故事就此拉开序幕...

4891140.title: Vexbound
4891140.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4891140.short_description: Vexbound is a free tactical puzzle-battler RPG where one slide can chain into a storm. Line up troops, raise walls, summon elites and champions, and break the enemy hero across a story campaign, AI duels, private rooms, and ranked online PvP.

4891180.title: SIGNAL//LOSS
4891180.short_description: SIGNAL//LOSS is a minimalist arcade survival game about keeping a collapsing signal alive. Each run starts readable, then escalates into faster rings, hostile glitches, screen noise, and split-second survival decisions. Tune the rings. Hold the signal. Delay the collapse.

4891260.title: NEON SURGE
4891260.short_description: A fast, neon twin-stick arena shooter: you aim, your ship auto-fires. Dash through bullets, hold off ever-bigger waves and pick roguelite upgrades each wave. 8 ships, 10 worlds, 7 modes.

4891330.title: Baseball Empire
4891330.short_description: A pro baseball management simulation. Use the draft, free agency, and foreign imports to build the ultimate team. Players grow and decline with age, suffer unexpected injuries, and break out as hidden potential erupts. Some may even transfer to overseas leagues.

4891410.title: Ring Toss Legend
4891410.short_description: Ring Toss Legend is a casual physics game where you toss rings onto prize pegs, earn coins, upgrade your skills, and chase bigger rewards as you explore new stages.

4891420.title: JobLoop
4891420.short_description: JobLoop is an immersive RPG where you play as Justin, a candidate for a mysterious job interview at a secretive technology company. Explore a dynamic, story-rich world, featuring choices and consequences, immersive levels and multiple endings. Get the job or die trying!

4891620.title: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown
4891620.short_description: A Living World RPG where NPCs live their own lives. Travel with your wolf companion, explore a changing world, and witness stories shaped by memory, relationships, and ambition.

4891650.title: PlantUp
4891650.short_description: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

4891660.title: Programmed To Execute
4891660.short_description: Instruct a robot to resolve hostage situations in this tactical programming puzzle game. Use guns, lasers, explosions, and even the environment to save every hostage. No prior programming knowledge required.

4865990.title: The Great Ebony Clock
4865990.short_description: Explore a cozy point-and-click mystery where your only way to escape is by manipulating time. Shift between different times of the same day, find clues and items to escape the Great Ebony Clock’s Time Prison. You never thought you’d be so happy to see Monday.

4866160.title: XiuXian Idle Cultivation
4866160.short_description: Sneaky Cultivation is a transparent desktop idle RPG about quietly growing stronger while you work or study. Keep a tiny battle window on screen, auto-slay monsters, collect gear and treasures, combine cultivation skills, and break through from Qi Refining to True Immortal.

4866460.title: Bombeard
4866460.short_description: Blow up your friends in a retro-innovative adaptation of the classic bomberman genre. Create and share your own maps, and play locally with up to 4 controllers or against your friends online.

4866480.title: Alluring Event Planner Invites Me In
4866480.short_description: Ezra works as a contract negotiator during the day and a signal hijacker at night. A wiretap plunges him into a crisis. On the verge of death in a car accident, he gains a new power and is then drawn into a mysterious game, uncovering the secrets of the Balance Management Department.

4866630.title: MONOCHROME ANGEL
4866630.short_description: Explore the derelict ruins of abandoned megastructures in this slow-paced first-person platformer. Discover movement upgrades to facilitate platforming and exploration. Find data logs of those who have gone before to uncover the lore of this dark world. //RETURN TO HEMRON, O FALLEN//

4866640.title: Trippy Plains
4866640.short_description: FEEL WHAT IT'S LIKE TO FLY FPV Trippy Plains is an FPV drone simulator built for both total beginners and experienced pilots. Strap into the cockpit of a 5" freestyle quad, a racing drone, a collective-pitch helicopter or a tiny whoop then fly anywhere you want across 15 distinct worlds.

4867150.title: Gate
4867150.short_description: Assume the role of a Gate Hunter and explore the dangerous worlds hidden behind the ancient Gateways, defeat hordes of monsters and hoard as much loot as possible. Customize your character and go from a nobody to a horde slaying machine.

4867700.title: Brainrot Fight
4867700.short_description: An auto-chess strategy battle game. Buy and merge Brainrot creature cards, build your quirky team, and watch them fight automatically. Collect 120+ wild creatures, mix skills and items, and defeat every opponent!
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

4868180.title: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
4868180.short_description: A 3D tactics RPG set in a fantasy retelling of the Imjin War of 1592 in korea. Command your squad across height-based grids where elemental matchups and terrain turn the tide. Branch through a three-tier class tree and forge deep equipment builds to make every unit your own.

4868190.title: KING of PROPS
4868190.short_description: Turn yourself into a coffee mug, a crate, or a fire extinguisher and fool the hunters! King of Props is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game: Disguise yourself as a prop, stick yourself to walls, use skills like Decoys and Mage Hand—and be the last undiscovered prop to claim the crown.

4869070.title: Delvegg
4869070.short_description: 《Delvegg》 is a desktop idle mining game. The core gameplay revolves around digging eggs, collecting pets, and building your underground mining empire.

4869180.title: GoatCart
