4869180.short_description: Wrestle for dominance with up to three friends or bots in absurd, physics‑based bumper‑car arenas. Use randomly spawning items to crank the chaos up even further.

4869220.title: Feetball
4869220.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

4869310.title: PINBOMB
4869310.short_description: The Pinball Roguelike! PINBOMB traps you in a room with a pinball machine hungry for higher and higher scores. Buy new parts to upgrade it, build wild synergies to feed the machine, and send your score through the roof. Oh, and there's a bomb strapped to it, so score big or go boom!

4869410.title: How Many Calories Are In A Muffin?
4869410.short_description: A short story about a difficult day at work and a painful breakup that lingers; about depression, anxiety, and how they can lead to eating disorders. Do you know how many calories are in a muffin? Are you ready for what the answer implies?

4869490.title: Stall Quest
4869490.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4869490.short_description: A shopkeeping simulation RPG for those who loved leaving shops open in old-school MMOs! Open a stall in Rei's dream, sell items gathered from dungeons, buy gear, and dive back in. Packed with 48 enemies, 30 items, and excitement! Try it out!
developers: こぐわらのAIゲーム開発部
publishers: こぐわらのAIゲーム開発部

4869530.title: According to the Emperor, Nothing Happened
4869530.short_description: No empire lasts forever. Challenge legendary Chinese emperors in this strategy card game by manipulating five national attributes through historical event cards and bringing their dynasties to collapse.

4869760.title: Blonde Doctor's Heart Beats Fast for Me
4869760.short_description: Thomas was on the verge of death after being attacked for exposing the evil deeds of the FX Group. He was taken over by a consciousness insect and became a digital life form. He got involved with Doctor Anna and Intelligence Agent Jennifer and jointly fought against the FX Group.

4869940.title: Anomaly : Rebirth
4869940.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4869940.short_description: Transformed by a plant supposed to save humanity, you are now tracked as the anomaly by the laboratory that made you. Will you be able to escape?

4870060.title: Garden Defence
4870060.short_description: Defend your garden from a bug invasion using everyday objects turned into turrets: magnifying glasses, garden hoses, UV lamps, and more. Upgrade your defenses, adapt to changing weather, and outsmart increasingly cunning enemies in this strategic tower defense with a backyard twist.

4870200.title: Cold Beauty Doctor Kneels to Submit
4870200.short_description: Eric, a low - level IT technician from Brooklyn, gets involved in the FX conspiracy to save his sister with a rare disease. After being transformed by the No. 7 consciousness insect, he starts his revenge and makes women like the cold - beauty doctor submit.

4870430.title: Tidy Up History
4870430.short_description: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.

4870770.title: Numbile - Monetize Your Math
4870770.short_description: Numbile is a unique puzzle strategy game with a blend of basic math. Embark on your new job as an intern mathematician, master eccentric characters, uncover powerful secrets, dominate deadly bosses, and pay off your student loans like there's no tomorrow.

4872180.title: Nutshot Simulator
4872180.short_description: A comedy physics shooting gallery: throw stuff, nail zany characters right in the nuts, and watch them ragdoll across mundane-yet-absurd locations. No score, no timer, no pressure — just you, a nutload of projectiles, and a deeply questionable hobby.

4872220.title: Ancestral Trace : Singkawang
4872220.short_description: Ancestral Trace: Singkawang is a cozy 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you help Lie Jun Hao, a young man who returns to his childhood city after eleven years away, uncover the story his family left behind.

4872320.title: Cardfight: Conspiracy
4872320.short_description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

4873200.title: Mr Twiddle's Wee Diddy Farm
4873200.short_description: MR TWIDDLE'S WEE DIDDY FARM DELUXE is a resource management roguelike of agricultural theming. Use farming to convert plants into materials for selling and potion brewing. Use a variety of crops and items to punch your way through hordes of chickens.

4873600.title: Precious Milf
4873600.short_description: A relaxing adult anime puzzle game set in a stylish office atmosphere. Complete illustrations, choose Easy or Hard difficulty, and unlock images in the Gallery.

4873610.title: Precious Milf 2
4873610.short_description: A relaxing adult anime puzzle game set in a stylish office atmosphere. Complete illustrations, choose Easy or Hard difficulty, and unlock images in the Gallery.

4874170.title: Balance: Umbilical Wake
4874170.short_description: Step into a fisherman’s recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the world’s rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your child’s birth begins to reshape it.

4874290.title: InCyanSpace
4874290.short_description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

4874340.title: Signal Foundry
4874340.short_description: A cozy idle game about reviving an abandoned deep-space refinery. Get the scanner running, dig up ore, build the machines that process it, and let your drones run the place while you're away. Two prestige layers, 30 achievements, a 19-track soundtrack, and no microtransactions, ever.

4874390.title: BrickSpace
4874390.short_description: BrickSpace is a 3 Dimensional Zero G Game, played with mouse where you prevent balls from getting pass you, and deflect them back inside toward bricks that get smashed when the ball collides with them. When all Bricks are cleared, you go to the next level.have shifting and rotating sections.

4874530.title: Detective Boto: Belle Memoir
4874530.short_description: A narrative game set in 1943 Belém, legends are vanishing, and the river’s secrets need a detective. Pink, if you will. As a shapeshifting river dolphin detective that turns into human (almost), uncover a noir mystery where folklore, memory, and conspiracy flow beneath the city.

4874970.title: Deck Forge
4874970.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: distinct classes, 500+ original cards, deadly relics, and branching trails that never play out the same way twice. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

4875040.title: PAN-DAE-MON-IUM
4875040.short_description: PAN-DAE-MON-IUM is a Mystery Dungeon inspired turn based RPG made with RPGMaker MV. Take control of sneering demons from the Ars Goetia as you traverse the Circles of Hell!

4875060.title: Rich List: The Order
4875060.short_description: A business simulation has never felt this epic. Trade stocks, build companies, take them public, unleash financial tidal waves, sit at the table of a high-stakes gambler’s night, and climb the Rich List. Then you realize: the other side of the board is called The Order.

4875090.title: SLANT
4875090.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer game where you reach the goal point by overcoming various traps and puzzles.

4875150.title: World Climate Lab
4875150.short_description: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

4875250.title: Mindscape
4875250.short_description: A unique blend of incremental progression and tower defense, set to the rhythm of the breath. Protect the Breath Center from Thoughts by releasing them through Awareness into Clarity.

4875270.title: ASCEND.exe
4875270.short_description: ASCEND.exe is a retro-horror incremental: build nodes, chain combos, upgrade production. Descend into the facility's abandoned sections to learn why it never stopped expanding.

4875310.title: Icon: Voidfall
4875310.short_description: Become Arafel, The Dark, in this story-driven RTS prequel to Icon. Corrupt the Choir, spread living corruption across Atrum, evolve monstrous armies, and bring an empire to ruin as you set the stage for the coming Voidfall.

4875320.title: In These Hallowed Halls
4875320.short_description: In These Hallowed Halls is a first person, psychological horror puzzle game. Make your way through a decrepit, abandoned mental Institution as you solve puzzles and unravel the story behind what lurks in the darkest corners of the building.

4875330.title: Gas Snacks & Tears
4875330.short_description: It's 2026. Airfare for five now costs more than the house, so the family drives a dying 2009 minivan from Missouri to Oregon. A deadpan comedy roguelite where the sushi is from a gas station, the memorials are 1-star reviews, and the check engine light is a mood. You will not all make it.

4875360.title: M7ZM Deal
4875360.short_description: A real-time multiplayer card game for up to 8 players. Collect lands, complete groups, and scheme your way to victory with action cards, treasures, and a shared Central Bank. work with the events, and alot more. Play with friends or against smart bots.

4875420.title: Happy Digger Go-Go
4875420.short_description: Play as a happy little digger bot, mine underground for minerals, sell your haul, buy upgrades, unlock cosmetics, collect pets, and dig deeper each run in this cute 2D mining adventure.

4875450.title: Daily War Online
4875450.short_description: Daily War — Build an island fortress tile by tile, design its defenses, and declare war on ELO-matched rivals. Drop a battle card to bend the rules, then watch the clash unfold. No twitch reflexes — just sharp building and smart timing. One war a day. Make it count.

4875460.title: Untangle
4875460.short_description: Untangle is a minimalist puzzle game about clearing crossed lines and sharpening your mind. Drag the points, separate every connection, and solve each tangled pattern in as few moves as possible. Simple to understand, satisfying to master.

4875500.title: Dice in Wonderland
4875500.short_description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Stack chips and multipliers into explosive scores, and forge every die in your pool with enhancements and engravings. Follow the Cheshire Cat through a dark Victorian Wonderland — one more run, all the way down the rabbit hole.

4875560.title: Ultimate Jam
4875560.genre: Sports, Free To Play, Early Access
4875560.short_description: 2-on-2 arcade ultimate frisbee — turbo sprints, bone-rattling shoves, layout dives, and a flaming disc that screams across the field.

4875580.title: Redline: Stampede
4875580.short_description: Explosive offroad racing with 32 vehicles on dynamic branching tracks. From Quad Bikes to Racing Trucks, weaving through shortcuts or plowing through trees, each vehicle has their own racing style.

4875590.title: Welderman Shop Sim
4875590.short_description: Build a welding shop from a single machine into a fabrication empire. Hire workers, manage production, complete contracts, upgrade equipment, and decide if you're staying in the shop or sending crews out on the road.

4875600.title: Selection Bias
4875600.short_description: In a Los Angeles fertility lab, scientist Adrian Sayre built the Index — an embryo-ranking algorithm sold as certainty. When the flagship baby is diagnosed with a disease the model called near-zero risk, three women each hold a piece of what was buried — and a different kind of romance.

4875680.title: Sealbound: Cthulhu Rising
4875680.short_description: A Lovecraftian card battle game. Pair two heroes, roll across a board-game dungeon, and assemble combos that break the numbers wide open — before the Doom Counter hits ten and the world gates collapse for good.

4876400.title: Chief Legal Officer Begs for My Orders
4876400.short_description: 24-year-old deliveryman Levi gets involved in a consciousness harvesting conspiracy while delivering food. He fuses with a consciousness insect to become a super digital life form, meets 42-year-old chief legal officer Saskia, and embarks on a dangerous yet alluring path of balance.

4876710.title: 乾坤玺•明
4876710.short_description: "Qiankun Seal·Ming" is an open-world role-playing game with a time-travel theme, crafted using UE5.

4876840.title: RANJIT
4876840.short_description: RANJIT is a brutal single-player survival game focused on physics, realism, and freedom. Unlike most open-world games, RANJIT does not provide maps, waypoints, or guidance. Players must rely entirely on their own sense of direction, forced to use their instincts, creating a true sense of freedom.

4876900.title: Goblin Gobblers
4876900.short_description: A chaotic rogue-lite blending time-pressured kitchen management with farming, fishing, stealth, and neighbourly theft. Run a restaurant for hungry goblins, gather ingredients by any means necessary, and survive ever-rising daily quotas, or risk ending up on the menu yourself.

4876970.title: Arkelia - The Fragile Inheritance
4876970.short_description: As Chancellor Kurt Baumann, steer a fragile republic through the aftermath of a civil war. Balance a divided cabinet, manage a bankrupt economy under military pressure, and face the looming threat of Nortelorian invasion. Will you save the Republic, or destroy it?

4877070.title: They Were Us
4877070.short_description: You're in for an exciting adventure about the main character Blake, who faces a ton of challenges before she uncovers the terrifying truth about this area. Various creepy creatures will appear along the way, as well as the surviving locals.

4877120.title: AJ's Anomaly
4877120.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror experience. Trapped on the 8th floor of a building that won't let her leave, AJ must identify what's changed in her fashion gallery if she ever wants the elevator to reach the ground.

4878520.title: Lady Legal Officer's Submission Training
4878520.short_description: Elijah was hunted by the FX Group and was reborn after fusing with the No. 7 Consciousness Insect. With the determination to take revenge and seek the truth, he maneuvers among various forces in different places, saves his allies, and uncovers the secrets of the Ethereal Singularity project.

4878670.title: To Type a Tale
4878670.short_description: To Type a Tale is a fantasy choose-your-own-adventure story where the only method of interaction is typing. Story progress, choices, and menus are all achieved through typing highlighted words.

4878700.title: Resurge: Europe Rising
4878700.short_description: Lead the Resistance and reclaim a AI & robot-occupied Europe in this unique blend of third-person shooter, RPG, and strategy. Capture strategic regions, protect your headquarters, and rebuild humanity in a colorful, cartoon-inspired adventure suitable for players of all ages.

4878710.title: 知夏
4878710.short_description: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

4879070.title: Meatballs
4879070.short_description: A fast, juicy bullet-hell roguelike where you're lunch fighting back. Pick from 11 meatballs, blast through 10 levels of waves and 5 outrageous bosses, and build a god-tier meatball from 30 weapons & 55 items — without stacking so much you literally fall apart.

4879200.title: Frog Adventure
4879200.short_description: Frog Adventure is a cozy puzzle arcade game about a frog trying to get home. Jump between cells, avoid cars, cross rivers on logs, collect crowns for perfect completion, and compete against a friend in a local race.

4879210.title: AMATERASU【 天照 】
4879210.short_description: A dramatic bullet hell shooter where you master your Shot, Bomb, and the Yatano Kagami System, which transmutes enemy bullets into resources, as you fight to overthrow AMATERASU, the Stellar Management System that has launched its assault on humanity.

4879530.title: Stella Echoes
4879530.short_description: A puzzle game where you move two characters at the same time with a single input. Explore two worlds where left and right are reversed, and use walls, conveyors, and one-way gates to solve precise spatial puzzles.

4880030.title: Echoes Of The Unseen
4880030.short_description: Echoes Of The Unseen is a psychological horror game combining stealth, exploration, and puzzle-solving. Navigate a haunting world, uncover hidden truths, and confront your fears as reality blurs. Experience tense atmosphere and player-driven storytelling in this immersive journey!

4880040.title: VHS Store Tycoon
4880040.short_description: Run your own video rental store in the golden years of VHS: buy movie rights, handle your customers, rewind tapes, and build a home-entertainment empire. A time capsule you can play.

4880060.title: Space Dogfight: Infinite
4880060.short_description: No health bars to hide behind. No progression curve to cushion you. Just you and your inertia. In a cold pixel void, pure dogfighting — drift to find that one lethal shot. Luck won't help. Only skill.

4880470.title: Water Spirit Escape
4880470.short_description: Water Spirit Escape is a top-down grid-based puzzle game. You are a round, squishy water droplet. Every step you take consumes water - one wrong move, and the spirit will dry up and disappear.

4880560.title: Unclaimed
4880560.short_description: It's 1991. You work alone on the night shift at a remote cargo facility. As you sort shipments and complete your tasks, unexplained noises from the hallways, strange images appearing on security cameras, and a growing sense of unease begin to turn your shift into a nightmare.

4880660.title: MeowPlay
4880660.short_description: A relaxing and heartwarming casual stacking game. Take command of the Cat Helicopter to stack toy towers in the swaying wind, and rescue every cat clinging to the vines.

4880720.title: Son of Beach
4880720.short_description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

4880930.title: Sunward
4880930.short_description: A deep, relaxed space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, and trade on a living market while you build a modular station, grow a colony, and expand across the solar system and beyond into a freighter-linked empire.

4881020.title: Tumly
4881020.short_description: Tumly is a 2.5D physics survival game where you steer a tumbling ball across drifting, colliding platforms. Master momentum, unlock belt-ranked abilities, and survive nine biomes across three difficulty modes — from a full challenge to cozy, low-stakes tumbling. Don't fall. Keep tumbling.

4881310.title: 0N35H07
4881310.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play
4881310.short_description: 0N35H07 (ONESHOT) - arcade first/third person 3d shooter about balls that shoot lasers at each others. It's free game, and it's source code is open to view and change. Multiplayer, decent bot AI, character customization, amazing soundtrack.

4881410.title: the epic and amazing adventure of gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX the adventure where gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX lives and becomes king gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX
4881410.short_description: play as gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX and decide the best life for him to live

4881430.title: HueTrix
4881430.short_description: HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike twist: clear lines to earn cash, then spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics. Chain combos across seven colors, stack permanent upgrades, and build a game-breaking run. Easy to learn, endlessly deep, full controller support.ㄴ

4881490.title: FinSim
4881490.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4881490.short_description: Your turn to manipulate the market! A financial market simulator where you can choose your own path. Manipulate news, events, and financial engineering to make billions. Or play honestly, growing companies the legal way. Coming soon!

4881530.title: Study Nook
4881530.short_description: Study tools included: Pomodoro timer To-do list Built-in media player with a hand-picked selection of lofi, ambient, and orchestral music Internet browser to stream any audio (Full Version) Play fetch with your companion dog Tend to your garden

4881570.title: The Quiet Cold
4881570.short_description: Gather fuel, build shelter, and keep your fires burning. Warmth keeps you alive, but it may attract roaming Giants. Save downed allies before the cold takes them, or something may rise from their bodies...

4881960.title: Void Beserk
4881960.short_description: A Vampire Survivors-style action game with Asteroids-style mechanics and endless progression. Stay on top, destroy everything, explore every sector, and survive over 100 hordes. Customize your ship and play cooperatively with friends.

4882240.title: A Dark Cave
4882240.short_description: Survive in a cruel world, build and expand your village, and descend into the darkness below. Gather resources, make difficult choices, and uncover the unspeakable truth hidden deep within the cave in this dark incremental game.

4882500.title: Clay Clinic
4882500.short_description: A chaotic co-op medical job sim for up to 6 players. Treat clay patients, run risky procedures, fix your friends’ mistakes, and survive each hospital shift without causing too much malpractice.

4882740.title: PokerField
4882740.short_description: A turn-based tactical duel with battlefield and classic card deck. Place a card and it reads two ways at once — poker figures and blackjack-21 lines. Build combos, capture enemy cells, and drag one shared pendulum to your edge to win. Solo campaign, hotseat, or ranked online 1v1.

4882750.title: Scrap Yard Simulator
4882750.short_description: Build your own scrap yard in the 1970s. Bargain with customers, uncover hidden valuables, sort and process scrap by hand, sell scrap to factories for profit, hire workers, expand your yard, and become the town's biggest scrap dealer.

4882820.title: MC not romancing LIs
4882820.short_description: "MC not romancing LIs" is a short visual novel. The story follows Tong Ren, the game's MC, who can see her "affection levels" with each of her "targets." But as an anime fangirl, she just wants to ship, not date! Faced with their advances... will she hold her ground, or fall into a romance?

4882890.title: Command Doctrine
4882890.genre: Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4882890.short_description: Describe a battle and AI builds it. Describe a war and get a whole campaign. Command Doctrine is a turn-based wargame with endless generated scenarios. Command armies across seven eras and outthink your enemy with supply, morale and terrain. Will your doctrine hold?

4883120.title: Cosmic Roll
4883120.short_description: Cosmic Roll is a simple 2D top-down platforming game about rolling a ball in space. Roll your way through levels and collect star dusts.

4883130.title: Nowhere House
4883130.short_description: Enter the cursed house of a vanished witch and solve puzzles across three parallel worlds. A dark point-and-click escape adventure full of mystery, trapped souls, hidden secrets, and eerie choices that shape your fate.

4883150.title: Ghost Case
4883150.short_description: Reopen a 20-year-old murder case after receiving messages from the afterlife. Explore Hidden Town, solve puzzles, question suspects, and uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click detective mystery.

4883160.title: Haunted Laia
4883160.short_description: A family disappears after being haunted by strange presences in their new home. Explore Laia’s memories, solve eerie puzzles across mysterious places, and uncover the dark truth behind what happened to them.

4883180.title: Another Shadow
4883180.short_description: Bastian is trapped in darkness by an ancient curse, and only Carissa can bring him back. Switch between two connected worlds, solve eerie puzzles, uncover hidden memories, and reveal the shadow haunting their new home.

4883310.title: Canal Tycoon
4883310.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

4883600.title: Necromancer: Ash & Bone
4883600.short_description: Raise an army of destruction and carve through massive enemy swarms. Combine powerful abilities and artifacts, experiment with countless build combinations, and transform from a lone necromancer into a force of death.

4884050.title: Nothing to See Here
4884050.short_description: Turn hide-and-seek into an art form! Use intuitive painting tools to camouflage yourself, blend seamlessly into the environment, outsmart seekers, and hide in plain sight across more than a dozen maps.

4884390.title: Galaxor
4884390.genre: Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4884390.short_description: Galaxor is an online sci-fi strategy game where you build planets, research technologies, command fleets and expand your empire across the galaxy. Manage resources, join clans, take part in events and face alien threats in long-term space warfare.

4884720.title: Fates of Alimore
4884720.genre: Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4884720.short_description: Fates of Alimore is a 1v1 card game where you don't just build a deck — you level a hero. Climb from level 1 to 10, evolve through your hero's story, and command six warring factions. Win not on points, but by slaying the enemy champion. An RPG saga fought in a single duel.

4884750.title: The Webring
4884750.short_description: An Old Internet experience by someone who loved being there.

4884830.title: Cat 3
4884830.short_description: Swap and match alien cats to blast through waves of cosmic foes. Cat 3 is a roguelite match-3 where each run you pick a hero, draft stacking upgrades, and collect relics. Match 3, break the rules, run it back.

4885130.title: Neural Descent
4885130.short_description: A 2D platformer with a twist. Jump, dash, and wall cling your way through the decaying program you have called home. You must go through rigorous courses and massive challenges to fully understand the mastermind behind your programming.

4886460.title: Breachline
4886460.short_description: Hold the line in a neon sci-fi siege. Deploy and upgrade 14 distinct towers, expose every enemy's weakness, and survive 50 escalating waves and relentless boss assaults. Every threat has a counter — find it before your base falls.

4886560.title: DEADFALL
4886560.short_description: Fight alone or with friends in a brutal horror wave-survival experience. Survive against endless waves of terrifying infected in this high-difficulty horror shooter. Play solo or with friends, unlock devastating weapons, discover secrets, and see how long you can endure the nightmare.

4886850.title: Goddess of Lust
4886850.short_description: Goddess of Lust is an adult choice-based visual novel developed using the Ren'Py game engine. Dive into a fantasy world filled with humor, grit, and sex as Nina and Felinus unravel the mystery behind the High Priestess's bizarre plans to change the world as we know it.

4886870.title: Hentai Puzzle: Midori
4886870.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Midori: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Midori, a mischievous adult student. Progress through challenges, unlock images and scenes, and enjoy a playful puzzle experience.

4886950.title: A Little Cove
4886950.short_description: When life gets heavy — a place to catch your breath. A little cove that's yours alone.

4886980.title: Dense Void
4886980.short_description: A first-person grounded sci-fi horror inspired by astrophysics, cosmology, and speculative scientific theories. Explore the unknown in the depths of space, where communication takes months, isolation is absolute, and the unknown defies explanation.

4886990.title: Domain: Evil Invasion
4886990.short_description: This game is an action-adventure game. Your goal is to eliminate all visible alien creatures. You can use shields and sword skills, with two different types of moves. You can parry and killing enemies can restore some stats. Continuous killing is the only way to keep you alive.

4887160.title: Principal Begs Me to Restrain Her
4887160.short_description: Toronto hacker Braden cracks the FX Group's Eternal Winter Plan and is hunted down, on the verge of death. He is reborn by fusing with the consciousness fragments of Liu Zihua. He gets involved in a conspiracy with the principal and the inspector and vows to uproot the FX Group.

4887250.title: Hamlet
4887250.short_description: Hamlet is a medieval city builder where pivotal characters drive your economy and define product quality and quantity. Manage and develop your people wisely because every person counts! Can you grow your hamlet into a powerhouse that rivals even the capital?

4887260.title: Anatolian Leopard
4887260.short_description: Arrive in a desolate Anatolian village as a zoologist searching for the elusive Anatolian Leopard. What begins as a routine expedition soon descends into a nightmare haunted by local folklore, dark secrets, and cosmic horror

4887280.title: Marrowood
4887280.short_description: Haunted by the suppressed memories of your childhood, you receive a letter from the town you grew up in. They need you to rebuild your family's farm. It's time to remember, welcome home.

4887380.title: My Cozy Cube
4887380.short_description: My Cozy Cube is a cozy game about scene stickers. Collage stickers according to the reference, or combine them freely for your own cube. Have fun with the cozy collage journey with your red panda guide, Chessie!

4887520.title: quietd
4887520.short_description: quietd is a no-input game you simply watch. A terminal hacks on its own across all 50 stages while you idle by. No commands, no clicks, no win, no score, no game over. Just chill, ambient cyberpunk: silent monospace text drifting in a corner of your desktop. Glance over and let it run.

4887540.title: Harlow's Climb
4887540.short_description: Jump, climb, and conquer a towering fortress in this challenging 2D platformer. Collect coins, overcome deadly obstacles, defeat enemies, and help Harlow rescue the wizard waiting at the top.

4888210.title: FAIL GAMES
4888210.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Sports, Early Access
4888210.short_description: Fail Games is a collection of extremely hard but simple minigames. Win each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail to buy effects and outfits. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

4888520.title: Pixel Three Kingdoms: Zombie Dungeon
4888520.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4888520.short_description: "Pixel Three Kingdoms - Zombie Dungeon" combines various random elements such as dungeons, exploration, auto-chess, hero and equipment draws. Choose a hero as the lord to assemble your army lineup, and all gameplay elements are generated by the program in the dungeons.

4888640.title: Shattered Bones
4888640.short_description: Fight through a hostile world full of savage beasts, horrifying undead, and corrupt men in this 2D action role-playing game.

4888670.title: SPEED OF LIGHT
4888670.short_description: Start with a fragile ship drifting through deep space and evolve into a physics-defying machine. Upgrade thrusters, harvest particles, vaporize enemies, and race toward the speed of light in this action space incremental game.

4889260.title: MEGA GOAT FOOTBALL: Cyberia Arena
4889260.short_description: An electrifying fast-paced 3D football game in the Cyberia Arena. Face an advanced CPU, unleash superpowers like the ice shot, and relive the excitement of football with a vibrant neon cyberpunk aesthetic. Dominate the field and become the true GOAT!

4889610.title: Ice Cream Hero
4889610.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4889610.short_description: Ice Cream Hero is a sweet tower defense challenge for one to four players. Team up with friends or play solo as Nilla, a brave little ice cream hero defending his land’s precious Sprinkle Bank from hungry silverware, chaotic waves, and big bad bosses.

4889680.title: Deep in the Dark
4889680.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4889680.short_description: Explore via the Deep in the Dark program and see all there is to see within the multiverse. As you complete research objectives your efforts will be rewarded with hats.

4890070.title: Deadly Dispatch
4890070.short_description: Tactical zombie elimination: build a multi-stage bomb, drop it on a zombie-infested city, and try not to hit the humans. 30 handcrafted levels, 12 bomb materials, chain-reaction physics, one bomb per sortie. Make it count.

4890090.title: Starfall Command
4890090.short_description: Pilot powerful starfighters, battle massive bosses, unleash devastating homing missiles, and defeat the Overmind in this fast-paced arcade sci-fi shoot 'em up.

4890250.title: Suho
4890250.short_description: A neon horde-survival roguelite where your cursor is the only weapon. Guard the core, sweep through endless swarms with osu!-style precision, evolve a build from loot-tier upgrades, and outlast 10 nightmare bosses. Then chase a cheat-proof global leaderboard.

4890600.title: FrontierLord
4890600.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4890600.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

4890850.title: Bot or Brush
4890850.short_description: Bot or Brush is an online party game for up to 8 friends where players draw predefined subjects, AI art joins the mix, and everyone tries to guess which creations were made by humans or machines.

4891020.title: Invisible Archery
4891020.short_description: Invisible Archery is a fast-paced top-down PvP arena game where every player is an invisible archer. Move, dodge, predict, and strike — but every shot gives away your position. Play online or over LAN with up to 8 players in tense arena battles where positioning matters as much as aim.

4891640.title: Do you remember?
4891640.short_description: A realistic-style experience where you are subjected to tests while living a repetitive routine.

4891720.title: Hybrid Gene
4891720.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4891720.short_description: Hybrid Gene is a somewhat fast paced monster catching game that allows you to genetically edit your monsters to create the ideal creature for your play style!

4891880.title: Prime Minister's Wife's Surrender Invitation
4891880.short_description: On the streets of Berlin, Thomas accidentally witnessed the secret of consciousness harvesting and was nearly killed. After a miraculous rebirth, he gained abilities and met the Prime Minister's wife. They started to cooperate to fight against the enemies, but then faced new crises.

4891910.title: Demeter
4891910.short_description: Hunt your prey or outsmart the Monster as a team in this exciting 3v1 horror multiplayer where Napoleon met Cthulu and unleashed supernatural creatures onto the world.

4891940.title: Cauldron Cartel
4891940.short_description: Run a cozy potion shop that is absolutely, definitely not a criminal front. Brew forbidden potions, hire goblins, dodge the inspector, and grow one bubbling cauldron into a full-blown cartel.

4891950.title: VoxMancer
4891950.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

4891970.title: Bringers of Darkness
4891970.short_description: Fight for the forces of darkness in a fast-paced bullet heaven survivors-like. Become a champion of darkness, master unique abilities, and bring ruin to the kingdoms of light that created their own nightmares.

4892050.title: Hentai Femboy
4892050.short_description: Hentai Femboy - Lie down comfortably! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4892120.title: ROUTE
4892120.short_description: ROUTE is a co-op survival game about driving a school bus across a zombie-infested world locked in endless night. Loot, craft, and upgrade your bus with a crew of four, and unlock new zones, each one its own challenge. Find out where the ROUTE leads, if you make it that far.

4892130.title: Gastropod Alien Adventures
4892130.short_description: Help a charismatic alien survive on Earth after a crash landing. Explore unfamiliar places, face unexpected enemies, and collect the necessary parts to repair your ship before it's too late.

4892140.title: Hentai Hot Milf
4892140.short_description: Hentai Hot Milf - Phew, they are so hot!! Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

4892180.title: Defeating Demons with my Dick in Another World
4892180.short_description: You've been summoned to another world by a sensual Saint to defeat the bratty Demon Lord... with your dick!

4892240.title: Nishin Difenda
4892240.short_description: Defend the egg cell from ridiculous waves of sperm in a biological roguelite where antibodies, mucus, pH and chaotic upgrades become your weapons.

4892430.title: Scolo's Fun World
4892430.short_description: Indie horror game with a creepy and dark atmosphere. You have to find keys to scape the levels while monsters are chasing you.

4892470.title: Critter Conquest
4892470.short_description: Command tiny critters in a fast paced woodland strategy game. Send swarms between burrows, capture territory, build your colony, and push back enemy creatures.

4892590.title: Purrvivors
4892590.short_description: The catapoclypse is upon us. Lead battle-hardened cats against endless swarms of vermin — auto-fire your weapons, scoop kibble between waves, and stack 32 weapons + 30 items into gloriously broken builds. Solo or 4-player local co-op. Survive… or meOWWW.

4892720.title: Skullchef
4892720.short_description: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

4892800.title: BALL BOY Simulator
4892800.short_description: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.

4892890.title: Trainbound Tales
4892890.short_description: Ride along in this steam train adventure RPG where you play as a newly arrived locomotive. Discover a vast world, expand the rail network, help the locals, and uncover the story of the continent Pyrocarda. Along the way, you deliver cargo, upgrade your train and complete challenges.

4893020.title: Bango Bingo
4893020.short_description: You’ve never played Bingo like this before. Build a powerful deck of cards, charms, and daubers, chase wild scoring combos across patterns and lines, and push your run deeper every night. One more ball. One more boss. One more run.

4893980.title: Metronome Mage
4893980.short_description: Metronome Mage is a pixel-art desktop companion that turns keyboard input into mana, spells, loot, and dungeon progress. Keep the small mage on your desktop, start Pomodoro-style explorations, and make focus time feel like a light fantasy adventure.

4894070.title: Simple Survivor
4894070.short_description: Simple Survivor is a clean, fast arena survival game about stacking upgrades, breaking enemy waves, and surviving a route of six escalating bosses where each is harder than the last. Pick your starting build, upgrade your weapons, and see how long your choices can can hold the line.

4894100.title: Midnight News Report
4894100.short_description: You watch a news program in the middle of the night featuring an unsettling reporter. As you watch, the world around you begins to warp and become unrecognizable. This is one broadcast you won't soon forget.

4894120.title: Los Cuentos de Frox
4894120.short_description: Explore the vast universe of Tora in this classic 2D turn-based RPG. Delve into a deep fantasy world filled with mysteries, traverse interconnected rooms and dungeons packed with secrets, and manage your inventory in a narrative-driven adventure.

4894140.title: Muhit
4894140.short_description: Muhit is a story-driven adventure set in an alternative 1990s Istanbul. Search for your missing family, explore the city, meet dangerous people, and slowly climb your way into the criminal underworld. Every job, connection, and decision brings you closer to the truth.

4894180.title: Thrice-a-dice
4894180.short_description: Trice-a-Dice is a roguelike Dice-Builder. Roll dice to earn money. Raplace dice faces for better ones and combine into the best. Buy Cats to create synergies with faces and upgrades. Deal with the Devil, gamble in slot machine and buy Angel's help. All of this just to pay to play further.

4894210.title: The Luraleid
4894210.short_description: The Luraleid is a surreal choice and consequence narrative fantasy adventure. Make choices to steer your story, meet characters and engage in puzzles and mazes.

4894220.title: Typerain
4894220.short_description: Words rain from the sky — type them before they hit the floor. Dial in Speed and Word difficulty independently for 25 ranked leaderboards, chase a shared global Daily Challenge, and climb 999 levels of unlockable flair. Pure typing arcade, all skill.

4894430.title: MaoShan：Dusk
4894430.short_description: Master Taoist talismans, unleash powerful spell combinations, and exorcise Jiangshi and restless spirits in a Chinese supernatural action roguelike. Battle through fast-paced encounters, uncover tragic ghost stories, and master authentic Maoshan magic.

4894450.title: Riftslayer
4894450.short_description: Riftslayer is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Fight massive waves of enemies, combine weapons and perks into powerful builds, and face dangerous bosses. Every run becomes more chaotic, more powerful, and more unpredictable.

4894510.title: NOEMATICA: Digital Dollhouse
4894510.short_description: Behold the humble Noem! Beguiling and silly-pilled, fully customizable, monstrous or adorable: with an n-dimensional vector space of fantasies and memories. An urban digital dollhouse, constructed top-to-bottom with a focus on simulation fidelity.

4894520.title: 仓王
4894520.short_description: Auction King is a multiplayer auction strategy game. On a future colony planet ruled by corporations, inspect clues, judge hidden asset values, and outbid rival players. Build your fortune from abandoned warehouses to skyscrapers, reach the orbital station, and compete for control of the colony.

4894530.title: Arenfall
4894530.short_description: Arenfall is a dark fantasy boss-battling action RPG. Master parry and dodge across 4 classes, solo or in co-op for up to 3 players. Take on Story mode, then the roguelite Boss Rush where every run reshuffles the deck.

4894580.title: Model Co.
4894580.short_description: Found a scrappy AI startup, train models nobody's seen before, and race rival labs to the frontier. Hire researchers, ship chatbots and developer tools, juggle burn and churn, go public, and build the lab that defines the field — a cozy retro management sim about the AI Hype rush.

4894800.title: NeoRunners
4894800.short_description: NeoRunners is a cyberpunk roguelite deckbuilder where you mod cards, collect relics, and chain Burn, Volt, and Flow reactions into broken combo engines. Read enemy intents, survive tactical turn-based fights, and push deeper into a neon city that wants you dead.

4894820.title: The Atrium
4894820.short_description: Mine your way through a vast cave system that watches as you dig deeper each day. Explore diverse biomes, collect valuable resources and craft increasingly powerful tools and upgrades until you are strong enough to reach the end before it all comes down.

4894870.title: Rogue Curling
4894870.short_description: Balatro-like roguelike curling where physics-based skill matters no less than a solid build. Combine synergies and precision, or just break the rules!

4894930.title: Akwarium
4894930.short_description: Survive a mutated laboratory aquarium where every chamber spawns new predators, weapons evolve with your build, and each run pushes you deeper into an absurd underwater bio-horror experiment.

4894950.title: ECHO:VORTEX
4894950.short_description: ECHO : VORTEX is a fast-paced sci-fi escape shooter. Survive procedural tunnels, fight four enemy types and a three-phase boss, collect Meteoroids and Gold, then race the global leaderboard. Every second counts — how fast can you escape the system?

4895050.title: Idle Pocket Crafter 2
4895050.short_description: An incremental idle mining RPG where you gather resources, craft equipment, defeat enemies, and unlock new biomes. Packed with content. Buy once, play forever with zero ads or micro-transactions.

4895060.title: The Quiet Flat
4895060.short_description: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare

4895210.title: Crossfall
4895210.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4895210.short_description: Crossfall is a cozy single-player top-down RPG with turn-based combat, developed by a solo creator. Explore a tile-based world, take part in dialogues, complete quests, craft items, go fishing, and gather herbs. Improve your skills and shape your own build.

4895240.title: Bunnyhoppers
4895240.short_description: A fast-paced 3D platformer where every jump counts. Master the bunnyhop mechanic, race through unique themed levels, and reach the finish line as fast as possible.

4895290.title: Hex Clash - The Fractured Combs
4895290.short_description: Command your swarm in Hex Clash: The Fractured Combs! In this turn-based strategic multiplayer game, face 5 Legendary Queens across Planet Hexanor. Farm Nectar, convert it to Pollen, Honey, and Stars to unlock epic cosmetics from Colony Chests. Unleash magical skills and rule the hex grid!

4895370.title: BAFF C
4895370.short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

4895390.title: SLIDE BLOCKS ～ブロックをゴールに運ぼう！～
4895390.short_description: Guide the star-marked block to the exit! A satisfying and challenging sliding puzzle game with over 300 levels to master.

4895410.title: Warrior Spirits
4895410.short_description: A martial arts card battler inspired by one of my favorite childhood games. Experience a story-driven adventure, level up your fighters, build your deck, shape your playstyle with stat upgrades, conquer roguelike runs, battle Raid Bosses, and fight players around the world in online pvp.

4895420.title: Observer's Mobius
4895420.short_description: Survive inside a sealed cube. Every action you take is observed by AI observers, and their judgment decides the next punishment or blessing.

4895470.title: Fractal.OS
4895470.short_description: Fractal.OS insists you play tic-tac-toe. Again. And again. Build an automated board factory, earn resources, unlock rules, and bend thousands of random matches toward a single impossible task: lose 10,000 times in a row. The system appreciates your compliance.

4895530.title: Dirty Air
4895530.short_description: Dirty Air is an adult romance visual novel set in modern Formula 1. As Rory Holloway, founder and Team Principal of Kestrel Grand Prix, navigate three high-stakes romances against a backdrop of technical protests, sponsor pressure, and a crash that nearly killed your lead driver.

4895550.title: Ride Up Together
4895550.short_description: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is a chaotic 1-8 player online co-op motorcycle climbing game where every jump matters. Climb to the top, sabotage your friends with powerful kicks, survive crazy physics obstacles, and try not to fall all the way back down.

4895560.title: Journey to Echo
4895560.short_description: Explore a handcrafted post-apocalyptic world, drive your vehicle across abandoned roads, scavenge for vital resources, repair communication systems, and survive against infected while searching for the last remaining outposts.

4895630.title: Azur Legend
4895630.short_description: Azur Legend is an anime-bishoujo collectible card game with fast, tactical card duels. Summon heroine monsters, chain spells and traps, and build series-synergy decks to defeat 38 rival duelists. Collect 304 illustrated girls, browse their profiles, and unlock alluring reward art with every win.

4895690.title: The Last Stand
4895690.short_description: A game about taking your last stand against a wave of enemies coming towards you

4895740.title: Proyecto Huemul
4895740.short_description: First-person survival horror inspired by a real Argentine conspiracy. Explore abandoned underground facilities, manage scarce resources, and stay out of its sight. Survive whatever lurks beneath the surface.

4895750.title: Nutsimilian
4895750.short_description: Nutsimilian is a turn-based 2D tile sandbox/simulation game with an emphasis on exploration, experimentation, and creative thinking within a procedurally generated world.

4895800.title: Chess
4895800.short_description: A professional chess simulator. It offers games against advanced AI, analyses of world-class chess games, and games played by chess grandmasters. You can solve and create chess puzzles.

4895840.title: Man Simulator
4895840.short_description: This truly masculine game lets you experience the daily life of a real man: mowing lawns, fixing things, hammering nails, and handling endless chores. A deep dive into a world of hard work, missed fishing trips, and the simple joys of a truly masculine lifestyle!

4895990.title: Argonauts Agency: The World on His Shoulders
4895990.short_description: Jason, Medea, and Heracles enter a mythical adventure where wit matters more than brute strength!

4896010.title: Who Heckled?
4896010.short_description: One player takes the stage. The rest hide in the crowd. Heckle them with memes, disrupt their performance, and don't get caught. A chaotic social deduction party game where the spotlight is a curse and the crowd is out for laughs. 2-6 players online.

4896100.title: Xalvorynthium
4896100.short_description: **Xalvorynthium** is a neon arcade action roguelike shooter where you dodge enemy fire, evolve your weapons, battle bosses, and chase higher scores through escalating waves of sci-fi chaos.

4896120.title: DeadTubbies 3: The Requiem of Evil
4896120.short_description: A third-person horror game and the sequel to a dark story. A mad scientist returns to the iconic Teletubby Land to finish his horrific experiments. Explore a chilling world, solve intricate puzzles, evade dangerous enemies, and uncover the ultimate secret of this nightmare.

4896210.title: Sudoku Haven
4896210.short_description: Daily brain & logic puzzles. Find your calm in 450,000+ Sudoku puzzles — free and offline. A fresh daily challenge, real solving trainers, and 20 quiet themes. Unwind and start solving.

4896360.title: Ceto-7
4896360.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4896360.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

4896500.title: Hash & Chill
4896500.short_description: A cozy crypto-mining idle game: build your farm, ride the market, end each cycle with a halving, and chill to rain and lo-fi.

4896520.title: The Drawn Hour
4896520.short_description: The Drawn Hour is a haunted-terminal card roguelike. Dial into a cursed dial-up BBS as one of three operators, build a deck, and claw through three corrupted sectors. Manage your rising Corruption, hunt relics, and face what waits at the drawn hour — alone, or in 2–4 player online co-op.

4896590.title: Between Gods
4896590.short_description: A punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every God. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear through shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after every death.

4896680.title: Huiyu Teach AI
4896680.short_description: A little desktop toy where you teach an AI how to do something — just by typing. You type out a thing — how to take a shower, which hand goes in first — and the AI takes a guess, tries to figure out what you meant, and shows you what it came up with. Whether it got it right is up to you to judge.

4896710.title: The Labyrinth
4896710.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4896710.short_description: Co-op first-person horror for up to 6 players. Explore a living maze that reshapes itself, activate altars to unlock the exit, and revive your allies before it's too late. Use your flashlight to see the creatures, but light and noise draw whatever hunts you in the dark.

4896790.title: Magoa Way
4896790.short_description: Magoa Way is a 2d retro sci-fi adventure game where you play the role of Thevir, a member of an intelligent species struggling on a dying world home to a once advanced civilization. By exploring, conversing, and using objects you try to find a cure for your mental disease by saving your people.

4896860.title: Pley Okey
4896860.short_description: Enjoy the classic game of Okey online with friends or play against AI. Create private rooms, improve your strategy, and experience a simple, polished version of this timeless tile game.

4896870.title: Click Dystopia
4896870.short_description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

4896950.title: Rapids
4896950.short_description: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, working the rudder and grabbing crates by hand to keep your load aboard. Survive escalating quotas in a roguelite where the river always wins eventually, the question is how far you get.

4896960.title: Daemon Doors
4896960.short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

4896990.title: MEGALITH
4896990.short_description: MEGALITH is a difficult Bullet-Hell Boss-Rush where you fight against megalithic machines in a tiny spaceship.

4897000.title: Echo 9
4897000.short_description: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

4897020.title: Letters From The Dead
4897020.short_description: Explore a handcrafted world shattered by catastrophe in an immersive isometric view. Traverse forgotten paths, survive deadly hazards & anomalies. Uncover hidden letters and lingering memories, and piece together the mystery of a lost world where every encounter, risk, and step matters.

4897040.title: Ashes of Alice
4897040.short_description: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

4897200.title: A Graveyard Shift
4897200.short_description: You took the night shift at the graveyard because the pay was good and the work was easy. Watch the gates. Clear the visitors. Keep the graves safe. Survive until dawn... and try not to learn why the last guy left.

4897220.title: Super Goldfish Scooping
4897220.short_description: It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before! Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!

4897270.title: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
4897270.short_description: Jump, dash, dodge, and fight countless stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

4897290.title: Legends of Companion
4897290.short_description: Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

4897310.title: Foodie Tour
4897310.short_description: Hex-grid match-3 meets feeding frenzy. 16 countries, 192 foods, 5 boosters, 4 diner types, 320+ levels. Time-based strategy. Build & share custom scenes.

4897330.title: VELKRADE
4897330.short_description: A dark fantasy card-battle RPG where you summon, strengthen, and customize Battle Records to fight through tactical front-row and back-row battles.

4897360.title: ITTO
4897360.short_description: Forge your own swordsmanship in this hardcore samurai survival action game. Build custom combo chains, master precise swordplay, and survive against endless waves of samurai and legendary swordsmen.

4897450.title: Strata the Cube
4897450.short_description: Every cube hides a solution. Study intricate interlocking structures, discover which pieces can move, and dismantle 3D puzzles one piece at a time. Unlock titles, earn achievements, and put your logic to the test.

4897480.title: Miravis
4897480.short_description: This is an action-adventure game blending fast-paced hardcore combat with open-world exploration. Travel across infinite realms between different lands. Trade, fight, collect, and develop. Experience thrilling combat in a unique art style and enjoy a captivating story with detailed worlds.

4897500.title: Oxygen Frontier
4897500.short_description: Explore the oxygen-ravaged frontier, battle mutated creatures, recruit bio-companions, and lead your squad to survival in a turn-based tactical adventure.

4897520.title: Baan Khok
4897520.short_description: If the city feels too big for you, come home to Baan Khok — a peaceful little village in the Thai countryside. Start anew: work the fields, grow vegetables, raise animals, and wander the lively temple fairs. Let life drift with the breeze, find love, and build a warm family of your own.

4897530.title: Mocha Camo
4897530.short_description: Mocha Camo blends graffiti with prop hunt! Paint your blank character to blend into the scenery. Deceptive poses and your art skills are keys to surviving under seekers' noses. Supports 2-10 players for quick matches or interactive streams. Fool everyone with your imagination!

4897540.title: Miner Survivor
4897540.short_description: Mine. Build. Survive. Now fight your friends. A fast 2D survivor game where you dig gold, build towers and drones, fight monster hordes, and now duel other players in 1v1 online PvP. Free demo available.

4897550.title: Blueprint Factory
4897550.short_description: Every machine follows your instructions. Build automated factories with intuitive visual programming, solve clever automation puzzles, and watch your factory come to life.

4897680.title: Point Rush
4897680.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Early Access
4897680.short_description: Get ready for the challenge! Point Rush propels you into a dynamic and fluid platformer. Chain precision jumps, optimize your routes, and dodge dangers. High score, speedrun, or just for fun: choose your own playstyle in this sleek, optimized world!

4897690.title: Red Interior
4897690.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4897690.short_description: In the game Red Interior, you will be constantly running and trying to find your way out of a seemingly deserted bar having five different levels each having their own gimmicks as well as most having their own music made specifically for the level. Can you make it out of this nightmare?

4897750.title: Don't Feed The Aisles
4897750.short_description: A PS1-inspired survival horror game where you explore an abandoned grocery store, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive relentless prehistoric creatures.

4897770.title: Feierabend Poker
4897770.short_description: From bottle to boss. Hustle out of the gutter and bluff your way to the top of the casino mafia in this Texas Hold'em RPG. 8 districts, 8 bosses, one pokerface. Build your hustler and clean out every table, solo or in multiplayer.

4897820.title: First Curse
4897820.short_description: A lone warrior awakes from a deep slumber, sensing something is terribly wrong with the world. Set out to seek the reason for this underlying sense of unease that has afflicted the people of the land.

4897850.title: Bubuia
4897850.short_description: A fishing, sailing, and management adventure inspired by Brazil’s rivers and seas. Manage your gear, customize your character, set up your fishing kit and boat, unlock quests across the waters, and discover fish and hidden treasures. Dive into the relaxing world of Bubuia.

4897880.title: 三国群英传之英雄传奇
4897880.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4897880.short_description: 这是一款充满古典气息的三国 MMORPG，这是千人同屏、真刀真枪的国战沙场。从本服厮杀到跨服争霸，从攻城拔寨到登基称帝，每一场战斗都靠操作和策略说话。在这里还有众多大家熟悉的历史人物如诸葛亮、关羽、吕布等都将以全新的形象呈现在玩家面前，他们都拥有独特的技能和属性。带上您的英雄们打出属于自己的江山！
developers: 三国群英传之英雄传奇
publishers: 三国群英传之英雄传奇

4897940.title: Futadzen
4897940.short_description: Futadzen is a futa visual novel and life simulator in a world full of dynamically changing events. Freely explore locations, complete quests, level up, play mini-games, and try to return home without breaking your "mark" under the onslaught of wicked temptations!

4897960.title: Bouncy Hammy
4897960.short_description: Play as a robot tasked with protecting Hammy, a cute and vulnerable bouncing creature. Your mission is to keep Hammy from touching the ground as you bounce it through hazardous levels using precise physics-based platforming.

4897970.title: Al Buen Callar Llaman Sancho
4897970.short_description: Al Buen Callar Llaman Sancho is a third-person action-adventure inspired by Don Quixote. Explore Vesania, a world where reality and fantasy intertwine, master dynamic melee combat, and recover the scattered pages of the original Quixote manuscript.

4897990.title: Egg Farm
4897990.short_description: Become the Ultimate Egg Farm Owner!Build your dream farm through relaxing idle progression while collecting resources and crafting your own overpowered egg build with a wide variety of random upgrades and powerful abilities.

4898080.title: Manala: Equinox War
4898080.short_description: A deckbuilding MMO where cheating is legal. Not an exploit: you cheat with your cards. Argue that their armor never covered that spot. Forget to deduct a hit point here and there. The Frog of the North sees everything, says nothing and sends the bill later.

4898120.title: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2
4898120.short_description: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2 is a lighthearted and fun hidden-object adventure game. A little girl from Earth and an alien kitten embark on a brand-new adventure, solving all kinds of quirky and unusual problems for the locals in a picture-book world.

4898140.title: Milk Can Clicker
4898140.short_description: Click cows, collect raw milk and gradually build your farm into an automated dairy. A relaxing idle/clicker game with upgrades, delivery orders, In-game achievements, prestige progression and no in-game purchases.

4898150.title: Mandat
4898150.short_description: Interactive political fiction strategy game: govern a country in crisis through Yes or No choices; developed largely with AI assistance. Press, elections, multiple endings.

4898190.title: Erevael
4898190.short_description: Explorer. Merchant. Diplomat. Mage. You decide who you become. Erevael is a generational fantasy RPG set in a world the Veil left dark - follow the paths that fit your style, master them, and pass everything you build to the heir who comes next.

4898270.title: Terminal Closure
4898270.short_description: Take your place at the tactical station of a spaceship and face a brutal war in the near future for control of the outer planets in this realistic space warfare simulator. Choose your side and lead your ship into battle, maneuvering and fighting according to the laws of orbital mechanics.

4898360.title: Cozy Cat Match
4898360.short_description: A free-to-start match-3 puzzle game with cozy home scenes and charming cat-themed art. Play the first 20 levels, enjoy relaxing puzzles, and unlock the full experience through DLC.

4898380.title: Ashmourn
4898380.short_description: ASHMOURN is a hand-crafted 2D roguelike of relentless combat and deep build-craft. Parry, dash and unleash god-given boons across five cursed biomes that reshape every run. Fall, grow stronger, and break the false dawn. Full controller support · 6 languages.

4898420.title: CodePhantom
4898420.short_description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Designed for responsive, well-balanced controls that are neither too fast nor too slow, it delivers a satisfying, authentic mech action experience.

4898460.title: Outspin Champions
4898460.short_description: Outspin Champions is a competitive PvP brawler where the spinning never stops. Blending party game chaos with souls-like precision, master physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

4898490.title: Hover Raid
4898490.short_description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this short incremental action game.

4898510.title: System Cleaner
4898510.short_description: Bullet heaven meets base building in a survivorslike set inside a broken computer. Fight corrupted files, stack upgrades, and place automated helpers that shoot, shield, repair, collect, and trap while you stay alive.

4898520.title: 20 Bucks Is 20 Bucks: A Never-Ending Story
4898520.short_description: Sensual, fun, and humorous visual novels for adults.

4898540.title: Debris Zone
4898540.genre: Action, Casual, RPG, Free To Play
4898540.short_description: Debris Zone is a top-down multiplayer space shooter set in a galaxy of wreckage and rival pilots. Jump between contested maps, customize your ship with lasers, shields, and drones, hunt epic bosses for loot, and fight to climb the ranks in fast, real-time dogfights.

4898570.title: The Infinite Dungeon
4898570.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon in this turn-based fantasy RPG. Choose one of four unique classes, battle dangerous enemies, uncover forgotten lore, and defeat powerful bosses as you fight your way ever deeper.

4898600.title: Beheaded Minotaur
4898600.short_description: Track and Hunt the Minotaur through a maze of ancient tunnels dug by people long past. In the pitch-black depths of the caves, you can never be sure whether you are aiming down the right corridor. Think while the footsteps grow louder and louder.

4898630.title: 宗门最后的长老
4898630.short_description: Sect master gone, demons invade, elders fallen—only you in seclusion. They don't know you've trained a millennium. Merge synthesis with tower-defense. Battle Shan Hai Jing beasts in ink-wash art. Combine skills, treasures, weapons to power up. Wield flying sword, blast endless hordes. Easy,

4898650.title: For The Witch
4898650.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down bullet heaven defense game. Protect a sleeping witch from swarms of mosquitoes, fight through nightly waves, collect mechanic-changing items, and build around powerful awakened effects to survive.

4898690.title: HordeFall
4898690.short_description: HordeFall combines Bullet Haven with Incremental. Earn money and prestige points by slaying endless waves of enemies and bosses. Unlock upgrades and manage your economy, stats and spells. Play actively or watch the game play itself while sitting in the corner of your desktop.

4898710.title: Speed Fall
4898710.short_description: An intense vertical descent survival game. Control different characters, jump across procedurally generated platforms, dodge various traps, collect fruit, and strive to survive as long as possible.

4898740.title: MISRECORDED
4898740.short_description: MISRECORDED is a loop-based found footage horror game where you must spot what's wrong before you can move forward. Walk the same corridor. Find what changed. Survive what notices you.

4898810.title: Akelarre
4898810.short_description: A psychological horror game where you enter the dark forests of Urkaitz as Gustavo, a reporter determined to uncover the truth behind a series of sinister incidents connected to a possible witches' coven.

4898890.title: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
4898890.short_description: Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke is a shot fired: fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day. The perfect companion for boring work. Fire. Hold. Repeat.

4898950.title: Dead End: Escape Your Fears
4898950.short_description: Everyone thinks they can make it out, but they've never met the Millers. Darkness. Intrigue. Isolation. Can you escape this creepy cabin full of twisted puzzles, or will you remain trapped forever? The time to prove yourself starts... now.

4899040.title: Absolute Legend
4899040.short_description: 本游戏是一个自动化的挂机刷宝放置游戏，支持装备属性范围，随机词条，强化，升阶，附魔！你需要在9个角色中组建一个3人小队，探索各种主题的挑战刷取装备，强化自己。直至打倒最终的敌人。

4899070.title: Unorthodox Rules
4899070.short_description: Unorthodox Rules is a mystery-comedy deduction visual novel about reading people, bending rules, and surviving an unfair game of logic, bluffing, and rock-paper-scissors.

4899120.title: Darning
4899120.short_description: A cozy game about quietly putting the world back together. Stitch torn, faded cloth and watch hidden color bloom beneath your needle — every piece a small surprise, endlessly new, and yours to keep. No timers. No scores. No failing. Just you, a thread, and the calm of mending.

4899170.title: Shattered Worlds
4899170.short_description: A fantasy turn-based strategy game where worlds get torn apart

4899210.title: Please Proceed To The Dungeon
4899210.short_description: Good morning, Gatekeeper. The dungeon opens at dawn and the line is already long. Inspect the papers, stamp your verdict, keep the order one wrong call and tomorrow pays for it. Your shift starts now.

4899300.title: Cheminots
4899300.short_description: Cheminots is a train conducting simulator, together you need to make sure the passengers reach their destination. Manage your coal and your water. Keep your locomotive intact. Control your passengers and keep their satisfaction high.

4899440.title: Elemental Forge
4899440.short_description: Match elements, cast spells, and awaken five ancient spirits. A relaxing fantasy puzzle game with no dark patterns — just pure elemental magic.

4899470.title: Norectus: Theatre of War
4899470.genre: Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4899470.short_description: A free-to-play strategy card game where five nations wage war. Build a deck around your Leader, then battle through ranked duels, a 100-floor roguelike, co-op bosses, and clan wars, plus Leader Clash, a full auto-battler mode built into the game.

4899480.title: Sanslo:Spin of the Three Kingdoms
4899480.short_description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

4899520.title: The Last Scribe
4899520.short_description: A roguelite action game where you write your own spells in a magical language. Venture into stories inspired by the great classics of literature, master the power of glyphs, and save these tales before they vanish forever.

4899570.title: Amadea
4899570.short_description: Run, jump, and climb your way to the summit of an ancient world in this freerunning Metroidvania adventure! Solve the mysteries of the land to correct the course of fate and save the Mountain from eternal winter.

4899580.title: Saving Yellow Ox
4899580.short_description: Saving Yellow Ox is a chaotic co-op climbing game where 2–4 players race through a floating countryside full of traps, moving objects, and ridiculous obstacles. A UFO has abducted the yellow ox, and the only way to save it is to climb higher, push your rivals, rewind time, and survive the madness.

4899660.title: The Hydrangea Line
4899660.short_description: A cozy pixel art visual novel set aboard a train winding through Japan. Choose your responses, uncover each passenger's story, and discover what quietly connects them all in this short story.

4899720.title: Quack or Die
4899720.short_description: An incremental run-based game, where kicking ducks is key to your survival! Pick a robot, work your way through the upgrade tree, play the claw machine and slots, destroy evil ducks and make it to phase 10 of the experiment!

4899750.title: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
4899750.short_description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

4899770.title: Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale
4899770.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4899770.short_description: Travel the old roads of a cozy storybook realm in Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale. Trade wares, visit lantern-lit inns, brave forests and mountain paths, and become the kingdom’s most beloved merchant. Every road has a story. Every village has a need. Every lantern leads you home.

4899790.title: Neuro Hunter
4899790.short_description: Dark, Corrupt, buried deep in Secrets and Lies. Your prospects were low until the Corporation gave you an offer. A job too easy, too good to be true... it was!

4899860.title: Doinaka de Reversi
4899860.short_description: A cozy and gentle Reversi game set deep in rural Japan. Enjoy matches and conversations with Japanese-style characters through Free Match, Story Mode, Tutorials, Puzzles, and Endgame Puzzles.

4899880.title: Sea Breeze & Waifus
4899880.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game with adorable bikini girls. Solve puzzles, unlock cute girls, and enjoy a groovy, atmospheric journey inspired by evening beach walk.

4899900.title: ANOMAL
4899900.short_description: Four deaths, four eras, one anomaly. Observe fragmented memories from every angle, piece together the timeline, and uncover what is wrong in this time puzzle.

4899920.title: Ultra Rad's Slide Hustle
4899920.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4899920.short_description: A puzzle game where you manage a limited budget as you navigate your way through garage sales and thrift stores to purchase valuable items. Research, repair, and resell those items for profit until your dad is proud of you.

4899940.title: Dyeversion
4899940.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

4899950.title: Demoman
4899950.short_description: Demoman is a 3D top-down arena survival roguelite about a retired soldier who was perfectly happy living out his days with his cat, General Meow — until an alien invasion ruined everything. Now he's dusting off old skills, upgrading his arsenal, learning new tricks, and leveling entire city blocks.

4900010.title: HOLOSYDE
4900010.short_description: HOLOSYDE is a fast-paced retro PvE FPS blending classic gameplay with modern, AAA visuals. Realistic environments contrast with holographic, glitching weapons and characters. From claustrophobic corridors to open arenas, tear through dozens of enemies in this brutal homage to classic shooters.

4900150.title: Ashbound Endless Hunt
4900150.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4900150.short_description: Ashbound: Endless Hunt is an active incremental action RPG where every click fuels the fight. Slay escalating waves and bosses, forge 100 weapon tiers, build a powerful party, complete relic sets, master combat upgrades, and prestige to return stronger and push deeper into the endless hunt.

4900160.title: Dungeon Convenience Store
4900160.short_description: Take on the role of a slime part-timer in a convenience store hidden deep within a dungeon! In this 2D top-down logistics simulation, organize chaotic items from portals, manage unpredictable customers and weather, and survive a 7-day shift by optimizing your workflow.

4900200.title: Doctor Mother-in-law Wants My Baby
4900200.short_description: Noah, a deliveryman, nearly died in a car accident on a rainy night but unexpectedly gained superpowers. His mother-in-law, Audrey, noticed his abnormality, and they joined hands to investigate the conspiracy of consciousness smuggling while developing a subtle affection for each other.

4900280.title: Prime Domination
