4900280.short_description: Prime Domination is a real-time strategy game where you build your base, manage finance, produce powerful military units, and battle against AI or other players in large-scale multiplayer matches with up to 10 commanders.

4900370.title: My Sudoku
4900370.short_description: Are you tired of high-octane explosions, photorealistic graphics, and games that demand actual reflexes? Good. Welcome to the ultimate low-resolution cerebral sweatshop - My Sudoku which can now be YOUR Sudoku!

4900400.title: Oblivions Garden
4900400.short_description: Claim a hex anywhere on a 1:1 reconstruction of real Earth and build a city that never stops growing. Real satellite terrain, real building outlines, a hierarchical economy from one parcel to a continent — and an AI that grows the world while you sleep.

4900420.title: Senseless Cooking
4900420.short_description: One Robot is Blind, The other is Deaf. Work together to cook and serve Hotdogs to customers over several days. Watch out for any errors that may occur and disrupt your perfect communication

4900660.title: Time, Line
4900660.short_description: Limited to moving left and right, every step you take pushes time forward. Thread through minimalist environments and discover how much depth can exist on a single line.

4900720.title: The Victim: The Evidence
4900720.short_description: A cringe story about a cringe guy dealing with a normal aspect of French law.

4900750.title: Void Swarm
4900750.short_description: Fight through endless enemy swarms in this fast-paced arcade space shooter with survivor-style progression. Upgrade your ship, unlock powerful fighters, and grow stronger with every run.

4900760.title: Stellar Harvest
4900760.short_description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

4900980.title: Blob of Ink
4900980.short_description: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater. Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.

4900990.title: MOR
4900990.short_description: MOR is a Multiplayer Indie Slasher, set after hours in a retro, early 2000s Superstore. Players must employ strategy, and teamwork to gather lists of items throughout the store, while evading an intelligent supernatural entity with predatory nature.

4901090.title: Between Glances
4901090.short_description: You're the crooked dealer at a game of 21, and the House owns you, where only cheating pays. Rig the deck in the half-second the mark looks away, his eyes hunting your hands, his suspicion climbing. Take a quiet cut, or push for it all. Get caught, and the night ends in the gutter.

4901480.title: After-Rain Bookmark
4901480.short_description: After-Rain Bookmark is a gentle all-ages school yuri visual novel about Shizuku and Shiori, two girls brought closer by rainy days, a library festival project, and a handmade bookmark carrying words they struggle to say aloud.

4901530.title: Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator
4901530.short_description: A game about being a ball and relax. Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator gives you an out of the world experience of the life of a happy ball. Do nothing or do the ball thing.

4901650.title: Rolling Star
4901650.short_description: Race across the globe to help the Long-tailed Tit find its way home. Guided by a mysterious blue light, he unwittingly becomes a "Rolling Star."

4901660.title: Cool Policewoman Defects for Hero
4901660.short_description: Hacker Arthur Wilson was hunted down after cracking the data of the FX Group's immortality plan. In a car accident, he fused with a consciousness insect and gained superpowers. While investigating the conspiracy, he awakened the inner desires of multiple women and obtained intelligence.

4901680.title: MONOLYTH
4901680.short_description: A Journey of Self-Deflection. MONOLYTH is a single-player arcade game, one-bullet bullet hell experience, and two-character play rolled into one. One rainy afternoon, we came across three TV screens reflecting on divinity. We decided to capture this in the only way we knew how: By making a game.

4901780.title: Golfcremental
4901780.short_description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

4901820.title: Remote Union
4901820.short_description: Welcome to Kutarsk! Investigate the incident and dive deep into the story of the city and its inhabitants. Remote Union is a first-person adventure game set in a dark and gritty dystopian future.

4901850.title: I Missed the Apocalypse
4901850.genre: Action, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4901850.short_description: Humanity has fallen under alien control every mind but yours. Alone and immune, you must gather resources, build robots, and fortify your base against ever-larger night assaults. Grow strong enough to strike back at the purple fortress looming over Neo Roma.

4901860.title: The Big Suck
4901860.short_description: A short incremental game where you are the disaster. Destroy fields, cars, buildings. Gather wreck to grow and spend it on upgrades inside the big skill tree.

4901870.title: Just A Regular Night Patrol
4901870.short_description: 'Just A Regular Night Patrol' is a first-person simulation game. Over the course of 8 days, review and execute your daily tasks based on the instructions. No jumpscares or anomalies. The goal is to simply be an ordinary night security guard and complete your shifts without making mistakes.

4901880.title: Off Axis
4901880.short_description: An action-packed sci-fi FPS set aboard a massive spaceship, where unstable gravity changes the way you fight and the environment becomes a weapon against your enemies.

4901910.title: Moon Miner
4901910.short_description: Drill into a dead moon, haul glowing ore, sell your load, and upgrade your mole-bot for the next risky descent. A compact mining adventure inspired by Motherload and I Dig It, with cozy progression, dangerous depths, and something alive below.

4901950.title: A Mystic Journey With : Crystalia
4901950.short_description: Embark on a titillating journey through mystical realms with Crystalia, your alluring guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with seductive reveals.

4901960.title: Big House
4901960.short_description: None can outgamble you. The Big House — a casino now bleeding from an unstoppable losing streak — needs saving. And of course, we'll do it the way we always do: fair and square.

4901990.title: Hentai Clicker: Samia is streaming
4901990.short_description: Click, collect hearts, upgrade, and unlock Samia’s scenes, outfits, and playful voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Samia is streaming.

4902060.title: Libera Nos a Malo
4902060.short_description: This is a QTE horror game inspired by 1970s horror movies. This game contains scenes of exorcism and demonic possession, Christian religious themes, disturbing imagery, screams, and moments of intense psychological tension. Some content may be unsettling for certain players.

4902090.title: Help My Wife Fall in Love NTR
4902090.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4902090.short_description: A chat-based relationship suspense visual novel. Read messages, inspect social posts, make choices, and uncover the truth behind a marriage shaped by suspicion, desire, and betrayal.

4902130.title: 崇祯模拟器
4902130.genre: RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4902130.short_description: 1644—the Ming Dynasty is collapsing. Rebels close on Beijing, Manchu armies at the gates, the treasury empty. As Chongzhen, China's last emperor, you command AI-driven ministers who flatter, scheme, and defy you. Rewrite history—or fall as the records say?

4902170.title: Pride City
4902170.short_description: You are a superheroine who protects the community while balancing everyday life: paying rent, going to work, and leading a queer neighborhood community. Can you handle it all? Make choices, build relationships, and save the neighborhood.

4902200.title: Le Fishe
4902200.short_description: Le Fishe is a cozy fishing adventure where every cast of your line leads to something new. Catch a wide variety of fish, upgrade your fishing gear, and unlock new locations as you progress. Talk to an interesting cast of characters and try your best to catch the biggest fish of them all!

4902300.title: Legend Buffet
4902300.short_description: 《Legend Buffet》is a horror cooking game. Amid the late-night drizzle, players cook delicious food for customers in a cozy food stall. As you attend to these mysterious diners, eerie surroundings and building tension will constantly close in on you...

4902420.title: Schooled
4902420.short_description: SCHOOLED is a bullet-heaven survivors-like where you collect real chemical elements to spell words and manifest elemental powers. Youre the nerd against the jocks and it's finally your time. Fight escalating waves of jocks with your superior intellect, a lot of chemistry, and pure ingenuity.

4902480.title: Rever4
4902480.short_description: A new kind of Reversi for up to 4 players. Rever4 supports single-player, local play, LAN play, and online matches, with multiple rule sets including classic Reversi, 3-Way, 4-Way, Duo, and Quartet.

4902600.title: Re:Store the Record Store
4902600.short_description: Re:Store the Record Store is a game about tidying up an indie record store after the owner had to run off to chase down his escaped monkey. Featuring over 800 items to pick up, sort through and return back into the crates where they belong. Take your time to look through everything or speedrun it!

4902750.title: Wizard Tower Pinball
4902750.short_description: Hypnotic retro pinball game with a realistic physics engine and five distinct tables, including a procedurally generated table with one million possible layouts. Master the flippers, chase high scores, and lose yourself in the lights.

4902780.title: Crack That Smile
4902780.short_description: A punchy, low-effort incremental game where you hover over frozen ice to shatter it and free adorable emojis. Upgrade your freezing-crushing power, break harder ice, feel invincible, and rescue every emoji collection in this short, packed game!

4903000.title: Solo Oasis : Unlimited Places
4903000.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4903000.short_description: A small avant-garde walking simulator where you walk from one fever dream to the next. Inspired by SOUP and LSD Dream Simulator. Made for SOUPJAM 2026

4903080.title: Stickman Cultivating Immortality
4903080.short_description: A pixel-art Xianxia action game. Play as a stickman cultivator soaring through floating realms, battling demons with sword and dao skills, pets, and magic treasures. Master combos, dodge fierce attacks, and rise through cultivation realms to immortality.

4903120.title: Turdventure
4903120.short_description: Walk your dog. Leave a "surprise." Outsmart the cops. 🐕💩 Turdventure is a comedy-arcade game where every walk is a chaotic battle of wits between you, your dog, and the law.

4903130.title: Railflow
4903130.short_description: Build a tiny railway company that lives on the edge of your desktop! Place trains, deliver resources, grow bustling towns, and expand an ever-evolving rail network in this cozy desktop companion management game.

4903180.title: Shuttle 17
4903180.short_description: A fast-paced 2D space arcade game. Collect drifting energy shards, deliver them to planetary orbit slots, and dodge asteroids before time runs out. Easy to learn, hard to master — built for high-score chasers.

4903260.title: Hazen's Children 2
4903260.short_description: A turn-based, retro-like RPG. Navigate the Battle Maps, level up your characters, and craft new weapons.

4903300.title: Realm Tycoons
4903300.short_description: Realm Tycoons is a turn-based fantasy strategy board game where rival rulers claim realms, build economies, grow armies, cast spells, upgrade strongholds, and battle for control of the kingdom.

4903320.title: You Are Not the Chosen One
4903320.short_description: An old school, single-player RPG inspired by the legendary MUDs of the past. Roll up a character from one of 8 classes and 7 races, then fight, scheme, and gamble your way across the continent of Vaelthara, writing your own chronicle in a world of ambition.

4903370.title: Bouncy Birbs
4903370.short_description: Bouncy Birbs is a cute, physics-based tactical roguelite. Drag, aim, and launch your pixel bird into battle! Utilize unique class skills and physics collisions to defeat enemies. Collect relics, roll for random talents in the gacha machine, and build your ultimate team in endless challenging levels!

4903420.title: A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story
4903420.short_description: This linear visual novel tells the story of protagonist Lance, a 25-year-old male, who is dating in these modern times.

4903440.title: Parasite Survivor
4903440.short_description: Steal bodies. Survive the dungeon. Become a parasite slime, take over monster bodies, and survive in this possession-based roguelite RPG.

4903450.title: 天天斗地主
4903450.short_description: Tiantian Dou Dizhu is a cheerful three-player card game based on classic Dou Dizhu rules. The game uses random dealing with a public web verification tool, allowing players to check deal records after each match for greater transparency and fairness.

4903560.title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
4903560.short_description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

4903640.title: DIBARO CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
4903640.short_description: Roll dice, command mana, fight on a hex board with up to 6 factions. Five elements — Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Void — carry unique effects and counters. Read rivals through mana layout, resources, and positioning. Build your Hunter, conquer Challenges, Survival, or Demon & Hero. Tactics and luck.

4903680.title: Pixel Cultivation Chronicles
4903680.short_description: Dive into this Cultivation Idle game for exponential growth! Idle to amass massive cultivation base. Refine roots, equip pets, and forge weapons for ultimate damage builds. Reincarnate to inherit global stats. Say goodbye to grinding, strategize your builds, and watch stats skyrocket!

4903800.title: Living on Plain Pasta
4903800.short_description: A conversation adventure where you spend the worst, best summer visiting your booze-loving senpai, making weird food, and sneaking out together at midnight.

4903810.title: Thousand Ward
4903810.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4903810.short_description: Thousand Ward is a tactical collector RPG where you build a 3x3 Band of Wardens, master turn-based Hold, Break, and Surge combat, conquer 1,000 levels across 10 realms, collect 200+ Wardens, and climb ranked online battles through strategy, synergy, and smart play.

4903890.title: Affection Engine
4903890.short_description: Auden Crane built Solace, the AI-companion app that turned loneliness into a subscription. Now a dead user's unmistakable words are surfacing inside his flagship companion, the FTC is circling, and three women each hold a piece of the truth. An adult romance visual novel with three explicit routes.

4903900.title: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures
4903900.short_description: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!

4903910.title: Rune Log
4903910.short_description: Decode a runic cipher, then decide what it truly means. A quiet, occult detective word game: solve each scripture letter by letter, then type your own conclusion to answer a villager's question about a death, a fraud, a haunting, or an old secret.

4903960.title: Chaotic World
4903960.short_description: Chaotic World is a top-down PvE arena shooter where your objective is to clear waves of different and unique enemies until you destroy them all. Set across colorful maps, you will have the opportunity to make yourself stronger by leveling up and finding loot on your way to the last wave!

4903980.title: Twig of Y
4903980.short_description: 《Twig of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中维系脆弱的连接、抵御断裂压力并延展角色能力，在稳定而连续的单人流程中体验以平衡把控为核心的回合制玩法。

4904060.title: Roll and Die
4904060.short_description: A push-your-luck dice roguelite. Greed gets you power. Greed gets you killed. Keep the rolls you like, push the rest, and pray you do not hit a skull. Climb the Pit to the god who runs it.

4904080.title: Feastfall
4904080.short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

4904130.title: Ofuda Placement Service
4904130.short_description: Ofuda Placement Service is a first-person horror game set in a school late at night, where you place Ofuda while being pursued by a spirit’s footprints and complete the request.

4904150.title: Gloomlings
4904150.short_description: Gloomlings is a gothic creature-raising game. Choose an egg, hatch it, and raise it through life -  feeding, caring for, and bonding with a creature unlike any other. Every Gloomling has its own temperament, and how you care for them shapes how they grow.

4904270.title: VANDALISM101
4904270.short_description: VANDALISM101: An Office Simulation Visual Novel! You’ll become a new employee at the mysterious, top-secret research facility VANDALISM101. Complete the tasks assigned to you, boost your performance, and survive!

4904290.title: My Slime Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
4904290.short_description: A relaxing 18+ image puzzle game where you assemble fragmented pictures of a honey slime girl. Complete 100 levels to unlock a growing private gallery. Simple, light gameplay focused on progression and visuals.

4904420.title: The Long Awakening
4904420.short_description: This is a psychological horror visual novel game. You wake up in an eerie old hotel with no memory. You need to meet bizarre characters and recover lost memories. There are 20 endings. Pixel art, desaturated tones, dreamlike dread. Horror comes from existential self-reflection, not jump scares.

4904460.title: Gary Stillwater
4904460.short_description: Take control of Gary in this comical 2D hand-drawn point & click adventure. Guide him through his many silly mishaps in rustic towns, beautiful countryside, beaches, jungles and more. Solve puzzles by finding, using and combining various items and interacting with characters in order to save the day

4904510.title: Inside You
4904510.short_description: Inside you are two women. One says you love her. The other also says you love her. You are in danger.

4904560.title: The Waking Grove
4904560.short_description: A cozy incremental idle about restoring a dead garden, one tile at a time. Spread life across the seasons and let the soil remember everything you grew.

4904730.title: Achievement Fly Clicker
4904730.short_description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

4904740.title: Chako
4904740.short_description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

4904910.title: Football Dynasty Manager
4904910.short_description: Take command of an entire football world. Recruit high-school prospects and portal prospects, build a college dynasty, then follow your players into the pros. Draft, trades, contracts, and championships. College and pro in one connected universe, where every snap, signing, and decision is your call.

4905030.title: Market Panic
4905030.short_description: Market Panic is a single-player finance roguelite where you build a portfolio, queue trades, manage clients, inspect rivals, and survive market crises across a 10-year quarterly run. Every asset can break when panic hits.

4905070.title: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！
4905070.short_description: Assigned to Moderate Her Chat! is a game where you become the moderator for rookie VTuber Komeran A. Lerna. Delete toxic comments as soon as they appear! With simple click controls, protect Lerna's livestream and keep the chat safe and friendly.

4905160.title: MR.EXPLORER
4905160.short_description: Explore the world, swap your body parts to gain unique abilities, uncover hidden secrets, and recover all 16 lost packages.

4905190.title: Beyond The Roots
4905190.short_description: Rise to the ranks of gods. Defeat the powerful fallen angels standing in your way in this challenging pixel-art boss rush, and earn your place in paradise.

4905270.title: My Fitness Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
4905270.short_description: A relaxing 18+ image puzzle game where you assemble fragmented images of a young fitness trainer girl. Complete 100 levels to unlock a private gallery. Simple progressive gameplay focused on visuals.

4905460.title: Chest Looter: Monster Card Collection
4905460.short_description: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

4905580.title: Tank
4905580.short_description: Take part in World War II battles with your tank. You can choose from several types of tanks and select a historical battle that interests you.

4905670.title: 失序的我与乐园
4905670.short_description: This is an adventure that takes place in an amusement park. Players will explore strange scenes, meet mysterious companions, and uncover the truth behind the 'Disorderly Park' program through turn-based battles and story choices.

4905680.title: Good Night,mare
4905680.short_description: A bite-sized casual runner-action game. Become Mo, a fantasy creature. Dodge sweet dreams and munch only on nightmares as you run.

4905750.title: ToadPonds
4905750.short_description: Build, decorate peaceful ponds, collect, care for unique frogs and create your own cozy wetland paradise in this relaxing nature simulation. Customize every habitat, grow a thriving ecosystem, and enjoy a stress-free experience at your own pace.

4905900.title: 终点站
4905900.short_description: After a war ended, we were abandoned at the end of the story. Cold winters, intermittently passing typhoons, and occasional seismic waves. The visual novel 『终点站』 will tell a story from the aftermath of war.

4905930.title: Rubblefield
4905930.short_description: A momentum-driven reinvention of Asteroids. Thrust and drift through a screen-wrapping field, blast ten distinct asteroid types, and take down a recurring boss while chaining power-ups: a screen-clearing Nuke, a homing shot, a sustained Death Laser, and more.

4905950.title: Infinite Minesweeper Simulator
4905950.short_description: Infinite Minesweeper Simulator offers unlimited huge maps based on classic Minesweeper. Great for stress relief and casual breaks. No time limits, perfect for perfectionists, new players and veteran fans to play freely anytime.

4905960.title: Shuffle Bistro
4905960.short_description: A restaurant-themed deck-building roguelike that surpasses sales targets through the synergy of menu, facilities, and perks

4906000.title: Bliss Point
4906000.short_description: Bliss Point is an adult romance visual novel. As CEO Tobin Greaves, navigate an FTC probe into Beanstalk Foods—the kids' brand built on engineered craving—while pursuing three women who hold the truth: a hostile toxicologist, your protégée, and a public-health dietitian.

4906130.title: Mini Pet
4906130.short_description: Raise, care for, and collect adorable tiny monster pets in a relaxing 2D pet-raising game. Watch them grow through cute evolution stages, unlock new Mini Pets, and complete your gallery.

4906290.title: Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy
4906290.short_description: Uncover the terrifying truth behind a cursed teddy bear in this first-person psychological horror adventure. Explore a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, survive supernatural encounters, and uncover Nini's tragic story in Chapter One of the Spooky Tales series.

4906320.title: Fog'n'Silence
4906320.short_description: Lead a group of Vagrants through the surreal open world of the Afterlife. Observe their journey through the eyes of a drone operator. Hide from blind monsters. Avoid malicious fog. Embrace the Cycle. Survive. Escape.

4906330.title: Immortal Gambit
4906330.short_description: Immortal Gambit is a cultivation-themed deck-building roguelike. Choose your path, build your deck, balance Spiritual Energy and Baleful Energy, defeat enemies, seize fateful opportunities, and begin your journey toward ascension through countless cycles.

4906350.title: Impostor Syndrom
4906350.short_description: A 4–10 player social deduction game where you don't even know your own role. Trade subtle clues about your secret word over live voice chat, expose the Impostor, and figure out who you are. If you don't know who you are, how can you know who to trust?

4906360.title: The Next Room
4906360.short_description: The Next Room is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite where every room is a new challenge and every decision can mean the difference between survival and death. Fight your way through relentless monsters, avoid deadly traps, uncover hidden secrets, and defeat powerful bosses guarding the path ahead.

4906410.title: Classroom 3B
4906410.short_description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi voice work in this psychological horror investigation.

4906520.title: Pixel: The Challenge
4906520.short_description: A 3D puzzle game in the spirit of the great tile-based logic classics. Collect every Pixel, find the keys, master ice, fire, conveyor belts and monsters — and reach the Plenum. 80 hand-crafted levels, every one provably solvable. Two art styles, three cameras.

4906580.title: Picofender
4906580.short_description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

4906760.title: Sparky's Escape
4906760.short_description: Spark's Escape is pure, adrenaline-fueled 2D arcade action. Dodge nasty enemies with unpredictable traits, deploy powerful power-ups at the perfect moment, and guide Sparky through the time portal. Conquer 500 handcrafted levels and the brutal Hell Mode!

4906780.title: Meme Farm
4906780.short_description: Turn one humble Like button into the internet’s biggest meme empire. Click, automate, unlock absurd towers, and grow your numbers beyond reason. Climb the leaderboards, crush your friends’ scores, and prove once and for all who is the ultimate Meme Lord.

4906790.title: Locomotive Works
4906790.short_description: Build custom steam locomotives and deliver freight on a working railway. Your designs affect performance. Different jobs need different designs, and every choice has trade-offs. Balance power, size, range and cost to build anything from small yard shunters to heavy freight engines for steep climbs.

4906910.title: Ashioto Kyōfu | Footsteps Terror
4906910.short_description: Touka Saeki, a former journalist and owner of the online video channel “Footsteps Terror”, travels to an abandoned mountain village where a school drama club mysteriously disappeared to cover that place in her next video. Her arrival awakens a long-buried curse...

4907030.title: The Exorcist's Apprentice
4907030.short_description: A first-person short psychological horror about exorcism. A victim is bound to a bed. A demon lurks inside her. Explore a confined apartment, rely on your mentor's guidance, and discover the precise ritual needed to drive it out.

4907380.title: TAKEDOWN 16
4907380.short_description: THE YEAR... 20XX - A polished corporate utopia masks a sinister reality controlled by an omnipotent AI. Survival in this high-speed, vehicular action-roguelite demands unrelenting aggression, delivering a chaotic, adrenaline-fueled experience.

4907570.title: Pickup Point Simulator
4907570.short_description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

4907860.title: Yakko Tako
4907860.short_description: Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly, tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky. One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

4907900.title: The City Of Akhetaten
4907900.short_description: The City Of Akhetaten highoctane Isometric Action RPG that seamlessly fuses fastpaced Hack Slash combat with deep survival resource gathering and sandbox base-building. Choose your class explore ancient lands build your village from scratch and survive against ruthless hordes across mystical realms!

4907960.title: GirlFishing: Catch your Girlfriend!
4907960.short_description: Fishing + Rhythm Game! What could be a better catch? Only beautiful girls! Catch 20 unique fish-girls to the beat of 30+ music tracks. Receive messages in chats, get to know the girls better, and unlock over 160 hot CG arts. It's time to cast your line!

4907970.title: Don't Stop Bullying me, Beastgirls!
4907970.short_description: Experience the beginning of a brand-new monster girl visual novel series set in a world where humans and monsters have learned to coexist... even if some beastgirls still enjoy picking on the occasional human.

4908020.title: Love Joy Happiness
4908020.short_description: Short incremental game about things that are important in your life.

4908030.title: Naya: The Forgotten Path
4908030.short_description: Naya: The Forgotten Path is a third-person action-adventure set in a magical forest of ancient ruins, dangerous creatures, hidden paths, and forgotten secrets. Fight with a bow, melee attacks, and magic, solve puzzles, explore mysterious lands, and uncover the truth behind Naya's destiny awaits you

4908060.title: Rhythm of Five
4908060.short_description: Become the heir of Samsin, the goddess of life, and journey through five mythic worlds to the beat. A Korean-mythology pixel-art game blending 4-key rhythm action with egg-nurturing.

4908080.title: Slots And Shots
4908080.short_description: Roll ingredients, serve cocktails, and bet on outcomes in a cozy casino bar.

4908110.title: Gas N Cars
4908110.short_description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

4908120.title: Idle Outbreak Z
4908120.short_description: A squad of survivors against an endless outbreak. An idle auto battler RPG where every zombie drops loot: grab the best gear, kit out your team, sell the junk, push deeper.

4908150.title: The Last Frame
4908150.short_description: Step into your late father's abandoned workshop, where unfinished paintings become living memories. Solve environmental puzzles, restore forgotten artwork, and uncover the story hidden within his final masterpiece.

4908180.title: Spinvestor
4908180.short_description: Spinvestor is a fun, risk-free alternative to winning millions while gambling in a casino where the house doesn't have the edge for once. Win big, invest in stocks, and run your own businesses while becoming the highest ranking VIP at Steak, the best casino where the house always loses.

4908290.title: Rouge Process
4908290.short_description: An AI is loose in the machine. Spread your code across a neon circuit board, seize compute, and outpace the antivirus before it purges you. A fast roguelite of territory, defense and escape: capture data, build subroutines, breach the gateway, go deeper. How long can you survive the system?

4908340.title: Alphbetto's
4908340.short_description: Roguelite letter-deckbuilder. The characters of the great classics sit at your table. Chain, sign and mutate letters from a deck shared by every player — every card you add arms your rival as much as you. Unlock the works line by line.

4908470.title: Soul Monsters: The Machine Kingdom and the Lich Queen
4908470.short_description: A story-driven roguelike deckbuilder set in the war between the Machine Kingdom and the Lich Queen. Build your deck, gather relics, and battle through 75 stages to uncover the truth binding four intertwined destinies.

4908520.title: Circulo
4908520.short_description: A fast-paced 2D arena survival game built around geometric chaos.

4908630.title: CyberRunner: Data Dash
4908630.short_description: CyberRunner: Data Dash is a classic arcade runner. Collect as many disks as possible while dodging obstacles, and bring them to the main base for decryption.

4908740.title: The Transfer
4908740.short_description: A Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure. As a London Tube driver, your routine journey derails into something ancient, forgotten, and buried beneath the tracks. Explore hidden routes, follow the journey, and unravel the secrets that refuse to stay dormant.

4908850.title: Let's Catch the Variable!
4908850.short_description: Math has come to attack the peaceful city of Multiplicity! Solve arithmetic problems in this top-down 2D shooter mixed with a plethora of minigames. Practice math on your own terms; challenge yourself or relax with flexible difficulty settings.

4908920.title: Waterpump Simulator
4908920.short_description: Start with a simple water pump and turn a small roadside stand into a thriving business. Sell drinks, upgrade your equipment, unlock new products, improve your workflow, and serve an ever-growing number of customers as you build your own successful roadside business from the ground up.

4909030.title: October: Survivor's Guilt
4909030.short_description: October: Survivor's Guilt is an first-person psychological horror game where you explore an unsettling house, interact with objects, and try to survive a terrifying night after a simple favor goes wrong.

4909050.title: Animal
4909050.short_description: Animal is a unique open-world survival game. Choose one of the animals and survive in the open world alongside your group.

4909080.title: NOVASWARM
4909080.short_description: A fast-paced space survival roguelite. Battle endless enemy swarms, evolve powerful weapons, create unique builds, and survive as long as you can.

4909100.title: Box Flow
4909100.short_description: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

4909260.title: Line Go Up
4909260.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4909260.short_description: Play as a CEO where you buy companies & hire executives to build out your deck, then test your luck in the free market. Bad gambles may push you to make tough choices in the events that pop up along the way. You will get fired if you fail to meet expectations, so make that line go up!

4909300.title: REDHAND
4909300.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

4909330.title: Last Bake
4909330.short_description: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

4909410.title: Gravity Vs Goo
4909410.short_description: A 2D sci-fi precision platformer where players switch gravity to avoid being consumed by sentient goo.

4909630.title: Tarry: The In-Between
4909630.short_description: A black and white pixel art action-adventure set in a world that isn't quite here and isn't quite gone.

4909660.title: A Flower Gently Plucked
4909660.short_description: Trapped in a freezing alpine cabin, Chester’s quiet retreat with his playful friend Blossom takes a heated turn when a storm forces them together. Caught between the fear of crossing a line and the intoxicating pull of a woman who refuses to be denied, some boundaries are meant to melt.

4909670.title: Have Fun Exploring
4909670.short_description: Have Fun Exploring is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. Urbex livestreaming is booming on the Dark Web, and the WR8 Audience pays well for thrilling content. Investigate abandoned locations to uncover who went missing and identify the ghost they became.

4909710.title: Hentai Tiles
4909710.short_description: Solve up to 120 tile-swap puzzles and reconstruct beautiful images. Progress through increasingly challenging grids, unlock completed pictures in the gallery, earn achievements, and discover additional puzzle packs through optional DLC.

4909800.title: Huiyu Party Run
4909800.short_description: Huiyu Party Run is a feel-good party game built for get-togethers — no skill ceiling, no long grind, just grab your friends, hit start, and the fun is already happening

4909940.title: Killdozer
4909940.short_description: Destroy the town that screwed you over! Killdozer is an action roguelike where your goal is to destroy a town while surviving a police onslaught. Unlock items and upgrades along the way to build your Killdozer into the ultimate destruction machine.

4909990.title: Taori
4909990.short_description: A sabotaged time machine shattered the world. You are Taori, humanity's final grudge in a co-op super-roguelike with endless augments, unreasonable enemies, and limitless growth.

4910090.title: Breath of the Waters: The Angler
4910090.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play
4910090.short_description: A realistic fishing simulation with RPG elements, built in Unreal Engine 5. Authentic physics-based feel × open-water exploration — from float to lure and bottom fishing. Read the water, hone your skills, rise from novice to master angler. Fish solo, or team up with friends.

4910140.title: Rawbugs
4910140.genre: Casual, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4910140.short_description: A Linux-native robot programming sandbox inspired by Brad Heide's 1992 Robugs. Wire logic gates into miniature fighting machines, build arenas, and watch emergent battles, foraging, and reproduction. No fixed score—just design, simulate, and save your own circuits.

4910220.title: Incremental Vampire
4910220.short_description: Upgrade your character and play challenging runs while constantly evolving in this Incremental "Survivor". Face MANY ENEMIES, collect gems, chests, and unlock INSANE upgrades and weapons. BECOME A TRUE BOSS.

4911260.title: Final Table
4911260.short_description: A single-player No Limit Hold’em game that teaches you how to think through each hand. Learn with guided play, coaching, lessons and drills, then test yourself in Career Mode without real-money gambling or microtransactions.

4911330.title: Sarkuteri Deli Simulator
4911330.short_description: Manage your own deli shop, order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and grow your small business step by step. Deli Simulator is a simple but heartfelt shop management game. By supporting this early version, you can help us continue improving and expanding the game.

4911350.title: Gods of the Grid
4911350.short_description: A Greek-myth match-3 roguelike RPG. Swap runes to cast spells, exploit each foe's elemental weaknesses, and descend nine dungeons of monsters and gods. Draft build-defining boons and relics, brave permadeath, then climb the leaderboard and dare Hard mode.

4911370.title: UNLOAD
4911370.short_description: UNLOAD is an intercept-focused, top-down shooter where your ammo is your life. Intercept lethal bullet hell from all directions to reload, pushing through extreme, razor-thin crises. Stand against the cybernetic bosses dominating the city and execute your justice.

4911380.title: Hell o’ Halo
4911380.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4911380.short_description: Become an angel and smash corporate evil spirits swarming through portals to reach heaven! In this deck-building game, any office supply from your hand—even a fountain pen or coffee cup—becomes a deadly weapon. Strategically use your cards to vanquish the horde and destroy the gates of Hell itself!

4911390.title: No Results Found
4911390.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4911390.short_description: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

4911450.title: shatAAAAp!
4911450.short_description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

4911560.title: PSYCHE
4911560.short_description: A fast-paced surreal arena shooter where first, second, and third person collide. Pull off backflips, bunnyhops, uncover secrets and unlockables, climb the leaderboards, and master your PSYCHE.

4911770.title: Mind Over Dice
4911770.short_description: Mind Over Dice is a tactical roguelike where luck becomes a weapon. Roll dice, assign values to your heroes, and outsmart cunning enemies. Heroes, cards, acts, secrets, artifacts, and much more! Every roll is a choice. Every face is fate.

4911780.title: SLYTHE
4911780.short_description: A snake made of heroes. An arena full of things that want it dead. Steer, stack classes, build something broken, and dive past the final boss into endless depths, New Game+, and a global leaderboard. The snake never stops - can you keep up?

4911910.title: Pirates Life
4911910.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

4911970.title: Demon God Story
4911970.short_description: Demon God Story is an action shooting game. In order to solve the expansion of corrupting particles in the Skeleton Demon Domain and the Skeleton God's ambition, the protagonist embarks on a journey of conquest.

4912000.title: What Was That?!
4912000.short_description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

4912110.title: Mayhem Duck Simulator
4912110.short_description: Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? 🦆 Mayhem Duck Simulator is a relaxing yet chaotic plastic duck simulator. Take control of every duck, rescue special friends, and stir up trouble! Whether you seek peace or pure madness, the entire pool is yours to command! ✨🛸🔥

4912320.title: Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers
4912320.short_description: Set sail in *Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers*, a dice-driven board game × trading strategy adventure. Roll the dice, trade goods, build your fortune, and compete with rival captains for global dominance in a world that changes every time you play.

4912540.title: Mini Mayor: 12 Years
4912540.short_description: Build your city and survive elections in this city-building management sandbox. Choose campaign promises, manage approval, and aim for three terms. Your choices shape the story and outcome. Will you develop the city or use your power to build your personal fortune?

4912560.title: No Death No Life
4912560.short_description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

4912570.title: Check-In Chaos
4912570.short_description: Run your own hotel — solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Check guests in, cook and serve, run the spa and pool, hire staff, and upgrade your rooms from Standard to Luxury... before it all spirals into glorious chaos.

4912590.title: DELTA REVERSI
4912590.short_description: A New Strategy Triangle Reversi! Place TWO triangular pieces in a single square in this unprecedented game. The traditional "take the corners" strategy is completely shattered! Experience a revolutionary brain battle by Japanese solo-developer Nakamura that changes Reversi history!

4912650.title: band.exe
4912650.short_description: A stylish rhythm game where every instrument offers a unique gameplay style. Play guitar, bass, drums, vocals, keyboards, and DJ, hit every note with precision, build massive combos, and master the beat. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

4912740.title: Cake & Bake
4912740.short_description: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

4912930.title: Don't Play Their Game
4912930.short_description: Analyze tapes, identify audio anomalies, and survive each workday as relentless creatures turn a simple job into a desperate game. Don't Play Their Game is a tense first-person horror experience where every mistake could be your last.

4912940.title: Cardume
4912940.short_description: A real-time PvP card battler fought by swarms of thousands of living cells. Build a deck that shapes how your swarm behaves, then swing the fight with a few well-timed cards. Mesmerizing to watch, and deep to master.

4913030.title: Professor's wife's spasm private lessons
4913030.short_description: Fitness coach Victor is reborn after a subway explosion and gains special abilities. He meets Eleanor, the wife of a philosophy professor, and the two gradually develop feelings for each other. At the same time, they have to deal with the pursuit of the FX Group and the crisis of the ancient rift.

4913160.title: The Curse of Dracula
4913160.short_description: Lead six hunters across cursed Transylvania in a desperate race against the night. Search the darkness for Dracula’s hidden coffins, survive his growing influence, and face the Count himself in his mountain castle. A compact gothic strategy board game.

4913230.title: Seed of Light
4913230.short_description: Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world swallowed by a dark fog. Manage your resources, find synergies, generate enough light to overcome the darkness and expand your territory!

4913320.title: Deadly Murdoku
4913320.short_description: Deadly Murdoku is a noir detective puzzle where logic is your only weapon. Read the clues, deduce where every suspect stood the night of the murder, then corner the one left alone with the victim and name the killer. A hard-boiled campaign and endless cases await. Pick up the chalk, detective.

4913340.title: Yuuki's Sky
4913340.short_description: Yuuki's Sky is a story-driven BL romance RPG set in a modern city. Balance work, relationships, and personal growth as you shape your future. Make meaningful choices, fall in love, pursue your dreams, and discover who you truly are.

4913390.title: Smashdown
4913390.short_description: Smashdown is a hyper-fast first-person vertical-descent platformer. Plunge as fast as you can through walls and obstacles, master your velocity, and survive the impact. Wall slides, wall runs, perfect jumps. Fall fast, fall smart...

4913430.title: Poker FC
4913430.short_description: Poker FC is a football-parody roguelike deckbuilder. Build your squad, turn poker hands into goals, and outscore the AI round by round to win the cup. Stack game-changing special cards, open packs to collect caricature stars, and face boss referees. 100% single-player, no ads, in 10 languages.

4913660.title: Belly Jeans
4913660.short_description: Deduce the captions to silly paintings in an absurd museum full of wordplay, puns, and gags.

4913670.title: The Peg Mines
4913670.short_description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

4913740.title: Odin's Chess
4913740.short_description: A clash of gods played over sixty four squares. Three rule sets share one board: a classical match of kings, a variant where you raise your host from a hand of cards, and a roguelike where every kill reshapes the killer.

4913820.title: Intended Parties
4913820.short_description: Intended Parties is an Adult Romance Visual Novel. As founder Lowell Vance, days from selling your "ethical" surrogacy agency, a buried medical warning resurfaces. Three women confront you: an abolitionist, a grieving doula, and your medical director.

4913930.title: Till The Light
4913930.short_description: A psychological horror about a convenience store, a mysterious entity, and the truth of your own existence.

4914110.title: Case of 1980
4914110.short_description: A sudden call from your grandfather pulls you back to the family farm. As Nathan, you arrive expecting a routine visit, only to stumble upon a horrifying reality tied to a 1980 crime. Trapped and isolated, you must face the entities lurking in the shadows and survive the night.

4914220.title: Trials Of The Forsaken
4914220.short_description: An online co-op horror game where you take on jobs from your boss, enter haunted locations to retrieve objectives, and escape alive, earn tokens to upgrade, gamble, and grow stronger while surviving monsters with proximity chat.

4914230.title: Let's Tidy Up! : Konbini
4914230.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

4914290.title: Exclusive Training of Female Officer
4914290.short_description: In a NATO secret training ground, Gabrielle Clark was framed by Hannah Ringgren and was on the verge of death. After fusing with a consciousness insect, she woke up. She will confront Ringgren and uncover the smuggling conspiracy of the FX Group.

4914310.title: Make the 100-year-old underworld queen regain her youth and become my servant
4914310.short_description: The low-class youth Benjamin awakens the nano power on the verge of death. After saving Ava, he makes a deal with the dying underworld old lady Sophia, making her regain her youth and become his servant, which attracts the attention of Nick Zimmerman.

4914330.title: Singularity Drift
4914330.short_description: Feed a hungry black hole. Haul debris into the void, devour whole biomes, then collapse everything in a Singularity to grow stronger forever. A cosmic idle game about gravity, greed, and infinite prestige.

4914340.title: Someone's Here
4914340.short_description: Just another night in your apartment soon transforms into a tense game of choices. Answer the door, trust no one, and survive the night. Every choice changes the outcome.

4914350.title: Frostward
4914350.short_description: Build a settlement. Survive the winter. In this procedural colony simulator, your villagers are your lifeline. Guide them through a harsh wilderness and expand a struggling camp into a massive, thriving colony island.

4914400.title: HellDay
4914400.short_description: An open-world survival horror game where you explore a mysterious island, build a base, hunt, craft, fight terrifying creatures, and repair a boat to escape.

4914430.title: Holidaze
4914430.short_description: A chaotic tour guide game where you herd unruly tourists through sandbox levels, handle disasters, visit photo spots, push shopping, and return to the destination on time.

4914460.title: TERMies Duels
4914460.short_description: Head-to-head word duels. You and your rival race the same 5-letter word — solve it first to yank the rope and drag them toward the pit. Win the tug-of-war to send them in. Quick match, ranked, vs-bots, and bracket battles, plus a classic daily Weekly Words mode.

4914550.title: Massive Wild Monsters Spawn Near the Castle
4914550.short_description: A turn-based roguelike tower defense game. Defend your castle on a 9×9 board against waves of stationary monsters with unique abilities. Recruit soldiers, cast spells, and pick 1 of 3 upgrades each round. Survive 100 rounds to win. 14 languages supported.

4914570.title: ON&OFF
4914570.short_description: ON&OFF is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!

4914590.title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department)
4914590.short_description: A.D.D is a management simulation game where you run operations for a company investigating the Backrooms. Connect nodes, build workflows, dispatch employees, and deliver the results the company demands.

4914600.title: Pot's On!
4914600.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4914600.short_description: Got your soul completely crushed by a crazy witch and turned into a kitchen 'pot'! An inventory auto-battler where you beat up suspiciously pretty monster girls and boil them in your pot. Cram items into a tight space and experience the thrill of erasing cooldowns with a downpour of MSG!

4914610.title: Dear Magical Girls
4914610.short_description: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.

4914640.title: The Gray-Crowned Reincarnate
4914640.short_description: An isekai fantasy visual novel about Kai, a boy reborn as a summoned hero, and Lilia, the saint who travels beside him. Across 15 illustrated scenes, your choices lead to four endings: become the Demon King, defeat him, flee together, or let the world fall.

4914670.title: MythiCorp
4914670.short_description: Working 9-5 as a corporate goblin. 💼 Train your stats, make some friends, expose your enemies, and uncover a conspiracy of mythical proportions! One wrong move and you're fired!🔥

4914770.title: Blame Echoes
4914770.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

4914820.title: The Walks We Used To Take
4914820.short_description: Hey Dad, this might be a bit strange, but I’ve made a game for you. It’s about you and me, and the walks we used to take. Could you let me know what you think once you’ve finished it? - Junebug

4914830.title: Toy Shop: Tidy Up
4914830.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,985 toys in a messy toy shop. Arrange the toys freely—no timers, no rules, no constraints. Just enjoy the satisfaction of tidy up the messy toys in your own creative way.

4914850.title: Bonded in Darkness
4914850.short_description: Fall in love with your worst enemy in this gothic vampire romance BL visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning to trust each other.

4914870.title: Moki x Moki: your business!
4914870.short_description: Get dressed up and put on your best apron, because it's time to get to business! With the help of a zombie waiter or a fairy manager or even a bunny barista, upgrade your cafe and decorate apartments to help bring life back to the neighborhoods of Moki!

4915000.title: Seeds of Pain
4915000.short_description: A group of kids decide to leave their floating island to go and explore the collosal tree that occupies half of their world. They descent will soon become much more dangerous than they thought. Visual Novel with resource management elements in a dark fantasy world.

4915010.title: Dry Jerky
4915010.short_description: You owe $100 in rent. You have $10. You have 5 days. Dry Jerky is a survival RPG set in Oasis, a desert city with a rat problem, a shady snack industry, and a cast of characters you probably shouldn't trust. Find work, make questionable decisions, and try not to starve before the landlord shows up.

4915180.title: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
4915180.short_description: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

4915240.title: Compile & Defend
4915240.short_description: A tower defense game where you don't click to shoot — you write code your towers run every tick, in Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, Rust, Zig or Lua. Prioritize threats with if, sweep swarms with for, and route air, armor and camo to the right tower. Better algorithms beat more towers.

4915250.title: Hatch'n'Wall
4915250.short_description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

4915450.title: Grim Reach
4915450.short_description: A dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather, craft, enchant and fight your way through a grim, forsaken world, then let auto-combat and offline progress grind on while you are away. Master 20+ skills, chase rare drops, and forge your build across melee, ranged and magic.

4915490.title: MoonHack
4915490.short_description: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

4915580.title: FORTARO
4915580.short_description: Build your own Wheel of Fortune in this physics-driven roguelike. Discover insane synergies, unleash spectacular chain reactions, and spin your way to an unimaginable fortune.

4915590.title: Pebble For A Queen
4915590.short_description: Not your average incremental. A hand-drawn cartoon exploration adventure where quests gate your progress and every choice matters. Smash rocks, master elemental tails, and unlock 1,500+ nodes as Goguz rises from a humble Xantul to King.

4915660.title: No Exit Protocol
4915660.short_description: **No Exit Protocol** is a psychological horror game where you're trapped in the endless Backrooms with no memory of how you arrived. Explore eerie, shifting environments, solve your way through each level, and survive the unknown as every escape only leads deeper into the nightmare.

4915690.title: Next Station is...
4915690.short_description: You operate the final subway train of the night. Inspect each platform, watch the passengers, and decide whether to open the doors or leave the station behind. Make the wrong choice, and something may board with them.

4915950.title: Anvil United!
4915950.short_description: A wacky co-op strategy for up to 4 players where every level is a new crafting challenge and a randomized reward opportunity.

4916060.title: WANDERLAND
4916060.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4916060.short_description: 不思議な箱庭をめぐる、3Dのアドベンチャーゲームです。

4916090.title: Drift of Y
4916090.short_description: 《Drift of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家在不断漂移的行动序列中判断攻防时机、利用技能的前后置关系并动态调整战斗节奏，在充满流动感的单人流程中体验以序列掌控与漂移适应为核心的回合制玩法。

4916170.title: Weft of Y
4916170.short_description: 《Weft of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中编织技能顺序、衔接角色行动并重组战斗节拍，在结构紧密的单人流程中体验以连锁构序为核心的回合制玩法。

4916220.title: The Legend of Fireball
4916220.genre: Casual, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play
4916220.short_description: Aim, charge, and unleash powerful fireballs to smash through everything in your path. Upgrade your power, collect fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets, then destroy bigger targets to become a legendary fireball master.

4916250.title: Mors: Idle Reaper
4916250.short_description: A dark idle RPG where every Hunt is a gamble. Gather resources, forge your build, risk your reward bank against brutal bosses, claim rare loot, and rebirth stronger. At Level 1000, Amo awaits.

4916270.title: Wizard's Calc
4916270.short_description: A mental math puzzle where every round presents a new equation to solve. Chain fire and ice operations to hit the target, navigate around locked digits, survive rule-breaking bosses, and use shop items to turn the tide.

4916310.title: My Beautiful Summer
4916310.short_description: You’re back home for the summer. Relax, chat with the locals, take on their quests, unravel mysteries and solve puzzles, explore the island, and most importantly, enjoy the sea breeze.

4916320.title: Oreworks
4916320.short_description: Start with a pickaxe. End with a fully automated industrial empire. Unlock new gameplay systems, optimize your production, and expand your mining operation.

4916400.title: Lemon Simulator
4916400.short_description: Lemon Simulator is a unique experience where your main goal is to be a lemon and enjoy life surrounded by nature.

4916440.title: Elementis TD
4916440.short_description: The strongest tower… or the safest one? In this solo elemental tower defense, powerful towers feed the Corruption that empowers your foes. Fuse elements, free 7 kingdoms, then survive the endless roguelite Eternal Vigil. Every tower is a choice.

4916500.title: Business Jet Tycoon: Age of the Turbofan
4916500.short_description: In Business jet tycoon you run and manage fleets of private jets for clients. Build airports, design interiors and set your markup.

4916560.title: Mini Mart Survivors
4916560.short_description: SHIFT24 is no ordinary convenience store chain. Strange customers swarm in endlessly, and ramen, snacks, coffee, anything on the shelf is a weapon. Fend them off, chase the clues worldwide, and pay your debt to uncover SHIFT24's truth.

4916680.title: A Simple job 2
4916680.short_description: 💼 One simple task. Countless choices. But what if your job was never the real objective? 😏 Experience absurd humor, discover bizarre endings, unlock achievements, and uncover what's really hiding behind it all.

4916700.title: Medovox
4916700.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4916700.short_description: Medovox is a cozy life sim and sandbox offering total freedom. Manage your own farm: harvest autumn crops, complete quests, and build your homestead. The game's standout feature is professional voice acting! Every action is vividly narrated, fully immersing you in peaceful country life.

4916780.title: Metal Detector Island
4916780.short_description: A cozy first-person metal-detecting adventure where you explore an island, follow signals, dig up buried chests, sell or collect your finds, upgrade your gear and unlock new areas in search of rarer treasures.

4916900.title: MuDustry Tycoon
4916900.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4916900.short_description: Build your music career as a rapper, beatmaker, or DJ. Create music, perform live, manage your daily life, earn money, build a fan base, and compete for a spot at the top of the music industry.

4916970.title: Chrissy
4916970.short_description: Chrissy Boulder, a serial spanker, has captured you in his house. You must escape. Explore the house, find tools, gear, weapons and most importantly a way out. He will be lurking in the shadows. Make too much noise and he will hunt you down. If he catches you he will spank you with his paddle.

4917030.title: Idle Turrets Pixel Defense
4917030.short_description: Defend the pixel frontier! Upgrade your turrets AND your enemies in this unique idle defense game. Prestige, evolve, collect permanent perks, defeat bosses, and climb difficulty tiers. How deep can your defense go?

4917040.title: Hungry Hungry Human
4917040.short_description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

4917090.title: Golf Superstore Simulator
4917090.short_description: Run your own golf superstore from the ground up. Order inventory, stock shelves by hand, set your own prices, and keep customers happy. Grow from a single ball bin to a fully stocked golf empire — one sale at a time.

4917140.title: Hentai Academy: Echo Protocol
4917140.short_description: A dark 18+ visual novel about a war that began fifty years ago — and the people who believe it's over. A ruined city, humanity's last refuge, and a voice beneath the earth that has started speaking again.

4917260.title: Paper Islands
4917260.short_description: Paper Islands is a mapmaking game where you play an explorer more interested fame than honest map-making. Sail on a living map that reacts to your changes, discover rare goods, manipulate frivolous rulers, and make your name by charting the vastness of the unknown world.

4917280.title: The Endless Hallway
4917280.short_description: The Endless Hallway is a simple, linear walking and running experience set in a surreal corridor that stretches forward forever. There's no turns, no puzzles, no exploration just a calm, continuous path designed for players who enjoy minimalist, relaxing movement through a strange, dreamlike space.

4917510.title: Click&Fix
4917510.short_description: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

4917640.title: Nuts & Bolts
4917640.short_description: An action-horror game where you fight off against various robots as part of your job. Time your attacks properly, chain together combos, flee when necessary, and complete your mission.

4917680.title: Cyber Dive
4917680.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Racing, Early Access
4917680.short_description: Drop through an endless neon megacity in a brutal 2D cyberpunk arcade racer. Slow time with Focus, slam into Cyber Dive for reckless speed, chain near misses, and race up to 8 players through a music-reactive city that gets faster, louder, and meaner the deeper you fall.

4917760.title: UNDERTOW
4917760.short_description: An 18+ visual novel about a shipwreck that tore her away from everything she knew — and a forgotten island whose secrets have waited for years, buried deep in the jungle.

4917820.title: Dread Below
4917820.short_description: A sci-fi survival horror game set in a procedurally generated underground facility. Restore power, evade an evolving creature that grows smarter as you descend, and uncover what SaniCore buried beneath the surface.

4917900.title: Coup de Grass
4917900.short_description: Start with a humble sickle and a tiny field. Harvest a bizarre new species of grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

4917940.title: Panic Pub
4917940.short_description: Panic Pub is a chaotic co-op pub management simulation where you serve customers, manage orders, and survive escalating chaos. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local or online co-op as everything quickly spirals out of control.

4918010.title: Sudokiller
4918010.short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

4918020.title: Orbital Tower Defence
4918020.short_description: Build towers on rotating orbital rings to defend your planet. Discover powerful upgrades, battle elite enemies and bosses, and master unique planets with distinct challenges.

4918060.title: HELP FROG
4918060.short_description: A challenging physics-based climbing game where you swing with your frog tongue. Every mistake can send you falling back down. Stay calm, master your momentum, and reach the hammer at the summit.

4918100.title: Black File
4918100.short_description: Black File is a story-driven detective simulator set in Istanbul. Investigate crime scenes, inspect evidence, connect clues, interrogate suspects, and uncover the truth behind a file that should have stayed closed.

4918170.title: Dark Realms: Hoia Baciu
4918170.short_description: Descend into the "Bermuda Triangle of Transylvania." Guided by the voice of his dead lover, Alex enters the world's most haunted forest. Hide from what stalks the dark, outwit a cult, and uncover a truth buried in Romanian folklore. A first-person survival horror experience.

4918280.title: Type Shogun
4918280.short_description: Learn to type! Type Shogun is a colorful educational typing adventure where players defeat targets by typing letters, words, symbols, and passages. Build keyboard confidence, practice WPM, and save the Keyboard Kingdom.

4918290.title: Soccer Cup Boys - Hentai Jigsaw
4918290.short_description: Get ready for a championship packed with male temptation: fit boys, sweaty bodies, and plenty of desire turned into puzzles. Soccer Cup Boys – Hentai Jigsaw is an adult puzzle game that will keep you entertained as you assemble increasingly naughty and explicit images.

4918600.title: RT
4918600.short_description: A modern take on run-and-gun platformers inspired by the golden age of 16-bit gaming. Explore hostile alien worlds, unlock powerful weapons and upgrades, return stronger to uncover new secrets and battle colossal bosses in relentless arcade action.

4918620.title: Ollie's After Midnight
4918620.short_description: Welcome to Ollie's Odd Show! a beloved family entertainment and food place where kids and parents alike come from as far as the eye can see! during the day it's a place of joy were the star attractions, Ollie Oddity, and his band of misfits wow the crowd with their charm!

4918680.title: LEXICON
4918680.short_description: A word based puzzle game where you twist strange rules, uncover hidden patterns, and solve clever linguistic challenges that always feel one step away from revealing something bigger.

4918690.title: CARNEVALE: Blades in the Crowd
4918690.short_description: One screen hosts, every phone is a hidden blade. Blend into a crowd of AI look-alikes, stalk your contract, and strike before someone strikes you. A 2–10 player social deduction party game. Phones join free in the browser — only the host needs the game.

4918720.title: おそうじバトル
4918720.short_description: A fast-paced 60-second cleaning battle! Sweep the floor to claim more area than your rival. Smash the trash, charge energy, and unleash tools. Pick 2 of 6 tools to turn the tide. With 5 difficulties, 6 stages, 10 missions, and 6 BGM tracks, there's plenty to master. Simple rules, deep strategy!

4918750.title: GridGame
4918750.short_description: Grid Game is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

4918780.title: grapplin' apples
4918780.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Free To Play
4918780.short_description: grapplin' apples is a multiplayer grappling puzzle game about exploring various areas, completing puzzles, obtaining collectables, and getting cosmetics for your apple! fight various foes, play mini-games with your friends, do whatever, it's your world!

4918790.title: BloodSpire
4918790.short_description: You are a cat surrounded by monsters inside a castle tower. A fast-paced action Cat-Roguelike with card upgrades and unique abilities.

4918800.title: Pago Forest 2: Frozen Memories
4918800.short_description: Explore a frozen fantasy world in an educational point-and-click adventure. Follow Flora, Freyja and Ramia through story-driven quests, learn English spelling and grammar, and face turn-based battles where words become your greatest weapon.

4918850.title: Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King
4918850.short_description: Betrayed in the Amazon, an elite Korean special forces commander crosses into a brutal fantasy world and rises as a lord. A dark military-fantasy visual novel with choices, light progression, and conquest.

4918900.title: Guild's Requiem
4918900.short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike. Run a guild at the edge of a dying world, send your party into the abyss, and win tactical card battles where every fallen light brings the end closer. Build decks across 10 heroes, chain devastating combos, and pay the price for every run.

4919050.title: Harbourlight
4919050.short_description: Warm light, late nights, one guest at a time. Grow, raise and catch your ingredients, then build each dish by hand across eight flavours, tailored to whoever's at the counter. Listen as your regulars open up, and watch a sleepy harbour town wake up as new faces arrive with new tastes to learn.

4919070.title: More BrainZ
4919070.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4919070.short_description: You lost your job. You lost your home. All that's left is an old camper... until the zombie apocalypse turns your rock bottom into humanity's last nightmare. After isolation, depression, and anxiety, you decide you've got nothing left to lose. Scavenge. Fight. Survive.

4919380.title: Idiots Stealing Things
4919380.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4919380.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all heist game where you backstab your friends for the biggest payout. Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and steal their loot right out of their hands. Race to the getaway van before the cops arrive, because until you extract, nothing you stole is truly yours.

4919470.title: To Home
4919470.short_description: A robot lost in space. Please help the robot, who desperately wants to go home, return safely.

4919510.title: Ember Camp Knight
4919510.short_description: A fast and snappy quarter-view 2.5D pixel art action game. Runs take just 5–10 minutes, and your progress survives death. Conquer a 4-layer themed dungeon, regroup at camp, and descend deeper.

4919540.title: The Clutch Deck
4919540.short_description: This is a turn-based card battle game where, upon defeating enemies with your deck, your cards can fuse together to forge a powerful deck that is truly your own. A diverse selection of decks and enemies infuses each playthrough with its own unique randomness.

4919550.title: Z-Sector
4919550.short_description: Z-Sector est un jeu de tir intense contre des vagues de zombies. Repoussez des hordes incessantes, obtenez des améliorations tactiques et dominez les classements mondiaux. Combien de vagues survivrez-vous ? Maîtrisez votre arsenal et devenez le survivant ultime !

4919570.title: Meow Star Archives
4919570.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats’ severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars.

4919680.title: Space Lot
4919680.short_description: "Space Lot" is a cosmic-themed slot x incremental x roguelite game. Expand your grid up to 9x7, trigger explosive symbol combos, and aim for endless cosmic expansion (level up)! If you run out of spins, the "Big Crunch (cosmic collapse)" awaits.

4919770.title: Tally Man
4919770.short_description: You find yourself in an infinitely looping dungeon tasked with verifying the ledger. Count the skulls, ensure the count, and increase the tally to escape.

4919880.title: Harvest Havoc
4919880.short_description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

4920160.title: Canvania
4920160.short_description: Draw the world as you explore it in this 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania.

4920640.title: プレア・チェスト
4920640.short_description: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

4920700.title: Callejero
4920700.short_description: Roguelite shooter for fans of Brotato and Balatro. Play as real street dogs who became legends. 60-second stages, 150+ cards, exponential builds, endless mode. 9 characters. 12 environments. 20% of net profits given away quarterly — to charity and community.

4920710.title: Keep On Nailing
4920710.short_description: Hammer nails. Collect coins. Repeat (a lot). Keep On Nailing is a cozy incremental game where a flick of your cursor sends a swarm of auto-hammers raining across the board. Grow a huge skill tree, forge mightier hammers, and crack open flashy powers!

4920750.title: Grim Siege
4920750.short_description: Grim Siege is a 1v1 dark-fantasy card duel. Raise your own tower or tear down your enemy's. Six classes and a deep status system turn every turn into a puzzle of combos and counterplay. Take on the AI or other players in quick matches and ranked battles.

4920780.title: Latiarum
4920780.short_description: A classic RTS set in Ancient Rome. Play three campaigns as Rome, the barbarian tribes, or Spartacus’ rebels. Build bases, gather resources, raise armies, and destroy your enemies. Battle other players online or fight bots in sandbox mode.

4894560.title: Topological Board Game
4894560.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4894560.short_description: An experimental strategy sandbox where classic board games become scientific laboratories across different lattices, dimensions, boundaries, and topologies, with customizable rules inspired by mathematics, physics, biology, and computer science.

4894750.title: Paper Shredder
4894750.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

4895070.title: Out A Space
4895070.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship as you cross the galaxy to uncover an ancient secret.

4895220.title: MULE: DON'T ASK QUESTIONS
4895220.short_description: 1-4 players. Smuggle secret packages across a 9 km² open world and a fully explorable international airport. Evade police patrols, customs inspections and airport security checkpoints while upgrading your vehicles, using disguises, and delivering the cargo before time runs out.

4895280.title: Abanto
