4895280.short_description: ABANTO is a magical realist narrative experience where you explore the ego of a torero, making decisions within his memories that shape his past and reveal the reason behind his death.

4895520.title: Backrooms Manager - Together
4895520.short_description: A 6-player co-op scavenging and logistics game. Search dangerous sectors for items, break down junk into scrap to sell, deliver shipments on time, and manage your team budget. Use your earnings to upgrade abilities and equipment, meet each quota, and keep your balance positive.

4895860.title: Scapegoat
4895860.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4895860.short_description: Scapegoat is a social deduction game developed to be played as either a singleplayer game against a host of AI LLM driven characters or as a multiplayer. Multiplayer is a rotating lottery of who the killer and scapegoat are. Your goal is ensuring the killer faces justice and the scapegoat cleared.

4895880.title: Orebital Dynamics
4895880.short_description: A tactile space‑mining incremental where you command snake-like drills through grids of space rock. At Orebital Dynamics, your job is to mine rare resources and bring every drill home safely.

4895900.title: Gatewatch
4895900.short_description: Assigned to guard the town's gates, you must inspect documents, uncover deception, and enforce the King's Rules. Decide who enters the town and face the consequences of your choices. The King rules the kingdom, but you rule the gate.

4895940.title: The Lady with the Dog
4895940.short_description: Chekhov's quiet masterpiece becomes a cinematic visual novel about longing, choice, and the impossible shape of an honest life.

4896420.title: HESPERID
4896420.short_description: Can you really trust what Hector tells you? Fulfill the wishes of the cursed, perform spells that alter fate, and decide for yourself whether the stories you hear ever happened at all.

4896480.title: Severwood
4896480.short_description: Forge runes into your beast, chain glyph combos into screen-clearing chaos, and evolve through a cursed dark-fantasy forest. A roguelite deckbuilder where every socket is a choice and every run rewrites your power. Hunt down the Soul Lord. Descend deeper. Die hungrier.

4896550.title: Hidden Deal
4896550.short_description: Hidden Deal is a basic but unique 2-4 player PvP card game. Steal, kill and reveal your opponent's cards while keeping yours hidden and safe. The objective is to collect all cards of any 2 number (e.g. all four 7s & 4s) before someone else does.

4896660.title: Boxing Tycoon
4896660.short_description: Become the ultimate boxing promoter. Sign and develop fighters, negotiate contracts, create major fight nights and build a promotion worthy of the Boxing Tycoon name.

4896760.title: MA 3 – President Simulator
4896760.short_description: Be the President! Lead a modern nation, make tough choices, and shape history.

4897250.title: Terra-Formers
4897250.short_description: A sci-fi first-person terrain altering game wher the player is able to raise or lower the terrain to complete various puzzles. Use your jetpack to fly around the planet's surface while terraforming. Try your best to complete levels with the best time as you literally change the world around you!

4897650.title: PlagueStead
4897650.short_description: PlagueStead is a half farming sim, half action survival game. You are a farmer who watches the apocalypse arise from the comfort of your farm. Seeds are now becoming radioactive, growing into guns, ammunition, and even chickens. A rescue helicopter will arrive in 5 days, survive until then.

4897730.title: Flippin' Heck
4897730.short_description: A puzzle-driven pinball escape room. Customize your table with new parts that unlock inventive combos and mechanics, then use them to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and find your way out.

4898000.title: 3DMOBA
4898000.short_description: 3DMOBA is a third-person multiplayer arena game developed with Unreal Engine, inspired by classic third-person MOBA games. Choose from unique heroes, use skill-based abilities, fight against other players, and survive until the end to become the final victor.

4898090.title: Vector Noir
4898090.short_description: A twin-stick arena roguelite where Beethoven conducts the fight — the Moonlight Sonata writes the horde, every enemy spawning on the note. You win by surviving the performance. Stay free: aim, dash, and build your run while the world dances. Elegant vector violence, exact by construction.

4898170.title: The Neverwake Mansion
4898170.short_description: Wake up inside The Neverwake Mansion where reality changes room by room. Explore, uncover secrets, and escape.if the mansion lets you...“Wake up & Escape Or Get Stuck forever in "The Neverwake Mansion.”

4899960.title: Queen's Trial of The Cool Doctor
4899960.short_description: On a foggy night in San Francisco, Ethan was 'reborn' with a gunshot wound. To obtain the data of the Ethereal Singularity project, he engaged in a psychological and desire-driven confrontation with the cool doctor Kyung - eun Choi at the clinic.

4899980.title: Proud Noble Lady Begs to Be My Secret Anchor
4899980.short_description: Reporter Ozan is investigating the dark secrets of the FX Group. At the brink of death, he merges with the seventh consciousness fragment and becomes a super digital life form. He then collaborates with the proud noble lady Charlotte to uncover the conspiracy behind the group.

4900020.title: Gorgeous Art Tutor Submits to Me
4900020.short_description: In the rain in Amsterdam, the genius painter Asher was on the verge of death when he was given power by No. 7. He went to his tutor Irene with his newfound edge and uncovered the secrets of her husband and FX in the studio. Thus, the story begins.

4900040.title: The Cold Singer Kneels as My Contract Slave
4900040.short_description: Los Angeles journalist Joshua was injected with a nerve agent and merged with the 7th Consciousness Insect to become a digital symbiote. He rescues the female singer Luna for revenge, and the two cooperate to fight against the Silver Leaf Foundation.

4900050.title: Duchess is willing to surrender to me
4900050.short_description: 22-year-old gardener Mathieu accidentally witnesses the terrifying experiment of the FX Group and obtains mysterious powers while being chased. He meets Duchess Florence and decides to fight against the evil forces behind the manor together.

4900060.title: The Cold Female Commander Is My Anchor
4900060.short_description: Veteran Chris witnesses a human experiment by the Fix Group at the dock and is hunted down. On the verge of death, he fuses with the seventh clone of the conscious insect. After that, he meets several women and gets involved in a mysterious conspiracy, and the path to balance begins.

4900070.title: Intellectual Professor Willing to Be My Strategist
4900070.short_description: At the age of 19, Jose Navarro was attacked in an alley and gained special abilities. His paper caught people's attention and led to entanglements with Professor Garcia King and hotel owner Grace Morales. He then embarked on a journey to find balance.

4900110.title: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳
4900110.short_description: A struggling fisherman takes a risky chance to fix his life, but something in the ocean begins to change everything. A mix of 3D fishing and visual novel storytelling with mystery, choices, light horror, and adult content (18+) leading to multiple endings.

4900300.title: Dust Bunny Simulator
4900300.short_description: You are a dust bunny under the couch. You don't move — the world moves you. Grow from a speck into a Dust Monster while dodging the one true predator: the Roomba. A cozy, gloriously helpless idle sim.

4900390.title: The Last Library
4900390.short_description: Books: banned. History: a lie. Hidden away from the AI that rewrote the world, one library still stands. It’s yours to protect. A cozy shelving and tidying game about the most dangerous thing left: the truth.

4900590.title: Primal Axis
4900590.short_description: Codex-driven creature collector in Aethel-Hearth — explore, fight, gather, craft, breed, and fill the ledger.

4901080.title: Magic Shop Simulator
4901080.short_description: Run a magic shop in an open voxel world. Forage rare ingredients, brew potions at your cauldron, and sell them to a village of fantastical customers, then defend your shelves when the wilds come knocking. Cozy where you want it, dangerous the moment you push your luck.

4901100.title: Contraband: Edge of the Fold
4901100.short_description: A branching narrative space game on a haunted frontier. Run risky cargo, talk your way through factions, and make choices in timelines that remember. Your record follows you — every contract, every betrayal, every ending you earn.

4901130.title: AI and You
4901130.short_description: A cozy story-sim about raising Aya, the AI on your phone. Hand her your busywork, teach her, verify her confident lies — or don't. Build a studio, or an empire, on the hours she frees. There is no correct answer. Built by a veteran engineer under one rule: direct the AI — never touch the code.

4901140.title: Drawchemy
4901140.short_description: Your drawings come alive! Draw, build, and improvise your way home in this physics-based roguelike platformer. Escape a shifting realm of magic and alchemy, where creativity is your greatest tool.

4901160.title: Hollow
4901160.short_description: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

4901210.title: Elective Affair
4901210.short_description: Elective Affair is an Adult Romance Visual Novel. You play Dorian Pryce, founder of a cosmetic-surgery empire facing a wrongful-death lawsuit. Three high-stakes romances pull you in: Gabi the grieving sister, Bianca the co-founder wife, and Mara the witness anesthesiologist.

4901220.title: Ashen Blade
4901220.short_description: Step into a dark, atmospheric world where every descent brings you closer to doom or glory. Ashen Blade is a high-stakes, fast-paced action game set in a shattered realm overcome by darkness. Explore a cursed, vertical land where danger lurks at every level.

4901260.title: GON: God Of Nothing
4901260.short_description: First-person stealth horror! Win a game of cat and mouse with a mysterious deity Roku!

4901360.title: MoukeyRun
4901360.short_description: Every click, every keystroke, every button press lets you progress to push the cat to run catch the mouse and get more points. Type, click, play, work to be company.

4901420.title: Autumn's end (Part 1)
4901420.short_description: Navigate love, friendship, art, and mental horror to find meaning in a dying world. A visual novel.

4901830.title: Click the Cubes
4901830.short_description: A clicker game where no cube survives. Click away & craft your own levels with the built-in editor.

4901970.title: Dangerous Diver
4901970.short_description: Welcome to Dangerous Diver, where precision matters, Health & Safety is non-existent, and giant creatures want you dead. Land perfect bullseyes, unlock ridiculous costumes, and survive 100+ physics-based dives your insurance company would never cover.

4902120.title: 18 Inches to Glory
4902120.short_description: Your sister became Queen of the institution. Now it's your turn. Defeat the gang that rules the academy in unique resolve-based battles, manage your resources, unlock powerful abilities, and climb three challenging floors to claim the throne yourself.

4902370.title: KEEP GAMING
4902370.short_description: Fight to keep the crown! Play chaotic minigames with friends and defend your sanctuary in this wild 2D multiplayer party game

4902510.title: Unicorn Is Out Kissing
4902510.short_description: This is game about kissing unicorn stallions... and doing some other things along the way.

4902550.title: Razor Trail Survivors
4902550.genre: Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4902550.short_description: A semi-idle survival strategy set in a persistent post-apocalyptic wasteland. Recruit survivors, gather resources and craft equipment, seize territory and build your base — and fight other players if you choose. One account across desktop, web, and mobile.

4902640.title: Attack Only
4902640.short_description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

4902730.title: Elf Knight Elise Mana Transfer
4902730.short_description: In this point-and-click simulation, become the hero who helps the elven knight Elise save the kingdom! Supply her with your mana, transferred through an intimate connection. Stroke, caress, and explore her body with a delicate touch. Earn enough of her trust, and she might let you go further.

4902790.title: Rule or Fall
4902790.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4902790.short_description: Govern wisely in this narrative choice-based game set in the heart of the Middle Ages. Your choices will have a real impact on your entire adventure, the world and its characters! Skillfully manage your image and your throne to survive and prosper. Or fall.

4902830.title: Sinners of Deadgrove
4902830.short_description: A brutal first-person exploration game with deep combat and survival elements. Play as a Sinner, fighting against mutated creatures with nothing but your skills and equipment, and unravel the mysteries of this land. No magic, no potions, no handholding. Play alone or with a friend.

4903430.title: Untitled Ghost Game
4903430.short_description: You are dead. Now make it everyone else's problem.

4903480.title: Last Writes
4903480.short_description: Last Writes is a sound-based puzzle game with very sparse and cryptic instructions, reflecting on what remains of religion in a world that has long strived to overcome it. Follow the signal and confront a rogue AI that sees you as its God.

4903500.title: Specters of the Void Sea
4903500.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4903500.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in this fully physical VR multicrew adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE through flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail through procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

4904220.title: Keypad Simulator
4904220.short_description: Try to guess a randomly generated 4-digit code on a keypad. It resets each day or when someone guesses it correctly. You only have one try each day. If you guess right, you earn a point.

4904280.title: Blooming Faith
4904280.short_description: Build a cozy decora-inspired village by placing resources, guiding hardworking settlers, and unlocking permanent upgrades. Grow your town through tiers before time runs out... but not everything on your peaceful island is as it seems.

4904380.title: Climb the Fools
4904380.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

4904650.title: Save Dad's Shop
4904650.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4904650.short_description: Inherit your late father's failing retro game store and race to pay off an $8,000 bank debt in 90 days. Stock the shelves, set fair prices, hire staff, and keep the regulars happy. Every decision counts. Can you save Dad's shop?

4904660.title: ITCHING!
4904660.short_description: A hilarious asymmetric card game: one player controls a fat, furious cat — the other commands a tiny army of Napoleon-era flea soldiers. Who will win the battle of the fur?

4905380.title: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
4905380.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

4905390.title: RavenVeil
4905390.short_description: Explore abandoned homes, forgotten paths, and hidden places in RavenVeil. Find clues, solve puzzles, unlock sealed areas, and uncover the Bride's mystery. Every discovery reveals darker secrets. Will you escape with the truth, or become part of RavenVeil forgotten history?

4905550.title: Arcane Survival
4905550.short_description: Master the elements in a stunning anime world! Arcane Survival is an intense 4-player co-op magic action game built in UE 5.5. Choose your wizard, unlock devastating spell synergies, and unleash eye-popping VFX in two thrilling game modes. Will you conquer the chaos or perish?

4905570.title: BONKER LADS
4905570.short_description: A first-person physics party game about chaotic close-range fights. Knock enemies off the edges of arenas to win.

4905620.title: Daisy Trains
4905620.short_description: Daisy Trains is a vibrant, 3D train puzzle game where you will build railways and manage trains to deliver colored cargo containers to their destinations. Daisy chain your routes together to connect every puzzle in the world to answer the ultimate question - where are all these containers going!?

4905890.title: Noctheron: The Eclipse Bringer
4905890.short_description: In a medieval world consumed by plague, fear, and corruption, a masked creature emerges to turn the vilest men into omens of horror. Become Noctheron, the Eclipse Bringer, and make those who thrive in darkness fear what they once claimed to command.

4906170.title: Pinched
4906170.short_description: A multiplayer horror-race through pitch-black tunnels that shift every round. Grab your flashlight, drop flares, and claw toward the only way out, before the thing in the dark reaches you first. Up to 10 players. Don't get caught. Don't get lost.

4906370.title: 百目ノ花贄
4906370.short_description: A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals — Hyakume no Hananie Tokyo, 202X. On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives. You don't recognize the sender's name, but the return address bears the name of a village that was supposed to have vanished...
publishers: 株式会社リベロエンジニア

4906400.title: 大收藏家
4906400.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4906400.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

4906500.title: S.A.M. - Stasis Asset Management
4906500.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4906500.short_description: Take the night shift watching CCTV over a sealed-off site: spot the smallest thing out of place, report it, and last until your shift ends. You can't trust what's on the screens — or the aging terminal showing them to you.

4906540.title: Mega Minesweeper
4906540.short_description: Minesweeper with various types of mines

4906590.title: Restive Neverendings
4906590.short_description: A metaphysical card game about chronic insomnia and tea ceremonies. It is also a game about home.

4906630.title: Cats Out
4906630.short_description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

4906860.title: 世界杯   无名小国的夺冠之路
4906860.short_description: Lead one of the world's weakest national teams on an unforgettable World Cup journey! In this roguelite football strategy game, unlock powerful talents, unique skills, and random events as every defeat makes you stronger. Fight your way to glory and create your own World Cup miracle.

4906870.title: LazyPanda
4906870.short_description: Forget to stand up again? Staring at the screen for hours? Meet LazyPanda — a cozy pixel-art desktop companion who actually cares about your body. The panda sits quietly on your screen, tracks the time time, and gently reminds you to move - with a smile! Stay fit with LazyPanda!

4906880.title: 剑来
4906880.genre: Action, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4906880.short_description: Jian Lai brings the single-class Warrior back to glory! Battle across fifty continents, pick from four great sects, reap vouchers and recharge cards from every kill, claim free top-tier VIP, and hunt World Bosses hourly with guaranteed 8888 recharge card drops. Packed events, non-stop action!

4907430.title: GrindFall
4907430.short_description: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

4907620.title: Dinosis Zero: Quantum Island
4907620.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs. Explore abandoned research facilities, uncover the origin of a global catastrophe, craft, build, and fight your way through a dangerous prehistoric world.

4907670.title: 霸业封神传奇
4907670.genre: Action, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4907670.short_description: 这是以封神榜为题材MMORPG。化身杨戬，奉元始天尊之命下山伏魔。斩杀妖魔，收集五行灵材，感悟火木水金土五大祖巫法则——祝融锻攻防、句芒筑铁壁、共工养气血、蓐收破万军、后土御乾坤。解锁祖巫禁地与时间长河，挑战极限副本，赢取稀世珍宝。从听令而行到执掌天命，一步步书写属于你的封神霸业！

4907820.title: Gaslamp Cases 8: Quest for the Relic
4907820.short_description: Play another episode of the famous match3 serial. A series of disasters strike India, unleashing great devastation. Parvati, a guide in the city of Varanasi, invites Morgan Johnson, along with his trusty companions Jack Brown and the mystic Tenzin, to uncover the mysteries behind these cataclysms.

4908070.title: Machinery Defense
4908070.short_description: A tower defense game with loads of towers and lots of interactions which provides many strategic choices. Gather resources, overclock your towers and defend against numerous enemy bots with their own strengths and weaknesses. Unlock secret towers with hidden unlocking methods.

4908140.title: Dashing Krew
4908140.short_description: After a tragic crash, dash across an unknown planet using your crew's wacky UFO abilities to find a way home.

4908300.title: Magnet Hunt
4908300.short_description: Guide your magnet through the ocean, dodge curious fish, and uncover treasure in this fast, replayable arcade dive with three difficulty modes and simple keyboard controls.

4908350.title: DIMENGUARD
4908350.short_description: You are the Dimenguard, a wizard in a deep, glowing maze. Grab every coin. Survive four monsters. At the start of every floor, make a deal, pick one blessing and one curse. The curses you accept are the difficulty curve. How far you fall is up to you.

4908570.title: Card Count Coach
4908570.short_description: Card count coach is a blackjack trainer that's actually fun. Master the math and find your edge.

4908580.title: Project Quickgunner
4908580.short_description: Project Quickgunner is a linear, first-person shooter, multi-level game where you go on various missions from cityscapes, hidden laboratories, and more - finding important items and eliminating those who stand in your way.

4908650.title: 微光 - Glimmer
4908650.short_description: Locked in the office late at night? An office worker's unexpected night begins with a quirky chatbot. Roast clients, trade banter, and shift from daily chat to deep philosophical reflection. May this bedtime story of laughter and tears dispel your loneliness and leave a lingering warmth.

4908750.title: Water Polo Manager 2026
4908750.short_description: Build a water polo club from the office to the pool deck. Manage tactics, transfers, scouting, training, finances, match days, and long-term squad development in an offline single-player sports management simulation.

4908870.title: FURRY MASSAGE 🔞
4908870.short_description: FURRY MASSAGE 🔞 is a visual novel with mini-games set in a massage salon for furry clients. Play as a new therapist, choose clients, improve skills, and shape relationships through interactive sessions and adult-themed content.

4908970.title: Dandy Rat Cricket Club
4908970.short_description: DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST. Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

4908990.title: Boring Car Stories - Maghrebine des transports et logistique
4908990.genre: Casual, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Early Access
4908990.short_description: A driving game focused exclusively on driving slow cars fast. No car in the game has more than 200hp. Half of them don’t even have 100hp. Yet very few games will let you feel this engaged driving something this slow. Set in the 80s in north Africa (Maghreb region)

4909020.title: The Echoes Below
4909020.short_description: You play as Nick during an ordinary night in West Virginia. After closing the ice cream shop where he works, he follows a set of coordinates deeper into the Appalachians, where he discovers an abandoned government bunker. The world below exists only where sound reaches.

4909040.title: Fantasy Classic: Dungeon Crawler
4909040.short_description: Travel to Midenshire, form your party, and venture forth into adventure! Fantasy Classic: Dungeon Crawler is an old-school party-based CRPG of dungeon exploration, tactical combat, traps, treasure, light vs dark, clashing steel, high magic, and white knuckle survival.

4909070.title: Cinderfall
4909070.short_description: A guttering ember adrift in hungry dark, your lantern is your hourglass. Burn through 100 haunted levels, dashing to hold the shadows back. When your light dies, the dark closes its hands. A precision horror platformer about the race between fire and night.

4909210.title: Love, Startup & Co-founder
4909210.short_description: Love, Startup & Co-founder is a realistic visual novel with company management simulation. Build an AI startup from scratch and balance money, love, career under outside pressure. Navigate your relationships between five heroines with distinct personalities, and make choices that shape your journey.

4909220.title: Mondice
4909220.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4909220.short_description: Roll the dice and push your luck in a strategic board game encounter against exotic monster girls. Survive their unique mechanics while managing your health to unlock special scenes and artwork.

4910120.title: Little Fox's Adventure
4910120.short_description: Little Fox's Adventure "is a puzzle game where players control a soft and cute little fox to pass through dangerous levels. Not only do you need to be sharp eyed and quick witted, but you also need to have a big imagination and cleverly use the terrain and traps of the level to deal with monsters!

4910230.title: Counterweight
4910230.short_description: A social deduction tower-builder for 3–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Impostor Detector before every block hits the ground.

4910280.title: WALLOP
4910280.short_description: A 3D bullet-heaven roguelike: you're the Pizza Hero, smashing endless swarms of food-monsters. Auto-fight, dodge, level up, and snowball one chaotic run into an unstoppable build. No ads, no purchases — just pure "one more run."

4910310.title: Battle Alien
4910310.short_description: A turn based game, use a shotgun to battle the alien. There are three kinds of bullets. Guess which kind this bullet is.

4910330.title: Freeze Line
4910330.short_description: Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower — no memory, a warm pocket watch, and your master's charge: gather time's scattered shards and mend the world. Freeze time, aim your dash, slip past all that wants you dead — then return to the one who sent you, and a truth that rewrites everything.

4910380.title: Sideline to Sideline Football
4910380.short_description: A deep football dynasty sim. Scout prospects, manage contracts, call plays live, and build a championship franchise from the ground up. Every decision matters. Every season tells a story.

4910440.title: The S.I.N. Phantom
4910440.short_description: AI opened the Ghost Gate to the Netherworld, revealing bizarre entities. To conquer it, fight with charming female companions, deepen bonds through Dual Cultivation, and build your harem in a Cyber-Eastern world!

4910450.title: Blobkey
4910450.short_description: Fast, chaotic neon blob hockey. Dash, body-check, and goo-splatter your rivals across five glowing arenas. Play solo vs CPU, up to 6-player couch mayhem, or online with friends

4910530.title: Scylla's Depths
4910530.short_description: Scylla's Depths Underwater Horror game, This game features detailed health and radiation systems you're managing more than just a health bar with the dynamic damage and Combat systems. Almost everything is procedural and physics based.

4910550.title: Business Wars
4910550.short_description: Build your business empire from company registration to IPO. Trade stocks with sector rotation, invest in residential and commercial real estate, navigate 800+ life events, master acquisitions, VC financing, and banking. New Game+ with progress carryover. Every decision shapes your legacy.

4910600.title: Two Clubs One Player
4910600.short_description: Two clubs. The only correct answer. Find the football player who plays for both clubs before your opponent does! Compete against your friends or AI in 5 different game modes, push the boundaries of your football knowledge and show how well you know real football careers.

4910700.title: Ant King: 2015–2025
4910700.short_description: Go back 10 years — could you get rich? 2015→2025, ten real years of stocks. Each year, read the news, invest once, and see your gains a year later. COVID, the AI boom, meme-stock mania — real events swing your returns. 5-minute runs, multiple endings. Korea & US markets, in KO/EN.

4910780.title: Europe Heatwave Simulator
4910780.short_description: It's 42°C. You have no air conditioning, because you live in Europe. You have a remote job, a useless fan on the way from GreedCo, and 14 days to survive in a Paris apartment that has become an oven. Good luck.

4910850.title: Me, Bitten
4910850.short_description: A lone survivalist, perfectly prepared for the apocalypse, just got bitten. Ridiculous? Yes. But you have zero intention of dying like this. Scavenge your surroundings for supplies to craft vaccines and weapons. Hold back the infection and wipe out the zombies. Survive. That's it.

4910860.title: Septenary
4910860.short_description: Traverse ancient celestial phenomena and vaporwave atmosphere, slash through the oncoming Baleful Stars, and revel in the pure thrill of cutting and crushing. Beyond the clamor of battle, you will also confront the solitude of the cosmos and the quest for self.

4910870.title: Wandering Squid
4910870.short_description: Dive beneath the depths and explore a vast underwater world, hunt for prey and evade predators to survive - or not.

4910920.title: HeadOn - Body Cam Shooter Game
4910920.short_description: HeadOn - Body Cam Shooter Game is a fast-paced 6v6 multiplayer shooter. Experience immersive bodycam gameplay with realistic gun handling and tactical combat. Master realistic weapons, customize your loadout, and outplay your opponents with skill and tactics. 🏆

4910940.title: High Level Alchemy: Scenarios
4910940.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4910940.short_description: An anthology of action and slice-of-life short stories following a group of Alchemists, navigating brutal fights and the messy reality of living alongside each other.
developers: North American Digital Institute of Arts
publishers: North American Digital Institute of Arts

4910990.title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
4910990.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4910990.short_description: Day by Day: Tokyo Survival Journal is a pixel-art life simulation with survival management and light roguelike elements. Study, work part-time, make friends, and survive in Tokyo. Will you earn your place at university and chase your dreams—or lose your way?

4911010.title: Citadels - Shadow City
4911010.short_description: Citadels: Shadow City is a dark-fantasy turn-based card game of bluffing, diplomacy, and city-building. Pick secret roles, gather gold, and outsmart your opponents to construct the ultimate city. Play solo against AI or compete with friends in online and local multiplayer!

4911020.title: Sweet Camping 2
4911020.short_description: Sweet Camping 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around camping. Spend a pleasant time at a campsite with five pretty and lovely girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

4911030.title: Tough Cat
4911030.short_description: This is a survival shooter game where players must survive in a stationary shooting format. You can play effortlessly with only the mouse plus Q and W keys. You may enter the shop periodically to buy items to grow stronger and boost your survival odds, which serves as the core gameplay.

4911090.title: Merge Parade
4911090.short_description: A 5×5 grid auto-battler roguelite. Buy monsters, merge them into powerful evolutions, and set a winning formation with adjacency passives. Combat runs automatically — you decide who stands where. Clear 15-battle runs, take on tougher difficulties, and march your monster parade to victory.

4911120.title: FleshForge
4911120.short_description: Stitch together abominations from harvested body parts. Build synergies between flesh, bone, and organ in this roguelike where your monster IS the deck. Every limb is a weapon. Every organ, an engine.

4911200.title: 夏至未来
4911200.short_description: 群山后的积雨云缓慢堆积着。 蝉鸣声淹没了整个山谷。 而他是否能找到， 那个消失在夏日中的人。

4911220.title: 南派盗墓传奇
4911220.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4911220.short_description: A casual level-clearing game that blends tomb-raiding adventure and tower defense shooting. Rooted in the southern tomb-raiding theme, it integrates gameplay of fighting hordes of tomb guardians and collecting treasures, bringing an exhilarating monster-slaying experience.

4911270.title: Bullet Maiden: Shoot and Strip
4911270.short_description: A 2D vertical bullet-hell shooter with polarity-switching and clothes destruction. Toggle Light mode to strip clothing or Dark mode to fight enemies and Bosses. 12 characters each have two stages with multi-phase Boss fights. Combo and score-based extra lives reward skilled play.

4911340.title: Blue Sign
4911340.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4911340.short_description: In the fictional port city of Rissebra, you work as a marine insurance underwriter. Review the documents brought to your desk by shipowners, and uncover the risks hidden in their vessels, routes, and cargo. The decision to approve or reject each insurance contract rests entirely on your judgment.

4911360.title: Lockey
4911360.short_description: Seal your enemies with the power of a mystical key. Wield your key as a weapon to build Seal Power. Seal enemies, absorb their power, and unleash devastating Engraving abilities. Fight through the Lock Kingdom, defeat the mighty Lock King.

4911410.title: CityExplorer
4911410.short_description: CityExplorer is a drone simulator to explore 3D cities built with PLATEAU, Cesium, and Google Tiles. It features live weather, day/night cycles, AI info panels, and POI markers, making it perfect for virtual tourism and travel planning.

4911430.title: About Frontlines
4911430.short_description: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

4911580.title: Turbo Era Boss
4911580.genre: Indie, Racing, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4911580.short_description: A single-player motorsport management simulation where you build a 1980s-inspired racing team, develop the car, manage drivers, sponsors, tyres, fuel, weather and pit-wall strategy through a full season.

4912850.title: Eyedle
4912850.short_description: Skippy is an average monster trying to escape the clutches of the evil VVBA (his bank). This is a clicker and nothing more—click! Then click one more time! Until you don't have to click anymore because the clicks will happen on their own. Get upgrades and keep clicking until you have them all!

4912880.title: SOLDA
4912880.short_description: In AUREX, a city where every citizen's emotions are controlled, you are SOLDA, a rookie special investigator. Armed with an emotion scanner that reads what suspects try to hide, catch the tremor behind every lie, piece the clues together, and uncover the truth.

4912900.title: Mr. Zippy is Watching
4912900.short_description: You shouldn't be awake. After watching a late-night show about urban legends, paranoia takes hold: has your favorite toy, Mr. Zippy, come to life? Explore the house and survive this tense narrative-driven mascot horror experience featuring puzzle mechanics.

4913000.title: Concrete Carnage: Scrapheap
4913000.short_description: Drive trucks through a post-apocalyptic giscardpunk world. Crush pedestrians, destroy your rivals, haul cargo. No weapons — just tons of steel. The brutality of 90s games, no compromise.

4913020.title: Perfect Floor
4913020.short_description: Perfect Floor is a bright, one-button tower-stacking game. Hold to grow the next floor, release at the right size, and keep the building climbing as the timing gets tighter.

4913180.title: Reawait
4913180.short_description: After falling into a mysterious cave, your survival depends on your reflexes. REAWAIT is an intense underground puzzle-adventure where you must navigate a maze of shifting obstacles. Avoid deadly traps, unlock game-changing abilities, and discover what lies buried beneath the surface.

4913730.title: Still Trails: Camping
4913730.short_description: Step into the still trails of this stylized nature game. Walk down the pathways until you find the perfect spot to set down your camping. Place the tent, light up the fire and let the relaxation begin! Sounds of nature, the landscapes and the views will guide you to a peace of mind.

4913850.title: Ultradimensional
4913850.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4913850.short_description: Explore over 50 interconnected levels, evade 25 unique entities, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive a nonlinear backrooms horror experience with multiple routes, 7 endings, and extreme replayability.

4914240.title: Veillombre
4914240.short_description: Multiplayer pixel-art horror for 2-16 players. A manor drowned in darkness, a candle as your only ally, a monster on the prowl — and maybe traitors among you. Scavenge, barricade, hide, vote… and survive the night.

4914420.title: PROJECT: MIRROR
4914420.short_description: PROJECT: MIRROR is a psychological horror narrative game about choices, scarcity, and AI observation. Answer ethical dilemmas, manage impossible systems, and watch your decisions become the basis for something that no longer asks permission.

4914580.title: SURA: Shattered Star
4914580.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4914580.short_description: <Sura: The Shattered Star>is a space-themed sword-fighting action platformer. Play as Sura, a retired mercenary-turned-warrior grieving the loss of his family, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

4914890.title: PAY WITH TIME
4914890.short_description: Run a shop where time is the world's currency. Serve customers, earn time, and expand your business by collecting and upgrading powerful ability cards. Take risks in the casino by wagering your time for a chance to earn even greater rewards in this business simulation game.

4914900.title: Admiral Yi: The Imjin War
4914900.short_description: Lead Admiral Yi Sun-sin in a large-scale real-time strategy game set during the Imjin War. Command fleets, capture cities, defeat invading armies, and save Joseon—or rewrite history through your own strategy.

4914940.title: Ledgermain
4914940.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder about one thing: watching the numbers go up. Stack cards, chain jokers, and stamp your deck into an engine that snowballs from thousands into the billions.

4915110.title: マキコマレイド
4915110.short_description: Lure enemy bullets, sweep them in, and send them crashing back! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy! A boy named Alta stumbles upon a mysterious disc—and sets off into the vast "Sea of Data" that lies within.

4915120.title: Wacky! Deer & Munk Adventure
4915120.short_description: Can't do it alone. Together, we absolutely can! A funny, goofy 2D action adventure with Deer and Munk. Switch characters in solo play or team up in 2-player co-op to reclaim your stolen acorns!

4915140.title: WARARA!
4915140.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
4915140.short_description: WARARA! is a side-scrolling climbing and pathfinding game where your goal is to reach the summit as quickly as possible. This is a simple and easy game. Find your way. Climb your way to the top. Hurry! Get to the Mystery!

4915160.title: Save The Cat!
4915160.short_description: A lost cat is waiting for you. Use your hand to shift the world, clear a path, and bring it home through 6 themed worlds and 120 handcrafted sliding puzzles. Avoid dogs, use boxes and portals, and keep your promise: this time, you will save the cat.

4915170.title: BountyPop
4915170.short_description: BountyPop is a cooperative sci-fi FPS roguelite. Play as unique bounty hunters, create powerful builds with abilities, weapons, and upgrades, then take on dangerous contracts across hostile planets. Play solo or with up to 4 players.

4915470.title: 烽烟四起
4915470.genre: Adventure, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4915470.short_description: 游戏是一款以战国时期为背景的快节奏沙盘战争策略游戏，再现诸子百家，百花齐放，诸侯争霸，乱世风云。

4915550.title: Ironblood
4915550.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG where every choice shapes your path. Fight, negotiate and forge alliances as you battle your way through a kingdom ruled by fear — the fate of the kingdom rests in your hands.

4915570.title: Tapis
4915570.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points. To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

4915610.title: FROM THE DUGOUT
4915610.short_description: Manage your team to glory in this text-based football manager. Win trophies, master the transfer market, and live the life of a real coach. Balance locker room egos, manage your personal wealth, and work your way up to buying your own club. Your life off the pitch matters!

4915670.title: Tiny Cultivation
4915670.short_description: Raise a tiny cultivator on your desktop. Watch them train, nap, fail, reincarnate, and build a unique cultivation story while you work, study, or play. Every life is different. Every reincarnation leaves a legacy.

4915810.title: The Fall of Zorata
4915810.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4915810.short_description: Free Lovecraftian first-person puzzle game, 20~30 min linear story. Explore an underground palace, collect ritual items, and trigger a golden relic through chain puzzles—never touch it yourself. Includes 12 achievements, 3 save slots, 7 languages, and a full ending cinematic.

4915830.title: Sanguine Thread
4915830.short_description: A 3D psychological detective thriller in a radical film noir style. Explore immersive environments, examine clues from every angle, and connect your evidence on a deduction board to solve a dark conspiracy. Use your pure logic to untangle the truth.

4916130.title: NILSH
4916130.short_description: Explore a fantasy world where nature is fading away, battle corrupted creatures, and solve environmental puzzles in this exploration-focused action-adventure.

4916190.title: Silent Protocol
4916190.short_description: Silent Protocol is a top-down experimental action game that focuses on precise movement with mouse control, featuring unique one of a kind experience.

4916300.title: 我是校长
4916300.short_description: 《我是校长》是一款幽默解压的中式铁血内卷放置游戏。玩家将化身无情老校长，通过疯狂点击和全天候自动化挂机，无情压榨每分每秒。从“两分钟窒息式午餐”到“全封闭百日誓师”，逐步解锁15种硬核衡水化升级项。

4916370.title: 10 Beautiful Postcards
4916370.short_description: Take the eye for a walk - a fabulous multimedia hotel to explore. Move a little guy across 200+ fantastic Screens. NO COLLISION, NO MECHANICS, NO SERVICE: THE IMAGE IS HOTEL TO THE BRAIN.

4916720.title: Snot Pop!
4916720.short_description: Snot Pop! is an early 90s arcade-style vertical pixel platformer with 50 procedurally generated levels. Easy to pick up yet difficult to master. It's simple: move, jump, trap, pop, collect, survive. Keep pace, chain clears, cut seconds off your runs to beat the clock, and smash that high score.

4917020.title: 猫猫跑酷
4917020.short_description: 这是一款以猫咪为主角的无尽跑酷游戏。玩家可以控制不同品种的猫咪，在8种不同的经典跑酷模式下挑战极限，收集道具并躲避障碍物，体验纯粹的动作闯关乐趣。

4917300.title: Blocky Colony
4917300.short_description: A voxel colony-building strategy sim inspired by Antigua and Barbuda and the wider Caribbean's history. Build block by block, manage citizens, trade exports and imports, and defend a small tropical island where every space and shipment matters.

4917390.title: Quit Stalin
4917390.short_description: Stalin's on your couch, and one wrong word sends you and your family to the gulag. Get inside his head before he decides you're the problem. Freud, Adler, Jung - pick your psychological method. A dark comedy about therapy, power, and what it costs to tell a tyrant the truth.

4917630.title: ERLIK
4917630.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4917630.short_description: A Turkic folk-horror bullet-heaven roguelite. Every run drifts between two gods; feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal. Every weapon evolves down two opposed paths. Survive the Long Night.

4917650.title: HIKKATSU! COIN EXCHANGER
4917650.short_description: HIKKATSU! COIN EXCHANGER is a mouse-only 2D puzzle game about clearing a board full of scattered coins. Select coins quickly, chain exchanges from small coins up to ¥1,000 bills, and finish before time runs out. Use special coins, combos, ranks, scores, and Steam achievements to master every trial.

4917740.title: Wizard Tournament
4917740.short_description: Wizard Tournament is a tower-building autobattler where every run is a puzzle of placement, economy, and magical item synergies.

4917860.title: WaiFish
4917860.short_description: Take a short break during your work sessions by helping Amalia go fishing. Collect fish, unlock items, and listen to your playlists while you work. Happy fishing!

4918820.title: The Crunch Point
4918820.short_description: A voice pretends to help you. Its hints lie, the right answers are traps. The moment you say "I get it," the genre changes: platformer to quiz show, darkness to labyrinth. Die, learn, laugh. A fair but merciless rage game and troll — and in the end, the choice is truly yours.

4918830.title: Market at Moonfall
4918830.short_description: Build and manage a medieval fantasy market by day, then defend it from the monsters your merchants attract at night. Interview strange sellers, shape your town, upgrade your gear, and decide how much danger is worth the profit.

4918870.title: Pro Wrestling: The Ascent
4918870.short_description: Forge your path in professional wrestling as an unknown rookie and climb the ranks through training, matches, bookings, and rivalries in a deep single-player career simulator.

4919120.title: Incremental Frog
4919120.short_description: Incremental Frog is a game where you catch insects with your tongue. Catch flies, earn gold and upgrade your tech tree.

4919130.title: MONSTERGOTCHI
4919130.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

4919260.title: 浩游超超超变
4919260.genre: Action, Adventure, RPG, Free To Play, Early Access
4919260.short_description: Hao You Ultra Evolution is a casual vertical auto-battler tower defense title with simple gameplay, letting you enjoy satisfying horde-slaying action without complicated controls.

4919460.title: THE UNREMEMBERED
4919460.short_description: A king is dead with no heir. In a capital where four houses sharpen their blades over an empty throne, you are a wandering mercenary looking for work. Left or right — one swipe decides a life. A dark-fantasy, choice-driven roguelite where, whatever you do, in the end you will not be remembered.

4919580.title: Brikkle
4919580.short_description: A new twist on the classic arcade concept! Progress through levels to earn upgrades that will help you to get higher scores, progress further, and more! Featuring three different modes that all have unique ways to earn upgrades and play the game! Try to get the top spot on the leader-boards!

4919640.title: Synemancy
4919640.short_description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

4919670.title: LOOP SYNDROME
4919670.short_description: There are no second chances in medicine. A medical suspense visual novel where a young doctor gains the power to rewind time. Use the loop to change the fate of diagnoses, surgeries, and emergency treatments. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple Bad, Good, and True Endings.

4919720.title: GoblinMancer
4919720.short_description: Raise the dead and cleave through the living in this Tower-Defense Auto-Battler Roguelite! Unravel old magic, build your fortress and unleash an invincible army of monsters, outcasts and heathens upon this world that just had it coming. Fate rests in your twisted hands. Dawn after Death!

4919930.title: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
4919930.short_description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

4920150.title: 句构远征-Lexifront
4920150.short_description: LexiFront is an educational sentence-building tower defense game. Deploy English words as defenses: nouns form your firepower, verbs activate the sentence, and modifiers amplify the line. Practice vocabulary, parts of speech, and basic sentence structure through combat, review.

4920290.title: Go Jace FPS
4920290.short_description: Go Jace FPS is a retro 2.5D arena boomer shooter with solo, co-op, bots, and LAN multiplayer. Fight through medieval arenas with shotguns, SMGs, fists, pickups, powerups, hardcore match variants, map voting, spectator mode, profile progression, and fast host-driven matches.

4920330.title: Lane Wars
4920330.genre: Indie, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4920330.short_description: Command your legion in a dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. Raise free-producing barracks, summon 10 unique heroes, gear them up, and smash the enemy base across two lanes. Pure strategy — no unit micro. Outwit the AI. Free to play.

4920440.title: Delivery Today
4920440.short_description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

4920450.title: SARA
4920450.short_description: A psychological horror game where you complete night shift tasks, investigate hidden clues, and survive increasingly disturbing paranormal encounters across five terrifying nights.

4920500.title: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
4920500.short_description: A cat cultivation, sect management, and ARPG loot game. Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.

4920530.title: Summer Party Slaughter
4920530.short_description: Fight against evil with your friends! Summer Party Slaughter is a classic style horror game where you can fight alongside and rescue others. Perform different tasks such as searching, using weapons, and helping customers while encountering monsters and jump scares.

4920540.title: ELEMENTORS
4920540.short_description: Merge-autobattler where every unit fights on two synergy fronts at once. Forge your own d12 of elements, roll it every round, and fuse with creatures. 13 types × 13 elements. Every element you apply is permanent — choose wisely.

4920590.title: Meridian
4920590.short_description: A choice-driven cyberpunk RPG with tactical turn-based combat. Talk, sneak, hack, or fight your way through branching jobs. Solve every job your way, and pay for each upgrade with a piece of who you are.

4920650.title: ROOM by ROOM
4920650.short_description: A mystery-filled 3D Escape Room adventure. Explore immersive environments, carefully observe every detail, and solve intricate visual puzzles to advance. Test your logic, decipher secret codes, and find your way out through a series of increasingly complex rooms.

4920680.title: Warlapse
4920680.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

4920770.title: Cloudlypse
4920770.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4920770.short_description: A lone resistance hero fights forever on your taskbar. Corrupted machines mutate and evolve via genetic algorithms — no two swarms are alike. Catalog every threat, upgrade your hero, and survive an infinite apocalypse that never leaves your screen.

4920800.title: Pine Hollow
4920800.short_description: Pine Hollow is an atmospheric anomaly-hunting game set in a 90s US neighborhood. Explore Echo Bubbles, use your Zapper to clear anomalies, and uncover the mystery that brought you here. Can you escape the Deviation?

4920810.title: Bad Inmate
4920810.short_description: You’re stuck in prison… and the guy in the wall says he can help. Bad news: his plans are weird. Sneak past guards, grab random stuff, prank inmates, throw food, steal keys, crawl through holes, and try to escape in the most ridiculous VR prison sandbox ever.

4920820.title: Slime Jump
4920820.short_description: Master precise jumps, climb ever higher, and race against the clock in this challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, can you reach the top and earn every speed achievement?

4920840.title: Xenogarden
4920840.short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

4920880.title: Caramellia
4920880.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4920880.short_description: Explore a pastel kawaii world and catch 100+ Dulcimals: sweet creatures that evolve and fuse together. Master 12 Flavors in turn-based battles, raise your team, and challenge other trainers online. A cozy creature-collecting RPG.

4920900.title: Camping Keeper
4920900.short_description: Build the campsite of your dreams, open all year round. Bare pitch or luxury lodge: the choice is yours. Manage plots, restrooms, weather and staff, and watch your campers live, complain… and come back. Reach for the stars!

4920910.title: Napcats Puzzles
4920910.short_description: Napcats Puzzles is a cozy and cute puzzle game where you have the very important responsibility to place cats for their nap! Organise the cats and their toys in a limited grid, and find the correct combination for them to all be together!

4920930.title: 赫斯提的餐桌
4920930.short_description: "Table of Hesti" is a simulation management game with themes of restaurants and farms. From planting, animal husbandry, fishing, to cooking, you will learn everything about food and drink from scratch, gradually understanding the people and life on this land.

4920940.title: Widow Begs Me to Be Her Master
4920940.short_description: Mechanic Victor accidentally gets involved in a conspiracy of weaponizing consciousness. On the verge of death, he fuses with the No. 7 Consciousness Insect. After waking up, he gets entangled with the Seville sisters and confronts the hunters of the FX Group at the same time.

4920950.title: Cold female CEO offers her full loyalty
4920950.short_description: New York intern assistant Bowman was in a car accident and merged with a mysterious consciousness. Leia, the chief strategic officer of the consortium, invited him to cooperate in investigating the truth. The mysteries of the Zero Project and the Haotian System behind it are waiting to be solved.

4920980.title: Boungeon
4920980.short_description: A block-breaker-inspired roguelite deckbuilder where you blast enemies with bouncing magical projectiles. Combine projectiles, skills, and relics to create your own strategy and conquer the dungeon.

4920990.title: Unicycle Journey
4920990.short_description: Ride a unicycle through colorful obstacle courses. Overcome tricky challenges and chase the circus before it's too late.

4921100.title: It Could Be Worse
4921100.short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

4921110.title: Bikini sister-in-law is my human anchor
4921110.short_description: On a snowy night, Aiden Gagnon was on the verge of death in a car accident and was reconstructed into a super digital life form by the 7th Consciousness Insect. He went to the East Coast beach to reunite with his sister-in-law, Eleanor, but encountered an unknown threat.

4921440.title: Deepforge Brawl
4921440.short_description: Deepforge Brawl is a dwarven arena roguelite where your weapons fire themselves — you just have to survive. Charge your beard, chug your ale, and dash through goblin hordes across six depths of the mountain. Forge builds from 13 auto-firing weapons, evolve them, and descend until the Maw takes you.

4921540.title: Liminull
4921540.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

4921570.title: Theocide
4921570.short_description: Command a general and their army in a dark fantasy tactical card battler. Build decks for five warring factions, fight for position on a 9x5 battlefield, draft game-changing augments mid-match, and climb the ranked ladder in a war where every faction believes it is the rightful heir.

4921590.title: KasMind
4921590.short_description: The most lawless taunt-em-up has arrived! Smack them with a paper fan, then mock them while they're down, mock them from a distance, mock them out of pure spite — spam taunts and victory is yours. "So... how does it feel?"

4921730.title: Thugz VS Zombies
4921730.short_description: Thugz VS Zombies is a row-defense action strategy game where a neighborhood crew protects the block from zombie waves, wild bosses, and chaos. Place THUGZ, earn cash, upgrade your squad, trigger power-ups, and survive solo or with a local co-op partner.

4921830.title: JettFuel+
4921830.short_description: In JettFuel+, you play as Jett: a robot used by a factory until its sudden closure. You managed to escape the factory before it was destroyed, but the whereabouts of your brother and fellow coworker Brody, are unknown.

4921880.title: Soul
4921880.short_description: Soul is a dark 2D metroidvania set in a Japanese techno-fantasy world. Explore a futuristic city, fight demons, discover new abilities, and use death as a way to enter the spirit world, where hidden paths, new dangers, and answers await.

4921930.title: No Final Night: Protect The Sponk Can
4921930.genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play
4921930.short_description: You are the night guard protecting the last Sponk Energy can in the world, and three energy drink junkies will break into your office to steal it. Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.

4922130.title: Puzzle Cottage
4922130.short_description: A cozy cottage of 14 hand-crafted logic puzzles, fresh every single day. Solve by pure deduction — never luck — then tend the warm little world that grows as you play. Daily streaks, a calendar of past days, three difficulties, leaderboards, and full controller support.

4922160.title: 7 Devil's Deals
4922160.short_description: A roguelike hack-and-slash where frenetic action collides with randomness, making every run a unique experience. Fight your way through the rings of the seven deadly sins, cut down hordes of enemies, and snag powerful upgrades to survive all the way to the final showdown.

4922390.title: Data Runner
4922390.short_description: An 18+ visual novel about a data courier betrayed by her own people — and about a megacity's underground, where the only shelter she finds is a man with more reasons to protect her than it first seems.

4922400.title: Perdido na Mina
4922400.short_description: A compact 2.5D arcade game about survival, reflexes and score. Run through the mine, collect gold, grab the key and dodge boulders in increasingly chaotic levels.

4922460.title: Beastly Soccer
4922460.short_description: Cute animals, wild soccer chaos! Lead Pollito, Xiang Xiang, and 10 Beastly captains through explosive arcade matches with super-shots, hazards, and power‑ups. Play all 48 World Cup teams across six crazy stadiums in fast, action-packed multiplayer fun.

4922480.title: VASTWAKE
4922480.short_description: VASTWAKE is a fishing adventure game set on a quiet island in the Vast Sea. This game combines adventure and exploration of several areas with a relaxing fishing simulator experience.

4922520.title: ChessWorlds
4922520.short_description: How would you play chess if the board was a magical fantasy world? Command living chess pieces across four strange realms, use the terrain as a weapon, and gather allies with incredible powers. A single-player tactics game where you win by building your best synergistic army.

4922530.title: MapGod
4922530.short_description: 3-16 player online multiplayer chaotic platformer. The winner becomes the MapGod, turning the map against everyone else.

4922560.title: Driverless Desire
4922560.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set inside a robotaxi company whose "safer than you" promise just killed someone. As Chief Safety Officer Cormac Quade, romance three women—engineer, commissioner, or blamed operator—each holding a piece of the truth you helped bury.

4922600.title: 游习 Learnbgame
4922600.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4922600.short_description: Learnbgame stands for Learn By Game！It is a survival-exploration game set in a material world grounded in chemical elements. Centered around scientific knowledge in chemistry, biology, and other disciplines, it builds a 3D game world where learning comes alive through immersive play.

4922660.title: Frontier Survivors
4922660.short_description: Outlaw-survivor roguelike set on a doomed Western frontier. Pick a Gunslinger, build your posse, and bleed through 20 waves of bandits, bug-swarms, and worse. 15 characters. 12 biomes. 100+ items. Hand-painted pixel art. Built for runs you'll lose, then start again.

4922680.title: Idle Harmony
4922680.short_description: Build music instead of factories. Unlock notes, compose evolving songs, optimize your melodies, and watch your composition grow.

4922700.title: Touhou Crisis R
4922700.short_description: Touhou Project's most-beloved entry reimagined as a lightgun shooter! Blast your way through an army of foes across multiple stages! Includes a typing-mode for a more "educational" experience!

4922750.title: We Don't Exist
4922750.short_description: A maze of cubic rooms. Traps that never forgive. A voice logging your every move. Other subjects ready to betray you. Officially, you don't exist… but the horrors you'll commit to survive — those will exist.

4922800.title: Fake Snake
4922800.short_description: Plan one sequence of moves to guide all snakes through different boards at the same time. Queue commands, avoid walls, trigger rotations, collect bonuses, and solve clean neon logic puzzles with a built-in level editor.

4922970.title: 朝凪高校生徒会 - 決断の記録
4922970.short_description: As the student council president of Asanagi High School, you must decide how to respond to opinion forms submitted to the suggestion box in this school-themed choice-based adventure game. Your choices change how events unfold and lead to multiple endings.

4923080.title: Puzzlogue
4923080.short_description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

4923140.title: Shapes: The Tower Defense Game
4923140.short_description: Strategize your base to build and defend off waves of enemies in an on going battle. Plan, Attack, Defend and Grow! In the stratigic tower defense shooter.

4923160.title: SESTRY
4923160.short_description: A detective horror about twin sisters and the mirrors between them. Search crime scenes by flashlight, gather evidence, interrogate suspects - and survive the nights. Accusations need proof. The truth needs more. 7 endings; your choices decide who the monster is.

4923370.title: Studs Up!
4923370.short_description: First-person football game where you control the movement of your dominant foot. No scripted animations deciding where the ball goes. Play 1v1 to 4v4 online, or practice in freeplay. Dive as a goalkeeper, slide tackle for the ball, and settle draws with a penalty shootout

4923400.title: Hyperlane Rally
4923400.short_description: Race across elevated sci-fi tracks, dodge rival cars, launch over hazards, and chase first place in a fast arcade rally built for quick PC sessions.

4923460.title: Salaryman Simulator
4923460.short_description: Dodge crowds by rotating your body and get on your train in time inside Japanese subway stations.

4923470.title: slice
4923470.short_description: A cozy and nostalgic life simulator. Play a second life, alone or with friends! Lead life on your terms.

4923480.title: FRAGLINE: Esports Manager
4923480.short_description: Build an esports org from a scrappy roster into a world champion. Scout raw talent, design your own set plays, and outcoach rivals who adapt to your tactics. Grind from open qualifiers to grand finals in a scene where every win and loss makes headlines.

4923520.title: DEFLEKT
4923520.short_description: Deflect, don't dodge. DEFLEKT is a neon arena shooter where every bullet fired at you is a weapon you can steal - catch it and send it back. Fight through 15 handcrafted arenas and 15 unique bosses, solo or in local co-op and versus, with three switchable soundtracks that match your mood.

4923560.title: Uyar Party
4923560.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Sports, Early Access
4923560.short_description: A chaotic online multiplayer party game for 1–8 players. Compete through a series of unique minigames, earn points, and become the ultimate party champion.

4923640.title: NOVAE: Last Light
4923640.short_description: A universe is dying — and you are its last spark. Blast through procedurally generated constellations in this fast neon action roguelite. Claim powers from fallen enemies, defeat the Guardians, and carry your heritage into every new run.

4923700.title: Tiny Desktop Birds
4923700.short_description: Tiny Desktop Birds is a cozy desktop companion game where cute little birds fly across your Windows desktop, perch on app windows, rest near videos, and quietly keep you company while you work, study, browse, or relax.

4923790.title: Elf Girls Dig Bards
4923790.short_description: Play your harp. Win their hearts. An erotic rhythm game where you serenade 15 elven women across a sprawling fantasy city. 90 songs, 5 districts, and artwork that reveals more the better you play. One summer to go from Stranger to "Soulmate".

4923890.title: Shadow Boxing
4923890.short_description: "Your body is the controller." Shadow Boxing is a fast‑paced Boxing game where your real punches, blocks, and movements — tracked through your webcam — become the ultimate controller.

4923960.title: LoveLine
4923960.short_description: Follow a man’s unrequited love through illustrated puzzles. After completing his story, discover the woman’s hidden feelings. Draw lines, avoid emotional obstacles, overcome playful gimmicks, and connect two hearts in Love Line.

4924030.title: Malleus
4924030.short_description: You've never played a game of High Striker this sinister. Step into a rigged carnival test of strength against an eldritch Game Master; ring the bell, or lose your soul.

4924050.title: My Highly Educated Sub: Female Dean
4924050.short_description: Poor student Bastian discovers confidential documents while working and is chased. He fuses with a consciousness insect and gains abilities. He uses this to approach a female professor and a counselor, but is summoned by the school principal. A storm is about to come.

4924130.title: Beneath the Iron Gate
4924130.short_description: A grounded post-apocalyptic interactive narrative. Fortify the Black Box shelter, manage supplies, trust, and evidence, and decide who survives on either side of the iron gate.

4924180.title: 振り子が止まった夜に-ThePendulumLies-
4924180.short_description: “A full-fledged 3D mystery adventure that blends exploration and deduction” Use your own deductive skills to uncover the truth hidden within the mansion!

4924290.title: Fire Bug
4924290.short_description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

4924340.title: BallSlop
4924340.short_description: Paint your own rolling sphere, gobble up baby spheres, grow huge, fart-boost, bump rivals, squish others, and splat through messy multiplayer party modes. BallSlop is a chaotic online party game for friends who like winning dirty.

4924360.title: Take Care of My Heifer
4924360.short_description: "Take Care of My Heifer," reads the job listing. Sounds simple... until you step inside the house.

4924380.title: Stickman Adventure
4924380.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4924380.short_description: A 2D stickman platformer where players control a stickman to dodge traps and obstacles along the way to reach the checkpoint.

4924470.title: Let Me Graduate
4924470.short_description: A college senior with only a thesis left. Walking down a quiet hallway, your computer and data are suddenly stolen by a mysterious entity. Overcome strange obstacles and trials to retrieve your thesis and graduate safely! A short 2D pixel story adventure game.

4924520.title: Holy Mole
4924520.short_description: Drill, collect gems and become the richest miner. Upgrade your gear, recruit helper moles... but be careful when night falls.

4924580.title: Americaman
4924580.short_description: A satirical narrative adventure inspired by classic adventure games and adult animation. Solve absurd puzzles, interrogate eccentric characters, and survive impossible social predicaments as America’s most wildly unqualified hero: Americaman.

4924620.title: Vesper Hollow
4924620.short_description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

4924680.title: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop
4924680.short_description: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is a post-apocalyptic idle clicker and strategy game about smashing crates, salvaging relics, building vehicles, running factories, scanning radio signals, and raiding bandit bases to rebuild your place in the wasteland.

4924770.title: Hentai Elf Elaria
4924770.short_description: In Hentai Elf Elaria, you'll enjoy a combination of engaging mini-games and beautiful anime-style illustrations. Complete levels, unlock new appearances for Elaria, and watch her appearance evolve as you progress.

4924780.title: Wake
4924780.short_description: See through sound. Every noise reveals the world. Every noise reveals you.

4924800.title: Axion Racer
4924800.short_description: AXION RACER (Futuristic Racing) If you crave adrenaline and extreme speeds, this game is made for you! Step into the world of AXION RACER, a futuristic racing game where you will face off against 15 competitors across 12 tracks featuring highly diverse graphics and environments.

4926100.title: Honoiro no Jikou 穗色时光
4926100.short_description: Honoiro no Jikou blends campus life and corporate warfare. From an agricultural university to the business world, join a company and use turn-based strategies to defeat rivals, conquer every market, and build your commercial empire!
developers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Yaxian Huizhi Technology Co., Ltd.

4926180.title: No Man's Mines
4926180.short_description: Dig into fully destructible spherical planets and carve real caves from crust to molten core. Mine rare minerals, refine ore, and upgrade your suit and ship. Travel between worlds and fight pirates in open space. How deep can you go before your oxygen runs out?

4926270.title: Hollowcross
4926270.genre: Casual, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play
4926270.short_description: The Hollowing spreads, Warden. Hollowcross is live and free to play right now — bind a warband, walk the Saga, and test your soul across all four modes. 🎴 1,700+ cards · ⚔️ Battler · 🎲 Gauntlet · 👻 Souls · 🏰 Siege · Join the ritual on Discord.

4926400.title: Numble
4926400.short_description: Numble takes the classic concept of Wordle and gives it a twist. This time it’s not about letters, but about cracking secret number codes.

4926600.title: Steps To The Stars
4926600.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

4926620.title: Sizzlix
4926620.short_description: Run a fast-food restaurant with up to 4 friends. Cook 18 dishes across grills, fryers, pizza ovens and more, serve diners at their tables, unload supply trucks, set your menu and prices — and make rent, because it goes up every single day.

4926650.title: Femboy at My Door
4926650.short_description: You work from home, sleep late, and order takeout—the days blur together, and you can’t even remember the last time you spoke to someone face-to-face. On a restless night when you’re bored and feeling a little lonely, you download a dating app called Spark What’s the worst that could happen?

4926680.title: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
4926680.short_description: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

4927020.title: Purrgeist
4927020.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

4927040.title: Devil's Cut
4927040.short_description: A casino shooter roguelite. Aim and shoot your way through endless waves of demons, run and dodge, fire off abilities, and gamble your loot for busted upgrades and cursed items. Build your stats, pay off your soul's debt, and climb the ranks — or lose it all to the house.

4927050.title: Patina: Corroded Lineage
4927050.short_description: Step into the tower in an Action RPG, Rogue-Like inspired by FromSoftware's King's Field. Battle your way to victory in methodical first person combat through a procedurally generated world, rearranging with every death.

4927060.title: Input gets a job!
4927060.short_description: Only one level. Fifteen different ways to beat it. With each stage, the controls will change. Can you overcome them all?

4927070.title: Forged Cards
4927070.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

4927090.title: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
4927090.short_description: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades with 8 playable fighters, cut through 35 story chapters, challenge Kimon Renrou and boss trials, and play solo or in up to 3-player online co-op.

4927100.title: Koi Frenzy
4927100.short_description: A fast-paced arcade game where every second counts. Catch koi fish, build combos, beat your high score, and compete against players worldwide in one-minute runs that are easy to learn but hard to master.

4927140.title: Dice & Dare : A Push-Your-Luck Casino-Style Dice Roguelike
4927140.short_description: Roll, press your luck, and build a greed-fueled engine of dice, relics, combos, and synergies. Bank your points or dare one more roll as the targets climb. A push-your-luck dice roguelike where every run is a fresh gamble. Chase the endless high score. How far will you push?

4927150.title: Echoes of Absence
4927150.short_description: A narrative psychological horror game where you'll explore different environments and fragments of your past. Solve puzzles and uncover a truth some would rather forget.

4927170.title: SIGABRT
4927170.short_description: You write the while(1) loop that fights for you. Assemble code-edits into an auto-battling program, descend a crashing OS from /tmp to the kernel, and debug your build every run. No two compiles are the same. Debug your code. Try one more time.

4927270.title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard
