4927270.short_description: A run-based party autobattler. Assemble ten heroes, build them on a sprawling skill tree, then send them marching into the dark - Vigor only ever goes down. Collapse, spend the haul, delve deeper. Dragons guard every tenth depth.

4927290.title: MoonScape
4927290.short_description: Build an army, raid rival corporations, and defend your base while it keeps running without you. Research upgrades, arm your Titan, and dig into a moon that isn't as abandoned as it looks. Something was here first. Find out why it's gone.

4927300.title: Wild Femboys
4927300.short_description: Survive a post-apocalyptic world as the only man in a hidden settlement of wild, beautiful kemonomimi femboys! 🐾 Defend your new home from ruthless raiders, build deep bonds, and find love in this 12-hour romance visual novel. 💖 Will you conquer the wilderness and their hearts? 🌲✨

4927420.title: Idle of the Dead
4927420.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4927420.short_description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

4927530.title: LIMINOID
4927530.short_description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

4927540.title: The Normie Apocalypse
4927540.short_description: In this game, you fight zombies while building a team of wierdos to help you! There are 64 unique base cards to add to your deck, and 48 unique treasures as well! Combo cards together to DEFEND against the zombies, or deal devastating attacks! Features 7 different areas with unique bosses to fight!

4927750.title: Guardian Heart
4927750.short_description: A multi-race tower defense game where each faction offers a distinct playstyle with 40 unique heroes. Recruit and fuse soldiers into legendary warriors, master diverse race mechanics, and defend the World Tree against the darkness.

4927820.title: Re:Mori Knights
4927820.short_description: Re:Mori Knights is a colorful fantasy action roguelike where fast, stylish combat meets replayable dungeon runs. Explore a bright world of knights, enchanted ruins, magical powers, strange creatures, and lost kingdoms as you build your Knight differently with every run.

4927900.title: The Keeper's Path
4927900.short_description: You are the keeper of a living prison. Train forbidden paths of power, bind gods and monsters into the earth, and drink the strength that leaks from them as you climb toward your own ascension. A slow, dark idle RPG about a single question: are you a custodian — or a parasite?

4928160.title: Kuma & Friends: Can You Save Everyone?
4928160.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4928160.short_description: Kuma & Friends: Can You Save Everyone? is a horror adventure game where every choice matters. Rescue survivors, explore haunted locations, and survive the night. Every decision you make shapes the story and determines which ending you'll reach.

4928310.title: Tatlone
4928310.short_description: Our protagonist lives an ordinary life, yet something continues to spark their curiosity. One day, a close friend calls and invites them to visit a place where their grandmother also lives. Before long, they begin working on a shared project together.

4928430.title: OUTER WATCH
4928430.short_description: YOU ARE THE ONLY HUMAN ON THE SPACE STATION. YOU DON’T KNOW HOW YOU GOT HERE. KEEP IT ALIVE. TRY TO SURVIVE.

4928450.title: Grand Theft Timeline
4928450.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
4928450.short_description: Pull a time travel heist with your friends. Operate a makeshift time travel machine to traverse the timeline with 200+ buttons, then arrive at a time era, explore it, find the valuable, and steal it. Just don't get stranded and become part of the timeline yourself. 1-8 players.

4928500.title: Wiener Rumble
4928500.short_description: A fast first-person arena brawler! Try to get other players out of the arena with a weapon that shoots different items. Enjoy multiple game modes and maps, and customize your character. Prove your skills in the ultimate chaos and be the last one standing!

4928510.title: Quickie Takeout
4928510.short_description: Adult-Only Visual Novel about fast-food shenanigans with your three quirky coworkers. Get into questionable scenarios in this light-hearted, slice-of-life NSFW comedy.

4928550.title: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
4928550.short_description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

4928620.title: Ancestral Orb
4928620.short_description: A turn-based fantasy battle game. Explore the world, fight and level up, and solve puzzles in various dungeons.

4928730.title: Hold the Line
4928730.short_description: Hold the Line is a top-down 2D roguelite survival game. Survive on a procedurally generated island, prepare by day, endure the night, forge your survival build, adapt to dynamic events, and face the final trial on Day 7.

4928820.title: Shelve the Potions!
4928820.short_description: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

4928860.title: POOLIMINAL
4928860.short_description: POOLIMINAL is an exploration-horror experience set in endless pool rooms. The smell of damp tile, muffled water sounds, and corridors that lead nowhere... until the water finds you. A thalassophobia-driven horror journey through liminal aesthetics.

4928980.title: Climb It Up
4928980.short_description: Climb It Up is a chaotic solo/4-player co-op climbing dungeon game. Dolphin-jump, climb, swing with grappling hooks, choose powerful rewards, fight corrupted enemies, and try not to drag your friends into the abyss.

4929020.title: Exo's CYOA
4929020.short_description: Exo's CYOA is an LLM-driven choose-your-own-adventure that adapts to you. Guide a party through dangerous places, talk to characters, inspect the world, collect gear, craft solutions, and make choices that reshape the narrative. You describe your next move, and the game responds with new narration.

4929090.title: The Wyoming Incident
4929090.short_description: The Wyoming Incident is a first-person psychological horror game from Veraxic Games, inspired by the infamous creepypasta of the same name. It's about what the broadcast does to you, and whether anything is left when it's done.

4929120.title: Lumenfall
4929120.short_description: Descend a collapsing tower as a fading ember — solo or in online co-op with Steam friends. Evolve a devastating loadout, brave twisted rooms and cursed Trials, and push ever deeper. 8 heroes, 19 evolving weapons, relics, a 65-contract challenge board, seeded daily runs. Full gamepad & Steam Deck.

4929170.title: Lane Glitch
4929170.short_description: Lane Glitch is a fast-paced combat racing game where you drive an armed car through highways, dodging obstacles and destroying enemy vehicles. Choose your path on a branching map, upgrade your ride, and face powerful bosses.

4929210.title: Military Destruction: Shock & Awe
4929210.short_description: A physics-driven RTS set in modern conflicts. Every jet, tank, helicopter, and missile is truly simulated — guided missiles can be evaded and misled. Plan operations from CENTCOM briefings, hand-pick your roster, bring every soldier home, and seize the oil.

4929280.title: Act Normal
4929280.short_description: Think you can hide in plain sight? In Act Normal, you aren't just playing—you’re performing. Thieves must mimic NPC behavior and grab as much loot as they can, while the Guard keeps a sharp eye out for anyone who doesn't quite fit in with the crowd.

4929300.title: DISCIPLES OF CANADA
4929300.short_description: Play as Viviette, and her three lieutenants, and defeat the three rivalling criminal gangs in this cute, and funny RPG Maker game. Featuring a large cast of chibi girls in a unique Canadian city.

4929320.title: The War Of Nalluer
4929320.short_description: The War of Nalluer is a top-down action roguelite. Choose from four heroes and battle through four biomes across 37 stages. Stack skills and upgrades mid-run, defeat multi-phase bosses, and unlock permanent talents and world-map progress between runs.

4929460.title: Toss Drop Smash Smash
4929460.short_description: Toss Drop Smash Smash is a physics based arcade-ish game where you play as a mischievous teenager hurling objects off rooftops to wreak havoc on the street below. It's part sandbox toy, part score chaser and more! Completely ridiculous fun!

4929640.title: Deepfake Lover
4929640.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set inside a synthetic-media giant. As Chief Creative Officer Emory Sinclair, navigate three dangerous romances—a crisis fixer, a returned actress, and your estranged co-founder—while a consent scandal threatens to collapse everything you built.

4929650.title: Shield Operator
4929650.short_description: Defend the skies against enemy missiles, drones, and aircraft! Deploy modern air defense systems, calculate trajectories, and destroy aerial targets in real time. Become an impenetrable shield for your territory. Repel any aerial threat with a decisive response!

4929670.title: Switch Ball Deluxe
4929670.short_description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

4929840.title: Master Stacker: Tower Trials
4929840.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4929840.short_description: Master Stacker: Tower Trials is a physics-based 3D puzzle balance game. Place awkward objects, read the center of mass, and survive tense wobbling towers in solo challenges or in player vs. player online matches.

4929930.title: Silly Soccer Mini-Game: Dribble Master
4929930.short_description: This is a wacky and funny football evasion survival mini-game with ultra-simple controls—you only need to move your character. Hordes of enemies will rush toward your soccer ball relentlessly; do not let them touch it. The longer you survive, the higher your score. How long can you last?

4929970.title: No Socks RPG
4929970.short_description: Fight groovy enemies, and recruit a team of sexy, cute and quirky Monster Girls to get your fits back!

4930200.title: Mutant Tide
4930200.short_description: The tide came in and it brought monsters. Carve through relentless swarms of deep sea horrors, forge 20 weapons into over 90 monstrous evolutions, and drag 10 mutated survivors back from the abyss alone or in co-op. A horde survival roguelite where the ocean wants you dead.

4930220.title: Sinful Hearts
4930220.short_description: As the priest of Santa Cecilia, save a village’s souls or exploit their sins. Sinful Hearts is a dark fantasy RPG visual novel with point & click investigation, branching choices, and consequences that can redeem, corrupt, or destroy.

4930270.title: FlipPanic
4930270.short_description: Flip the panels to launch enemies — and your friends — off the stage! A top-down arcade party game inspired by 8-bit classics. Clear 8 stages and beat the boss solo, survive waves in online co-op, or knock each other off in PvP. Simple rules, endless mind games. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

4930280.title: Super Football Arena
4930280.genre: Action, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, Sports
4930280.short_description: A soccer game supporting 2 to 8 players in simultaneous online competition. The only rule here is VICTORY! Punching, tackling, and even magic are 100% legal on this pitch. Welcome to the most chaotic soccer match of your life!

4930300.title: Bumper Buddies
4930300.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

4930440.title: American Navy SEALs
4930440.short_description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

4930480.title: Priest Amore
4930480.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4930480.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

4930520.title: Triox
4930520.short_description: An indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

4930580.title: Paintball Playground VR
4930580.genre: Action, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Free To Play, Early Access
4930580.short_description: Step into the ultimate virtual arena in Paintball Playground VR. Dodge incoming paint, dive behind tactical cover, and blast your friends in fast-paced multiplayer matches. Master realistic physics and competitive game modes in the ultimate VR physics shooter.

4930620.title: Hentai Clicker: Vanilla
4930620.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and upgrade your way through Vanilla’s teasing livestream. Unlock scenes, outfits, and playful voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Vanilla is streaming.

4930640.title: おかあさん
4930640.short_description: This is a Japanese horror, puzzle-solving, walking simulator.Your mother suddenly collapses right in front of you. Save her.You only have two actions to change her fate. Search for clues hidden throughout the house, piece together the truth, and try again and again to reach the happy ending.

4930680.title: Fitness Waifu
4930680.short_description: Fitness Waifu is a puzzle game about charming fitness waifus and a sporty atmosphere. Complete 30 levels, unlock stylish illustrations of girls during workouts, and save all the images in your personal gallery in high quality.

4930800.title: Drone Orbit: An Incremental Space Mining Drift
4930800.short_description: Pilot the mothership and watch your drone fleet mine the asteroids. A laid-back space mining idle & incremental game you can just leave running, set to a mellow lo-fi soundtrack.

4930820.title: ClassWarfare
4930820.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4930820.short_description: Choose a class, choose who to trust, and survive seven strange days at an academy where every label becomes a weapon. A free story RPG prologue with turn-based combat, classmates to recruit, and choices that follow you.

4930890.title: Send Forth the Brave
4930890.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilding game about assembling adventuring parties and running an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine hero, weapon, and item cards to form teams that meet each commission’s needs, earn gold and reviews, uncover relics, and build the realm’s most powerful and beloved guild.

4930900.title: Derelict Planet
4930900.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

4930920.title: Songs of Wasteland
4930920.short_description: Songs of Wasteland is a horror third-person shooter. You play as a lone hero Emma who wanders the wasteland which has no sign of civilization. Only terrifying monsters lurk in the shadows and underground. Shoot, explore, and survive, the future of humanity is in your hands.

4930940.title: Bunny Colony
4930940.short_description: Cut and plant grass, guide your bunnies, and grow their numbers in this simulation puzzle. Clear traffic jams, supply food efficiently, and expand a colony that keeps multiplying through farming and breeding! How many bunnies can you make?

4930960.title: Snip & Fly
4930960.short_description: A cozy rope-cutting puzzle with a sly little twist. Swipe to snip the ropes and set the tied-up birds free — but slip up and free an eagle, and it'll bite back.

4931390.title: Don't Go Duck
4931390.short_description: Don't Go Duck is a physics platformer where you roll an arrow-marked die inside a cylinder. The arrow on the top face sets the duck’s direction. Time each roll and jump carefully to guide the duck up the cloud platforms without falling.

4931410.title: Sudoku Atlas
4931410.short_description: Premium, distraction-free Sudoku: no ads, no accounts, no internet. Eleven grid sizes (4×4–25×25), deterministic seeded puzzles, full keyboard/mouse/touch support, and a high-contrast, colorblind-friendly design. Buy once, own it forever.

4931480.title: Harvest Together
4931480.short_description: Build a cozy farm with friends or solo! Grow crops, raise animals, and ride your horse across the meadows. Dynamic weather waters your crops when it rains and blankets your farm in winter snow. Online co-op for up to 4 players — sow together, grow together.

4931550.title: MOGUMOGU! POOP BATTLE
4931550.short_description: Feed 🐰 and launch 💩?! A simple-control online 💩 battle begins now!

4931560.title: Key Lingo
4931560.short_description: A typing-based language learning game with WarioWare-style quick mini-games, spaced repetition, and built-in mnemonics — fun even if you already know the language, with secret advanced modes for dedicated learners.

4931590.title: All Hands
4931590.short_description: All Hands is a Sci-fi Strategy RPG with Turn Based combat and a focus on relationship management with the Corporate Nations that rule the stars. Journey with your fleet through the universe dealing with the situations that present themselves, and face the reward or consequences of your choices.

4931630.title: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper
4931630.short_description: A cozy single-player simulation game. You've inherited an old vineyard, and a cellar of 1,600 wine bottles, each waiting for its place. Sort, organize, and shelve them all as the new cellar keeper. Relax into the rain and music. Unlock new skills, trust your instincts, and bring the cellar to life.

4931760.title: BlockSouls
4931760.short_description: BlockSouls is a surreal indie adventure set in a lonely brutalist city. Explore strange places, meet unsettling characters, face disturbing enemies, and uncover hidden paths in a dark, dreamlike world.

4931840.title: LOCO
4931840.short_description: LOCO is a social deduction game set on a train. The Traitors are trying to stop the train while the Passengers must uncover and eliminate them before they succeed (and The Smokers must smoke).

4931850.title: Maneki Mania
4931850.short_description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

4931860.title: Rotting Grief
4931860.short_description: A short psychological-horror narrative in which your choices matter. Journey through the give stages of grief as Liam, a man who just recently lost his wife due to... unknown... circumstances.

4931920.title: TREASURE ISLAND: The Crimson Legacy
4931920.short_description: A dark adult visual novel about legacy, betrayal, and buried power. Return to Treasure Island with Jim Hawkins, six dangerous women, pirates, secret orders, and the Crimson Compass as the sea opens the path to Flint’s true treasure.

4932010.title: Chrome Circuit
4932010.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

4932030.title: Still Pines: watchtower
4932030.short_description: Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery where you play as Claire, a college student trapped at an isolated winter watchtower. Explore a semi-open snowy forest, uncover clues about a missing ranger, survive the thing watching from the trees, and follow story objectives.

4932040.title: Aetherdrifter
4932040.short_description: A deep sci-fi idle RPG. Mine and salvage dead fleets, refine matter into alloy, fabricate parts, and rebuild your ship from a scout to a world-sized Ark. Fight ship-vs-sector battles, chart a starfield, automate the grind, and keep earning while you're away.

4932190.title: Deck of Empires
4932190.short_description: A multiplayer RTS game where you are dealt cards every 60 seconds, and you use strategy to place cards, and command your units to create and grow a powerful empire to defeat your foes!

4932290.title: To Raise a King
4932290.short_description: You are a young king with twenty four years to raise a kingdom, choose your queen, prepare your heir, and hand the crown on well. A turn based medieval strategy told in painted storybook chapters, with a fully voiced cast and six queens whose stories reshape your reign.

4932320.title: Cozy Commons
4932320.short_description: You've arrived in town jobless, catfished, and completely broke. But every great story needs a little drama! It’s time to build your dream home, make lifelong friends, and uncover the town's deepest secrets.

4932350.title: Watch The Edge Honey!
4932350.short_description: Climb to the top in this adorable anime adventure! EVA will guide you every step of the way. What could go wrong? ♡

4932410.title: Farmabot
4932410.short_description: A seasonal farming roguelike. Grow and crossbreed crops with real genetics, ride the four seasons and their weather, and defend your farm from waves of enemies and seasonal bosses. Upgrade your bot, raid the wastes, and uncover the truth before O.N.Y.X. finds you.

4932460.title: Earth Simulator
4932460.short_description: Shape a planet. Watch history unfold.

4932470.title: Tac-Tums: DreamQuest
4932470.short_description: Tac-Tums: DreamQuest is a cozy but challenging pixel art action-platformer. A young boy enters his dreams to rescue his Yaya. Explore magical worlds inspired by Venezuela, overcome enemies, puzzles, and platforming challenges, discover new powers as you advance through this retro adventure.

4932480.title: Wartorn: A Visual Novel of the Ukraine War
4932480.short_description: A narrative game about ordinary people caught in war. Resist, flee, endure, or speak out — every choice reshapes your story across four endings. Set during the war in Ukraine. Half of net proceeds go to humanitarian relief. An act of empathy, not entertainment.

4932500.title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy
4932500.short_description: 送外卖，攒彩礼，目标 18 万 8！“想娶我女儿，彩礼必须 18 万 8，一分都不能少！”，丈母娘的一句话，让你决定离开电子厂，开始全职送外卖，努力奋斗，只为攒够彩礼，迎娶你的心上人。

4932580.title: Last Choice Hero
4932580.short_description: Is that choice really heroic? Guide an immortal Hero through absurdly cruel ultimate choices in this dark-comedy fantasy ADV.

4932610.title: Twerk Simulator
4932610.short_description: Shake that, earn cash, and upgrade your cheeks from plain to THICC! Customize your look with gold thongs, clear up pimples at the clinic, and battle your friends online in hilarious multiplayer twerk-offs. The ultimate cheek-clapping clicker simulator is here!

4932750.title: Phone Booth
4932750.short_description: You are currently trapped inside a phone booth. When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins. From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

4932820.title: Bottle Flip Inc
4932820.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

4932860.title: Hentai Age Workplace
4932860.short_description: A timeless, timer-free puzzle game where you piece together fragments in a calm atmosphere to reveal stunning portraits of beautiful maidens. Perfect for relaxing and unwinding at your own pace.

4933310.title: Just a Stupid Room
4933310.short_description: Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.

4933400.title: Coin & Steel
4933400.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Early Access
4933400.short_description: Coin & Steel is a top down fantasy RPG blending blacksmithing, shop management, quests, and action combat. Forge and sell equipment, explore dangerous lands, battle monsters, expand into new businesses, and play card games at the local tavern.

4933590.title: Titanite
4933590.genre: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play
4933590.short_description: Titanite is a post-apocalyptic Mecha survival game blending free-form building with competitive PvP. Command powerful Mechas, navigate the deadly Warzone, and retreat to the safety of your Base World. Forge your own survival rules through strategy and gunfire!

4933610.title: DUAT
4933610.short_description: A week after a research team disappears inside a Egyptian pyramid, you are sent to uncover what happened. What begins as a routine recovery mission quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival. Uncover the truth buried in the ancient ruins and escape the nightmare hunting you from the shadows.

4933650.title: One More Shake
4933650.short_description: Shake a vending machine, collect cans, earn money, and build the ultimate idle vending empire through satisfying upgrades, automation, and endless progression.

4933730.title: Handslayer
4933730.short_description: Handslayer is a single-player roguelike built around poker hands. Every battle is a tactical duel where you build not one, but three hands to defeat your opponent. Collect powerful relics, discover ancient artifacts, and forge game-breaking synergies. Every hand matters.

4933760.title: Fleetfall - Galaxy Domination
4933760.short_description: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

4933800.title: Gods Play Dice
4933800.short_description: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

4933850.title: Incremental Garden
4933850.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

4933860.title: SacriForge
4933860.short_description: A dark-fantasy roguelite where loot isn't the reward — it's the fuel. Sacrifice your gear to forge one ever-evolving artefact, bend your build around brutal Keystones and Pacts, and carve through a cursed forest where death is permanent.

4933990.title: Alembic
4933990.short_description: A falling-sand sandbox built on the **real periodic table**. Every element has genuine physical properties, and reactions emerge from real chemistry — rust iron, ignite thermite, run a galvanic cell, split a uranium pile to criticality. Discover it all in an encyclopedia that fills as you play.

4934040.title: Hentai Furry Lioness
4934040.short_description: Hentai Furry Lioness is an adult puzzle game featuring beautiful anime artwork. Unlock new illustrations of the majestic Lioness, complete 24 levels, earn achievements, expand your gallery, and enjoy an atmospheric soundtrack throughout your adventure.

4934050.title: Lustpunk 69
4934050.short_description: Lead the return of a legendary gang boss, take over the neon lit metropolis of City77, defeat rival gang leaders, build your own crew, and unlock fully animated adult scenes.

4934200.title: Loot Survivors
4934200.short_description: Survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

4934300.title: Cheese, Please!
4934300.short_description: Cheese, Please! is a short incremental bullet hell about the super-pilot Mouse fighting against the Cat Empire. Break in, snatch precious Cheese, and upgrade your ship using a massive Skill Tree. Discover dozens of unique weapons and powerful perks to become unstoppable.

4934380.title: Guess
4934380.short_description: Guess is a calm word-puzzle game where you solve each word from its definition, then carry the letters you earned into the next — an endless chain of vocabulary. Play Endless mode to build a streak, or the shared Daily Challenge, with progressive hints that guide you whenever you get stuck.

4934390.title: Universalia
4934390.short_description: Sling new worlds into orbit inside real photographed skies. A zen physics game about gravity, patience, and the quiet joy of watching something you made keep turning. Fifteen handcrafted star systems. Every failure is a beautiful explosion.

4934400.title: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator
4934400.short_description: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

4934440.title: Rockblaze
4934440.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

4934530.title: Dungeon Nox Exotica
4934530.short_description: A retro first-person dungeon RPG with manual exploration, automatic return routes, and battles you can automate or command. Loot, regroup, read your expedition logs, and descend one floor deeper.

4936120.title: Necromancer Idle: The Endless Drain
4936120.short_description: Defeat The Necromancer and free the world from his evil! An Idle/Incremental inspired by RPGs and Roguelites: choose between Soldier, Ranger or Mage, die and rise again keeping your innate experience, automate your actions and reincarnate until you end the curse that drains your life.

4936190.title: The Outskirts
4936190.short_description: You wake up in a dense fog, standing in the middle of a desolate four-way intersection at the edge of town. Trapped in an endlessly repeating neighborhood, you must carefully determine which of the four branching roads is the safe route.

4936250.title: Station Between
4936250.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

4936280.title: When Two Roses Collide
4936280.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

4936300.title: Yokai Hunter
4936300.short_description: Hunt yōkai. Evolve your arsenal. Outlast the swarm. A bullet-heaven survival roguelite where every hunter plays differently, every weapon transforms mid-run, and the horde never stops growing.

4936460.title: Mossvale
4936460.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4936460.short_description: Mossvale is a small online fantasy RPG where you fight monsters, collect gear, complete quests, fish, cook, trade, and grow your character in a shared pixel world.

4936530.title: Color Cup Racing
4936530.short_description: A chaotic marble motorsport game where colorful racers battle through wild themed tracks, career seasons, fake-coin predictions, and broadcast-style championships.

4936540.title: The Ones Who Answered
4936540.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

4936630.title: Zombie Tag
4936630.short_description: Zombie Tag is a multiplayer tag game where humans run from a zombie in a construction-site parkour arena. The zombie infects caught players, turning them into zombies. Push others with boxing gloves, use traps, and survive until time runs out.

4936660.title: Peg Champ
4936660.short_description: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break all the red pegs to win, but be careful you don't run out of shots. Earn money and fill out a huge upgrade tree on your journey to become the Peg Champ!

4936690.title: Hideout Heist
4936690.short_description: A cooperative game about infiltration, hide-and-seek, and a tense standoff between cunning intruders and a security guard. You and your team find yourselves in a restricted area where a cache is hidden somewhere. Your mission is to find it, reach your objective, and avoid getting caught.

4936700.title: Caravan Survivors
4936700.short_description: Keep the wheels turning. Your caravan rolls down a deadly road while hired heroes and mounted turrets hold back the endless horde. Build your loadout, manage your caravan's inventory, and haul risky cargo for profit. Survive the route at all cost.

4936930.title: Offerings of Odin
4936930.short_description: Offerings of Odin is a fast-paced roguelite twin-stick shooter where every floor lasts just 30 seconds. Survive a wave of enemies before making your escape to the next level. Upgrade your build, and jump straight back into bullet-hell chaos.

4937100.title: Buns!
4937100.short_description: "Buns!" is a casual and cozy, single-player game about bunnies baking buns. Make bread to sell in your bakery, and to deliver to your new neighbors, around an open-world map. Relax with self-paced gameplay and easy controls. Let's make some buns!

4937160.title: Sustentability
4937160.short_description: Sustentability is a high-intensity hack n’ slash inspired by musou-style combat, where you battle massive hordes of enemies with fluid and stylish gameplay, rooted in nature and Brazilian culture.

4937250.title: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story
4937250.short_description: A stray flyer, a run-down detective agency, a boss who vanishes on day one. In early-2000s Japan, untangle small cases and the reasons behind them — a retro-PC "line & paint" mystery.

4937290.title: EAT THE RICH
4937290.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4937290.short_description: 2036. President Tump Jr, America’s first tree president, declares $TUMP the national currency. Money is worthless. It is now the pitchfork economy. Eat the rich or rob the poor. Become the 1% of the 99%.

4937340.title: Boobs & Hexes
4937340.short_description: Boobs & Hexes is a 2D visual novel about one cursed apartment, eight beautiful witches, and the guy who accidentally set them all loose. Nobody can leave until the spell is broken - so might as well fall in love with them! Pick your side, win your coven, and decide how the story ends.

4937370.title: Warlords: Deckbuilding Autobattler
4937370.short_description: Every card is an army. A roguelite deckbuilder-autobattler where you drop squads, spells, and siege engines straight onto a living battlefield and watch the clash resolve. Draft outlandish packs, break boss lords mid-fight, take the crown. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

4937380.title: Starspire Hunters
4937380.short_description: Hunt monsters, sell their loot, unlock powerful upgrades, and earn your place in the Starspire Hunters Guild as you climb the mysterious, reality-bending Starspire in this charming side-scrolling Action RPG.

4937420.title: Zereoton Hauntings 3
4937420.short_description: Zereoton Hauntings 3 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

4937470.title: 最上邸R
4937470.short_description: A Japanese-style horror visual novel set in 1980s Japan. Five years after a mysterious disappearance, Yukari Kanzaki and Akane Kiryu enter the abandoned Mogami Mansion. Explore its hidden secrets, uncover its dark past, and face multiple endings shaped by your choices.

4937570.title: 猎国沉默专属
4937570.genre: Casual, RPG, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4937570.short_description: Lie Guo Silent Exclusive is an ancient Chinese imperial idle casual game focused on relaxed tap-and-idle progression. You can steadily accumulate wealth without constant manual operation.

4937660.title: My Spell Shop
4937660.short_description: Did you ever think, 'I want to make my own spells'? Then this game is for you. In a fantasy world full of magic, you're both a new mage and a new shop owner who is trying to advance as both. Buy new components, make new spells, and sell those spells to the customers who enter your spell shop.

4937700.title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
4937700.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

4937720.title: Oath Eternal
4937720.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

4937730.title: Moonlit Journey:  Homestead
4937730.short_description: Purchase your homestead, master unique skills, and uncover hidden secrets in a cozy top-down farming RPG where the world transforms through all four seasons.

4937900.title: NODE ZERO

4937940.title: Flip & Conquer
4937940.short_description: A coin decides every battle — you decide everything else: the target, the stake, the cards you spring. Not luck, nerve. 4937950.title: My Succubus Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
4937950.short_description: A seductive adult puzzle game where each completed level reveals more of a mysterious succubus. Solve 100 image-based puzzles, unlock the gallery, and progress toward intimate rewards.

4937990.title: CrossSpell
4937990.short_description: Weave words and cross them for massive combos! A competitive crossword puzzle where you freely place letters and "unleash" them to blow up your opponents. No falling blocks! Master deep tactics, play unique rules, or use custom dictionaries in "Deck Spell" mode in up to 4-player battles!

4938060.title: Sweet Secret
4938060.short_description: Sweet Secret - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around secrets. Enjoy the pleasant time spent at home with five pretty and cute girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

4938190.title: Cozy Coast
4938190.short_description: Cozy Coast is a tiny fishing game that lives in the corner of your screen. Cast a line while you work, fill your almanac, and grow your angler at your own pace. When you want company, open the hub and fish alongside friends.

4938300.title: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
4938300.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4938300.short_description: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

4938320.title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
4938320.short_description: Bocage is a peaceful 3D puzzle game where you place farm pieces to fill each grid. Respect each animal's constraints, master new puzzles and watch your little landscape come to life!

4938410.title: Last Fiefdom

4938410.short_description: Last Fiefdom is a large-scale multiplayer online strategy game. 4939150.title: Hadal Zone
4939150.short_description: Survive this puzzle-horror adventure and uncover the truth behind the terrible story hiding in the depths of the aquarium! But beware: once you cross the point of no return, there is no going back...

4939160.short_description: Explore a mysterious roadside motel as Anna in this story-driven adult simulation. Discover hidden interactions, unlock new scenes, customize your experience, and enjoy a cinematic interactive adventure created exclusively for mature audiences.

4939220.title: Teddy's Horde
4939220.short_description: A top-down arena survival brawler. Pick a bear, drop into the arena, and hold out against escalating waves of wardens. Alone or with your friends in local coop.

4939320.title: Botter - Idle Dungeon Crawler
4939320.short_description: Define your character: gear, stats, and behaviour, then deploy. Your bot descends procedurally-generated dungeons on its own: fighting, looting, leveling up. Watch it work, gear it better, send it deeper.

4939340.title: Xarana Xos: BACKROOMS
4939340.short_description: A psychological horror game inspired by the Backrooms with a unique Yakut cultural atmosphere. Explore abandoned spaces, uncover hidden secrets, and try to survive in a place where reality has long lost its boundaries. But remember: you may not be alone here.

4939360.title: Hentai Puzzle: Sunny
4939360.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Sunny: Solve adult anime puzzles with Sunny, a mischievous lifeguard. Progress through the game, unlock teasing images and scenes, and complete her alluring gallery.

4939420.title: Facrobry
4939420.short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

4939450.title: Kyrox Arena
4939450.short_description: The sky tore open and the Swarm poured through. Survive endless waves in a first-person pixel arena, tear new guns from what you kill, and stack run-defining upgrades. Then take your aim online for brutal 1v1 duels. Fast, dark, and unapologetically retro.

4939480.title: Starter Dungeon
4939480.short_description: A challenging Tower Defense game set in the world of a fantasy game. Manage a dungeon by reading through monster resumes and choosing who to hire, then summoning them to defeat the waves of incoming heroes after your treasure!

4939500.title: Weirdose
4939500.short_description: A techno-gothic incremental roguelite with inventory management. Your application to WEIRD CO. has been accepted. Employee onboarding is now in progress. Please report to the Emotional Production Department.

4939890.title: Spidoosh
4939890.short_description: Swing into this physics-based multiplayer spider battleground. Master your webs to swing, slingshot, climb, and build structures. Catch elemental flies to infuse your attacks with fire, electricity, and acid. Become the toughest, most aura’ed up spider of all!

4939950.title: Hunt Skeletons Together
4939950.short_description: Take on a cursed church in Hell with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, bone-throwing hordes. Swing above the dead with your grappling hook. Blast off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

4939980.title: Rung of Y
4939980.short_description: 《Rung of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中逐级建立优势、在攻防转换中把控节奏并推动角色成长，在层层递进的单人流程中体验以行动层级与策略推进为核心的回合制玩法。

4940180.title: 300 Seconds Before Darkness
4940180.short_description: In a world immersed in total darkness, light is the only hope. Lose it, and your journey ends; keep it, and you may live to see another day. While venturing across lands where monsters loom, harvest the energy required to keep the seed of hope well lit. Time is short, so may those who strive thrive!

4940190.title: Background Hero
4940190.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4940190.short_description: Every hero starts somewhere, usually with a dull axe, an even duller pickaxe. Background Hero puts you in charge of building one from scratch, one skill at a time. Idle progression, tiered upgrades, task lists, resources, dungeon rewards -- perfect for the completionist chasing the elusive 100%

4940330.title: Derby Heroines: Run, Bet, Win!
4940330.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Racing, Simulation, Sports
4940330.short_description: Horse-racing rules, track-girl speed. Collect 100+ runners, train them, chase the PINZUDO 5 jackpot. In-game currency only. Streaming welcome!

4940340.title: Spinny-Roly 64
4940340.short_description: An old-school gem collection game about a roly-poly who likes to bounce around.

4940400.title: Time Boxing
4940400.short_description: Throw punches across time itself. Play cards to attack, rewind, and rewrite the timeline in fast card-battler boxing duels. Master unique fighters and decks—just don't open a paradox you can't close, or the time fights back.

4940410.title: A Nice Safe Job
4940410.short_description: A Nice Safe Job is a cozy 2D crime caper set in a 1950s metropolis. Master tactile safe-cracking puzzles, outsmart dynamic security systems, and climb the Thieves Guild ranks to become the city’s most notorious thief. Crack the safe, grab the loot, and get out clean. 4940900.title: Little Noël: Christmas Village

4941130.short_description: A slowburn boys love / yaoi story between a retired teacher and his former pupil set in Scotland.

4941330.title: Nibble Quest
4941330.short_description: A collectathon 3D platformer starring a hungry capybara on a quest for legendary snacks. Jump in solo or with friends.

4941400.title: Ice Cream Express
4941400.short_description: Drive your ice cream express through the neighborhood, craft delicious frozen treats, and serve fresh handmade ice creams to customers.

4941520.title: Galactic Sentinels
4941520.short_description: Galactic Sentinels is a high-octane bullet-hell shmup packed with old-school arcade soul and modern polish. 4941600.title: Mine the Deep
4941600.short_description: Battle relentless drone swarms, mine valuable resources, and upgrade your ship into a devastating weapon platform.

4941730.title: Walk Home
4941730.short_description: Walk Home is a short psychological horror game that puts you in the shoes of a young teenage girl experiencing deeply unsettling circumstances as she navigates an eerie dirt trail back to her rural home late at night.

4941910.title: Readerpet
4941910.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4941910.short_description: Grimalkin is a small pixel cat who believes you should be reading. Log your books, grow a garden where every plant is a story you finished, and let him keep you company — in the game, or docked at the bottom of your screen while you work. Free, cozy, and quietly judgmental.

4942020.title: Dark Journey to the West
4942020.short_description: A dark-themed idle loot game. Gather and train minions and artifacts with distinct abilities — then pit your builds against legendary bosses. Lead your monster squad through the Heavenly Palace, the Underworld, the sacred mountains, and beyond, all in search of the true scriptures.

4942340.title: Klorbiest Catch
4942340.short_description: Captain a klorb fishing boat on the Klorbing Sea, a modern-day gold rush over the world's most unpredictable waters. Bait & drop catch pots, manage a crew with minds of their own, and out-klorb your rival captains before the quota runs out.

4942350.title: The Political Simulator
4942350.short_description: Create a candidate and run a Presidential campaign across the United States. Improve your approval rating with battleground voters and try to earn enough support to win on election night. The campaign mode allows you to take part in a turn-based strategic campaign where every decision matters.

4942520.title: malang girl
4942520.short_description: Malang Girl is a 2D platformer game featuring extendable arms. Utilize your extendable arms for grabbing, throwing, and more to solve puzzles and defeat enemies.

4942590.title: 山河营造
4942590.short_description: Build an ancient mountain settlement in a deterministic 3D colony survival sim. Choose settlers, plan shelters, farms, workshops, storage and defenses, then survive hunger, winter, illness, trade demands and social strain.

4943170.short_description: Catetris is a captivating puzzle game where players must place falling pieces of various shapes to fill horizontal lines on the board.

4943410.title: Hentai Mature Femboy

4943890.title: SunSet Diffusion
4943890.short_description: With the sun on the verge of burning out, embark on an isometric single-player RPG adventure in a magical realist world. Explore, converse, enhance stats, and make choices. 4944020.title: Idle Heroes Saga
4944020.short_description: Idle Heroes Saga is an idle game where you collect heroines, form a team, and embark on adventures.

4944160.short_description: Turn your project folder into a calm 3D file library. Choose a local folder, watch files and folders become books, organize them onto shelves, edit text files, create groups and subgroups, and save your layout locally.

4944980.title: Araf: The In Between
4944980.short_description: Araf: The In Between is a tactical auto-battler where heroes inspired by history clash between life and death. Build powerful teams with classes and elements, shape your strategy, and fight for a chance to return to the living world in solo battles or online PvP.

4945040.title: SmashCore
4945040.short_description: SmashCore is a short, physics based incremental game about smashing asteroids into dust with your gravity cursor and feeding it to the Core. Discover ancient technology and new ores in deep space and use your cash to buy upgrades in the huge skill tree.

4945070.title: Shenanigans Party
4945070.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

4945210.title: Super Mush Bros
4945210.short_description: SUPER MUSH BROS establishes itself as the most ABSURDLY ATROCIOUSLY AWESOME 2d platformer EVER!!! The game focuses on exploration throughout a plethora of vibrant and dull levels. Gameplay is seasoned with devilishly tricky bosses and moments when players can't figure where in the world they are.

4945490.title: Moan for Me
4945490.short_description: A short adult comedy game where your voice is the only controller. Vocalize into your microphone to match scrolling wave patterns — controlling volume, pitch, and vibrato in real time — to satisfy six demanding characters. Easy to laugh at, hard to master. Microphone required.

4945570.title: Digital Survivor
4945570.short_description: A cyberpunk survivors-like bullet-heaven roguelite set inside a corrupted computer. Dodge endless malware hordes, auto-blast alpha packs and system bosses, loot socketed gear and evolve game-breaking weapon synergies, then raid vaults and extract alive to keep your haul.

4945580.title: Unemployed Nightmare Together
4945580.short_description: Punch out or get punched! Unemployed Nightmare Together is a 1–4 player co-op horror where you're trapped inside a nightmare office by a relentless job application. Restore power, complete your paperwork, and reach the elevator before you're drained. Quitting is not an option.

4945600.title: Let's Farm Together
4945600.short_description: Build your dream farm with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op farming adventure! Raise adorable animals, grow seasonal crops, fish, customize your farmer and loyal dog, and turn your small farm into a thriving countryside paradise.

4945920.title: Vizza
4945920.short_description: Vizza is a calm, interactive visual sandbox of GPU-accelerated simulations. Shape particles, patterns, flow fields, slime molds, cellular automata, and color gradients into strange, beautiful, emergent motion.

4946280.title: Cybersoul 2
4946280.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy
4946280.short_description: Multiplayer Cyberpunk Card Battler & Incremental Hub. 33+ factions, 1,200+ cards. New Roguelite game modes: Raid Boss, Chaos Brawl, Auto Battle & Draft Arena. Includes Dark Web, Souls & Star Power Idle Games. Sell your soul in the Glitch Arcade. Fight online or go dark. Play Solo offline.

4946720.title: 时装工坊
4946720.short_description: This is an immersive creative game that combines fashion design and simulation management. You are a fashion designer and run your own tailor shop. Here, you can design clothes from scratch, then sell them, get more production materials, and then make more beautiful clothes.

4946800.title: The Night Archive - Sable's
4946800.short_description: The Night Archive is an episodic first-person horror series where each episode tells a story pulled from the darkest corners of true crime. These are the stories of those who lived to tell about it.

4946980.title: Defective Detectives 3
4946980.short_description: Twenty years of experience, zero solved cases. Detective Johnson and trainee Billy take on a counterfeit money case. A nonlinear, absurdist detective story with dark humor, a ton of twists and turns, and countless ways to die ingloriously.

4947140.title: Ballakala
4947140.short_description: Ballakala — retro arcade paint shooter. Blast enemies, paint the arena, climb the global leaderboards. 50 levels, 10 bosses. Shoot, splatter, repeat.

4947690.title: Crossroad Chaos
4947690.short_description: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.

4947910.title: Hentai Clicker: Johanna is streaming
4947910.short_description: Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock scenes, outfits, and playful voice reactions with Johanna, the naughty ship captain, in Hentai clicker: Johanna is streaming.

4947930.title: Glow up Hero
4947930.short_description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

4947950.title: SOVA NA SKAKALKE
4947950.short_description: It's all fun and games... until the Jump Rope Owl shows up.

4948330.title: Library Waifu
4948330.short_description: Library Waifu is a cozy puzzle game about charming waifus among books and libraries. Complete 30 levels, unlock beautiful illustrations of girls in a reading-inspired atmosphere, and save all the images to your personal gallery in high quality.

4948370.title: Hentai Puzzle: Sayuri
4948370.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Sayuri: Solve puzzles, progress through Sayuri’s gallery, and unlock playful adult anime images and scenes starring a cheeky coffee shop maid.

4948410.title: My Zombie Apocalypse
4948410.short_description: A fun, no-nonsense top-down action game: tear through an infested low-poly city, rip through short, dynamic missions on foot or behind the wheel, and climb the global Steam leaderboard.

4948420.title: Odyssée Stellaire
4948420.short_description: Board your ship and push the boundaries of space exploration in this contemplative space incremental. Gather resources, develop your technology, and travel from the Moon to the edge of the solar system to answer a mysterious signal from the stars.

4950450.title: Loop of Agony
4950450.short_description: A brutal, fast 2D parkour experience where only the most skilled survive. Race against time and the most punishing obstacles ever designed. Climb the leaderboard, leave your friends behind, and dominate this loop of agony.

4950470.title: Tidy Up Together
4950470.short_description: Catastrophe! An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. Maybe you'll ask some friends for help to tidy up?

4950560.title: Enhanced Affair
4950560.short_description: A ruined champion coaches an openly enhanced sports circuit in the Mojave desert. As the inaugural Ascendant Games approach, romance three dangerous women: a hostile rival, a clean outsider, and the executive who owns his story. Adult visual novel with explicit content.

4950920.title: Sweeplings
4950920.short_description: A cute logic puzzle about scanning the board to find Starlings and avoid Boomlings. English UI · No spoken dialogue. If you love logic puzzles like Minesweeper but want something warmer and more visual — with clues on the board instead of numbers — Sweeplings is for you.

4951010.title: How to Summon a Dommy Mommy Sleep Paralysis Demon
4951010.short_description: Your plan was simple. Chant the words, take the pills, lie back, and let a demoness of your dreams (literally) show up to drain you dry. Reality had other plans.

4951050.title: Durak
4951050.short_description: Play classic Russian Durak with clean cards and quick offline rounds.

4951190.title: Konbini Cleanup
4951190.short_description: Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,948 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilites, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

4951300.title: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Silver Heart
4951300.short_description: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Silver Heart is a CEO romance kinetic visual novel with 3 routes. Every love interest is a CEO.

4951330.title: Nordic
4951330.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

4951350.title: 捉鸡
4951350.short_description: Catch Chick is a fun 3D platforming adventure where players jump across floating sky platforms, chase escaped chickens, and climb toward the crown at the top. Play solo or with friends online, overcome obstacles, collect chickens, and enjoy hilarious moments on every climb.

4951360.title: Ashrun Survivors
4951360.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4951360.short_description: Fight endless hordes in Ashrun Survivors, a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite. Build powerful weapon evolutions, unlock lasting upgrades, and push deeper into dangerous runs where every choice shapes your survival.

4917720.short_description: The classic 2048, reborn in three dimensions. Slide, stack and merge glowing number-cubes across boards from 3D up to 6D. Adjust dimensions and size, pick your theme and soundtrack, then export any run as an MP4 baked with background and music. Cloud saves, achievements and Workshop included.

4918080.title: Campaign Forge
4918080.genre: Adventure, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4918080.short_description: Your story never ends—and it's yours to steer. Build a world, a hero, and a party woven into it by name, then let an AI co-author spin an endless, curated campaign chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers. Generate it free, fully offline, or bring your own AI.

4918200.title: Chuckle Express
4918200.short_description: Drive a train which jumps and drifts across endless tracks to have the last laughter from the trail of blood behind you. Simple mechanics for a cross-platform arcade game using a lot of dark humor to draw a stylistic visualization of everyday capitalism.

4918320.title: Pixel Harvest
4918320.short_description: Pixel harvest is a cozy idle game where you grow your very own farm unlocking new seeds and plants as you farm. Get upgrades to improve your farm with the money from selling your plants! Unlock new plants through breeding neighboring plants to get a chance to mutate into a entirely new plant type.

4918370.title: Alia Domus
4918370.short_description: Explore and colonize an unknown planet in this pixel art survival RPG. Collect resources, complete quests, and craft technologies from different eras of humanity to turn Alia Domus into a home. Start with basic survival and reach civilizational splendor.

4918480.title: Holy Scrap!
4918480.short_description: Blast your friends into spare parts in Holy Scrap! Battle in a wide range of arenas, from the moon to the inside of a volcano. Upgrade your robot after a loss. Shrink yourself, double jump to safety, or turn your bullets into freezing, bouncing rockets! Combine upgrades to find your favorite combo!

4918530.title: Unwanted Guest VR
4918530.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person escape horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

4918700.title: GrunglePunch
4918700.short_description: Disgusting abominations fighting in deadly, free-for-all combat; searching endlessly for freedom.

4918760.title: Pippa of Caerbannog
4918760.short_description: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!

4919060.title: Escape from Track 7
4919060.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

4919310.title: MEKAKUSHI-SAN
4919310.short_description: MEKAKUSHI-SAN is a first-person 3D horror adventure set in an invisible Japanese neighborhood. Your gaze reveals hidden terrain and paths, while looking, not looking, and closing your eyes become visual mechanics for exploring the otherworldly town and escaping MEKAKUSHI-SAN’s pursuit.

4919330.title: Cloud Arch Simulator
4919330.short_description: A reverse tower-defense puzzle for engineers. Architect cloud systems that survive brutal traffic surges — place CDNs, caches, load balancers and databases, hit deploy, and watch your design hold or collapse under a live storm. Real patterns, real tradeoffs, a live YAML mirror.

4920100.title: The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain
4920100.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4920100.short_description: The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain is an immersive live-action game mixing supernatural horror and puzzles. You play a passenger trapped on a creepy train and must survive. Focused on a blood-stained Passenger Survival Rules, you have to follow the rules, uncover their hidden secrets and escape.

4920140.title: Heavenly Battle
4920140.short_description: "Heavenly Battle" is a Roguelite survivor-style horde survival game inspired by Chinese mythology and Journey to the West. Fight your way through the demon horde before the Pill Spirits consume the Southern Heavenly Gate — or the Three Realms will never know peace again...

4920190.title: webcam strained
4920190.short_description: Catch and dodge game. A movable basket, restricted to left-and-right movement along the bottom edge of the screen. Catch cash to increase your score. Unlock new levels and upgrades. Adjust the number of falling objects, movement speed, and other features.

4920220.title: Coinada
4920220.short_description: Match colorful pieces, collect physics-based coins, and convert them into dollars before time runs out in this fast-paced 3D arcade puzzle game.

4920360.title: Police vs Thief : 2P
4920360.short_description: Catch the thieves within a limited time, and elude the police in an even tighter window. Enjoy the fun of playing tag in a cops-and-robbers theme, available in both single-player and two-player game modes.

4921030.title: Splimbo City
4921030.short_description: By day, you're just another data entry drone at Splimbocorp. By night, you fight in underground clubs. But someone at the top is pulling both strings.

4921690.title: Where Ichor Flows Below
4921690.short_description: After three carriage rides, you have finally made it to the quiet town of Palena to start your new life. Things seem to be going well with your new arcane workshop here, but it seems your past hasn't entirely escaped you.

4921890.title: LUMEN BLACK
4921890.short_description: Light is your only weapon. Reveal the path, survive the dark.

4922730.title: Send Them to Hell
4922730.short_description: Demons want Earth. Bad idea. Smash them back to Hell in a chaotic pixel-meets-3D roguelike of absurd, game-breaking builds. With heroes like a holy Knight, a Corn-Launching Robot, or a Wizard Girlie and her ferocious cat. Play solo or 4-player online co-op. Commence the slaughter. Send Them To Hell.

4922760.title: Run While You Still Can
4922760.short_description: Fast Paced Combat Runner, Breaking free from your cell in an enclosed island where the government is out to get you with it's high tech drones and turrets.

4922820.title: Hellkick
4922820.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is a lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No health bars, no combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

4922910.title: Settlers of Pineshore
4922910.short_description: On the edge of a new continent, you are responsible for connecting the wild region of Pineshore and its settlers to the rest of the world. Hire workers, gather resources, defend your venture from unknown dangers, and keep building the railway!

4923900.title: Desktop Pet: Idle Cats Cozy Chaotic Companions for your screen
4923900.short_description: Adopt cozy cats for your desktop. Watch them nap, wander, climb, chase toys, earn Hearts, and cause tiny chaos while you work or relax.

4924040.title: Professor & Reporter Bow to Me
4924040.short_description: In New York in 2025, hacker Finn was shot dead by mercenaries but was reborn as a digital ghost due to a mysterious force. He demonstrated his abilities in class and caught the professor's attention. Then he met an investigative journalist, and an adventure against FX began.

4924280.title: Chain Reaction: Breakshot
4924280.short_description: Chain Reaction: Breakshot combines the precise aiming of classic billiards with the strategic deckbuilding of roguelikes. Within a retro CRT visual style, combining various mechanics turns every shot into a feast of strategy and fun.

4924330.title: Station 21
4924330.short_description: What traps us is not time, but our faith in it.

4924370.title: Media Basket Manager
4924370.short_description: Take control of every aspect of your club: transfers, tactics, finances, youth academy, facilities, and sponsors. Experience full seasons with real-time simulated matches, make key decisions, and lead your team to victory in the league and other competitions. Single-player game.

4924510.title: Lust Share House
4924510.short_description: A thrilling cohabitation in a boarding house! Live with 3 beauties: a lonely landlady, a prickly gyaru, and a hikikomori. Explore, peep, and raise affection. Walk a fine line to avoid jail, unlock intimate events, and master the house!

4924590.title: Mumbai Chef - Junk Food Simulator
4924590.short_description: Mumbai Junk Food Simulator is a stylish cooking simulator about an Indian street food vendor. Cook viral street food, slice zucchini with flair, smash ice with a rock, and fry eggs in absurd ways. No rush – just satisfying cooking, quirky mini-games, and colorful customers.

4924760.title: I Became a Cat
4924760.short_description: You woke up as a cat, can you find a way to be human again?

4924810.title: GALAXY BEAT
4924810.short_description: GALAXY BEAT is a rhythm game where you hit incoming blocks in time with the music. Featuring over 70 original songs, a wide range of difficulty levels for beginners and experts alike, and a powerful Custom Editor that lets you create charts for your favorite music. Start your rhythm adventure today!

4924820.title: Space Civilization Clicker
4924820.short_description: An idle clicker where you grow one small planet into a galactic empire. Click Earth, colonize living worlds across star systems, build Dyson Spheres, catch comets and reset reality with the Big Bang. Your civilization keeps producing even while the game is closed.

4924930.title: IsleFolk: Build. Trade. Survive.
4924930.short_description: Build and grow your own island colony, gather resources, craft structures, and trade with visiting merchants. Guide your workers, expand your shores, and uncover the secrets of the sea.

4924940.title: Dealer's Hand
4924940.short_description: A gothic blackjack rogue-lite. Manipulate your odds with powerups, special cards and effects to win the souls of the damned and choose to either slay or set them free.

4925040.title: Gear Clash: Hero Unite
4925040.short_description: Assemble your hero squad for fast-paced tactical showdowns—victory is forged one gear at a time. Slot gears into your panel to trigger powerful effects each rotation: summon heroes or launch deadly weapons. Build your engine and craft game-breaking synergies. Watch your gears tear through monsters.

4925050.title: Microwave
4925050.short_description: Microwave food in a dreamy, liminal space by yourself or with friends.

4925070.title: False Normality
4925070.short_description: False Normality is a first-person psychological horror game where a rule-driven system watches your movement, punishes disobedience, and slowly takes control away from you.

4925090.title: Avoid Mushrooms
4925090.short_description: Pick mushrooms, die from mushrooms, repeat.

4925260.title: Milfylicious: The Heat Rises
4925260.short_description: Continue your journey as the Young Master of MILF Mansion in stunning 4K. Protect your great-uncle’s revolutionary energy legacy, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate tempting relationships where every choice shapes the mansion’s future—and your desires.

4925290.title: Mansion of Oblivion
4925290.short_description: Camera, action, a new birth. Nothing before, nothing after, only oblivion. A dirty basement, chains. No name, no past, just a Victorian mansion playing with your mind. But you're not afraid; no, you love to play too. Let the show begin!

4925300.title: Unnamed Pogo Game
4925300.short_description: Trapped in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb alone or with friends in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

4925330.title: Chronime Puzzle: Cats
4925330.short_description: Chronime Puzzle: Cats is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

4925430.title: Invasion of the Number Vegetables
4925430.short_description: Explore strange worlds, solve puzzles, and defend Earth from vegetable invaders — all while sharpening your multiplication skills. A single-player adventure from classroom to the stars.

4925470.title: Wildegrove
4925470.short_description: Wildegrove is a fast-paced magical roguelike isometric bullet hell where you wield powerful spells as a gnome chosen by the gods. Battle the relentless waves of enemies, collect runes that compliment your playstyle, and upgrade your favorite spells to unleash devastating blows to save Wildegrove!

4925480.title: MindTesting: The but smart Experience
4925480.short_description: MindTesting is a series of minigames focused on cognitive abilities such as reaction, memory and timing

4925500.title: Companions' Chronicles
4925500.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4925500.short_description: This AI sandbox RPG features diverse world themes for instant immersive adventures. Customize world rules, character sheets and stories; share or import player-created themes. The full version adds dynamic backgrounds, emotion avatars and personal AI chat API support.

4925600.title: Kitten Wool Cup
4925600.short_description: Play solo or with friends in chaotic kitten soccer matches where the ball is a giant ball of yarn. Slide, tackle, pounce, and score your way through the Kitten Wool Cup, earn wool after every victory, and decorate your cozy cat house with furniture as you chase championship glory.

4925610.title: Blast Horizon
4925610.short_description: The Screen Belongs to your Enemy - Take it Back!In this classic Shmup, you will fight through impossible odds against hostiles flooding the battlefield from every direction. Every second is a test of positioning and precision while turning the battlefield into a storm of explosions.

4925700.title: Blooming Parasite
4925700.short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game set in a research facility hiding a classified underground complex overrun by an evolving parasitic organism. Explore abandoned laboratories, uncover buried secrets, and fight to survive a nightmare that's spreading from the inside out.

4925710.title: DR. VIOLET'S NIGHT OFF
4925710.short_description: Midnight Consult: Dr. Violet's Night Off is an interactive desktop simulation game. Invite the elegant Dr. Violet to your screen to keep you company. Interact using your mouse, watch her gaze track your cursor, customize her outfits, and enjoy a relaxing atmosphere right on your desktop.

4925720.title: DON'T TURN AROUND
4925720.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror game. An intelligent monster stalks you from the dark, listening to your every breath. Outsmart the creature, hide in the shadows, and find a way out. Whatever you do, don't turn around

4925760.title: Hentai Puzzle: Emy
4925760.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Emy: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Emy, a naughty creature hunter. Progress through challenges, unlock images and scenes, and enjoy a playful adult puzzle experience.

4925890.title: Mischief House
4925890.short_description: Do chores. Wreck the house. Blame your friends. A chaotic online physics party game for 2-8 players.

4925930.title: Legend of the Godslayer
4925930.short_description: The world has fallen into an age of darkness. Creatures of the abyss emerge across the land, sent by the Gods to bring about humanity's destruction. But amidst the chaos of the battlefield, a legend rises—the Godslayer.

4925980.title: The Frog And The Tower
4925980.short_description: A punishing roguelite dungeon crawler about a lone frog knight trying to climb a tower that's slowly corrupting the world around it. Fight through rooms of twisted creatures, discover powerful treasures to aid you, and uncover the secrets of the tower before it finishes what it started.

4925990.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
4925990.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

4926020.title: Last Angel
4926020.short_description: Master deeply technical 11-attack weapon combos in this fast-paced 2D action-roguelite. As the last angel in a demonic world, you must kill the invading demons and fight until death to survive an endless holy war.

4926050.title: Hush
4926050.short_description: Be quiet. Stay calm. Don't look at it. A 1–8 player co-op horror descent: search dark procedural levels, contain what you find, and extract — while a creature hunts whoever panics most. One shared panic meter, live proximity voice, and an infinite descent scored by how deep you get.

4926090.title: SHORAPAN: Beneath the Crimson Sky
4926090.short_description: SHORAPAN — a dark parable of a strange city beneath an eternal crimson sky. Those who doubt it aloud are the first it takes.

4926530.title: Rekindled
4926530.short_description: Rekindled is a spell combination game the featuring 2D characters in a 3D world, your task is to use your combinations to fight off magical creatures and open your path to the volcanic peak and awaken the long-slumbering Phoenix, so its everlasting flame may Rekindle the world again.

4926770.title: Guardian of soul tower
4926770.short_description: Fight in real-time, build powerful elemental decks, and climb the Soul Tower in this dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Every death leaves behind a Nemesis Phantom created from your own deck, waiting to challenge you in future runs.

4926800.title: Dreams of Suffering
4926800.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror game where you explore a haunting dream world, investigate mysterious environments, solve surreal puzzles, and face unknown entities. Experience a deeply atmospheric journey where sound, fear, and instinct guide you through the darkness.

4926820.title: Amara
4926820.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

4926930.title: Room69
4926930.short_description: Room 69 is a first-person psychological survival horror. Escape a cursed labyrinth, manage your 'Desire' meter, and hide from sex-crazed demonic entities. Survive brutal boss encounters or face explicit, high-quality NSFW punishments. Can you resist your deepest urges and survive?

4927190.title: Orion-7
4927190.short_description: A sci-fi adventure with classic Memory mechanics. Explore a mysterious planet, battle enemies, train your memory, play through the story campaign, and compete with other players in online PvP.

4927240.title: Ruptured Floor
4927240.short_description: Dive into a surreal and dark office space made of infinite floors. Traverse them all, one at the time, to find an exit. Ruptured Floor is a horror puzzle game with a unique twist. Every floor requires a combination to open the door. The code is known. The lock, however, will need to be found.

4927340.title: La gran aventura de David Santiso
4927340.short_description: Point-and-click adventure in the classic Sierra/LucasArts style, packed with Spanish humor and satire of the paranormal subculture. Verbal duels against believers, two full arcade minigames hidden inside. Spanish audio and text only.

4927490.title: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
4927490.short_description: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings.
