Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

4927690.title: Boomsday
4927690.short_description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys have gone rogue and want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op & couch.

4927770.title: The Joust Autochess
4927770.short_description: The Joust Autochess allows you to see your favorite zany physics brawlers in an environment like you've never seen them before... tactical autochess combat! Combine like cards to upgrade your forces! Strategize with items to find the perfect build!

4927930.title: 樂園餘燼
4927930.short_description: A game that combines dungeon exploration with turn-based strategy combat. Explore randomly generated dungeons, challenge yourself in strategically deep battles, and uncover the hidden truths of an ancient civilization!

4928170.title: Celestial 9
4928170.short_description: CELESTIAL 9 is a roguelike fusing Teochew lore & 'Mu Shi' poker. Forge pacts with deities! In a deadly gamble challenging the Sunken Sovereigns, use strategy to unleash epic combos and keep your family's last incense burning!

4928600.title: Black Lake
4928600.short_description: Black Lake is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned orphanage beside an endless black ocean. Search for your missing sister, survive what the children became, and uncover the ritual beneath the lake.

4930750.title: Just Five More Minutes
4930750.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4930750.short_description: A pixel-art horde survivor. Pick a hero, wade into the swarm, and let your weapons fire while you move, level up, and shape a build — stacking upgrades, chasing synergies, and evolving your gear across stages full of enemies.

4931010.title: AIKO
4931010.short_description: A horror adventure where you explore a mysterious house, solve puzzles, evade terrifying entities, and uncover the hidden truth behind a family's forgotten memories.

4931110.title: Cubara: A Table by the Sea
4931110.short_description: Turn your tiny deserted island into a bustling diner in this cozy farming & cooking sim. Hungry travelers sail by and stop at your tables for lunch. Grow crops, fish, grill, and plate every order, hire staff, expand the island, and earn a Michelin star. Play solo or online co-op.

4931190.title: Retro Pack Club
4931190.short_description: Rip open retro card packs and flip every card one at a time. Sell it for cash, or keep it for glory? Binder space is tight, so you can't keep them all. Hunt foils, misprints, glitches, and serial #1 across endless themed sets in this cozy, addictive collecting sim.

4931260.title: The Ocean Between Us
4931260.short_description: The Ocean Between Us is an atmospheric Japanese-style visual novel about distance, memories, and emotions that linger between two people. Experience a calm romantic drama with a gentle pace, emotional dialogue, and a melancholic atmosphere.

4931280.title: Chinese Basketball Manager
4931280.short_description: Manage your team, train your players, build your dynasty, and watch young prospects with a passion for singing, dancing, rapping, and basketball live up to their talent!

4931430.title: Logic Foundry
4931430.short_description: Logic Foundry is a circuit-building puzzle game where every solved design becomes a reusable chip. Start with simple traces and build toward a tiny 4-bit CPU. This is an alpha playtest. The campaign is playable, the game and levels levels are still in progress.

4931680.title: reWinWar
4931680.short_description: A fast-paced, minimalist turn-based strategy game. Wargame.

4931700.title: Alien Siege: Earth
4931700.short_description: Top-down arcade space shooter with retro pixel-art style. Fight waves of alien invaders across world landmarks, buy upgrades between battles, collect power ups, participate in events & missions, defeat epic bosses, and more.

4931720.title: Camera 5
4931720.short_description: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

4931880.title: Cubed
4931880.short_description: Cubed is both a puzzle and an arcade game for VR and non-VR.  Relax and get your mind off everyday life in puzzle mode.  Challenge yourself in arcade mode.  Or grab a friend and play arcade mode either as a team or as bitter rivals, stealing and sabotaging your way to victory!

4932130.title: Backrooms With Friends!
4932130.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op horror game where you and your friends noclip into an endless maze also known as the Backrooms. Explore procedurally generated levels and avoid the Entities that stalk the halls. Get separated and you might not make it back. Get caught and you won't make it out at all...
publishers: Boiling Poo in a Kettle Publishing

4932180.title: 鉄道運行管理シミュレーターPro - Railway Dispatcher Pro -
4932180.short_description: Command an entire rail line as a Centralized Traffic Control (CTC) dispatcher. Set routes, keep trains on time, and rebuild the timetable in real time when delays strike — the operations-management evolution of Railway Dispatcher.

4932300.title: Lust Tap
4932300.short_description: Lust Tap — cinematic 3D adult clicker. Fill the bar, keep the rhythm, and unlock every scene. Easy to start. Hard to put down.

4932400.title: Meet Sudoku
4932400.short_description: A professional Sudoku game featuring Classic, Killer, and 11 popular variants, including Thermo, Arrow, Kropki, XV, Jigsaw, Diagonal, Anti-Knight, and more. Learn with 63 solving techniques, enjoy daily challenges, smart notes, hints, statistics, and puzzles for every skill level.

4932420.title: Psi/Clash Rumble!!
4932420.short_description: In a sleepy mountain town, awaken your psychic abilities... and sign up for a tournament? Uncover the mystery of your newfound abilities and engage in meaningful one on one turn-based battles - and learn new psychic skills in the process!

4932510.title: Mùa Hình (Trading-cards Season)
4932510.short_description: Every kid's game has its own season: season of Marbles, season of Rubber bands, season of Statues… and the season of Trading-cards. We bring you those nostalgic games in a fresh “digital” way. Practice, compete online, climb the rankings and elo ladder to earn prestigious titles and unique items!

4932620.title: Idle Demon Lord
4932620.short_description: 【Idle Demon Lord】 is a dark idle loot game. Leave it running to farm endless drops — 6 rarities, gems, runes, relics, legendary affixes and sets. Craft hundreds of builds via skill trees. Online, offline and ascension loops. Codex, trials, pets, dailies. Pure number-go-up bliss

4932720.title: Celestial Clash
4932720.short_description: Celestial Clash is a free online strategy card game based on Journey to the West. Build your deck, manage resources, summon cultivators, cast spells, equip artifacts, and upgrade units. Master the five elements, choose your battles, and compete against all.

4933380.title: LOFI Records: A Focus Companion
4933380.short_description: Create your own AI companion in a lo-fi record store. Customize their look, personality, and voice, then focus, rest, chat, track tasks, play music, read tarot, decorate the shop, collect songs, and welcome monster customers as your real-life effort becomes a shared daily life.

4933500.title: Me and You
4933500.short_description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

4933530.title: Gamercury World Engine
4933530.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
4933530.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

4933570.title: Screen Pet Engine
4933570.short_description: Adopt a living desktop pet, or make your own. Import your art, wire simple behaviors on a visual node graph, and watch it walk, idle, etc, and tumble across your real desktop. A cozy little studio for building the companion your screen's been missing.

4933720.title: Okey 101
4933720.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4933720.short_description: Play 101 Okey against real players! From the Tea Garden to legendary tables, the excitement grows with every bet. Find a quick match or create your own table — chat, send gifts, spin the daily wheel, and play your way to the top!

4933810.title: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
4933810.short_description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

4934060.title: Unknown Contact
4934060.short_description: A short underwater horror game where you pilot a one-person submarine into a lightless trench, tracking a signal that has started answering back.

4934190.title: Hito's World
4934190.short_description: Learn, type or use your voice to explore a world made of ideograms. Are you ready to embark on a journey to recover your lost memories? Welcome to Hito's world, a game where you can practice languages while discovering a world full of friends, adventures and more!

4934310.title: GERAND: Operation KV-44 2.0
4934310.short_description: Commander, Gerand here. I repeat: the Armored Train is surrounded! Build and upgrade your squad of living tanks, crush the enemy in tactical battles, and fight your way through the blockade. Your objective: create a legend of the USSR — KV-44 2.0. Copy that? Over!

4934320.title: SlimeHold
4934320.short_description: Recruit powerful Slimes, discover unique Items, and defend your King in this roguelite tower defense game. Build powerful synergies, survive endless enemy waves, and create a new strategy every run.

4934370.title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
4934370.short_description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

4934460.title: Snitch Switch
4934460.short_description: Build and decorate your own 3D hangout room, invite friends to public or private lobbies, and play social party modes where votes, questions, trust and chaos reveal how well you really know each other.

4934480.title: Decrypting Life
4934480.short_description: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s

4934590.title: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
4934590.short_description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

4934610.title: Hidden Cats: Castle
4934610.short_description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of castle! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats are waiting for you! Play and relax!

4934640.title: Hearts Gone Black
4934640.short_description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

4934680.title: Gaslamp Cases 9: The Ghost of Autmaton City
4934680.short_description: Immerse yourself in a tale of intrigue and suspense in Automaton City, where science and superstition clash. Solve match-3 puzzle challenges to uncover clues and unlock new areas. Play the 9th part of the fantastic Match3 serial!

4934690.title: Hear the Void
4934690.short_description: Multiplayer horror × audio hunting × liminal spaces. In a world of endless corridors and infinite pools, everyone is invisible. Run, and your footsteps give you away – hear them, find them, execute them. Here, silence is the only law.

4934840.title: Catch the Witch
4934840.short_description: She steals their relics. They want her body. 🔥 Catch The Witch is a live, no-CGI NSFW chase: sprint and parkour through a bandit village grabbing occult loot while three hunters close in. Get caught — and the fun really starts. You control the camera. You control the show. 😈🧹

4935000.title: Infinite Elevator
4935000.short_description: Ride the elevator down, study the same hallway floor after floor, and decide if something has changed. See something strange, press up. See nothing, go down. Get to the ground floor and escape the nightmare.

4935010.title: Hentai Clicker: Summer is streaming
4935010.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and unlock Summer’s outfits, scenes, upgrades, and playful voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Summer is streaming, a flirty adult anime clicker with sunny progression.

4935060.title: FarmFriendzy
4935060.short_description: FarmFriendzy is a first-person multiplayer co-op farming life simulator built for friends who want to grow together. Complete quests, earn promotions, manage your personal wallet alongside the co-op economy, and keep an eye on your hunger and thirst as day turns to night and crops grow in real time.

4935110.title: IRU
4935110.short_description: IRU is a cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends open-world exploration and auto-battler combat with roguelike progression. Find and tame magical creatures to assemble a unique team and pervail against the dangers of the world!

4935210.title: Homicide Desk
4935210.short_description: Read the evidence. Run the forensics. Question suspects in your own words, they lie, crack, or lawyer up. Accuse the wrong person, and Internal Affairs comes after you.

4935230.title: Red Glare The Reckoning
4935230.short_description: Red Glare: The Reckoning is a fully standalone experience of Real Time Tactics game Red Glare. You do not need the original Red Glare to play. Whether you're a returning agent or a first-time recruit, this is a complete campaign with its own story.

4935270.title: TRAINCORE
4935270.short_description: Command a fusion-powered war train through a cyberpunk world. Build specialized wagons, consume resources, salvage enemy wreckage, upgrade your convoy, and survive until the next station.

4935290.title: Starfallen: Strength
4935290.short_description: Welcome to the Sky Ward, a fortress built with the purpose of discovering the mysteries of magic on the pangea Aelyria. As Lennon and Petra, who serve the Sky Ward. Explore the Sky Ward while unveiling the mysteries of the world, defending it, and falling in love along the way.

4935320.title: MODIFY
4935320.short_description: MODIFY is a top-down puzzle game featuring a variety of abilities to change the attributes of objects to your advantage. Every object has a purpose. Every property can change.

4935330.title: The Backrooms : Threshold
4935330.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

4935420.title: Focus My Deer
4935420.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

4935510.title: Cellar Keeper
4935510.short_description: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

4935770.title: Reality Engine
4935770.short_description: José, a Newell's Old Boys fan, breaks the "reality" and travels to different alternate realities. Will he manage to get back home? Find out in this crazy game!

4935790.title: Yolk & Yonder
4935790.short_description: Help the hen collect her chicks! Move blocks, press buttons, crawl through pipes, and avoid spikes. But remember: the more babies you rescue, the more massive the mother hen becomes, blocking the passages in the next stages.

4935810.title: VHS World '89
4935810.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

4935820.title: Of Beasts And Alchemy
4935820.short_description: A turn-based alchemical roguelike where you roll customizable dice to fight through a hand-drawn 2.5D world that shifts from cute and silly into dark, corrupted chaos.

4937300.title: My Mysterious Creature
4937300.short_description: A curious little creature comes to live on your desktop. It potters about while you work, quietly settles down when you're busy, naps when you're away, and grows closer to you over days. It speaks no words, only feelings. Raise it, dress it up, even give it a voice with your own AI.

4937320.title: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
4937320.short_description: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

4937410.title: UKNON Jones - Fighters
4937410.short_description: A spin-off of the series: "UKNON Jones & Guynelk" and developed by one person. A colorful, dynamic 2.D fighting game playable locally or online with characters possessing unique and varied abilities.

4937640.title: The Offering Hour
4937640.short_description: In an arena watched by gods and demons, you are the Sacrificer. Time is your only currency — and your life: summon monsters, utter dark rites, wear the monster's skin, all paid in the hours you have left. A strategy-action roguelike. One gate — only one side walks free.

4937690.title: Backrooms: Liminal Tether
4937690.short_description: Explore the seemingly endless shifting expanse of the Backrooms in this isometric pixel-style liminal horror game. Discover and research anomalies, and upgrade your tether to delve deeper into the unknown.

4937820.title: Eternal Embrace: Lumina's Sunshine
4937820.short_description: A turn-based deck-building card game for solo play or co-op with up to four players. Craft and upgrade cards and equipment with materials brought back from dungeons, make the most of your favorite class’s role, and take on increasingly difficult dungeons.

4937960.title: Lasthold
4937960.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
4937960.short_description: Fight through relentless zombie hordes, gather resources, grow your farm, unlock powerful weapons, and survive long enough to escape a zombie-infested island.

4938100.title: Somewhere in İstanbul
4938100.short_description: An atmosphere-driven survival and exploration game set in an Istanbul fallen into silence after a massive disaster. Face dangers in ruined streets, manage scarce resources, craft essential gear, and fight to stay alive in maps inspired by real locations of the city.

4938550.title: Goldhaven
4938550.short_description: A roguelike trading-floor survival sim. Buried in student debt, hired by a firm with one rule: hit your number every week or get walked out. Read the tape, go long or short, push your leverage — while the SEC, the IRS and your own desk circle. 3 story threads. 9 endings. Up or out

4938590.title: IN
4938590.short_description: If this message still exists, then we didn’t. Restore the station’s emergency power, explore abandoned laboratories and industrial sectors, solve the failures we left behind, and remember—every generator you restart brings the station closer to life… and something closer to you

4938610.title: Fateward
4938610.short_description: An RPG that plays out in film and bends with every decision and every path you take. A young adventurer leaves his home and walks into legend: a sentient blade at his side, gods watching, an old danger stirring at the frontier of the kingdom. The fate of the world is yours to shape.

4938620.title: MIXBALL: Football Basketball Volleyball Tennis
4938620.short_description: Mixball combines the world's most popular sports into one action packed game. Play Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball, and Tennis in the same arena. Enjoy Single Player, Local Multiplayer, or Online modes as you challenge your friends in fast paced, adrenaline filled matches.

4938960.title: Backrooms: Overstay
4938960.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4938960.short_description: Survival horror in an infinite, procedurally generated Backrooms. Solo or in 1–8 player co-op: scavenge, craft, build a shelter, and hide from monsters that hunt by light and sound. Stay fed, warm, and sane long enough to find the way out.

4938970.title: RTS Outpost
4938970.short_description: Build your base, command your army, and wage real-time PvP war on a living conquest map. Clear a frontier of monsters and alien UFOs, join a faction, team up with friends, and climb the seasonal ranks. A classic base-building RTS with modern military firepower, ad-free on desktop.

4939090.title: Pixel Evolution
4939090.short_description: A twin-stick arena shooter where every run rebuilds the game itself. Collect pixels, survive the constant HP drain, and complete each upgrade checklist to COMPILE the next era — evolving from 1-bit monochrome all the way to 3D, one boss at a time.

4939110.title: Chaos Cinema
4939110.short_description: Chaos Cinema is a first-person management game where you restore and run a chaotic movie theater. Serve snacks, sell tickets, clean messes, manage supplies, choose films, and keep customers happy before movie night turns into total disaster.

4939170.title: Farm Renovator: First Job
4939170.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4939170.short_description: You inherit an old, neglected farm—so what do you do? You don't wait for a miracle. You clean it up, renovate, furnish, and upgrade it! Become a farmer, trader, and builder all at once and turn yourself into a true one-person band. Be the best version of yourself and become a county legend!

4939200.title: Shadows in Sanluca
4939200.short_description: A Supernatural mystery in the beating heart of a Latin American city. Scour the past memories of an abandoned house, build out a web of connections between its inhabitants, and learn of the sinister truth that led to their downfall.

4939240.title: RyuuKotoba/Flowing Words
4939240.short_description: A Japanese arcade game for learners and the curious. Practice hiragana, katakana and 104 Kanji N5 through fast-paced gameplay. Learn at your own pace - it won't teach you grammar, but it will give you achievements and perhaps rights to brag at parties.

4939470.title: Idle Fleet
4939470.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Simulation
4939470.short_description: Command a mining fleet that never clocks out. Train 7 skills, automate them with drones, trade on a player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull — all server-side, so your fleet keeps working while you sleep. Log in to progress you actually earned.

4939540.title: FreeStyle 2 Classic: Street Basketball
4939540.genre: Action, Casual, Massively Multiplayer, Sports, Strategy, Free To Play
4939540.short_description: FreeStyle2 Classic: Street Basketball is a fast-paced 3-on-3 street basketball game. Choose your favorite character, customize your skills and Freestyle moves, and create a playstyle that's uniquely yours. On the court, only skill, teamwork, and strategy determine victory.

4939640.title: Toast & Toaster
4939640.short_description: Control a toaster that fires toast in a hand-drawn Roguelite Shoot'em Up. Choose cards to create powerful builds while your enemies grow stronger with each round.

4939710.title: SYNTAX WARS
4939710.short_description: A cyberpunk duel of pure reads. Both fighters lock in a move in secret, then flip at the same instant — no reflexes, no combos, just mind games. Strong eats Weak, Weak pierces Guard, Guard parries Strong. Loved the bluffing in Inscryption or the spacing in Footsies? Step into the arena.

4939820.title: The Expansion
4939820.short_description: A psychological first-person horror experience set in endless Backrooms. Explore abandoned corridors, uncover hidden secrets, evade mysterious entities, and survive a world where every turn leads deeper into the unknown.

4939930.title: Void TD
4939930.short_description: Build powerful defenses, collect loot, combine effects, and survive evolving waves from the void in a tower defense game driven by ARPG-inspired buildcrafting and persistent progression.

4940040.title: Hollow of Y
4940040.short_description: 《Hollow of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中管理资源消耗、维持技能循环并拓展战斗手段，在不断深入的单人流程中体验以续航与突破为核心的回合制玩法。

4940230.title: Oops, All Tanks!
4940230.short_description: Build a tiny 2×2 RPG warband, draft and upgrade gear, forge powerful weapons — then watch your terrible ideas fight other players’ saved builds and somehow turn four questionable heroes into an unstoppable wall of tanks.

4940250.title: The Millhaven Murders
4940250.short_description: A hand-drawn and story-rich deduction mystery set in 1887. Pearl Lundgren is dead and two men have been arrested for her murder, but the full truth remains to be discovered, and only you can piece it together.

4940260.title: GrooveDeck
4940260.genre: Indie, Simulation, Free To Play, Early Access
4940260.short_description: GrooveDeck is inspired by hardware grooveboxes and excellent with controllers. Sequence beats, program melodies, and shape your sound live. Pick it up, press play, and make your next banger.

4940280.title: Chronicles of the Fallen Realm
4940280.short_description: Nine Hero classes. Five Acts of darkness. One Shadow Lord. Chronicles of the Fallen Realm is a dark fantasy turn-based RPG roguelite where defeat fuels your rise. Upgrade your Heroes, master unique skills, and push deeper into the Fallen Realm each run.

4940290.title: Desert Waifu
4940290.short_description: A relaxing tile-swap puzzle game set in a sun-scorched desert. Rearrange the scrambled tiles to rebuild each hand-crafted artwork, then watch it come to life as a fully animated reward scene. 10 levels, no timers, no fail states.

4940480.title: TV Network Simulator
4940480.short_description: Build your own TV network, license shows, schedule prime-time slots, hire writers, sign sponsors, and fight for ratings week by week.

4940570.title: 1 HP DUNGEON
4940570.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy
4940570.short_description: 1 HP. So does everything else. A cornered Dragon King sealed his own vault under one law: a single breath of life for all who enter. Descend a seeded, endless dungeon, reclaim your stolen spells, and hunt the coward through the dark. Every threat is dodgeable, but one clean touch ends the run.

4940640.title: The Haun-T-ed House
4940640.short_description: Play as a ghost trapped inside a strange haunted manor in this short puzzle-platformer adventure. Avoid lights, transform into paintings to stay hidden, and find your way through three increasingly challenging levels to escape The Haun-T-ed House.

4940660.title: PAPER.VOID
4940660.short_description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

4940800.title: Global Plates
4940800.short_description: Build delicious food factories! Place machines, lay conveyor belts, and cook the world's favorite dishes — pizza, sushi, paella, and masala. But keep it fresh: the longer ingredients travel, the sadder the food. A cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

4940830.title: Forest TD
4940830.short_description: Forest TD is a top-down strategy game blending tower defense, survival, and elemental magic. Explore a vast forest, transform trees into defensive towers, and combine elemental abilities to fend off relentless waves of enemies.

4940930.title: SKOS: 13.86
4940930.short_description: You are stalkers thrown by an anomaly into the 14th-century Middle Ages. Survive solo or in co-op among knights, and make dangerous raids into modern-day Pripyat for Soviet weapons and loot. Change the course of history or perish in the ruins of the past and future.

4940990.title: Suas Escolhas - O Caso do Magnata Desaparecido
4940990.short_description: A noir detective gamebook where careless reading gets you killed. A tycoon has vanished: 4 suspects, 780 choices, 11 endings — 85% of all runs end in death or prison. Every clue you uncover stays in your case file forever. Originally written in Brazilian Portuguese. The case is yours.

4941350.title: Welcome to Deathtrap!
4941350.short_description: You have been thrown into the Deathtrap, do you have what it takes to survive? Fight, loot, equip powerful artifacts, and discover forgotten paths to progress in this old-school dungeon crawler with Metroidvania-style exploration.

4941550.title: SDETA - SUPER DEATH ENDER THE AVENGER
4941550.short_description: A fast, addictive side‑scrolling arcade shooter inspired by Defender, with modern effects, tight controls, and intense score‑chasing action.

4942000.title: Blend In
4942000.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Blend into a crowd of identical NPCs by moving like them, while an armed Detective with limited bullets hunts the humans. Social hide-and-seek for 2-8 players: mimic, bluff, talk... and don't give yourself away.

4942110.title: Tilebound:Mahjong Survivors
4942110.short_description: Move. Auto-attack. Build your hand. Survive. Tilebound fuses Vampire Survivors-style auto-battler chaos with authentic mahjong tile-matching strategy. Collect numbered and honor tiles from fallen enemies, assemble winning hands (Pung, Kong, Flush, and more), and unlock devastating upgrades.

4942230.title: Huiyu Undercover
4942230.short_description: A "Who is the Undercover" party game. Multiplayer online. Three roles — Civilian, Undercover, and Mr. White. connect directly with friends and Outwit your friends in a battle between lies and truth. Support Room Password, Many Words.

4942270.title: Everfall: Rewind
4942270.short_description: Everfall: Rewind is a single-player 3D action RPG set in a fantasy world. Explore the field, take on quests, battle enemies in third-person action combat, and grow stronger as you uncover what lies ahead.

4942450.title: Feather Trace
4942450.short_description: Inside vast biodomes, embark on a one-of-a-kind birdwatching journey built around deck-building, Birdpedia collection, and long-term progression. Explore diverse habitats, meet birds of every kind, and study them through card-based play to fill out your Birdpedia.

4942660.title: The Proxy
4942660.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign the documents on your desk, trade on secrets only you know, and weigh every favor from allies who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

4942750.title: Bramblewick: Guild Management Simulator
4942750.short_description: You are the Guild Master. You don't swing the sword — you decide who does. Hire adventurers, send them down dangerous roads, and make the calls they'll never forget. In Bramblewick, every hero remembers each quest, wound, and order you gave. Build your guild. Live with the choices.

4942770.title: 崇祯直聘：明末官场沉浮模拟器
4942770.genre: Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4942770.short_description: 《崇祯直聘：明末官场沉浮模拟器》是一款以明末崇祯朝为背景的历史叙事策略游戏，融合城池经营与官场抉择。你将扮演出身各异的一名末世小官——寒门文官、缙绅子弟、武官后人或宫中宦官，在天灾、兵祸与党争交织的十七年里治理城池或管理兵务政务，周旋于上司、同僚与士绅百姓之间，并走向属于你自己的结局。游戏没有善恶评分，每一次选择——秉公或贪墨、强硬或妥协——都通向真实且不可逆的后果。你不是在扮演好人或坏人，只是在回答：如果活在那个时代，你会成为怎样的人。

4943060.title: ROE: Robotic Outworld Explorer
4943060.short_description: Explore a hostile planet, searching for map data and upgrades. Your robot starts from scratch each mission, having to navigate around obstacles and dangerous lifeforms until you can return with powerful equipment to access new routes.

4943790.title: Max Cross
4943790.short_description: Blast, jump and survive in a frantic hand-drawn run-and-gun platformer where every run is different. Stack crazy power-up combinations, battle through three increasingly brutal worlds, and chase the highest score.

4944000.title: Just in Case
4944000.short_description: A 2–4 player co-op horror game about doing a very bad job with your friends. Drop into somewhere you shouldn't be, haul out anything incriminating, and clock out before the quota (or the dark) catches up with you.

4944270.title: Zombie Parking Lot Defense
4944270.short_description: Night has fallen on the parking lot. Your car is the last stand. Fortify it with turrets built from scavenged auto parts and hold back the endless zombie horde. A fast, replayable tower defense with roguelite upgrades, deadly bosses, and one rule: survive one more wave.

4944280.title: Skimmies
4944280.short_description: Skimmies is an arcade action adventure about skimming stones through dangerous rivers, dodging obstacles, battling enemies, and chasing the perfect run.

4944300.title: Project: Space Farm
4944300.short_description: A cosy farming rogue-like in space! Plant crops with unique abilities and harvest them for points to stay ahead of a rising quota. Add new crops and actions to your deck to optimise your turn. Discover synergies and combine powerful effects to watch those numbers reach the stars!

4944570.title: Cats MiaoMiaoMiao~
4944570.short_description: This is a healing, cat-themed match-3 puzzle game. Collect various adorable cats by clearing levels — every little cat you've encountered will come to your private courtyard to freely stroll, nap, and show off their cuteness. Build your very own warm and cozy cat backyard!

4944600.title: Dumbfire
4944600.short_description: Launch a missile and thread it through tight obstacles as fast as you can to take out the target. A physics time-attack flight game — chase faster runs for more points— with a built-in level editor and Steam Workshop courses. For fans of Superflight and Clustertruck.

4944710.title: Untold Memories: Obsession
4944710.short_description: Play as police officer Nathan Mercer in a story-driven psychological horror game. Explore a quiet home, uncover disturbing clues, piece together the events of the night, and unravel the mystery before the past closes in.

4944800.title: OBITT Escape from the room
4944800.short_description: You stray from a shrine into a room and become a palm-sized person. This is an escape action game to find your way out through trial and error from a miniature perspective. Manage your HP to survive and break free from this giant room! A time attack mode is included for an extra challenge.

4944930.title: Frame Fatale: A Minesweeper Gallery
4944930.short_description: A picross/minesweeper hybrid where every correct tile reveals a little more of a hidden painting. 17 explicit scenes in total, fully animated, packed with nudity, sex, and dripping slime. No time limit, no fail state, just you, the grid, and 18+ content.

4945010.title: Occult: Scarlet Elegy
4945010.short_description: Delve into an occult society of exorcists and spirit mediums through the eyes of Lily: a shy healer possessed by the spirit known as Lament. Explore atmospheric 3D environments, build relationships with your team, and fight stylish turn-based battles in this love letter to "Those who are alone."

4945310.title: Solaris
4945310.short_description: Solaris is an immersive first-person action game set in an alternate, post-apocalyptic Soviet satellite Poland. You are Irka: a skilled rooftop runner and courier. Sneak, run and climb the roofs of the destroyed city to find a cure for your grandma infected by a mysterious disease called Solaris.

4945520.title: Traffic Authority
4945520.short_description: "Control dynamic city traffic! Deploy cards to manage lights and signs, keeping the streets moving. Combo cards with buildings for massive boosts. Solve accidents before chaos hits to crush the high score!

4945790.title: Echoes in Darkness
4945790.short_description: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.

4945810.title: Odysseus' 13th Ship
4945810.short_description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

4945850.title: Galumb
4945850.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Racing, Sports
4945850.short_description: Punch, kick, push and race your way to the top in this chaotic multiplayer party game. Outsmart obstacles, team up when it helps, or betray your rivals. In Galumb, there are no rules.

4945980.title: Grimoire of Blanks
4945980.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences aren’t. Fill the blanks with words, twist sentences into devastating combos, and survive alone or with friends in this 1–4 player roguelite deckbuilder.

4946070.title: Sudoku Girls: Hawaii Vacation
4946070.short_description: Arrive in Hawaii and begin an adventure filled with new friendships, colorful characters, and classic Sudoku. Experience illustrated visual novel scenes, solve puzzles, and enjoy Hawaii with the girls.

4946340.title: How Much For It?
4946340.short_description: Manage a mysterious second-hand shop where every deal carries a risk. Inspect unusual items, uncover hidden clues with tools such as UV light and scales, negotiate with unpredictable customers, upgrade your shop, and face supernatural events shaped by the cursed objects you choose to buy.

4946440.title: Granule
4946440.short_description: A ditherpunk physics sandbox where anything goes with Murray, and there's always something within reach to make it worse.

4946460.title: Journeybound Idle
4946460.short_description: Another world needed a hero. It got you instead! A long fantasy-idle RPG: climb the adventurer's guild from F-Rank to S-Rank, max your skills, clear 114 quests, discover 1,300+ items, hire companions, farm, craft, fight, tons of QoL, a desktop widget, and lots more! Releasing August 7th!

4946490.title: Clickstellar
4946490.short_description: Ignite a dying star and forge a galactic empire from a single tap. A cozy sci-fi idle clicker: harvest Energy, automate cosmic megastructures that earn while you sleep, then Ascend, collapse it all into Dark Matter and be reborn as a brand-new star.

4946500.title: Matter MazeBall: Element Trials
4946500.short_description: Roll a ball through cel-shaded physics mazes where what your ball is made of changes everything. Stone sinks and smashes, ice glides and melts, a balloon floats until a storm pops it. 30 elemental balls, 39 hand-built mazes, living weather, and local 2-player. Material is the mechanic.

4946580.title: Retro Flight Simulator 2026
4946580.short_description: Take off from airports around the world and explore a retro-styled open world from the cockpit of a passenger jet. Plan routes, use autopilot, fly through changing environments, and land at global destinations in a lightweight single-player flight simulation.

4946710.title: Tailwind: A Sleep Sailing Game
4946710.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4946710.short_description: You are not the captain — you are the wind. Lay gusts and lulls to carry a little sloop and her Skipper across a moonlit archipelago. A slow, pretty sailing roguelike to unwind to — even fall asleep to, with soundscapes, a wake-up alarm, and a boat that sails itself.

4946830.title: No Way Back
4946830.short_description: No Way Back is a short atmospheric first-person horror game. Investigate the mysterious disappearance of your father in a lonely house deep in the wilderness, on the shore of a remote lake.

4946930.title: Fast Charging Tycoon
4946930.short_description: Build and run an electric vehicle charging company. Choose your locations, win over drivers, outsmart your rivals, and rise to lead the industry. Achieve greatness by claiming one of four victories once the market has matured. Do you have what it takes to build a fast charging tycoon?

4947120.title: Scrumbag
4947120.short_description: You are the cursor — the last honest user in a machine built to farm your Attention. Auto-fire your way through swarms of cookie banners, tracking pop-ups, and EULAs in a fast, funny survivors-like roguelite. Draft absurd upgrades, cash in your Attention, and survive the Performance Review.

4947210.title: Demolitors
4947210.short_description: Command powerful Demolitors, battle enemy machines with unique Insignias, upgrade each machine through its skill tree, unlock even stronger Insignias, and defeat formidable bosses.

4947380.title: Windborne
4947380.short_description: Windborne is a live weather wallpaper and a gentle collection game. It renders global weather as a hand-drawn map — wind streams, rain falls, cyclones turn — and when the right weather arrives, small visitors drift in on the wind for you to spot and collect. No forced interaction, no punishment.

4947410.title: Remy Thornfield: Royal Dreams
4947410.short_description: Set out on an epic journey in this captivating match-3 adventure set in the enchanting realm of Ironhelm. Take on the role of Remy Thornfield, a humble farmer turned heroic Duke, as he sets out to save his beloved Princess Lady Isolde from a dark curse that threatens the kingdom.

4947530.title: Be A Chameleon
4947530.short_description: Save humanity, be the shining light against darkness, and destroy all evil. Not really..... it's a silly sandbox game where you play as a chameleon.

4947540.title: Dependent State: The Last Witness
4947540.short_description: Dependent State: The Last Witness is a single-player narrative action-adventure. As operative Chen Yufei, uncover erased evidence within 72 hours, confront the people tied to the case, and survive escalating chases and fights—then decide what truth remains.

4947550.title: TrueClash
4947550.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

4947560.title: Shield Knight
4947560.short_description: Shield Knight is a pixel-art 2D side-scrolling action game. Master the timing of melee and ranged blocks, counter slashes, arrows, and shockwaves, and fight through fast-paced stages and boss battles to uncover the truth behind the knight order and the monster unrest.

4947850.title: LexiWeave
4947850.short_description: Write words across the board, capture territory, and turn every letter into a clever move. LexiWeave is a strategic word puzzle game where careful planning, sharp vocabulary, and a little risk-taking can transform a few simple words into a sweeping victory.

4948000.title: Moo Who?
4948000.short_description: Can you sound like an animal well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPCs, and make animal sounds into their mic before hunters figure out who is fake.

4948460.title: Monochrome Rainbow
4948460.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

4948470.title: Bugfix Billionaire
4948470.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

4948520.title: Espetero Simulator
4948520.short_description: Become the king of the grill in the world's first Espetero Simulator! Master the art of skewering sardines, control the fire on the sand, and manage the rush hour of a busy chiringuito in the heart of the Costa del Sol. Can you handle the August heat, or will your business go up in smoke?

4948530.title: Rabbits Hunt 2
4948530.short_description: Rabbits Hunt 2 is a point-and-click exploration horror game set in an old Japanese house. With your partner Roppy, investigate a home tied to a family tragedy and follow strange traces toward the truth. No combat, only observation, unease, and quiet J-horror.

4948610.title: Alchi
4948610.short_description: Alchi is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a unique card-mixing system. Slay monsters, unlock distinct characters, and craft outrageously powerful combos by manipulating and mutating your deck!

4948680.title: Mind Against Fate
4948680.genre: Indie, RPG, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4948680.short_description: Mind Against Fate is a turn-based tactical PvP arena RPG combining classic tabletop strategy with deep character builds. Choose your class, customize your gear, manage risks with calculated dice rolls, and outsmart your opponents in intense grid-based duels!

4948750.title: SYNTHS
4948750.short_description: An AI desktop companion who actually talks back. Speak to her out loud - she hears you, thinks, and answers in her own voice, lips moving in real time, in character. She remembers you, reacts to you, and runs entirely on your PC. No scripts. No subscription. She's yours.

4948820.title: Farm Hand
4948820.short_description: A cozy roguelike deckbuilder about creating huge harvest combos! Draft new seeds, discover game-changing synergies, and carefully plan your harvests to maximize your score! Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

4948830.title: StowStow
4948830.short_description: StowStow puts you in a physics-driven warehouse where every box has weight and consequence. Scan cargo, dodge explosions, draft upgrade cards, and build conveyor lines until the chaos runs itself.

4948860.title: Incredibounce
4948860.short_description: Bounce your balls, earn profit, buy and upgrade machine to automate ball bouncing in this short incremental game about bouncing balls.

4948870.title: Blindstep
4948870.short_description: A robot with no forward vision. You can only walk backwards and the moment you turn to look where you're going, the screen goes black. Ten sectors of collapsing floors, hydraulic presses and things that patrol the dark. Every jump is taken blind.

4948890.title: Rocket Rush
4948890.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4948890.short_description: Rocket Rush is a fast-paced QTE rhythm climb where every launch is a fight for altitude. Hit precise prompts, survive hazards, build streaks, upgrade your rocket, and chase the leaderboard as you blast higher into the unknown.

4948950.title: Naval Strike
4948950.short_description: The classic Battleship duel. Hunt the hidden enemy fleet on a phosphor-green radar, watch missiles rain on your own ships, and turn the tide with scout planes, torpedoes and interceptors. Call the square. FIRE.

4948970.title: Delphyr: The Deep Whispers
4948970.short_description: Dig to the last living core of a dead world. Delphyr is a 2D action roguelite where every death sends you home to the family whose bond the Deep cannot break — upgrade with them, then dig deeper. Hand-crafted spells, a grapnel, telekinetic mining magic, and titan bosses await below.

4949010.title: 100 Easy Maths
4949010.short_description: 100 Easy Maths is a minimalist math puzzle game designed to sharpen your mental agility. Solve 100 unique, fast-paced equations across 10 thematic rounds and unlock 100 Steam Achievements, one for every single correct answer!

4949030.title: OurClicker
4949030.short_description: From the creators of OurLife and OurCoven, OurClicker is a brand new clicker game that puts you in charge of an up-and-coming Game Development Studio where all you do is... CLICK!

4949040.title: LockLine
4949040.short_description: LockLine is a fast turn-based tactics game with one simple goal: destroy your enemies with a devastating orbital laser from space. You just have to line up your units, pick a target, and call down the strike. Unfortunately, the enemy is doing the exact same thing. This complicates matters...

4949070.title: Cozy Cookmaster
4949070.short_description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.

4949150.title: SUPERFUTA ⚡️
4949150.short_description: A sudden change throws you into a hidden world of power and danger. Explore a semi-open city, face unique opponents in first-person combat, and shape your path through choices in this adult visual novel (18+) with progression, puzzles, and multiple outcomes.

4949260.title: Silk Road Defenders
4949260.short_description: Get ready for an adventure where you travel across lands to protect caravans. Assemble your team as the leader of the Hunters' Guild. Your party and tower compositions and your boost decisions will determine the destiny of Silk Road.

4949290.title: Dead Prints
4949290.short_description: PSX style psychological horror where you run an overnight print shop. Identify sinister customers, manage print supplies, make copies, and manage your insanity as your mind gets more and more unstable.

4949360.title: Undying Soul
4949360.short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite where you summon fallen heroes to fight beside you. Combine their abilities into broken builds and put relentless bosses in the dirt.

4949370.title: Stacey's Demise - A Prequel to I FORGOT TO TAKE THE CHICKEN OUT OF THE FREEZER
4949370.short_description: A split-screen co-op prequel to I FORGOT TO TAKE THE CHICKEN OUT OF THE FREEZER. Play as Stacey or her creepy dog, walk the dog before Mom gets home, or gear up with guns, car upgrades, sentries, and ally with Fatima to take down the brutal final boss, Um Fatima.

4949390.title: Rilo vs. the machines
4949390.short_description: You are Rilo, a brave armadillo on a mission to free your Amazon friends and destroy the evil machines. Bump and blast your way into the mysterious factory complex using your wits and unique roll skills.

4949420.title: Humbuggest
4949420.short_description: Ziggy wants the crown and will do anything to steal it, even if it means breaking the law by breaking the laws of physics. Manipulate time and solve fourth-wall-breaking riddles in this comedic 2D puzzle-platformer filled with classic pixel art.

4949480.title: Aerovice Frutiger World
4949480.short_description: A relaxing exploration adventure inspired by Frutiger Aero. Wander through dreamcore worlds, backrooms, poolrooms, and liminal spaces, uncover secrets, collect treasures, and experience a nostalgic journey in vibrant 3D.

4949810.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Paris
4949810.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Paris 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4949820.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Orlando
4949820.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Orlando 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

4949860.title: Swimcraft
4949860.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Early Access
4949860.short_description: Turn your own photos into living fishing venues in a cozy angling sim grounded in real watercraft. Snap any water, stock it with fish, tie authentic rigs, read the swim, and land the specimen of a lifetime. Your swim, crafted.

4950050.title: The Magical girl Childhood friend lives Next Door
4950050.short_description: A story-driven romance visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover secrets, and lead to multiple endings with your childhood friend.

4950070.title: Sophical
4950070.short_description: Explore a mysterious interconnected world, collect philosophical cards, build powerful decks, challenge strange characters to card battles, and uncover the secrets of the Hearts in this story-driven adventure.

4950110.title: Wild West
4950110.short_description: Wild West is a unique town-building simulator set in the Wild West. Your family completely controls the town of Tombstone. Sheriff Jeff keeps the peace, Mayor Norman builds the town, and businesswoman Rose runs the shops. Ensure the town’s prosperity and growth, and defend it against enemies.

4950120.title: Influence
4950120.short_description: You are the unseen force steering humanity toward the light of reason — or the abyss of fear. Every tap reshapes a civilization, and dozens of endings remember your choice. All the while, Fjord — your desktop pet — perches on your window and taps in your place.

4950160.title: Nine Winters
4950160.short_description: Go up to the rooftop radio and send a signal into the darkness. Protect the warmth of your only shelter, let the stray cat in, and survive nine increasingly harsh winters in this cozy survival game.

4950190.title: Warix
4950190.short_description: Warix is a fast-paced 1v1 territory capture fighting game set in a dark, microscopic world. Control a glowing cybernetic nanobot, draw trails to claim turf, and destroy your rival in high-speed combat. Parry bullets, steal boost, and outsmart players online or battle a relentless solo AI.

4950240.title: Slutia RPG
4950240.short_description: Slutia: RPG with explicit Adult Sexual Fantasy. Create your custom hero, recruit stunning heroines, and conquer dungeons in strategic turn-based battles.

4950290.title: DINO RUNNER: CHRONICLES
4950290.short_description: DINO RUNNER: CHRONICLES is a fast-paced, procedurally generated 2D platform runner. Test your reflexes as you jump, dodge, and slide through 8 increasingly difficult dimensions. Reach the portal, unlock new skins, and survive the ever-accelerating dash!

4950300.title: Exchange Alley
4950300.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

4950310.title: Saving San Martino
4950310.short_description: A stealth adventure where you spray graffiti to reclaim Sicily from the mafia. Pick locks, tag turf, and build your base on the Mediterranean coast.

4950370.title: Teleportato
4950370.short_description: Teleportato is a janky physics puzzle-solving 2D platformer RPG that lets you bounce, roll, and teleport across the land as a potato with an arsenal of tools! Discover multiple areas, make some friends, learn about potato-breaking lore, and save your potato family from their demise!

4950680.title: DeathSlots
4950680.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Gold --- If you run out of gold you die!! 💀

4950790.title: 缆绳火箭拳
4950790.short_description: *Clutched!* is a 2D side-scrolling steampunk adventure game! Experience the exhilarating fun of physics-based swinging, climbing, and impacts! It's a small, exquisitely crafted indie game, essentially made by one person.

4950880.title: Legend of Deepshade: The Shattered Seal
4950880.short_description: A classic grid-based first-person dungeon crawler. Turn-based combat, deadly puzzles, and 50+ floors of loot-filled dungeons. Inspired by the RPG greats of the 90s.

4950910.title: Xeno Clip
4950910.short_description: A top-down shooter Roguelike. You are a Surveyor mapping a hostile planet: clear rooms, choose your path, and collect Black Boxes that reshape your combat—turning one rifle into chain-reaction clears. Aiming + movement + build-defining items.

4950970.title: MORS
4950970.genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4950970.short_description: Build an automated factory on a true-scale Mars streamed from real NASA terrain. Mine, smelt and belt resources, run trains between outposts, master chemistry, and grow from a lone lander into a planet-spanning industry while the real Martian weather does its worst.

4951830.title: Horse Spirit Valley 2
4951830.short_description: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems, and explore five beautiful worlds in Horse Spirit Valley 2.

4951870.title: KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World - Korea Ver.
4951870.short_description: Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Korea! Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Korean scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.

4952050.title: Primitive Shades
4952050.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Free To Play
4952050.short_description: Explore an abandoned school, solve mysterious puzzles, and survive the strange shape-like monsters you accidentally unleash. What begins as a late-night urban exploration quickly turns into a chaotic fight to escape.

4952090.title: SOLITAIRE.EXE: Klondike with a Slot Habit
4952090.short_description: The solitaire roguelike that wants your soul. Clock in, clear each deal to make payroll, then install cursed floppy-disk plugins to chain outrageous combos. Survive the performance reviews. Get PROMOTED, or get TERMINATED. Klondike, with a slot habit.

4952160.title: Curtain Call in Flames
4952160.short_description: Curtain Call in Flames is a single-player 2D courtroom mystery visual novel set in a traditional Chinese puppet troupe. As defense attorney Bian Bo, investigate a murder, question witnesses, examine evidence, and expose contradictions in court to uncover the truth.

4952170.title: Her Revenge
4952170.short_description: Stuck inside a sealed apartment building, The player has to uncover a massive misunderstanding and save the world.

4952310.title: Memento: What You Forgot
4952310.short_description: Memento is a psychological narrative game with a card-based combat system. You play a man with no memory. Every memory you reclaim becomes a card in your deck, your means to face those who marked you. Walking through eight primary emotions.

4952330.title: Magic Poker
4952330.short_description: A deck-building card game inspired by Blackjack and Texas Hold'em. Build your deck, enchant your cards, and every play demands careful calculation and strategy. Come compete to become the best card player in the tavern!

4952380.title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
4952380.short_description: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

4952400.title: Findport: Before the Silence
4952400.short_description: A cyberpunk detective visual novel where you investigate a hidden signal beneath the city, dive into a digital underworld, and make no-win decisions the game remembers all the way to one of four endings.

4952430.title: Knell
4952430.short_description: A gothic top-down survivor-roguelite. Attack, weave and dodge through undead hordes while picking level-up cards to build your character, then fight a boss at the end of each map. Nine characters, dodge-only defense, run-based roguelite progression.

4952440.title: Slotlocked
4952440.short_description: A short first-person gambling survival game. Trapped in a room for 7 days, use slot machines, gacha prizes, vending supplies, and escape tools to earn coins, survive, and decide whether to leave.

4952490.title: Astral Bounty
4952490.short_description: Astral Bounty is a brutally hard 2D arcade sidescroll shooter straight out of the 90s. Shoot your way through hand-built formations, earn credits as you go, and spend them on upgrades, checkpoints, and revives. One difficulty setting, four ships, no mercy.

4952640.title: OnlyCats
4952640.short_description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

4952650.title: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon
4952650.short_description: Build your dream indie game studio from a tiny office into an industry legend. Hire developers, create games, research engines, survive reviews, fight bugs, decorate your office, and make one more release.

4952780.title: muyu
4952780.short_description: 1. The core of the game is tapping. Every click delivers immersive, relaxing feedback through realistic sound effects and animations. 2. Each tap adds to your "Merit" value. Watching your Merit grow brings a satisfying sense of achievement and ritual.

4952800.title: Ablahshikar
4952800.short_description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

4952830.title: Torovo
4952830.short_description: Investigate the remnants of a forgotten industrial town in this handcrafted open world detective game. Take pictures and use them as evidence against the town’s residents. Track routines, plan your days ahead... and don't inhale the fumes.

4952870.title: Entities Detected
4952870.short_description: Your shift as janitor involves mopping spills and serving coffee to "hard working" scientists. Finish your chores, keep the entities from creating chaos and survive the night using every tool and gadget at your disposal.

4952890.title: Vividly Blank
4952890.short_description: As a mind reader with Aphantasia, Lesly can see into the volatile, extraordinary minds of others—but never her own. Dive into a rich 3D fantasy GL narrative, navigate complex romances, and uncover the truth behind a curse that is both a gift and a blank canvas.

4952960.title: JazzWitch
4952960.short_description: An epic jazz session, a crumbling tower, and dimension breaking portals! Battle against enemies, or musicians?, as you stylishly climb the fragile walls of your sanctuary. Music is magic, right?

4952990.title: Draw It, Forget It
4952990.short_description: Draw prompts in seconds, clear your memory with quick distractions, then decipher your own wonderfully confusing sketches. Play solo or join friends over LAN for voting, shared drawing challenges, and hilarious chains of drawings that drift farther from the original idea.

4953010.title: Sea of Electronica
4953010.short_description: A relaxing simulation game about drifting endlessly across a digital ocean.

4953090.title: Hackagon: Cyber Card Battler
4953090.genre: Indie, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4953090.short_description: HACKAGON is a fast 1v1 cyber card battler. Breach the network with the red team or defend it with the blue team. Cards are played face-down and revealed at the same time, so victory comes from reading your opponent, not moving first. Build your 12-card deck, claim the areas, and take the network.

4953250.title: Pirate Waifu
4953250.short_description: Pirate Waifu is a puzzle game about charming pirate waifus and the spirit of sea adventure. Complete 30 levels, unlock colorful illustrations of girls in pirate costumes, and save all the images in your personal gallery in high quality.

4953280.title: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
4953280.short_description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

4953310.title: Neon Tyrant
4953310.short_description: Neon Tyrant is a co-op vertical shmup where togetherness is a mechanic: fly close to bond shields, rescue downed wingmates under fire, draft run-defining perks. Campaign, endless, daily runs, boss rush — 1-4 pilots, local or online. Flying solo? Hire an AI wingman that learns. Everything glows.

4953340.title: Mars 2099
4953340.short_description: Defend humanity's first Mars colony in this fast-paced modern arcade space shooter. Battle asteroid storms, hostile UFOs, complete challenging missions, and master skill-based gameplay inspired by the golden age of arcade classics.

4953500.title: ZONE 47
4953500.short_description: ZONE 47 is an atmospheric checkpoint inspector simulator set in a quarantined exclusion zone. Inspect documents, uncover contraband, survive deadly emissions, and decide who gets through—and who is turned away.

4953530.title: Couch PVP
4953530.short_description: A split-screen party FPS for 2 to 8 players on the same couch: blast through football, infection, heists, paintball and betting tournaments in low-poly arenas, and settle the score with your friends, controller in hand.

4953560.title: Serve Up!
4953560.short_description: Prepare drinks, burgers, desserts, coffee and more in a 3D fast-food job simulator. Master hands-on cooking stations, progress from worker to manager, and serve orders solo or with up to 4 players.

4953580.title: 永夜协奏曲
4953580.short_description: 这是一部暗黑童话百合视觉小说。世界陷入永恒黑夜，白发少女辛芙拉目睹潮水淹没故乡，无家可归的她踏上了寻找庇护所的旅途。途中，辛芙拉从树上救下了金发女仆玛丽。两人一同前往高塔避难，并逐渐揭开世界陷入永恒黑夜的真相。

4953610.title: Big Bad Pharma
4953610.short_description: A cosy pharmacy-stocking sim with a wicked streak. Clock in, sort the shelves, chase satisfying upgrades, and slowly climb the corporate ladder of a pharmacy that maybe shouldn't exist. Tidy. Satisfying. A little bit evil.

4953630.title: LiLM: Living language model
4953630.short_description: Set out with your AI into an ocean of information. Explore AI-generated worlds, balance existence between convergence and divergence, and nurture questions instead of answers in this idle roguelite observation game. The more you observe, the more your AI transforms.

4953640.title: Shoot Some Rocks
4953640.short_description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

4953670.title: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
4953670.short_description: Trust your team—or read between the lines. Take on five co-op missions with 3–8 players, but one of you is the Spy, quietly steering the team toward failure. Trade excuses, cast suspicious votes, and expose the Spy before they fool everyone.

4953710.title: Typing Show
4953710.short_description: Learn typing in a musical rhythm game with endlessly generated melodies. Each note of the melody turns into a letter. Instead of writing text, practice as if you were playing the piano in a band.

4953800.title: Planet Zombie
4953800.short_description: A retro zombie shooter first-person bullet heaven that descends, level by level. 50 levels deep in 9 acts. 2,800 zombies on screen at once, kills counted per second. A fight against the zombies and for your mind.

4953810.title: Hentai Clicker: Hotaru is streaming
4953810.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Hotaru in Hentai clicker: Hotaru is streaming. Unlock outfits, scenes, upgrades, voice reactions, and playful progression with a très coquine matsuri girl.

4953830.title: Damnatio Lusoris
4953830.short_description: A survivors-like bullet heaven set in a casino of the damned. Mow down thousands of monsters with 25+ auto-firing weapons. Then gamble the spoils: play poker against slain bosses, spin jackpots, drop Plinko chips, and win the run by beating The Dealer at his own table.

4953850.title: Cruzado
4953850.short_description: Cruzado is a medieval action roguelite where you battle relentless hordes, create powerful builds, and prepare between fights. Upgrade your gear, drink potions, romance your companions, and choose every move carefully—one mistake could end your entire run. Are you ready?

4953880.title: Willcaster
4953880.short_description: Draw the path across the cursed grid and cast the spells; your champion walks it, fights, and bleeds by your plan. But the frog is no puppet. He has hungers, moods, and a will of his own. Feed his desires and he trusts you. Overrule him and he may refuse.

4953930.title: Code Cadima
4953930.short_description: Something hostile took over the company while you were gone. Code Cadima is an exploration horror game that captures that eerie feeling of being left all alone in a place where you definitely shouldn't be.

4953940.title: 2D Factory
4953940.short_description: Build a factory from hand-crafted beginnings to a nuclear-powered megabase. Mine, automate, electrify, ride steam trains across deserts and reach the atomic age — alone or in online co-op. A cozy top-down automation game across 5 tiers and 5 biomes.

4953950.title: Arcade Mogul
4953950.short_description: Build the arcade of your dreams in this cozy tycoon sim. Design your floor, place hundreds of games, hire staff to keep the machines running and the crowds happy, redeem prizes, and grow a struggling little arcade and become a mogul! 196 Different Arcade Machines & Attractions.

4954070.title: Elven Desire Ladyboys
4954070.short_description: As a professional wildlife photographer, you boarded a small aircraft. After a catastrophic crash, you awaken in a mysterious village. Your rescuers are beautiful elves. A civilization that has remained hidden for centuries. And a secret: Every elf in this secluded paradise is a ladyboy.

4954150.title: Flotsam Front
4954150.short_description: A real-time naval strategy game set in an alternate-universe archipelago. Design your own warships and aircraft, refine resources to fuel a war economy, then command fleets to launch carrier strikes, hunt submarines, and seize islands.

4954200.title: Plausible Deniability - Cover Your Tracks
4954200.short_description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

4954240.title: My Lovely Nurse
4954240.short_description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

4954270.title: My Clay Planet
4954270.short_description: A cute and cozy desktop game where you care for a tiny clay planet, grow crops, place animals, and jump in to control your little friends as your world lives on your screen.

4954340.title: Line Tower Wars
4954340.genre: Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4954340.short_description: A standalone version of the classic lane-wars custom map. Defend your lane with a maze of elemental towers and send creeps at everyone else.

4954440.title: Hentai Puzzle: Selena
4954440.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Selena: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Selena, a flirtatious tennis player. Progress through the game, unlock images and scenes, and enjoy a playful adult puzzle experience.

4954470.title: Just Cribbage
4954470.short_description: Classic two-handed cribbage, done right. Race to 121 against a provably fair AI that never peeks, from Cozy to Cutthroat. A coach and Academy that make you better, plus Ranked play, cribbage solitaire, daily puzzles, and the Daily Deal. No gimmicks. Just cribbage.

4954480.title: Blame the Wind
4954480.short_description: A turn-based artillery duel across a destructible city skyline. Read the wind, set your angle, and lob a banana — or a baguette, or scalding regret — at your rival. 16 silly fighters to unlock, one-button GIF export, and a hidden CRT mode. No grind, no pay-to-win, no FOMO. Just couch chaos.

4954490.title: Swordoria
4954490.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Free To Play
4954490.short_description: > Command a growing army in a fantasy battler that runs in a strip at the edge > of your screen. Recruit companies, equip every unit, raid rival commanders, > and push through twelve battlefields. No ads. No paywalls. Just the climb.

4954590.title: MoonCraft
4954590.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4954590.short_description: Your landing pod is destroyed and oxygen is draining fast! Explore, mine, craft, and build to survive relentless alien attacks on the dark side of the moon!!!

4954610.title: Bumper Core
4954610.short_description: Bumper Core is a fast-paced arcade physics game where you defend your core by striking incoming shapes into goals. Hit harder for bigger scores, chain combos to multiply them, and survive the escalating storm then build your own levels and share them.

4954660.title: ALPARGUN
4954660.short_description: Join intense cinematic military operations. Infiltrate behind enemy lines with the ALP Squad, complete high-risk missions, and experience modern tactical combat. Developed entirely by a solo developer using Unreal Engine 5.

4954690.title: Marginalia
4954690.short_description: A hex-tactics SRPG where allies and enemies share one turn order—read who moves next and strike before your line breaks. Pick your destination each sortie, but strong enemy patrols roam the map: slip past or fight. Capture the wounded for their gear and rebuild a ruined fort. 90s cel-anime style.

4954710.title: Capsule Carnage: Don't Press That
4954710.short_description: A 2-6 player online party shooter! Capsule dudes, rarity-tiered weapons, dual-wield affixes — and a big red button that drops from the sky. Press it for a 666-point jackpot… or a nuke. Don't press that button. (You will.)

4954780.title: Fifth Tier
4954780.short_description: You're not just the manager — you own the club. Start in the fifth tier with a broke squad and a crumbling ground: set tactics, sign players, build the stadium, keep the board happy. Then sell up, buy a bigger club, and climb again. Five leagues. One long road to the top.

4954790.title: Cold Bloom
4954790.short_description: In an isolated research station buried in snow, a curious girl uncovers secrets, connections, and hidden pleasures. Explore, talk, and unlock intimate moments at your own pace.

4954960.title: Train Trek
4954960.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Strategy, Early Access
4954960.short_description: Tower defense on rails. Wake the last war-train in a steampunk world that needs you: build your armored consist car by car, bristle it with turrets, and harvest fuel on the move as you hold the line across a vibrant frontier. Capture towns, upgrade your train, and follow a lone survivor onward.

4954970.title: No Body No Problem!
4954970.short_description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

4955010.title: De-Extinct Desire
4955010.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set at a de-extinction preserve. As keeper Ansel Weir, face an eight-week countdown to a global unveiling, protect engineered animals, and choose a romance with geneticist Freya, filmmaker Robin, or rancher-vet Shea.

4955040.title: Dragon Hoard Keeper
4955040.short_description: Become the keeper of a dragon's treasure hoard. Read each customer's cryptic request, gather clues, deduce what treasures really are, restore worn relics, and forge new ones from materials you collect. A warm shopkeeping sim — serve customers by day, wander glittering caverns by night.

4955110.title: Baskets and Blooms
4955110.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

4955250.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
4955250.short_description: Survive 100 increasingly dangerous waves in a sci-fi roguelite shooter where every decision shapes your ship. Upgrade your systems, discover powerful relics, forge unique synergies, and uncover the mystery that awaits beyond the Horizon.

4955330.title: Morder
4955330.short_description: Morder is a social deduction, but you have to try your best to cover your tracks and not leave any evidence behind. Unlike most social deductions, you have to plan your murder and create a strategy to help you win. There is also only one detective who can chose who they think the murderer is.

4955360.title: Mechanisms of Mystery: Remastered
4955360.short_description: Try your skill as an escape artist to solve the puzzles and get out of the room!

4955450.title: Effidolum
4955450.short_description: It was a fake — that's exactly why I could love it. Fifteen days of Rei's summer vacation. A first-person "seeing" narrative adventure. Fully voiced (JP/EN/ZH). Playtime: 3+ hours.

4955500.title: Deep Haul
4955500.short_description: Mine a vast, lonely asteroid field at the edge of a giant solar system. Tear ore from drifting rocks, haul it back to the station, and upgrade a rust-bucket into a roaring hauler. Dodge mini-suns, the sun, and a black hole — and clear the whole field to win.

4955510.title: Carlot
4955510.short_description: Build your deck to shape the slot machine's odds and score points with poker hands. Combine a wide variety of cards and relics to create your own build in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelike.

4955590.title: Datum
4955590.short_description: A roguelite quiz deckbuilder where trivia is your weapon. Answer questions across a variety of categories, then combine cards and relics into game-breaking combos. Level up and use meta progression to unlock new cards and craft powerful builds.

4955600.title: Capy of Gods
4955600.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

4955680.title: cargame123
4955680.short_description: 2D physics-based cargo delivery driving game with unlockable time slowing.

4955700.title: Charon 卡戎
4955700.short_description: A point-and-click narrative puzzle game with a delicate art style and soothing pace. In this Underworld at the end of all things, guide souls who lost their memories and speech safely across the Styx. Luckily, our protagonist is about to face the most restless bunch of them all...

4955720.title: Quest 108
4955720.short_description: Quest 108 is a retro party RPG built around pre-battle decisions, automatic combat, and post-battle rewards. Prepare a five-member guild party from 108 characters, set formation, gear, and skills, then watch compact trial battles unfold and grow from the results.

4955880.title: Pizza Man
4955880.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Early Access
4955880.short_description: You are a 23 old man down on his luck, he's living in a dingy apartment, he just lost his girlfriend, and he owes a ton of money to the giant floating head in the sky! But there's a silver lining, Jeff's Pizza just opened down the street and they're looking for delivery drivers!

4955890.title: Smelly Bubbles
