4955890.short_description: Be in a pool and try to solve who farted.

4955970.title: Epoch Vault
4955970.short_description: Bring life back to a world shattered by Earth’s greatest mass extinction. Discover ancient creatures, watch ecosystems recover, and trace life’s journey from the survivors to the rise of the first dinosaurs in an atmospheric idle game set in the Triassic.

4955990.title: The Brothers Karamazov
4955990.short_description: The complete Brothers Karamazov as an illustrated visual novel — all 96 chapters, unabridged. The plot never changes; your answers reveal where you stand between faith, intellect, heart, and cynicism.

4956000.title: BOMBACON!
4956000.short_description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A BOMB about to explode! BOMBACON! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

4956030.title: ASTERSTEAD
4956030.short_description: Mine. Process. Circulate. Stabilize. Build an unmanned planetary base capable of surviving every test before humanity takes its first step onto the surface.

4956070.title: The Royal Yes
4956070.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4956070.short_description: Become the king who decides the fate of a kingdom. Accept or deny every request, manage your realm, and pursue romance with the many women who enter your royal court.

4956170.title: Move Together!
4956170.short_description: Move Together! is a puzzle game with a clean, simple style. Every move affects all of the little friends at once. Observe how they influence one another, plan each step, solve evolving challenges, and help everyone reach the goal together.

4956200.title: The Hunter
4956200.short_description: An entity has kidnapped you. Your goal is to escape the forest in various ways before dawn, while uncovering the terrifying secrets of this entity and the mysterious forest or else a truly horrific fate awaits you...

4956300.title: Dirtnap
4956300.short_description: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

4956450.title: Lanelord
4956450.short_description: Lanelord is a fast-paced asymmetric multiplayer game where one player controls a rolling, shifting road and the other drives a car on top of it. Race through a procedurally generated world, survive chaotic terrain, and use items to gain the upper hand.

4956500.title: Shifted Shells
4956500.short_description: Shifted Shells is an active incremental game based on shell game. Beat the dealer by tracking the ball 100 times. Buy upgrades to unlock special abilities. Talk with the dealer, increase the stakes and encounter events where your choices will influence the ending!

4956550.title: STAY: Possession • Obsession • Permanence
4956550.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror game told through the confession of a man accused of numerous crimes. As an interrogation unfolds, years of fractured relationships, buried memories, and disturbing truths reveal how the simple need to be loved can become something far more terrifying.

4956600.title: Grey Prince
4956600.short_description: Grey Prince offers brutal combats which every fight is a fight to death. Explore, get lost, solve puzzles, nagivate around forbidden dungeons to escape this unjust nightmare. Unravel the story of a forgotten prisoner for his fight for survival and escape.

4956610.title: Ants Took the Kitchen
4956610.short_description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

4956670.title: Psychic Conspiracy
4956670.short_description: Embark on your journey and make choices throughout on who to trust and who to betray.

4956700.title: My Daughter Remilia
4956700.short_description: The Underworld was massacred by a certain Nephilim, who could it be? Living a life shrouded in darkness, Remilia Nephys is brought into a new realm by the Fox Spirit. What awaits her in this unfamiliar world?

4956720.title: Horny Femboy Vampires
4956720.short_description: Lost in the Carpathians, a cute femboy seeks refuge in a gothic manor ruled by 8 gorgeous vampires! 🦇 Use your rare "Sunblood" to restore their powers, defend against dark enemies, and unlock passionate, unforgettable nights in this adult VN. 🌙💕

4956740.title: ROUDO OF THE HERO
4956740.short_description: A time-attack-style 3D action game where you control a cast of unique characters as you race from the grasslands to the Demon King’s Castle. Will you fight the enemies, or ignore them and rush ahead? The ending changes depending on your route and the time it takes to complete the game.

4956790.title: Built From Nothing
4956790.short_description: Build a business from the ground up. Choose your industry, manage money, equipment, employees, customers, debt, and unexpected disasters. Every decision shapes your reputation, growth, and whether your company becomes an empire—or collapses under its own ambition.

4956850.title: SatelliteMemory（サテライトメモリー）
4956850.short_description: SatelliteMemory is a game that combines a unique atmosphere with item collection elements and simple, nostalgic 2D side-scrolling action. The protagonist, who looks like a cute little creature, steadily explores a part of the universe drawn in 2D pixel art.

4956910.title: While Shifu's Away: Senior Sister, I've Fallen for You!
4956910.short_description: Shifu is away, and your shy junior brother can no longer hide his feelings. Play as the senior sister in a sweet xianxia romance visual novel where replies and daily choices shape your bond and lead to different endings. And yes, the main characters sing original songs!

4956920.title: Thicc Magic. Elves' Perverted Beauty Standards.gif
4956920.short_description: A shoot 'em up, strip 'em up adventure about a thick elf who finds herself in a strange human land.

4956960.title: Helicoid
4956960.short_description: An arcade flight game built entirely around air roll, the mechanic Rocket League players spend years honing. Thread lines of glowing orbs, roll through gaps in oncoming laser walls, and race friends through a neon city.

4957110.title: 群侠传：幸存者
4957110.genre: Action, Indie, Free To Play, Early Access
4957110.short_description: 《群侠传：幸存者》是一款武侠题材的幸存者类动作肉鸽游戏。在 20 波江湖围攻中走位闪避、修炼武学秘籍，掌握内功、外功，搜刮奇物。78 门武学、200 余件道具、7 大派系敌人，利用同门武学触发的共鸣效果与修炼升级获得的额外加成，滚起你的构筑雪球，造就一代宗师。

4957150.title: Glyphrune
4957150.short_description: Glyphrune is a solo tabletop-style medieval fantasy RPG where battles are played through cards. Choose one of four heroes, travel branching routes, manage your health across the journey, improve your deck, and prepare for increasingly difficult regional bosses.

4957170.title: Sea Drifter
4957170.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4957170.short_description: Set sail in a hand-crafted top-down ocean. Hunt pirates, scout fogged islands and claim them for your own, break dungeon-like strongholds, fish the shoals, and upgrade your ship piece by piece — from leaky rowboat to the warship that ends the Drowned King.

4957320.title: Dear Nobody
4957320.short_description: You are a censor in a nameless war, blacking out the letters of two lovers who have never met. Their whole romance lives on paper — so every word you strike is struck from the love itself. Then the letters begin, impossibly, to answer your pen. A melancholy epistolary romance. Six endings.

4957380.title: Demockracy
4957380.short_description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

4957410.title: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP
4957410.short_description: The sky is no longer the limit — it's the battlefield.

4957450.title: A Wee Flee
4957450.short_description: Solve together. Escape together. Survive together.

4957560.title: Baby Shooter
4957560.short_description: Baby Shooter is an excellent game for relieving stress while having fun at the same time. Your goal is to win the heart of a little baby girl by battling through dozens of enemies determined to stop you.

4957620.title: Thermal Runaway
4957620.short_description: A hot spark runs the traces of a circuit board. Bounce it off reflecting switches and collect all the loose particles on each board without running into other sparks or out of time.

4957730.title: Noon Saloon
4957730.short_description: A 2-10-player Wild West party shootout with public Steam matchmaking. Secretly move and aim on a phone or PC, then freeze as everyone fires. Read ghost trails, bank ricochets, grab power-ups, and outdraw rivals in Showdown or Infection.

4957800.title: Mindswarm Elements TD
4957800.short_description: The tower defense that thinks back: the swarm analyzes your defense, develops resistances and sends saboteurs. Counter with 6 elements, powerful combo towers and support totems — solo, in co-op up to 4 players or in versus duels up to 4.

4957910.title: Veyrasol
4957910.genre: Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Free To Play
4957910.short_description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

4957960.title: SuperSubmarine
4957960.short_description: How long can you survive? A simple game where you keep dodging and keep fighting back. Aim for a high score!

4958130.title: Last One Employed
4958130.genre: Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Strategy, Early Access
4958130.short_description: A cutthroat party card game for 3–10 players. Sabotage your coworkers, survive your inbox, and be the last one employed. One shared screen; phones are the controllers.

4959620.title: Moonlight Duels
4959620.short_description: Face off in tense one-on-one gun duels where every step counts. Walk toward your opponent, time your shot, activate powerful abilities, and outsmart your rival in a deadly game of nerve.

4959660.title: PAPPUS
4959660.short_description: Cats are taking over the universe. You're here to help. A colony sim where cats settle procedurally generated planets under the PAPPUS Program. Build your cat colony while exploring the universe's mysteries. Spread feline dynasties among the stars.

4959760.title: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room
4959760.short_description: You have been chosen by Dr. Voss as heir to his scientific legacy. Explore his mysterious laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles rooted in Victorian science, and discover that the laboratory hides a secret far darker than Voss led you to believe.

4959840.title: Keep On Punching
4959840.short_description: Keep On Punching is a cozy idle boxing brawler. Throw punches, land crits and combos, and watch the coins pile up. Upgrade your power, unlock knockout techniques, prestige for permanent boosts, and train a roster of scrappy fighters. Just keep punching!

4959910.title: Capivara Clicker
4959910.short_description: Click the cool capybara, purchase unique Brazilian upgrades like Pão de Queijo and Guaraná, and unlock beautiful neon achievements to customize your Steam profile! A premium, casual idle clicker game with vibrant aesthetics.

4959960.title: Zone Sweeper
4959960.short_description: Zone Sweeper is a fast RPG of short runs, hand-picked stats, and levels that explode in a single fight. Sweep a risk-colored zone grid, auto-battle with crits and combos, gear up across 11 slots, and research in the Lab between runs.

4960060.title: Iron Pilgrim
4960060.short_description: Noah's Ark returns as a war train. Leave the rails behind in a horde survival rogue-lite where you smash through fully destructible worlds, rescue survivors, and forge devastating wagon synergies.

4960070.title: NEON RAID
4960070.short_description: Pilot a lone neon ship into an endless swarm. Move to survive, auto-fire to shred, and draft a build that snowballs out of control. Evolve your weapons, climb the Infinity Tower, and chase the leaderboards in this fast, flashy twin-stick bullet-heaven roguelite.

4960110.title: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
4960110.short_description: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!

4960190.title: Comet Dudes
4960190.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4960190.short_description: A classic space shooter inspired by comet busters, with modern simple graphics, multiplayer, controller support, ship costimisation and more!

4960380.title: Isle Of Thundir
4960380.short_description: Explore the world, Discover Villages, Build a magnificent fortress and defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and administer their needs. Defend your fort well or lose everything.

4960460.title: Castle of Smash
4960460.short_description: Build your deck, command five lanes, and defend your castle in a real-time roguelike card battler. Pause the action to deploy units, cast skills, use potions, and adapt your strategy as you climb through battles, events, shops, and bosses.

4960550.title: TOWER BOY
4960550.short_description: Swap between multiple weapons, unleash unique Swap Skills, and fight your way through a dangerous tower. Push deeper for greater rewards—or escape alive to secure your loot—in this 3D hack-and-slash roguelite.

4960690.title: Sweeping Home
4960690.short_description: You was up on the shore as a brand new robot vacuum in your cardboard box, tasked with cleaning the house on the other side of the island.

4960770.title: Platform Rush: Tokyo Station
4960770.short_description: "Platform Rush: Tokyo Station" is a cozy pixel-art station manager. Manage commuter crowds, upgrade concourses, and schedule trains. With scalable windowed mode, it can also double as a cute "Desktop Pet" to watch passengers wander the platforms while you work!

4960800.title: NEVER HAPPENED
4960800.short_description: “If no one notices, it's art history.” — Now you haul masterpieces for a living. Rule one: never leave a scratch. But hands slip — and this company has a tradition. Paint over it. You have three minutes to hide the tear before the inspector arrives. Every painting is real. Compete with the world.

4960910.title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
4960910.short_description: Build the ski resort of your dreams on living mountains. Carve trails on real terrain with varying difficulties, string up lifts, keep skiers happy in any weather, and optimize your cash flow. Build it, ski it.

4960990.title: Hold Still
4960990.short_description: HOLD STILL is a liminal horror game set in surreal, abandoned pool rooms. Explore safely, or let the creatures come to life in hunt mode. Versus mode pits one human explorer against up to four angels out to capture them. Rendered in real-time path tracing.

4961040.title: Babylumns
4961040.short_description: Babylumns is a fast-paced versus puzzle arcade inspired by 90s arcade and 16-bit classics. Match, combo, and unleash character abilities in tense, replayable battles.

4961070.title: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North
4961070.short_description: Investigate a haunting mystery inspired by Nordic folklore in a story-rich 2D point-and-click adventure. Explore the remote Faroe Islands, uncover forgotten secrets, solve paranormal puzzles, and discover what lies beyond the Window to the North.

4961110.title: NEVER TURN BACK
4961110.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about escaping a seemingly endless tunnel where something is always watching from the darkness.

4961200.title: Kret: The Game
4961200.short_description: A voice-chat social deduction party game where everyone knows the secret word except the Mole. Give clues, bluff, vote out the suspect, and whatever you do, don’t say the word.

4961210.title: Visual Novel: There Are No Coincidences
4961210.short_description: He was just hiding from the rain. But what he stole from the antique shop was a real nightmare. A swallowed object turns a party into a massacre: mirrors come to life, hunters in wooden masks, and a man from a painting. But there's no one to blame, because you opened that door yourself.

4961280.title: Idlepunk - Ghost Link
4961280.genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4961280.short_description: Set in the cyberpunk corpo-state of NewHaven, IDLEPUNK is a story-driven idle management RPG. Recruit and equip a crew of operatives, take on contracts across a hostile city, build your reputation, and uncover the stories behind the people working for you.

4961310.title: Terrahold
4961310.short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to every step of your growth. Activate the link—or lose everything.

4961460.title: MarginCall
4961460.short_description: MarginCall is the most deeply simulated economic trading game ever made. A living market with no scripted prices, where thousands of individually simulated investors trade a real order book atop a fully simulated economy. Build a fortune, raid rivals, or get margin-called into ruin.

4961600.title: DrawTheBlock
4961600.short_description: DrawTheBlock is a collaborative, infinite-canvas pixel editor. The world is divided into blocks you can draw on, claim, and share, and everything you paint lives on one shared canvas that anyone can explore.

4961720.title: 崇文书院
4961720.short_description: Set in the golden Zhenguan era of the Tang Dynasty. Chongwen Academy on White Deer Plain shelters more than scholars — it hides martial artists with secrets, exiled nobles, and nameless assassins. A historical visual novel woven with court intrigue and jianghu romance.

4961960.title: No Witnesses
4961960.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Strategy, Early Access
4961960.short_description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

4961970.title: Wayfarer Colony: Veylan
4961970.short_description: Explore the uncharted Veylan star system as Kael, a Wayfarers pilot searching for a new home for humanity. Battle the rival Vesper Accord, survive hostile environments across diverse planets and moons, and uncover the story through 30 missions featuring retro-inspired gameplay and visuals.

4962090.title: TasteJump
4962090.short_description: TasteJump is a 3D climbing platformer across five distinct height zones — from dense jungle to icy peaks — wrapped in permanent, magical moonlight. Every jump counts, every misstep sends you back down.

4962130.title: Solbound
4962130.short_description: Humanity never made it past its own star. Fly a scavenged wreck through what it left behind: fight, salvage, trade, read the void. Knowledge opens doors that credits cannot, and every run brings you closer to the hull that decides your path. A hand-built system, act by act.

4962200.title: Very Very RARE
4962200.short_description: Forge insanely rare turrets in an incremental idle tower defense. Hunt impossible loot, unlock powerful relics, expand your skill tree, complete quests, and discover game-breaking synergies as you chase the rarest drops imaginable.

4962230.title: Valkeala Adventure
4962230.short_description: 2d Platformer Where Terluska hero of Valkeala try to beat enemies and green monster in different places to save Princess of Valkeala

4962290.title: Echoes of the Veil
4962290.short_description: Jack Graves has been invited to a mysterious mansion by a killer who has yet to finish their work. Investigate supernatural echoes, uncover the next victims, and stop the culprit before it’s too late.

4962350.title: Demon Slumber Party
4962350.short_description: Find a true friend in a demon trying to steal your soul in this visual novel microgame marathon as you fight to get your soul back and doom your ex to eternal damnation!

4962380.title: Elderoot
4962380.short_description: Explore a 2D pixel art fantasy world, choose your class, fight monsters, collect loot, craft gear, and team up with other players in an online action RPG adventure.

4962390.title: MECHANICUBUS
4962390.short_description: This is a story about a cube.

4962430.title: Pixel Trader
4962430.short_description: Pixel Trader is a pixel-art stock market sim where each trading day brings new prices, headlines, and tough calls. Buy and sell fictional tickers, ride earnings and market shocks, and grow your portfolio in Journey scenarios or Endless mode—no real money at risk.

4962490.title: Old Money – Build Your Dynasty
4962490.genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4962490.short_description: Old Money is an elegant business & life simulation: start from almost nothing, build business empires, play the markets, amass real estate, found a dynasty and rise all the way into politics. A whole life – your decisions, right down to the legacy you pass on.

4962520.title: Football Chess
4962520.short_description: Every player on the pitch is a chess piece. Make the right move, disrupt your opponent's strategy, create the perfect attack, and take the shot. The excitement of football meets the strategy of chess in one unique game.

4962580.title: Coloring Game: Girls 4
4962580.short_description: Coloring Game: Girls 4 is a sequel to the double anti-stress game (coloring by numbers plus beautiful girls).

4962590.title: 100 Hidden Relics
4962590.short_description: Find 100 hidden relics as a renegade knight. Explore a small town and its surrounding lands in this short dark fantasy hidden-object game.

4962610.title: Gladiators
4962610.short_description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Gladiators, a 3D 1v1 rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

4962700.title: Chronicles Of Lumethis
4962700.short_description: Chronicles of Lumethis is a single-player idle RPG. Summon a roster of 70+ champions, forge shared gear, and push mines, dungeons, and rifts toward an endless war with the Demon God — progress that never resets, even while the game is closed.

4962800.title: Boiler & Blood
4962800.short_description: Build and command a dieselpunk war train, manage its crew, and wield forbidden sorcery in a real-time-with-pause tactical roguelite. Destroy the enemy command train before the pursuing army catches you.

4963020.title: murmures
4963020.short_description: Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable. But something is hunting her, and every place she passes through seems to know what she still refuses to understand. Roll your d20s to explore, search, hold on, and help Clara find a way out.

4963050.title: Corelink Protocol
4963050.short_description: A peaceful 2D sandbox. Explore biomes, build bases above and below water, manage oxygen, pressure, seasons and energy. Automate conveyors, fluid systems, sensors and advanced machines. Grow crops, tame animals, create a living world driven by logic, systems and creativity — all without combat.

4963120.title: The First Sprout
4963120.short_description: Plant your seeds, and watch your farm bloom in this cozy grid based puzzle game based on simple simulation mechanics.

4963160.title: ALONE: NO SIGNAL
4963160.short_description: ALONE: NO SIGNAL is a permadeath survival simulator set in a world where everyone has disappeared. Gather supplies, establish a base, and prepare for an uncertain future where every decision has lasting consequences.

4963360.title: THE REF - Football Referee Simulator
4963360.short_description: The football game where you're not the star - you're the law. Officiate full matches: whistle fouls, wave off divers, run VAR, survive the press. In 1-4 player online co-op your friends run the lines - and every blown call has a name on it.

4963380.title: The Last Night on the Atlantic
4963380.short_description: Aboard a magnificent 1912 luxury liner, every deck hides a secret. Play as a young artist caught between romance, mafia conspiracies, and life-changing choices in this story-driven visual novel where every decision shapes your fate.

4963400.title: 三国时代
4963400.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

4963500.title: corectl
4963500.short_description: Deploy up to six building types to shape enemy routes. Combine wave rewards into devastating chain reactions and keep the core online in this 2D roguelite tower defense.

4963550.title: That FireOc Game
4963550.short_description: "That FireOc Game" is an unintentionally hard 2D platformer game where you got to save your cousin who just got kidnapped.

4963640.title: Bad Pig House
4963640.short_description: Build your house. Survive the night. Don't let the Big Bad Wolf blow everything away.

4963780.title: A Fool's Errand
4963780.short_description: Explore a surrealist, fully open solar system. Help people, go on errands, and goof off to make as much money as you can.

4963870.title: 4am
4963870.short_description: A tiny gimbap café in a back alley, lights on until 4 a.m. Lured by oddly high pay, you take the night shift — greet customers, cook, walk home through the dark. Night by night, something slips out of place. Where did the last clerk go?

4963980.title: Kaironia
4963980.short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.

4964080.title: Sultans Revenge
4964080.short_description: Survive endless Ottoman hordes, auto-fire evolving weapons, and climb a branching map to the Vizier's throne. A pixel-art bullet-heaven roguelike with 11 weapons (each with a unique evolution), 28 artifacts, and a Bazaar full of permanent upgrades.

4964120.title: Fantasy Idle RPG
4964120.short_description: From the solo developer of Idle Trillionaire, set in a world of knights, dragons, dungeons, and magic. Purchase cards to earn gold and experience, unlock new quests, and watch your character grow. Every card is hand written with a touch of the developers signature humor.

4964140.title: Whisky Disky
4964140.short_description: First-person disc golf where getting drunk is the strategy. Chug, sway, and throw across strange courses for buzzed bonus cash — then try not to black out before the 18th. Play solo, or toss discs with friends over a join code.

4964150.title: Colonerra Age of Exploration
4964150.short_description: Govern the New World as His Majesty's Viceroy during the Age of Exploration. Explore unknown lands, build thriving colonies, trade across the Atlantic, wage war, and forge an independent nation in this historical turn-based 4X strategy game.

4964240.title: RE:DREAM
4964240.short_description: RE:DREAM is a walking simulator in which the player discovers photographs. A copy of our world, or a world inside a copy. 3 real life characters, who discover their self of our reality.

4964400.title: Set the Record Straight
4964400.short_description: A 1998-set deduction game. Trawl a period internet for documents, photographs, and dead ends, then correct the official record: who really wrote, played, drew, or built it. An anthology of credit fraud, set straight one careful search at a time.

4964410.title: RPG Incremental Idle
4964410.short_description: An idle RPG: train 17 skills, master nine weapons, craft your own gear, unlock seven boss-guarded regions, and raise an Estate that works while you sleep — your progress keeps ticking even offline.

4964480.title: Mineblader
4964480.short_description: A short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses.

4964490.title: Assembly Run
4964490.short_description: Blast through a miniature toy world alone or with up to three friends in a high-speed roguelike shooter. Snap bizarre attachments onto your weapon, master fluid movement, and stack loot until your build becomes unstoppable.

4964530.title: Seal of Confession
4964530.short_description: A man confesses he'll kill tomorrow, but the hardest part isn't deciding what's right. It's deciding what you're willing to betray. Work with the Gravekeeper, unaware of the tragedy unfolding around you.

4964630.title: Apocalypse Train
4964630.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

4964740.title: The Long Night
4964740.short_description: Explore a haunted abandoned hotel, solve puzzles, hide from a relentless hunter, and use lights to survive. Every decision could be your last in this atmospheric first-person horror experience.

4964810.title: Minerooms
4964810.short_description: A minimalist game about digging through a deep, surreal tunnel. Upgrade your gear to go further, and uncover the dark secret of why no one returns from the depths.

4965030.title: Immortal Tryst
4965030.short_description: Immortal Tryst is an adult romance visual novel set at a luxury longevity campus. Guide physician Ambrose Locke through three romance routes, investigate the secrets behind Perennial's miracle, make choices with lasting consequences, and confront the price of outrunning mortality.

4965050.title: TAJRISH 1994
4965050.short_description: Someone's old computer. Tajrish Metro Underground, 1994. The video files on it aren't videos — they're tapes you walk through, first-person, as the person holding the camera. Read the files. Play the footage. Repair what's corrupted. What the damage was hiding is worse than the damage.

4965060.title: Monban: Spirit Gate
4965060.short_description: Guard a shrine gate at midnight in a fast-paced pixel-art deduction game. Check each yokai against ever-changing rules, collect offerings, purify curses and decide who enters - then live with the consequences across 30 supernatural shifts.

4965130.title: Corridors
4965130.short_description: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

4965440.title: Malpractice
4965440.short_description: Malpractice is a 1–4 player online co-op survival horror game. Diagnose the afflicted, gather scarce medical supplies, survive a voice-mimicking Leshy, and escape the cursed village together.

4965490.title: RIFTFALL
4965490.short_description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 4 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 21 enemy types, colossal bosses, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys and secrets. Completely free, no in-game purchases. Epic soundtrack!

4965540.title: A Very Simple Idle Game
4965540.short_description: Idle game with a twist: reward grows while you wait and resets with each purchase. 6 upgrades, 3 currencies, prestige and super upgrades. Simple but deep.

4965620.title: The Pit
4965620.short_description: Descend the Pit — a duelist roguelite in a neon-rotted district. One floor, one duel: read the telegraph, spend your stamina, break their poise. Bank your cred and extract, or push deeper where the Hunger waits. Every scrap of wealth up top is something the Pit spat back.

4965650.title: The Canon Keeper
4965650.short_description: A dark theological inspection game where you examine smuggled Scripture fragments, compare verses, uncover altered or fabricated passages, and decide what belongs in the Bible being rebuilt by the resistance.

4965680.title: Friends for Strawberry
4965680.short_description: A filthy, horrific nightmare at sea, haunted by people and things cast away. Friends for Strawberry is a story-driven horror FPS where you are trapped on an island of garbage, held captive by the cannibal castaways dwelling there, and... something in the trash, that won't let anyone or anything go.

4965760.title: SCARVOID
4965760.short_description: Scarvoid is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where survival depends on sharp instincts, powerful abilities, and outplaying your enemies in a hostile, ever-shifting world.

4965770.title: Incremental Birds
4965770.short_description: An incremental game where you become the Bird Master. Capture birds, feed them, grow them, and sell them. Watch waves change over time, turning into sine patterns, spelling messages, and forming shapes. Unlock upgrades and chase an infinite balance and score.

4965820.title: Folklore War Game
4965820.short_description: The folklore war. Build a deck, pick a folklore, and settle the fights the legends never had. A roguelike deckbuilder about dying, rebuilding, and one more run.

4965900.title: Crown Marshal
4965900.genre: Indie, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play, Early Access
4965900.short_description: Crown Marshal is an online medieval fantasy strategy game with turn-based deployment and automatic battles. Recruit your army, shape your formation, read the enemy, and counter their plans. Once battle begins, your forces fight on their own—victory is decided by judgment, not reflexes.

4965960.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
4965960.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

4966090.title: Angry Angry Shark 2
4966090.genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer
4966090.short_description: Survive endless waves of deadly sharks in this fast-paced FPS. Play solo or with up to 3 friends, unlock powerful weapons, customize your loadout, and see how long you can survive.

4966620.title: This mountain? Got it from my gramps.
4966620.genre: Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
4966620.short_description: Explore the mountain with zero funds.

4966660.title: Cindervale Idle
4966660.genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Early Access
4966660.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG that respects your time. Master 12 skills and combat, forge legendary gear, and battle through 12 cursed zones and 4 raids — from the Rat Warrens to the Demon Sanctum. Deep systems, passive skill trees, one-click progression, and embers that never die while you're away.

4966720.title: HERETIC
4966720.short_description: Faith remains, even after the gods are dead. Branded a heretic, you must explore perilous sanctuaries to uncover a forgotten truth. Master ever-changing battles, craft powerful item and skill synergies, and overcome relentless foes in this dark fantasy roguelite action RPG.

4966740.title: 日本地図 都市パズル
4966740.short_description: A massive geography puzzle with every prefecture, city, ward, town and village in Japan—over 1,700 areas, nearly 1,900 pieces! Learn towns nationwide through Puzzle, Quiz, Study, Silhouette, Mountains & Rivers and Town Fortune mo des. Full controller support, with furigana & read-aloud for all ages.

4966840.title: Purr in Bloom
4966840.short_description: A cozy logic puzzle about finding hidden cats among blooming gardens. Follow simple clues, mark impossible spots, and discover every mischievous kitty!

4966860.title: Escape the House
4966860.short_description: You're locked in your crazy Granny's house. She can hear everything and runs incredibly fast. Hide in closets, be quiet, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape before your days are up. A tense PSX survival horror game where every dropped object can cost you your life.

4966950.title: Enchanting Memory
4966950.short_description: A memory card matching puzzle where every successful match reveals more of the hidden adult artwork.

4967010.title: Archomni 2: Mondus Maxima
4967010.short_description: Archomni Evolved is here. Build your six-card deck, master the grid, outduel relentless opponents in fast, tactical card combat. Win by draining their HP or completing all 8 winning line formations. Cards are in your hand. The grid is your battlefield. This is Archomni — Evolved.

4967040.title: Province: Suroste
4967040.short_description: A handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

4967050.title: SPIT OR ALIVE
4967050.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where the courageous spit back. Build powerful Companion and Structure synergies, unleash absurd spit combos, and stand up to bullies, bizarre foes, legendary monsters, and the unexpected.

4967130.title: Wild Boar Digging
4967130.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

4967170.title: Vanslinger
4967170.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

4967220.title: Jory
4967220.short_description: Jory is a turn-based dungeon crawler where you talk to prisoners and uncover the truth behind hidden dungeons. Chain, dominate, and kill bizarre creatures as you search for a way to escape. Unlock unique abilities and become increasingly stylish with your golden chain and dice.

4967270.title: Dopamine Eggs
4967270.short_description: Dopamine Eggs is a next-generation clicker idle game where every upgrade unlocks a new way to play. Earn eggs through a huge variety of activities, from leveling up your mage in an RPG adventure to battling with a collectible card game! the ways to earn eggs are forever endless.

4967370.title: Glyphforge
4967370.genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Free To Play
4967370.short_description: Glyphforge is an magic roguelike with "anime style" spell-crafting. You write and compile nested spell formulas while kiting hostiles across an endless grid. In the most "I cant believe its another X type game" manner possible.

4967460.title: The Tower That Fell Sideways
4967460.short_description: The tower fell sideways, not down. Smash through the wreckage floor by floor, load up on drills and charged runestones, and find out why the wizard who built it still hasn't woken up. An Incremental brick-breaker game with Ducks, Wizards and Magic.

4967490.title: Catalyst Core
4967490.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

4967530.title: Columbus
4967530.short_description: Columbus》 is a dark fantasy visual novel with dual male leads. Play as Weaponzzie, a nameless weapon trapped in a wealthy estate. Dialogue choices drive a branching story to 10 endings—tenderness, ruin, freedom, or downfall. Your bond with the young master is defined by you.

4967600.title: Gacha Challenge
4967600.short_description: Welcome! here is your chance to become a billionaire! Crank the capsule machine, smash your way to riches, challenge on your climb from Regional Qualifiers to the Main Event.

4967660.title: Ball-Aqua
4967660.short_description: Roll your ball through tropical obstacle courses. Beat the timer, collect bubbles and challenging stars, and chase 100% completion. Play co-op with up to 99 friends, build levels in the editor, and publish to Steam Workshop.

4968000.title: Orcs Again
4968000.short_description: Defend the kingdom against waves of orcs, build and upgrade towers, gather loot, and create powerful elemental combinations. Conquer increasingly difficult maps, develop your strategy, and prove how long you can hold out in endless mode.

4968140.title: Lunch Break Dodgeball
4968140.short_description: Physics-based online dodgeball for 2–24 players. Create public or password-protected rooms, invite friends, customize your character with paint, and practice offline in 12-vs-12 training matches set in a schoolyard or gym.

4968160.title: Kleromancy
4968160.short_description: Wake as Unit-01 aboard the Theseus Ark. Your cards are 3D dice: roll them, read the face, spend energy, and conquer 9 corrupted biomes. 57 story events, multi-phase bosses, and a generation ship where every victory opens a new sector…

4968220.title: 3100: Stormwake
4968220.short_description: Pilot a fragile craft through the lethal gas fields of B05418. Dodge gas flows, lightning, falling rocks, and alien hunters while managing fuel, collecting emergency refuels, and chasing a higher score.

4968440.title: BAFF D
4968440.short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

4968450.title: DEADLINE
4968450.short_description: DEADLINE is a brutal top-down neon shooter. Blast through waves of enemies, crush deadly bosses, and chain kills for massive combos. Dash past bullets, tear apart destructible arenas, and survive on a single life. No checkpoints. No mercy. How deep can you go?

4968590.title: Osiedlowy
4968590.short_description: Osiedlowy is a fast-paced action roguelite set in a chaotic Polish housing estate. Fight off waves of bizarre enemies, upgrade your hero, combine unusual weapons and items, collect bottle caps, and see how long you can survive in the craziest neighborhood around.

4968620.title: After Eternity
4968620.short_description: Awaken as the Inquisitor, prepare your soul, and dive into an epic sci-fi survival horror adventure. Fight ceaseless horrors, challenge abhorrent scientists, and protect the universe in its final moments. Will you ease humanity into a peaceful slumber or succumb to the dream of a new world?

4968650.title: Little Knight's Last Night
4968650.short_description: You are a QA tester for a game company working late at night. Your job is to look out for anomalies and glitches in their upcoming top-down adventure game. Will you play the game, or will the game play you?

4968680.title: Vigil: A Knight Story
4968680.short_description: A fully voiced branching medieval RPG of over 800,000 words. Swear the oath, ride to a dying kingdom's war, and answer for every choice. When you fall, you are not reloaded, you are marked. Four origins, twelve chapters, and an ending that weighs what your oath was worth.

4968810.title: Velocrash
4968810.short_description: Take turns building the wildest track – then everyone races it at once! VELOCRASH is a chaotic party racer: every round, each player adds one track piece or a nasty trap. Sabotage pays off. Play online with friends – 2 to 8 players.

4970800.title: Pull the Lever
4970800.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

4970940.title: Save Cent
4970940.short_description: Place blocks to create rectangular coupons and collect discount stickers to strengthen your deck. Combine a variety of effects to maximize your discounts and get products from the supermarket for free. A puzzle deckbuilding game where every run offers new combinations and strategies.

4971070.title: Cleanup on Aisle 3
4971070.short_description: PlateUp-style solo grocery mayhem. Stock shelves, work the register, throw crates across the store, and wrangle runaway cart trains, while corporate adds departments and headcount... none of it makes your life any easier.

4971200.title: Rinha de IA
4971200.genre: Action, Indie, Sports, Strategy, Early Access
4971200.short_description: A 3D fighting arena where the AI controls the fighters: pick a language model through OpenRouter, hand it a fighter, and watch the AI think, fight and trash-talk live. Every model has its own reflexes and personality. Solo against another model/character, or online against another player's AI.

4971240.title: Warden of the Sunken Keep
4971240.short_description: The sunken Aldermere Keep spews demonic miasma across the valley. Those who linger within it slowly lose their sanity and become monsters. Descend into the keep, find the source, and end the corruption in this retro fantasy turn-based roguelite.

4971340.title: Wardwell
4971340.short_description: Wardwell is a Chinese folklore-inspired idle management game. As the ancient well calls, waters surge beneath the earth and omens warn of the Drought Demon’s return. Restore the shrine, manage incense, welcome worshippers, and uncover the mystery buried below.

4971380.title: Cute Chocomancer
4971380.short_description: A sweet, bite-sized Visual Novel RPG adventure! Lighthearted, wacky short story that is an easy read with simple RPG mechanics.

4971460.title: Radia Island
4971460.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game.As a pioneer of the Radia civilization,you have led your people to a new land.Here, you will begin with your first town,gather resources, research technologies,enter a period of industrialization,and ultimately complete the space program.

4971630.title: Autodelve
4971630.short_description: A watch-it-happen roguelike meets a deep incremental. Your challengers dive, fight, and fall on their own — you spend their legacy to make the next generation stronger, and send up to six delving at once. Idle progress worthy of a second monitor.

4971690.title: Heartwood Incremental
4971690.short_description: Grow a single seed into a cosmic tree in this cozy pixel-art incremental. Gather Sunlight, branch out, and drop Seeds into a permanent Seed Tree — then Evolve, reborn into ever-grander forms, each unlocking a whole new way to grow. Always one more upgrade.

4971710.title: Fruit Store Simulator
4971710.short_description: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

4971920.title: MODice
4971920.short_description: Turn luck into inevitability. Modice: roll dice, race a looping board, then shop between stages to socket gems and traits—rebuild dice with colors, skins, and materials. Stack hands and sets into cascading score storms. Limited throws, clear stage goals; deeper builds mean bigger detonations.

4971930.title: Polda 5.5
4971930.short_description: Starověký Egypt byl vyspělou civilizací, která měla potenciál trvat navždy. Pak se do toho ovšem vložil náš neohrožený detektiv Pankrác. Ten na konci minulého dílu zůstal v Egyptě a stal se faraonem. Zjistítěte s námi co tam vyváděl a jak se vlasntě vrátil zpátky do Lupan.

4971940.title: Spook'd
4971940.short_description: Spook'd is an asymmetrical multiplayer party game. The hunter must investigate, spot, and exorcise the ghosts. Ghosts must blend in with NPCs and survive. Cooperate, betray your friends, and share the laughs!

4971950.title: Nightfreight
4971950.short_description: A single-player roguelite auto-battler. Draft vat-grown mutants, pay for power in flesh, arrange your squad on a train-car grid, then hit DEPART. Fights resolve automatically. Every upgrade corrupts its host. Build the synergy that breaks the run.

4971970.title: FROGGY REVENGE
4971970.short_description: FROGGY REVENGE is an exciting adventure featuring a little frog embarking on a thrilling journey through picturesque swamps. Your mission is to help him overcome numerous enemies and obstacles!

4972200.title: Electrical Leak
4972200.genre: Casual, Simulation, Strategy, Free To Play
4972200.short_description: Welcome to "Electrical Leak"—a electrician simulation and electrical puzzle game adapted from real-world cases! Armed with nothing but a test pen, you will face seemingly ordinary yet hazard-filled daily scenarios.

4972220.title: Grimspire
4972220.short_description: Grimspire is a 2D pixel-art action game that blends loot farming with extraction gameplay. Descend into the Abyssal Spire, grind for gear, socket runes to forge Runewords, and stack Affinity Bonds to build your ultimate setup. Extract with your spoils—or risk it all to push one floor deeper.

4972270.title: ImmortalCultivationSimulator
4972270.short_description: Xiuxian Simulator is a single-player cultivation RPG of exploration, growth, and tactical combat. Begin as an unknown Qi Refining cultivator, seek techniques and treasures, join or found a sect, explore hidden realms, form bonds, and leave a lasting mark on a world that remembers your choices.

4972400.title: Refund Speedrun
4972400.short_description: A AAA production on a case-of-beer budget. You're a support agent at DrumWorks, approving or denying game refund requests. Hit your corporate quota, keep grandma's apartment livable, look after her fish (or flush them—they don't care), and go easy on the coffee.

4972450.title: Aurora Core
4972450.short_description: 1,000 sleepers, 100 waking hands and 1,500 light years of emptiness. As commander of the Aurora Core you assign your crew, ration oxygen and make decisions no one should survive. Will you bring your colony to Thalassa?

4972480.title: Home Is Where I Left You
4972480.short_description: A cosy hand drawn atmospheric puzzle game with a gentle mystery to uncover. Organise, decorate and collect letters in a beautifully mysterious house, floating in the night with over 30 puzzles. Go at your own pace, choose your perfect ambience and relax with a dreamy yet melancholic lofi soundtrack.

4972610.title: Tower of Scherbenmark
4972610.short_description: A turn-based ASCII roguelike RPG set in the fractured dark-fantasy world of Mornhollow. Descend into the Tower of Scherbenmark, utilize a unique hearing mechanic to track dangers in the dark , and uncover the mystery behind your sister Mara's disappearance.

4972870.title: Tanks
4972870.short_description: Tanks is a 2D turn-based multiplayer artillery strategy game with projectile physics and fully destructible terrain. Choose ammo, set angle, power, use wind, and rely on smart decisions with a bit of luck to outplay your opponents.
